neighborhood_overview: Pyrmont is mostly known by outsiders as that one suburb in Sydney with a casino in it. That’s a bit of an unfortunate reputation because the folk that live around here know just how charming and spectacular the booming area can be. By the water there’s newly developed park land that shows off the Sydney’s incredible sandstone cliffs and high-end dining establishments that feed the city’s power offices (both (Hidden by Airbnb) and Fairfax are in the wharfs). Further inland there’s hip cafes like Clementine’s and Miam and a surprisingly multicultural food scene - try Kopitiam for Malaysian, Vic’s Meats for American barbecue, and Willis Canteen for Indonesian.       Then there’s the big draws, the Fish Markets and the Casino itself – not for gambling though, simply because it contains some of best restaurants in Sydney.

reviews.comments: The location was perfect for our needs and the apartment was quiet.  The check in did not go well as we weren't told which apartment it was and the key had to be collected from another location over 1km away which we didn't know either until we got there, and had sent the uber off.  The listing says there is a key safe but they didn't use it for us.  The host wasn't contactable either despite calling the 24 hr number a couple of times and leaving messages, so the whole process took about an hour and a half.  The apartment is tiny and is more of a bedsit rather than having a separate bedroom.  This also made me wonder about the very expensive $170 cleaning fee.
Great apartment with walking distance to bus stops and cafes. The property is very safe with the access control system. Suitable for the girls. Nice and helpful staff.

Very clean and well put together apartment. Would suit a longer stay. I was on a business trip so just needed a bed. The location is amazing.  Comfy bed. Lots of additional amenities to make your stay more comfortable.

The apartment was super clean and had a lot of conveniences.  There is no view to speak of but we only slept there so that wasn't such a big deal. Quiet street. Great washer/dryer for use. Good amenities. Beware of the footboard on the bed- it sticks out beyond the mattress and loves to bite your shins. The biggest headache was the check in process; we arrived a bit late and had to check in at a hotel that was kind of far away - especially when dragging our luggage uphill most of the way late at night. Also, do NOT get on the elevator - in our jet lagged state we failed to notice the lettered-wing and got on the elevator only to get stuck for 10 minutes... especially concerning as the emergency button didn't seem to work. You'll be on the first floor; door was open and unlocked when we arrived but for the rest of the visit it was locked when arrived to add to security.

The location of the unit is within the Darling Harbour area and only a ten-fifteen minute walk from the Central business district. Near a park and many businesses and restaurants. neighborhood_overview: This studio is located only 10 minutes walk away from Kirribilli Village, a suburb that not only houses our Prime Minister but offers a variety of lovely cafes, patisseries, bars and spectacular waterfront harbour views.  From Kirribilli, you only need to walk 5 minutes further to visit Sydney Luna Park, or take a walk across the iconic Sydney Harbour Bridge, taking you to the city in just under 30 minutes.  Also 10 minutes walk away is North Sydney CBD, a bustling business district offering supermarkets, cafes, restaurants, shopping malls, hair dressers, gyms, dry-cleaners... as well as the dry-cleaner located right next door to the apartment itself!
notes: The great thing about my apartment is it's location, however being so close to the city means whisper quiet surrounds are not guaranteed. The road outside my apartment can get a little busy during peak periods such as the morning and evening commute. If you are particularly sensitive to noise, this is something you should consider when staying at mine. It can get very warm in Sydney during the summertime. Although I don't have full air-conditioning installed, I provide a portable air-conditioner for my summertime guests. For taller guests 6 foot and over, my bed might be a bit of a squeeze. For couples I recommend putting the taller person on the pulled-out section of the bed where at least there's no frame hindering the feet! ;)
transit: Getting around is ridiculously easy from my place. Walk 5 minutes down the road for North Sydney Ferry wharf, 7 minutes to Milsons Point Train station, 10 minutes to North Sydney train station and bus stands.    From Milsons Point station, it's only one stop to the city. Should you want to explore a little more of the Northern side of Sydney, the bus stop right outside the apartment complex will take you to the suburbs of Neutral Bay and Cremorne, home of Australia's most beautiful independent cinema The Hayden Orpheum Picture palace; built in 1932 and restored to its amazing former Art Deco glory... for all you movie buffs out there, it's definitely worth a visit!
access: Guests have access to the entire apartment - Make yourself at home! ^_^
interaction: Although you might not see me in person, I'll be available for any questions or issues via mobile or Airbnb message!
house_rules: Please use coasters for glasses, and use a tray or tea-towel if you're resting plates on any furniture that's not a table. If there's any spills, breakages or other accidents, please let me know as soon as possible - accidents do happen, but the sooner I'm notified the more likely we can come up with a fix ^_^ The only people who should be residing in my apartment are those listed as my guests on Airbnb - if you intend on having visitors please do me the courtesy of clearing it with me first.  Thanks! ^_^

Millie's place was the perfect location for our stay in Sydney. Just a few meters to the next bus stop and only a few minutes to train station and harbour bridge. The studio was clean and matched the description and had a great view to the bridge.
Would definetly recommend this!

Clear and quick communication with easy instructions for check in/out and how to find Millie's apartment.  Millie's studio had everything I needed for my week in Sydney, and is conveniently located within walking distance to the train, shops and restaurants. I loved the view too - a wine on the deck watching the bridge light up was just what I needed at the end of each day!

I stayed in Millie's place with my wife through our short visit to Sydney, and it was a delight. The place is a walking distance to the restaurants and cafes in Kirribilli, and a one train station away from the city. The station is almost 7-minute walk from the building. Millie did her best to make us feel at home. She provided us with many goodies for breakfast, and made sure we get entertained through her movie and game collection.

I would definitely recommend Millie's place for anyone visiting Sydney, and I would check it out for availability next time I'm planning to visit.

Millie provided us with a really cosy apartment in a really awesome area. There are really cool restaurants at the foot of the bridge at Miltons Point. We took the ferry to get there or walked over the bridge. What a fascinating city. And what a spectecular view from Millies apartment. Thanks Millie, we had a great time.

We loved the apartment and would love to stay there again in the future. The location was great to get to the centre of Sydney and also the ferry system. The view from the balcony was amazing and the apartment was well equipped (even catering for emergency amenities). Millie was always on hand and very quick to reply to our messages. Thanks for being a great host.

We stayed at Millie's place four nights and congratulated ourselves on a good choice, mainly because of the location. It is in North Sydney which puts it into a lower price bracket, but it is a 5-10 minute walk to the North Sydney ferry which takes you right to Circular Quay, which is the public transportation hub and next to the opera house. You can even buy your public transport pass at the little store next to Millie's. Also, the apartment has a balcony with a stunning view of the Sydney Harbour bridge and skyline. These things compensate for the apartment's tiny size and lack of air conditioning. Millie left us with a lot of breakfast food plus coffee and milk. The kitchen was clean and well equipped. The bed converts from a day bed to a double, and even if we had done it correctly it would have required strength and lifting. If you are not young and strong get her to leave the bed set up for you. The apartment is charming and clean but the public areas of the building, including the laundry room, could use freshening, but don't let that put you off. We would stay there again.

It was a beautiful stay in this lovely studio, we enjoyed the time there.
And Millie is a great host, the conversation was really good!
Thanks very much!!
It was super easy to get to places and we loved walking over the bridge every day.

name: Sydney City Apartment  Petersham
space: Hi, my kids are now grown and living on their own so I am keen to share my Sydney apartment. It is located parkside in Petersham with a great view of the surrounding area and City Skyline. It is a modern, bright large split level space, with living areas upstairs and 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and 2  veranda's downstairs. The complex has a lift and is security coded. There are 2 train stations and a bus stop within 5 minutes walk. all of which are 10 minutes from the centre of the City. It is an easy walk to the restaurants and cafes of eclectic  Newtown or the sensational tastes of little Portugal in Petersham and little Italy in Leichhardt. Bookshops, curios and arthouse theatres are all in walking distance. Your accommodation is a large well appointed air-conditioned bedroom, complete with a new Queen size bed, beautiful linens, wardrobe space with generous mirrors.Your room opens onto a private balcony where you can enjoy your morning coffee. description: Hi, my kids are now grown and living on their own so I am keen to share my Sydney apartment. It is located parkside in Petersham with a great view of the surrounding area and City Skyline. It is a modern, bright large split level space, with living areas upstairs and 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and 2  veranda's downstairs. The complex has a lift and is security coded. There are 2 train stations and a bus stop within 5 minutes walk. all of which are 10 minutes from the centre of the City. It is an easy walk to the restaurants and cafes of eclectic  Newtown or the sensational tastes of little Portugal in Petersham and little Italy in Leichhardt. Bookshops, curios and arthouse theatres are all in walking distance. Your accommodation is a large well appointed air-conditioned bedroom, complete with a new Queen size bed, beautiful linens, wardrobe space with generous mirrors.Your room opens onto a private balcony where you can enjoy your morning coffee. You will have your own newly renovated ele
access: I provide generous breakfast provisions  for guests to prepare at their leisure ..for other meals I can make recommendations for any type of budget or style of cuisine locally. The washer and dryer are always available to use and wifi is included.
interaction: Happy to share a chat over a wine in the evenings or leave guests to discover the City in their own time. I work full time close by and am generally home in the evenings.
house_rules: No Smoking

host.host_about:
Hi, I'm in my early 50's and enjoy meeting people. I love my home and enjoy entertaining when time permits. I am an avid reader and movie goer and enjoy trying new local restaurants. I spend the weekends at markets, the movies or with friends sharing a meal.
I'm hoping to travel a lot more in the next few years and I'm keen to hear of other peoples travel experiences.

reviews.comments: Stayed with Kerri as we needed somewhere close to the family (who have grown too much to fit us into their small house). Beautiful apartment and a lovely bedroom and bathroom for our use.  Kerri is a great host and a really nice person - with excellent taste.  We'd be happy to recommend her place to anyone and be happy to stay there again.

Rather than an awesome room, Kerri was really an amazing host, very supportive and sociable. 
I enjoyed staying with her, it was a nice experience.  She would never hesitate to answer any question or even to offer any kind help.

The flat is as per the pictures: decorated with taste, offers nice spaces and is very clean. The room is very pretty and the double bed has a super comfy matress- good sleep guaranteed. It was also much appreciable to have a own bathroom&toilets.
Kerri is welcoming and communicating with her was easy (i needed a room for the following day and she replied straight away). I felt comfortable as soon as I arrived, she is such a nice and warm person.
Moreover she is full of attention, I did not stay long but the bathroom had been cleaned and new fresh towels provided. It was no problem to use the washing machine (There is a tumble dryer, but also the possibility to have the clothes dry on the balcony). Just felt like home.
In short, a quality and easy stay with a fantastic host. I highly recommend anybody to stay at this place.
Kerri, I will remember the discussion we had around a glass of wine! Thanks for having hosted me.

l'hôtesse très sympathique , accueillante, serviable,  nous a fait découvrir la ville et les environs le jour de notre arrivée, l'appartement est confortable, propre et bien décoré, le petit déjeûner copieux, nous avons eu le plaisir de voir avec Kerri le feu d'artifice du 31/12/12 sur sa terrasse ;nous sommes très heureux de l'avoir connue Katia et Pierre

It was a great pleasure to stay in Kerri's house. Everything looked like on the picture. The flat was very tidy and clean. Kerri is a kind, open and helpful person and she knows a lot about the life and the world which means you can have very good discussions with her. I will never forget my stay and I can highly recommend to everyone to stay in Kerri's house!
Kerri's apartment in Petersham was comfortable and convienient for our stay in Sydney. Everything was beautifully presented and the bed was very comfy!  We would stay again.

Staying with Kerri was my first airbnb experience and it could not have been better. Right from the moment I made the reservation, Kerri welcomed me with an offer of directions, which as it turned out I didn't need as her place was very easy to find. The apartment is beautiful and comfortable with much attention to detail. I was given a great bedroom with a very comfy bed and had my own beautifully appointed private bathroom. The place had the feel of a five star hotel, but with the added bonus of Kerri's friendliness. Immediately downstairs is a very cool cafe serving awesome breakfasts, so I ended up passing up the generous continental style breakfast that Kerri had offered me. The apartment location is perfect, as just down the road is the lively area of Newtown with its many bars and restaurants. I highly recommend staying with Kerri and look forward myself to staying there again in the future.
Perfect host, perfect house and perfect cat! I would stay with Kerri without hesitation. Clean, tidy, modern, friendly, welcoming and relaxed. Perfect!

Kerri hosted my Mother In Law while we had an overflow of guests in our house. We couldn't have asked for a more perfect experience than she got with Kerri. The apartment is like an immaculate hotel, with a very good sized bedroom and uber-modern bathroom for my MIL. Kerri was the perfect host and friend to my MIL, sharing movies, wine, stories and friends with her. Can't quite believe how perfectly it all worked out. Thanks so much Kerri!

Loved the stay at Kerri's place. Beautifully appointed and fantastic location. The view from the apartment was incredible. Great also having a cool little caf right alongside a gorgeous park. Thanks Kerri for providing a high quality bnb stay. It was really appreciated.

Staying at Kerri's was my first experience with Airbnb. It completely exceeded my expectations! I had such a fabulous experience thanks to Kerri. Her home is beautifully decorated and quite comfortable. I immediately felt right at home. Kerri couldn't have been more gracious. She is a very bright, fun-loving person and she made my stay in Sydney very special. I highly recommend staying at Kerri's place!
Second time staying with Kerri. What can I say? Best place to stay in the Sydney area. Not only is this a comfortable, clean home, Kerri is the best host EVER! Absolutely loved my stay here!

It was great pleasureto stay with Kerry.We felt as we were in our home.Kerry was supportive,friendly,kind and lovely.Her home was not less than what has been shown in the pics.You get all appliances and amenities without trouble.We loved our stay too much amd highly recommend it to anyone.A+++++:)

We are an elderly couple (but not old) from Finland visiting Australia and Sydney for the first time. Staying in Kerris place was also our first airbnb experiance and it is hard to imagine any better place and host for us. We were so pleased and happy all the time, 8 days. It was easy to use public transportation from Stanmore railwaystation. We used everything train, bus, ferry and even light rail. Kerris home is beautyfully furnished, just for our taste. And she had everything in order, very tidy, very organized. We had a very good brekfast and we even enjoyed two dinners with Kerri. Kerri helped us in every way even when we had some problems. We felt like we had visited a good friend. We can warmly suggest Kerris home for everyone. If we ever come to Sydney again we will try to meet Kerri again.
Kerri was a wonderful, very friendly host. The apartment was spotlessly clean and the bed very comfy.

I visit Sydney for work a few times a year and previously have stayed in motels. It is extremely difficult and expensive to find anything close to the city. So I thought I'd give airbnb a try and Kerri's place looked and sounded great. 

I was really pleased to have found Kerri's lovely apartment. Very comfortable and well designed and Kerri is the perfect host: even cooked me a lovely meal when I arrived and provided secure parking for my car. Kerri is very friendly and easy-going and you quickly feel like you're staying at an old friends house.

Thanks Kerri. I'm sure I'll be looking to stay again on future trips to Sydney

Kerri is a wonderful host, she made me feel very welcome and comfortable in her beautifully decorated and clean apartment. 
Kerri is very accommodating and thoughtful and would totally recommend staying at her lovely home.

I had an amazing stay with Kerri. She has a beautiful place that is walking distance from Newtown, a hip neighbourhood where you can spend many hours wandering and discovering quaint shops. Kerri is very hospitable, she picked me up at the train station, and made me feel right at home. The room and the apartment overall are out of a design magazine. Beautifully done. Thanks Kerri!
Staying with Kerri in Sydney was wonderful!  She is a lovely hostess whose home is beautiful and comfortable.  Indeed it was my very best Airbnb experience and I have use these listings many times!

We had a wonderful stay in Kerri s home. She is a great host, all the comments so far speak for themselves. Great location close to the city and the airport, nice neighborhood, wonderful Appartement, everything clean, you'll have your own bathroom. It was perfect for our stay. Kerri responds quickly and was really trying to make everything work out for us. Recommended to everyone.
Kerri was an amazing host! She immediately made us feel right at home and treated us like family. I highly recommend her very nice apt for anyone wanting to stay in a central area in Sydney.
Kerrie is a wonderful host, could not have asked for better. Beautiful apartment, very clean and great to have your own ensuite. Would love to come and stay again one day!
We've stayed a few times with Kerri.  She's a great host and her apartment is lovely.  We're happy to recommend and look forward to our next visit.

Kerri's place was conveniently situated only about 20 minutes walk to theatres and restaurants in Newtown and about 20 mins drive to the airport for Saturday morning pick up. The bed was very comfortable, lovely bathroom and living area and Kerri was a helpful host. Being under the flight path was a novelty for our very short stay (and no planes overnight). However, the traffic noise from the busy main road was a bit of a problem for us and woke us up early. Although for convenience of location I would consider staying there again.
Kerri is a very nice person and a great host. The location was simply perfect for me…everything was how Kerri descried. I can recommend Kerri.

Great host, great time!! We really enjoyed our stay in Petersham, we discovered Sydney by train and bus - erverything close by. Kerry gave us a lot of brilliant tips and made us feeling like home. Thanks for everything, looking foreward to see you again, Thomas and Margarteha from Germany

Kerri was the perfect host kind and couldn't do enough for us we felt like part of the family .
The apartment was gorgeous  and central to railway and shops our bed was very comfortable and ensuite  was nice and fresh and recently renovated .
We enjoyed our stay in Sydney and will come back and hopefully come and stay with Kerri again .
The reservation was canceled the day before arrival. This is an automated posting.

The apartment is everything you would want, clean, well designed and close to shops, cafes and train.  Kerri is a very gracious and friendly host, we enjoyed our stay and would most certainly come again.  Thanks Kerri!

Kerri's was a lovely place to stay and she was both friendly and helpful too. It was only a short 15 minute train ride to the centre of Sydney so with a my multipass it was easy.

Listen to kerri's hints and tips as Watson's bay was truly fabulous.

I arrived at Kerri's place, and thought, Hmmm...when can I move in? This is a fabulous apartment, and Kerri is a generous, thoughtful host who contributed a great deal to making my stay in Sydney very enjoyable indeed. Plus, we had a lot in common, which made for some lovely conversations! I would heartily recommend this place to travelers seeking a fine welcome in a beautiful apartment. Only word of note: if you're someone who needs absolute quiet, it's a bit noisy on weekday mornings (not weekends, which are much quieter).
Another great stay with Kerri, room lovely as always.
Kerri was very nice and accommodating. Unfortunately I was unable to stay last omits but she was a pleasure to communicate with and will definitely be a place for next time! Thanks Kerri!

A wonderful first AirBNB experience for us. A beautiful welcoming home with charming decorations and Kerri is an excellent host. She greeted us with a glass of wine and gave us good advice on trains and where to eat.  We slept in a comfortable big bedroom with good lighting and elegant furnishings. Will stay there again.

My husband and I spent four nights at Kerris.The accomodation was great,lovely bedroom and bathroom,clean and uncluttered.Kerri was a warm and friendly host and very welcoming- nothing was too much trouble.The location is fabulous,cafés and transport on the doorstep.Even the cat was friendly.

Our first australian experience was at Kerri's home. The place is located at 20 min from CBD and 2 train-stations from a vibrant and colorful place called Newton. Kerri has been more than helpful, provinding us with usefull and detailed information about Sydney and its surbubs, places of interest and much more. Everything was exactly as described. We are really looking forward to spending some more time in her apartment in a fortnight.

Kerri is a wonderful host! She is warm, friendly and helpful. She even drove us around to visit Sydney. Her apartment is nice and spacious enough to enjoy a comfortable stay. The location is on walking distance to public transportation. 
If we are ever back in Sydney, we would have no hesitation to stay with Kerri again. Highly recommend! 
Thanks for a great stay !
Kerri was the most wonderful and accommodating host I could of wished for.
The reservation was canceled 3 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.

Kerri’s place and Kerrie are special, even better than the pictures.  I selected Kerri’s accommodation for ease of commuting by train and the beautiful décor.  I balked at the prospect of hauling all my luggage up a slight hill to her place, and Kerri cheerfully was at the Petersham station in 5 minutes on a Saturday afternoon to drive me to her apartment.  I found the Stanmore Station (less than a 15 minute walk past some nice houses) easier, and walked it at night and felt safe.  I was at Kerri’s for a demanding conference, and being at her place was like a relaxing resort.  The home ambiance is so beautiful and the plant and sun make it a very special home away from home.  Some of the memorable touches:  really soft sheets, a well-appointed private bathroom, a friendly cat, the self-serve breakfast of fruit/cereal/yogurt laid out in the morning (one morning she left eggs and a tomato with a pan and spatula too), the plants and view from the veranda where I ate and read, and the lovely decorations from her travels.  There’s also a nice, upscale grocery just down the street.  We didn’t see too much of each other, and the lengthiest time we spent was when Kerri generously took me to my rental car office in Mascot near the airport.   Kerri’s friendly and adaptable when you have odd plans like I did.  It was a treat to stay here!
Great place and a lovey apartment! Highly recommended! I would definitely stay here again in Sydney!

I thoroughly enjoyed my stay at Kerri's place. She is a wonderful host and very welcoming. There was a delicious cooked dinner on my arrival and a lovely Breakfast laid out for me to help myself in the morning. I enjoyed sitting on the spacious balcony looking back towards Sydney. The whole place is very clean. The bedroom is spacious and the bed very comfortable. I enjoyed my own bathroom with plenty of fresh towels. Kerry's place is a lovely peaceful home away from home.  I would come back anytime I am in Sydney. Thank you very much Kerri.

Staying at Kerri's place was absolutely wonderful! Kerri is an awesome host, very friendly, warm, welcoming and great to talk to. She always ensured I was comfortable and even drove me to the next place I was staying in Dulwich Hill. A lovely breakfast of fruit, cereal and yoghurt was laid out for me to help myself every morning and Kerri made a yummy cooked breakfast for me on my last morning. I also enjoyed dinner a couple of times with Kerri which was great, she is a fantastic cook! The room was lovely, clean, really nicely decorated and with its own modern bathroom. I also loved the chocolates! Wish I could have stayed longer, I would definitely stay again. Thanks Kerri!

Kerri was very welcoming for minute one,the apartment is lovely & nothing is to much for kerri,she always helps & advises which is a great help,kerri joined me & my family for dinner out one evening which says how easy a person she is to get on with,I fully recommend a stay here & will defiantly stay here again when I come back to Sydney

My 2 nd stay in the space of 2 weeks this time for 7 days,another pleasant experience,no probs just left to do my own thing,kerri was always there for advice of places to see & things to do.the apartment is a fab place to stay & a steak in the newington hotel opposite is a must.
Fab host def recommend

Our first ever Airbnb experience was just perfect.  Kerri is a lovely host, the apartment is very stylish and we had a yummy breakfast too.  We couldn't have asked for anymore.  Kerri was very efficient from the first point of contact and we were made to feel very welcome.  She gave really good restaurant recommendations which is always nice when staying in a new area.  The train station is close so  it made everything accessible.  We will definitely stay here again.

Had a great stay with Kerry who is a wonderful host. The location is excellent, just a short walk to Stanmore or Petersham stations with quick trips to the city and airport. 
Kerry's home is very clean and well laid out with plenty of privacy and your own bathroom. A great video and book library, beautiful deck area for meals and just relaxing...what more could you need? 
Breakfast was laid out and Kerry even cooked me a meal on arrival and picked me up from my daughters place. A wonderful host, beautiful home..... I'll be back!   Thank you so much Kerry
Another great stay. Thanks for looking after us again.

We had really good time in this beautiful house. The pillows, sheets and towels are clean and smell good. Its location is good. We walked less than 10 mins from Petersham station. The host prepared some fresh fruits, milk and toast for us for breakfast and we liked it very much. We will choose here to stay if we come Australlia again.

It was the 3rd time we stayed at Kerri’s place and it was as perfect as the 1st time.
The room is nicely decorated and big enough for accommodate comfortably 2 people and the bathroom next door was for our private use only. 
Kerri is a very communicative and interesting person, always ready for a chat and a glass of wine on the terrace or in the large living area.
The apartment is well located, on walking distance from Stanmore train station, which is at about 20 min from CBD.
I would recommend this place without hesitation to anyone who is looking for a comfy stay in Sydney.

We stayed with Kerri after we had moved house and before flying to Europe for a holiday and it was exactly what we needed! Kerri is a lovely, thoughtful host, offering us breakfast for the morning and making sure we were comfortable. Her place is really lovely, the bed is very comfy and the shower is the best! It's also very conveniently located to the cafes, shopping and nightspots of Newtown and Enmore, with the city a short train ride away. I would highly recommend Kerri's to others looking for a Sydney stay.

It was very fun to stay at Kerri place, Very nice house, to share time talking at night with Kerri on her balcony with wine was just perfect and lovely. Kerri make you feeling at home. She also help me to be able to find the way to see the koala refuge. Thanks Kerri, for sure if I have the chance to go to Sydney again I will ask you if a can stay at your place again.

This is the second time I've stayed at Kerri's place.  Kerri is a friendly and generous host who takes great care with the appearance of her beautiful home.  Easy to organise a check-in time.  Handy location only a 5 minute walk to Petersham station.   Good value.
Kerri is a fantastic host and I truly enjoyed my visit. I would recommend Kerri and her apartment to anyone.
Kerri is a wonderful host and I always thoroughly enjoy her hospitality and friendliness. Cheers Lynette
Clean and comfortable room, renovated apartment in modern style, excellent balcony space.

Excellent and friendly host with a beautiful apartment and excellent room and bathroom. Recommend to anyone looking for a clean, neat and well maintained apartment in a good neighbourhood for shops, restaurants, public transport.
Excellent host. Fantastic property. Clean and beautifully appointed. Handy for public transport & shops.

We had a wonderful time staying with Kerri for almost three weeks.  She is a fantastic host and made us feel truly welcome in her lovely home.  We especially enjoyed the delicious fresh fruit salad prepared freshly every day to accompany breakfast.  The property is only a few minutes away from the train station, just 15 mins to the centre of the city, ideal for Sydney sightseeing.  Newtown, with its vibrant shops and estaurants is just a short walk away which was excellent for us as we became regular visitors to the Cow and Moon (voted best ice cream in the world).  We have no hesitation recommending Kerri and will definitely stay again when we next return to Australia.

Beautiful apartment with a great balcony looking out to the lights of the city , where we enjoyed one or two wines . Kerri's hospitality was outstanding.Very close to the train station,take aways,restaurants.   This will be my first choice of accommodation when I next visit Sydney .

Kerri was such a welcoming and friendly host who went out of her way to ensure my stay was comfortable. The apartment was immaculate, the bedroom spacious and the facilities modern. The location was perfect, with everything I needed within walking distance. For my first airbnb experience it was perfect, would highly recommend and will be staying there again!

What a pleasant surprise after a string of "less than expected" experiences on air BnB.    

The secure parking and lifts are just the beginning.  Kerri has created a delightfully modern and stylish home that lends itself to being shared.   Truly tasteful and functional bathroom, and it was all mine.  It all continues upstairs with the perfect kitchen, a sun filled dining and lounge area, flowing  out onto large private deck with views of a vast city skyline, including the harbour bridge, which is probably ten kilometres  away.   Truly magnificent.  Yes there are some big noises from the road out front  and the jumbo jets above, but it really isn't a problem.  Kerri loves this space and who wouldn't.

Kerri's apartment is in a very handy location to restaurants,shops and trains. Easy to get into the city. Great views from the balcony.  Kerri's hospitality is outstanding . I had a wonderful time . Thank you.

I love my room and my house! It's 3 mins away from Erskineville train station, which is 5 mins away from Central station by train. 5 mins to all the nice cafes and bars, and 10 mins to one of the best areas in Sydney, Newtown! My housemate is a nice and chilled Aussie girl and she has a cute cat, Lulu. Welcome!
space: I have a piano and guitar that you can play. A heater and a heating mattress to keep you warm. I love to chill at the terrace with winter sun.

house_rules: Welcome to our warm and comfortable apartment. We want you to feel like home, so please make yourself comfortable and settle in. - No smoking anywhere in the unit, we love the smell of Sydney's fresh air; - The house is always spotless as we are a very proud home owner. I love to socialise but privacy is also respected and assured. Happy to give you directions & ideas about touring, eating out and places to see in Sydney. - No pets, we love pets but unfortunately it's a building requirement; - Loss of keys will incur a charge of $300, sorry it's building charge; - Do not touch the fire sprinkler, it'll cause the units above and below as well as units around to sprinkle. After that, it'll alarm the fire brigade. The cost of the fire brigade visit is a minimum of AUD2200 and the repair of the entire unit's water damage, it'll be one very expensive bill; - You agree that, although unlikely, we may need to access the apartment from time to time during your stay, e.g., to attend to repairs

host.host_about:
Hi, we are Rachael & William. We have been living in this lovely city of Sydney for more than half of our lives. 

We like trying out different cuisines, we love travelling and we also enjoy having a quite relaxing time at home. 

I have had many great experiences travelling and I am hoping that our guests staying in our places will experience the same excitement and magic in Sydney.

We'd love to meet you from the other side of the world and we'd love to talk with you about interesting things we had in this city. We look forward to hosting you soon!

reviews.comments: Great place , very modern, clean , easy to communicate with the hosts , definitely worth a stay

We found this apartment to be really wonderful to stay in! The view is amazing (although not the water view shown in the photo, which must have been taken from the south side of the building). But wonderful all the same. The apartment faces north You can see a little bit of ocean in the distance ,beyond Manly I guess.  We looked forward to coming home to the apartment every day. So comfortable. It helps to pull the curtains a bit going out for the day so it doesn’t get too hot. There is a great cafe with friendly staff, and good coffee and food in the courtyard below.  It’s called Springtime. There is a bus-stop to shoot into town in about 7 minutes almost directly across the road. Lots of restaurants nearby including a very colourful Mexican one. 
The directions  to get in if   you are driving, need to be clearer. And it helps to know that it is on level 11  and that the attachment on the key needs to be held near a small box to make the lift go to your level. 
All in all a magnificent and thoroughly enjoyable stay, and really comfortable beds.

Great apartment I’m a great location. Was just a bit disappointed at the lack of utensils in the kitchen and also we clearly stated that we needed a 3rd mattress however although being told there was one there it wasn’t anywhere to be found. Our 4th guest had to sleep on a cot mattress for 2 nights.
I truly recommend this place.
Perfect apartment in a great location and is equipped with cot, change table, high chair and toys for small children.
Good location,bus stop in front of building, 5 mins walk to wolli .

Wonderful space. Very clean and comfy. Great for kids. Quiet but with amenities and restaurants all very close. Could have used a few more plates and cups, but that’s being picky. We’d absolutely stay here again and recommend it to families.

We enjoyed staying in Crows Nest - it's close to the main hub of the suburb and a quick walk to trains to get into the city.  Also, the memory foam mattresses were really comfortable - everyone was saying they slept really well!
It’s a beautiful apartment for families with kids. We truly enjoyed our stay and highly recommend this place. The communication was great and we had everything we needed. Thanks Will and Rãchël
The apartment is great, very spacious, comfortable and in a great location for tourism or business.
Great location and a lovely apartment with fantastic views. Recommend staying here
Very spacious apartment with a huge TV in the living room and v comfortable beds :)
Fantastic location. Close to bus and trains. Nice french pastiserie nearby.
nice place for family with young kids
Great and convenient spot to Crows Nest, North Sydney and the Mater Hospital. Clean apartment and comfortable beds.

Great location and lovely 2 bedroom apartment.

Limited storage for guests, and kitchen essentials was limited.

Would stay again!!
Excellent, will definitely stay again when I am back.

Would be an ideal one or two night stop over. Lovely beds/sofa and toys for kids. Very little space if you wish to unpack any clothes (even if just one person) not much kitchen ware if you want to prepare meals. So I wouldn't recommend for longer stays although our family of 5 managed for a week.
Will and Rachel were amazing. So helpful when we lost our car keys. We didn’t have kids but this is the best place for kids under 6.

description: Recently renovated and truly spacious studio apartment in the heart of Potts Point. Within walking distance to some of Sydney's best attractions and an easy 8 min walk to Kings Cross Train Station. Beautifully renovated and appointed, you will have access to free Wi-Fi, the new kitchen with cooking facilities, washer & dryer and the building's stunning pool!  The space works for solo adventurers and business travellers, with the comfortable queen sized bed making it perfect for couples. My studio apartment is beautifully renovated and spacious, with a super comfortable queen sized wall bed, making it perfect for a relaxing stay in Sydney. There is a full sized kitchen with cooking facilities, if you feel liked a home cooked meal and coin operated clothes washing and drying facilities on every floor of the building.  Access to the apartment is hassle free, through the gorgeous new entry foyer and up the newly refurbished lifts. The apartment has free wireless internet and a HD TV, with
neighborhood_overview: Potts Point is one of Sydney's premier suburbs. Its tree lined streets, beautiful old apartment blocks and easy access to Sydney CBD, Royal Botanical Gardens, Woolloomooloo Wharf, Circular Quay and all of Sydney's best attractions, make it one the most desirable places to live and visit in Sydney. You'll love the local cafe and restaurant scene and the gorgeous boutique shopping that is literarily on your doorstep. A perfect place to base yourself for your stay in Sydney.
transit: Kings Cross Station is an 8 min walk straight down Macleay and Victoria Streets, where you can directly access all of Sydney and the Airport. Potts Point is a popular suburb close the CDB, so there is also a multitude of bus services on your doorstep and there is never a shortage of taxis.
access: You will have full access to all the facitilities of the apartment, such as kitchen, bathroom, laundry, wireless internet etc.  The building also features a swimming pool, which you are welcome to use at your leisure.
interaction: I will be available 24hrs each day during your stay, just phone or email me. I will also most likely be there to check you in and show you around the apartment when you arrive in Sydney.

host.host_about: Hi I'm Vickie! I am an avid traveller who loves my city and Airbnb allows me to share it with you and!!! I truly enjoy meeting new people and look forward to welcoming you to my beautiful city.

name: Apartment among the trees
summary: This unique apartment has been stunningly designed and built using all natural materials. The mud render and recycled timber complements the surrounding bush and light spills through the windows and skylights. You really feel immersed in nature and secluded from the outside world. The space is really versatile and works well for couples and families with kids. Close to a number of beaches and Avalon village, this place makes for a perfect beach getaway!
space: This lower level apartment is massive and the space is very versatile. The kitchen is fully equipped and includes a gas stove top, sink, coffee and tea making facilities and small fridge. The lounge has a day bed which folds out into two singles, a large couch, TV with digital network and dining table and chairs. The bedroom has a comfy queen size bed, a chest of drawers and a hanging rack. Lie in bed and look out through the tress, listen to wildlife and lose yourself in the tranquility. The bathroom is light and bright and has a bath and separate shower. Outside there is a small deck, an outdoor shower - perfect for rinsing off after the beach. There is also plenty of parking on-street, just at the end of the driveway. The walk from the car space on site to your front door is around 60 meters. It is a little steep and there are a set of stairs (see pictures).

The bathroom is light and bright and has a bath
neighborhood_overview: The property is a short stroll to Paradise Beach, on the Pittwater side a perfect place to escape the summer crowds. This property is in a great location to enjoy all Avalon has to offer – beautiful beaches, famous breaks, boating, sunset picnics on the Pittwater and great cafes, restaurants and boutique shopping.  You will find a house manual available at the property that details all the local favorites - cafes, restaurants, best beaches etc.
notes: It's worth noting that the walk from the parking to the entrance is a little steep as the property is located on a hill. Please be careful when walking down to the apartment especially if it is dark or has been raining. There is also a set of stairs from the driveway (stairs featured in one of the pictures). Please also note that some guests may find this space a little rustic. It is in the bush and has been beautifully constructed using mud render and recycled materials. There is also a separate studio on the property that sleeps 2 and can be rented out as well.  This listing is available by looking at the 'hosts other listings' .
transit: There are buses right outside the door and close by that can take you into the village, to the surrounding beaches and in to Sydney city.
access: Guests have full access to the downstairs apartment and the area just outside the apartment.
interaction: The owners live on the property but do not actively interact with the guests. As a cushie property you have guest support available throughout your stay. The level of contact is completely up to you - we can act as a local guide or leave you to discover and fall in love with everything the Northern Beaches have to offer.
house_rules: - The apartment is a lower duplex so please respect the noise levels at all times.

We went at the start of winter and the place had enough heaters to keep it cosy.

Everything was absolutely beautiful. Self check-in was perfect for our circumstances. The treehouse was idyllic and all of the amenities were beautiful. Communication with the host was outstanding. Would stay here again!

We didn't actually stay here but we used this gorgeous property for a photoshoot. Molly was super helpful and made sure we could start our shoot on time. The property was super clean and exactly as the pictures showed! Great little retreat in Avalon.
Very serviceable accomodation. Great area.
A beautiful place for a weekend getaway. Great communication, close to the shops and beach and really comfy beds! Molly was really accommodating as well, thank you!
Great place for a quiet getaway

The apartment was perfect for our overnight stay. Communication was excellent throughout, and place was in a great spot - not even five minutes drive from Avalon shops and the beach. Beds were really comfy, the apartment was equipped with everything we needed, and it was so lovely waking up surrounded by the bush. Would definitely stay again!
Nice place for living, quiet and peaceful
A lovely place to relax. Very charming!
This is an amazing place to escape the bustle of Sydney. Comfortable, and close to everything you'd need and nestled in beautiful canopy. Highly recommend.
Gorgeous space, perfect for an escape from the city. Would recommend to anyone looking a place within range of quiet but also cafes and things to do.

Beautifully located private apartment in bush setting in Avalon. We stayed for a wedding in Whale Beach and the apartment was perfect for our family. Hosts were very helpful and great with communication during our stay and beforehand. Access to the apartment is via a very steep driveway and stairs which were slippery in the wet so be careful if raining. If parking more than one car parking is on the road which is at the bottom of the steep driveway but there is one spot very close to the apartment which was handy. Beds very comfy, apartment nicely styled and bathroom lovely with a clear roof and lovely toiletries which was a nice touch. Perfect for our stay. Photos are accurate representation of apartment.

Fantastic apartment in a fabulous location. Beware there are no fly screens on any window and given the location in the bush, with a pond outside one main window, mosquitoes were fierce. It was also disappointing that there was no hot water.

I enjoyed my stay at the Avalon apartment amongst the trees, check in and check out was smooth, and communication overall was appreciated. The location was great and especially for the summer time of year. The only critique was the front door and maybe being a bit sturdier, and that the surrounding area was a lot busier than anticipated however it was still a lovely stay.

The location is very handy to the beaches and local restaurants, and is also very quiet.  There are some nice touches to the design of the property that add to the experience - the skylights, large sliding timber windows, wrap around verandah, and an outside shower for washing the sand off after a trip to the beach.  The facilities are comprehensive and the beds comfortable.  Suited our family very nicely for our weekend at the beach.  A ceiling fan in the main living area would be an easy and inexpensive way to improve comfort on hot nights, but all in all it is a lovely place to stay.
We went to do a photoshoot on the property. It was very beautiful and the hosts did everything they could to ensure we would have a great time. :) thanks guys.
Very nice outlook however a little on the old side.

I stayed here for a birthday weekend getaway. It was my first experience with Airbnb which went smoothly. The communication was timely and helpful throughout the stay. The phone reception /wifi was a bit patchy & there were a few creepy-crawlies which kept my friends up for a portion of the night (didn’t really bother me). Otherwise, we had a relaxing time; the space is cosy and beautiful as pictured, well-equipped, with comfy beds, in a peaceful location. We also enjoyed visiting the cafes and beaches nearby.
Very cool accommodation set amongst the tree-tops

Billie and Molly have a great apartment with a cosy feel. Located in a very quiet spot and only 5 min drive from Avalon beach. Close to the shops and everything you need. Thanks for having us! 

Alex & Jo
Great little 'treehouse' and not too far from the main town. Lovely little beach just a short walk away too to go and watch the sunset.
Lovely little place for a quick trip away, concierge were brilliant
Amazing place :)

Easy and friendly communication throughout our stay here. Place was cute and although surrounded by other houses it was nestled amongst trees so it was quite secluded. A rustic but well maintained 1 bedroom cottage well prepared for airbnb guests. About a 20 minute walk to Avalon beach and local shops, restaurants etc. Very steep driveway :)

The location was great for our overnight trip visiting Palm Beach and surrounding areas. The bathroom with it’s clear roof gave amazing light and was a nice novelty.  The house had more of an older cabin type vibe, although the bathroom was really modern and white and clean. Check in was really easy with the lock box and we booked the day of and got a response within the hour. Great service.

Our stay was absolutely perfect! The service was excellent to communicate with and flexible with us. The space was beautiful, clean and private. We loved spending time in the afternoon sun that streams into the house. The space is beautifully decorated and had everything we needed. Thanks so much- we hope to be back!

Beautiful space, easy check in, Molly quick to communicate.
Would return

The location is nice and close to Avalon, but it is a  pretty small place and wouldn't recommend it for 4 adults as it only has one bedroom and two single beds in the living room (not as pictured). The photos make it look nicer than it is, it's dark and pretty run down and there were a fair few bugs inside. The place is private which was nice and very green.

Cushie was great. Good communication. The place is not the same as in photos. The place was not very well cleaned and the furnitures were old, from the 70s. The location is amazing though - real disconnection from the city. I would not recommend this place if you are after a bit of comfort. Ideal for a yoga retreat.
Lovely stay in a unique little spot
Great location and space amongst the forest but so close to town! Easy check in - thanks!

A truly unique and homely place for a holiday - somewhat small but aesthetically very beautiful inside and out. Convenient to many facilities including Clareville. Just remember to use a lot of insect repellant in the summer.

Loved this place amongst the trees. Felt like we were up in the mountains in Bali. Had everything we needed and the place has some lovely warm touches. If you’re scared of creepy crawlies it may not be your best option, but we loved it nonetheless. Hosts were really responsive and helpful. Would definitely come back here if we are looking for a quick getaway from Sydney by the beach.
Lovely unit- quiet and clean. Good place to stay to explore the northern beaches from. Had a great stay here and was easy to arrange how to access the place. Thanks for the great weekend!
This is the second time we’ve stayed at this lovely, leafy, private spot. We love how close it is to everything, yet nestled in the trees it feels like miles from the hustle of Sydney life.
Beautiful home, thank you!

name: Spacious 5 bedroom house - PERFECT LOCATION
summary: Set in the heart of the popular Sydney suburb Bondi Junction, this picturesque house is ideal accomodation for a tailored trip of your choice. A 5 minute walk to one of Australia's biggest shopping centres and a further 30 seconds to train station, you'll be in the marvellous Sydney CBD in 3 stops to take in all it's sights. A 10 minute bus/20 minute walk in the opposite direction and you're on the golden sand of the world famous Bondi Beach.  A big house in a great location!
space: TV and Netflix 4/5 bedrooms and living room, air conditioning in each space, lots of natural light and 4 bathrooms spread evenly throughout the house. A driveway and parking space adds to the convenience. The large house  provides privacy for your own space and an outdoor area to soak up the sun (if you're not at the beach).

neighborhood_overview: Bondi is truly a wonderful place with the obvious attraction being the golden sands of the beach. a 10 minute bus journey or 20 minute walk down Bondi road and you are right there, Icebergs swimming pool and bar is a great place to relax if you don't want to sit on the sand. North Bondi has the RSL boasting fantastic views and a good food, Neighbourhood bar and grill as well as Bondi Hardware and Ravesis are great places to relax with an alcoholic beverage.
transit: Bondi Junction train station is a short walk away with the city being 3 stops away to either Martin Place or Town Hall. A wide array of late running buses will also take you to Bondi Beach. Bondi Road (parallel to the house) also has a wide selection of coffee shops, cafes and bars for your entertainment. You can also walk the Bondi to Coogee coastal walk something you will not want to miss on a good summers day.
access: Everywhere, its yours!
interaction: I can be contacted by telephone at any reasonable hour as well as being very responsive via email or SMS. We will put a local guide to Bondi on the fridge for guest's convenience and perusal.

name: Light-filled private room next to Surry Hills
summary: Light-filled upstairs bedroom with a retro 70s vibe vinyl floor, overlooking the garden. The house is shared with two (very lovely) others from Brazil and Sweden, but you will have your own private bedroom and full use of the kitchen, dining room, living room and garden. The house is on the border of Redfern and Surry Hills, less than a 5 minute walk to bustling Crown Street, and 2 minutes from the nearest Coles.

reviews.comments: Felicity was communicative and pleasant, the room was clean, quiet and comfortable. I would recommend to other guests.

Beautiful room with a surprisingly lovely view, loads of sunlight in the room and such a comfy bed. The house is in such a great position, so close to Central and Surry hills, was sad to have had such a short stay. The stairs up to the room are very steep so make sure to watch your step! Thank you for a wonderful stay Felicity, I had a great time.

name: Spacious Family Home in Coogee
summary: This Sydney Semi is ideally located between Coogee beach and ‘The Spot' in Randwick. It is a spacious 2 story house with  3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, 2 lounge rooms, plus study. It has a generous sized garden & deck offering expansive district views.
space: This traditional Red Brick Semi Detached has had extensive renovations with an entire new level built. The house is built to capture as much natural light as possible with over sized windows and doors that bring in the outside so that you enjoy summer. With consideration of  Sydney temperatures the house is designed to allow for maximum airflow, keeping it cool during the hot months. Downstairs level is a modern and well appointed open plan kitchen. The dining area has an extendible table that fits 10 people.  The downstairs lounge has 3m bifold doors that opens up onto a specious deck and garden. There are district views from the downstairs level that go out as far as the Blue Mountains on the horizon. There is also a new bathroom, laundry and study on a split level giving you that little bit extra space to sit and plan your day.   We have a  perfect size garden for kids to play in, And you can have lots of Aussie style BBQ on the 3 burner natural gas (not bottled) hooded bbq.   Upsta

neighborhood_overview: 'The spot'  with its gentle heritage ambiance is a easy 10 minute stroll away. It offers a wide range of restaurants and cafes. It has the Ritz cinema which shows new release movies.  Coogee beach is an easy 15 minute down hill walk. (1.4 km) Climbing back up the hill might be not be quiet as easy. A 3 minute  car drive down to the beach might be a better option if you are pushing a pram.
notes: We are a family of 4 with 2  young boys and understand the importance of adult space.  The TV room is designed to be sound proof when the door is shut so the parents can sit and enjoys the view while the kids watch their TV upstairs. The Xbox is wired in so feel free to bring your favourite games or you are most welcome to use ours.  Alternatively you may use the upstairs lounge as a fourth bedroom. However please note that this room has the only TV in the house.  You will have access to Netflix and with unlimited wifi you may watch as many movies as you like. ***Please note, at this stage ideally we prefer quests who are looking for a minimum of 7 nights  accommodation over new year period. Thank you for understanding.
transit: Rainbow St is very central there are several bus stops all around. Fortunately none stop out side our house. However there are a few options depending on where you would like to go. Just (Hidden by Airbnb) Sydney buses to see alternate options.
access: You will have access to the whole house and garden. At the far end of the block is a shed and a small sandy area that we ask guests to please stay away. This area will be developed next year and is currently not suitable for use.
interaction: you can contact us any time via email or phone. There will also be numbers available in case of an emergency.
house_rules: We are a non smoking family and pet free home.  Please respect our preferences for no smoking and no pets. The Xbox and Wii are all wired up and ready for your kids to use. Please do not unplug these. The cables are hidden through conduit and difficult to get in or out. The house is designed to allow maximum light and air to flow to keep the house cool during the Sydney summer months and filled with light during the winter. The flip side to this, is that the house is very exposed to wind and rain when left open.  We therefore ask that you please ensure that the south facing doors and windows are closed during any rain or strong winds. Please do not leave the house with the south facing door and window open. and please do not sleep with the south facing doors or window open. There are many other windows in the house that can be left open for ventilation at all times.   If it rains while these windows or doors are left open there will be significant water damage to the interior of the ho

reviews.comments:
Anat was a fantastic host from the very beginning. She was very responsive during the booking process and flexible with my family's arrival, which helped us greatly arriving in a new country. 

The house is a beautifully renovated 3 bedroom in South Coogee with tons of natural light and outdoor lounge space. The kitchen was well supplied for us to cook and bake, and we were surprised to see the BBQ was hooked up to the main gas line. Very cool!

We drove most of the trip, but there are also nearby bus lines that take you into Sydney proper in 45 mins or so. I highly recommend this BnB and am excited for all that have the opportunity to stay here :).

name: Bondi-Tamarama BEACHFRONT Apartment
summary: This gorgeous 3-bedroom apartment is directly across the road from the beach. It's very light, beautifully decorated and all within minutes of Bondi, Bronte, restaurants, shops and buses to the CBD. Watch the waves as you have a drink on the balcony.
space: Here are a few of the highlights of The BEACHFRONT Apartment: THE APARTMENT The building only has 7 apartments in total. Your new neighbours are lovely. They all enjoy spending time at the beach and they are mature enough to avoid late nights and loud parties so you won't be disturbed. THE BALCONY It wraps around the front of the building and gives you a huge entertaining space. From the balcony you stare straight at the water and out to the horizon. It's stunning! INTERNALLY We have furnished the apartment using light and bright colours to capture all of the sun that pours into the rooms throughout the day. There are three different eating areas - the dining table, the breakfast bar with views out to the beach and an outdoor table and chairs (where you'll probably spend most of your time) ENTERTAINMENT If you want to, you can sit inside and watch the huge 54" TV and use the DVD player or you can walk to Bondi and watch some real life entertainment at any one of the bars, clubs or live

neighborhood_overview: Tamarama is the younger, arguably prettier, sister to Bondi Beach. It's a relatively quiet beach where locals spend hours bathing in the sun. There is a park here with BBQs, toilets, changing rooms and a large grassy area to make a picnic. GREAT OCEAN WALK While you're in the area, you must take the Great Ocean Walk. It's a pathway that hugs the coast line all the way from Bondi to Coogee beach. Thankfully, it crosses your doorstep. Just join the throngs of people making the pilgrimage every day. SCULPTURES BY THE SEA Every year artists erect a series of sculptures along the Great Ocean Walk. It's a magical display set against the ocean views along the walk and it attracts thousands of local people and others from around the world. This year it is happening from 24 October - 10 November.
notes: FREE BOTTLE OF CHAMPAGNE We want you to have a great time when you stay at our place. We like the idea of you sitting out on the balcony celebrating something and admiring the view. So, anyone that books for 3 nights or more will find a bottle of Veuve Cliquot in the fridge upon arrival. SAVING LIVES We are really thankful to live by the beach and it's a stunning beach. One of the things that makes this beach a great place to swim and have fun in summer are the lifesavers who volunteer their time to look after the people who use the beach. Chances are that you've chosen our place partly because of the beach out the front. So to thank the guys that look after the beach for us, 10% of everything that you pay to us will be given to them as a donation. It's the least we can do for the guys that keep the beach safe. We'll send you a copy of the receipt and any comments that we get from them in thanks.
transit: BUSES The local area is serviced by buses that will take you to other transport hubs that will take you anywhere you need to go or you can catch a local bus directly to the CBD and be there in about 15 minutes. You'll have access to the internet from the computer set up for you in the apartment. Just either call 131500 and ask them for help or search 131500 on a search engine and you'll find a website showing all the timetables. You're not too far from anywhere!
access: All guests will have free access to all the amenities and facilities in the Apartment. This includes a coffee machine, dishwasher, washing machine, dryer, 434 litre fridge, a complete library of books, 54" TV & DVD Player, wireless broadband internet, sound system and an intercom / security system. TRANSPORT Once you arrive at The BEACHFRONT Apartment you probably won't want to leave. But should the need arise, there is transport immediately out the front. The #361 bus stop is across the ride and it will take you to Bondi Junction or Bondi Beach. From the Junction you can catch buses and trains to the city. The bus is handy, however, most things are within walking distance anyway.
interaction: Unfortunately, we don't get to meet the guests. We leave keys outside in a 'lockbox' which allows you to collect them whenever you arrive. We usually stay nearby and are available in the event that you need help with anything.
house_rules: Please be mindful of our neighbours and leave our home as you found it :)

host.host_about:
Hi there,

My name's Wayne. I live in Sydney, Australia with my fiancé, Kate.

I'm a management consultant, an author, a commercial helicopter pilot and I've recently developed a real love of travel with time in LA, Turkey, Greece, London, Vietnam, Thailand, Camboodia, Bali, Hong Kong and France all in the last 12 months.

We've done quite a lot of share living both at home and abroad so we'd like to think we know what makes a good environment in a home.

Hope to meet you soon!

Wayne and Kate

reviews.comments:
The apartment exceeded expectations.  
First, the location was incredible.  Literally overlooking the Tamarama beach and a beautifull balcany to sit on and watch the world go by.  
Secondly, the apartment itself was perfect.  It is clean, with great entertaining spaces and very welcoming.  You don't feel like your invading another persons home but it still feels homely - if that makes sense!  The beds, couch and linen were all clean, fresh and comfortable.
Third, it's only a 10 min walk to Bondi!
Finally, Wayne is lovely and immediately responded to all my questions.  We only booked the apartment a few days before, and it was my first time dealing with airbnb, so we really appreciated the quick responses.  Also, we had a bottle of champagne and chocolates on arrival which was a lovely surprise!
I would highly recommend this apartment.  It is the perfect place for people who want to hang out, relax and and enjoy one of Sydney's premier beach locations.  
I will definitely go back if I need a place in Sydney.

We had a great stay at Wayne and Kate's place. We travelled to Sydney for a family long weekend and from the moment we opened the door we felt at home. Their home is open and airy with a fantastic view of the beach. The location is perfect, we went on walks along the "ocean walk" to Bondi and the opposite direction to Coogee and Bronte. It was great sitting on the balcony looking out at the beach and the many energetic people pounding the pavements and in the water enjoying the waves. Wayne and Kate were great hosts emailing and messaging us with directions to their home and suggestions of places to visit. Nothing was too much trouble. The champagne and chocolate they left for us was also well received . We can not wait to return. Thankyou Wayne and Kate for sharing your beautiful home with us.

Wayne and Kate were wonderful to deal with, quick responses in the lead-up to our stay and comprehensive instructions on how to get the key when we arrived. As soon as we walked in we knew we were in for a lovely stay. The view is magnificent and the apartment is spacious and airy, and well-represented in the photos on the website. The kids loved the big TV which meant more time on the deck for us! Great walks and easy parking which is not easy to come by in Sydney. Would thoroughly recommend this place.

Holy moly what an apartment. Actually better than the photos! The vibe is clean, open, breezy, sophisticated. After a picnic lunch at Bronte, We enjoyed dinner together at the table and an evening swim. We were a party of 6, and all of us slept comfortably and felt like a million dollars the entire time. The kitchen was awesome to cook in and the balcony a peaceful breakfast spot. It could not have been more perfect.

Everything went smoothly and Wayne and Kate were very easy to deal with. The apartment is stunning, wonderful views of the beach, and although I only spent the afternoon there, my Mum and her friends who stayed over found everything they needed and were raving about the location. I'll be back! :)

We had an absolutely wonderful time staying at Wayne and Kate's place.. you cannot beat waking up to the sounds of the ocean! We had friends travelling from overseas for our wedding, and we could not have asked for a better place to stay; 2-10 mins walk to any of Sydney's great beaches, and all the anemities that you need in an apartment to make the place as comfortable as possible. Wayne and Kate were fantastic in getting back to us on any inquiries and were very thoughtful and approachable. The perfect hosts! now we need another excuse to rent out the place again ;) Thanks for everything!

We had a great time staying at Wayne and Kate's place. It is an absolutely beautiful apartment in an amazing spot. It was great to fall asleep listening to the sea.
Me and 5 girlfriends stayed for a weekend and we were all blown away. The apartment had everything we needed, we just added a few bottles of champers to sip on the balcony and soak up the Tamarama atmosphere. 
Thanks Wayne and Kate :)

From the first contact with Wayne and Kate my first experience using AirBNB has been fabulous! Their regular and thoughtful communication was perfect and we were so excited to stay at their beautiful apartment overlooking Tamarama Beach. We arrived to find cold bubbles in the fridge, a block of chocolate and a 'house and area manual' to assist use with everything we needed to know during our stay. The apartment was perfect! Great size for a larger group and it was so nice to have the home comforts right at our fingertips. I cannot recommend this experience enough and look forward to staying at Wayne and Kate's apartment again in the near future!

We had a wonderful stay at Wayne and Kate's Tamarama apartment. Excellent communication and experience from the very start. Checking in was simple and we arrived to a lovely bottle of bubbles! The view and location are absolutely unbeatable, and the apartment is terrific. The photos do not do justice - it's an amazing apartment! Great lighting, very comfortable, and well furnished. The flat has all the amenities you need and truly makes you feel at home.  

We had a very small issue with the internet dropping out periodically but Kate went above and beyond to ensure things were fixed.  And… left us another bottle of bubbles for our troubles, which was so incredibly nice!

The apartment was a short walk to Bondi, Bronte and Coogee beaches.  The walk from Tamarama to Bondi is breathtaking.  We were lucky enough to catch the Sculptures by the Sea the week of our stay.

Our experience was outstanding and highly recommend Wayne and Kate’s place. We did not want to leave! We look forward to staying at Wayne and Kate’s in the future. Thanks again for everything, Wayne and Kate!  :)

Fantastic spot although the weather was not on our side!

I arrived late on the weekend, so Wayne and Kate were super accommodating with my friend John. Place is very secure, has an amazing outlook over the beach. Café’s and restaurants are a short walk away, and transport easily accessible. 

Great experience and would love to stay there again!
Thanks Wayne and Kate we had a lovely time at your apartment. Was clean, beds comfy and great view of the beach!!

What an absolutely fantastic apartment and view! The hosts were fantastic to deal with and gave quick and very helpful replies! The apartment had everything we could need for a girly weekend away. Thanks so much, we all had a ball =)
Wayne and Kate's apartment is in a fabulous location right on the beach of Tamarama. It is clean, well maintained and suited our needs with 2 teenage boys. Thumbs up!

We had a great time, the apartment was lovely, clean, the views were spectacular and all expectations from the posting were met! They even left us bubbly!
The owners were very kind and even left us tips for the area.
I recommend this apartment and experience highly.

-Boyana

Absolutely perfect place to stay in Sydney! The beach is quite literally, across the road! The views are to die for day and night. Short and beautiful walk to Bondi or Bronte for restaurants, bars and bigger beaches if you want them. The apartment is clean and very comfortable,  it has everything and more you could want. And the hosts are extremely kind and accommodating. We had a ball staying here!

Wayne and Kate’s beachfront apartment is simply amazing. From the moment we made an inquiry about the place, Wayne and Kate went above and beyond when responding to our questions and requests regarding the place – even replying within minutes when we sent a message at midnight!

Stepping foot into the place, you might have to take a second to realise that you’re not actually in a designer home magazine. All of the amenities are in great condition and all three of the bedrooms were large with the beds comfortable and extremely clean.

After settling in and making a cup of tea and coffee with the stocked kitchen, we decided to take a look at the lengthy list of activities that Wayne and Kate had compiled just for us. You can never undervalue local knowledge!

While Wayne and Kate’s place is extremely fun, it’s also the perfect place to get some work done. We popped down to Tamarama Beach Café (across the road!) and bought back some coffee and sat and worked at the breakfast bar overlooking Tamarama Beach with our laptops – using the speedy wifi that was provided, of course.

Simply, Wayne and Kate are amazing hosts and their stunning apartment is perfect for work, play and everything in between!

We loved staying at Wayne and Kate's beautiful apartment right on the beach. The apartment is beautifully furnished and we felt right at home. Wayne and Kate were fantastic hosts and were in regular contact to make us feel welcome. We can't stress enough how good the location is, being able to walk across the road for a swim at a moments notice is amazing. Highly recommended!
Beautiful location, nice hosts, close to Bondi and Bronte for cafés and restaurants. We had a great time! Thanks Kate and Wayne.
Wonderful apartment and extremely responsive hosts. Wish I were back on the beach!

Fantastic apartment, fantastic location, fantastic hosts! Everything was thought of for us and we had a wonderful stay. The best equipped apartment we have ever stayed in...enough of everything, and more!
 thanks guys!  xx

Hi Wayne & Kate. We had three couples staying at the apartment for the weekend attending a wedding nearby.  We had a great time in the apartment and enjoyed the generous living space that you don't get in a hotel room. The view of the beach was awesome. Thanks for leaving everything so clean and tidy.
I'll definitely be back
cheers
Tony & Stef James

Had a fantastic weekend in this beautiful beach front apartment, hosts were great and helpful and the apartment was just as pictured if not better.
I would definitely recommend staying here to anyone who loves the beach and an apartment that has everything you would need.

We stayed here with my parents and our family for our holiday in Australia.  Location was absolutely fabulous - so close to the beach and in the middle of the beach walk so we could do our morning walks either south to Bronte/Clovelley or north to Bondi.  Once we figured out the bus system, it was easy to get back and forth to downtown Sydney from here.  The apartment was spacious, comfortable and we enjoyed our meals on the large balcony looking at the beautiful ocean and coastline.  Had a great time in Sydney - our visit coincided with Vivid Live which was amazing.  Wayne and Kate are awesome hosts - loved the champagne and would highly recommend this place for a family holiday.  House has everything you need.

I did not meet Kate and Wayne but all the arrangements to access their apartment and when leaving worked smoothly.  They responded to all notes and met all requests. The apartment is in a beautiful spot with direct access to the beach and a view from the balcony to die for.  All round a very enjoyable experience.  Thanks.

Absolutely fantastic place. Location is breath taking& the view is mind blowing.
Would highly recommend this place and many thanks to the hosts for their quick, kind response..
We had a gr8 time & look fwd to returning some time soon.
