The building is a serious disappointment.  Secondly the interior photography is selective in as much as it doesn't show details including aspects of disrepair.  The paint on the front door chipped and damaged, carpets are grubby and stained, the window coverings are damaged, their is rust on the internal hinges, windows fittings are corroded; laundry bench cracked,  all matters that can easily be addressed.  A major disappointment other then location.  A very positive aspect was the owners commitment to sharing the daily tariff with the local surf life saving club.

This is the second time my family and I have stayed at Wayne and Kate's apartment in Tamarama. It really is that fabulous. A beautiful apartment to stay in, in the most fabulous location, and the most wonderful hosts you could imagine.
Wayne and Kate's Tamarama beach apartment is a treat to stay. Excellent location and fantastic property. We loved every minute of staying here.
Great location, clean and comfortable home, accurate listing, accommodating hosts.  You can't go wrong staying at Wayne and Kate's place.

Wayne and Kate's place was amazing.  It's the perfect location on Tamarama beach (beautiful beach between and a short walk to Bondi and Bronte).  The house is fully stocked with amenities, beds were very comfortable, and spaces bright and cozy.  Highly recommended.

Wayne and Katie's place is amazing, perfect location on Tamarama beach with the Bonding to Coogee clifftop walk right on your doorstep. Wayne and Kate were perfect hosts, very easy to deal with and clearly are thoughtful and generous people. If we come back to Sydney we will have no hesitation in staying there again.
Wayne and Kate are truly super hosts and the view from the apartment speaks for itself.

We had a great time at Wayne & Kate's apartment. The location was amazing - we could get to three different beaches, all within walking distance, and the views from the apartment itself were unparalleled. Thank you for a wonderful stay!
Amazing location right next to the Tamarama beach. The view is fantastic and the hosts have been great with all our questions! Really enjoyed our stay and can’t recommend it more :)

Location Location Location! Absolutely loved this apartment. Balcony with amazing view over the beach. A short walk to Bondi or Bronte with amazing cafes, restaurants etc. The host was really flexible and easy to communicate with. Would definitely stay here again and recommend it to anyone!

Wayne&kate's place was great, we really enjoyed our stay. 
great space, very clean and tidy.
Special note on communication, they were a great host, very quick responses. They provide complete information about our stay, pretty much everything we need to know about the place.
Very recommended!

We had a lovely stay at Wayne and Kate’s apartment. The apartment is very comfortable, Wayne and Kate take a lot of care to make their guests feel welcome. The beds are incredibly comfortable, we hade everything we needed and the view is to die for. Watching the ocean from the balcony was both calming and rejuvenating. The cafe on the beach opposite serves great food and coffee and our kids loved the beach and the playground. Thank you Wayne and Kate for being so attentive and thoughtful, we had a wonderful time.

Couldn’t rate it highly enough. Great place, great location, great hosts. 
It’s a ripper.

Wayne and Kate's place is ideally located with views over Tamarama beach. Very comfortable space and beds.  Quiet despite so close to everything.  Bus is 150m down the street. Very enjoyable long weekend stay. Excellent hosts with great and prompt communication

This is our second time staying at Wayne and Kate’s place and once again it was a wonderful stay. The house is in a great location and wonderfully equipped. You can’t complain waking up to views of Tamarama beach! Beautiful! 
Their communication is second to none. They provide full information on check in /the house, how to use everything and are quick to respond to any questions! 5 stars!!
Perfect spot above the beach with fantastic views.
Wayne and Kate, what a knockout location! Your apartment was lovely and all that we hoped for. A pleasure to deal with you and a terrific place to stay. Kate and Richard & Co.
Fantastic spot and views. Perfect for a Sydney coastal getaway.
This was a great place to stay! Amazing views and very comfortable.
Absolutely stunning location!
Beautiful apartment great location, spacious with all amenities we needed. Beach is lovely. Wayne and Kate communicated wonderfully. We had gloomy weather and the view and location was still enjoyed.

View is amazing, location is perfect. Unfortunately it was very windy while we there and the windows rattled quite loudly. Also, neighbors decided to have a large party and noise went on until early in the morning.
Outstanding accommodation, extremely clean, comfortably furnished , beautiful outlook over tamarama beach.  We loved it here!

Wayne and Kate's place was perfect for a beachside weekend. There were three of us and the space was just right. Close to restaurants (about 15 minutes walk to Bondi) and overlooking Tamarama. Beds were comfortable and space to prepare meals if you are so inclined.

SYDNEY PRIVÉ If you wish discover why Sydney is such an extraordinary place then I would highly recommend  Sydney Privé, which is an exclusive concierge service that specialises in providing personalised tours and luxury experiences for the most discerning traveller. To truly experience Sydney, one must explore the local hideouts,  and there is no better place to do this than in Darlinghurst. Darlinghurst is the heartbeat of the city!  Checkout our airbnb Guidebook for some of our favourite hideouts.  The Guidebook will provide you with website links and actual location.
notes: IMPORTANT:  Our apartment is privately owned and serviced. It is not part of the hotel that is operated from within the building. That the apartment is only used for 2 guests  and not to be used for parties or events.  That guests are mindful of our neighbours, and adhere to safety and security rules of the building and staff.  Check-in : 2PM Check-out : 10AM EARLY CHECK-IN/CHECK-OUT:  If would like to change your check-in/check-out time, please let us know this information when making your booking.  We will make every effort to accommodate your request, however this may not always be possible as we have the cleaners, fresh linen drops and maintenance scheduled. LOST KEYS AND SECURITY TAG: In the unlikely event that the keys and security-tag are lost or stolen, for security reasons we will need to replace the lock, keys and security-tag. host.host_about:
At the centre of my life is my beautiful family...home is wherever my family is.

I enjoy filling my life with positive experiences and love to travel and experience new cultures, to meet new people, to read and just enjoy the beauty and wonders of the 'littlest' things in the world around me and my family.

reviews.comments: Friendly, helpful and welcoming hosts. Beautiful and comfortable apartment. Located opposite beautiful Hyde Park and close to Sydney's main attractions and public transport. We enjoyed having Sydney on our doorstep and exploring the city. Can't wait to visit again! Thank you Desiree and Julian.

Desiree's Airbnb was perfectly appointed. The space is incredibly clean and welcoming. She had everything I needed for work and relaxation. She also provided helpful instructions and was easy to contact for whatever I needed. The location is great - coffee, grocery, dry cleaning, bars, shopping all within minutes. Love this location!
The place is perfect for that single or couple who is on a getaway. Great location.  Not to mention your Hostess is impeccable.

Desireé the host was very friendly and replied quickly to any questions. The apartment was a little noisy from the road outside but it wasn't a big issue. It has obviously been recently renovated and is very clean. There was tea/coffee and milk which was a convenient touch. I would recommend this Airbnb.

If you are looking for room with have the best location and the most comfortable room condition, Desireé's room is just what you looking for. It's exactly same as the pictures, super clean, large enough for 1 or 2 person and you need only 3 mins walk from the Museum Station. It's also close to the mart, convenience store and easy to take a taxi. What I love the most is that it's just near the Hyde Park. It means that you could walk there every morning and night with beautiful view. And comfortable bed, clean and large shower booth, big screen TV with Samsung Smart-hub, big dinning table... everything in room was ready for your perfect trip. In addition, Desireé is really kind, good-hearted host. I couldn't meet her but she always answer kindly to my messages and give help everytime :D Don't miss this room!!

Desirée is an excellent host. Quick to respond to questions and most helpful. The accommodation itself is spacious and exceedingly clean/tidy. The location is excellent - near to the Museum train station (direct connection to airport in only 15min) and a very pleasant 15min stroll, via Hyde Park, to Martin's place. I would definitely recommend the accommodation to both business travelers and tourists.
A lovely, clean and spacious apartment right on Hyde Park. We loved the apartment and the little touches - a hand written note and fresh flowers. Thanks for having us, Desiree

My daughter and I came to Sydney for her medical school interview.  Desiree was an outstanding host - providing detailed instructions on every stage of our stay, including our last day where she kindly offered for us to check out later than the arranged time.  The apartment was immaculate and really did provide a home away from home. You could seriously just turn up at his place as everything is provided for the guest's use. Desiree thought of all the little special touches - from fresh fruit and sparkling water to chocolates and flowers.  The location is fantastic - walking distance to all that Sydney has to offer.   Her guide book and restaurant recommendations were wonderful.  Highly recommended  - better than any hotel stay!  We  will be back again!  Many thanks Desiree
Wow my best Airbnb experience by far. Great location very clean and comfortable. Desireé is a wonderful host and her apartment is just fantastic.

Really lovely apartment in a really convenient location. The apartment was really well equipped and beautifully maintained. Probably one of the best Airbnb locations we have ever stayed in…thank you so much for everything Desiree!!
Absolutely divine! Lovely spotless apartment in a fabulous location.

Everything is perfect! Location is great. House was very clean and tidy. Desireé is a very kind, helpful and responsible. Our communication are very smooth, no problem at all. It must be one of my favourite airbnb stay! Thank you for the lovely flowers and chocolates. Highly recommend to stay in Desireé 's place for your next accommodation!

Hi
We had such a great time staying with Desiree.  The flat is perfect and centrally located. We couldn't recommend a better host.
Steve and Lucy

What an amazing apartment! I would highly recommend this apartment! I stayed here with my partner and we had plenty of space. It was in a perfect location right across from Hyde park. I did not use the pool but the apartment does have a roof top heated pool which looked great. Apartment was clean and the bed was comfy. Desireé was a wonderful host and had some lovely touches such as stocking the fridge with beers and provided snacks, fruit and milk etc. the bathroom was also stocked with products and didn't even need to use my own shampoo etc. We also were allowed an early check in and a late check out which was just amazing. I will be staying here again on my next visit.

This was a sensational experience from start to finish. Desireé was exceptionally communicative and helpful, across arrival instructions and helpful hints, to being extremely flexible with my check in and departure times from the property. She was wonderfully generous with items left in the fridge for me to help myself to, and even some lovely fresh flowers for me on arrival. It's a gorgeous apartment right in the hub of the city BUT with the bedroom double glazed I had some of the best nights sleeps here I've had in ages. Terrific stay. Best part? Uber wide screen Tv and free NETFLIX! I loved this apartment. Don't hesitate to book.

Desiree certainly knows how to make her guests feel welcome. Fresh flowers and chocolates on arrival is an example. Her attention to detail was very much appreciated and one of my best airbnb experiences to date. She was also quick to respond to all queries. The apartment is as shown in the photos and immaculately clean. Dont hesitate to stay here!

Todo ha sido perfecto! La comodidad del apartamento es aún mejor en vivo que en las fotos. Los detalles y amabilidad de Desiree son grandiosos. Sin duda aconsejo por ubicación y comodidades este apartamento para conocer la preciosa Sydney es perfecto!

Our host Desiree is fantastic she had everything ready for us.  It was so easy we just turned the key and everything was there.  She kept in contact with me to make sure everything was ok which was very thoughtful.  There was fresh roses in the apartment really lovely touch also lots of groceries like tea bags, coffee, milk etc. which was great after a long flight.  There are even bath robes and lovely fluffy towels The apartment is beautiful very luxurious, we loved it.  It's spotlessly clean, great TV, WIFI, everything you need and more. It's a great location. Very easy to walk around from and also Museum station is right on the door step. It was our first visit to Sydney and should we go back I would love to stay here again.  I can't thank Desiree enough. We were absolutely thrilled with it. Truly 5 star.
A lovely, comfortable, well decorated apartment in a great location. Very friendly host. I can't wait to stay again.

Where do we begin? Desireé is a wonderfully thoughtful host that made our stay so special. The apartment looks exactly as pictured - modern, comfortable and clean. The location is fabulous and central to everything! This apartment does not disappoint! Our only regret is that we didn't stay for longer. We will certainly be back the next time we are in Sydney! Thank you Desireé!

My parents loved Desirée's flat. She had left a hand written note and ferrero rocher as well as beautiful, fresh flowers to make it a special welcome. A perfectly stocked kitchen and tasty tea made it really homely. It was also spotless clean and the African styled furnishings gave it a memorable touch. The house has friendly reception staff and they were helpful with giving directions. The location is sublime as it overlooks Hyde Park which is really close to both parts of the city centre. We highly recommend the flat and would happily stay again in the future. Thanks!
My stay at Desireé's apartment was one of my best experiences yet! She's a phenomenal host and the apartment has everything a traveler could need. It's really a luxury stay. Loved it!!
Desiree was a fantastic host with a lovely apartment in a great location in Sydney!

Centrally located, comfortable, 4 star quality, beautifully decorated apartment with everything you could need including a lovely view of Hyde Park. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and are already looking forward to staying here again. Desireé was helpful and responsive. We miss it already.

Desiree's place was beyond our expectations!! The interior of the home was very clean and modern. The location was perfect for exploring the city, and communication with Desiree was always very clear with quick response. If we ever go back to Sydney we will definitely book with her again!!

The apartment is really well located, a stunning view from the rooftop pool on the Anzac Memorial and the Sydney eye tower. Desireé is helpful and kind! 
A really good address!
Loved staying at Your place, great location, 20 min walk to Opera House, close to great shopping and dining area...Thank You for the chocolate and the flowers!!!

Loved this apartment.  It is located across from beautiful Hyde Park.  You can easily walk to the botanical gardens, many museums and art galleries, the opera house and much more.  The apartment itself is beautiful, nicely furnished, has all the amenities you would want including coffee, tea, milk, cookies, fruit and more.  There is a convenience store right next to it.  Desiree could not have been warmer or more helpful. She was available any time we had a question.  We already asked to book another stay and we will recommend her place to friends.

This is a very nice condo, location was awesome.  We walked everywhere and went to some of the restaurants Desiree recommended, we were not disappointed.  Had a great stay and most certainly would love to do it again.

The apartment was perfectly located and very lovely.  It's just as nice as the pics, and Desiree was the perfect host.  The neighborhood is wonderful, and the guidebook Desiree provided was very useful.  Definitely go to Messina at least once for gelato (we went twice).  We also loved the ARTERY gallery, and bought some nice gifts for friends back home and even a cool painting that I could carry on to the plane.  Overall a great experience and a perfect spot to end our trip to Australia in style.

The appartment is very confortable, very clean and new. It is like it's shown no pictures. Desiree was really helpful and left us the basic stuff for everyday needs, such us coffee, tea, sugar and bathroom supplies. The location is convenient, easy to get from the airport and with lots of buses stops, in a nice area. We had a great time!

This is best place to stay in Sydney! Just few steps to the Hyde Park. Right in the central area which is easy to travel,exploring and food hunting.
When we arrived this beautiful apartment. Everything you see make you feel like home. Because we were there for the Sydney gay and lesbian mardi gras. You can watch the parade at the balcony (Best view ever).
And we thank you for the host making our trip in Sydney unforgettable.
Best apartment ever, super central in the heart of Sydney, 100% recommended, check it out!
My husband and I had a wonderful time staying in Desireé's beautiful apartment. Would definitely stay again.

This is a lovely apartment, in a hotel/serviced apartment building.  For once the pictures really don't do it justice.  The hotel rooms get marked down for being dated in reviews on hotel sites, but this apartment certainly isn't.  It's centrally located: it has Darlinghurst's little strip of restaurants just around the corner, and central Sydney equally close in the other direction.  I was here for a week in March and it (unusually) rained every day, so the 60" UHD Samsung smart TV with Netflix and Stan (Aussie streaming), as well as Apple TV, was particularly welcome, as was the small gym on the roof.  The pool was less useful, but would be great normally.  Desireé is a very friendly host too.  Highly recommended.

Desireé’s apartment is the perfect place to explore Sydney city from. Perfectly central to all city sights. The apartment was super clean and neat. It hosts beautiful city views, a quick 5 minute walk to Museum rail station, and a hop to great restaurants and nightlife. The apartment is tastefully decorated with art and books from adventurous travels; furnished and accessorized with absolutely everything that I could require, plus more. I was impressed at the Desireé's thoughtfulness in accommodating her guests needs. Such things as a kind welcome note. Petite chocolates, mini fresh milk packs in the fridge, expresso machine and every conceivable toiletry item one could need inside a bathroom cabinet. Discreetly rolled up extension cords so you never have to look for one to reach the wall socket to charge your digital devices. The bed was comfortable, where sprigs of fragrant lavender greeted us laid upon freshly rolled up towels. We loved our stay and highly recommend Desireé as a host. She communicated well, was always polite and prompt with messaging all required information upon booking. There's no doubt why Desireé has been voted as a super host. You will be delighted.

This is a wonderful place to stay comfortable and clean easy access and very close to Museum Station and  beautiful Hyde Park. The host is marvelous and provided us with so many wonderful amenities. We would definitely stay here again .

Desireé is a wonderful host. She's easy to contact and responds promptly when you send her an email. Her place is very comfortable and clean. She let us arrive early and we had no problem staying an extra night. We really appreciated that!! Transport to the city and surrounding areas are very close to her place. Great place to walk around lots to see and do. I would definitely stay again :)
Lovely, tastefully designed and very clean apartment in a great location. We had high expectations having read the rave reviews and it certainly did not disappoint.

Desiree was the perfect host.  The apartment is just as it is down on the airbnb site.  Desiree answered our many queries and requests super-quickly and she is very approachable and friendly.  The location is really close to all the CBD attractions and public transport.  Desiree added so many extras like a bottle of wine and chocolates to help us celebrate our milestone anniversary. We would highly recommend this listing. Thanks Desiree!

This apartment is a very nice good place to stay, its in a secure building, The apartment is spotless clean and very well maintained, very comfortable, kitchen is well prepared with stove, oven, fridge, microwave, coffeemaker, watercooker, dishwasser, enough pots and pans etc. Livingroom has a comfortable sofa, salon table, mega big TV with many channels, dining table with 6 chairs, extra lounger, two small balconies, one which has 2 chairs and a table. Bedroom with large bed, desk and big closet, bathroom with sink, shower and toilet. The host had many soaps, shampoos, drinks, coffee, wine and bottled water available for us to use, which was very kind and nice ( Im not sure if this is always there) The host replied always quick to any questions we had. We stayed 8 nights and we will return! Thanks Desiree and Julian!

Fabulous apartment in the centre of Sydney, we'll appointed and great facilities, pool, gym and pay laundry downstairs. Apartment is just like the photos. Communication with Desiree was fabulous and nothing was a problem. Nice personal touches when we arrived. A great place to stay

Fantastic! Desireé made the entire stay flawless - sent detailed arrival info days before, had keys waiting for us at the front desk, a bottle of wine waiting upon arrival, and a spotless apartment with all possible amenities. Great home base for a vacation. Public transit just across the street, restaurants are within 10 minutes walk, and a taxi stand is available right next door. Highly recommend.

Very tidy, modern one bed apartment opposite Hyde Park. The location was superb for transportation, local cafes, local cafes and restaurants. Great Wifi, safe and secure. The host Desiree is very helpful and has a lot of extra bits and pieces to make stay more comfortable. Would stay again.
We had a wonderful stay in Desiree's apartment.  Great location, spotlessly clean and very homely.  Would definitely stay again.

If you are heading to Sydney and want a FANTASTIC place that is central and within walking distance to everywhere, especially Darling Harbour, then please stay at Desiree's apartment.  There is everything you could want close by, especially restaurants and public transport, the airport train is just a few meters away. The apartment has everything you could possibly need and more. Desiree's interest and love of people shines through in everything she does; she goes way beyond being a superhost.  Thank you Desiree for making our stay so special and we can't wait to come back, hopefully when the weather is a little kinder.

Great location! Everything is in walking distance and the supermarket is just around the corner. The hosts are always available and very helpful. The apartment is very clean and safe. Would definitely stay here again!

Perfect central apartment, walkable to everything you need and very close to public transportation options as well. Desireé was an absolutely fantastic host, stocking the kitchen with the necessities and even a bottle of wine! She communicated everything up front very clearly and had great recommendations in her guidebook. We were very comfortable in the apartment for our stay and would highly recommend to anyone looking to explore the Sydney area!
Desiree and Julian were wonderful hosts. The listing was beautifully decorated. Would absolutely love to stay here again during our next trip to Sydney.

This is a lovely apartment for a couple. Well fitted out, a few essentials for eating in and decorated with a very tasteful African theme. During the cool winter evenings, the reverse cycle heaters were fantastic. Traffic noise was well muted by the double glass in the bedroom. Desireé was very communicative through our stay and had provided lots of info about Sydney and what to do, where to eat, etc.

This is a little treasure in the best part of Sydney! Desiree was a great communicator, checking in with us all through our visit to make sure all was good - and it was great! Lovely sized apartment, beautifully appointed and fully of little things to make our stay memorable.

We spent a very comfortable 8 nights in Desiree's apartment.  It is just as it looks in the pictures.  It is smartly decorated with comfortable furniture and lovely modern kitchen and bathroom.  There is a guest laundry in the building with coin operated machines and you can do a big wash and dry for $4 each.  The apartment is bright and airy and has a nice busy city outlook which we enjoyed.  You can certainly hear the buzz of the city around you but you are right in the CBD so that is to be expected and enjoyed.  The location is fantastic.  You can walk to just about everything in the city centre and trains and buses are only metres away if you want to get around more quickly or go further afield.  Very easy access from the airport by train into Museum station. The host, Desiree, was a pleasure to deal with, excellent communication all the way through.  This is a wonderful little home away from home putting you right into centre of the Sydney action.

Eine sehr Zentrum nah gelegene Wohnung. Absolut empfehlenswert um Sydney zu entdecken. Man kann optimal zu Fuß in die Innenstadt und läuft nur kurz durch den Hyde Park. Zum Flughafen sind es auch nur 15 Minuten.
Enjoyable repeat stay.
We had a great time here. The host is so generous and thoughtful. One of the best places I've stayed! Highly recommend!!!

Desirees place was awesome. The room was very clean, internet speed was sufficient, and all the goodies that she provides in the room ( extra toiletries, snacks, and even wine in the kitchen and refrigerator were a great bonus.  The location of the condo was very convenient to get around Sydney.  Lots of restaurants and train stations nearby !!!  Desiree was also very quick at responding to our needs and questions . Overall, 5 out of 5 stars for us !!!
The apartment has great convenience to everything. It suits for tourist. Desiree is helpful and warm hearted.

Fab location near Museum train station. Apartment sparkling clean and so many extras e.g butter, beer, wine, bottled water, cereal etc that were much appreciated. Would definitely recommend this apartment.

Desiree is an amazing host and had the perfect space for us! It started from wonderful communication to easy early check in. It continued with an immaculate unit that provided us an oasis from our sight seeing. We use Airbnb quite a bit and especially enjoy being able to have a kitchen area for a quick breakfast or meal and morning coffee. The unit was close to grocery, public transport and amenities were as if I had lived there. We were there to celebrate my spouse's 50th birthday and were pleasantly surprised by the nice and thoughtful birthday card. Thank you again and we had a blast!

The apartment is perfectly located, easy access and walking distance to all attractions. Spotless clean, well appointed and really comfy, the seperate bedroom was great especialy when you are traveling with a baby !
Thanks again for our great stay :)

A super place to stay - well appointed, beautifully furnished with great facilities within the building. Going to Sydney contact Desiree.

Sue Hillman
The apartment was absolutely as expected. Clean and modern. Lots of great restaurants and shopping close by.

Beautiful apartment, clean, modern, nicely decorated. Centrally located, walking distance from everything we wanted to see. Two balconies with awesome views of Hyde Park and Oxford St. We really felt like we were living the Sydney high life. Plenty of towels, bedding, etc, there was even a bunch of shampoo/conditioner/soap to use and coffee, juice and chocolate for us as well. Desiree’s apartment really felt like a home away from home, will definitely visit again next time we’re in Sydney!
Desireé’s place is extremely well located, superbly comfortable and sparklingly clean. We would love to stay here on every future visit to Sydney.

This space is great. The size is wonderful for a couple, anything you could need was available. Desireé was so easy to work with. We asked for special accommodations for checking in and out and Desireé was swift in reply as well as considerate in communications! The space is even nicer than it appears in the photos and the location is very convenient to so many attractions.

This is an amazing place!  LOVED the amenities of coffee, milk, wine bottle, chocolate bar , great TV, lots and lots of towels, and wonderful location.  We didn't use the rooftop pool, but we should have (busy visiting daughter).   Could not have been happier with this choice.  Thank you Desiree.
Super great stay here!

This is the perfect location. Just a block from a great transit connection but walkable to the main sites too. 

It’s easy to get anywhere. We took the bus to Coogee and Bondi beaches, to Sydney Fish Market, to Opera House and ferry hub of Circular Quay for the ferry to Manly.  You are also on subway routes too!

The home is quiet even though the street and park are well used.  It feels super safe to walk in.

There are great grocery and restaurant options right here...and we were hooked on Greenhouse Coffee just a few blocks down to start our day. We enjoyed the Sydney Festival and walked to their events and free activities. 

The home had lots of lovely touches and thoughtful additions in the bath, the kitchen and a nice collection of books and info.
Very nice, stylish place, close to everything, in  quiet environment. Check in was easy.
Stylish decor—thoughtful touches—great communication—\0perfect location!

This was our first experience with Airbnb and we have been very lucky to choose Desiree as a host. The apartment is lovely, very clean, confortable and well appointed. The size is perfect for two people and the location is very convenient, in front of Hide Park, easy to be reached by the airport via irport likn train that stops just few steps away. All the main city attractions are at walking distance. Desiree is very kind and supporting. You can easily reach her at any time via e-mail and she answers in a few minutes. Highly  recommended!
Great flat in the heart of Sydney. Photos and description exactly as advertised, and host communication was second-to-none! Would recommend if you want to be able to walk anywhere centrally
This place is really good!! It has convenient location, basically you can get everything you need within 10 minuets-walk. The hosts are super kind and thoughtful. Highly recommend!
Amazing location, loved the area and easy walk to all major sites. Very nice unit and amazing value.

Desiree earns a big tick for hospitality and thoughtfulness. The apartment was exactly as described and couldn't have better suited a weekend Mardi Gras getaway.

We'd definitely recommend this place to others and can't rate Desiree's communication and responsiveness highly enough. The apartment was spotless, had all the mod cons you could wish for, was convenient to transport and perfectly located with awesome views.
Great communication and thoughtful touches! Will definitely stay together
Amazing location, the apartment was exactly how it described.  Desiree was very responsive and check in was easy.  Highly recommended!
Beautiful view, gorgeous apartment, and perfect location. Would definitely stay here again the next time I’m in Sydney! Thanks for the wonderful stay, Desireé!

You will feel at home at Desireé's apartment. Beautifully designed, it is luminous, cosy and perfectly situated in front of Hyde Park; the Museum Station is just a few steps away and many bus stops are just downstairs. It' s easy to go anywhere you wish, thanks to the perfect location.

And Desireé is a real superhost: Quick to answer my inquiries, she gave me valuable advice during my stay.

 I recommend strongly this apartment: You will enjoy even more your stay in Sydney (and won't want to leave...). Many thanks Desireé!

Desireé and Julian’s apartment was a perfect place to explore Sydney from - and delicious Darlinghurst restaurants nearby. They had thought of everything, and we really appreciated the homely touches. The bed is very comfy, there is plenty of wardrobe space, and a comfy couch when a night in is in order. Despite the location right near Hyde Park, it is very quiet and we were not bothered by any noise during our stay. Desireé and Julian were lovely hosts and we appreciated the clear directions and easy check-in and check-out. We would love to stay here again when we’re in Sydney again!

I have stayed at Desiree’s place twice now as I travel for work and it’s one of my favourite Sydney accomodation venues. It’s is absolutely spotless, secure, quiet and the most convenient location. Desiree is an excellent and attentive host - this place deserves every great review it gets and more

Desiree's place was very comfortable & was perfectly located for my trip to Sydney. I came for the Sydney Film Festival, and the apartment was well located on Hyde Par, so I could walk to and from the venue. The studio was very comfortable and well stocked too - the little things such as tea, milk, spreads for breakfast etc were thoughtful. Picking up and dropping off the keys were a breeze and whilst I did not meet my host, she was very responsive and helpful. I can highly recommend this place for a city based jaunt. Thanks again Desiree

Really lovely apartment in a fantastic location. The double glazing in the bedroom and super comfy bed meant we slept like a log, and the rest of the apartment is stylish and very comfortable. As per previous reviews, Desiree's thoughtful touches, excellent communication and brilliant local recommendations really shines and elevates the whole experience to something very special. We stayed with our toddler, and the building/apartment has excellent pram accessibility.

Great apartment in an excellent locations, close to public transportation and countless cafes and dinner spots. Desiree was always super quick to reply and available at all times to meet our requests. We would definitely stay here again if returning to Sydney!
A great convenient location to stay for visitors to Sydney with a great host.
Great location and a very nicely presented apartment.
Such a great apartment, super host and fantastic holiday!!!  Keeps in contact and replies to messages super fast
Desireé’s apartment is great! It's clean, well lit, comfortable, and located in a great part of Sydney. Desireé is a great host and an excellent communicator. I would love to stay here again!
Do yourself a favour, if this place is free, book it!! Stunning. Thanks so much
Wonderful base for my visiting parents. Desireé was so helpful and conscientious and I can’t recommend her apartment enough.

Desireé was the perfect host for my parents on their return to Sydney after staying in her apartment the previous week. She was fast to respond to queries and the apartment had lots of thoughtful touches and was in a great location. Definitely would use this when they visit again.
Fantastic unit, very central. Lots of amenities.

Location, location, location!

In the heart of the city, close to transport, close to cafes and restaurants and walking distance to CBD.

Hotels are good, Airbnb’s are great!

This apartment is a wonderful place to stay in Sydney. It is very stylish and comfortable. The location is near transport, shops, cafes and restaurants. Having access to a kitchen also gave me the option of cooking a light meal if I didn't feel like going out.

Desiree’s apartment was wonderful. Beautifully furnished, sparkling clean, fabulous location and many thoughtful touches. The location is amazing and i would stay there any time I am in Sydney. Thank you for sharing your home Desireé and your thoughtfulness!
Very good location. Incredible host, Desiree helped us out with everything and responded really fast. Everything we needed was at the appartment.
Beautiful rental, perfect location to attractions, busses, restaurants and so much more. Owners go above and beyond.

A wonderfully stylish and authentic apartment. Perfect location. Lots of lovely books to read and thoughtful touches. The hosts are fantastic. I would hope to stay there if ever we are in Sydney again.
we had such a great stay. the location is super, the host is flexible and accomodating and the appartment is sooooo nice plus, plus ,plus

This flat was absolutely perfect! It was located right across from Hyde Park with a beautiful view. It was very central to everything we wanted to do in Sydney. She also left us chocolate, coffee, milk and other food for us which was so lovely to come to. We traveled very far and were immediately impressed by the lovely accommodation and personal touch of Desiree’s flat. I would highly recommend this apartment if coming to Sydney for a city break!
Wonderfully appointed apartment. Centrally located and a lovely host
Desiree’s place was absolutely perfect for our time spent in Sydney. Amazing location and everything you could need! Highly recommend staying here while in Sydney!

Desireé apartment is so centrally - ideal location! 
The apartment is a real home from home & has everything you need.
Desireé is a super host, very easy to checkin & out. 
We loved our stay here & didn’t want to leave. :)

My wife and I had a lovely time staying at Desiree’s apartment. Was very close to public transportation to get around the city. Apartment was very clean and comfortable for our stay. Desireé was very prompt in any communication before and during our stay. Highly recommend.

This AirBnB is not to be missed! Home was very clean and there were thoughtful touches upon check in. I arrived very late at night and the check in process was quick and easy. The host had amazing and quick responses during my stay - great communication. The apartment has 2 balconies which allow loads of sunlight into the space when the curtains are pulled back. Great location for Ubers, Taxis, walks in the park. I stayed for business and I walked to the CBD within 15 minutes - easy. I will definitely stay again!

The moment you enter this Airbnb you realize this is a host who cares.  Chocolate on the coffee table, cold water in the fridge, cereal on the shelf, and roses in the bedroom greeted us.  Nine floors up you can hear the street noise but the bedroom is surprisingly quiet.  The location is near the metro and walkable to the waterfront.  This home and its location were perfect for our 6 night stay.  Would happily return on our next trip to Sydney.

This city sized apartment was wonderful.   Very clean, well stocked with most everything you need.   Located around grocery stores, pharmacies, shops, restaurants and bars.  Great location for exploring Sydney,  buses and trains within 5 minutes, walking distance to circular quay. Street noise was remarkably low in the bedroom. The only shortcoming was the internet connection,  very spotty if more than one device was was connected.   We would definitely stay here upon our return to Darlinghurst.

I highly recommend Desiree's place to anyone visiting Sydney.  It's convenient, clean, and very comfortable.  Desiree was an outstanding host.  She was communicative, helpful, and went above and beyond.  I hope to return.

Fast Wifi and fully appointed kitchen; with 5 bedrooms; 3 bathrooms and 2 living areas and study. host.host_about:
I'm an active, community minded recently divorced single parent. I live in with my children in our family friendly home in a great suburban location in Sydney. My home is conveniently located close to shops, parks, transport in a quiet leafy street, very centrally located and close to hospitals. 
I have listed my home as I share the care of my children with their father and I travel frequently for work, and Airbnb seemed like a great opportunity for my family to help cover costs. 
I've previously hosted overseas students and always found it a really positive experience for both myself and my kids. We are a welcoming happy family who like to enjoy all our beautiful city has to offer and we look forward to welcoming you and your family.

reviews.comments: Beautiful house and gorgeous pool and spa! Perfect for our family with young kids

Heidi's home was perfect. Our family group was very comfortable and had a wonderful time. Heidi was very accomodating, the house was clean and everything we needed. The kids loved playing in the pool and the adults loved having a spa when the kids went to bed! It was a great location and home base for sightseeing. We'd definitely stay again! Thanks for having us and helping make our family reunion so wonderful,
The host canceled this reservation 30 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.
All is as described. Lovely home, not just a house. We were made to feel completely welcome. Our stay in Sydney at Heidi's home was like coming back to an oasis. Thank you for your hospitality.

Beautiful house - the photos do not do it justice, and Heidi was absolutely lovely to deal with and was ready to help with any issues that arose during our stay, literally coming to the house in the rain to fix the spa!

A lovely weekend overall, in a lovely house with a lovely owner. Would definitely stay again.

Our family has such a wonderful time living in Heidi's house. We have 7 adults and 1 baby and this house comfortably accommodates all. It is a very nice house with every convenient facility you could ask for a holiday rental. Heidi even got a rice cooker and so many spices that we use for our cooking. It's so great because my family is from Vietnam and they love to cook and cannot live without rice. We also have great time using the clean pool and barbecue. My husband and I had a good experience when taking my 5 month baby to swim for the first time. Heidi is a fantastic host that welcomed us in the first day and showed us every corner of the house. We are very satisfied and definitely will come back here if we have a chance

This house is absolutely stunning. We were in town for a family funeral, and I'm so glad we found Heidi and her house as it made our stay a lot easier to deal with.

The house and property are gorgeous, a lot of effort has gone into how it looks. There's everything you can think of here and is perfect for families. It's perfect for anyone really. Our toddler was in heaven and I suspect a bit sad to come home.

The linen felt and smelt new and incredibly fresh, the instructions Heidi left described everything well. The air conditioning, netflix and internet were all terrific. Having three bathrooms and toilets was a blessing with our large family. The pool, yard, trampoline, cubby house, swings and hammocks all got used a lot.

Heidi was incredibly accommodating, she let us stay at really short notice and did her very best to make our stay as comfortable as it could be given our circumstances.

This stay was worth every cent and not only will we recommend the house but we'll also stay again should the need arise.

Thank you Heidi.

Heidi was very pleasant to deal with and provided me the flexibility I needed when it came to a late checkout. 
The large beautiful home was extremely comfortable and very well equipped to suit my large family's needs. 
Her backyard was manicured abc the pool was super clean.
This was booked on behalf of my colleagues and they really enjoyed their stay. Thanks Heidi

Heidi welcomed our family in person at the house. She gave us a nice tour and made sure we were comfortable using all the controls for the pool, appliances, TV's ect. 
She then sat with us and reviewed our itinerary for the week. She had some great suggestions that we would have never known about that really made our visit to Sydney special.
The house has been updated but still has the charm of an older home with the crown molding and tray ceilings. The kids had a great time in the Pool and jumping on the trampoline.
The neighborhood was quiet and provided easy access to the train as well as shopping and restaurants.
Our family thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Heidi's property and would recommend it with no reservations.

We had a fantastic family reunion trip staying at Heidi's home. She was extremely accommodating letting us stay at the last minute and also letting us extend our check-out when some family members took ill. 
Heidi has a very welcoming and comfortable house which is obviously a well-loved family home. The pool and back garden were amazing. Towels, linen and all appliances etc. were all in great condition. 
We really couldn't have asked for any more! Thank you so much, Heidi

Thanks Heidi,
Awesome property! Our family had a lovely time. We had a gorgeous family bbq on sunday where my children and nephew ran around in the 'park' as my nephew called it. We all enjoyed the pool & spa - even our bubbly black lab! Beds super comfy & delightfully decorated. To top it all off - very quite neighbourhood close to all amenities. Thanks Heidi & family for sharing your fab home.

There are no words to describe how perfect this property was for our needs and for how amazing Heidi was in accommodating our request. Heidi bent over backwards to make the property available to us even though it meant she and her family had to change their plans to vacate the property. 

The location and size of the house plus all the extras were a perfect fit for us. We needed a place where family could come together - from Spain, Bangladesh, Melbourne, Albury, Gundaroo and Canberra - for a funeral and Heidi's place was like coming home. 

On the one night when everyone was staying over, the house easily slept 9 adults and 3 children. It was great having access to 3 bathrooms. Off road parking and great relaxing options both inside and outside. The pool and spa and trampoline and cubby house were the icing on the cake. 

Thank you a million times over for your generosity Heidi - it made a world of difference to all of us.

Heidi's place was absolutely amazing. The house was immaculate with plenty of space for the 3 other couples we had staying with us. The house itself had everything you could possibly want for a weekend in Sydney.
The location was absolutely incredible close to Carlton train station and not to far from the Airport.
A big backyard with plenty of space for kids to run around an amazing pool which was incredible. 
I will be recommending Heidi's place to all my family and friends and will not hesitate to contact Heidi for any further trips to Sydney to see if her place is available.

The most amazing host and home I have ever had the pleasure of visiting! We used Heidis lovely home for a film shoot and could not have found a more idillic location. 
The entire crew wanted throughout the day to jump in the pool and go for a swim it was that inviting.
Heidi is also the perfect host, nothing is too hard or can't be done, she even sourced another dining room table for us!

I would recommend Heidi and hour home to anyone who would listen. Now I want to go back and stay there with my family!

Heidi's house is clean and comfortable. My kids loves her back garden very much. It's a mini playground for them. 
It's easy to reach the shopping center and airport. 
We enjoyed every minutes here in her house.

We loved our stay at this delightful house. The house was perfect for our family holiday of 3 couples and 5 children. The backyard space and amenities were so well suited to our needs, our children happily played outside every waking hour. 
The kitchen is well equipped, with indoor and outdoor dining options. The bathrooms were modern and lovely. The bedrooms were clean and comfortable and spacious for those needing a portacot. 
Heidi is a lovely, accommodating and well organised host and made our stay very comfortable and easy. 
We will most definitely rebook here in the future.

The place is amazing.  Great location for morning walks. Very friendly neighbourhood. The house is very clean and the swimming pool is just way too relaxing. I honestly enjoyed my stay for 5 nights. The place is very spacious and I could not look for any place better than this.

Great house with all the inclusions you could ask for. Very comfortable, private and quiet neighbourhood . Very central and easy to get into the city or to the south. We stayed for two weeks with our three young children and it met our needs perfectly. Will definately recommend.

this home was big and very spacius.can easly stay upto 8 peoples.pool was plus and childrreb likes it.
home have enough aminties and OK wifi.
bugs and flies are only downside but it  its ok if you are not staying long in kitchen.
非常酷的地方,交通方便,设施齐全,干净温馨的家｡

Had a very comfortable stay at Heidi's place. Good central location, close to some great Lebanese restaurants on Rocky Point Rd and handy to Brighton cafes. Comfortable beds and good linens. Bathrooms are lovely. Would recommend for a family trip and would stay again. Thanks Heidi!
Best airbnb experience I ever had. Beautiful place, nice house, well equipped. All you need is provided.
Heidi's house was absolutely perfect for our stay. Immaculately presented and with all the necessary amenities. Plenty of space too--excellent host!
Great hospitality, huge house in friendly neighbourhood
Heidi was a fantastic host. Communication was fast. clear and easy and the house was great. Highly recommended for families and groups.

My family had a wonderful time thank you for your sharing your home with us Heidi . Everything was there that we wanted in a holiday home, Although it would  of been nice to have a second fridge and little more shade for around the pool. Highly recommended

Our family group stayed at Heidi's back in 2016 and we all loved it. One of the kids, aged 8, who has travelled the world and stayed in many fabulous places, declared "Oh, I LOVE that house" when he heard we were returning this year. And once again it lived up to his expectations and surpassed ours. The five bedrooms are stunning and the mattresses to die for on the comfort front. The three bathrooms are the epitome of luxury - they have all been completely made over since our last visit and are both beautiful and functional. The pool, the spa, the cubby house, the hammocks, the undercover outdoor area ... the list of features goes on. And to complete the package is Heidi - the most responsive, flexible host you could hope to meet. If you are looking for a space to share and create memories this is it. Book it now. You won't regret it.
The host canceled this reservation 2 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.
Such a beautiful home that is very comfortable and relaxing. My friends and I really enjoyed our stay here!

Conveniently located 2 minutes to Bondi Beach and  very close to many of the exciting cafes, bars and restaurants  grocery stores and bakeries in Bondi.  Easy access to bus and trains which are very frequent , 15 minutes to city.

neighborhood_overview: Friendly and pleasant neighbours. Excellent facilities in the neighbourhood;great cafes, bars , pubs and well renowned restaurants to suit your particular dining preference. 2 minutes to  Bondi Beach.  Coastal walks to Tamarama and Bronte Beach or  to  Rose Bay and Watsons Bay , if you prefer the inner Harbour views .
notes: Please note that the security deposit will be higher if you intend to stay for more than a week.  $1200 for month.  Christmas  -New Year period needs a minimum of  6 days stay .
transit: Transport couldn't be more convenient. There's a choice of buses that go into the city. (phone number hidden) and the 333 express bus. They run every 3-5 minutes at peak time  or 10 minutes. there's the  train from Bondi Junction and even the Rose Bay ferry  to take you to   the city if you want to go to Darling Harbour or the Museum and art Gallery.
access: Shared laundry downstairs
interaction: Happy to spend a  morning showing my guest the local area  and giving necessary information about getting around the city.  And at least an evening meal together depending on how long you stay.
house_rules: No smoking and no pets are allowed in the building. I use my space for yoga practice so you need to leave shoes outside the door thanks .   Please leave the  space you use as you found it .   If your stay is more than 3 weeks   a cleaning fee of $80 will be charged. Please provide me Accomodation ID  and reviews before completing the reservation .

host.host_location: Bondi Beach, New South Wales, Australia
host.host_about:
I am an English teacher who has taught students from many nationalities . I have travelled  countries in Europe and Asia so far and keen to do more.
 My favourite city is Barcelona  and  the village of Roquebrun in France.
 I  love all forms of movement and dance and  theatre and am devoted  to my yoga  practice .Soon  to be  yoga teacher training  in Byron.
 I love living  in the heart of Bondi. There are many activities to enjoy by the beach or if you want some solitude there are beautiful walks along the coast or places to meditate.

reviews.comments:
Karen is a wonderful host.
I really enjoyed her place and her company. Her place is clean comfortable and close to all (2 min walk to the beach)
Karen guided me through all my stay and thanks to her my 4 days visit was a filled up with the right activities.
Thanks you karen for being such a great host I hope one day to come back.

Karen is a great host. She really looked after me throughout my stay and helped me with all manner of things. I felt very welcome in her place .
 I liked that the place was so conveniently located to everything: the  shops, the  great variety of eating places and the lovely waters of Bondi Beach. Transport was very easy to the city or Bondi Junction. The place was clean and the bed very comfortable. I would definitely stay again !  Thank you Karen .

Karen is a lovely host. Her place was tidy, clean and comfortable. I felt very welcome and well looked after during my one week stay.
The place was conveniently located and close to the beach, shops and transport routes. Thank you Karen!

Karen is the perfect flatmate for me. 
Quiet, clean, respectful, nice. I had a great time with her. She is also considerate to her guests, trying to help me to find some shops or stuff like that. 
The bedroom is sunny, clean and cosy. The bed is comfortable and is bigger than he looks on the picture. The Appartement is also more beautiful than on the picture. The kitchen is very well equipped. What else to say. The location of the flat is vey close to the beach not even 5 limited walk.
I had a great time in this Appartement and will definitely come back there if I visit Sydney again.

Karen is a wonderful host and her home is lovely.  She made me feel so welcome and helped me with all my questions about Bondi.  I had a wonderful night’s sleep in Karen’s peaceful home.  Her guest room is very comfortable.  I was also lucky enough to sample Karen’s cooking.  She’s a wonderful cook!  

Karen’s home is in a fantastic location near Bondi Beach.  It was such a treat to be so close.  Just a short stroll and you’re on the sand.  Next time I stay in Bondi, Karen’s place will definitely be my first choice for accommodation, and I would love to see her again.

Had a great week in Karen's lovely apartment. The room was clean, light and spacious. Karen's a great host and went out of her way to make sure I was happy. 
Great location few minutes walk to the beach, restaurants and cafe's and easy access to public transport. Would definitely recommend for anyone visiting Bondi!
Karen is an amazing person! Big heart and a master cook chef, if you like heath food! The bedroom is bigger than in the pictures! Loved my stay!

I was made very welcome by Karen and shown around the apartment which was indeed bright and sunny and perfectly located in Bondi. Easy to walk to the beach and shops and bus and restaurants.thr room was comfy as was the whole apartment. I would stay here again! Thanks Karen

Stayed with Karen for almost 2 weeks. Where do I begin?  To say she was a fabulous host is an understatement. She was very kind, helpful and took time to write places of interest  to visit. I was made to feel very much at home at put at ease. Couldn't have picked a better place to stay.  I have enjoyed doing yoga with her,going for walks,we even found time to go for dinner one evening. 
I would highly recommend this place to stay as it is so close to the beach and public transport. Would definitely come back!

My experience was great! Karen is too hospitality and the best yoga teacher I ever had. The flat clean and ordered, really close to Bondi beach and others points of interest. Surely I'll know where to go when I'll come again in Sydney.
Thank you Karen for the beatiful experience.

I thoroughly enjoyed my stay at Karen's apartment! It is extremely close to Bondi beach, in a clean, safe building.  
The location is also near 4 different buses to the nearest train station.  It was very easy to get around.  Food and shopping are nearby as well. 
The room is very comfortable and clean.  I felt very at home and everything I needed to know was explained the first day.  Wi-fi was also available whenever I needed it.  
Karen was fun to talk to as well. I enjoyed learning more about Aussie life and things to do in Sydney through her.  I hope to see her again the next time I visit!

I have spent one week at Karen’s. Awesome place, pretty close to the beach. She explained everything when I got to her place, like house rules and things to do in the surroundings. The room is exactly as seen in the pictures, pretty clean and organized. Breakfast available. I was able to use the laundry room. Karen was a great host, very easygoing and helpful on answering questions regarding the region and it's culture. Definitely recommended.

I loved staying at Karen's place. She is such a kind person and made me feel like home. The place is very close to the beach and in the perfect location for a stay in Bondi. I highly recommend her place and I'd be happy to stay again.

Had a chance to stay with Karen over the weekends and I'm glad I have chosen her place. It's very near to everything especially to the beach. Place is very cozy and nice. Karen is a super host! She is very hospitable and kind. She even gave me a tour and recommended the best spots to visit in Bondi, and on my last day I was a bit in a hurry to get back to the city and she offered me a ride to the bondi junction.
Karen is one of the best hosts I've ever had the pleasure of staying with. More than a stay, I made a friend in Bondi! Don't hesitate to stay with her.

Karen es como un amigo que espera por tí.  Preocupada de todos los detalles.  La pieza es muy acogedora, extremadamente limpia al igual que todo el depto.   Un lugar muy tranquilo ademas de su excelente ubicación a pocas cuadras de la playa y los lugares de entretención y comercio.  Con locomoción para cualquier lugar de Sydney.  Excelente
My stay at Karen's place went according to plan. Super A+ host and would gladly come back again!
