reviews.comments: Great place!! Spectacular postcard view of Sugar Loaf Botafogo beach.The apartment is newly-renovated and air-conditioned .There is a shopping mall ,grocery stores,a great independent  movie theater, bookstores, and great cafes minutes from the building. The metro station is located just a few blocks away. Copacabana and Ipanema beaches are just a few stops away by bus or metro. You can actually walk to Copacabana and Urca ! Ana Amelia was  so responsive and worked with me to create a vacation with everything.She is very prompt on responding to requests and is extremely helpful.

Estou muito satisfeita com o atendimento e transparência com que fui tratada, tanto pela anfitriã ANA AMÉLIA como pelo site AIRBNB.
Tive inúmeros imprevistos durante a reserva do Flat, incluindo a necessidade de mudar a data de chegada até o cancelamento definitivo da minha viagem. Em todos eles, fui atendida com muito atencão, flexibilidade e consideracão por ambas as (Website hidden by Airbnb) certeza indico!!! 
É nas horas em que as coisas não saem como planejamos que percebemos o quanto é importante tratar com pessoas competentes e honestas.
Muito Obrigada por tudo! E espero em breve fechar outras reservas!
Sophia
Ana was nice as well as Patricia, and the space is incredible.  Clean, bright, airy...with an absolutely perfect view.

This apartment is just incredible: it has a breathtaking view on the "pao de azucar", and even an hammock on which you can lay and watch the panorama. It is really as it seems on the photos, and probably even better. Moreover, Ana has been very kind, taking care of all my needs/requests. If I will ever come back to Rio, I hope I can stay here again.

The apartment is charming and really does have a spectacular view from the 12th floor, is safe and does have very good air-conditioning!

The location in Botafogo was perfect for my trip which was for work so the easy access to the Metro and numerous buses was really helpful as we needed to be all over the city each day for meetings.

I was very impressed with Ana Amelia's efficiency in responding to my booking and various enquiries - this was appreciated. Also, Patricia her assistant was punctual for the handover of the keys despite the lateness of my arrival and she was also very helpful when I had any questions. Also, the reception staff were extremely nice and helpful too!

I really enjoyed my stay and have recommended it to a number of friends.

However, as it is important to provide a truthful review, it is fair to say that my only negative comment about the apartment is that the noise levels from the street below are very high due to the many lanes of traffic in front of the building but most significantly the windows are of extremely poor quality so there was never a quiet moment - the flat really does need secondary glazing.

Finally, many thanks for hosting us - it was a memorable trip!

I spent a wonderful time in Ana's apartment. The view is really spectacular!  It is near the shopping,,10 minutes from Copacabana and 15 from Ipanema. You have every transportation you want at your door or pretty near.
Amelia and her assistant Patricia were really nice and cosy and if something is missing or if you need anything they  are very helpful.

We spent 11 days at Ana's apartment and agree it has to be the best view in Rio!  The location is great, especially if you want to spend time both in the south (at the famous beaches and Lagoa) and further north in the city centre seeing some of the cultural bits, as Botafogo is mid-way between them. In fact we did lots of walking (as far afield as the Jardim Botanico and to Urca for the Sugar Loaf cable car) and relied on the nearby Metro for our transport needs.

The apartment was clean, modern, safe and had all the facilities we needed including a great big fridge/freezer, coffee percolator, washing machine, huge wet-room style shower, wireless internet, and effective air conditioning which was especially welcome.  I'd agree about the noise of the 11 lanes of traffic, but the earplugs we brought with us meant we weren't disturbed.

Ana's list of local suggestions of shops, restaurants etc was a big help.  Highlights of our trip included a day trip by ferry to Niteroi, an afternoon at the brilliant exhibitions in the Paço Imperial, cycling round the Lagoa, a swish lunch at Confeitaria Colombo in town, the Saturday antiques market at Praça XV de Novembro (much better than the Sunday craft fair at Ipanema General Osorio) and of course plenty of relaxation with agua de coco and caipirinhas at Copacabana and Ipanema!

If we go back to Rio (which I hope we will) I'd be very happy to stay at Ana's place again.

Me encanto el apartamento, realmente una vista magnífica al pao de acucar! El baño muy limpio, el aire acondicionado funcionaba perfecto. Un barrio recidencial, muy tranquilo y a la vez cerca de los sitios turísticos.

We have been looking at the photos of Ana Amelia's apartment all through the cold British winter and the reality was even better than the pictures.  What a view and perfectly positioned to walk to the shopping, run along the beach, catch a taxi to the centre or in the other direction the swimming beaches.  

The apartment was well equipped but not at all cluttered - I hope we will be able to return in future years.
The reservation was canceled 341 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.

Appartement super lumineux avec une vue sublime!!!!
A 10-15 minutes à pied ou transports en commun de tout!
Très bon accueil et conseils; si nous revenons à Rio nous reviendrons c'est sûr!

This place is absolutely perfect, just like the other reviews say. I stayed for 2 weeks while I was in Rio for work. The subway is just a few minutes away, everything you need is close by (pharmacies, grocery stores, the Botafogo shopping mall...). It's just what I needed. 

The apartment is very well equipped and I was able to cook and do everything else. The living room area is really nice and the cable television has channels in English available. The kitchen is easy to cook in and the oven, etc, work perfectly. The washing machine was also very helpful!

Ana's assistant greeted me when I arrived because Ana wasn't available. She explained everything and was always available by phone in case of a problem. 

I would definitely book this place without hesitating if I have to go back to Rio again!

We stayed in this apartment 6 days and, summarizing, it was better than we expected.
The apartment was clean, big enough for a couple, and has all the things that you could need (iron, whasing machine, gas kitchen, fridge, tv with cable, air condicioner...)

But the thing that we loved was the view. The Pao de Açucar and the beach of Botafogo are visible from the hole apartment (excepting the bathroom). 

The only thing that can be a bit annoying is the fact that the apartment is in front of one of the main roads of Rio and therefore, there is a constant traffic noise. 

Summarizing, the apartament

We overall had a great experience at Ana's apartment.  The view was fantastic as you can see in the picture.  The location was great too, in walking distance there were juice bars, convenience stores, a mall, and the metro.  Also, the doormen were very friendly and helpful during our stay.

An amazing place to stay in Rio. The apartment is spotless and is perfectly laid out with everything one could need. SO convenient, with the metro close by and a continuous stream of busses right out of the front door. Cabs are very easy to find also. The area is well served by supermarkets and great restaurants. The huge Botafogo Praia shopping mall is a block away. Patricia, Ana's assistant, was there to help with any needs and kindly helped us, along with the friendly doorman, with our cases when we checked out. As for the view, wow- truly unbelievable! Would love to come back!

A great ten night stay indeed! The apartment is really good. It is in good condition and there is everything you'll need: bed linen, towels, good wifi, an iron, washing machine, aircon, well equipped kitchen etc... The location is perfect. The metro station is near so it is easy to get around the city. Also, Botafogo seems to be really safe even at night and there are great restaurants and supermarkets nearby. Ana (even I did not meet her) and her assistant were really kind and helpful and everything went perfectly. Would book again, definitely!

We really enjoyed our stay with Ana Amelia Macedo's place at "The most beautiful view in Rio"! The place is clean, secure and beautifully located for the one of the best views in Rio. All amenities works perfectly. Ana's assistant (Patricia) it was very helpful with the small details about the place and outside in the neighborhood. Her response it was always stellar. We definitely recommend it.

We  had a great experience at Ana's apartment. The view from the apartment is fantastic. If you take pictures, you will have a Rio de Janeiro postal.
The location is great, in walking distance there convenience stores, a shopping mall, and the metro. The apartment is clean and big. 
It have all the equipment that you need for a good stay in Rio. Otherwise Ana and Patricia, the Ana´s assistant are very polite.

I stood in "the most beautiful view in Rio" apartment for one week. I highly recommend it. The view is very beautiful especially between five and six in the morning. The kitchen has everything you need to prepare your own meals and the washer is very convenient in the bathroom. 

I did not meet Amelia but I was welcomed by her assistant Patricia who was very helpful. 

Thank you Amelia and Patricia, we enjoyed our stay and plan to return in the future!

Yes! The view is fabuleus. 
The apartment is cosy and complete and the location (Botafogo) is perfect. 
Disadvantage:  there is a lot of traffic noise during the day and during the night.
Ótimo apartamento, perfeito para casal! Bem localizado, metrô e restaurantes próximos. Prédio antigo, mas bem conservado. Uma boa opção de hospedagem.

O apartamento é muito confortável, bem equipado e limpo. Tem tudo que você precisa para relaxar e muito mais. Nós fomos capazes de levar o nosso cachorro e ate ele se sentia bem lá. A vista das janelas é maravilhosa e a localização é perfeita: o bairro não é muito lindo, mas tem mercados, botecos, a praia é em frente e é facilmente acessível. Passamos um fim de semana muito lindo. Obrigada por tudo Amelia Ana e Patricia! Esperamos voltar em breve.

The flat is spacious, with a beautiful view indeed. It is ideally located for those who want to see more than Rio's beaches, with good transport links anywhere in town and the airports. Being so central, the flat is a bit noisy; I was pleasantly surprised to see how quickly I got used to the city hum. Thanks very much !

Even though I didn´t meet Ana, she was always in communication with us through Paty, her assistant; they were very accommodating with us and Paty gave us some great advices about the city.

The apartment is nice and it was very clean, you have everything you need. The best thing about this place is the view, it is really amazing. If I come back to Rio, I definitely will consider this place to stay again.

¡I recommend this place to anyone that want to visit Rio!

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Aunque no conocí a Ana, ella siempre estaba en comunicación con nosotros a través de Paty, su asistente; ellas siempre estuvieron al pendiente de nosotros y Paty nos dio buenos consejos sobre la ciudad. 

El apartamento es agradable y estaba muy limpio, tiene todo lo que necesita. Lo mejor de este lugar es la vista, es realmente increíble. Si regreso a Río, definitivamente consideraré este lugar para quedarme de nuevo. 

¡Recomiendo este lugar a cualquiera que quiera visitar Rio!

This apartment has a gorgeous view,  but it is located right above a very busy road. Beware of constant noise, day and night. Place is cute and conveniently located. It was easy to grab a taxi and close to metro.  Unfortunately Ana Amelia was away. Her helper, the girl who opened the flat for us, did not speak English and was not helpful at all. The TV did not work and we could not reach her for any assistance for 5 days.

The apartment has great views! Whilst a lot of the previous comments provided by other tenants mentioned the noise issue, my husband and I were not too disturbed by the noise. The apartment is also very spacious which was definitely a plus point! 

Upon our arrival we were greeted by Anna's assistant, Laura. Whilst Laura was very helpful, she did not speak English too well so there were a lot of things about the apartment that was left unexplained. 

Our stay was generally great with some water interruption occurring towards the end. Notwithstanding, Anna was always prompt in replying to is when there were interruptions. Furthermore, Anna kindly compensated the shortcomings by provisioning the taxi transport to the airport (which was a very nice gesture!)

In summary, my husband and I were in Rio for 8 days and thoroughly enjoyed our stay in Anna's apartment.

One Word: LOCATION!
The flat is in a very central and nice area of Rio and the view is even more incredible than in the pictures.
As some other visitors mentioned, it is a bit noisy (because of the cars) day & night... so bring your earplugs!
But honestly, the view is really worth it!
We haven't met Ana Amelia but Laura for check in / check out. No problems with that, it all went smoothly at the times that were planned.

Overall, very good flat for a stay in Rio with everything you will need (and even a very nice juice bar downstairs)!

Ana's apartment indeed has a breathtaking view - and this is a source of constant pleasure. The sun rise is particularly stunning!  It is a bit noisy - the road outside is really busy most of the day and night - but it was surprising how quickly one gets used to it with the windows shut. The place was beautifully clean and equipped with anything you could want. The bed is comfortable and the shower powerful and large.  There is A/C and a fan and good wireless. Ana and her assistant Laura could not have been more helpful, and were quick to respond to questions. The juice bar on the corner beneath the apartment is a must - try the Mango juice but remember to ask for no sugar!

Ana Amelia's apartment is very nice and modern and, as promised in the description, it really is the most beautiful view in Rio. Great location, although the building is huge with many apartments, many people in and out and some stores on the first floor and it's on a very busy street. It's easy to get metro, bus, taxi from there.

Arrived at the apartment and greeted by the lovely Ana and her assistant Lara. Beautiful view took our breath away. Clean and spacious with everything needed for your stay. Super shower and plenty of storage space. Comfy bed and great air con. Yes there is traffic noise but ear plugs did the job and we got used to it after a few days. Ideal position for the metro and buses, but taxi rides really cheap so used those at night for safety. Shopping mall close by and great restaurants. Wouldn't hesitate to recommend this apartment.
Um belo apartamento, bem localizado, simples, funcional e confortável. A vista é deslumbrante até com o céu encoberto. Espero voltar em breve. Recomendo, com certeza.

Ana Amelia`s apartment was really great. The view is even better than the photos. Flat is very clean and tidy. When we arrived Ana Amelia and Lara greeted us with a generous welcome. Everthing was ready in the aparment for us to stay in comfort. The location was great. Very easy to reach by public transportation. Close to Lapa and Beaches as well. Don`t think twice this apartment is simply great and  will meet your expectation in every aspects. Thanks Ana and Lara.

Exceptional flat with an incredible view over the famous "Pão de Açúcar". Very bright and clean . A nice vintage deck chair, from which you see only the Pao de Acucar. Aircondition works very well.
What a pity you cannot swim in the sea from the nice Botofago beach in front of the house, which is poluted and that you have to take a bus or taxi to go to Cocapabana.
Food shop is a little too far (15mn walk), even for bying a bottle of water. Very few restaurants in the aera. Nevertheless a very nice place to spend a few days.
Ótimo apartamento. Bem localizado, boas acomodações, limpo e atendimento muito receptivo. A vista merece um comentário à parte, pois é realmente uma das mais bonitas do Rio de Janeiro. Super indico.

I will break this review into three items - the unit, location, and assistance.  

The Unit:
The view is amazing, the unit is very spacious, the bed is comfortable, the AC works great, and all appliances work well - it has everything you will need (pots, pans, glasses, silverware, etc.). 
The noisy traffic outside did not bother specially after closing the  windows. 

Location:
The location is great, just outside the entrance there are two juice bars and a "padaria" (deli).  It's also close to banks and a 3-minute walk to the Botafogo Praia Shopping.  
It's about a 5-10 minute walk to the subway, there is a bus stop nearby, and there are cabs driving by all the time (to get an idea there are 33,000+ cabs in Rio which is more than twice the number of cabs in NYC).

Assistance:
I had a few questions while I was there and Ana always responded promptly and ready to help.   Laura (the assistant that met with us to turn in the keys) was very nice and always on time - for getting us the key she was in the apartment at least 30 minutes earlier, and to turn in the apartment she was 10 minutes early. 

Overall, I strongly recommend to anyone that wants to visit Rio!

Host was very welcoming. We had a late arrival and due to traffic we arrived later than stated but Camille waited around showed us the apartment. The apartment itself was as described! Absolutely luved out stay - spacious for three people, amenities needed there and the view was simply gorgeous. The area it self is convenient. When we come back next year will definitely stay here again! ☺️

The apartment was as indicated in the app, clean, modern, and tastefully decorated. The view is amazing! The neighborhood is central and safe. The only negative point was the loud street noise, which of course is normal in most areas of Rio.

I booked the flat for myself, my husband and a friend to stay for a week. It was impeccably clean and there were fresh sheets on the main bed. Ana Amelia and her assistant Laura welcomed me to the flat and everything was in order. During our time there we twice had a problem with our keys, where one spare set did not fit the lock at all. Ana Amelia's assistant, Laura, sorted the problem out instantly. We really appreciated this. The only negative was that the sofa bed is quite old, and although comfortable, we felt that we had to put double sheets on the mattress as it was quite stained. Otherwise the flat was very comfortable, and I would certainly suggest the flat to family and friends. The building is very safe with 24hr porters who were more than kind and helpful on our lock issue days!  In all, we had a wonderful stay and waking up to the magnificent view of the Sugar Loaf every day was wonderful.

Le logement est bien situé, conforme à la description. La vue est effectivement magnifique !!!
Le manque de double vitrage a fait que nous avons été obligés de dormir avec des boules quiès.
Malgré cet inconvénient, nous avons été satisfait des 3 nuits passées dans cet appartement.
I was unique waking up with a view the Sugarloaf every day!

Appartement conforme à la description sur le site, encore plus charmant en réalité. 
Équipement sommaire mais le nécessaire est là (draps, serviettes de toilette, ustensiles de cuisine, eau).
La vue sur le pain de sucre est saisissante et vaut à elle seule que l'on choisisse cet appartement.
Seul bémol: le bruit (important trafic au pied de l'immeuble)= boules quies obligatoires, à prévoir.
Nous n'avons pas rencontré Ana Amelia durant notre séjour, les check in et check out ont été réalisés par deux jeunes filles très gentilles mais dont l'une ne parlait pas anglais.
Immeuble sécurisé (gardien 24h/24).
Emplacement idéal (moins de 10min à pied du métro, arrêt de bus au pied de l'immeuble, quartier populaire très agréable).
En somme, très bon séjour, appartement à recommander.

The host was accommodating and the description was accurate.
However, the living room air conditioner did not function at all.

The description of "the most beautiful view is Rio" is, and I have seen almost every view, an understatement.

The staff was helpful and thoughtful.

Botafogo is a fun place to wander around.

Gostei muito de ficar no apartamento da Ana Ameila, a vista de Pão de Açúcar é incrível, não perca a oportunidade de acordar com essa vista quando você ficar no Rio de Janeiro! O apartamento também é muito comfortável e limpo e tem tudo que você precisa. O apartmento fica no prédio seguro e bem localizado para conhecer a cidade maravilhosa. Ana Ameila ajudou bastante com nossa estadia e organizou um jeito para deixar as chaves com ela então poderíamos sair cedo no final dia para pegar nosso voo. Gostaria de voltar com certeza!

Great stay at Rio , the place have indeed an amazing view , we had a little problem with the AC but was resolved by the host , Ana was always checking that all was perfect for us , Rio is a lot of fun so we are planning to come back very soon :).

The apartment was clean , and the building is pretty safe.

Bellissimo!!! Vista stupenda e oltre al pão de açùcar si vede anche il Corcovado dalla finestra del bagno! Appartamento spazioso, sicuro e in un'ottima posizione con tutti i servizi. Veramente perfetto!!!

Ana's flat is exactly as advertised. Spacious, comfy, and with and amazing view. Close to a mall that has everything you need. And easy transport connections to mail sightseeing points.

Fernanda and Dan received us very well and communication with Ana was great all the way.

Thank you for a lovely stay!

Todo o atendimento foi feito virtualmente. E funcionou. Todas as minhas dúvidas foram rapidamente atendidas e de forma eficiente.
A vista do apto é de fato linda!
O apto é espaçoso, prédio de 12 andares com elevador e muitos serviços úteis ao redor (metro, onibus, shopping, farmácia, etc).


Para casais, um bom custo x benefício!
Great and luminous flat. The view is impressive (just like in the pictures). If you are coming from overseas and are jet lagged, you will enjoy unforgettable sunrises.

This apartment really does have the most beautiful view in Rio!  This is the second time we stayed here.  The apartment is clean, simply furnished, and has everything you need to make you feel at home.  But the best part of the apartment is the location.  It is close to the subway, to major bus lines, and an easy cab ride both to the beaches and the center.

Very good location right in front of Botafogo beach with a stunning view on the sugar loaf. The landlady was very responsive. The apartment was sufficiently spacious and clean. Everything was as described in the website. We recommended the landlady to install a power shower device to make taking a shower more comfortable.
Ótima localização, vista realmente deslumbrante, apt fiel ao descrito e as imagens da oferta, equipado e limpo. Adoramos (eu e minha família) a experiência.

Ana's home was clean, comfortable and interesting - the views were more spectacular than in the photos. The location was perfect for sightseeing and walking around the city's landmarks. Ana also had a handy folder of recommendations for things to do in the area.

We had a few initial glitches - there was no toilet paper in the bathroom and the toilet at one point got clogged (we were only told later, during the de-clogging process, that plumbing in Brazil is not up to scratch and because of this, toilet paper is binned not flushed). But Ana's assistant Laura was on call and despite the communication problem (she speaks Portuguese, we speak English), she ensured that the issue was taken care. Overall, a good experience.

Travelled with colleagues in September 2016.
Хороший район, все необходимое рядом. Вид из окна лучше чем на фото!, он просто потрясающий! Очень уютная и милая квартира, все правда. Хозяева отзывчивые и пунктуальные.
A vista é insuperável e o apartamento é lindo e confortável. Super recomendo!
I really enjoyed my stay in this cute cozy yet spacious apartment with the greatest view! Definitely recommend it!

Luana é ótima anfitriã, me senti em casa. Compartilhamento de áreas em comum, cozinha, sala sem problemas. Quarto limpo com armário grande e espaço suficiente. E o melhor de tudo, pertinho de onde eu precisava ir, fui e voltei caminhando, o bairro estava tranquilo.
Antes de ir ao Rio, nos comunicamos por celular, e ela pode me dar as direções de como chegar ao apartamento. No final, gentilmente se ofereceu para me apanhar no Terminal Rodoviário, a caminho de volta do trabalho. Achei ótimo, por não conhecer a malha viária urbana por lá. 
Conversamos muito, achei muito interessante.

reviews.comments: O Carlos foi um excelente anfitrião. Conversamos durante as negociações e ele prontamente atendeu as minhas necessidades. Viajamos em 6 pessoas e todas ficaram encantadas com o apartamento e a presteza do Carlos. O apartamento é excelente, fica bem próximo ao metrô de Botafogo, tem um mercado próximo tb. O condomínio possui área de lazer para criança, piscina, sauna... O pessoal do condomínio também nos auxiliou em tudo que precisamos. Excelente experiência. Super recomendo.
Wonderful apartment..great person to deal with..had a wonderful stay in Rio we loved it..Muinto Obrigado Carlos!

What an awesome place! Carlos Leandro's apartment was clean, safe, exactly as advertised and in a great neighborhood. He was a great host - very responsive and accommodating and also gave us excellent suggestions for things to check out. I only wish we could have stayed longer!

We stayed in Carlos's apartment in June 2014 and had a really positive experience.  The apartment is well located for all the usual Rio sites - Sugarloaf, Copacabana, Ipanema.  Bogafoto is a nice suburb itself with bars, restaurants and shops.
The apartment was well equipped and the communal area with the pool and games room was very nice.  I can recommend this place for a nice stay in Rio.

We rented this apartment during the World Cup, perhaps the busiest time ever for Brazil.  The apartment was in a great location and everything was as described in Airbnb.  Carlos was very welcoming and helpful during our stay.  He gave us great recommendations on where to eat and what to see in Botafogo and the rest of Rio.  We really wish we could have stayed longer.  When we return back to Brazil, we will definitely look him up again and hope his apartment is available at the time.  Highly recommended.
Carlos, deu atenção total sempre que precisei, o local estava bem organizado, limpo, fora a localização que é ótima próximo de transporte público, perfeito.
Perfect location! Central, secure and Carlos is really helpful! Flat is perfect! Everything you need is there or just a minute away!
Genial

A localização do apartamento é ótima, perto de metrô, ônibus, farmácias, comércio, supermecado e barzinhos.
O apto é otimo também, ar condicionado em todos os aposentos, os únicos pontos negativos são que no quarto de solteiro não tinha cortina e a luz do sol atrapalhava dormir até mais tarde e na cozinha não foi separado um espaço na geladeira e nos armários para nossas coisas, mas depois de conversado isso foi solucionado.
A estrutura do prédio é muito boa, as crianças curtiram muito a piscina e existe uma lanchonete perto da piscina que facilita muito a alimentação.
Qualquer dúvida que tínhamos o Carlos respondia prontamente!!
Apartamento confortável, super limpo, com excelente localização e o Carlos foi bem atencioso. Estadia maravilhosa em Botafogo.

Este apartamento é tao bom localizaçao para ficar perto de tudo com os metros e onibuses que pasam perto.  E o apartamento tem tudo que precisa, e se tem crianças é um sonho de divertimento.  Sentimos muito em casa aqui e Carlos Leandro estava otimo.
Excelente persona , servicial , autentico , disponible , realmente un ser HUMANO . GRACIAS CARLOS Y SU FAMILIA .-
Carlos sempre muito atencioso e solícito a solucionar qualquer problema!

reviews.comments:
Excelente estadia tivemos no apartamento da Sandra! Ela flexibilizou os horários de check in e check out de acordo com nossas necessidades e atrasos. Aluguei para o reveillon com alguns amigos e não tivemos nenhum problema no prédio ou no apartamento. Assim que chegamos, Sandra nos recebeu pessoalmente e deu todas as orientações de chuveiro, cozinha, etc. Ela havia deixado água na geladeira, uma coca cola e algumas frutas para quando chegássemos. O apartamento estava limpinho, o espaço é ótimo, ideal para seis, sete pessoas. Existem dois banheiros com chuveiro funcionando. Ao lado do prédio existe uma lanchonete e ao lado da lanchonete uma agência do Banco do Brasil. Na esquina há uma agência do Banco Itau e uma Loja Americanas. Em frente ao prédio há uma loja da Mundo Verde, para quem compra coisas saudáveis e sem açúcares e também um restaurante self service (por quilo) de comida caseira muito bom e barato.
Assim que pudermos, voltaremos!!!
Lugar muito bem localizado, apesar de não muito amplo o apartamento acomodou muito bem todos hospedes, lugar do jeitinho como descrito e com uma anfitriã fora de serie. Voltar e quase uma obrigação.

Bom, tivemos um problema com o check in. Eu e minhas amigas alugamos a casa de sexta de carnaval até quarta feira de cinzas. E por motivos pessoais, não podíamos chegar na sexta durante o dia e avisamos a Sandra que chegaríamos de madrugada. E a resposta dela foi que não poderíamos chegar de madrugada, e sim no sábado pela manha. Não gostamos, pois estávamos com a casa alugada e tivemos essa resposta. Assim que chegamos no sábado, Sandra abriu a porta do apartamento e disse “ué, vocês não iriam chegar no domingo?” Ficamos mais uma vez decepcionadas. Tirando essa péssima desavença, o resto foi ok. A casa limpa e bem arejada, tivemos uma ótima estadia. A casa muito bem localizada.

We loved Silvia's cosy apartment, especially the charming outdoor terrace. This apartment was perfect for me.  I loved it.  Best parts were sitting on the patio in the morning sun, clean and practical kitchen, bath and bedroom.  The location was stellar. Overall our stay at Silvia's was great. The apartment's located within a 5 minute walk to many restaurants and bars as well as a 10 minute walk to the beach. The Leblon neighborhood is very safe and the building is also very secure (security guard during the day, tall gate out front, several doors to unlock in order to get into the building). Compared to Ipanema and Copacabana, the neighborhood is quieter and less touristy which made our Rio experience feel more authentic. The only downside is that the apartment is a tight squeeze if you have more than 3-4 people. We had a total of 5 girls and found that the apartment really only slept 4 "comfortably." The bedroom has an AC unit but the main area where the two sofa beds are located only has a fan. We were there during the height of the summer and whoever slept on the couch directly across from the TV had minimal air flow (the fan is directly above the first couch when you enter). While having the patio door opened helped a little, there was not much of a breeze due to the high walls on the patio. I would say that during the cooler months, the apartment sleeps 4 comfortably but during the summer only 3. Other than the air circulation/sleeping arrangement issues I would highly recommend this apartment due to its ideal location. Silvia is also a great host - she was very responsive and was super flexible with our check-in time. Overall we really enjoyed our stay in Rio at Silvia's!

Choosing Silvia's apartment was easy, because it reminded me of those lofts in Europe. It's very well decorated, bright, confortable and had all the amenities necessary for my 3 week stay. 
I travelled by myself from Perth, Australia, after 5 years away from Rio, to visit one of my sons, granddaughter and friends.  Leblon is the perfect place to be for holidays or business, and this apartment is 3 short blocs away from the beach, while supermarket, amazing bakeries, restaurants, "lanchonetes", are just around the corner, 1 to 5 minutes away.  
The one bedroom apartment is exactly how t's described, on the street level of an old building and has a very charming terrace. During the day, there are two nice gentlemen, "porteiros", who take care of the entrance and us :). They keep the building safe and very clean. At night, the residents and I had the appropriate keys to lock the main gate outside and the main building door. Very safe building and apartment. I did not have any issues and all the residents were very kind and polite. Brazilians are amazing people. 
Leblon is also very central, close to Ipanema  and Gávea (both walking distance), Copacabana, Barra da Tijuca, the city and many touristic attractions. 
Silvia was fantastic since the begining. She always answered promply my emails, even with the 11 hours difference between Australia and Brazil. She was at the apartment at my arrival to give me informations, details about internet etc. Superb!
Sheets and towels were changed every week without a problem and I only had a problem with the internet once, which Silvia came to the apartment straight away and we discovered that I had disconected the wrong plug out of the wall. My mistake! 
I will definetly go back to the same place in the near future with my husband and adult son. 
Thank you Silvia. 
Muito obrigada, um beijo e até breve.
Michèle

El apto de Paulo Thiago es tal cual muestran las fotos. Cuenta con todo lo necesario para tener una estadía perfecta en Rio. Tiene servicio de mucama. Esta a una cuadra de la playa, posta 10. Cuenta con una piscina increíble y super limpia. Se encuentra en pleno centro de Ipanema, a pocas cuadras de Leblon y de la laguna.  Paulo Thiago es muy amable y atento. Alojamiento altamente recomendable.
Another great stay at this lovely apartment. Hope to return again soon.
Ótimo apartamento, muito bem localizado e com ótima estrutura.
Excellent appartement , très bien situé , très bien équipé ! Recommander sans hésité ! Merci !!

host.host_about:
Olâ, meu nome é Renata, você será muito bem recebida no Rio de Janeiro. 
Seja bem vindo! 
I lived for many years in Italy ad I am fluent in English, Italian, French, Spanish and Portuguese.

address.street: Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

reviews.comments: Great host, nice and cozy apartment! Renata was so kind and she helped us in any way, even with our really late booking (just the evening before the check-in!!). Perfect position, 2 min from the beach, safe area, money change, shops and restaurants are all nearby. We strongly recommend Renata and her apartments, and if you are italian she is the perfect choice for you: she speaks perfect italian!

A localização do apartamento é maravilhosa, perto da praia e a vizinhança é muito segura.

A receptividade da proprietária foi super boa e amigável.

I highly recommend this apt.  It's a great place in a great location.  The apt is rather large, has been newly renovated and is two short blocks from Copacabana beach.  My girlfriend and I also stayed at another one of Renata’s properties nearby and really liked the Copacabana area.  There are plenty of restaurants, shops and bars close by, and of course you have a world class beach just a couple blocks away which was the main attraction for us. We also did quite a bit of walking and this apt lends itself to a 20ish minute walk to Ipanema beach and a 40ish minute walk to Leblon.  I highly recommend making those walks as you end up on a series of world class beaches the vast majority of the time and views and beaches are stellar.

Working with Renata was a pleasure. She was flat out great and has been the best host and person I have come in contact with while using airbnb.  We had a change of plans and needed to make this reservation at the last minute and she was able to accommodate. Our flight also didn't leave Rio until the late evening and she was a huge help in locating a place where we could leave our bags for the day. 

We hope to make a trip to Rio again at some point and when we do we will definitely reach out to Renata.  Thanks again for all your accommodations, recommendations and help Renata.  It was all very much appreciated.

I recommend this accommodation of Renata. I was welcomed in a very hearty way from her mother who explained everything necessary. The apartment is clean and fully equipped with taste. It is safe due to 24h security at the entrance. It is just two blocks away from Copacabana beach, 10 minutes of walking from a metro station and free taxis pass the streets all the time. Close you will find supermarkets, drug stores, banks, restaurants and cafés. Renata arrived on time for a hearty goodbye. The only things you shall keep in mind are, that during carnival you must expect to hear music from the street and that apartment blocks in South America have a rather large open supply funnel.

Small but very nice apartment at a perfect location in the middle of the copacabana area. Beach, shops, restaurants and supermarket in walking distance. It is also save to get home by night as the entrance to the apartment is just next to the main street in Copacabana.
Renata was very friendly and gave us some tips about Rio and also organized a low priced taxi to get back to the airport. We booked the apartment only the evening before arriving and everything worked perfectly.

My friend and I had two amazing weeks in Renata's beautiful appartment. The appartment has an incredible and safe location, you really are in two minutes at the Copacabana. Furthermore, the bakery is around the corner and the supermarket only two blocks away.
Renata is very lovely, she received us middle in the night and we could write her whenever there was a problem.
We loved the appartment it's small but we didn't need anything bigger, the bathroom is nice and you can easily cook a good meal in the kitchen. 
As two young girls we felt safe in Renata's apparment and were happy that there was a 24h doorman. 
Thank you Renata for making our stay in Rio so unforgettable :)

Renata was a perfect host! Really nice person and made our stay in Eio very comfortable! Her place is very tight and clean! I can only recommend people to use her place while staying in the fantastic metropolitan of Rio.

Thank you for all the tips about places to go out, eat and see!

Grazie Mille!

Kris & Runa

Renata es una persona muy amable que nos hizo sentir muy comodos en nuestra estadia. El departamento es muy lindo y esta muy bien ubicado en el centro de Copacabana a solo 2 cuadras de la playa. Muy recomendable!

I had such a comfotable time in Renat's home. The best thing was location. It's middle of copacabana and so close to beach and very easy to catch bus, subway and taxi. Supermarket, laundry, restaurant and bar everything is so close... 

The second thing is flat itself. Its very bright flat as you can see in foto. Feel fresh and everything is inside...and comfotable to use... also there is so much space for storage. It was very cozy.

The third thing I liked is security. I was a bit worried about this as I am woman and travel alone but this flat 24hours guard in enterance. And the location itself is very safe area so you dont need to worry!!

Lastly I love the host Renata. She is great person very international open minded. She always there want to help you and she is trying to give better service I can see this. I am sure next guest will even more  enjoyable stay. :) thanks a lot for everything. Obrigada.
O apartamento fica muito bem localizado, perto da praia, em uma região movimentada. O piso é de taco, pode ser que cause alergia em pessoas mais sensíveis. A Renata é super gente boa e prestativa.

Departamento ubicado a dos cuadras de la playa de copacabana, cerca de un supermercado y farmacias. Muy agradable, estuvimos tres noches y fue perfecto.
Renata es una excelente anfitriona, nos dió datos de cosas que hacer en Río y nos ayudó a reservar un taxi para volvernos al aeropuerto por un precio muy conveniente.
Recomiendo este lugar!
To stay at renata's place was really cool, the place is realy well located, and has everything you need. And renata has provided me with really good tips to explore rio.

We HIGHLY recommend Renata's studio and especially recommend her as a host as we know she has other properties in the area. We stayed in the Green Studio (I called it) one block from Copacabana beach post 6 for 8 wonderful nights. My husband and I had to go to Rio in Nov for business and since we did not know anyone there we thought of trying out Airbnb (which is very popular in SF were we live). We were attracted by the slogan "feel at home any part of the world" and thats exactly how we felt in Renata's apartment, at home. By the end of our trip, we where saying to each other "lets go home?" Hehe.
When we arrived we were greeted by Renata with so much attention and care. I felt like I was being received by a friend I'd known forever. She helped us with tips about the area, a list of restaurants and things do. When we needed her she was available and we felt so fortunate to have met her! 
The apartment was exactly as advertised! The bed is super comfortable, tons of closet space, easy to organize for long stays, there is a sweet little kitchen and laundry tank. The building is very clean and safe too! The 24hr doormen where all super sweet and attentive. The neighbors were friendly with us. We felt very safe in the building. We loved the neighborhood and the location and made a lot of friends there. We would walk to the beach and back several times per day. 
The location is prime, I would give a super high walk score, we walked everywhere! The supermarket was one block away, the pharmacy is on the corner, the post office, restaurants, bars, stores, shopping centers, and flea markets are all walkable. The taxis stop in front of the building and the bus runs on the streets above (to Leblon, Ipanema and Barra da Tijuca) and  below (Leme, Lapa and the city Center). Over all we were super satisfied with our stay! We will for sure come back and stay with Renata next time! Obrigada por tudo Renata!

We stayed in Renates studio for Christmas and we had a wunderful time. It's really close to the Copacabana playa, supermarket, restaurants and subway. Rebate is a really nice hostess with good tips and there if you need here. Highly recommended!

Renata's place is great, located only two blocks away from Copacabana beach you have everything (Restaurants, Bars, Coffee Shops, Banks, Supermarkets, etc) you need at walk distance. You can also take different buses (or a taxi) to all the main sights in the city like Pao de Azucar, Lagoa, Cristo Redentor, etc. Will recommend you stay here if you are a couple and wanna spend some chilling days close to the beach. The neighbourhood looks very safe and we had a great stay.

We fell in love with Renatas green room at the first sight. 
The apartment is very good located. You will have everything important around, like ATMs, supermarkets, restaurants, bars, best breakfast spot in town (Caféina) and of course Copacabana beach just 2 min. to walk.

The flat is very cosy and good equipped. It has everything you need, for example air condition plus fan, fridge, excellent wifi etc.
And also there is a 24 hour doorman service.

Renata is a very helpful and friendly host. The communication with her was perfect and also she gave us good advices to discover Rio.

We had 9 greats days there and when we visit Rio again, we would definitely stay at Renatas apartment once more.

Highly recommended for those who are looking for a place in the heart of Rio.

The stay at Renata's apartment was simply perfect; The place looks exactly like the photos and it's very complete, comfortable and very well located.  Renata was super friendly and very responsive during my entire stay.  I look forward to staying at one of Renata's apartments in the future.  :)
Renata's place was great. Very comfortable and the best location. Plus she was an amazing host, offering me tips on restaurants, bars and the city. I would absolutely recommend a stay here

Renata is a very warm, friendly and kind host. She's a great first point of contact on your arrival to Rio, a friendly face! The apartment is exactly as it appears in the photographs, very well presented and in a safe part of Copacabana. We appreciated the accommodation for our 6 nights. Thank you for having us Renata!

We had an amazing experience in Rio. Renata was a wonderful host, helping us settle in to the cosy and colourful apartment just minutes away from Copacabana beach. I would recommend this place to anyone, its just minutes away from the beach and various other attractions. There are great resturants, supermarket and money exchange just a few steps away. The aparment was prefect for what we needed. It had air conditionar which is essential for Rio's heat, a working kitchen and bathroom. The apartment is exactly like the pictures. Hope to visit Rio again, thanks Renata for a wonderfull stay.
Foi ótima a experiência. O apartamente é bem localizado e super bonitinho. A anfitriã é atenciosa e nos recebeu bem. Obrigada Renata

Consiglio caldamente la casa di Renata per soggiornare a Rio. Non è molto grande ma è  perfetta per una o due persone Essenziale ma ben organizzata e pulita. Il punto di forza è la posizione: in due minuti a piedi sarete nella spiaggia di Copacabana Inoltre avrete a portata di mano negozi ristoranti e locali tipici e la fermata della metro è raggiungibile a piedi in pochi minuti. La ciliegina sulla torta è Renata:gentilissima disponibile e fonte inesauribile di consigli. Inoltre parla perfettamente l'italiano e questo per me è stato fondamentale. Da ripetere. Obrigado Renata!

Principalmente queremos agradecer a Renata por su hospitalidad, amabilidad, carisma, la ubicación del apto es perfecto, queda a dos cuadras de la playa de Copacabana, tiene transporte publico cerca, restaurantes, bares, droguerías 24 horas, cicloruta para los que amamos el deporte, queda a 40 minutos de Lapa en transporte y caminando a Ipanema a 15 minutos.  Desde allí puedes ir fácilmente al Cristo redentor y Pan de Azucar. 

La decoración, limpieza y los utensilios necesarios para hospedarse los tiene a disposición,  muy recomendado. Renata de nuevo mil gracias por tu hospitalidad, esperamos volver pronto con mas tiempo. Abrazos. Diana y Camilo.

It was amazing! Renata is the best host i've had in long time. I recommend anybody going to rio to get in touch with her. Location of the apartment was very good (2 blocks to the beach), apartment was clean and tidy as well. Thanks for the nice expierence renata!

My boyfriend and I had a lovely time in Rio at Renata's apartment. The space is clean with lots of light and 24-hour security. We had access to large closets which is helpful to avoid the "living out of a suitcase" look. The apartment is also very close to the beach in a safe neighbourhood and is walking distance to the metro. 

Renata herself is a gracious host with lots of good recommendations on what to do in the city and how to get around. She is very accomodating, bringing us water and treats. Most importantly, she responds to messages quickly both before we arrived in Rio and afterwards, to ensure that we have a pleasant stay. She also speaks excellent English!

I would highly recommend staying at Renata's apartment if you're planning a trip to Rio. I've stayed in airbnbs all over the world and it's always great to meet a host to takes pride in her space and in her city.
La experiencia ha sido excelente. El apartamento impecable y bien ubicado. Y Renata una anfitriona perfecta y puntual.

Location was fantastic  2 minute walk to Copacabana beach, restaurants, Cafe, metro and so much more!! renata and her mother were a pleasure to deal with. very easy going, polite and spoke English very well .

The apartment itself was a bit dated, but most importantly  homey and clean. 

Would definitely reccomend this to anyone looking to stay in Copacabana.

Renata's apartment is amazingly well located, a stone-throw away from Copacabana beach. It's close to a multitude of shops and restaurants as well as public transport and taxis. Located on the 8th (luckily with a lift) it is fairly quiet and well equipped. I didn't get to use the kitchen during my stay but it looked adequate. 

In summary: nice place to stay.

Renata's apartment is fantastic! It's 5 minutes walk from the beach, the wifi is super fast, and the apartment is like a home away from home. It's also located really well in relation to the rest of Rio, so you'll cut down on travel times and taxi costs. Thanks for a great stay Renata!

We had a wonderful time staying here. The apartment is bright and airy and located right in the heart of Copacabana, just 2 blocks from the beach. Renata was on vacation, but we were greeted by her very affectionate and sweet mother, who answered a lot of our questions and did everything she could to get us situated in the apartment. It was an amazing experience and felt perfectly safe in a doorman/elevator building. Would recommend this to anyone wishing to stay in the Copa area!
A localização do apartamento é excelente! Fomos muito bem recebidos pela mãe da Renata e o apartamento é bem confortável. Gostamos muito!

Très bien placé. 
Propre, dans un immeuble surveillé. 
Et en plus Renata parle français.

Fui muito bem recebido pela Renata, muito atenciosa. A descrição do anúncio condiz com o que encontrei. A localização do apartamento é ótima. Próximo a praia. Tudo funcionou perfeitamente durante a minha estadia. Possui tudo muito próximo, supermercado, bares, padarias, restaurantes, estaçao de metrô... o bairro é muito tranquilo. Gostei muito e recomendo! Obrigado Renata.

J'ai passé une très agréable semaine à l'appartement de Renata.  Le logement est très bien situé, dans un quartier très vibrant, plein de restaurants, de cafés, de boutiques et bien entendu tout près de la plage.    Renata parle plusieurs langues dont le français, la communication avec elle est agréable, facile et efficace.  L'appartement est propre, bien équipé et confortable. Un gardien contrôle l'accès à l'édifice alors on s'y sent en sécurité.  Pour ceux qui sont très sensible au bruit, il faut savoir que l'on entend la vie de la rue même si on est situé au 8e etage.  Autrement c'est un très bon choix.

Très bon expérience dans l'appartement de Renata! L'emplacement est vraiment parfait pour les adeptes de la plage et/ou de la fête! Copacabana est très bien désservi en bus/taxi pour se déplacer facilement. L'appartement est petit mais convient parfaitement a la visite d'une si grand ville (on est pas souvent chez soi). Renata et son compagnon nous ont bien acceuillis et l'immeuble est plus que sécurisé!
Obrigada Renata!

Nous avons été très bien accueilli par Renata qui nous a présenté son logement ainsi que donné des indications touristiques sur la ville. Son appartement correspondait bien à la description faite sur le site de Airbnb. La localisation était juste parfaite pour nous : à deux pas de Copacabana et près d'Ipanema qui sont quartiers vivants et animés.

O apartamento é igual descrito. A localização é ótima. A Renata foi muito gentil na recepção e o Carlo no  check-out. Deram diversas dicas legais de passeios. Destaque para Passeio de Bike na Lagoa, Restaurante El Born na Rua Bolívar.

Apartamento tem uma excelente localização atendeu nossas expectativas , anfitriã Renata super atenciosa gostei bastante de tudo , único problema que tive foi ter ido de carro pois devido ao feriado não tinha lugar para parar na rua e os estacionamentos estavam lotados , acabei parando em um estacionamento a quatro quadras de onde estava hospedado e paguei super caro, mas o resto foi tudo ótimo obrigado Renata.

It was a plwasure, great location, clesn safe, little but cosy, a nearly fully kitchen if you wanna use it. 

We will be back

A Renata foi ótima, nos deus várias dicas, e abriu bem o horário de check in e check out do apartamento para nos ajudar! O apartamento estava super limpo e organizado. A localização é melhor impossível!
Valeu super a pena!

We highly recommend this place! The apartment was clean, safe, and well located. Renata is both professional and personable. We enjoyed our stay immensely. We traveled with an infant and was able to set up a crib in the entry (in essence we were able to make it into a two bedroom). The doormen were kind and helpful (when we arrived early they got in contact with Renata for us-- which was nice since we do not speak any Portuguese). Renata gave us some great food recommendations. A short walk from the apartment will bring you to the beach, numerous restaurants, and stores. Everything else (tourist attractions) is a short taxi ride away. Comfortable bed, necessities in the kitchen, hot shower, clean room, quiet apartment building (nice neighbors) and working AC. Would stay here again.

She is a great host a great person, I enjoyed staying in her apartment... It is a super great location 

I highly recommend staying in her place, within walking distance to restaurants,supermarket and the beach.

El departamento es muy cómodo para 2 personas, limpio y con aire acondicionado optimo. Es tal cual las fotos y descripción. Tiene muy buena ubicación a la playa, restaurantes, cafés, farmacias, comercio en general. A pasos de locomoción para ir donde quieras en Rio de Janeiro. El barrio es muy seguro y cuenta con portero las 24 Hrs.

Renata es una excelente anfitriona, muy atenta, informada y dispuesta en ayudar, para que pases una excelente estadía.

La verdad es que ha sido estupendo,  la comunicación con Renata fue constante,  nos estaba esperando puntual cuando llegamos,  nos dio todo tipo de información sobre, donde había supermercados,  bares para salir, restaurantes.... 
Fue super amable.  El location del piso es inmejorable,  tiene todo lo que hace falta para unos días de vacaciones.  Quedamos muy contentos.

O apartamento tem excelente localização. Pertinho da praia e com várias opções de bares e restaurantes por perto. O apto é pequeno, mas muito limpo e organizado. A Renata é uma excelente anfitriã, nos recebeu muito bem e foi super atenciosa durante todo o nosso contato. Recomendo.

Renata is very welcoming and considerate. She is also responsive to messages and answered all of our questions quickly. The location of the apartment is perfect and looks just like the photos. The area is safe, well lit, and the 24 hour security desk is helpful too. The neighbours were quiet but sometimes you can hear traffic on the street. It was very easy to get around the city from the apartment. I would highly recommend this place for 1-2 people.
Renata is a great host, I recommend staying here. It's a great place to stay. Within walking distance to the beach and many nice restaurants.

Gostei muito do Ap, um lugar aconchegante, limpo, com uma iluminação boa, o prédio muito bem organizado desde a recepção até o andar do Ap. A localização é ótima, muitos comércios próximos, cafeteria, supermercados, farmácias, bares, restaurantes, bem pertinho da praia. A recepção da Renata foi exelente tanto no check-in quanto no checkout, foi muito atenciosa com informações de locais para fazer refeições, sair pra beber, passeios e como se locomover nas suas do bairro. Vale muito a pena se hospedar no Ap q é conforto garantido. Sentir falta de um ferro de passar roupa mas, a tábua tem. Vou querer ficar mais vezes no Ap quando voltar ao Rio de Janeiro.

Renata é muito atenciosa!! Nos recebeu muito bem, sempre solicita e nos assessorou em todo o momento da estadia, é Flexível e compromissada.
A localização é ótima! Uma quadra da praia, e próximo de bancos, metrô e outros serviços e comercio local. Prédio e apto bem cuidado, limpo com wifi e ar condicionado funcionando normalmente.
Portaria 24 hrs
O apartamento tem ótima localização, é pequeno mas aconchegante. A Renata e seu marido foram muito prestativos e nos atenderam muito bem. Ficamos muito satisfeitos!

El lugar es muy lindo. Se encuentra bien ubicado, es muy seguro y esta muy limpio.
Un placer visitar la casa de Renata.

Lovely flat in a great location. We relly enjoyed or stay there. Close to eveythig, including the beach and the subway, and a load of shops, cafes etc. 

Renata is a fabulous host. Thanks!!

Tava tudo otimo, Renata e Carlo são pessoas mto simpáticas, nos sentimos en casa.
A única coisa que poderia ser melhorado são os talheres.
Obrigado!

Accueilli agréablement par Carlo. :-) 
Logement bien situé avec une station de métro à proximité (cantalgo) et appartement conforme aux photos.
Si j'ai passé un bon séjour, c'est un peu grâce aux conseils de Carlo et Renata (week-end à Buzios). 
Merci à vous deux. :-)

Renata’s place in Copacabana is GREAT! The location is perfect (just two blocks from Copacabana beach - a short walk to Ipanema), close to plenty of restaurants and shops, and really convenient to the metro or taxis. It’s the perfect hideaway for a couple or single traveler like myself. Renata and her husband Carlo were fantastic hosts and were in constant contact with me. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!!! Obrigado por tudo!!!

Es un alojamiento antiguo, no es muy cómodo, la cocina es  pequeña y tiene cucarachas, el dormitorio tampoco resulta cómodo, el servicio de WIFI es malo la conexión se cae demasiado y los ascensores fallan demasiado. Por otra parte, el departamento esta muy bien ubicado y la anfitriona tiene muy buena disposición y voluntad.

Renata’s place has a great location! You are in that part of the Copacabana where you have everything you need! The beach is really near and the value for the price is amazing!  It’s a great place for a couple, because there is enough space! Renata was also flexible with the time to check in and that was great! 
I really recommend this Renata’s flat to everybody!

Renata and her husband were very nice. They gave me several tips about the nearest places. The apartament itself is very cozy  and location is great - very close to Copacabana beach, with restaurants, shops and bus station around :)
Really a great host. The place is exactly as listed. The area is among the best of Rio. And I will certainly return
Emplacement idéal. Appartement propre et sécurisé. Vraiment très bien. Excellent accueil de Renata.

This is the perfect place to stay for a solo traveler or couple!  You will be two short blocks to the beach in a very safe building.  The porteiros (doorman) are very friendly and the neighborhood is clean and safe.  There are many shops in the area and the subway (for cheap access to Centro) is a short walk away.  This really is the perfect place to stay if you want good value and good access to all that Rio has to offer.

Mi novio y yo quedamos en el apartamento de Renata y nos encantó. El barrio es seguro, limpio y tranquilo, a dos cuadras de la playa, cerca de metro y todos los buses. Muchos restaurantes, tiendas y supermercado a menos de 5 minutos caminando. Ella y su marido son personas muy simpáticas, amables y nos dieron buenos consejos. El apartamento estaba muy limpio, justo como en las fotos, tamaño perfecto para una pareja. Muchísimas gracias Renata!

Renata's apartment is very nice and clean as well as perfectly located. You are two blocks from the beach. 5 minutes from the metro. There are many restaurants and bars near by and Reneta is a very helpful hosts. Definitely recommend

Everything great! Cosy and clean apartment with great location. Getting to the beach could barely be easier. Several super markets and gyms nearby which is convenient not having to go too far for. Renata was super helpful and communicative. Made check-in very easy and even showed me around to two gyms in the neighborhood so I could check them out.

Lo que ven en las fotos es al 100%
Un lugar bonito, seguro, cómodo y bastante limpio. La ubicación es excelente, y aparte de tener Copacabana a 1 cuadra, tiene mercados, bancos, restaurantes y todo tipo de locales cerca.

Para mi y mi pareja fue exactamente lo que buscábamos en nuestro viaje a Río. Y Renata es una increíble HOST! Sin duda volveríamos a ese lugar
This apartment is perfect for solo travelers, it has everything you need and a great location. Renata is an amazing host, incredibly helpful. Highly recommend.

This is a small and cosy apartment in an older building in the very heart of Copacabana.  Beach, shops, transport, Metro ... all at your doorstep.  The building staff are very friendly and keep you safe.  Your host, Renata, is wonderful.  I recommend this apartment to you.  xx

Renata's place is wonderfully located, close to the beach and in the heart of Copacabana with Ipanema in walking distance. The apartment is larger than the pictures suggest and has ample space for a solo traveller or a couple. The flat is clean and has working air conditioning, which is a nice bonus.
Renata and her husband were flexible with regards to check in and check out times and gave me a list of local places to go to. I would definitely recommend this flat!

neighborhood_overview: Se você quer descobrir o coração do Rio de Janeiro e a alma dos cariocas não vai encontrar isso nas praias de Copacabana, Ipanema ou Leblon. Para o verdadeiro sabor da vida noturna e do espírito dos cariocas, há apenas um bairro perfeito para isso: A LAPA. Localizado no centro histórico da cidade do Rio de Janeiro, este local é sinônimo de boemia e alegria. Quase todas as antigas mansões e sobrados, com seu charme arquetetônico inigualável, alguns construídos na década de 1770, foram transformados em bares da moda, casas noturnas super-animadas, nascedouros de novas tendências e artistas e locais frequentados pelos amantes dos vários estilos de samba. Muito frequentada pelos moradores da Zona Sul do Rio e da Barra, o local tem número cada vez maior de visitantes estrangeiros também por conta de seus vários atrativos e pelo fato de ser considerado hoje o local mais seguro do Rio para se transitar à noite, com equipe da Guarda Municipal dedicada à região. A LAPA é o berço do Circo Voador
transit: Tudo é perto. A principais movimentações podem ser feitas a pé. Os principais pontos turísticos da Cidade - fora da Lapa, claro - podem ser acessados facilmente via táxi, ônibus ou metrô e ficam entre 5 minutos a 25 minutos de distância. Tudo simples, fácil e sem complicação.

reviews.comments: Ótimo anfitrião e muito atencioso. Apartamento bem localizado para quem quer um local próximo ao centro do Rio. Bem conservado e completo para uma estadia confortável.

Alexandre es un excelente anfitrión, una persona muy gentil, sus sugerencias oportunas y valiosas, gracias a ellas la estadía en Rio de Janeiro fue un placer para nosotras.
El alojamiento cumplió  y supero totalmente las expectativas, el vecindario fue precioso, el más completo en entretenimiento para nosotras, cercano y fácil para trasladarse a otras localidades, ¡recomendado completamente!

Minha estada em Rio de Janeiro foi ótima!!! O apartamento do Alexandre é excelente, limpeza impecável, ar condicionado e ventilador bons, internet rápida, banheiro e chuveiro ótimos, cozinha muito bem equipada, localização perfeita, com metro e ponto de ônibus perto entre outras qualidades. Não deixando de esquecer, é claro, a recepção do Alexandre, que é uma pessoa super atencioso e educado. Valeu, voltarei mais vezes...

Apesar de não conhecer o anfitrião pessoalmente, todos que me receberam, foram muito gentis! Mas também em todos os contatos, o Alexandre respondeu prontamente a qualquer dúvida. Gostei do local, limpo e organizado. Exatamente como nas fotos. No meu caso que era para estudos foi ótimo!

Our host Alexandre was exceptionally helpful and a very nice man. When we had difficulty finding a laundrette he offered to wash our clothes which was extremely generous. The apartment was bright, clean and comfortable and in a great part of Rio. The apartment was very well priced especially as we were staying during the World Cup. I would have no hesitation in recommending the apartment and Alexandre.

Alexandre was waiting for us at the apartment when we arrived, and was very helpful and had all the information we needed about Rio. The apartment was very clean and very nice remodeled, and he had some refreshments ready for us. The location at 1st doesn't look great, since it's not close to the beaches; but it turns out that all the night life of Lapa is 3 blocks away; so if you like to enjoy the bars and live samba music, it's greatly located. The only deceiving part is that the apartment is located in an old building and street; this being said, it's secure and once you are in the apartment, you forget all about it and you think you are in a really nice building.

My husband and I stayed at Alexandre's apartment for 4nights during the worldcup period 2014. It is clean and centrally located(close to bus station, supermarket, bars and restaurants; walking distance to metro) in a safe neighborhood. Neighbors are nice and there's a security guard in the building. We had safety concerns before our trip but we totally feel like home after the 1st day. Alexandre is a trustworthy and very friendly host. We enjoyed the quarterfinal match and found no difficulties to travel around w/ metro and taxi during our stay. Alexandre, thank you so much and we look forward to meet you in San Francisco. :)  Hugs and kisses.

The accommodation was good, functional, perfect to experience the real Lapa, which is to my opinion one of the best neighborhoods in Rio.
Nearby the accommodation you have lots of bus stops, so you can reach potentially any place in Rio from there.
No words can explain how Alexandre makes you feel welcomed. He is a great host and you can always rely on him.
I would give more than 5 if was possible.

It was amazing time in amazing place! When we arranging our trip we looking for place near the Sambodrom (cause it was main target of our trip) so we fortunatelly choose this appartment. But it was more than we   (Website hidden by Airbnb) day street, where this appartment is become to market with fresh fruits, another day there was a lot of bars, next day we can dance with a lot of people right here under the (Website hidden by Airbnb) was awesome amd maybe like fairy (Website hidden by Airbnb) lost but not least I want to say...if you looking for fun and arrange your trip by yourself, this appartment is best  choice) You can walk by foot around Lapa and it is 10 minutes far from Sambodrom, or you can go by bus to every sightseen you want directly cause here 3 bus station near the appartment. Wish you be here and falling love with Rio as we did....

O contato com o anfitrião foi muito positiva. Tudo estava conforme o combinado. Qualquer dúvida que tínhamos eles estavam prontos a ajudar e resolver qualquer imprevisto. Recomendamos e agradecemos pela hospedagem tranquila e aconchegante.

A recepção foi ótima. O apartamento é lindo, superconfortável, bem equipado. O prédio é tranquilo, bem localizado, perto de tudo, muitas linhas de ônibus passam ali perto.
A estadia foi excelente.

Passei 12 dias no apartamento do Alexandre e tudo correu muito bem. Estava a trabalho e a localização é ótima, tem tudo muito perto, mercados, farmácias, banco, lavanderias, pontos de ônibus, uma barraca de frutas 24 horas bem em frente e até uma feira livre aos sábados. O apartamento é bem ventilado e tem uma janela enorme que dá pra rua, e é bastante claro. Cozinha bem equipada, liquidificador, panelas, fogão, microondas, cafeteira e demais utensílios. A geladeira funciona super bem também. O prédio é antigo mas tudo funciona, com as devidas precauções não se tem problema nenhum. Sempre que necessário consegui contatar o Alexandre mas quase não nos encontramos pois nossos horários de trabalho não permitiram, de qualquer forma ele sempre se manteve disponível pra qualquer eventualidade. Voltarei com certeza.

A recepção foi ótima! O Sr. Alexandre foi muito prestativo, nos deu um guia que facilitou muito nossos dias no Rio. O apartamento é excelente, bem arejado, tudo bem limpinho, a cozinha tem tudo que precisa. A localização é ótima! Supermercado, farmácia, barraca de frutas, banco e sem contar a vida noturna da Lapa que é muito boa! Passamos ótimos dias no Rio! Recomendo!

Ficamos 10 dias no apartamento de Alexandre. O predio tem seguranca as 24 hs. O apartamento é como aparece nas fotos, bonito, limpo e bem confortavel.
Alexandre sempre nos ajudou pra fazer nossas ferias ainda melhores, brindando informacoes e ajuda quando (Website hidden by Airbnb) certeza alugaria denovo o apartamento porque foi uma otima experienca.

O Alexandre foi pontual na entrega do apartamento. É importante mencionar que o apartamento está totalmente reformado e tem tudo nas redondezas. O moradores e funcionários do prédio são amáveis. Eu definitivamente recomendo a locação deste apartamento.

Nos gustó mucho la recepción de Alexandre. Fue muy atento al recogernos del aeropuerto, e incluso no tuvo problema en recogernos al día siguiente de lo que habíamos acordado, ya que perdimos el vuelo de conexión. Al llegar al departamento nos dio material que nos sirvió mucho (mapas, libros informativos, etc) y nos dio algunas recomendaciones. Tengan mucho cuidado en Rio, es una ciudad muy peligrosa, a mi me robaron mi celular en Copacabana mientras esperábamos el Año Nuevo.
Gracias Alexandre por tus atenciones!!!

Hice una reserva de última hora y Alexandre me fue a encontrar inmediatamente para la entrega de llaves, además de esto me espero mucho tiempo porque me perdí camino al departamento, Alexandre es un 7, demasiado amable y muy atento! El departamento es igual a las fotos, muy bien cuidado. Recomiendo hospedarse con Alexandre!

Alexandre was a very friendly person. He helps you even after your stay in his appartment. I was there for 2 days in the appartment and i forgot my keys and wallet there, he even took his time to make a rendez-vous to bring me my wallet and keys that's how good he is (and how sloppy i am) xD.

The appartment is a very beatiful appartment in a very beatiful artistic environment. The appartment is just like in the pictures. he even brings you welcome cookies.
Ótimo apartamento, ótima localização. Super recomendo.
Small nicely apartment ideal for a short stay. Alexander was very well accomodate and he was very available. I recommend.

I just finished a 6-7 week stay in one of Alexandre's apartments and it was beyond what I had expected. His hospitality was second to none. The apartment was exactly as advertised and perfect for my long stay. The neighborhood is very close to everything with 2 supermarkets within 200m from the apartment. He made sure I always had everything I needed and even went above and beyond several times to make my stay truly a great experience. I would recommend him to anyone staying in Rio with 100% enthusiasm. I plan on renting from him again on my next stay in Rio de Janeiro. This is 5 stars without a doubt.

The description of the apartment was very accurate, in fact I thought it was larger than I had expected from the photographs. Alexandre showed us around and gave us good tips for our stay. Myself and my niece felt safe in the apartment and we had no problems at all in the 2 weeks we were there For the Olympics. Although the surrounding area may look a bit dodgy at first glance , you are really experiencing living in an apartment in Rio .The security personnel in the apartment block were always present and we really enjoyed our stay. If you are a light sleeper or get annoyed with street noise then take ear plugs as Rio never stops!! We walked around the area and took buses and metro very easily to other areas . In the evening, returning from the Olympic events we left the Metro at Carioca and it was always easy to hail a yellow cab outside on Rua da Republique Chile.
Wifi was good and reliable.
Thanks for a great stay!

Parabéns ao Alexandre! Foi muito prestativo. Só tive problema com o forno do fogão, que não funcionava, mas foi prontamente consertado. O apto é perto de mercado, comércio em geral, farmácia etc. Como bônus, ainda tem um uma feira sábado de manhã para comprar várias frutas e vegetais.
Fomos muito bem recebidos, o local é muito bem localizado pra quem pretende estar próximo de tudo. Tudo foi ótimo e dentro do esperado.
O Sr. Alexandre foi muito atencioso e prestativo, mantém o apartamento em ótimas condições de moradia, vou indicá-lo sempre que puder.

Alex siempre estuvo disponible para ayudarnos, no solo en el recibimiento a un horario muy temprano, sino después por (Hidden by Airbnb) , consultando varias cosas. 
El departamento es impecable, muy equipado, y en una zona inmejorable por la cercanía al metro durante el día y los bares durante la noche. Quedamos muy contentos.
Todo excelente!
Alexandre was very friendly and helpful. He stored our luggage while we were outside of Rio. Also he was extremly flexible when we changed our checkout date. He is a great host!
Ótimo apartamento, ótimo anfitrião. Tudo conforme descrito!! Foi uma excelente passagem pelo Rio! Recomendo!
Ótimo apto, a localização é boa, próximo do metrô, assim como mercado e principais acessos do RJ
Tive uma estadia maravilhosa nesse apartamento, muito bem localizado perto da vida noturna, varias padarias, lanchonetes, restaurantes e mercado ao lado. Além de ser de fácil acesso.

A acomodação do Sr. Alexandre ofereceu para mim e meu filho o melhor conforto que poderíamos esperar. Ventilador, ar condicionado, funcionando perfeitamente. Tudo que se precisa quando chega da rua cansado querendo um bom banho e uma boa cama. A limpeza estava perfeita. A localização é ótima para quem escolheu o Centro do Rio para se hospedar. Para qualquer lado que saia a pé, pode-se encontrar todo o tipo de comércio, desde restaurantes, padarias, farmácias até supermercados. A Lapa está próxima numa caminhada de alguns poucos minutos. Também a linha do VLT, quando quiser descansar as pernas. E não poderia deixar de comentar na recepção na chegada pelo próprio Sr. Alexandre que nos recebeu como um bom anfitrião. Muito obrigado, Alexandre. Um grande abraço!
I would stay there again the place is cozy and bright, clean. And also is central. I felt home really like the apart and Alexandre was very helpful.
Central, bonito departamento, acogedor y muy limpio
Alexandre é um ótimo anfitrião. O apartamento é muito bem localizado. Próximo a muitas opções de lazer e ao aeroporto Santos Dumont. Recomendo.
Ótimo lugar! O Alexandre é muito solícito. O apartamento é super limpo e fica próximo à farmácia, supermercado, noite da Lapa, uns 15 minutos do metrô. Recomendo a todos!

We really enjoyed our stay in Rio!!
Although Alexandre was not there at that time, he made sure a very nice and amiable friend of his welcomed us and was there for Check In and (very flexible!) Check Out. Thank you!!
The building feels safe with its own guard and you can reach other parts of town by bus, uber or taxi.

On a passé une semaine dans ce logement. Il est conforme aux photos. Très bien situé dans Lapa à 15 min de marche des bars, restaurants, transports (bus et metro) et de certains lieux touristiques comme les Arches et la favela Santa Teresa. Propre et dans bâtiment sécurisé avec un gardien de jour comme de nuit. Alexandre nous a très bien accueillis et a pris le temps de nous donner des conseils.

Мне очень понравилась квартира у Александра! она была очень чистый светлый, в Европейском стиле. там был кондиционер и отдельный вентилятор на потолке который тоже прекрасного охлаждал. маленькая кухня со столовой. небольшое пространство но оказалось удобным. Большой холодильник. чистая ванная, чистые полотенца. утюг зонтики. удобное расположение район Лапа. очень дружелюбный хозяин, приятное общение на английском языке. Нам всё очень понравилось! спасибо большое Александр! мы приедем к вам вновь!
Alexandre foi um ótimo host. O apto é muito legal e com ótima localização!

Alexandre é excelente anfitrião, nos recebeu muito bem e foi bastante atencioso durante toda a estadia, sempre disponível. O espaço é bastante acochegante e exatamente como descrito. A localização é maravilhosa, rua e proximidades  com movimentação praticamente 24h  e ônibus na rua ao lado, a poucos passos. Além disso é próximo da Lapa, onde tem a saída de passeios para Arraial, Búzios, Angra e Petrópolis, da para ir/voltar caminhando tranquilamente. Em suma, foi tudo perfeito. Recomendo a estadia.

Localized at 7 minutes of the beach, you are in the best place for amazing holidays : bars (pubs), canteens, shops, metro at 5min! Don´t miss also the famous Copacabana beach, the predilection place of local and international surfers.

When you do the reservation, I will send you my phone number and my personal email. Also the way to combinate your arrival hour. I speak Portuguese, English, French and Spanish.

I would highly recommend to a respectful guest looking for tranquility and a quality stay in Rio De Janeiro.

The flat is stated to be for 6 people, however it is fit for no more than 4 people. There is one double bedroom with no mattress (and very hard bedspring). A second room can be made out of the living room by closing a metallic partition and consists of a couch which extends to two single mattresses on different levels. 2 additional people are supposed to sleep in a minuscule room the size of a closet, with barely enough space for two extremely unhealthy mattresses on the floor. This place is set apart from the rest of the apartment, accessible behind the kitchen, and more likely to be a laundry room than a bedroom.
We were 5, and one of us was obliged to sleep on the couch and to buy a fan for the nights (no AC in the living room once the partition is closed).

Moreover, as soon as it started raining, the open areas from the ACs began to leak inside the house
