Bus to Lionel Groulx metro Station : 10$. Good for 24h on the STM transport network. 2) VIA RAIL : Train vers la station Bonaventure : 14$. Train to Bonaventure Metro : 14$. J'habite près du métro Outremont.

house_rules: Le logement est non-fumeur, mais il est possible de fumer sur le balcon. Je permets d'utiliser la cuisine. Vous pouvez utiliser le four grille-pain seulement. Si vous désirez garder des aliments au frigo, vous êtes les bienvenus, je vous ferai un espace désigné. Il y a des épiceries tout près et un dépanneur au coin de la rue. SVP nettoyez votre vaisselle. Ne pas laisser de la nourriture et de la vaisselle sale dans la chambre. Lorsque vous quittez, apportez votre nourriture avec vous. Du thé et du café sont disponibles sur place, vous pouvez en prendre. Je fournis le savon et le nécessaire de toilette. Le bain est grand et il est possible de prendre un bain ou une douche. Vous pouvez connecter votre portable, votre chargeur, un réveil et le nécessaire de toilette (fer, séchoir) sur mon réseau électrique. Aucun appareil électrique énergivore ou bruyant ne sera toléré.  Je désire louer la chambre à des personnes qui ont majoritairement des occupations à l'extérieur, le jour. Mon logemen

host.host_about:
Bonjour!

Je suis bibliothécaire et étudiante à la maitrise. J'habite un joli 5 1/2 en plein coeur d'Outremont, à deux pas du Mile End, à proximité de cafés, boulangeries, restaurants et du fameux St-Viateur Bagel! Une station de Métro est a 5 minutes de marche. 

Je serai prête à vous guider vers les endroits gourmands intéressants à Montréal et peux très bien vous assister dans vos recherches (c'est ma spécialité) de trucs à voir.

Je travaille le plus souvent de la maison, sur mon mémoire.
Voyageurs d'affaire bienvenus!

-----

Hello!

I'm a librarian and master student. I live in a cosy 5 1/2 in the heart of Outremont, close to Mile End and the famous St-Viateur bagels. On the street you can find cafés, bakeries, restaurants with terrasses. The closest subway station is a 5 minutes walk away.

I can surely guide you and help you find any activities you'd like to do while in Montreal. I mostly work on my thesis from home.

reviews.comments:
Centrally located apartment in a really nice, lively area of Montreal. Very welcoming host. Isabelle was SO thoughtful. She offered a disposable kitty litter and catnip for my cat, who quite enjoyed the stay too! 

The room (and apartment) was SUPER clean and came with everything from a bathrobe to shampoos and soaps to even - and this one impressed me a lot - a PRAYER MAT. For people who need one to pray! I had NEVER seen anywhere think of providing so simple and obvious an amenity before, not even expensive hotels. It shows a level of empathy that she continued to demonstrate during the whole 10 days I stayed with her. 

She's a good conversationalist and also very capable of resolving conflict calmly, which is good since there are bound to be toes stepped on when two strangers decide to live together for several days. 

All in all, despite some minor awkwardness, I'd say that I had a nice stay and would recommend Isabelle's company and hospitality to anyone wanting to find low-price high-class accommodations in Montreal for a brief time.

the host: Isabelle is a fantastic host. She is direct, easy going and fun with a great  sense of humor ( to the extent of comprehending and appreciating mine. lol). It was easy to communicate with her and we had some interesting exchanges. A brilliant conversationalist who have an interesting opinion on the surrounding world.
the place: The room has all the basic amenities, you could dream of with a great balcony to enjoy, if the host agreed to share with you. Although small, but this is a known fact, it's perfect for the solo traveller.
the neighborhood : I've lived in Montreal for quite a while now and still puzzled by the mile-end. I called it the little Paris, for the amount of french living in the neighborhood, but not only. The place is charming and the small cafes and pizzerias definetely gives you a taste of Europe.

Isabelle welcomed me,  and I felt like she had been my good friend for a long time by the time I left!   Isabelle went out of her way to find a parking spot,  made sure my stay was lovely and comfortable.  She is a fabulous chef, and a wonderful company.   I truly enjoyed my stay.

Le mauvais temps m'a forcée à avancer mon arrivée et Isabelle était disponible pour me recevoir un peu plus tôt que prévu. Un voisin faisait du bruit et elle est allée lui demander de baisser le son. Bref, elle a su rendre confortable mon séjour et je l'en remercie.
Great place, great hostess, great value.

We had an amazing stay at this home! It is so much bigger and lovelier than the pictures even convey. The neighborhood is fantastic too.  It's a bit north of the trendy neighborhoods of Mile End and Plateau, but we were so happy we ended up staying here.  It has tree-lined streets with a wonderful village feel.  It also seems to be a destination restaurant neighborhood and we ate really well. I highly recommend both Jean Talon market and the Indonesian tapas bar.  The home itself is airy and spacious with a wonderful back deck. It's particularly good for families.  Coming back after a day out biking and exploring felt like coming home - only much nicer.  Genevieve and Yanick were out of town when we were there but communication was quick and easy and there neighbor Dan was enormously helpful in letting us in and providing advice.  Would definitely stay again if possible.

We spent an wonderful week in Geneviève & Yanick's charming home, with its lovely back garden terrace. The apartment is very large and well organised for family life (we were 2 parents with three teens), and possessed all necessary amenities for visitors. The beds are comfortable, the two bathrooms are recently renovated, the kitchen is great to cook in, everything was clean and organised for our arrival, no problems with the wifi or tv.  And the cat is friendly.  Our questions were quickly answered.
The neighbourhood is fantastic, very family-oriented, close to 2 métro lines, several bus lines, a fantastic bakery, Jean-Talon market, great restos, Dumoulin bike shop, Bixi bikes....you can walk everywhere you need to go!
We highly reccommend this home to family travellers.

Le séjour s'est très bien placé! La maison de Geneviève et Yanick est très bien placée, dans un quartier très sympa. Elle est par ailleurs très très agréable à vivre. Tout était prêt pour qu'on passe un bon week-end! Je recommande vivement!

It is right beside the wonderful St-Joseph Oratory. Nearby are a grocery store, lots of restaurants, shops and convenience stores. It is a charm. You will have access to a modern kitchen with a refrigerator to store and cook your food. A laundry room is available in the building.
access: You will have access to a modern kitchen with a refrigerator to store and cook your food. A laundry room is available in the building.

host.host_about: Passionné de voyages, de films, de musique, de livres, de sports. Je travaille et étudie en réalisation cinématographique.

reviews.comments: Great place, excezsiyg
Une chambre agréable dans un grand appartement juste à côté de l'oratoire St-Joseph, avec un accueil sympathique de Raphaël. Recommandé !
We had a great time! Raphael is a very nice host!

excellente expérience.
à recommander
Amazing location
You get what you pay for and the location is amazing! A really pretty neighbourhood, right by the subway :)
Raphael est chaleureux et son espace est super.
Raphael is an awesome host, made my stay in Montreal a lot easier! The place is close to UdeM and HEC and also to a wide options of food, supermarkets and touristic attractions
Amazing location and stylish place Raphael quickly response for everything he is really very nice guy
Great location and amazing at the price.  Could be a bit cleaner, though, and the internet was somewhat intermittent.
Nice place, close to the subway  and Université du Montréal  (UDeM)
An apartment close to everything (bank, pharmacy, restaurants, grocery store, University of Montreal)
comfortable room as well as the owner’s hospitality. Good place to stay!
Everything was perfect!

Excellent accueil de Raphaël qui était très attentionné. J'ai passé un agréable moment dans cette sympathique colocation, et j'y ai trouvé tout ce dont j'avais besoin. Seul petit bémol, la cuisine pas toujours très propre...
great guy really easy going would recommend easily

Raphael charges $25 cleaning fee. So at least I expected a clean apartment. Bathroom, kitchen was very dirty. I didn’t use either. I did wanted to boil some water for tea but there wasn’t any kettle or pot. The bedroom has no lock & is right by the main door. So, you can hear people coming & going. The bedroom was hot like a sauna, even with the window open. Didn’t end up sleeping, didn’t even shower. 
I arrived about 9pm, left 8am the next morning. He justified by saying it’s only $17/night but with the cleaning, service etc, it ended up costing $48.02 for 1 night. Didn’t use any of the amenities due to uncleanliness. 
I didn’t meet him only spoke on the phone. He seemed nice & was communicating throughout the night & asked me take pictures of the whatever wasn’t clean because he needed evidence for the cleaning company, which I did & sent it to him. He said he would meet me in the morning, check out the place and refund me the cleaning fee but didn’t show up or responded to my messages. Location is good & check-in was easy.

Chambre dans un appartement en collocation très bien située car proche du métro, de nombreux commerces, restaurants, de l'université et de l'oratoire St-Joseph. Raphaël est un hôte très à l'écoute et avec qui la communication est fluide. Encore merci pour son accueil parfait et ses efforts pour rendre mon séjour agréable, je n'ai absolument manqué de rien. Je recommande sans hésitation!

Raphael's room was superb; absolutely a great deal considering the area. Room was very well-kept, and check-in was a breeze. Perfect for any traveller or couple looking for a good place to rest while exploring Montréal.  The metro and St. Joseph's Oratory are steps away, and CDN is a lovely neighbourhood to roam. Raphael was quick to respond and check in on us, and was a great host. Highly recommend.

Awesome location, this room was in a very convenient spot to allow you to explore Montreal. Room itself is alright, place is not too clean, we actually had to go buy our own toilet paper because there was none and if you're ok with other people stay in same place with you, then you'll be fine here. Really good host, communicative. Only downfall of this place was the cleanliness and how it was unclear about other people also living there. Even so, it was quiet and everyone was respectful of each others space. If you are looking for a place to sleep and semi shower, this place works great!
The host canceled this reservation 33 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.
The host canceled this reservation 7 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.

name: Luxury modern cozy condo Old Port w/ PARKING
summary: We have three unbeatable features: location, indoor parking and price! Very nice and beautiful brand new construction condo right in the heart of downtown Montreal-Old Port It's a few steps from 2 subway stations (Berry-UQAM and Champ-des-Mars).
description: We have three unbeatable features: location, indoor parking and price! Very nice and beautiful brand new construction condo right in the heart of downtown Montreal-Old Port It's a few steps from 2 subway stations (Berry-UQAM and Champ-des-Mars). Berri-UQAM subway   IGA grocery store, Pharmaprix and Jean-Coutu drugstores   Bars and restaurants at St-Denis Street  Old port of Montreal and La Fontaine Park  Last stop of 747 shuttle bus from the airport Parc Jean Drapeau
transit: Berri-UQAM subway   IGA grocery store, Pharmaprix and Jean-Coutu drugstores   Bars and restaurants at St-Denis Street  Old port of Montreal and La Fontaine Park  Last stop of 747 shuttle bus from the airport Parc Jean Drapeau
house_rules: No smoking  No pets  No loud music or noise after 10pm till 8am.  No parties

reviews.comments: Marcos was polite and very professional when we first arrived.  The condo was amazing and kept spotless.  We were in a great part of town and very close to the metro for areas that we a little further away.  Staying here was great.  An ideal area to get where you needed to go!

Marcos and Mari's apartment was a great location! The parking was clutch.  The apartment was modern, clean and comfortable. Walking around Old Montreal was easy and convenient. We will definitely be back!

Marcos & Mari were great hosts. Marcos replied by text within an hour whenever I had a question or concern.

The location was perfect. Two blocks from Rue Berri & St Catherine by the Berri-UQAM train station. Just far enough to not hear the crowds for Fierte, but close enough to walk out to the festivities.

The apt was immaculately clean! My friend said it was so clean, she was scared to walk in it haha. Also, I enjoyed the simple and modern furnishings. It would be as if I had furnished it myself, so I really felt at home :)

I really enjoyed having the privacy of the apt and being stress free in a safe building. The air conditioner worked perfectly against the scorching heat outside! The smart TV is great for bringing your own media to play. I had music and concerts in MP3, MP4, MKV, and AVI formats which all worked to my surprise! 

Also, the bed in the bedroom is a lot bigger than the photo looks! I think the photo "squished" the bed haha. It's at least a queen size I think.
Good place and excellent location. Would recommend.

Marcos & Mari's place is wonderful- clean, comfortable, and in a great location! Walking distance to a lot of great stuff. Getting in and out was a breeze with clear instructions from our hosts, and they were very responsive when we had questions! We absolutely loved our first visit to this amazing city!

Marcos and Mari's condo was super close to all the best restaurants on Saint Denis and just a few minutes walk to the core of Old Montreal! Check in and check out instructions were clear, excellent and flawless. The flat was modern, clean, and gorgeous! Thanks again for the stay! :)

Marco and Mari were very friendly and helpful. The check in and out were simple and everything went smoothly. This is a great condo in a great neighborhood, I honestly found it to be nicer in real life than in the photos.
Very clean place. Check-in was straight forward and simple. Convenient location with PARKING!

Marcos was an amazing host and very accomodating. The apartment was spotless and tasteful. The location was outstanding with tons of stuff to do within walking distance or a short cab ride. Would definitely stay here again!

Marcos was extremely helpful and flexible as we arrived and was quick to respond to emails if we had questions. We enjoyed the location as it was close to main Subway station and lots of restaurants on Saint Dennis. The apartment was clean as described. The garage felt secure and was very clean as well.

Great Experience! Marco's place was awesome! He wasn't able to meet us for check-in but he left detailed instructions even a baby could follow and he always responded to text messages within minutes!

The place is exactly as shown in the pictures. Really clean and cute. It's also in a great spot: Quiet but close to everything.

Would not hesitate to recommend Marco's place to anyone.
The apartment was perfect, great location in old port.  Marcos was a great host and very responsive, will stay there again!

We were visiting Montreal for a 3 day music festival that was happening in locations in Old Montreal and Place des Arts. This was a perfect location to either walk from or get the Metro 2 blocks away. The condo was exactly as described on the site and it was a pleasure to stay here: well equipped, very clean, and a quiet building. And given Montreal's confusing street parking rules, it was nice to have the indoor parking and not worry about tickets!   We would return.

Marcos and Mari's apartment was the perfect spot for our long weekend in the city -- clean, centrally located and conveniently close to a variety of transit. The pick-up instructions for the keys was extremely clear and well communicated. 

One small note: the residents do live here full time... from the photos we were not expecting to find a full fridge, computers, full closets. etc. Not a huge deal, but it took a bit of navigating to ensure we weren't unintentionally invading their privacy.

All in all, highly recommended!

The apartment was very clean and had plenty of amenities such as clean towels, sheets, and cookware. We enjoyed the easy walk to the downtown and Old Port area. Marcos and Mari were very responsive to questions and were helpful along the way! Parking inside was extremely helpful, considering the heavy snowstorm Montreal was experiencing. Thank you for a great stay!

Our stay at Marcos and Mari was truly a seamless and smooth experience! Conveniently located a 5mins walk to Old Montreal and 10min walk to downtown, every place was very accessible. A very clean and comfortable stay and indoor parking is a major plus. We would love to revisit and stay at Marcos and Mari again! Thank you.

A perfect 10/10 for Marcos and Mari.
Very easy to deal with. No issues what so ever. Very clean.
Do not hesitate to rent the apartment. The parking included is a huge plus.
Nous avons adoré notre séjour chez Marco & Mari. L'appartement était propre et fonctionnel et surtout bien localisé.

It was a very comfortable stay.. Everything was clean n neat, easily accessible. And they were just a phone call away for any assistance needed. 
My wife really loved the way the apartment was done and was kept so well organised. It looked n felt very pretty. It was our first AirBnB experience and it was v pleasent.

We enjoyed our stay here and would come back/recommend to others!
Marcos was easy to get a hold of prior to arrival and  for check in, and was patient in addressing my questions and helping me check in.
The apartment was clean, comfortable and well-furnished. Marcos and Mari were excellent hosts: they made sure to post the wi-fi password throughout the apartment; they laid out fresh towels, shampoo and soaps; they made up a tray of coffee and goodies; and they even left us a letter to welcome us and to wish us well on our trip. 
The neighbour is very well-situated (close to Chinatown, two Metro stops, Old Montreal, Rue St. Catherine and the highway). The closest grocery store is about a 10-15 minute walk away. The underground parking was very convenient. If you're planning to travel to Montreal over the summer (2016), be aware that there's tons of construction which will affect how you get to the underground parking and around the city (not a deal-breaker but make sure to plan ahead!).
Great place

Marcos and Mari's condo is in a great building at a convenient location to the Quartier des Spectacles and Old Montreal. Although we didn't get to meet in person, our check in was easy and the space was clean and well appointed.

Marcos & Mari's place is great. It is located in a quiet neighborhood, and its close to the Berri UQAM subway station, IGA supermarket, and the Old Port of Montreal. The place is clean and the amenities are complete. We did not get to personally meet Marcos and Mari, we were only communicating via Airbnb's messaging yet they were still very helpful and accommodating in our questions. My husband and I highly recommend the place. We will definitely pick this place if we ever go back to Montreal.

Marcos and Mari were great, they were very attentive and made sure we had a great experience. The apartment is in a great location and looks just in good in person as it does online. Highly recommend!

Marcos and Mari were responsive, helpful and generous. They were very prompt in responding to our questions. Before the day we arrived, they sent us another note with logistical details and directions to the parking, and left an awesome hand-written note in the apartment. 
The apartment itself was modern, well designed and clean. It had everything that we needed for our short stay, including the in-door parking. The location is great - we could walk to a majority of the places we wanted to check out. Highly recommend.

Marcos and Mari's condo is the perfect home-away-from-home! They are amazing hosts, responsive and available as needed, but completely unintrusive. The condo is modern and spotless, and with the parking and proximity to the metro, it can't be beat. We hope to visit again soon!

Wonderful hosts!! Apartment was in beautiful shape. They were very accessible and left great directions for getting settled. The whole trip was improved by the ease and warmth which we felt in sharing their place. We could not have imagined a better stay!

A great place to stay in Montreal ! You are close to all the hot spots by walking but still in a very secure emplacement. The condo was super clean and there is air conditioning. It is pretty small but perfect when you are 2 or less. The host are adorable (even if I didn't meet them) and always there to answer your questions.
Pleasant initial email, OJ, chocolate, crackers and water was available, and their apartment had interesting books and wall decorations.

My stay at Marcos and Mari's apartment was very comfortable and pleasant.  The apartment is modern and very centrally located.  The entire experience was enjoyable and the check-in/check-out was seamless and flawless.  They left a nice note and some chocolates to welcome me which was a nice touch.  It felt like a home away from home and I thank them for allowing me to stay!

Host communicated quickly and was responsive with questions.  The initial access to the apt was difficult, as the call buttons to be buzzed into the building were either not working correctly, or due to the late hour, the host did not hear their call.   The unit was clean, quiet and as described.  We enjoyed our stay.  Thank you!

Marcos and Mari were great hosts from the time we booked to the time we checked out -- i.e., they answered all our questions and made sure we were all set to "check in" and "check out". Also, without prompting, they provided us with information about getting to their place from the airport (take the 747 bus). Their place was clean and cool (temperature). The building is in a great location (close to two metro stations and within walking distance to the old town). Very positive experience.
Felt incredibly welcome and loved the apartment and location - would not hesitate to stay here again with great hosts!

name: Best location downtown + free parking - Esperanza
summary: In the heart of Downtown Montreal, one block of the famous Ste-Catherine street.  2 mins from montreal's best restaurants bars and club. 2 blocks from Metro station Guy-Concordia and PA supermarket. Max of 6. 1 closed lovely bedroom (queen size bed) . 2 sofa-beds in the living room (size double). Beautifull dining place. Free Wifi - Free parking - Free Netflix access on TV. There is a swimpool, a sauna, a gym and a squash area in the building as well as a nice rooftop terrace. You will love it!
space: You will love my place! I have a large room set up with a confortable queen size bed and added a little desk and a nice chair to create a nice little laptop friendly space. The living room has two Ikea Beddinge sofa beds that can unfold into  confortable beds a little large than size double each. I have high speed internet 35 mb/s and  a 55 inches full HD tv with a roku unit so you can access youtube and a Netflix account (logged in) and enjoy movies and shows. Beautiful candles are set on the table to decorate the place and you are very welcome to light them up and enjoy the different smells my wife picked for you.  Fresh towels are in the closet for your relaxing shower hopefully after enjoying our beautiful swimpool upstairs or our gym, squash room and sauna.

Beautiful candles are set on the t
neighborhood_overview: Althought it is very quite around the building it only take a 5min walk (2 blocks) to get to the best Montreal night life attractions including crescent street and the Wiston Churchill Club. It is also one block away from the ste-Catherine street with all the shops and restaurants. You can find all kind of food in a 2 blocks radius including fine steaks at l'atelier argentin or the best Japanese food at Kazu (big line up). We also have the PA market one block away if you rather buy ingredients and cook your own meal as well as a smaller grocery shop adjacent to the building.
transit: We are very central so you can walk to most places and you probably still be faster than most cars. For longer travels you can use the subway, Guy Concordia station is one block away, that would be on the green line. You are also welcome to use your car since I do provide a parking space which take one of the problems away (parking) leaving you to deal with the other: Heavy Traffic
access: - Swimpool - Sauna  -Gym -Rooftop terrace - Squash room
house_rules: The gym swimpool terrace and squash court close at 22h, please respect the building rules, also if you bring food and drinks to the terrace please clean up after yourselves, its just common courtesy since its a common space. I already set the parameter to only accept non smokers but if for some reason you pick up smoking during your stay please do so in the balcony.

reviews.comments:
Karim gave clear and thorough instructions prior to our visit. Though we never needed to meet in person or speak over the phone, he was very friendly and helpful, and eager to make our stay as comfortable as possible. 

Use of the squash court was a bonus.

Tidy and comfortable apartment with all the essentials and good shower pressure. The futon bed was comfortable. The dedicated secure undercover carpark was great. Short walking distance of downtown and the major city attractions. Karim was very responsive and a pleasure to communicate with. Would happily stay in the apartment  again if ever back in Montreal.
The place was very clean and cozy. 5 mins walk from St Catherine St. Very communicative and responsive with me. I will recommend it for sure to other guest visiting Montreal!
The place was very clean and the location was amazing.  The only challenge was the pool was closed for renovations during our stay.

Host was very accommodating for our last minute late night check in. Parking garage was kind of tight, definitely would be a squish for a mid sized car. But aside from that, Appartment was a lot more spacious than expected :) very cute decore and extremely convienent location !
Great location. Walking distance to pretty much everything.

We had a great stay! The place is just as pictured very comfortable & clean. I didn't get a chance to meet Karim but he provided detailed information on how to check in, park and check out. The place is at a very convenient location - close to restaurants, bars, shopping and metro. Would definitely recommend and come back.

The area is great with many restaurants in the immediate area.  Mt. Royal is within walking distance and not a bad hike to the top!  Apartment was clean and comfortable.  Pool was unavailable due to renovations while we were there.
As described, great clean apartment close to attractions.

Karim was an excellent host.  Gave us accurate directions and instructions.  Flat is located perfectly in walking distance (or metro) of all downtown action.  We love to walk everywhere as Montreal is a walkable city but had no issue with Uber and taxis.  Did not take advantage of the pool due to limited time but it is amazing along with the rooftop patio.  Had no issues with loud neighbors and building is relatively quiet.

Karim's apartment is awesome! Fit 5 of us comfortably. Karim offered some great local recommendations and was really helpful and responsive. The location is within walking distance from a lot of cool restaurants and bars. There's a lot of shopping on Sainte Catherine which is right down the street. It's also a cheap taxi ride away from the water front and Mount Royal. Would definitely recommend this place!

The apartment is  almost exactly as described. It's not fancy, but you will have everything you need. The beds are all futons, even in the bedroom. It's well stocked, very clean and comfortable.  Parking situation is wonderful. Location is wonderful. Karim was very responsive and helpful.
Exactly as described and more.  Great communications. The pool and Netflix TV were great. Thank you!
everything was good but was abit noisy in the morning and the parking was pretty tight and sketchy other than that everything was good
L'appartement est sympathique mais le ménage laisse vraiment à désirer .... Draps avec des taches, poussière un peu partout ... Dommage au prix de la nuit on s'attendait à quelque chose de propre.

Karim's place was sizable, but also very basic. It's use is clearly for Airbnb's only, so it felt a bit bare. Lacked small details like a full length mirror and paper towels. We also ran out of toilet paper (we were 2 women, stayed for 5 days, and there were 2 very small rolls when we got there). As for location, it was very close to the metro. The parking spot was clutch. We ended up not using our car at all (walked/took metro). As a side note, if you are sensitive to cigarette smell be aware that the hallways do have a strong odor. The apartment itself had none, but there were a lot of cigarette butts on the patio. Unfortunately we did not get a chance to check out the pool. Overall we were satisfied with our stay.
Everything was perfect. Karim explained the check in process effectively and we enjoyed our stay. There was no hassle and the location was everything we wanted and more.
Tres bien
Merci bcp pour oouvoir nous acceuillir dans l'appartement. Karim a très bien expliquer toutes les demarches à faire, on a eu du plaisir a rester chez Karim:)
Great place and great location

The location is great - you can find all kind restaurants, dry cleans, supermarket and very close to Metro (on the same block).  It is very convenient to find meals (Japanese, Korean, Indian, Chinese, Spanish, Steakhouse, Vietnamese) it is close to University and college so transportation and restaurant are very easy reach.

Just as listed, I wouldn't say dirty but wasn't the cleanest place ever.
The terrace and building amenities where amazing! Enjoyed my stay. 
Worth it for the price. Thanks Karim!

Great location - very near to metro station, which can be used to access most attractions in Montreal. The parking space is a bonus. Karim sent a detailed and easy to follow check-in procedures. He even helped to set up the sofa bed with pillows and blankets prior to our arrival. Thank you!
This was a perfect location for my fist visit to Montreal. Everything was as described and access was super easy.
the place is great but the parking kind of chalenging

Karim's place is at a very vibrant neighbourhood. There are lots of good restaurants nearby. It is of walking distance to the Montreal Museum of Fine Arts as well. He also provides guide books in his place, which turned out to be very helpful. Karim gives detailed instructions, so it is easy to locate the apartment. Overall, it was a good experience.

Karim was very flexible and always quick to respond any inquiry.
The bathroom could have been a little more clean but overall great stay!
Karim provided accurate information to easily check in and out.   The apartment was clean, comfortable and stocked with essentials for our stay.   Centrally located.  we enjoyed our stay.

Quaint apartment. Close to transit and quite accessible. Parking spot is enclosed-  corners are a little tight but easily navigated. Pictures are a good representation of what everything looks like. Karim is great at replying and explaining the check-in process. Had a great night in Montreal !
Karim's place is as advertised. Good communication, great location and thankful for the parking spot!

Karim went out of his way on his weekend to make sure we were happy! He always text back within minutes and was very flexible. We showed up three hours earlier then check in, and Karim made it work so we could park our car in the free parking zone, and drop off our bags. I would highly recommend his condo! Comfortable, clean and great location! Thanks again for a great weekend in Montreal!
Great central location in downtown Montréal. Drove in but didn’t really need to use my car at all. Subway stop is around the corner and restaurants all around!

That’s was awesome, The appartement was very clean, everything was nice, thank you Karim, 
If I’ll come back to Montreal I’ll not hesitate to contact Karim again
Great location downtown near Mont Royal and Ste. Catherine, awesome amenities, great price, and Karim was accurate and responsive!

Karim's place was exactly what we needed-- a quiet haven in the heart of Montreal. The apartment had what was needed for our group of five. Not fancy but definitely serviceable and (again) the location was wonderful! The rooftop access, pool and parking made it even better. A short walk to so many great city spots! We had a wonderful weekend there! Thank you, Karim!

Location is great. It was about a 3 minute walk to St. Catherine, where there are plenty of places to eat and shop. Very comfortable place to stay! Karim was awesome in communicating with us and responded very quickly.
Right by the subway! Good place to stay if you want to see as much of the city as possible
Great location, easy chef
Great location. Very nice apartment. We will definitely come back to it if we visit Montreal again.
Very gracious and helpful host!
Everything was as is  in the photos and description of Karim’s apartment. Stylish and comfortable..the location can’t be beat with parking being a huge plus.
I can't believe there really was a squash court and sauna in this building! How amazing. Karim's place was just as advertised and he was so quick to respond to our messages. Thanks, Karim!
Pretty nice! Good place with excellent location! Since I stayed here during Christmas holiday, one point is that the temperature is pretty low, not warm at all. Overall, it’s pretty great!

My boyfriend and I enjoyed Karim’s place very much. Super close to the green line Guy-Concordia metro station to get around the city. We kept our car parked in Karim’s parking space. The parking is tight, but doable. We did a 3-day unlimited Metro pass that was only $18 CAD, which was perfect in getting us anywhere we needed to be from Karim’s. Karim was very quick to respond and helped us out with a last minute booking after our previous booking got canceled on us. Highly recommend and would definitely stay at his place again!
Bien situé, propre, bonne communication, stationnement interieur*****

This apartment is centrally located with decent indoor parking. However, it is poorly maintained and missing a few amenities in the kitchen. The accumulation of dirt and dust over the year is obvious on furniture and baseboards with stains on walls and doors. The worst is to be charged a cleaning fee and to then be handed a dirty apartment that was not properly cleaned after the previous night's guest. From a stinky towel and dirty bathroom to dirty sinks and filthy countertops and stovetop. I would not stay here again.
The condo located in Downtown Montreal, where is convenient to access everywhere such as Metro, stores, cafe, express food, etc. Check in and Check out procedure is easy.

Great communication with Karim. 8th floor apt centrally located so you can walk everywhere. Metro just a block away.
Indoor parking a plus as was the small pool and sauna. Apt was nice and quiet and clean. Futon mattresses rather hard and anyone with chemical sensitivity would notice the spray air freshener odor
Karim's place is awesome. Great location, ease of checking in and out, very spacious, and access to an indoor pool which was very unexpected. Thanks again!

Arriver simple , réponse rapide 
Appartement très bien situer , complet 
Rien à dire !!!

We were very happy with our stay. The room was exactly or better than advertised, and the amenities in the building were great (though the squash court seems to actually be a racquetball court). The location is fantastic - about a 10 minute walk from nightlife at Crescent street - and included parking is a huge plus. While we did not meet Karim in person, he was very responsive to our messages and the Argentinian steakhouse suggested in the listing was fantastic.

Karim's place is a great! Everything is as described and its a great location close to the subway and st. Catherine street.  Karim is also super quick to respond. The only issue we had was that there wasn't enough toilet paper and we had to go buy more. There also was 4 of us but we only had 2 towels. Overall it was an amazing stay and we would stay here again.
Awesome location, I had a great weekend at Karim’s place!
We stayed in Montreal for the long weekend. Our stay was amazing. Karim was quick with his responses and everything was as described.

Karim is an excellent host and very responsive to messaging. His directions for check-in, etc. were very clear and helpful.

The place has everything you need. However, the on-site parking has a max 5’7” clearance, so don’t count on free parking if you have a truck, suv or minivan. 

The building is easy to find and conveniently located within the city.

We really had a great weekend in Montreal staying in this place. Pool and sauna are extra enjoyable part of our stay, parking is tight but manageable. The unit is nice and clean. Definitely a great place to stay downtown, just a few walks away from restaurants, stores and public transportations.
Highly  recommend
C'est un endroit situé dans un quartier intéressant de Montreal.

Everything was great and absolutely satisfactory. Quick, responsive communication, super clean and nice apartment with lots of amenities and top location in walking distance to anything we needed. Anytime again :)
Perfect !
really good place but becareful with the underground parking

The apartment is in a perfect location. 3 minutes walking from saint catherine with is a really nice street and location. However the apartment is really old, not clean at all and the smell in the entire building is really nasty. I had to ask the owner to come and clean the apartment again because I could not stay there. I sent her picture of the floor and the stains. They came again to clean however the stains and dust were still there. I had to clean them myself. She didn’t want to reimburse me the cleaning fee. 
I would not suggest that apartment to anybody.
Real cool

The place is close to the main strip of bars and restaurants. We enjoyed our stay and the parking was also great. The place's cleanliness could be better, but for the price and the location and the free parking we thought it was fine.
Karim is an excellent host and his place is clean, spacious and is in the perfect location of downtown Montreal! 5 stars all the way!

This apt is located so that you can walk to the old port area or the McGill area. Also very near the metro stop if you want it. Having  indoor parking is a huge plus. The most problematic issue was arriving in 30+ degree weather with no a/c installed as advertised (which was a main criteria in selecting this place). It was quite unbearable. 
While Karim was very prompt and polite in his exchanges leading to our check-in, once this issue had to be addressed I was very unimpressed with how it was handled. After several exchanges trying to address this legitimate concern, which disrupted most of our evening, arrangements were finally made to come and install the a/c that night. In the end it only made a slight difference, given that its an older window unit. If you plan to use the kitchen, be aware that some essentials are missing; including the proper items to wash and dry dishes. Otherwise, the bed and pull out couches are very comfortable for sleeping, and the highlight for us that mostly compensated for the other disappointments was the amazing rooftop patio and pool on the top floor. If this host is able to rectify the few issues addressed, this place has a lot of potential.

We would definitely stay there again.

reviews.comments:
Beatrice's place was great. Can't complain about anything at all. Location was great, the place was spacious, the bed was comfortable, the kitchen had everything you need to cook and serve a full meal (I did not get a chance to use it). 
At first I was skeptical about the place because it had no reviews and the main contact number on Airbnb is not a local one. But there was really no reason to as Beatrice provides you a direct contact number to her mother, who handed me the keys. 
They were both very accommodating on check-in times. Marie is very sweet, she told me what was around the area and ways to get around. She made sure I had everything I needed before she left. 
I would definitely stay again, it would be my first choice if available on my next trip back to Montreal.
Great location just off St. Laurent blvd and yet the apartment is quiet and very comfortable. The back patio is a great place to sit back and relax. We'll be back as soon as we can.
A nice place in a nice neighbourhood, nice cafes and bars around and close to the metro. I would come back anytime.

I loved Beatrice's spot! Location was amazing, the apartment was clean, comfortable, and spacious. The kitchen was well  equipped (however I didn't get a chance to use it). The backyard was beautiful and Beatrice was communicative and accommodating. I would definitely stay here again!

Thank you Beatrice, the stay in Montreal was really nice. The Appartement has everything inside. I will surly join you again. 
Your recommendations were great and you were really helpful!
The apartment is great. We loved to stay there. In the near there are a lot of shops, bars and cafes. We felt very comfortable. Cheers Marcus, Katja and Ben
Beatrice's appartement was a wonderful place for our first Airbnb experience
my boyfriend and I had an awesome time at this spot. The house is stylish and clean and our host made sure we were confortable at all times!

host.host_about:
Hello! 

I am from Morocco and been calling Montreal our home for years now.
I am bilingual, and I can kick it in Arabic and Spanish as well.

I work in communications, advocacy and policy, mostly on  migrants and refugee matters. I read and write a lot. I'm a passionate and avid napper as well. In another life, I was an economist and a dancer. 

Bottom line, folks, is that I'd love to welcome you in my home and make sure your stay is memorable. 
Whether you are looking for a clean, quiet, and comfortable place to relax and have fun in when you're in a new city, get in touch!

reviews.comments: Jiji and Alex's place is spacious and really well-situated in the heart of Mile End, with super easy access to transit, downtown and shops and restaurants around. Although Jiji was away upon our arrival, she arranged for an easy check-in. She was kind enough to provide us with all we needed for breakfast. We had a short but comfortable stay chez Jiji et Alex during the weekend.

This place was perfect for my weekend visit to Montreal! It hit all the items on my checklist - location, cleanliness, comfort, affordability. The apt. is warm & inviting, beds comfortable, all amenities were provided. It is within walking distance of nearly everything one would want to do - plenty of restaurants, nightlife, parks, shops. And although Jiji & Alex were out of town, they arranged for someone to meet my friend and me as soon as we arrived and get us settled in. There were even bagels & schmear waiting on the counter- so thoughtful! They left the numbers of local contacts should we need immediate assistance and Jiji kept in touch via email throughout the visit. She responded quickly and with detail - giving suggestions on what we should do in the area based on our list of interests. Jiji and Alex truly have a gift for hospitality - I highly recommend staying here should you venture to Montreal!

Although Jiji and Alex were away during our stay, they provided a seamless and gracious backup plan for our arrival. His mom and sister were super helpful in orienting us to the place. We loved the location in vibrant and interesting Mile End and were delighted with the kitchen arrangement and comfy bedrooms. A grocery store right downstairs made it especially convenient. This was a great size for two couples, with reliable internet, a great espresso machine, and  everything we needed for a weekend stay.

Jihane and Alexandre were great hosts, they provided us with all the information we required to get around the city. The location was great, close to the bus stop and metro station. The appartment was comfortable , clean and cozy! Thanks again for everything, Christine

Nous avons été très bien reçus chez Jihane et Alexandre. Il faut souligner leur attention et leurs précieux conseils. Nous sommes venus avec deux enfants et cela s'est très bien passé. L'appartement est très bien situé  tant en terme de transport que d commerces et activités. Un grand merci!
Wonderful place in a perfect location!
Accueil chaleureux et super logement. Proche des commerces et de nombreux restaurants, l'endroit reste calme. Je le recommande ! Merci encore :)

Great place in an awesome neighbourhood. I couldn't have wished for a nicer place to stay, it is close to a lot of nice shops and restaurants and is nicely decorated and clean. If you want to experience Montreal I absolutely recommend staying here!

The apartment was close to restaurants and some shopping.  It was a bit of a distance to downtown and the metro.   Communication with our host was great.  They were very accommodating for our uncertain arrival time.  The apartment was spacious and very comfortable.

We couldn't have asked for a better stay on our long weekend in this great city!  Jiji and Alex's place is exactly as described, and the perfect location in the heart of the Mile End.  Restaurants and shops out the door, not to mention the grocery store underneath. Communication was great and they were readily available if anything was needed.  The space was perfect size for 2 couples, clean and well stocked with any essentials needed.  Great find in a good area!

Having stayed in many airbnbs in the last two years, Jihane was the most responsive, easy to contact, and friendliest host I've interacted with. The apartment is close to so many amenities. A couple things to be aware of for the summer, there is a lot of noise from the street with the windows open and the bedrooms get a lot of light. If you're sensitive to those things, bring earplugs and a sleep mask. The beds are comfortable and the kitchen has everything you need.
Jihane made this experience-- she was a great communicator, friendly, and accommodating. I felt so welcome at her place!
Everything was as advertised. Great place and fantastic location.

這次預約房間和男友度過平安夜,算是不錯的體驗｡整體感覺很滿意,房子空間夠大,感覺整潔和光猛｡很喜歡簡約風,給人舒適的感覺｡房東也很熱心回覆和幫忙,唯獨要提早離開通知得有一點遲,預約房間時沒有提及,因平安夜玩得比較晚,翌日早上要提早起比較匆忙｡房東說公共區域可以繼續使用,但清潔阿姨感覺我們很阻礙的樣子...
有些美中不足值得一提,床鋪感覺很惹塵,不知是白色的緣故還是甚麼,但鋪塵的感覺扣了一點分｡另外,很應聲,一大清早便被樓下的聲音吵醒｡除了這些,整體感覺還是滿意的｡

name: 走路3分钟过关香港罗湖口岸100米两房一厅楼下双地铁口
summary: 房子交通特别便利,就在罗湖口岸隔壁,步行5分钟,就可以到罗湖口岸过关到香港｡离罗湖口岸有多近呢,就是从住处步行150米到罗湖地铁站E2出口,进入罗湖地铁站,罗湖地铁站A出口出来,就是过关大厅了｡就这么近关口!! 楼下有双地铁口,距离住处20米就是人民南站D出口｡步行150米就是罗湖地铁站E2出口｡如果你来旅行,到深圳湾公园､红树林公园可人民南地铁站直接到达｡世界之窗､欢乐谷､kkmall和万象城可罗湖地铁站直达｡国贸和东门就在附近1公里内,可以摩拜过去或打的不跳表,金光华广场和佳宁娜广场可以步行过去｡这个交通方便太无敌了! 房间从色调到灯饰到所有细小的装扮装饰都是一一挑选的,和平台展示图片一模一样,这套房子主打蓝色色调,装饰粉色的家具,营造一个温馨的家庭环境｡里面的设施设备都是全新的,提供简单厨具可以做简餐,洗漱用品都是全新的五星级酒店一次性高档套装(提供毛巾)｡ 重点强调一下房间卫生,房东找了一个有洁癖和强迫症的阿姨搞卫生,要求每次一定要搞至少1个半小时卫生,床上用品都是精心挑选超舒适的,最重要的是保证一客一换,一客一换!

name: Cozy home at Futian,1min2Metro,near customs to HK
summary: The hosts of this little sweet apartment are a couple. One is an architect, the other is an IT programmer. The architect is Pisces, the programmer is Capricorn. It's a kind of perfect combination of art and technology. We both have a dream to share a nice place for travelers. So architect designed, programmer decorated. At last, we have this new cozy home on airbnb.
space: It's a 35㎡ apartment on the 8th floor. There are 3 lifts in the building. Living room: There is a queen-size bed suit for 2 persons. Sheets are all clean for each guest. A desk is provided if you need to work or read. Mi TV is connected to internet, a lot of free movies can be watched. Refrigerator is filled with drink and fast food, but need extra charge. Books are mainly in kinds of architecture and technology, but in Chinese. Washing machine is in balcony. Bathroom has a separate shower. Towels, toothbrushes&toothpaste, shampoo&bodywash, soap and slippers are provided. Kitchen is all equipped. You can easily start your cooking. If you need any special tools for cooking, just tell us before you arrive, we are glad to prepare for you.  Technology: 100M free wifi, Mi TV, smart door lock(you can use password to open the door, the password will become effective just before you arrive and lose effective on 12:00 the day you leaving), smart air condition(cold&heat).

neighborhood_overview: Our apartment is located at the center of Shenzhen, along the Binhe road, one of the main streets. It is very very near the Huanggang checkpoint to Hong Kong(not in Hong Kong, don't be confused by airbnb map, Hong Kong is a river beyond). Our apartment is in a big community. If you want to experience the true Shenzhen lifestyle, this is suitable for you.  Floor -1 to 3 of the building is commercial complex. You can find garden, swimming pools( both in door and out door), gym, basketball court, supermarket, community library, beauty salons, massage, restaurants, almost all the things you need. At downstairs, there are all kinds of delicious restaurants and great street food. You can try different tasty cuisines. At least, if you want a quick meal, we have McDonald's.
transit: Chiwei metro station exit C is next to downstairs. 2 stops(1 stop in fact because of still not open of Fulin station) 5 mins metro to Huanggang checkpoint(24 hours) to Hong Kong. 10 mins metro(4 stops) to Futian checkpoint to Hong Kong.(Metro connected on both sides) 3 stops by bus 369 to shenzhen conference and exhibition center, 10 mins(4 stops) by metro. 2 stops to Huaqiang Bei by metro. To Airport: Take metro line 7, transfer to line 11 at Chegongmiao. 36.9 km takes 59 mins.  To Shenzhen railway station(Luohu) or Luohu checkpoint: about 4.2km, but metro and bus will take a long way to there, taxi is a better choice.  To Futian railway station: metro line 7 transfer to line 3, 6 stops in total. To Shenzhen North railway station: metro line 7 transfer to line 4, 11 stops in total.
access: 起居室厨房卫生间阳台提供的设施都可以使用｡ 房间内有存放一些房屋维护与经营相关的物料和工具,如有需要请跟我们联系｡
interaction: We are friendly and supportive hosts.  No matter how long you are staying, as hosts, We will personally make sure your stay as comfortable as possible. Just please tell your requirements. We can speak English and Mandarin. If you need any recommendations to go around the city(local cool areas, good events, transport links etc), we will be available for any questions anytime.

房主特别友好好客,房子也十分温馨,装修很有格调,最重要的是房子特别干净,是很棒的一次住宿体验
Its a nice department. Clean and quiet
值得再來
很不错很好｡小姐姐很热情,离罗湖口岸很近适合去香港玩的人｡

Place is clean and tidy. Easy to find. Near metro and shopping malls. Will consider to stay here again next time. Cheers!

This place is well-furnished and I think everyone will like the style. The location is good as well, very close to Dong Men street and Lao Jie, where you can enjoy delicious food and shopping. It is very close to LuoHu station as well. You can conveniently go to Hong Kong. Over all, I highly recommend this place to you.

Cozy and beautiful, we had a wonderful night here! :)
All the things are clean and comfortable, the design of the room is same as the picture in this website! Nice place!
总的来说非常不错啦~房子最大的优点就是非常干净整洁,而且洗护用品都很齐全也都是不错的牌子;地理位置也真的很不错,超近就是各大商圈,吃喝玩乐都超级方便,比去口岸还快｡缺点就是隔音真的很差,附近领居们也挺吵闹的;还有就是离口岸也没有特别近哦,走路还是要15分钟的,有行李的话走着的确不方便,但是已经很不错啦~
房子很温馨舒适,交通非常方便,楼下就是便利店,很愉快的入住体验!
超出了预期,不错｡
很棒的房子,很棒的房东｡很开心的旅行｡s所有的一切都很方便｡感谢房东｡一切都很舒心｡谢谢｡
房间很漂亮,和照片几乎没差,自助入住也很方便｡就是从罗湖口岸走过去还是有一点远的,拖着大行李箱并不是很方便｡下水道堵!!洗澡的时候水渗不下去,这个很尴尬……洗发水没有惹挤得有点心累其他都挺好

充滿日式風味的複式小窩居,裝潢和擺設都有種令人很放鬆的感覺~鄰近有地鐵站,出門方便~附近也有大商場可步行到達~

房子很好看很温馨哒~离口岸也近,大概10分钟左右路程吧

但是,隔音太差了,一到晚上就是小孩哭闹的声音,还有走廊的脚步声都听得很清楚｡
而且,房东的洗澡间下水有问题,洗澡的时候整个洗澡间和厕所都会淹水｡

地理位置很好 離羅湖口岸很近 我盆友家也很近哈哈

房間很整潔 晚上睡得非常舒服

謝謝屋主快速回答問題｡ 地點也不錯喔!超讚的^_^
不错,闹中取静,房间阳光充足,舒服｡
Amazing
挺好的,地理位置也很方便,下次还会考虑住｡
特别有氛围,设施也都很好｡
环境超好,拍照超美的哟~
装修很温馨 家居都是和风的 设施也很现代  出门是人民南地铁站 走路十五分钟左右可达国贸或罗湖地铁站
挺好的,挺干净,要是枕头再舒服点就更好了,离火车站很近,也不吵闹,装修也挺别致干净
位置方便,去罗湖口岸都挺近的~
房间位置很棒 很方便第二天去香港 布局合理 大落地窗很加分 装修风格也很棒 唯一遗憾周边晚上有些吵 但是整体很棒
Convenient and stylish space, fast communication with host.
整体不错,温馨有格调,而且离火车站跟口岸都很近,方便的很｡入住超级方便,根据房东的入住提示完全可以自助入住｡提醒一下要中午12点前退房,12点的时候保洁过来打扫卫生｡
性价比一般般,房东不太热情有点遗憾
房间整洁度太差,第一天就看到了几只蟑螂,设备也太陈旧,和预想的差太多
Very outstanding place. Very good location, walking distance to train station and shopping mall.
房间就是隔音不是那么好,其他都挺不错的
第二次住了,超喜欢!日式的小loft,温馨又好看｡而且交通位置真的是很赞,走路去罗湖口岸,旁边还有很多商场,附近向西村巨多好吃的,简直想多住一晚｡房东小姐姐也很nice,小东西都准备得很齐全,点个香薰趴在床上看樱花树和星星灯,美得不要不要的,下次过香港还是会选择住这儿的
离口岸很近,附近有购物商城,交通很方便,房间也很干净,住的很愉快｡
非常舒适满意的住所,不过要小心楼梯
房间很漂亮,超出我的预期,住得很舒服开心,下次到深圳必定再租

Nice Location, quick response, nice house!!! Great
感謝房主 房屋佈置很好看
很好 房间风格很好看 卫生也不错

我们是两个女生,楼下大门晚上12点就关门了｡地方也挺安全的,性价比高,房东阿姐非常热情,热络｡
谢谢gigi房东,很热心肠很好客的一位女士,给了我们很多出行建议,房间干净整洁设施完善,离旺角D3地铁口非常近,且房间非常安静｡房子带有电梯,房东很细心的告诉我们房间的物品在哪里,门是双层的,很安全｡以后有机会再去香港我还来这住｡

位置就在旺角地铁D3出口旁,地段很好;房东阿姨很热情,入住和退宿都很方便｡
来香港对比各大订房app,讲真都挺坑,所谓的做活动减价正好让我关注到其实都比平时贵｡爱彼迎上订到这家｡虽然主页图不多但是胜在简洁干净｡地理位置没的说,旺角d3出来就是｡去哪都挺快华星冰室,楼上,稻香早茶｡甚至隔壁就有沙爹王｡去肥姐波鞋街啥都用走走的到｡差不多初次来香港你想要的都基本满足｡专柜可以去朗豪坊｡价位不高在香港能住到这个空间真的满意｡比所谓五六百以上酒店好挺多｡夸赞

位置很方便,就在旺角地铁口上面,但房间是独立的,窗外是不临马路,也不吵;安全系数高,楼下12点门禁,房间有两道门,还有台电视能看到走廊和电梯间的监控;房间内设施完备,什么都有,还有转换插头;房东GiGi姐超级热情,在落马洲坐地铁的时候就打电话说大概一小时后到,结果GiGi姐早就到房间把空调开好,然后还下楼来接,各种介绍房间设施,后来还发来一些图片提醒,第二天走的时候台风就要来了,也很贴心的建议我们坐地铁去机场｡总之,非常满意,下次去还会住GiGi姐家~

Gigi’s building is literally 10 steps away from Mong Kok station and it’s in one of the liveliest streets I’ve seen. As soon as you are out of the building you will completely feel the full experience of busy Hong Kong.

Gigi’s responses and tips to get around are quick. Just make sure you bring a towel and you’re all set to enjoy Mong Kok and Hong Kong!

If you’re looking to experience busy Mong Kok, the location of Gigi’s place is perfect.
下樓出了門就是地鐵站,住宿位置也非常安全,性價比極高,周邊購物商城一應俱全｡房東阿姨十分熱情,祝生意興隆,萬事如意｡
老闆娘人超好的 入住前把該注意的都說給我了 第二天下雨還把傘送給我了 實在是感謝 祝老闆娘生意興隆

Pleasant space, in a good location very near to a train station, suitable for 1 person (2 probably ok). It is very basic and you don't get a great deal for your money, but it is Hong Kong. Don't expect any cupboards or space to put you clothes or extras like fridge or microwave. It is exactly as described though and provides everything it says in the description. Feels safe and comfortable enough for a short stay. Host is very responsive and helpful.

Gigi is great and thoughtful! I arrived slight earlier and she was in the midst of her lunch. She rushed over to let me in, she even take away some delicious local dimsum for my husband and me! It was still warm and perfect!! Exactly what we needed! Thank you!
房东人很好!离旺角地铁口超近,房间很干净,下次来香港也会选择这里嘻嘻

Even though there was a slight hiccup on dealing with the price at the beginning, but Gigi has handled it like a pro. Everything went very smooth, the place is very strategic (literally down from an MTR), clean, and tidy. I really appreciate the quick responses and warm welcome from Gigi. Definitely will recommend this place to friends when they're visiting HK. Great job!

地点中心  屋住人很好.

真的只离 Mong Kok D3 出口几小步而已,房间很干净,舒服,主人们很热情｡ 觉得唯一可以改进的地方是希望卫浴水龙头上有大一点,在墙壁上的镜子｡目前有镜子,但它是小小的,剃胡子要自己拿看看,有点难｡ 谢谢!

Host is friendly and helpful. Definitely worth paying the amount of money to stay in such good location and a super clean place. 
Super near to MTR station and the toilet in the room is very clean. 
I’ll recommend this place to everyone that plan to pay a visit to Mong Kok.

The water heater will only supply water for short period. I need to close and wait awhile for the water being heated again while I finish washing my hair and waiting to wash my body  anyway, Gigi is fast respond and helpful. Thanks

Gigi and Hanna were brilliant hosts. Very communicative and helpful, responding to questions very quickly.

The apartment is in the heart of Mong Kok - the location is outstanding if you want a true taste of Kowloon. The room itself is very clean, has a double bed and great shower. It's basic, but if what you're after is a place to stay in a great location then you won't be disappointed. Amazing value for money!

Gigi is quite helpful and warm-hearted. The most prominent advantage of her place is the location. It's really 5 meters away from D3 exit of Mongkok MTR station. I came back to Hong kong to attend my graduation ceremony. One month before that, I browsed on Airbnb for a whole day to look for a room and at last decided to choose Gigi's place, which turned out to a right decision. I may consider another room of hers in Tsim Sha Tsui next time.
房源位置非常好,出门就是旺角中心~房间的空间也很大,适合闺蜜情侣一起住｡当时因为坐公交,绕错了路,GiGi姐耐心等了我们好久｡谢谢GiGi,下次来还住你这~

Gigi’s place is simple, clean and straight forward. It’s in the 5F of a building and the other floors can be a bit sketchy but the locks of the room is pretty good and I felt safe there.

reviews.comments: 作为天空之城的第一位房客真的很幸运,酒店跟房东描述的一样,位置超棒,坐地铁逛商场吃美食都很方便,希望房东越做越好,下次来香港的话还会住在这里的!
It was a very convenient place to stay. There are a lot of food around.
很好的房子啊 也很有感觉要是想要shopping 这家准没错 楼下就有金英药妆还有甜蜜蜜啊 离地铁站也很近 地铁站对面就有翠华餐厅.到达海港城也就10分钟
房间面积比想象中小很多,整个房间转一圈只需要七步,没有桌子没有椅子,卫生间小到无法伸手｡交通位置方便是唯一可取之处｡
地理位置不错
房东相当的热心贴心,回复也很及时｡房子整体比预期要好,勉强可以住三个人,性价比较高｡地理位置特别棒,几步路就有地铁站,十分钟走到维港,二十分钟能走到游船码头坐船去澳门｡美中不足在于床铺不是太干净,第一次也比较难找｡
Value for money
民宿地理位置非常好,走路十多分钟到海港城,崇光百货,离地铁口个非常近!附近各种小吃都有!简直不要太方便!

reviews.comments: Nice place
位置挺好的,附近很多东西可以逛!方便用户出行,房东人也很好,很热情!
位置很好,尖沙咀地鐵C2出口直走三十米就到了,房間很精致很干净,虽然在闹市之中,晚上睡觉也不吵,后面一条街就有很多吃的,去天星码头和海港城走路就可以到,很方便｡
交通非常便利房間也乾淨
首先 房子的位子很方便 楼下有很多公交站,离地铁也很方便,周边吃的也很多,周边很多商场,离海港城很近,很方便｡另外我们订的房间有点小,嗯,大概就只有一个20寸的箱子可以放下,但是麻雀虽小 五脏俱全,里面该有的也都有,整洁度也算可以｡最后房东人很nice,会热心帮你解决一些问题,另外早上的阿姨也很热情,是一次很好的住宿体验｡
地点不错,尖沙咀地铁出来就能找到,不过房间真的很小,在香港繁华地段寸土寸金可以理解,是我自己没想到那么小,房东人很好,本来要给我们换大一点的,是我没注意信息所以没换到,房间挺干净的,适合一个人入住或者小情侣｡
good location,convinent transportation,dedicated services

Definitely above expectations for  such a low price!

At first looking for a hostel in HK was a bit tricky. A lot of them offer the same stuff ( like close to mtr. Etc...]
What stands out is that this one is strategically located at TST and also the closest one at a MTR station. Just exit TST C2 exit and it there. 
I love the convinience that the check in was seamless. They give you a passcode for the door and room. Even if its the late hours of the night.
The place is very cheap and also has a nice design to it. 
It is clean and amenities are quite goodsuch as  toiletries (soap, shampoo, toothpaste, toothbrush, combs), it also has towel services which are included. 
You get free water per day.
The housekeeping is excellent as well.

What I would suggest is to have them include the following...
Water dispenser.
Common fridge
Microwave.

As a traveller this is quite useful for eating indoors or if you are in a budget.

Other than that my stay was safe, efficient and I enjoyed it. Thanks I hotel. Will come back with friends next year! :)

host.host_about:
Hello everyone and an advance welcome to Hong Kong. I love to travel, explore and meet people around the world. Airbnb allows me to achieve all that and when I don't have time for work, I love to host, so I can continue to meet people. I turn my guests to friends, so I know the key ingredients of a perfect stay. I am looking for guests who are friendly, easy going and respectful.

Your safety, security and comfort are my top priorities, so once your reservation is accepted; rest assured, you are in the safest hands. I treat my guests like long lost friends, so expect a warm welcome from me when you check in.

I respect religious freedom; however, my place will not cater for any special religious worship or practices. I will also not cater any rude guests, guests with hotel expectations and guests who do not agree with my house rules. Thank you for reading and we wish you all a safe and pleasant trip ahead.

Sven is a wonderfully welcoming, helpful and friendly host. The room was clean, comfortable and quiet. It is located very conveniently next to Sha Tin MTR station and has excellent bus connections. I had a fantastic stay and would not hesitate to recommend it.

Sven's puppy is also very welcoming and well behaved. Sven's place is truly a hidden gem in HK. Strongly recommended and will stay at his place again.

Sven and kathy they really helped me a lot.  They even helped me open the shower heater one day that I will arrive home very late. 
For the room is quite clean and comfort, it is perfect for one residence. U will have ur own bathroom, which is very convince. The bed is very cozy and warm. 
For the transportation, it will take u  5-8 minutes to walk to the Shatian subway station, where u could take the MTR.  Also there is a supermall and many restaurants around this area.

Very nice room in an oase of calme close to the Shatin metro station. 35 m'n from the airport by bus. A good compromise to visit Hong Kong. Cheaper than the main island. The temple at walking distance is worth a visit. You might see monkeys on your way....

Sven and his girlfriend are so kind and sweet.
They took care of me like family and friends and gave me a lot of information so I could learn about Hong Kong.
The house is also very clean, comfortable and pleasant.
I had a very good air conditioning, humidifier and bathroom heating, and it was so good that I was able to use it whenever I wanted.
I had originally intended to stay for three days, but their house was so good and lovely that I decided to stay for another three weeks. I would have wanted to stay longer if it was not just a business trip to China. I strongly recommend this house to those who come to Hong Kong.

I was a month in Hong Kong for an internship at the Prince of Wales Hospitel. The location of the apartment was perfect for me.
Sven was always available, always responded directly to my concerns.
I have never felt like a tenant more like a fixed roommate. I had a very good time with Sven and the incredibly funny dog Zonda.
Thanks for the many help and the good time in HK

Thanks to Sven, I had a very pleasant time in Hong Kong.
He is very kind and concerned about me during my stay.
When I had questions or trouble, He always answered my questions via mail as soon as possible he could or support me to solve my trouble.
The house is really convenient for the station and shopping malls, so that I could get anything I wanted to buy.
Also it was good exercise for me to go up to stairs.
Thanks for the kind hospitality, good  communication with Sven.

Sven was an absolutely fantastic host. He was very sweet and welcoming upon my arrival. The room was clean, well furnished and equipped with all the essentials. Sven even gave me a SIM card to use for free! The bathroom was private and clean. Sven always clean the house and make sure everything is sanitised. After a long day, being comfy in the AIR room was ideal. Definitely the best experience I’ve had so far. Look forward coming again. Thanks Sven!

Sven and his partner are very nice, friendly and warm-hearted. They are always ready to help you. The room is fantastic, very clean with good facilities. It's near Sha tin Station (no more than 5 mins walk I think, there is a path through stores) and big plaza. It's very convenient to go shopping and go to anywhere. Living here is a very cost-effective choice. 非常棒的房间,非常好的房东,房间干净整洁设施齐全｡来之前听说在半山腰上以为需要爬山,但其实就一小段台阶,而且周围环境也挺小清新的,很有意思｡离商业区也很近,不管是在附近逛逛还是去地铁站坐地铁都非常方便｡总而言之,居住体验很好,住这里性价比很高｡

It is great to stay in a village house in urban Hong Kong, especially in a jam packed place like Sha Tin. It gives a feeling of being in an older time in HK. If you wish to be in Sha Tin area, I think this is a great place to lodge. 

Gentle reminder: For people with weak knees, there is a very short climb to the house.

This place is very central and close to public transport, ideal if you need to go to CUHK. It is up on a mountain that you need to climb through stairs (about 5 minutes or so). Sven was a very considerate and friendly host. When my flight time was changed from the evening to the next morning, he let me stay at his place until I had to leave for the airport early in the morning at no extra cost. The flat was clean. Be aware that the bathroom fan of another bathroom in this flat connects to the bathroom of this bedroom, so when it is on it can be quite loud. Overall, I had a pleasant stay here.

Sven was an extraordinary host. He exceeded my expectations in everyway. First, he helped me settle down by teaching me where and how to setup mobile phone cards and bank accounts. Secondly, he helped me setup a mailing address, so I can receive packages form overseas. Thirdly, he introduced his friends and other guests to me and occasionally made some outings, so we can all have fun, such as dinner plans and celebrated my birthday with other guests. Sven definitely made me feel like a family member and I was grateful to have booked his place. After a long day at school, his dog Zonda would give me a warm hug to welcome me home. I would highly recommend Sven's place to everyone; especially if you are a student. His place is 2 stations from CUHK and the walk to his duplex is excellent exercise and only a short 5min walk. Thank you Sven ^^ and I look forward spending my remaining school years at your place =)

Sven’s place is a village house located on the slopes about 5-10mins from Shatin MTR station. It’s conveniently located next to the malls, bus terminals, Taxi stands and mini buses that goes to Sai Kung, CUHK, Race course and Science Park. You need to walk some stairs to his place, but the view and feel pays off! It was a short notice booking at Sven’s, but he was super quick in response and provided all the essentials in meeting him. The room is nicely furnished with its private bathroom outside the room. Windows were big and bright. Sven prepared everything for me such as hot water for shower, towels, water and even turned the air conditioner on prior to my arrival. I felt spoiled and was mind blown by how much he offered during my stay. The cost relative to the experience you get is unparalleled. I would definitely come and stay with Sven again. Definitely recommend to everyone!

This place is the best. Bright, airy, spacious and comfortable. Sven was very nice and super helpful. His helper assisted me with my belonging and Sven made pancakes in the morning. Very peaceful place to stay and will definitely come again. Thanks Sven!

Sven was very welcoming and generous and included me in everything he could. The apartment was a short walk from the train station, bus stop and a large shopping mall. The room was clean and tidy with an ensuite and had a nice view. I would highly recommend staying here as it is very convenient and in a lovely location to explore Hong Kong.
Private bathroom was convenient. Nicely designed house. Right next to Sha Tin subway and IKEA. Overall a top choice in Sha Tin.

Sven is a superb host and make sure everything i needed is being attend to! Location is good apart from need to climb stairs but its normal for such apartment in HK, so those with really big luggage must take note. Really love the village within the city feel. Thank you so much Sven.

Sven is a considerate landlord. The room is spacious (in the HongKong standard) and very clean. Hidden in Paitau Village and facing Shatin Grand Central Plaza, the apartment has a nice view from the balcony and is essentially noise-free (also in the Hong Kong standard).  I visited Hong Kong several times, and this is the best place I have ever stayed.  5 stars!

host.host_about: 我是香港本地人,在台灣修的旅遊科,很喜歡交朋友,很高興能認識來自世界各地的朋友,我將盡力為你們提供最溫馨最真誠的服務和房間｡

address.street: 旺角, 九龍, Hong Kong

reviews.comments: 地段很好,在旺角地鐵站附近交通非常方便,生活機能也非常好｡只是房間稍嫌小一點,不過如果只是追求便宜可以睡一覺的地方是很OK的｡
Perfect location.

出行前,Ken将路线图发给我,所以还是挺好找｡在旺角,交通方便,而且旁边就是朗豪坊,购物很方便｡
check in 和check out都比较快,房间整齐干净｡
I had an interesting check-in timeline because of flight delays and logistics. Ken was great and helped us out! The location is awesome for hitting the town and exploring.
在20多层的大厦上,三人住有点挤,谁叫HK寸土寸金呢｡前台妹子很文静啊,态度好｡早到可以寄存行李后下楼逛,退房了也可以寄存行李出去逛,这一点很好｡
Good, reasonable, got the job done. Exactly what we were looking for.

les chambres sont comme sur les photos ,pas très grandes mais le luxe de Hong Kong c'est l'espace .les chambres sont propres et calmes.L'accueil est très sympathique et souriant et Ken a été très serviable .
 Proche du métro et des attractions du quartier.
nous sommes restés 6 nuits et nous reviendrons si nous avons l'occasion de repasser par Hong Kong.
Merci pour tout .
A recommander
He was very kind and friendly! You won't regret choosing his hospitality!

We stayed in this place only for day time as we needed place to rest after night flight and before other connection flight. Its a nice place to stay, perfect location, hot shower, little noisy but is a exact city centre so what you can expect. Wifi works perfect and the staff is nice
Ken的房间干净整洁,地理位置很棒,离旺角地铁站大约步行5分钟｡在香港属于性价比很高的房子了,很好的一次入住体验｡
乾淨,近地鐵,附近晚上熱鬧,員工態度良好

I'm totally fond of this place. the view outside the balcony is awesome, this place is like a little , cozy, homey place to stay. it gave me a little home feeling when I'd step into the house :)
 the location is great, there's bus stop just right outside and mrt at the corner ,shopping malls right behind and "nv ren jie" is just right behind somewhere (walking distance) . i'm surely will be back when i come to visit hong kong next time :) 
ps: the host is very friendly :))

The host was friendly and helpful in providing the assistance we need. Just that the heater has to be warm up every 20mins other than that the room was comfortable and clean. Will definitely choose to go back to stay as the price is much affordable and reasonable as compared to hotel !
好喜歡店店~風格很有特色,有家的感覺~留意到床鋪枕頭的有淡淡的清香,房間雖小,五臟俱全,下次還會再來的~店主還有店員都好nice~必須好評喔!
Great stay at Ken's hostel
房间挺小的  但是设备齐全
住的挺舒服的,态度都很好~~

Ken is very friendly and helpful, recommended some nice restaurant.  My friend and I stayed here for 3 nights, overall I think location is very good, close to shopping area, MTR, Food outlet and the market.   Bed room is clean with fresh bath towel and bed sheet.  Will definitely come back to stay here if I am coming to Hong Kong again.

Ken is a ball of happiness :D He welcomed us very warmly, and even we came before check-in time he let us in. The location was perfect, it was very close to MTR station and bus station, I was using the bus from and to the airport since it was cheaper, and the stops was just right there, and the bus going to China Ferry Terminal *if you want to go to Macau* was right in front of the place, and there was mall, convenience store and eating places right around the corner
Though the room was a bit small which I assumed was normal in HK, I and 2 of my friends felt the space was enough for the three of us

Thank you Ken, Lilly and the other girl *i forgot asking her name* :)
与图片有一点点的区别!

This place is all about Ken the host's family, and staff plus the location.
Right at Mong Kok MTR Station so access to every place on both sides of Hong Kong is right there. Perfect.
Ken and staff always had time to do anything and everything to help gladly.
Totally great hosts.
The newer renovated rooms are definitely the pick.
Perfect location.
公共區域佈置得非常有心❤️ 很有賓至如歸的感覺｡唯一缺陷是房間內設施有點殘舊,牆壁蛻皮之類⋯⋯但整體來說金門旅舍很不錯的,推薦❤️
住宿地地理位置非常好,交通十分方便｡楼下便利店和美食非常多｡一开始住的房间墙皮有点脱落,但是很快协调换房,房间非常舒服,老板还送了巧克力~值得考虑!

Ken and his staff were very kind. We had a problem with our room and ended up moving out in the middle of the night but his staff was very helpful and ken helped us getting my refund and deposit back in the coming days.
Very professional and accomodating
宾馆外面环境很好,后门出去很多餐厅｡在朗豪坊旁边,购物也很方便｡宾馆比较自助,毛巾什么的要自己换,洗手间比较小｡隔音效果一般｡房间外面有办公桌可以用,挺好的
地理位置优越,沟通顺畅,总体干净｡就是在香港这个寸土寸金的地方,面积实在过于局促,尤其是卫生间,台盆是迷你的,洗脸时水老是洒出来,如厕时头会撞到台盆,大家要有心理准备哦,其他OK
房東很親切,房子很乾淨｡雖然訂的時候看到的房型和到飯店看到的房型有點不一樣,讓我們小小的失望,不過大致上很滿意｡謝謝!
This is a terrific location, close to Mong Kok MTR, shopping and heaps of food. The room is small but that's to be expected in HK. Staff are always friendly.

Location is great. Just a 2min walk from Langham Place, Mong Kok. The room we stayed was expectedly small. We took a peep at Rm 106 and felt that it was better than the one we stayed (Rm 107). Our room was clean and bathroom facilities worked well. Shampoo and bath gel provided. We can change towels anytime we want and that's a plus point. Will be a great choice if you don't intend to spend a lot of time and money in hotel room and want to have a bit more budget for eating and shopping. Our 4-year old gal didn't mind the cramp space and we felt safe. Staff were very friendly and helpful. Thank you!
这家店真的很棒,出乎意料的整洁,位置绝佳,老板人很好,强烈推荐,以后到香港还来这家店｡
A good place to stay! Will definitely stay here if i get the chance to visit HK again!
Ken's place is cozy. If you want to stay somewhere near the MTR, shops, and stores but quiet at the same time, then Ken's place is for you.
非常享受的一次旅程｡
Very clean and nice hotel. Lobby open 24 hours. Front desk person is very helpful. We had an easy time staying in this hostel. Recommended!
Good place to go. Close to downtown and shopping
房主非常友善､尽职,整个沟通过程很流畅｡住处地理位置很好,店主也提供了很多帮助｡尤其是中间由于个人原因需要一些特别的安排,店主都及时帮忙解决,推荐!
It was clean and the host was kind and helpful.

It was nice!! Very cosy and comfortable. The lady there is very friendly and welcoming. Even allowed us to place our bags before check-in and after check out! The location is centralised. Near to mtr, a lot shops/food around that area. I think only downside is the walking space and the bathroom. Also, it is slightly creepy at the corridors but other than that, I would totally recommend!!

Best location! Very near to MTR station, bus station, food vendors, etc. The room is clean and comfy, though a bit smelly.. Ken is very nice, i love how he took great care of us while we were there. Good value for price! Definitely will come back to Kam Mun Guest House ☺️

Ken was very nice and helpful. Needed help finding the accommodation so I messaged him on airbnb and he replied very quickly. It was a great stay. Super close to the Mong Kok station which made our travels so much easier.

The place is clean. Hosts were really helpful. If you are going on budget and don't mind sacrificing some comfort (as the room is really small), this is a great place for you. Thanks for the good stay:)

Such a not good experiences in the last day of my stay , they just give me late check out until 12.15 , first they remind me time to check out at 12.00 and then i ask for the late check out , they gave me 15 minutes and around 12.02 they cut down my electric , so rude . I even didnt complain about their complementary just a small face towel and even no drink in the room.

Lage war sehr gut, zentral und konnte überall gut hinkommen. 
Das Zimmer war wirklich sehr sehr klein und es gab kaum die Möglichkeit große Koffer abzustellen. Man muss sich schon wirklich gut verstehen um mehrere Tage in dem Airbnb auszuhalten weil es wirklich winzig ist.
Wenn wir Probleme hatten war immer wer da, um uns zu helfen.
十分感谢ken的热心,在来之前 (Hidden by Airbnb) 上告诉我们该怎么走,一路上都保持密切的联系｡这次出行非常方便,居住的地方离地铁站很近,靠近朗豪坊｡在这个热闹的地方,晚上住宿却十分安静,不用担心会被吵到｡可以说是性价比十分之高了!并且房东很热心,每次出行都给了我们指引｡很愉快的一次旅途!十分感谢两位房东!
Great location. Host is friendly. However, can improve on Housekeeping/cleaning services.

Great location..and Ken and his assistant were very helpful and accomodating. The place was central, clean, dead handy for the airport bus and as described. No problem recommending this place as excellent value for money!

地点非常好的一家宾馆,就在旺角地铁站E2出口出来,前面那个路口转左直走,前面有间kfc,再走多几步注意看左手边“新兴大夏”,进去后上电梯直达21楼就是宾馆啦!地点非常方便,楼下满街都是24小时港式茶餐厅,还有几间711走几步路就到了｡一抵达的时候柜台男生很热情的招待我们,我们住的是三人房,由于行李太多,原本住的那间三人房过于拥挤,他主动提议换过另一间比较大的三人房给我们,很加分房间中规中矩,干净整齐,无异味,备有浴巾和基本梳洗用品,还有风筒｡
缺点:浴门口并没有抹脚布,使用浴室出来后脚都是湿的很不方便,希望日后可以改善这问题哦｡

To others this might be small in room size but given Hong Kong is a space premium country, the room is a good reflection of how HK people live. The hotel's location is centrally located to everything and easy access to bus train and any eatery. You can't go wrong staying at this place.
Second time staying here and just as great, clean, and convenient as last time. Ken is a great host, very thoughtful and considerate. This is a lovely little guest house in the heart of the city!
Ken's place has good location and valuable price.
Very small room, but Ken was very accommodating, other staff there was also very helpful! Location was superb!
Easy, accurate, quick response, clean & nice location.
地理位置非常不错,附近好吃的特别多
Perfect location.  Value for money.
总体还行吧,房间比较干净,就是外面的走廊很破旧的感觉｡可能香港都这样吧

1.首先交通真的很便利,旺角站出来根据房东的指示信息很顺利地找到了｡同层里有好几个宾馆,他家的门厅走廊最有特色
2.出门坐地铁坐公交或者打的都很方便,对面就是朗豪坊,稍微走几百米有夜市小吃摊
3.房间真的很小,只能勉强打开20来寸的行李箱,没法正常走动的那种,好在也只是回来睡觉｡洗手间更小了,马桶总是被弄湿,花洒的水出来很急,有点痛(不过后面住迪士尼出水也是一样的情况)
4.最后还是要感谢房东,第一天到的时候有个朋友发烧了,问她借温度计,虽然没有但是很贴心地说可以为我们介绍边上的诊所
位置很好,但是房間有點小

Fantastic place if you want to feel the city. Mong Kok is a commercial zone with facilities to move to any place in the city. However most of the bars are in the HKG Island but you can take any of the the transport method that the city offers and you can be there in few minutes. Ken was very kind with us. We recommend his place.
很不错的住宿,房间虽小,但是设施齐全,出行便捷!
旺角中心区,离地铁不远,都不错｡唯一觉得可提升的是房间较小(实际没法提升,呵呵),箱子打开整理东西都有些困难｡
麻雀虽小 五脏俱全,地理位置很好,Ken人很可爱,给出了非常棒的出行建议｡
