name: Tonight I Sleep in Kowloon City
summary: Enjoy a comfortable bedroom in our home located near the old airport of Hong Kong. Leave behind the crowd and see yourself in a quiet neighourhood with unique urban landscape and great food just around the corners.
space: Land is gold in Hong Kong!! You will be staying in a private room with our family and hope you enjoy the every little bit of space you have in town.
description: Enjoy a comfortable bedroom in our home located near the old airport of Hong Kong. Leave behind the crowd and see yourself in a quiet neighourhood with unique urban landscape and great food just around the corners. Land is gold in Hong Kong!! You will be staying in a private room with our family and hope you enjoy the every little bit of space you have in town. We are a family of 5 (Mom and Dad, my younger sister Miu, my wife Carina and I) with 4 dogs and a cat. Make sure you are okay with them, well I mean the pets :) Whenever you are at home and not out exploring the city, feel free to join us for dinners and family gatherings! Situated near the old Kai Tak airport, planes used to fly just above this neighborhood. You will find old buildings which are only 5 to 6 floors high which are quite different from the rest of urban Hong Kong. But the redevelopment are rapidly changing this area and high-rise buildings are sprouting up everywhere. Let me know if you are carrying large luggage,
neighborhood_overview: Situated near the old Kai Tak airport, planes used to fly just above this neighborhood. You will find old buildings which are only 5 to 6 floors high which are quite different from the rest of urban Hong Kong. But the redevelopment are rapidly changing this area and high-rise buildings are sprouting up everywhere. Let me know if you are carrying large luggage, your point of entry and flight arrival time. We will recommend you the way to get to our home and arrange to meet and bring you home.
notes: We live on the second floor and there's no elevator in the building. Make sure you're okay with dogs and cats before booking :)
transit: Transport around Kowloon City is not the most convenient but it keeps us away from the crowd. Walk up to the nearest MTR station (Lok Fu) takes about 15 mins. There are numbers of bus and minibus to Mongkok (Downtown Kowloon) which take about 10 mins.
interaction: We are a family of 5 (Mom and Dad, my younger sister Miu, my wife Carina and I) with 4 dogs and a cat. Make sure you are okay with them, well I mean the pets :) Whenever you are at home and not out exploring the city, feel free to join us for dinners and family gatherings!
house_rules: Keeping the room as the same as before will call it fine. No smoking inside the house, thank you!

host.host_about:
Come visit Hong Kong, look for the escalators up Mid-levels in Central,  take the ferry across Victoria Harbour, see yourself in the neighbourhood of Jordan and Mongkok in Kowloon, or embrace the mountains in Sai Kung if you are too fed up with all the extravagant stores and shopping malls. This city is always on the move and you can feel the traditions still live among the people here. Seek beyond the modernized appearance and there is always something more to offer no matter what kind of travelers you are. 

From Hong Kong. Love traveling with my pack and passion.

reviews.comments:
This is a real find for anyone trying to find a more relaxed part of Hong Kong, but who does not want to leave the comforts of urban life. Located near the former Kowloon city, you live right in the middle of the nightlife of Kowloon district, with many eateries just down the street. The place is excellent location wise  as there are buses in front of the apartment building. If not, you can make a 15 min stroll (8 min if you walk at a brisker pace) to the nearest mtr station. Franco and his family really made me feel welcome for a period of 3 weeks, this made me re-appreciate Hong Kong on another level. Especially Madam Wong was an excellent host, much thanks for inviting me to badminton, the hotspot was very delicious! 
Highly recommended for anyone wanting to seek some peace of mind and feel/see a slower paced lifestyle of Hong Kong.

I was only at Franco's home for two nights, and didn't get to spend too much time with the whole family, but I generally felt very welcome at theirs ( (*even if their dog Nana didn't like strangers much, their cat, Little Flower, took a shine to me!) - came back in the evening once intending to pop out again for dinner and they invited me to sit down with them for a home-cooked meal T_T and when Franco and Carina had Boxing Day off they invited my friend and I to join them for a day trip to Tai O where we had a lovely day out walking around the fishing village. Franco's mum Win is also super friendly. Basically I'd love to meet them again when I'm back in Hong Kong one day, or if they visit Tokyo...!

Kowloon City is far-ish away from most tourist areas, but it was just right for me since the area is full of cheap and delicious food, and I loved walking around the market, the more traditional provision shops selling all manner of pickles... Their place is probably not for you if you're expecting... I don't know, a hotel or something. It's very no-frills but was perfect for me - I just needed a warm shower, clean place to sleep and some privacy (I had my own room). Be warned about the lack of elevator; Franco and his dad helped me with my suitcase up and down two floors!

Franco's home is cozy place. And the Wong family are really nice. It was a wonderful experience to stay in their home and I will definitely miss you guys. Hope to stay there again in my next visit to Hong Kong.
家的感觉,非常的温暖,喜欢他家的小动物｡交通很便利｡下次还会光顾｡:)

Place is tidy clean and spotless comfortable bed with quiet environment even with two dogs and one cat to live with.the family's host was ever so nice and friendly . I would love to stay in Wong's family again next time I back to Hong Kong

Franco's family was superfriendly.  The room matches the description, the flat is immaculately clean. The bed may be small as it is mentioned in one of the previous references but for me it was comfortable and I am 190. There are good restaurants near the house (thanks again!) and a park nearby. I would definitely stay at Franco's place again if I had such a chance.

Franco is an excellent host and I enjoyed staying at his place even if it was only for three nights. I found the apartment to be just as the advert describes. Franco was communicative before I arrived, and generously met me at the bus stop (A22 route from the airport) to show the way to his apartment. The room and the whole apartment was tidy and clean and I was made to feel at home from the beginning. The whole family is welcoming and friendly and we had many conversations about travel, work, and other matters.

To get around, I used the MTR station (Lok Fu) a short walk away (10-15 minutes depending on your pace) but there are other options (minibus, bus, depending on your destination). The local area has plenty of restaurants so it's easy to find a place for dinner within a few minutes walk, and there are the usual supermarkets and other stores so everything you need can be found nearby.

Before arriving, I was not sure about staying in an apartment with three dogs and a cat, but in fact they were fine. At first the dogs were nervous of the new visitor, but they never jumped up or caused me any problems, so unless you really dislike animals it should be ok.

I would be happy to stay at Franco's place again and can recommend it as a good/clean/safe place to stay. Many thanks to you and your family Franco!

On arrival, our friendly hosts warmly greeted us and made us feel very much at home. They took us out for breakfast, showed us how to get around, where to shop, how to catch public transport, and even spent a day taking us sightseeing. They also did the laundry for us and made sure we were very well looked after. The place is clean and comfortable, and if you like pets, this place is highly recommended. There is a shopping complex just a short walk away, plus many shops and restaurants nearby. we have a great time there with franco family.

With Franco and his family I felt like I belong here. They were so welcoming and thoughtful :) Their house was close to the bus stop, but they still picked me up there. The house was just like what's shown here, and my room was big enough - even the upper berth was spacious enough to have a nice sleep. I didn't actually have to bring my daily necessities; they shared almost everything with me. And we had dinner together, sharing our life experiences. The dogs were quiet and behaved very well throughout the time (they were actually trained). Everything's fantastic!!! I'll definitely stay at Franco's the next time I come to HK.

Franco said I was the 11th guest visiting his home. And I think I am a lucky one. In the 3 days in HK for my LSAT, I received a lot of help and support from Franco and his family.
I recommend you to come to Franco's home if you are to take LSAT, SAT, or TOEFL at HKEAA, in San Po Kong. There is a bus stop at the door of Franco's home and you can take the 11D for only two stops(about five minutes), with additional around five minutes' walk to the test center.
There are three dogs and a cat at Franco's home. It is easy for them to get familiar with you if you feed them occasionally. One dog named Lubi got so familiar with me that she slept on the floor in my room quietly for a night. I hope she will remember me next time I come to visit Franco. 
Life in Kowloon City is both of traditional HK daily lifestyle and exotic. Many Thailanders live around. HK-style Cafés and Thai food restaurants may just open vis-a-vis across the street. And thanks to Franco, I tried the best restaurants of the best. 
Kowloon city is a good place for anyone who just wants to be a flâneur, exploring around the city and experiencing the charming ordinary HK life. And Franco's home is certainly a fantastic place for a rest.
The host Franco and his family with the dogs and a cat named Ah Fah are awesome! The house was clean and has a friendly atmosphere.

It is a very great experience to live in this house with these lovely people,every details in here is  setted up meticulously,even you meet some problem ,these people will help you to solve it. youcan play with their lovely dogs or cat here ,and youcan feel the cozy and warmful atmosphere .I very appreciated these people bring me that great experience here,itisu
nforgettable

It was my first time lived with a family in my journey.And thanks for Franco and his family gave me a very unforgettable trip.They're friendly and another four members are very lovely.I'm sure everybody will have a good time here.

It was lovely and had everything one would need to feel at home. It's easy to find even for someone knows nothing about that area. Transportation and other basis are available within seconds. You can enjoy companion from lovely pets. At the same time it has sufficient privacy as well as space for one to relax. Franco and his mom are helpful and really kind people. I  joined them at dinner with 4 dogs sleeping peacefully. Though there are 4 dogs the house is clean and just super cozy. 
I would definitely recommend this bomb, especially those who need to take exams :)

Franco and his family are soooooo kind and helpful! And I like their dogs named NaNa,Ruby, Muemue(i dont know how tu type this one) and a cute cat named xiao Hua! I think I 'll be their place next time! That's so great!!!!!!

I came back to HK to visit my friends here, especially Franco's family :) I feel like I'm a part of the family. For the last time and this time we shared a lot of experiences. We had dinner together. We walked the adorable dogs together. We went hiking together. And we would share our views of life together :) They made me love HK even deeper and they are the reason that I'll definitely come back again.

I traveled to Hong Kong for just 7 days. But thanks to Franco and his family it became an unforgettable time for me. The room is spacious and cosy. I had enough space to rest, sleep and place the luggage and bags in. The nights were silent. I got an own key for the building and room. The dogs are really nice and the whole apartment is clean. I was growing up with dogs and know what kinda work it is to keep a house with dogs clean. I never found dirt anywhere. The bathroom is spacious and comfortable. I was having dinner with the family and whenever I had a question I got super advise. The public transport system in hk is quiet convenient. If you buy an "octopus-card" in the airport u can use any transport system with it by holding the card on a scanner to pay. U can charge the card in 7/11 (a supermarket which u can find everywhere in hk). The next MTR Station is just 15 min by foot and the next bus stop is right in front of the door. The area around the apartment got everything. Fresh market, supermarket and many different restaurants with delicious food. If you don't know what to eat, ask Francos mom. She always got nice Ideas and can tell good restaurants nearby. I will definitely choose this room again and whenever I'm in Hong Kong I will visit Franco and his family. Francos room deserve 5 of 5 stars.
Franco and family were very helpful.

Franco and his mother were very friendly and welcoming.  Communication before my stay was quick and they helped me easily find my way to their place from the airport. The place was very clean and conveniently located near many bus stops and a 10-15min to the closest MTR station. They let me use their octopus card during my stay. 
I had a great time!

What impressed me most was the kind heart of Franco's family. My stay in HK was so much more than just traveling. I actually LIVED here :) We shared our life experiences and they inspired me with their precious thoughts.

Kowloon City is a traditional region of HK where I experienced local people's lives. Several bus stations nearby are linked to everywhere in HK and I enjoyed sitting at the front seat of double-decker buses exploring this lovely city.

I stayed with Franco and his family for around a month. From beginning to end they were incredibly friendly and helpful. Franco gave me detailed information on how to get to the flat from the airport, and his mum was waiting to welcome me. The room was comfortable and clean, with (much needed) air conditioning. I joined the family for some traditional Hong Kong meals, which were delicious. The flat was fairly lively, with around 6 dogs in the living room during my stay. However, they were all very friendly and well-behaved, and didn't enter the private room. The location is a wee bit out of the way - my commute into Admiralty took around 40 minutes by bus and MTR - but its a nice area. Lots of great Thai and Korean restaurants nearby, and the Walled City Park is just round the corner. Overall had a wonderful time living with Franco and the family. Would recommend to anyone looking for a place in Hong Kong, and hoping it will be available if I'm ever back in the city!

Franco is indeed a super host!! Pre-arrival communication is good with prompt response. His 4 dogs are surprisingly tame and they welcomed me at the doors upon my arrival! The room is cosy and the bed is very comfy too. 

Kowloon City is like a hidden gem amidst the bustling cities in Hong Kong. It is a food heaven with many eateries and fusion cafés located just within 5 mins walk from home. Save the hassle of walking to the MTR station! The bus stop is conveniently located right below his house. 
Franco's parents are very helpful and will patiently explain to me the directions whenever I'm in doubt. I had meals together with his family and visited the nearby wet market to experience the local people's life.

Overall I had a pleasant stay at his house and I will definitely be back again for my next trip to HK.

I had a great time staying with Franco and his family. From the first to the last day, they always took perfect care of me. They are very generous, globally-minded and friendly people and introduced me to many new foods and interesting places that you may not find in any tourist guide. The dogs were fun to be around (Ruby was my favorite, and she knew it), and despite being home to so many pets, their nice apartment was always very clean. The neighbourhood felt safe at all times and getting around town was easy from Kowloon City. Thanks again for the amazing stay. I hope to meet again someday!
来一趟香港去哪都方便的情况下,房主还是很热情的告诉我想去的地方的路线,很暖心!家里住的舒服!感觉很温馨!!

Franco and his family members ( including the dogs lol) are great hosts. They provided me with cosy room and thoughtful care. We even ate dinner together, sharing our different experience. In a word, I strongly recommend you guys to consider here as an ideal stay.    :)
房东一家聊得投缘 整体很整洁 下次再回来

Its a lovely home and welcoming family.
In certain ways its central to HK as a whole, giving good access to the North/East/South/West, either by MTR up the road, or the bus stops either outside, or just a few blocks down the road.
Its a lot more authentic HK than staying in a hotel in HK-Island or TST, and the family invited me along for days out and were always available for tips and advise.

It was such an awesome experience! I came Hongkong to take SAT and ACT test and I lived with Franco's family for 9 days. His mom and dad are so generous and decent. I appreciate  hospitality. They had prepared nearly all the necessities when I checked in such as alternative plugs, towel, shampoo or even fruits and lemonades! They also invited me to taste original HK breakfest and snacks. Lovely pets sometimes could be a bit noisy, but it didn't matter since they are very quite for most of the time. They are quite adorable and docile.

Overall I came away feeling that I had absolutely chosen the right place to stay - I would definitely recommend this place!
The room is small and plain, but the bed is comfy and there are plenty of power sockets. Not really suitable as a place to spend a lot of time, much more for somewhere to stash your stuff securely and lay you head at night.
What really stands out about this accommodation is the family. So generous and helpful, they go beyond what you would expect from a host. We had a really good laugh together and all my needs (and some wants) were catered for.
Yep, if you are a sociable person, this is the place to stay.

Absolutely exceptional experience. Although I didn't meet Franco himself, I was warmly welcomed as a friend and very directly and simply by his family (and the 4 dogs, and the cat). The guest room leaves plenty of opportunity also to hide away and get a calm moments for a productive day of work if needed (a desk is provided), but of course, if you have time, the best is to pop out and simply get ready to receive all the love and attention that could get you accointed with the inners of Kownloon City, with lot of nice surprises (nice HK dessert place, was invited for dinner, enjoyed thoughtful talks, and walking the dogs, and visiting the legendary walled city park by night... etc...). I can only recommend this place. I hope I'll have the opportunity to come back.

入住的時候F正在和太太一起在外旅遊不在家,F家是我入住airbnb以來最熱鬧最有愛的,因為家裡有四隻狗狗和一隻貓貓,真的超級開心!雖然進門的時候狗狗們叫得很大聲,但是不要怕,他們只是在熟悉你的到來,實際上非常的溫順,他們都是經過F的妹妹寶兒調教過的哦. Ruby非常開朗喜歡找你陪她玩,也是一個十足的好奇寶寶,最後大家就只記得她的名字了. 阿妹,娜娜(小名,全名回來就忘記了),還有最膽小的XX我也怎麼都想不起來,好傷心. 回來很想念他們.
第一天晚上回來F媽媽在家,我們坐著一起聊了好久,非常喜歡和F媽媽的聊天,第一次知道了WorkAway的旅行方式,好羨慕她的開放和簡單. 
第二天上午他們一家人邀請我一起早餐,非常地道的港式早餐,超級好吃,等位吃完馬上下一個,雖然很趕但卻講究. 後來才知道F媽媽還要花一個多小時去西貢上班,不知道那天遲到沒有?永遠都會記得F媽媽在國外WorkAway,時刻告訴自己的一句話:我要做得最好,因為我是香港人,代表了香港,不能給香港丟面子. 
F的媽媽很開朗,F的爸爸比較安靜,但是非常的親切,很喜歡F的妹妹寶兒,希望有機會來上海聯繫我哦,帶你好好遊上海!
遺憾的是沒有見到F本人,聽說他的太太和我是同行,相信一定有很多共同話題,期待下一次的見面!
If you are looking for a place where you can feel at home...where you can enjoy real HK home made foods and family environment, this is the place for you!
这一家人非常热情!居住环境很好｡居住气氛也很轻松｡给了我很多的帮助｡帮忙找路线图  又带我去吃正宗的香港早点!真的特别感谢这一家!

name: Incredible space with amazing views

We have a second guest room listed as: Sublime setting, a room with a view.
space: Welcome! After a peaceful walk up Peak Road (around 20 minutes walk, some of which is uphill + no cars on Cheung Chau) you will be rewarded with a unique detached 1950's home nestled above a scenic cove.  This spectacular home offers tranquility and unparalleled views of the South China Seas, whether reading in the hammock , watching the brown kites nesting in the casuarina trees or enjoying breakfast at one of the garden tables.  At night, waves will lap you to sleep and in the morning you'll be woken by birdsong. This south facing home is ideal for short or longer breaks, for couples or singles who desire a refreshing and peaceful holiday..  We have two guest rooms available. neighborhood_overview: A very quiet and residential area.  There is a small rocky beach just 20 metres below the house where you can go swimming.  A few  minutes walk takes you to the peaceful Nam Tum Beach . Around 300 metres from the house is another beach near Kwun Yam Temple. There are many scenic walking routes to explore on the island.
notes: We are happy to provide our guests with a light breakfast, on request. We have two young dogs - Ella and Pepper.  Like all dogs when they hear the front gate / door open they will bark but will stop once they see you. Ella is very friendly and once you are in the house she will have already made friends with you. Pepper is younger but bigger. She's well-behaved and likes to do her own thing. There are a number of steps leading down to the house from the front gate which may be an issue for wheelchair users.
transit: Cheung Chau has a friendly and relaxed atmosphere where the best way to get around is on foot.  Ferries depart Central ferry piers to Cheung Chau every 30 minutes.  Fast ferries take 35mins and the slower ferries take 50mins. Cheung Chau is famous for its street snacks and seafood restaurants.  Enjoy your stay!
access: One of two guest bedrooms, this south-facing room with sea views is equipped with a queen sized bed, a large built-in wardrobe, air-conditioner and hair-dryer. Directly opposite the bedroom, you will have access to a bathroom with shower. You have access to all the outdoor space, the kitchen, living room and pool room. You are welcome to come and go as you wish, as you will be given your own keys. A designated tea/coffee table is in the kitchen for guests where they can help themselves to the variety of tea infusions, coffee and snacks. The conservatory pool is ideal for cooling down in the hot humid Hong Kong summers. You have access to the outdoor space. You are welcome to come and go as you wish. There is no curfew.
interaction: If we're around we are always happy to help with what to see/do/eat on Cheung Chau and in Hong Kong.  But we will stay out of your way.
house_rules: Please note that check-out time is 12pm / midday. For occupancy of more than two persons, we charge $250HKD per person. This charge applies to children aged 5 and over. Please leave the room as you found it.  We take our shoes off in the conservatory/pool area and it would be great if you would too. We do not provide guests with toothbrushes so please bring your own. You are welcome to smoke outside.

reviews.comments:
My girlfriend and I planned to stay in Cheung Chau for a night to escape from the noisy and crowdy urban area. We tried to organise a similar trip before and the information we found showed that the condition of the average hostel in Cheung Chau were just acceptable. 

Robin and Yan's place is an exception. After seeing the photos they posted on Airbnb website we made the reservation without second thought. The outcome proved us right. I dare say that it is the best accommodatin I have ever found in Cheung Chau.

Yan and Robin is a nice and friendly couple with exceptional taste in different aspects of living: books, furniture, food, etc. They are willing to suggest where we should visit during our stay (e.g. the delicious chilli chicken pot!) and tell us how to get there in detail. They have paid attention to every detail to guarantee they are providing first-class service. It is indeed our honor and fortunate to be their second pair of guests. 

When we arrived at the pier, my girlfriend and I took time to walk around the commercial area and visited the catholic church nearby, and then Robin came and showed us the way to his home. Although his house is located at the middle of a hill, it is not far away from the commercial area. The road to his house is quiet and well-maintained; it is not physically demanding to walk through it even we were with our luggage.

After entering the gate of his house, Robin led us through a large garden to the veranda, which is facing a marvelous and astonishing view of the coast. My girlfriend and I enjoyed reading books there during daytime. At night, it would become so romantic to stay there when the star-shaped light decorations hanging from the ceiling are all turned on. Next to the veranda is the indoor pool area. As the weather was turning cold these days, it felt so warm inside it. It is decorated with plants and oriental style decorations and furniture. It made me feel like I had travelled to Bali. 

The sitting room and our bedroom are spacious, clean and well-lighted. The interior design is in harmony with the outdoor area. As soon as we had settled ourselves in the sitting room, Robin served us hot tea and traditional local pastries. Then he gave us the key of our room - they have attached a mini flashlight to the key ring, and it helped us a lot when we were looking for our way back to the house at night. The next morning, Yan was so nice to have prepared some fruits and her homemade bread for our breakfast. The jazz music played in the sitting room was just excellent (my girlfriend and I even danced).

We will always remember Robin and Yan and our time staying at their place. We will definitely come again the next time we visit Cheung Chau.

Our stay in Cheung Chau with Robin & Yen was great! They made us feel very welcome in every aspect from communication on how to get there to restaurants to try in the area.

The house itself is wonderful with a great view of the sea and adjacent cliffs. The space was very clean and there was even a puppy, Ella, as an extra perk.

Cheung Chau is a walking or biking island so keep that in mind. We spent many hours exploring large swathes of the island from the Tsa Poi cave to the main Cheung Chau pier and some temples and beaches, all which were very easily accessible from the Airbnb.

It was a great experience and we would recommend it to anyone wanting a quieter few days on their Hong Kong trip.

The location of Yen and Robin's place, hidden away on Cheung Chau island, isn't so much charming as enchanting! This kind of quiet peace amongst trees and overlooking the sea is rare enough in any city, let alone Hong Kong.

I would characterise my visit as perhaps like staying with your favourite auntie and uncle. I am full of gratitude for the kind, generous warm hospitality as well as genuine interest in ensuring I had everything I needed.

In terms of tips that might help other travellers, other than the "don't hesitate and book now" cliché, I would probably mention:
1) The house is uphill from the ferry. Therefore try to pack light.
2) Be sure to go for sushi and tea at the Hometown tea house. If you have time, stop by for a photo and chat; and sign the guest book as well.
3) The internet on Cheung Chau has a reputation for being patchy by HK standards, particularly during storms. By European standards it was more than adequate for accessing files over the company VPN.
4) Try to visit mid-week when the island is practically devoid of other visitors. You could have the beach to yourself!

We couldn’t have wished for a better place to stay in Hong Kong whilst visiting our daughter. Cheung Chau is a charming island, less than an hour by ferry from the piers at Central, but has managed to preserve a traditional feel, with a working harbour, no cars, narrow streets, plentiful inexpensive restaurants, sandy beaches and multiple walks around the island. Wen and Robin’s delightful house is a 15 mins walk uphill from the ferry in an excellent location overlooking the sea. Unusually for Hong Kong, the house, both inside and out, has plenty of space, including a large terrace, spacious open plan dining and living room, pool room with plunge pool, separate bathroom with a shower for guests, and a well-appointed bedroom with air con, large double bed and good storage. As if this wasn’t enough, Yen and Robin were perfect hosts, inviting us to share their home and enjoy their company, together with their friendly dogs Ella and Pepper. We didn’t want to leave!

Being at Yen and Robin’s was a magical retreat from the hustle and bustle of urban HK. We were greeted by a pair of energetic dogs, and welcomed warmly by Robin. Despite the chaos that Typhoon Mangkhut created a week earlier, much of the house was already restored. We were stunned by the natural greenery, and also the calming blues that their house opened into. For a night, we could almost swear we lost ourselves. We would highly recommend this to anyone who’s looking for a romantic getaway.

neighborhood_overview: Mong Kok is one of Hong Kong's liveliest districts and includes popular markets, shopping streets, stalls and malls. The neon-bathed historic streets that wind through one of the densest parts of the world are worth visiting.  The neighbourhood includes one of Hong Kong’s most popular markets, the Ladies' Market, and also has a ton of shopping streets, which are a common feature in southern China. Conveniently, these are where a cluster of merchants sell one type of product on a single street. Mong Kok has entire streets and street sections dedicated to the sale of goldfish, flowers, birds, sneakers, and kitchenware. ･Sai Yeung Choi Street sells electronics, cosmetics and clothes. ･Shantung Street and Dundas Street are where you can pick up the latest Japanese and Western fashion and accessories. ･Langham Place is one of the many malls where you can do your Mong Kok shopping in air-conditioned comfort.

Athena was very helpful as she provided us various information that makes our trip to HongKong wonderful. Although the room is quite small, it is very clean and it is located near the MTR so its very convient. Overall, it is really a nice place to stay at if you are looking for a budget place to stay.

Our experience was good as Mr Yiu and Ms Luk were excellent in facilitating our check in and answered all our queries during our stay. They even provided us with a local SIM card and ended our trip with a sure win lucky draw prize!
The room was small but cosy and clean. Shampoo, shower gel and toothbrush with toothpaste are provided. Towels are available on request. 
The location is right in the middle of Nathan Road. You can choose to walk to either Mongkok and Ya Mau Tei MTR and both are just a 5-7 mins walk away.
Overall, a good convenient place to stay for short trips.

We knew our 3 nights stay got off to good start with warm welcome from Mr Yiu :) Very near to Mong Kok MRT station which is made it very convenient for us to explore Hong Kong. Room fitted the description listings and daily room service in tidying up our room was definitely a plus point. Ms Lok and Mr Yiu also are very helpful in accommodating our request for our early check out. Will recommend this place to our friends and we will be back to stay at this place again if we visit Hong Kong again.

Yes! The room did look like from the pictures- the beds came in single twin beds, and even the comforter sets, the bedsheets were exactly like in the picture too! (even the curtains). 

I've to commend the room's cleanliness. One of the first few things that I noticed about the room when I stepped in was its clean floor- spick and span, I did not spot clumps of hair or the floor being covered in dust- that was one of the strengths of the room. 

Secondly, the toilet's floor was clean and there was no hair lying about the floor, or murky stains spotted about the toilet (not that I dared inspect every corner dilligently- but I stepped into the toilet barefooted, assured that it was clean)

They only provide basic body foam and shampoo, which are put into wall dispensers. I found the body soap to suffice but the shampoo was abit drying and so you might want to bring your own shampoo perhaps. 

Cleanliness-wise, I give the sleeping area room + the toilets a 3.5 / 5 stars as I did not spot any dirt that irked me, the floors were clean enough to walk barefoot and they looked without dust. 
Perhaps, the only area which I did not walk barefoot much on was the doorway area as we were wearing shoes in and walking on it, during our first day. 

Space-wise, it may be small, but mangeable for 2 people. I would say that it is just nice- roomy for 1 pax but just nice- slightly tight (depending on how spacey a room you are used to) for 2 people. Hong Kong is known for small room sizes though, so I thought this small room space is common.
The toilet is quite small though, and the places to hang your clothes/towels might not be as luxurious as hotels but we managed alright ultimately. There's not much space to move in the toilet. But its cleanliness and the reasonable price topped the space constraints! Bedroom wise , space is alright for 2 people.

Perhaps, the room window was the only difficult thing managing as it was abit hard closing it and some slight dust.

Towels and linen smelt fresh! Bedsheets felt clean!
You need to request for towels. 
Host was very obliging, VERY, in answering all my many questions! I emailed her TONS. 
Keith & Joey were on duty when we were there and both are helpful, obliging people. Joey was very friendly and helped us to check which Karaoke places were cheap and the night bus to the airport! Their guesthouse is quite systematic I feel, with either Keith or Joey(lu xiao jie) on duty at different times of the day and they give you the number to call them with a phone hung outside the reception door. 
Keith answered any questions we had too! 
They even provided us a SIM card with internet!
THANK YOU Athena, Keith&Joey! 
For this price&cleanliness, it's worth.

Unser Aufenthalt war super! Das Zimmer ist zwar sehr klein, aber das ist in ganz Hong Kong der Fall, und es war gar kein Problem seine Koffer unter dem Bett zu verstauen (es gibt keinen Schrank, darüber  sollte man sich bewusst sein). Wir hatten jeden Tag neue Handtücher und auch mehrmals die Woche neue Bettwäsche, was mich sehr positiv überrascht hat. Der check- In und check-out waren problemlos, und auch eine Verlängerung des Aufenthalts war super unkompliziert. Die Gastgeber sind sehr freundlich und zuvorkommend. Die Lage war meines Erachtens perfekt. Mong Kok ist der etwas chinesischere Teil Hong Kongs, man kann Street food entdecken, shoppen gehen, und es gibt vielerlei Restaurants. Jedes Wochenende kommen die Hong Konter auf die Straße und singen, es gibt auf jeden Fall viel zu entdecken!  Die Metro war sehr nah, und man ist in windeseile in Central oder TST.  Besonders entzückend ist, dass ums Eck ein Fruchtstand ist, wo wir jeden morgen frische Fruchtshakes getrunken haben. Ich würde diese Unterkunft jedem empfehlen, der sein Geld lieber für andere Dinge ausgeben möchte, das locale Hong Konger Leben kennen lernen will, und würde auf jeden Fall wieder die Unterkunft von Man Ching Athena wählen!

name: Designer Apartment in Sheung Wan
summary: We live in a beautiful and spacious one bedroom apartment in the heart of Sheung Wan.  Lots of natural light and an open view over trees on Hollywood Road and the Man Mo Temple. We are close enough to the action whilst still being in a quiet spot, a rare find!
description: We live in a beautiful and spacious one bedroom apartment in the heart of Sheung Wan.  Lots of natural light and an open view over trees on Hollywood Road and the Man Mo Temple. We are close enough to the action whilst still being in a quiet spot, a rare find! Often described as the new SOHO, there are chic coffee shops and international gourmet restaurants as well as small street side dai pai dongs, up market boutiques and antique shops as well as traditional Chinese medicine and dried food shops – the best of both worlds where old meets new. The area is well served by minibuses, City Bus, taxis, and the old style Hong Kong tram. The MTR is a two minute walk from the flat. Many bus routes run along Des Voeux Road and Queens Road West and though many streets are too steep or narrow for buses, some minibus routes travel through the upper streets.

reviews.comments: I had a wonderful stay at Maria's.   I have stayed at many apartments in HK on Airbnb over the last years and this one is definitely in my top 5.  Lovely place, very comfortable, felt like home, extremely central and close to the metro, restaurants and shops.   From the beginning the communication with Maria was very easy despite that we were both in different countries and she was very accommodating and nice.  I would highly recommend Maria's place and hope to stay there on one of my next visits to HK.

I didn't get to see Maria but it seems we know more about each other than what we thought ;) She has been very responsive to all my requests.
Place is really good, clean, well equipped (maybe missing a dehumidifier to have better nights), bed is gorgeous. Nothing to say about the location, you have it all at an arm reach. Will i come back? for sure!

The apartment was conveniently located, close to everything from bars, restaurants, grocery stores and great shopping on Gough street. Maria's apartment is just as it appears in the photos and she was an incredible host -- very responsive and helpful. I'd definitely stay here again next time I'm in Hong Kong

Maria's place is perfect! Great communication. Place to pick-up the keys so it was easy check-in. 
The apartment is located less than five minutes walk from Sheung Wan  MRT station (which is also just a 25 mins train ride from the airport.)
The location is perfect. In city center. Take the train or walk on Queens Road. Lots and lots of cafes, coffee shops, and restaurants. 
The apartment is on the 15th floor (elevator.) One bedroom, living room, bath, and a functional small kitchen to cook simple to semi-complex meals. Lots of natural light. Large HD TV and decent wi-fi. 
Everything is great! Highly recommend.
great
The apartment is in very convenient location , so easy to get everywhere. Thanks Maria to make my stay very comfortable

My husband and I spent 5 nights at Maria’s place and we had a really lovely stay!!  With the caveat that many HK apartments are relatively small, Maria’s place was certainly big enough for a couple.  Two key things:  the bathroom had ample hot/cold water and the bed was super comfortable.  We didn’t cook anything, but the kitchen was well-stocked and there’s a small grocery store just next to the apartment. The location is great – two blocks from a metro station, near the trolley / bus lines, right below Man Mo Temple, and about a 15-20 minute walk to Central, Soho, and the piers.  There’s a great dim sum place about a block north and wonderful older streets, with traditional shops selling ginseng and dried seafood are all nearby.  Maria was very responsive before arrival and during our stay.  Overall highly recommended!

Maria's apartment was great and was a helpful host. 
Location, location, location, it is located it heart of everything, bars, restaurants, coffee shops and supermarket conveniently located down stairs. 
We had a great time Maria, thank you very much.

I think Maria is probably the best and most accommodating host that I have ever stayed with. Would definitely stay again and recommend to others.

thanks!

We had a fantastic experience in the Sheung Wan area of Hong Kong Island.  There is everything you need within a short distance of the apartment.  The apartment is sizeable enough for 2 people and is a safe haven away from home after the chaos that Hong Kong often supplies!  Transport is close by, restaurants are in abundant supply, and the locals are usually helpful and happy if you are spending money.  The antique markets are a short walk away and there are some fantastic tea rooms just around the corner.  Loved the area and the apartment.  Thank you Maria for allowing us to experience Hong Kong as the locals do
It was a comfortable stay at Maria's flat and we really enjoy everything here; It's clean, spacious for a couple, convenient location. Thanks Maria for making us a great experience in HK.

Maria's home is gorgeous. I was after a weekend getaway from work in Manila and it was perfectly suited. Clean, tidy, excellent location and quiet for metro Hong Kong. Maria was easy to contact and clarified any questions I had. I loved my stay in Sheung Wan and will definitely be back!
Maria's thought of everything a guest in the city might need.

Maria’s place is spacious, well decorated, very comfy (bed makes you want to do pjay days every day), and superbly located. 
You’re staying in a real home, which makes it really nice. 
I highly recommend Maria’s apartment

This apt could not have a better location — it’s about a 15 min walk from Central and right in the heart of Sheung wan, which is itself a lovely neighborhood. There are tons of cute cafes, restaurants, and shops a stone throw’s away. Be aware though that Sheung wan is extremely hilly, with lots of stairs. The MTR station is very close — a straight walk down Hilier st, which is right in front of the apt. No hills or stairs on this walk! I should also say that cabs are very easy to find in front of the apt, and quite cheap and reliable. Cabbies often don’t speak English but we showed our destination on (Hidden by Airbnb) maps, and this worked great every time. 

The apt itself was small by our Wisconsin standards but probably quite large by HK standards. It was clean and cozy and perfectly fine. It was surprisingly quiet for being in such a bustling neighborhood. The bathroom and kitchen were small (but we didn’t need to cook or even shop for groceries considering all the amazing food options nearby) and there was little storage for our stuff. But for two people it was great and we had such a wonderful time there. Nothing but lovely memories. 

Maria missed our initial Airbnb request because she was traveling, but once we got a hold of her she was super responsive and helpful. 

We had such a happy stay in HK. Thank you Maria for providing a great home base.
Great place all around!
Terrific in all senses!

neighborhood_overview: Tai Hang is an older area where the 'village' houses have been renovated while still keeping the low-rise open feel of the original area. Many of the apartment blocks are only 5-6 floors high, not common in Hong Kong these days. The area is unique and renowned for the eateries at street level. There is a walkway at the end of the street to Victoria Park and to Tin Hau, another popular eating area. Causeway Bay shopping Centre is within walking distance.
notes: I am happy to chat via email prior to your stay to help you plan and prepare for your time in Hong Kong Regarding the floor levels: The apartment is officially named as 4/26 Wun Sha. This means it is on the 4th floor (as per British numbering of floors) but the Chinese character outside the apartment door shows it as 5th floor (as per Chinese way of numbering floors). It is 26 as it is on the left of the stairwell - 28 is to the right. You'll know it by the plants by the door as well.
transit: The MTR in Hong Kong is excellent, providing regular and easy access around the city. The Tin Hau station is a 6-7 minute walk. Buses are available at the end of the street, at a nearby terminus and on several surrounding streets, making travel around Hong Kong very easy. Taxis are also available and cheap.
access: This is the entire apartment. interaction: I am happy to advise and chat with guests about the many options of things to do in Hong Kong. house_rules: Appreciate no smoking inside the building. I've never had a problem in my 8 years of hosting this apartment - all guests have been extrememly respectful of the space and items in it. Few details to help maintain the 'pest free' and comfort of my home: 1. Please keep the 3 sink holes covered & closed when not in use. If you choose to use the filter - please ensure it is only filtered with COLD water. The hot water ruins the filter. 3. Hot water: please leave OFF when not in use - prevents high power costs. It is electric so it'll need 3-5 minutes to hear prior to a shower  4: When going out for the day, or leaving, please ensure the following is turned off: water heater, air-conditioners, lights & coffee machine. (& sink holes closed/covered) 5. When leaving, please ensure the door is locked (seems crazy, but many forget this!)

name: Room in quiet village in Sai Kung
summary: ONLY ENQUIRIES IN ENGLISH WILL BE ACCEPTED, DUE TO THE  NEED TO EXPLAIN THINGS LIKE THE ALARM SYSTEM YOU MUST BE ABLE TO COMMUNICATE IN ENGLISH A lovely en-suite bedroom and a separate living room/second bedroom in 3 storey Sai Kung village house in a tranquil setting. There is great hiking right outside the door and plenty of beaches a short ride away. Our house is the perfect for guests who want to go hiking, enjoy some watersports, as well as explore the area's attractions and Sai Kung town.
space: THE HOUSE The house is a typical village house with three floors and a furnished roof with fantastic views down over Sai Kung and the sea. The house is in a very small village and is very quiet. The guest bedroom is on the top floor of the house along with our master bedroom. There are stairs leading up to the roof terrace. At the top of the stairs is also a fridge that guests are welcome to use to save them having to go all the way down to the kitchen to get a cold drink, milk for coffee etc. There is are tea and coffee making facilities in the bedroom. On the middle floor there is the living room / second bedroom. This room can be used as a living room if you are staying as a couple or an individual,or as a second bedroom if you are a party of 3 or 4. On this floor is also the second bathroom with shower, toilet and sink, and our daughter's bedroom.  The downstairs consists of the kitchen, a bathroom and the  living room / dining room. neighborhood_overview: The village is nestled in the hills above Sai Kung and there are some great walks and hikes right from the village. It is a lovely place to get away from the hustle and bustle of the city but still be near enough to enjoy all it has to offer. If you enjoy hiking, we have the Machelhose Stage 4 and the Ma On Shan trail right on our doorstep, and the Wilson Trail section 4 starts in Ho Chung which is a 10 min bus ride from Sai Kung.
notes: We have one dog (very sweet natured) and two cats who are rarely seen as they hide from everyone! Please note that if you are two separate people who do not wish to share a bed, you will need to pay extra for the second bedroom, which is the equivalent of a third person ($400 per night)
transit: Sai Kung town is only a 20 minute walk or you can get a minibus (10 min journey plus 4 min walk to bus stop). From Sai Kung it is very easy to get into Hong Kong Island, the journey time from Sai Kung by car or taxi is 30-40 mins or about 1 hour on public transport.   Sai Wan beach is a 25min taxi ride and then a 30 min walk. Trio beach is a 10 min taxi ride then a 10 min bus ride. Sai Kung beach, which is very small but has fantastic watersports rentals such as kayaks, wind surfers, paddle boards etc. is a 25 min walk from the house or a 10 min walk from Sai Kung town.
access: Guests are welcome to use the middle floor living room. The downstairs living room is the family room and is not a shared space. Guests are welcome to use supplies from the kitchen such as cutlery, plates  etc. if they would like to have a BBQ or breakfast (which they provide themselves) on the roof terrace, but it is our family kitchen so it is not available for cooking meals. There is also the roof terrace which guests are welcome to use if the weather is fine. This 700sq ft space has fabulous views looking out one side to the mountains and the other down to Sai Kung and the sea. There is a charcoal BBQ on the roof which guests are welcome to use, and a fridge just inside the door to the roof.  Please let us know if you would like to use the roof and / or BBQ so that we can get it ready for you as the cushions and umbrella are stored inside to to keep them looking nice. You can buy charcoal for the BBQ from one of the shops in Sai Kung (same price!) We have all the tools you need for
interaction: We will be very happy to help with anything during your stay and can also help organise or recommend trips to other parts of Hong Kong.  We do not speak Chinese so if you are coming from China and do not speak much English this will not be a good place for you as it makes communication very difficult and there are quite a few things we need to communicate about, like the alarm system, facilities etc. (SENSITIVE CONTENTS HIDDEN) translate is not very accurate and can cause problems, plus does not help with face to face!
house_rules: PLEASE READ THE HOUSE MANUAL THAT YOU WILL RECEIVE ONCE YOU BOOK. THIS HAS IMPORTANT INFORMATION. There is a no smoking rule in the house but guests are welcome to smoke on the middle floor balcony or on the roof. If you intend to use the BBQ please let us know in advance and tidy up the rubbish / food etc and bring inside any plates, glasses etc. afterwards, ie don't leave food out. We will clean up  Please take off your shoes and leave them in the cupboard under the stairs. We have an eight year old daughter whose bedroom is on the middle floor, so please keep the noise at night to a reasonable level, especially if you are staying during the week as she has to be up early for school.  The kitchen is not really available for use and we do not provide breakfast. However, there is a toaster and a Nespresso coffee machine in the Green room and you are welcome to have breakfast on the roof terrace and we have plenty of plates, cutlery etc that you may use. I had a really nice time in Sai Kung. Tara and her family were very welcoming and helpful giving me lots of information and a lift into town when I had all my luggage. The views from the rooftop are amazing and there is great hiking and beaches for swimming nearby. I also did a kayaking tour that I can highly recommend.

This BnB nestled up on the hills above Sai Kung was in my opinion a great and idyllic getaway within the boundaries of Hong Kong's SAR. Some have argued that it wasn't easy to reach and a bit too far out. But this argument proves illogical while they are comparing to anything else more urban - hence this be called a 'getaway'. However I find this to be a perfect solution to be out in the mountains surrounded by the full force of green vegetation all the while only a five minute taxi ride into Sai Kung town for all your amenities, enough choices for eating out and a convenient terminus to head into the city about an hour away. What more can you ask for?

The British family hosts are friendly and generous. Although I've always seen B&B's to mean 'bed and breakfast', this accommodation is more like a 'B', since breakfast was, as clearly defined on the site, not included. However their kitchen is free to use and one only needs to bring their own groceries up to the house to cover the stay. Rooftop BBQ was a promised highlight but the grill was so rusted out from under-use that my planned steak BBQ turned to a stove-top fry down in the kitchen instead.

Overall I still highly recommend this stay to anyone who wishes to find a nice quiet stay to gaze out in late afternoon/evenings under the stars on the rooftop or just to hunker down for a few days watching countless DVDs available or to hike on the plethora of trails that lead out and around the surrounding mountain sides. Whatever you end up doing, you'll come out fully rested and ready for another round from Hong Kong city's knockout attack on your whole being.

neighborhood_overview: Sai Ying Pun, a traditional neighbourhood of Hong Kong is now home to many of HK's best eateries. Although the area is now clearly  product of gentrification, it still has a lot of the old school charm it is famous for - traditional businesses abound.  There are four hip restaurants right next to the building; Potato Head is right opposite the building.  A few minutes' walk up to the High St will find yourselves in the middle of a popular evening hangout spot with many bars and restaurants. A French wine shop/bar is one of my personal favourites.  The area is very close to Central yet far enough from the choas to wind down after a long day. You can truly have your cake and eat it in Sai Ying Pun
notes: LGBT guests welcome!
transit: 3 minutes walk will get you to the Second Street entrance of Sai Ying Pun MTR station, which itself is two stops away from Central.  15 minutes on the MTR will get you to the main shopping districts of Tsim Sha Tsui and Causeway Bay. The night markets in Mong Kok and Yau Ma Tei are also within easy reach on the MTR. Several bus routes stop 1 min away from the apartment.  The Hong Kong Airport Express is also within easy reach by either MTR or taxi
access: Keys and the entry code to the building will be provided to you on check in. Lift up to the apartment on 9/F
interaction: I am available for contact via (Hidden by Airbnb) , email and calls. Happy for you to reach out to me at any time should there be an issue. Happy to introduce guests to a socialable group of friends who will be happy to show you around the area and wider Hong Kong, and the nightlife which HK has to offer.

Tiny and quiet village far from the city chaos! I didn't know there was anything like this in Hong Kong. Terry was very helpful and told us a lot of facts about the area.  He recommended us to take a hiking trail to the ancient fishing village of Tai O and it was a great experience.
这次的香港之旅特别不错,特别房东非常热情,考虑周全,为这次旅行增色｡房间整洁干净,环境优美,周围全是绿色,空气清新,噪声少,非常适合考前复习｡离机场很近,10分钟车程,交通便利｡

很棒!距离东涌地铁站需要换乘巴士/taxi  15分钟左右,附近景点比较集中,房间在一楼,设备齐全,室内拖鞋,建议冬天自带袜履,玻璃门窗,花园很漂亮,还有自种的木瓜,晚上可以去天台坐躺椅看星星｡接待我们比较多的是房东Terry,香港退休老师,港式普通话讲起来比较费力,还是会很仔细介绍景点,画出景点指引,怕我们记不住,像教学生一样“考”问我们路线｡;-)来时正好被捎回来, 走前Terry还一直送上TAXI~PS:两只咪咪好乖,可惜Kitty住院了,希望早日康复!

Staying at Ricky's place was a great experience!

It was an absolute pleasure to stay with Ricky.  He was very responsive to our communication and helpful in providing direction once our flight landed.  He even provided us with the written directions in Cantonese in case our taxi driver didn’t speak English (which came in very handy!).

Ricky had his cousin meet us at a College which was 10 minutes from the airport.  His cousin was very friendly and helpful – he even arrived with a cart to carry our bags to the apartment.   As there are no vehicles that directly access Ricky’s neighbourhood, there was a lovely 5 minute walk on a beautiful path which weaved through the jungle.  

Upon arrival at Ricky’s building, it was clear that the place was very clean and well kept.  He provided us with some water bottles, offered us dinner, and his 2 friendly cats entertained us while he checked us in.  He proceeded to show us the rooftop terrace which is a great spot to hang out and enjoy the view of the mountains.  There is also an area to wash and hang dry your laundry up there.

The room appeared to be recently renovated.  It was small, but it was very clean and efficiently laid out.  There was good A/C to keep cool as well as a TV with some basic cable for some entertainment.

Overall, this was a perfect place nearby the airport to spend the night before continuing our travels.  The price was fair, and I would highly recommend staying here.

Location is 5 minutes nice walk away from main road, in the middle of the threes and bridges on a very small village. Very quite, clean, excellent Wi-Fi. Very close to the airport and good for one night stop over.

We were only here for a single night on a long layover between Australia and the US, but Ricky and Terry did everything to make sure our very short stay was stress free. The village is a bit off of the main road, but they were waiting for us when we arrived with a cart that we could load all of our luggage on to and they brought it to the residence for us. They did the same thing for us super early in the morning and had taken care of making sure a cab was waiting for us to take us to the airport. They also gave us a ride to the train station after we first arrived to make our night much easier. It was super short notice, and a super short trip but they went above and beyond to make sure we were taken care of.

The room is very clean and convenient. The location is in a quiet spot in the nature. I find it perfect for a weekend to get out of the city and enjoy nature! 
Ricky and Terry are great hosts! They were very helpful with the pick-up, check-out and suggestions for getting around. We took a hike to Tai O and really enjoyed it. 
I highly recommend this place if you like nature, hiking and to see another side of Hong Kong.

Ricky and his cousin are most helpful. They even drove me to the MTR for breakfast! Will definitely stay again if I'm venturing back this way.

Excellent hosts!!! Ricky and Terry are super helpful. Good wifi connectivity. It is located in a village far from city centre so the air is extremely fresh and environment is very quiet and serene. You can get a good nice sleep here.
Nice new building in a traditional village near the airport. You cross clear streams to get there. A different and nice experience.

I missed my flight at HK airport and needed somewhere to stay for the night for the next morning flight. The place is a private room on the side like it's your own place. Has everything you need for a quick rest. He even woke up in the early morning 630am to help us trolley our luggage to the taxi area and called a taxi for us. Very friendly and a great host. Would stay again.
We really enjoyed our stay at Ricky's home. It was beautiful out there and well worth getting out of the city to see. A little slice of serenity after a week spent in the hub of Hong Kong.

第一次使用airbnb,这是个很有趣的选择｡
1.地理位置:因为这次到香港计划并不是为了购物为主,所以第一站决定去大屿山住两天,爬爬山｡选择了Terry和Ricky的家｡晚上21:30出机场后,按Ricky的指引,在机场坐蓝色的士,15分钟内左右到下车的点,Terry和Ricky两位一起等我们｡建议问的士司机要小票,我都不记得他收到我多少钱了,下车看牌的时候HKD56.2,因为有行李费,然后钱都放一起就搞不清楚了｡就在大屿山松满路,从大马路上走进去需要大约10分钟左右,其实白天是非常舒服的,有山有溪水,景色很好,晚上没有太多路灯｡第一晚Terry和Ricky帮我们推行李,带我们走了一遍进去的路,还是挺好走的,第二晚我们就是自己走回｡配给我们手电｡路也不难记得,还是方便的｡村子安静,没有杂七杂八的外人,安全回到｡相比大屿山景区里其他酒店,性价格很高,值得推荐｡ 
2.家庭环境:被青山绿水包围的三层白色小楼,打理的很干净,院子里有Terry种的花花草草､果树｡屋顶有个大平台,视野开阔,可以坐在上面舒服看的看看风景｡我们这次选择住的是在1A,配有独立洗水间｡在一楼,推门后就是房间,床､电视､桌椅､洗手台､干湿分离的淋浴间,就是两人洗澡之间需要间隔20分钟以上,不然水不热｡虽然不大,地方足够,我们一个30寸的大箱子打开也可以走动｡房间是地砖,非常干净｡床品舒适,两晚都休息的很好｡第二天一早后我们出去爬山了,回来看到Terry也给整理过了,完全干净｡山里夜里稍有点冷,房间也多备了一条被子｡如果比较怕冷的人,可以在山里多带件衣服｡

3.房主印象:非常感谢Terry和Ricky都很热情的积极沟通,从预订前的咨询,就给了很多实在的建议,帮助我做行程规划｡到了之后,画了路线图,考虑我们的体力和之后的行程,推荐给我可以去的地方｡第二天一早还开车带我们去吃正宗本地早餐,要知道前一晚他们因为要去接夜归的其他客人,凌晨1点才休息｡但他们也尽可能帮助所有客人,可以放心的把你的大屿山之行放在这里｡一直使用 (Hidden by Airbnb) 保持联系,告诉我们怎么坐车,可以吃什么｡总之值得推荐｡

4.社区印象:房子锁在的牛凹村,步行15分钟内就到了逸东村,超市､便利店､餐饮店什么都有,有不懂路的时候问下路人都很热情的帮忙解答｡大屿山这个季节不冷也不太热,爬爬山特别适合,听说缆车马上要进入维修的阶段就不能使用了｡很适合放松之行,以后有机会我还会回来尝试自己去爬山,还有大东山,愉景湾都还没去成,谢谢你们的推荐,让我对香港的郊外有全新的认识｡

希望短暂的两天,没有过多的打扰你们｡最后祝Terry和Ricky以及你们的家庭,Merry Christmas and Happy New Year!!愿我们会再见面!写的比较多,因为我在预定之前也从很多评论里得到了关键信息,引导我选择合理的住宿｡希望我写的也能帮助大家获取信息｡
Rickys place was a perfect spot to rest our heads after a long day of travelling. He was very helpful in getting us to and from the airport with directions and assistance to and from his place!

We had a two day layover in Hong Kong and this place was located close to the airport. Ricky was able to pick us up for a small charge, which I would highly recommend since it otherwise would be difficult to find this property if you are not familiar with the area.

We woke up the first day and Ricky and his colleague provided us with maps and directions in both English and Cantonese. Furthermore, they gave us a walking tour around the property as well as highlighted all the main attractions in and around their area. 

I would also recommend this property to anyone who is interested in going to Hong Kong Disneyland as it has a close proximity to the Metro Station and local bus routes. 

All in all, Ricky and his friend were very friendly, professional, and informative. They spoke very clear English and were very helpful in both providing us with extremely personalized customer service. Again, I would highly recommend this property to anyone.
非常棒的地方,环境安静,房东人很好,早上4点起来赶飞机还特意帮我们叫车送我们｡两只小猫也很可爱

感受不一樣的香港｡東涌,一個遠離城市喧囂的村子,風景環境都超級好,晚上還能看到繁星,坐在天台十分愜意｡Ricky非常非常nice和熱情,我們訂的比較衝忙,晚上很晚入住,早上五點多要趕去機場,Ricky超級貼心地送我們出去馬路還幫我們叫了taxi,超級感謝!!下次一定會和朋友再住一次,好好遊玩周邊,給自己一個休閒充電的時光^ - ^進去房子要走一段村路,但蠻快的,晚上很黑需要電筒,但很安全,離鬧市比較遠,但打車出去也很快,房子很棒很乾淨,超愛天台,很有feel｡熱愛自然,想尋找一片寧靜,or一幫friend開趴的強推!!
The place is nice and super clean. Super friendly host. The location is a little far from the main road but still is a cool place to stay..
非常热心靠谱的房东,第一时间给答复,告诉过去的花费时间距离打的费用,确实跟房东讲的一样,机场过去非常方便,打车10分就到了,步行过去住宿地方7分钟左右,下车时候房东的表哥接去住宿地方,非常耐心一一解答我的问题,以后在香港赶早班飞机有落脚点了,会介绍朋友们这个好地方,谢谢房东的周到服务
环境很舒适,很干净,还会推荐朋友去住,房东很nice,terry很热情的给我们介绍周围值得玩的地方

首先,房东Ricky和Terry都很热情,他们会提供 (Hidden by Airbnb) ,并在 (Hidden by Airbnb) 上告诉你方便到达的路线,如果要坐巴士,千万要坐S64,如果坐S1的话,到了东涌巴士总站,打车过去还需要30块｡想在机场打车的话,坐大屿山的车,但是要等蛮长时间的,车少排队的人多｡
其次,实事求是的讲,民宿位于牛凹村内,从巴士到达地港青基信学校走路到民宿,大约需要15分钟,而且内部路线比较绕,在没有房东陪同的情况下很容易迷路,也不要指望导航,导航在这里是完全没用的, (Hidden by Airbnb) 地图和Apple手机里自带的地图我都试过了,完全找不到｡
第三,抱着来了之后去东涌地铁站坐地铁去尖沙咀或去东荟城的想法的同志们,建议你们打消这个想法,这里离东涌地铁站和巴士总站还是有一段距离的,而且因为村庄里差不多晚上六点天就黑了,进出虽然有路灯,但还是比较暗的也很容易迷路,且村民们都休息的比较早,还是早点回来睡觉比较现实｡
第四,民宿的隔音确实一般般,它位于两层小楼内,基本上楼里的马桶冲水声､洗漱声､隔壁说话的声音,村庄里的犬吠声,会伴随着你入睡｡
第五,赶早班飞机的同志们,可以跟Terry拿一下香港的士的联系电话,打车去机场需要 (Phone number hidden by Airbnb) 块,行李额外一件5块,差不多10-15分钟就能到机场,还是很方便的｡但早上出门村庄里会比较暗,请顺着路灯走会比较容易走出来｡

房东Terry和Ricky真的很好人,很热情,而且很健谈｡第一晚12·30am才回来,房东特地出来路口接我们｡

Check out 时我带着四个月大的婴儿出门,房东还特地载我们去搭车,让我省心和省了很多力气｡

这里住了两晚,房间里很干净和安静,女儿都睡得很熟(平时在家都不能睡得那么熟)｡外面的空气很清新,让我晚上可以安心地带女儿出来吹风｡

楼上有个大阳台,晚上可以上去看夜景｡这里是香港的“小”世外桃源｡
Ricky and Terry are some of the best Airbnb hosts I've ever had! Very kind and incredibly accommodating to our every need.

The edge of this place comes from the very accommodating hosts, Ricky and Terry. They know how to converse in English and answers to your every questions promptly. They hand out maps of tourist spots and gives complete directions to places, which is very helpful for first time travelers in Hong Kong. If you love the outdoors, you will enjoy the scenic walk from the main road to their home. But if you're not into long walks, this is not the listing for you.

I had about a 10 hour layover in Hong Kong, so my boyfriend and I needed a clean, affordable place to crash. Our flight arrived at 11:45pm and left the next day at 10:15am. Ricky was great about communicating with me from beginning to end. He answered all my questions super fast! Even though I had a somewhat late arrival, his cousin Terry met us and had a dolly for our luggage. His place is like this hidden oasis. You take this cool walk through all these fruit trees. It looks like a forest! It's off the beaten path, but that's what adds to it's charm and appeal. When you get to his place, it's quiet and you feel like you're away from the hustle and bustle, but you're really not. 

The room that we stayed in had a separate entrance from the house, so it was like we had our own apartment,  minus the kitchen. My boyfriend and I each had a backpack and a carry on suitcase. The room was a bit tight for us and our stuff, but it was manageable. It was clean, cozy and comfortable. It had all the amenities you would need...towels, soap, shampoo, comfy and clean bed, heat or AC (which we didn't use), safe place, and privacy. The room was just what we needed. We had our own bed and restroom. It was clean and it was close to the airport. Plus, there's wifi! Since I arrived kind of late, I texted Ricky about the wifi and he got back to me right away! 

Then, on our departure day, Terry had arranged a taxi for us and saw us off. It was like VIP service without the VIP price.  Overall, you can't go wrong by booking with Ricky and Terry. These guys know what they're doing. Their place is just what you need...if it's for one night or more...you'll get great hosts with a great place to stay. Don't wait...just book with them!

Terry will make your trip to Hong Kong as enjoyable and easy as possible.  He drops everything to help you, he even picks you up after the airport, draws you maps, gives amazing details and trip ideas, and even took us to the market and got street food with us the first night.  I highly recommend ricky and terry as hosts!!!
位置有点偏.但是房东服务很好.来接我们.还一大早帮我们叫的士.很好!很不错的度假选择!

Ricky and Terry were wonderful with helping transport my luggage to and from the room with a trolley, giving me the best directions, explaining the subway and bus system, and hailing me a cab when I needed it. 

Pros: Very close to the airport, a cheap taxi fare, and easy to get to the MTR station via bus. 
That said, Walking to the MTR station without taking the bus is about 30 minutes and it's a very enjoyable and easy walk I would take daily just for some quiet time and fresh air. 

Cons: 
-The bed is incredibly firm (but I didn't mind it, though if you need a mattress with any sort of spring this is not the bed for you)
- A five minute walk from the road to your room (I also didn't mind this, in fact, I chose this room because of how scenic it was described and I was not disappointed)

Would stay again!
My brief stay was made so easy by Terry and Ricky's friendliness and helpfulness. Many thanks to you both. Highly recommended!

우선 한국으로 돌아와서 생각해보니 여기보다 좋았던 곳은 없었다는 생각이 들어요. 첨에 숙소 근처에 도착한 날은 게스트하우스까지 들어가는 길도 험한것 같고 주변 마켓가는데도 오래 걸어야하는거 아닌가 해서 좀 막막했거든요. 저같은 경우에는 엑스포와 가까운 숙소를 원했기 때문에 이정도는 감수해야지라는 생각이었어요. 시간이 지나면서 지내다보니 움직이는 거리도 별로 길지 않고 조금만 움직이면 다 갈 수 있는 거리였어요! 엑스포나 공항은 두말할것 없이 가까웠구요. 메인로드랑 살짝 떨어져있다보니 밤낮할 것없이 조용하고 편안한 시간 보내기 딱이어서 너무 좋았어요. 숙소는 리키와 리키 사촌인 테리가 같이 운영하는데 주말에는 테리 혼자서 게스트하우스를 관리해요! 전 진짜 여행다니면서 테리같은 호스트는 첨봐요. 24시간 진짜 제가 필요할때 다 도와주고 처음 온날 비도 많이 오는데 택시 내리는 곳에 픽업와주고 짐도 다 들어주고 짐풀고 나니까 주변에 마켓까지 같이 데려다주면서 마을 소개도 해줬어요. 정말 천사가 따로 없었어요. 만약 침사추이 홍콩섬처럼 번화가가 아닌 좀 더 안락하고 편안하게 쉬면서 홍콩을 둘러보고 싶은 분들은 여기로 가셔야해요. 전 다음번에 홍콩 가게 되면 또 갈거에요.

我很感謝能夠選中Ricky家的這個house,真的是非常好!我很後悔自己為什麼只book了1晚T.T首先這家是村子裡的一棟獨立的3層房子｡我們入住那天非常幸運地碰上Ricky和他的表哥Terry剛好在我們附近吃午飯,所以他們非常nice過來接我們｡Ricky和Terry人很好,很熱情,會很仔細跟你講解附近值得遊覽的地方還有非常小心叮囑,所以不用害怕會迷路~因為我從來沒有到過東涌,每次都是要去機場路過,這次因為想要到大澳看棚屋和海豚,所以就住了這裡｡要進房子,就要經過一段小村路,沿著小河走大概5-6分鐘,沿路一片植物,很多蝴蝶和小鳥,天很藍,空氣也很好｡整栋house非常雅致且装饰简洁有心思,房間非常整齊乾淨!配置也很充足,我一向出外都是自帶毛巾､牙刷､洗浴用品,所以這些都不成問題｡這裡去大澳､長沙海灘､大嶼山､昂坪360都很方便!而且附近還有一個很有特色的香港街市,还有周邊的保育做得很好!还有很多值得去的景点｡這裡讓我對香港有了一個很特別的認識｡晚上進村小路會有點黑,如果一個人可能會覺得有點害怕,但是很安全的｡晚上小路上還會有螢火蟲!而且可以上house的天台看星星!非常舒服｡還有這裡有2只很可愛的貓咪~之後我一定會再來的｡好好地在这里呆上两三天真的很舒服｡感谢Ricky和Terry!

Ricky gave us so many wonderful recommendations. The place would be a bit challenging to find your first time so he had his cousin, terry, meet us. Terry was also incredibly friendly and told us where to go to eat. 

We loved Lantau Island and explored Tai O and Big Buddha the next day before heading to Hong Kong. I’m so glad we did this. 

Thanks!!!

It was a great experience. I arrived early few hours but Ricky and Terry already prepared , The pictures and texts that Ricky gave were very helpful and accurate, I can easily flow it and find the lovely place. The room is very new and clean, makes comfortable. And they free offer the guests the Charging converter and flash lights in case can use it. Terry help me book the taxi everyday even at early morning at 6 he walk me out and till I am get in the Taxi,that’s make me feel so warm and appreciate.also help me carry the heavy luggage. Give me advise about the restaurant and shopping place so I can eat and buy the (Website hidden by Airbnb) very happy and glad meet those nice person and stay at a fabulous place. I enjoyed the environment, the sunset and fresh air. This place as beautiful as a vacation, but also very human and sweet｡非常舒服非常热情很美的住宿,推荐
GOOD
Great place! It’s a little far from the subway station. But in Hong Kong, it’s not easy to find a nice and private room at this price. I like that it’s not in the city. It’s quite.
Ricky和他的表哥非常热情,住所干净,整洁,Ricky还帮我们预约了去机场的车,人非常好,需要赶飞机的游客可以考虑入住｡
房间干净舒服,去得是大晚上十一点多了出来带我们进去,房主ricky没见到,但是有什么问题都很耐心回答很nice,带我们进去房子的虽然不知道叫什么但是感觉也很好告诉我们路线和附近游玩攻略,感觉棒棒
十分满意~服务满分,环境优美,干净卫生

정말 좋습니다. 가까운거리에 쇼핑센터와 현지의 자연경관이 있습니다. 현지인들의 생활을 잠시나마 느껴볼 수 있었습니다. 서비스도 친절하고 청결도도 훌륭합니다. 다만 접근성이 다소 떨어지고 개발되지 않은 경로를 통과할 수밖에 없기 때문에 치안 면에서 어떨지 약간의 의구심은 있으나, 건장한 남성이나, 단체로 모여서 이동하시는 분들이라면 걱정하지 않아도 좋습니다.(밤에 이동하시는 것은 비추) 방 안은 완벽하게 정리되어 있었고, 코앞에 한국에서 볼 수 없는 자연경관이 펼쳐져있었습니다.(그럼에도 방에는 모기 한마리 없어 정말 관리를 잘 하시는구나 생각했습니다.) 새벽에도 빠른 응대를 해주시고, 간이한 지도를 제작하여 제공해주셔서 어디로든 쉽게 이동할 수 있었습니다.
Wonderful hospitality! Great communication from start to finish. Provided local places to eat, gave very efficient directions, met us at the designated spot, and the room was clean and refreshing!
Mr. Ricky and Mr. Terry really serve us like a King. He came to help us pick up our heavy luggage from check in and heavy rain when check out. His place really cozy and clean. Great !
房间很干净,房东很友好,还绘制了地图提供给房客以便出行｡很不错的一处闹中取静的住所｡
热情好客,祝一切顺利
房东人特别的好,我们七点半的飞机五点起来陪我们去打车,前一天晚上还是两点多睡得｡还帮我们一起看演唱会的拉了个群｡房间也很干净,两个大行李箱可以一起打开｡美中不足就是有一点偏,也有点难找,绝对不要跟着高德导航走!绝对不要!!跟着他给你发的地图就好｡要打电话的话要把区号去掉不然打不通｡总体来说还不错｡
雖然冇見到Ricky本人,但系他的表哥非常熱情｡雖然那天只有他一個人,也不忘介紹周邊的景點及玩樂設施給我們參考｡房間非常乾淨舒服,設施齊全也非常周到｡有機會還會繼續book這個民宿｡
因为时间来不及所以没有及时check in 准备入住的时候已经很晚了 加上那天下雨 要走一段不方便的山路 一开始没有找到还在很晚打电话给房东问询 幸好房东及时接了电话 房间里的东西很齐全 该有的都有 并且问房东要了另外的转换插头也在第二天送了过来 还为我们叫车 有问题找他们都能解决~非常感谢

路有一点偏僻,下车之后要走大概要走五六分钟的路才到达房源｡房间不大｡刚好可以摆下一张床和一个衣柜,旁边就是一个小小的洗手间｡
房东很贴心｡住的地方离机场近｡

Ricky’s place was a great respite from the airport terminals (we were in Hong Kong for. 23 hour layover).
Clean, and comfortable with a well functioning air conditioning unit, and a great shower! 
The orchard walk to the room was lovely. 
If arriving at night you might want to request Ricky or his cousin Terry meets you at the YMCA drop off. 
If Terry hadn’t met us, I’m not sure we could have navigated the walk to the guesthouse), 
Terry was also a great help in finding local food and attractions (the Indian place on Terry suggested was amazing) thank you Terry!

Being my first time in Hong Kong during a 17 hour layover, I was a bit nervous. However, after being so kindly greeted by Terry, my nerves instantly went away and I felt at home. The place is very clean and has all of the necessary amenities for a comfortable stay. Highly recommend going up to the rooftop terrace to catch the beautiful sunrise/sunset. Thank you again!!

Stayed in double room 1A.Nice and (Website hidden by Airbnb) shoes inside rooms and common areas-slippers are provided.Good room air-con,was switched on before our arrival.Very welcomed after a walk from the taxi drop of point.Terry was very nice and welcoming,he came to meet us,even though I didn’t ask him to.The  detailed map with the directions from the  taxi drop off point to the house was provided by (Website hidden by Airbnb) was very clearwith the pictures as well.The common areas consists of a small launge with kitchen (guests can  use the microwave) opened between 08:00-22:30.Also there is a nice terrace with sun laungers and tables  and (Website hidden by Airbnb) in the room and a botle of water was also provided.On the whole simple,clean accommodation located near the (Website hidden by Airbnb) and quiet.
Lovely hosts and super helpful about transportation and things to do on Lantau Island. This is quite remote in comparison to staying in Tung Chung, but it is worth getting out of the main areas.
Ricky真的非常热情,也很nice,照顾的很周到｡房子是在村子里,需要走一段小路才能到,唯一的不方便就是这点吧｡第一次住香港的村屋,一路上小溪､蝴蝶､沿路的果树,还有鸟儿,好像回到了小时候外婆家的感觉,晚上在天台躺椅上看星星真的是很美妙,如果不是要赶飞机真的很想多呆一会儿
环境雅致,乡村风情,房东热情,服务体贴周到,公寓环境很好,离机场很近,再次感谢房东的贴心招待

Ricky’s place is located in a small traditional village in a green belt on the edge of Tung Chung. However, it is within easy walking distance of transportation and amenities in the city. It’s quite different from the usual Hong Kong experience - calm and peaceful and relaxing. The rooms are small but very clean, comfortable and newly remodeled.  Ricky and Terry were both very helpful and accommodating and provided tips about getting around. One thing to keep in mind is that you cannot reach the location by automobile as there is no vehicular road to the site, so plan accordingly.
所处环境优美,干净整洁,非常好的体验

Clean,comfortable and quiet,  we like the place so much and had a great stay over there. Please be prepared that you have to walk 7-10min from the village entrance.
Wonderful quiet location with hospitality to match. Would highly recommend to all travellers.
Perfect place to stay on a layover or just traveling around locally! Super clean and helpful!
房东人很好!他有提前和我们联络,地址的指引也很详细!

Please please pick this place, it is a must if you want to travel in hongkong , and see an amazing view ! The host is very professional, they will help you if you have any questions ! Also please be respectful to their place, it is so beautiful. The roof top has one of the best sunset views. It is also extremely private ! Come and bring more people there ! Great family place !
我觉得房间同环境好好,门口有玫瑰,哈哈,估计早上睇会好靓,虽然我地过去系住一晚,但系terry好好人,交代路线入住等等都好详细,第二日我地好早去机场又帮我地call车,真系好好好好人,如果再去香港玩嘅话都会再考虑

100% recommended for people who long for a temporary stay in Hong Kong particularly after a long time flight. Close to international airport, a bonus for fans of hills, mountains and creeks.
It’s a nice and cozy place for short stay.

Ricky provided great instructions and the place was very close to the airport. He also helped us get to and from the airport which was great and the room was very quiet at night. Very friendly, kind hosts! Thank you!

Ricky was very communicative and helpful. I appreciated the fact that he let me check-in much earlier than the official check-in time, because of my flight landing time in Hong Kong. The instructions to reach the guest house were very clear with both text and picture instructions. The transit map he provided was also a lot more accurate and helpful than (Hidden by Airbnb) Maps was.
the place was super clean and tidy, just what we needed for our long layover. the host was very helpful, which made our stay so easy.

房子特别好,比想象中大｡从机场打车过去70港币｡我们是去看演唱会的,当天11点才到,去房子的路上没有路灯很黑,我们有些害怕是房东来接的我们,人特别好｡
第二天天亮了真的是被周围景色吸引,很漂亮｡走的时候房东帮忙叫了车也送我们出去,一直等的士来了才走｡

就是洗澡的时候没热水…

房东回复很及时,很有耐心,去机场很快,交通便利!
You can find the place with (Hidden by Airbnb) Maps, it is well defined, there is a parking lot to cross through, follow the exactly instructions

I was attending a conference nearby, and had an easy time travelling back and forth with the help of my hosts. Overall had a great stay and would recommend to friends.

Die Unterkunft ist sehr geräumig und sehr gut ausgestattet.
Recht grosse und helle Räume. Obwohl an einer stark gefahrenen Strasse gelegen, recht ruhig bei geschlossenen Fenstern.
Da ein grosses Spital gearade oberhalb liegt, hört man sehr oft die schrillenden Sirenentöne der Notfall Fahrzeuge.
Man ist per Bus relativ schnell im Zentrum. Für ältere Leute wäre das zentrum zu Fuss etwas mühsam zu erreichen.

The apartment was perfect for our stay in Porto. A good sized apartment and easy to get to the heart of old town. Marta was very helpful with checking us in early and meeting. Very good for local suggestions and providing a brief description of the town. Thanks for having us Marta

The apartment is very good situated. Not far from the Metro Casa da Musica ( 12 minutes walk ) and to the old town 10/15 minutes. A big Shopping Mall also nearby (6/7 minutes ) with also the food market. You can sit, drink and eat small portions of all kind off kitchens.
We only spoke to Martha by Mail, the person who checked us in was very friendly. 
It was a pity that there is very much traffic  making it not so fun to sit on the balcony or to have the Windows open.

Nice and clean apartment but hot water was an issue.  This may be because Marta was out of the country while we were there.  Maybe there were instructions that we should have been provided but we had cold water 2 of the 3 days of our stay.

Clean, comfortable and well equipped apartment. Excellent windows block out most traffic noise during the day and Quiet at night for sleeping. Walking distance to the old city and the waterfront.
Loved staying here
Alojamento muito agradável, silencioso e bem localizado.

This apartment is located a walk away from all the action of downtown Porto in a residential area. Porto’s downtown area is small so you can be close to the action in no time. The apartment was clean, well kept and had everything we needed. The balcony was nice for the morning coffee with a view. AC’s worked great and can’t thank the host enough for the pointers and recommendations. We felt at home. The recommendation to go to the Yeatman Hotel for sunset drinks was awesome, hands down the best view in Porto.
