address.street: Vila Nova de Gaia, Porto, Portugal

reviews.comments: Olga's home was very welcoming, clean and simply beautiful. The room does not only have an en-suite, but a private balcony as well. We were staying with Olga for one night but would definitely stay longer if we had more time in Porto. Great place to stay at, lovely family, highly recommended!
Olga est une hôtesse très sympathique. Nous avons passé un bon séjour chez elle
Everything was really nice, beautiful room, and nice location

Great location and great host. We booked in on our Camino cycle from Lisbon to Santiago and Olga's place is 50m off the "way" and from the metro which takes a few minutes into town. The room is beautiful with an en suite and balcony. To be recommended.

La chambre et la salle de bains sont spacieuses,  confortables,  propres,  bref parfaites. Le lit est excellent. Vraiment à 2 pas du tram/metro qui vous emmène en 10' au centre de la ville. Assez facile de se garer. L'hôtesse,  Olga, vous parlera français comme vous et moi,  elle est absolument charmante, vous indiquera les bons coins et tout ce dont vous aurez besoin.  Une ville magnifique,  un logement parfait: une belle étape airbnb

Olga was a lovely host. The room is spacious, clean, comfortable and comes with private bathroom and balcony. The location is perfect; Metro is 1min away. 
We had a lot of fun playing with her cats too!
The room and the bathroom was very clean. I def recommend it :)

Quarto com óptima decoração, muito confortável, limpo e com ótima localização!Tem casa de banho privada o que é  muito bom e prático. Tinha aquecedor central e estava uma óptima temperatura  no quarto.tem também wi fi e TV  no quarto. Sítio a voltar

Olga's place is awesome! For a private room, rather than a full house, it is a great option because it has a private bathroom connected to the bedroom. It also has a cute little patio that we were able to enjoy. The wifi was fast and easy to connect to. Olga had many different resources available for us to use for sightseeing. The room was very cute and also clean! We loved it here! :D
Obrigado pela hospitalidade. Espaço muito limpo, reservado e calmo. Perfeito para quem quer realizar uma formação ou vir passar um fim de semana ao Porto. Voltarei certamente :)
Casa muito confortável, limpa, óptima para descansar, perto do metro, foi uma agradável experiência. Recomendo.
Muita simpatia, suuper limpo e suuuuuper cômodo! Muito obrigada pela experiência Olga 5 ⭐.
Confortável, limpo, bom para descansar, bem localizado. É a segunda vez que fico no espaço da Olga e gostei muito e recomendo. Grato achyuta

Olga is a great host, very fast in communication, great room with on suite bathroom, very comfortab
le bed and even a little balcony! great value!
Olga est une hôte  attentionnée et  très disponible . Le lieu est bien situé et le cadre de l’hébergement était tout à fait adapté à nos attentes . Je vous recommande sans hésitation !
Alojamento muito perto do metro , com comércio nas imediações. Quarto limpo , arejado , boa luminosidade e sossegado.

name: Spacious sunny suite, city center
summary: Spacious sunny suite with private bathroom, wide windows in a beautifully newly restored two-story house with view over the garden in a peaceful setting. We are two sisters who enjoy the art of hospitality and cooking healthy and exquisite meals.
space: Spacious sunny suite with private bathroom, wide windows in a beautifully newly restored two-story house with view over the garden in a calm and peaceful setting. We are two sisters who enjoy the art of hospitality and cooking healthy and exquisite meals. Our home, which we tend to wholeheartedly, has 4 large rooms and a common area with a living room, dinner hall, kitchen and a very sunny garden where you can enjoy your breakfast. We are located in the city center at a 15 minutes walking distance from the main historic touristic itineraries, in a very quiet neighborhood with parking area, several traditional Portuguese restaurants and supermarkets (13 minutes walk from the metro station of Polo Universitario and half minute walk from several bus stops).
description: Spacious sunny suite with private bathroom, wide windows in a beautifully newly restored two-story house with view over the garden in a peaceful setting. We are two sisters who enjoy the art of hospitality and cooking healthy and exquisite meals. Spacious sunny suite with private bathroom, wide windows in a beautifully newly restored two-story house with view over the garden in a calm and peaceful setting. We are two sisters who enjoy the art of hospitality and cooking healthy and exquisite meals. Our home, which we tend to wholeheartedly, has 4 large rooms and a common area with a living room, dinner hall, kitchen and a very sunny garden where you can enjoy your breakfast. We are located in the city center at a 15 minutes walking distance from the main historic touristic itineraries, in a very quiet neighborhood with parking area, several traditional Portuguese restaurants and supermarkets (13 minutes walk from the metro station of Polo Universitario and half minute walk from several
neighborhood_overview: Very peaceful neighbourhood close to a beautiful garden in the city center of Porto and at a walking distance from the main historic itineraries. You'll find plenty of restaurants and fine dinning places in our neighbourhood. There are 2 supermarkets at a 5 minutes walking distance from our house. Come and enjoy the real Porto, this is a very popular neighbourhood and it will give you a feel of how people live in this city!
transit: There are free parking areas around the house.  Polo Universitario is the closest metro station (13min walking). Buses in front of the house: 5 minutes to the historical center; 20 minutes to the beach (Foz)
access: We provide all bed linen and towels Living room with cable TV (with main international TV channels), comfortable couch, board games and small library Your own set of keys to the house and for your room (this ensures the safety of your belongings) Fully equipped kitchen.  Free wireless internet throughout the house Terrace - where you can enjoy your breakfast  Tips & advices - we are here to welcome you to Porto and help you discover it!
interaction: We'll be glad to welcome you upon your arrival and we'll be available to offer you advise and information about Porto. If you are around the house at dinner time we'll probably share a meal together! We're two sisters, so you'll probably always find one of us at home.
house_rules: Striclty non smoking (not even in the garden). Please make little noise after 10pm.  If you use the kitchen please keep it clean and wash the dishes after using.

host.host_about:
Hello, I'm Oriana from Portugal.
I love traveling and I'm also an Airbnb host!

reviews.comments: Oriana and her sister are the best hosts i ever had. They cared a lot if we needed something all the time. About the house, in my opinion, i felt very comfortable there, the room is as it is shown in the pictures with it private bathroom! Cosy house that i would strongly recommend to next travellers.

We spent a lovely time in Oriana's house. She and her sister was very listen to our needs and give us very good advices about visiting Porto and Portugal.
We take time to know each other around a cup of tea. It was very pleasant.
La maison d'oriana et de sa soeur est très accueillante tout comme les propriétaires et leur adorable chiot. Tout est raffiné et bien décoré. Plusieurs chambres sont dédiées au Rbnb .

thank you Oriana! it was good time in Porto... home is peaceful and comfortable in friendly neighborhood, room exactly expected: sunny, clean and nice arranged with private bathroom. Safety place for a car on street and half an hour walk to historical center. We can also used a good equipped kitchen and open for guests living room.

We spent a lovely stay in Oriana's home: our room and the house are very luminous and the furniture is beautiful, elegant and sober. The bedroom is totally faithfull to the photo and very pleasant.
The kitchen is well equipped and there is a very good bakery next to the house. The living room is also very nice.
Oriana is very thoughtful, discrete and speaks very well English.
She gave us nice suggestions to visit Porto.

Oriana was very kind to welcome us before the official change so we could leave our stuff at her place while waiting. Besides that she also gave us some quick tips about neighbourhood and the city - she was helpful with those anytime we had some questions.

Otherwise our room and bathroom were very clean and tidy and all the things described were provided and available. The neighbourhood is nice and calm and all things needed (coffee place/restaurant, bus and metro stations, stores) are in surroundings. In other words, if you are visiting Porto you should definitely consider staying at her place.

Nous avons été reçu par Oriana qui est très charmante,un peu de difficulté pour ce comprendre (nous ne parlons pas beaucoup l'anglais et pas du tout le portugais ,Oriana très peu le (Website hidden by Airbnb) chambre est très agréable,l'accès au centre de porto est très facile par le bus 600 ,il y a beaucoup de chose à voir
Yes, everything was ok

We had a nice stay in the house of Oriana. She is a good host and was  very kindly and If we needed some informations she was always very helpful. 

Thank you very much Oriana!

Orianas place is perfect for a stay in Porto. We were accomodated in an exceptionally clean environment and the room was exactly as described. The location is alright, 25 mins on foot to the old port.

Oriana is very kind and helped us a lot with restaurants and stuff like that.

We can only warmly  recommend this place and wish Oriana all the best for her future.

M&L

Wir waren 3 Nächte bei Oriana, um uns einen Eindruck von Porto zu verschaffen. Eine alles in allem gute Wahl. Nette Gastgeberin und cooles Haus in guter Lage. In der Nachbarschaft sind viele Geschäfte und mit dem Bus ist man schnell im historischen Center.

Nous avons eu un très bon accueil, son repas végétarien que nous avions réservé à notre arrivée était très bien et très copieux.
Nous ne regrettons pas d'avoir pris la chambre privée. C'est un endroit très calme. Très bon compromis par rapport au centre de Porto (ligne de bus, métro à proximité) mais nous avions pris l'option de faire de la marche durant ce week-end prolongé car les repas étaient très copieux.
Petit plus : Oriana se débrouille très bien en français.
Merci pour ce séjour. Ma petite fleur des îles se souviendra de ses 40 ans.

Oriana i jej rodzina, którą poznaliśmy, są bardzo gościnni i pomocni, z wielką przyjemnością spędziliśmy tam 7 nocy. Pokoje dokładnie takie, jak w ofercie, czyste i przyjemne. Okolica urocza, a ludzie wokół życzliwi. Również piękna pogoda pozwoliła nam spędzić wspaniały tydzień. A przy okazji poznaliśmy słodką Mel. Wierzcie mi - warto pojechać do Porto, to jedno z najpiękniejszych miast jakie zwiedziliśmy i przy tym relatywnie tanie.  A jakie porto - każdy rodzaj wart grzechu!

I had a lovely stay at Oriana’s home in Porto.  The room was bright, clean and quiet, in a recently renovated building so that you truly get the feel of old Porto along with the conveniences of modern living.  It is not far from the city center, yet has a bit more of a residential feel although there are shops, cafes and a supermarket in the immediate area along with the bus to downtown only two blocks away.   I was very pleased with the accommodation.

Everything about Oriana listing is 100% right on. We can also verify what others have said about her hosting are accurate. We would like to add that the architecture of the building is special as the ceilings are high and the stairways are majestic which adds to a special feeling for Oriana's home. She has created a oasis from the hustle and bustle of Puerto.

This is a beautiful house near Porto attractions. We visited Porto for New Year and it was pouring rain.
room was large and very clean, however a little cold/damp in the evenings. Great place to stay on our next visit!

We stayed at Orianna's place for two days, and it was a great experience! Our room was situated in the townhouse in the nice quiet part of Porto, close to the city centre and to all the places of interest and shops. 

Our room was on the 2nd floor, with a bathroom. It was very clean, with great bed. Window overlooked the courtyard. For the guests there is also a kitchen to cook and a dining room. 

So, we enjoyed our stay and highly recommend our host!
Muito boa a casa, tem charme. O quarto é bastante agradável também.

It was really a great choice to stay at Oriana's place while visiting Porto. Apartment is cosy and well equipped, we had enjoyed freshly made home breakfast, and felt atmosphere of the old Porto. Although Apartment is not located in historical center it was not too far, and as we had car there was no problem with parking nearby. We can definitely recommend staying at Oriana's place!

The house is authentic, clean, comfortable and you feel at home at Oriana's! The room is big and sunny, and you have access to your own bathroom, which is great. We couldn't meet Oriana, but our stay was great and we write each other just enough to feel fine in her house and in Porto. The townhouse was not in the city center, but some buses can take you there. The neighborhood is okay, but clearly not as beautiful as the center. 
A very nice place for a great price!
It was a pleasure to stay at Oriana's place.  The room is really comfortable and Oriana is a great host. She explained us everything we needed to know about the town.

Nos encantó la casa!! Nos quedamos en la sunny suite, grande y luminosa, muy agradable. Todo está muy limpio, tal y como sale en las fotos. El barrio es muy tranquilo, a unos 15-20 minutos andando del centro... 
Si vas en coche en la puerta de casa se puede aparcar muy bien y sin pagar.
Además Oriana es muy simpática. 
Sin duda Repetiríamos!!!
Muy recomendable.

Awesome, big and sunny house. We were treated as kings by Oriana.s mother while she was not there.
Well located and really easy to park if you travel with your own park.
100% recommended

Even though the weather was rainy we had awesome days in Oriana's house! Our suite was clean and very pretty and the people in the house were kind and lovely. The house is in half an hour walking-distance from the City Center, so we didn't need bus or taxi every day. We felt really comfortable and happy!

The house was beautiful, and really cosy.
It felt just like home.
Definitely will come back soon

Bonjour,
On a pas vu Oriana :-( notre chambre jumelée avec une seconde salle de bain il y avait beaucoup de bruits, le matelas n'est pas confortable, il y avait pas petit meuble pour déposé la trousse de toilette . Si non on à découvert un super restaurant juste en face. On reviendra !!!
Merci à Oriana pour notre séjour la maison est très belle et notre chambre avec sdb privée était très agréable, j'espère que nous aurons l'occasion de revenir sous le soleil!!!

Wir waren sehr zufrieden mit der Unterkunft von Oriana, die wir so vorgefunden haben wie abgebildet bzw. beschrieben. Sie hat uns herzlich begrüßt und uns alles im Haus erklärt. Genau gegenüber fanden wir einen Parkplatz für unser Mietauto und ebenfalls an der Ecke ein einfaches aber gutes Restaurant - zwei Ecken weiter eine sehr gute Pastelaria, die wir ausgiebig genutzt haben. Wir hätten in der Nähe einen Bus in die Innenstadt nehmen können, haben es aber vorgezogen, zu Fuß in die City zu gehen (ca. 30 min.). Wir können also den Aufenthalt bei Oriana gut weiterempfehlen.
Andrea und Bruno
Oriana was great host. The room was as good as on pictures. We highly recommended the place and would stay there again. :)

Oriana was very nice, she showed me around in the house when I arrived and I asked her a good few questions and she was very keen on helping me (: i can really really recommend to stay at her house. When I left we said goodbye and her mum was here too they were doing the garden and she cutted down one rose for me and said I should take care of myself (: very very lovely people (: thanks again Oriana (:

We had a great stay at Oriana's home. She is a great host and provided us with very clear instructions and everything we needed. The room was clean and neat and we had our own washroom. As it is a large older home, we had to make sure to be quiet during night hours. The house was close to a bus stop and it was easy to access the metro. I would recommend staying with Oriana in Porto! :)
Great accommodation! We enjoyed staying at this wonderful place. It's only 30 minutes walk from the city center. We highly recommend it!

We had a great time at Oriana's home. We were early on arriving, but she opened the doors to us anyway. She let us drop our luggage off and gave us some recommendations for lunch around the neighborhood. We came back to a beautiful and cozy room with a view of the garden. The room was very spacious, with a private bathroom and lots of wonderful natural light. Her home is about a twenty minute walk to the city center or a 5 minute Uber for only €3.65. There are also two bus lines that will take you as well. Oriana was very helpful, generous, and welcoming. We had a great time and we would definitely stay again!

Das Zimmer mit Bad hat alles was man sich wünscht. Es ist sehr schön eingerichtet. Leider hat nur meine Freundin Oriana persönlich kennen gelernt. 

Die Lage ist wie beschrieben sehr ruhig. Direkt gegenüber ist ein kleines Cafe, geführt von einem älteren sehr freundlichen Herren. Leider hat nur meine Freundin Oriana persönlich kennen gelernt. 

In der dritten Nacht gab es irgendwie einen ziemlichen Lärm im Haus. Ich weiß nicht warum, aber meine Freundin und ich sind um 2 Uhr Nachts aufgewacht und hatten erst das Gefühl, es sei jemand in das Haus eingebrochen. Ich habe in den Flur geschaut und nichts entdeckt. Weiß also nicht, was da los war. Insgesamt ist das Haus sehr hellhörig.

A lovely spaciously room in a beautifully restored home in  a quiet part of Porto. Public transport is close by. We never saw Oriana or anyone else in the house but she left the keys for us to collect which was no problem.

Tout d'abord Oriana est accueillante. Tres belle chambre avec salle de bain privative.maison calme et reposante .Le petit plus , allez prendre votre petit déjeuner au café d'en face ,la patronne est souriante et parle très bien l'anglais
A really fantastic room and a caring host. Very helpful with directions to and from the b&b, as well as to the uni I studied at. The room was light, airy and very comfortable. Thank you again!

Nous avons passé un très bon séjour! La chambre et la salle de bain sont très propres, calmes, avec vue sur le jardin. La maison est à environ 30min de marche du centre mais ce n'est pas gênant, nous avons tout fait à pied, le trajet est agréable. Nous recommandons vivement !

Mi novio y yo nos quedamos dos días en casa de Oriana. La experiencia fue excelente. La casa es tal como se ve en las fotos. Nos quedamos en el sunny room. Todo muy limpio, con baño propio y muy ordenado! Hemos disfrutado mucho quedarnos acá. Muchas gracias por recibirnos! Totalmente recomendable
Das stilvoll eingerichtete Haus ,der kleine Garten und das helle ,komfortable Zimmer haben mir gut gefallen.  Auch die Begegnung mit anderen Reisenden in der Küche und im Esszimmer.

Oriana was a friendly host. The place is really nice and close to the center.
TIP: uber is cheaper than public transportation for reach the center or come back home late.
My wife and I stayed with Oriana for 3 nights. We both adored her and loved our stay. The house had a great atmosphere and our room was fantastic!

Great host, she was very helpful all the time.
Highly recomended

Oriana war sehr gastfreundlich und hilfsbereit. Sie wohnt in einem sehr schönen Haus und das Zimmer mit Bad war geräumig und sauber. Mit dem Bus, der sehr regelmässig fährt hat man etwa 10 Minuten in die Altstadt und die Fahrt kostet 1.20. Wir waren sehr zufrieden mit dem Aufenthalt

Oriana gave us a lovely warm welcome.
The room was spacious as described, clean & tidy.
Although a bit away from the river & city centre, the location for us was ideal. It gave us the ideal starting point for a walking tour of Porto, with friendly café's en route.
We would happily return, not just to Porto, but to Oriana's home.
The host was friendly and replied to my question quickly and the place was easy access to the city center. It was comfy and convenient.

A Oriana é um excelente anfitriã, discreta e calma, dando espaço para nos sentirmos em casa, num ambiente  tranquilo e sossegado. A casa, antiga e carismática, é acolhedora e tem muita luz. Os espaços, sala, quarto, cozinha e wc's têm o essêncial, são limpos e arejados. O bairro é sossegado, com boa vizinhança, tem por perto todo o tipo de lojas, lavandaria, restaurantes, cafés, etc. Fica perto do centro da cidade, o que permite deslocarmo-nos em visita sem grandes distâncias.

Thank you, Oriana, for this wonderful and comfortable stay at your beautiful house, I enjoyed it very much and would come back anytime. Oriana is a very friendly woman; I loved the peaceful house and that the rooms view is the houses' garden :).
The house was beautiful and the host was very helpful. She was gone the weekend we stayed but made sure to check in with us to make sure our time there went well.

We stayed 2 nights at Oriana's guest house and had a fantastic time in Porto. Oriana was very lovely, friendly and helpful...even checking us in at midnight which we were very appreciate of. We stayed in the room with its own ensuite bathroom rather than one of the other ones with the shared bathroom which had other guests, and the room itself was lovely and spacious, the bed comfortable, and it had a nice view out over the (Website hidden by Airbnb) was quite cold at night though, although Oriana did supply lots of extra blankets. Overall a very good experience and a lovely host.
Oriana was a great host. We had everythng we needed and only had to ask if we needed anything else. Lots of light in the room and the heater worked well plus great hot shower. Thanks for everything
Beautiful house and clean, Oriana is a friendly and helpful host.
We left two days in advance of our scheduled booking

We have traveled in Portugal and Spain for two weeks. And the most pleasant memories we have about Porto. And partly from the place where we have stayed, in the house of Orianna. It was very cozy, nice and comfortable. The house is ancient, but it was even more atmospheric and more interesting to be in it. As for convenience, the room is spacious and bright, the bed is large and comfortable, the bathroom room is clean and pleasant. In general, everything was super. The owner herself is a very interesting girl, pleasant in communication and always ready to help and suggest any trifle. We highly recommend this house for your stay in Porto.

Oriana è stata molto accogliente e disponibile. La casa è molto bella, luminosa, pulita e accogliente. Dista 30 minuti a piedi dal centro (Ribeira) e 20 min a piedi dalla metro. Alla sera ho spesso usufruito del taxi per tornare a casa (dal centro) al costo di 5-6 euro. Consiglio assolutamente il posto!

We enjoyed our stay at oriana!
There was a good connection to the city centre by bus, on walking distance as well. We only stayed two nights but we might come back for more. Thanks!

I had a great stay in Oriana's house. My room was really comfortable and had a view of the gardens. The neighborhood is very local but also walking distance from the city centre. I would definitely stay here again!

Het verblijf licht heel goed voor bezoek aan de stad. Met ongeveer 25 minuten lopen ben je in het centrum. Je bent echter ver genoeg uit het centrum om toch nog je auto te kunnen parkeren.
Het huis is een oud pand met sfeer en goed genoeg opgeknapt om plezierig te zijn. 
We vonden het bed nogal hard en smal. Bovendien kraakte het. Verder is de kamer licht en prettig ruim.
Oriana's place was lovely as was she, would thoroughly recommend!

Es una hermosa casa antigua, cuarto con baño privado, ubicado a 2 min de la parada de camión o 20 min caminando del centro de la ciudad. Oriana fue muy amable, nos recomendó varios restaurantes muy buenos y nos oriento acerca de como movernos en la ciudad. :)
La habitacion esta muy bien, amplia, luminosa y perfecta para descansar, Ornella es muy amable y es facil comunicar con ella, seguramente regresaria.

Oriana was a great host! 
The room was perfectly cleaned and bright. We stayed 3 days in Porto, we could walk in 25min to the city center! I highly recommend it!

Estuve el fin de semana con mi madre y todo estupendamente. La habitación estaba muy limpia, organizada, muy bien cuidado todo. 
Oriana muy atenta, en cuanto pudo fue a preguntar si nos hacía falta algo, si estábamos cómodas. Muy atenta! 
En cuanto a la ubicación, está a unos 15—20 mim andando del centro. Muy contenta.
Oriana is a great host. I would toota
Charming old house with all modern conviniencies. Perfect place for stay !

la casa di Oriana è molto bella, 
la stanza in cui abbiamo dormito (quella col bagno privato) è silenziosa, spaziosa e luminosa
Oriana mette a disposizione la cucina e la sala da pranzo ai suoi ospiti, è poco presente in casa, ma è molto disponibile ad aiutare anche tramite mail nel sito di airbnb (risponde quasi subito).
la casa si trova a circa 2 km dal centro di Porto al quale è collegato da 2 linee di bus, la stazione di metro più vicina è a circa 500 mt, ma andare e tornare dal centro a piedi è una camminata piacevole.
Il quartiere è tranquillo e cis ono negozin di tutti i tipi e anche ristoranti tipici
Albergue próximo a Universidade Fernando Pessoa. Metro mais próximo fica 15-20 minutos de caminhada, na estação Marquês. Supermercado, cafeterias e restaurantes perto.

Nuestra estancia en casa de Oriana  fue genial, la casa es preciosa y muy limpia, la habitación era muy cómoda y con unas vistas muy bonitas. Está a pie a unos  20 minutos del centro turístico  de Oporto. 
Se puede aparcar fácilmente por la zona. 
Encantados con este Airbnb y con Oriana.

Estuvimos en un espacio lleno de encanto, limpio y en un barrio tranquilo en el que se puede comer más barato que en el centro, estando a 4/5 minutos del centro en autobus ( dependiendo del conductor del autobus). Oriana fue muy amable y nos aconsejo que ver y donde comer en Porto. 

Aconsejamos a todo el que quiera ver Porto que este en esta casa con tanto encanto!!
Una estancia muy agradable y Oriana ha sido una gran anfitriona

Oriana is a kind host, respects your privacy and provides useful information about the city. The house is very characteristic, quite old but comfortable. From the house it's easy to reach the historical center with the public transport.
A very fine house a good walk from the centre. Very good value for money.
Oriana's studio was lovely and as pictured. She was very kind and offered some great suggestions on where to eat. We would stay there again!

Oriana was very friendly and more than happy to answer me any questions or to help me with anything. The room was great and the house really lovely. I had a great time in Porto and would stay at Oriana's place again any time!!!

We had a wonderful stay at Oriana's apartment. The room is situated in a beautiful old building with a spaceous living room and a fully equipped kitchen. Our private bathroom was clean. Oriana's recommendations turned out to be amazing: we had the best dinner night at restaurant LSD in the city center, definitely go there if you have the time! Oriana herself is a very kind and loving host who made sure we felt at home anytime. Possibly the nicest host we've ever had. Only feedback we could think of is that it took us 30min to reach the city centre by foot instead of 20min, but it's a nice walk (and public transportation/taxi's are cheap) so that wasn't really a problem for us. All in all we had an amazing time and would definitely come back.

Belle maison rouge!!Fonctionnelle!Nous avons déjeuné tous les matins juste en face de chez Oriana pour3€!!Pain beurre muffins et 2grands café! Et pour les fins de soirées notre cantine,juste en face,sur l autre trottoire ,une brasserie  ou goûté  les plats typiques a moindre coût! Le patron parle un peu (Website hidden by Airbnb) aussi très bon accueil! !

Everything was great, very clean and atmospheric house. 
Oriana was able to meet and settle us at night, detailed about the city and the surrounding area, advised some places to visit.
Very pleased with the availability of drinking water in the room.
Oriana is kind, friendly and helpful and the room is beautiful. For sure come next time I'm in Porto.
A casa da Oriana é  precisamente como nas fotos, espaçosa, limpa e muito bonita. Oriana é  uma pessoa muito gentil, atende rapidamente quando a procuramos.
Oriana's home is beautiful and unique. I believe if you are looking for an authentic experience in Porto this is the place.
The house is stylish and clean.  The kitchen is a little bit small but enough for making breakfast or a snack. Oriana is nice and gave us good advices for restaurants.

Oriana's place is as described.  Spacious, bright, and close to the city center about 10 minutes ride by the city bus few blocks from the place.  Oriana was very pleasant and easy to communicate with.   If you return to Porto, Portugal we will definitely consider staying with Oriana.

Location in friendly neighborhood. Lots of small restaurants and bakeries. Bus stop close to location and straight to city center. 25 min walking distance from old town. Room was big and sunny with a private bathroom and totally meet our expectations. Oriana welcomed us at the arrival and gave us some good tips on what to see and where to eat. We can recommend this owner.
Always wanted to stay in an old place in a city.  This was the perfect place for that. It was easy to get around.  Oriana gave us good dining tips
Very beautiful house, with large rooms! Busstops to the city center at 1 min walking distance. Orianna was also very friendly!
Oriana ist eine liebe Gastgeberin und ihr Haus ist schön und gemütlich.
oriana's room is as true as described: sunny And spacious.location is also good.oriana's respose is alwsys in time And precise. very high performance cost ratio!

Oriana is a really nice person and always trying to help where she can. Unfortunately we only met once for a short moment. But I could reach her easily via airbnb and mobile. Check in worked perfectly out as her friend was waiting for us at night. 

The place is a really nice old house in a pretty quiet neighbourhood, north of the city center. You can walk there in round about 45 minutes or take the public transport. Option 1: bus to trinidade and then metro. Option 2: go directly by metro. Bus is ca. 2-3 min. from the house, metro ca. 15 min. Closeby are some supermarkets as well as a restaurant over the street. But you can aso use the kitchen, living and dining room what we did a few times for breakfast. 

The room we booked (suite) comes with a double bed, closet, commode, chair and its own bathroom. The room and bathroom themselves are relatively big. As the furniture is pretty old I didn´t like the smell and beside that the drawers had been dirty, so for me it was definitely too less space to put my stuff somewhere else - same in the bathroom. The door to the bathroom is hard to close/open which starts to get on the nerves anywhen. If you turn on the light a really noisy deduction starts working. 
I was traveling with my brother - so the bed was toooo small for the 2 of us. No idea which size it had - maybe 1.20m? Additionally the mattress is really uncomfortable, you can already feel the springs, and the bed makes a noise always when you are moving. I am sorry to say but I can´t recommend staying in that room (which is BTW the most expensive one of all 3 rooms Oriana offers).

After 3 nights we had the option to move in another room with 2 seperate beds (which is 5€ cheaper a night). The switch was the best decision ever as we had the first night we slept well over there. The  room has enough space for 2 people and also enough options to store your stuff somewhere. The only difference - it has no own bathroom and there is only a tiny window to let some light inside. As is it closer to the street also a bit louder if you prefer sleeping with an opened window.

In total I would not come back to Orianas house. For me it is too far away from the city center. Then I would prefer paying a bit more instead of loosing time in moving up and down and paying for public transport. I am also a bit disappointed about the room we first booked and also that Oriana didn´t offer to pay back some money after room changing (as the one was cheaper).

Oriana's place was very stylish and she was very nice to let me check in earlier than her normal check in time. The place is accurately described and amenities all worked fine. I was just disappointed by how cold the place was without central heating. Oriana did give me heating for my room but I could only be comfortable with many many layers during the the night time. I would say if you're visiting Porto in the winter time, definitely bring extra layers. Overall staying at Oriana's place was definitely an accurate way to experience life in Porto as a typical Portuguese and the place is very central to everything.

I stayed at Oriana's place for three nights. 
Basically the location is good you can either take bus (only 2mins walk to bus stop) or walk down to the old town in 20mins. The room is exactly as the photo shown, clean and spacious. 

Oriana is a lovely lady who provide me a good restaurant list, transportation information. I really had a great time in Porto, of course her place is definitely recommended! Thank you again, Oriana!

Oriana é super acessivel e flexível. Facilitou o checkin pois chegamos tarde e ela deixou tudo preparado para nos acomodar. A casa é super confortável localizada em  um local muito tranquilo. Levei 7 min de carro até a ponte Luiz I, restaurante e cafe a 100 mts da casa..

Would not stay there again. Hostel atmosphere instead of an AirBnB.
Very cold all the time.  Heating plak on the wall was sitting on the floor and giving minimal heat.  Had to sleep with clothes on. Furniture in the room was in poor condition and seems like it came from Goodwill.
Oriana was very nice, but not too helpful.  Location was pretty good with a short bus ride to historic center.

Oriana is awesome and her place is really cute, squeaky clean and located in a quiet neighborhood not far from the tourist spots in Porto.

That is the short and sweet version of the review.

And to expand a little more: 

She was really good at checking us in, showing the place and being super nice to list us a good variety of good restaurants to go. My wife and I are vegan, which tends to narrows down the restaurant options even more, haha, but that was not a problem at all. *(small review of a really good restaurant close to her place at the bottom of this review). 

Her place is a pretty cool but we didn't explore the amenities that much because we were out and about all the time during our stay. The room is super clean; the bed is really comfy (not extremely soft, which me and my wife like). Clean private bathroom with hot shower. 

Her place is great and Porto is beautiful. 

Enjoy your trip!
___________________________________
*Restaurante Rito  
Delicious food, super friendly staff and not expensive at all. It's a restaurant that locals go that serves more the traditional-like Portuguese plates (read: a lot of meat and seafood options) but Oriana herself suggested us to "Just go there and tell them that you are vegans. They might put something together for you that is not on the menu.", and sure enough, the chef came to our table and asked what we liked and he put together a delicious plate for us with the ingredients he had available that night. 
Pretty awesome experience.

Oriana is very nice and friendly. She answers quickly and you can contact her at any time. 
The room is a bit cold in winter but very lovely furnitured. Everything is clean and you feel like home.
Nice place to stay

Oriana was a very welcoming host and so we enjoyed our stay in her beautiful restored house! It´s not too far from the city centre, there a lots of shops around, the Location is great :) Highly recommendable!

Oriana is a lovely host who welcomed us to her home and city, providing some great tips for where to eat and drink in Porto. She made certain we were comfortable - and warm - in her beautiful home, which is within a short walk of Porto’s old town.
It was a pleasure to stay at Oriana's house. Very neat and spatious room in a nice old but well refurbished house. Pleasant and stylish.

Oriana's place is a big house in a nice and quiet neighborhood. Historical city center is close with bus, just near the house. The kitchen is good, all you need to cook. We were there in winter so yes, the house was cold, but in the room it was ok with the heaters. The bathroom was clean. It can be a little bit noisy into the house (kitchen, step on floor)  but the guest were nice and gently. We saw Oriana once, at our arrival and she was very nice. Very reactive when the gaz was out ! Porto is a great city, so enjoy !

Camera molto luminosa, accogliente e pulita.
Il letto è caldo e comodissimo.
Molto bello il pavimento in legno, così come il mobilio.
Il bagno è piccolo, ma fa sufficiente alle sue funzioni.
(Come spesso all'estero, non c'è il bidet, ma ci si arrangia...)
Anche la casa è accogliente e graziosa.
La fermata dell'autobus è a nemmeno 5 minuti ed è comoda per il centro.
Centro che si può raggiungere anche a piedi, ma in una cinquantina di minuti.
Oriana è un'ospite perfetta: gentilissima, disponibile ad aiutare, cortese e veloce nelle risposte. Tiene molto ai suoi ospiti.

Adorei ter tido a minha primeira experiência no airbnb na casa de Oriana. Ela foi muito atenciosa e prestativa. O local é de fácil acesso e tem comercio perto, isso ajuda muito. A única coisa que poderia melhorar é o aquecimento do quarto, achei fraco as placas de aquecimento. Passamos um pouco de frio no quarto.
Very accommodating host and beautiful location. Her local recommendations really helped make our trip

Oriana is very nice and the house is very clean / comfortable to live in. The only disadvantage I would say is the location, about 25min on foot to the city center. Compared its price, I recommend Oriana' place. She is very responsive to every question about the house and about the city.
Oriana is a very helpful and nice host. Her home is beautiful and clean. We spent a great time there. We highly recommend it! :)

O local é simples mas muito bom, ônibus para o centro com facilidade, é possível caminhar também até a Ribeira em  20 minutos. Perto de  padarias e supermercados. Oriana nos recomendou restaurantes do bairro, e outros um pouco mais distantes, com comida muito boa e bons preços. Gostamos, voltaríamos a nos hospedar com a Oriana.
Our stay in Oriana's flat was perfect! It's very lovely and very spacious, I deeply recommend it!

We had a very good time and great experience in Oriana's place.
The house is really nice and good location for the ones with or without car.
She is really friendly and helpful with recommendations. We recommend her place anytime.

Très bon séjour à Porto. Oriana est une hôte très sympathique. Malheureusement nous étions en "collocation" avec d'autres couples et nous n'avons pas passés une seule nuit tranquille. Beaucoup de bruit, leur salle de bain touchait notre chambre (douche à minuit pour certains), les portes claquaient à 00h comme à 2h du matin. En bref ce n'était pas très paisible. Malgré ça la maison est sympa. Merci à Oriana pour son accueil.

It was great to stay Oriana’s place:) before I arrive, she is very helpful, very quick response how to get the house. 
Also I did mistake for booking date, but she is very helpful and so kind. 

Oriana kindly gave me extra contact for just in case for check in. When  i arrived the house, her friend Maria helped me. She is also really helpful and kind too:)! She bring me near neighborhood food place, and helped me order food. also gave me many advice of Porto with map. 

Location is pretty safety area, 30min work to the downtown, 15min by bus. 
From airport 15min by drive and vey close. 

Thanks for everything! :)
Aya

Agréable séjour sur Porto. Oriana nous a bien reçu et expliqué les lieux à visiter ainsi que les restaurants à faire dans un anglais très compréhensible. La maison est propre et typique. Petit bémol sur la literie... Mais je recommande : bus 600 à 5 minutes à pied, pour aller dans le centre et en face de la maison, il y a un restaurant, pratique pour le petit déjeuner du matin pour 3 euros. Bon voyage.

예쁜 사진과 싼 가격에 3박 숙박을 하였는데 지금까지 체험한 곳 중 가장 최악이었어요

결론은 싼게 비지떡 이었습니다
꼭 참고하세요~

The welcome of Oriana is really great, she give us good tips to visitig the city and good address for eat and drink.
The house is really nice and full of history.
A la prochaine.
Orianas place is great. Very well located. We enjoyed staying there. Good and quit neighborhood, cozy apartment. Highly recommended.
Good stay!
Los detalles de la casa

My wife and me were in Oriana's department, we really liked it, great to have private bathroom, Oriana was very kind and helpful, I loved the Francesinha in the Cafe de Santiago she recommended us, she was always aware to help us, her place is not to far from the city town (25-30 mins by foot), however the buses in oporto are too delayed, so we recommend to use Uber or taxy, it's very cheap........ Estuve con mi esposa en el apartamento de Oriana y de verdad que nos gustó, excelente haber tenido baño privado, Oriana nos ayudó y orientó muy bien, me encantó una Francesinha que nos recomendó comer en el café de Santiago, no está muy lejos del centro histórico (25-30 minutos a pié) sin embargo los buses en oporto son bastante demorados, así que si vas muy tarde lo mejor es que tomes un taxi o Uber, en oporto son muy económicos...  Obrigado Oriana :)

It was a delight to meet Oriana and to stay in her homey, clean, and charming home. She was very accommodating and responsive from the beginning, letting us check in early and giving us some amazing restaurant suggestions! The room was just as expected, comfortable, filled with sunlight and squeaky clean. Although we did not spend much time in the home, the public areas (living room and outdoor garden/yard) are simply great places to relax, drink tea or read a book. We thoroughly enjoyed our few days in Porto and Oriana's place made it feel like home away from home! Would definitely recommend to others.

Accueil très chaleureux de Oriana qui nous a mis tout de suite à l'aise avec des explications et des conseils clairs et précis. Notre chambre lumineuse donnait sur un jardin privé, donc pas de bruit de la rue. Comme annoncé par Oriana, trouver une place de stationnement pour notre voiture n'a pas été un problème. Nous avons beaucoup apprécié notre séjour à Porto. Nous recommandons cette adresse.
Nettes altes Haus, liegt ca. 3km von der City Porto entfernt. Keine Metro direkt da, aber Busse möglich.

L’alloggio di Oriana è molto bello, all’interno di uno stabile storico con dettagli vintage. Gli spazi sono grandi e puliti. La distanza dal centro è percorribile anche a piedi (2km) oppure basta usare autobus con fermata a 300m.     Host disponibile e gentile. 
Consigliato.

Oriana nous à accueilli avec  beaucoup de simplicité et d'efficacité dans sa maison ancienne pleine d'authenticité, très propre et bien située. La chambre située cote jardin est très calme. Nous avons visité la ville à pied en partant de la maison.

Oriana has a beautiful home, big room with a private bathroom.A big plus is a free parking in the streets around which was very important for us.easy 20 minutes walk to city center. She gave us some tips, what to see or where to eat, very pleasent girl.We recommend this place if you are visiting Porto.
Accueil de qualité, superbe maison, un peu loins à pied du centre mais quand on aime la marche c est parfait pour visiter la ville et il y a des bus juste à côté.

I think this is one of the nicest Airbnbs I have ever stayed at -- the house is just so lovely (and beautifully decorated!) and Oriana was a great host. I was somewhat sick while staying at this place, so I was so happy to be in a nice, bright, comfortable room while recovering! Oriana was very sweet and caring as well. Next time I am in Porto I'd love to book this place again!

L’appartement de Oriana est très bien situé dans Porto, à environ 20 min à pied du centre ville. Nous avions notre salle de bain privée et la cuisine était partagée. La maison rouge a le charme de l’ancien, c’est top ! Oriana a été une hôte parfaite : communication, réactivité et hospitalité, rien à dire ! Vous pouvez y aller les yeux fermés :)
Lovely space and gracious host!
was a lovely stay in a lovely house a little outside the touristic city center
Oriana is super kind and a great host. We had a wonderful time staying at the apartment. Everything was perfect :)
We had a good time in Porto and the room in Orianas house was beautiful and quiet. In 20 minutes you can walk to the „Oldtown“ or you take the Bus!

Oriana is a really good host. She and her boyfriend gave us many useful tips while we were staying in Porto. Her house is really beautiful. Our room was spacious, light and with private bathroom, which was definitely an advantage. I recommend staying at Oriana’s house!

We had a great stay at Oriana’s place. Although the apartment is a bit of a walk (around 25 mins) to the city centre it was great value for the very reasonable price we paid. Was great to have an ensuite and Oriana was great at answering any questions throughout the trip. Maria who checked us in was also very helpful offering lots of tips on where to go.
beautiful house, nice and clean. we found everything we needed in the kitchen. nice cafe at the other side of the street. 30 min walk to touristic parts of the city. we'd come again.

Oriana é muito atenciosa com seus hóspedes. Nos orientou onde comer, como pegar transportes e por onde andar. A casa é um pouco afastada do centro, mas como em Porto tudo fica perto e as caminhadas são muito agradáveis, é possível fazer andando. Recomenda-se comer uma francesinha no Cenáculo, restaurante na redondeza do apartamento onde os garçons são ótimos e a comida é uma delicia. Nossa estadia em Porto foi bastante agradável e recomendaríamos.

Oriana foi muito rápida e atenciosa em todos os detalhes, minha avaliação não tão alta ficou por conta de que eu esperava um pouco mais de conforto com relação à cama, chuveiro e ao que a foto aparenta ser. No mais, nota 10.
Oriana is very nice host. Her house was very cozy and stylish.
Orianas house is very clean,very well decorated,bright and airy. We had a wonderful stay there,thanking Oriana for her help and generosity in sharing her house with us.Highly recommended.

We stayed at Oriana for 2 nights. She was very kind to meet us in the evening and explained everything (it’s our first time at Portugal). Apartment itself has nice charm with all Indian details. Though building is old and you can feel this in rooms (you can hear everything from another toilet over the wall). Bed is comfortable, room is full of natural light. Location is more or less good, you can get by feet to the center in 30 mins. 

Thank you for your hospitality !
Beautiful house, great atmosphere and amenities. Quite a walk to the water front/Gaia but we loved it any way :)

Everything was great. Oriana was responsive, helped with finding places and objects. We liked the place of landing. Everywhere we wanted to go was easily accessible by public transport. The old town can also be reached by walking. This is one of the places where we will come back next Year.
Très bien. Je recommande chez Oriana. Très disponible, sympa et arrangeante. Appart très propre et paisible.
A delightful apartment in a quiet street. Good public transport links into the central city. Good amenities and a nice cozy environment. Oriana is an excellent host.
Oriana’s place is super nice, I really enjoyed during my stay at her house! She was  really nice and gave me lots of tips when she welcomed me. Absolutely recommended!
une belle maison et une hôtesse discrète et accueillante

Very fast communication, precious suggestions on what to eat and where to go, detailed answers by Oriana that made our stay smooth. Very nice, old house with a nice vibe. Located 25min walk from city centre, local and cheap restaurants around. Quiet, calm and intimate place.

Casa antigua y acogedora. Habitación àmplia con baño privado completo. Espacios comunes acogedores y amplios.
A 20-30min andando del centro de Porto. Buena comunicación con transporte público.
Muy cerca de la casa hay supermercado, farmàcia y cafeterías donde poder desayunar muy bien!
Oriana es muy atenta y hospitalària.
Oriana was very friendly and gave us some tips what to visit and where to eat. The place is stylish, it also has a very cute and green garden. Absolutely recommend!
Oriana's house is very nice and clean. She's a great host and gave us some useful tips about Porto. The apartment is located about 20 mins walk from historic center. We enjoyed our stay!
Eu gostei muito do quarto, Oriana e uma pessoa muito atenciosa que sempre tentou ajudar. Indicarei para todos os meus amigos e familiares.
La casa está a media hora andando más bien

Oriana è una ragazza dolcissima e molto ospitale. 
La stanza è ben pulita e fornita di tutto ciò che serve per un soggiorno di qualche giorno a Porto. 
La stanza dista 20’ a piedi dalla metro (Lapa), mentre 20’/30’ a piedi circa dal centro. 
Visitare la città a piedi è stata una mia scelta, è comunque possibile usufruire della comodità del bus. 
Consigliato!

host.host_about:
Somos um casal de brasileiros que adotou o Porto como nova morada. Desde o Brasil, sempre gostamos de receber, e a experiência de ter hóspedes em nossa nova casa em Portugal tem sido gratificante e enriquecedora. 
Adoramos viajar, portanto compartilhar histórias e ouvir as dos nossos hóspedes é maravilhoso. Seja bem-vindo!

We are a couple of Brazilians who have adopted Porto as our new home. Since we lived in Brazil, we always like to receive, and the experience of having guests in our new house in Portugal has been gratifying and enriching.
We love traveling, so sharing stories and listening to our guests is wonderful. Welcome!

name: HomeShortStay - Trofa Apartment
summary: Located in Trofa center, this apartment features a balcony with views of the city and is 19 mi from Porto. Free WiFi is provided throughout the property. This apartment features a double room and a single room. The west facing living room has a flat-screen TV and a dining area, as well as a sofa bed. The kitchen has a microwave, a toaster and a fridge. Towels and bed linen are featured in this self-catering accommodations. There is a private bathroom with a shower.

space: O acesso dos hóspedes ao quarto é directo do exterior através de um pátio ajardinado.
description: O "Quarto das Laranjeiras" fica na Foz Velha, a 100 mts do jardim do Passeio Alegre entre a foz do rio Douro e as praias no Atlântico. O centro da cidade está a 30 mnts em transportes públicos. O acesso dos hóspedes ao quarto é directo do exterior através de um pátio ajardinado. Durante a estadia a porta que liga o quarto à casa fica fechada pelos dois lados, do quarto pelos hóspedes e da casa por nós. Duas bicicletas poderão ser cedidas durante a estadia por 10€/dia (x2).

address.government_area: Aldoar, Foz do Douro e Nevogilde

reviews.comments: Isabel and Carlos are really nice and communicative people and there place is lovely. The place is located in one of my favorite areas of Porto. Right near the beach and only minutes away from the main tourist area in the city. The room is like the pictures with a nice private bathroom, two persons bed fish tank and desk. The glass door to the garden is your private entrance to your room which is very useful. I'd loved also the tea and cookies Isabel left for me. Overall a really nice experience.

La experiencia ha sido positiva. Tanto Carlos como Isabel fueron muy amables en todo momento. La habitación cumple con las expectativas y es como aparece publicada. Está situada en la parte baja y es independiente del resto de la casa. Dispone de privacidad total. La entrada/salida es por el ventanal. El lugar y el conjunto de la casa es muy tranquilo y relajante. Lugar pefecto para un buen descanso.
Todo estaba muy limpio y  ordenado. La cama en su conjunto era muy cómoda,  el baño pequeño pero suficiente. Estuvimos un fin de semana y para esas dos noches, nos dejaron 6 toallas, champú, gel de ducha y gel de manos y de buena calidad. Disponen de secador de pelo.  Asimismo, nos dejaron en una bandejita, diferentes tipos de tés, unas pastas muy ricas, azucar y un kettel para calentar el agua. Si váis cuando hace frío, dispone de calefación.

Die Unterkunft ist wie beschrieben, es ist alles vorhanden was man brauch. Sogar ein Wasserkocher, Tee und Gebäck stehen bereit. carlos haben wir nicht kennengelernt aber Isabel hat uns sehr warmherzig empfangen. Es war toll.

Nettes, kleines Zimmer mit Bad.
Bequemes Bett und top Lage.
Carlos haben wir leider nicht kennengelernt, da wir sehr viel unterwegs waren, aber konnten seine sehr liebe Frau kennenlernen.
Fazit: Toller Aufenthalt in einer tollen Stadt
Carlos and Isabell were very warm, helpful and kind people. They made is feel very welcome and help whereever they could. We would come back any Time.

Great place! The room has everything you need, it is clear and cosy. The location is perfect - very good access both to the city center and to the beach. Lots of nice spots with good food, coffee and drinks. Hosts are very nice and helpful. We strongly recommend!

I've had a very good time in Porto, staying with Carlos and Isabel. Such nice people! The room was just right, very clean and very comfortable. And there was a dubble entrence whitch made me feel save. It is close to te river and close to the sea. Carlos and Isabel helped me find my way around and gave me a city map. Very little tourists, what I liked very much. I would stay with Isabel and Carlos again when I return to Porto!

The room is quiet with a pleasant aspect over an interior courtyard.  Close to restaurants and shops but secluded and peaceful. It is near the sea in the old town. Parking is nearby on the seafront.  The room is small but comfortable.
A gente adorou nossa estadia no Porto! Fomos muito bem recebidos e recomendamos para tudo mundo. Obrigada!!!

Isabel and Carlos are very interesting and polite people. It was really pleasant to communicate with them! The room is beautiful: cozy, clean and chill. It is 3 minutes from the ocean and also has a separate entrance, which is so conveniently. We have really enjoyed staying at this place - next our stop in Porto definitely will be in this apartment! Thank you again!
Acolhimento simpático e prestável!

Carlos and Isabel were excellent hosts. The room was very nice and clean.  They are very close to the beach and just a short bus trip away from the city centre.  They went out of their way to invite me to dinner which was such a treat.  If you are travelling to Porto I would highly recommend that you stay with Carlos and Isabel.

We really enjoyed our stay at Carlos & Isabel's Room. It is a small but charming Room which has everything you need during a short City trip. You walk ~100m to a busstation where you for example can easily get connected directly to the City Center in about 10-15 Minutes. 
Carlos & Isabel are very friendly and fantastic hosts. Just feel free to ask them whatever you want.
숙소에서 걸어서 바다까지 2분이면 갑니다. 조금 외진 곳에 있지만 500번 버스타면 다 20분 내로 도착합니다. 방은 작지만 안락하고 있을건 다 있습니다. 호스트 부부 분들도 매우 친절하십니다. 조용하고 차분한 곳이라 혼자서 여유롭게 지내기 좋습니다. 와이파이가 조금 느리고, 빨래할 곳이 없습니다. 미리 알아두고 가세요.

Just some little problems with the bathroom: water comes down from the wc and in the shower go down slowly, and didn't told before. Twice it was difficult to comunicate with host. But they are very relaxed person, the room is nice, clean and comfortable. Very close to the Foz of Douro. Bus is closed and with  a taxi is 6 euros to the centre

Great room with private entrance to inside garden. Beautiful neighbourhood close to the sea and nice bars and restaurants at the promenade. If I come back I would definitely stay at the friendly warm and welcoming place of Carlos and Isabel!

Isabel was very nice. She helped us in every need and made our stay very comfortable. The room is adorable and was perfect for our needs. The bathroom was tiny but that was no problem. It was clean and everything worked.
We can really recommend a stay there.
It's the best spot with the park and water near. And you can easily take a bus or Uber to the center. Really nice holiday vibes!

Nous avons été très bien reçu. Chambre propre et calme. Place de parking gratuite aux alentours. Il est nécessaire de prendre le bus ou le tramway pour rejoindre le coeur de porto.
Très bon séjour dans ce logement.
Prachtige locatie, binnen 1 minuut ben je bij de zee. De kamer is perfect, schoon en alles wat je nodig hebt. In de buurt een paar heerlijke eettentjes. Isabel was erg lief en makkelijk te bereiken.

Die Unterkunft liegt sehr nah am Meer und ist für 2 Personen für ein paar Tage völlig ausreichend. Das Bad war etwas klein aber alles nötige war vorhanden und sauber.
Isabel war sehr nett, hilfsbereit und am ersten Tag wurden wir herzlich von ihr empfangen.
Das Zimmer ist daher für einen kurzen Aufenthalt in Porto am Strand zu empfehlen!

Great place, very friendly and generous people. The room is lovely and very clean. The private bathroom and entrance are super practical. We can unconditionally recommend this accomodation. It is ideal, both for hanging out on Portos beaches and for visiting the city center after a lovely walk along the Douro.

The home of Carlos and Isabel is situated a mere 3 minute walk from the coast of the Atlantic ocean. A beautiful park is just across the street and the frequent 500 bus will take you all the way to the historical center of Porto in about 20 minutes. Nearby you will find cafe's with delicious pastry and coffee. Scenic beaches are also very close. The air, especially in the morning, is filled with the smell of the ocean that will surely empower you for the adventures of the day, of which Porto has plenty to offer.
The room itself was incredibly cozy and clean, smelling of fresh linen. Felt more like a 5 star hotel room than an affordable Airbnb location. The room has its own entrance with access to the street as well as a private shower and toilet room. You can bar the access from the rest of the house for extra privacy. There's also a fish tank to stare at to help you relax. Upon arrival we found cookies, tea and a small kettle to boil water with that our hosts kindly left for us.
All of our requests and wishes were met with utmost kindness and keen will to help. Our hosts made us feel welcome and showed true southern European hospitality.
We highly recommend Carlos's place to anyone looking to enjoy their vacation in Porto.

Nice room, very clean, in perfect place, near a quite place (public garden) and the beaches in one side and Porto center in the other side. Bus stop at 50 meters really easy! Isabel and Carlos were very kindness and reactive! We really recommended it!
Carlos and his family are truly great hosts. They've been very helpful, warm and welcoming. The room is very cosy, comfortable and clean. And has nice hidden bathroom. Best choice.

I spend two nights in the comfortable room at Carlos and Isabel. It's quiet and clean and the private bathroom and own entrance are very convenient as well as the flexible check-in/out. The beach and river are close and there are some wonderful restaurants in the area and few tourists. Three days of walking around, soaking up the sun and simply enjoying life. Thank you!

Our time in Isabel and Carlos house was wonderful. The room we were at was very clean, big and it had it's own little private bathroom where you can have really hot showers. The house is also very close to the beach and to a bus stop where you can take bus 500, which is very convenient. You can also take an uber from their house to the center of the city for about 5 to 6 euro. They were both amazing hosts and went beyond our expectations. Wonderful room and hosts.
Adorei! Para uma pessoa ou casal é bastante bom para ficar na Foz do Douro.

Rewelacyjny pokój ☺️ świetna lokalizacja przy cichym parku , 1 min od oceanu  blisko do sklepu, restauracje z miłą obsługą i pysznym jedzeniem. Zabytkowy tramwaj zabierze Cię w 15-20 min. wzdłuż rzeki do starego miasta. Gdzie możesz dobrze zjeść i napić się pysznego lokalnego wina. Na północ w stronę portu ciągnie się wspaniałą promenada z miłymi kawiarniami. Przy porcie zjesz zawsze świerza rybę  Gospodarze są na medal , bardzo mili i zawsze dobrze doradza gdzie można się udać w razie niepogody.

Porto is beautifull and ocean is magic. And Carlos&Isabel appartament (with the cleanest bed linen and towels, with aquarium and awakening with classical music) have become my real home for these 4 days. Сozy room, ideal cleanliness, quiet courtyard, narrow street, wonderful park near, good public transport connection, friendly, sympathetic and kind citizens and 2 minutes walk to Atlantic (Website hidden by Airbnb) makes my holidays.
Many thanks to Isabel and Carlos.

Simple and great at the same time. Nice location, if you like the sea. Our favorite double decker #500 stops just round the corner and brings directly to the station and the center.  Breakfast in the small coffee at the park is a must and two minutes away.
Hosts are warm and kind, we wish we stayed longer :)
Excelente alojamiento, anfitriones maravillosos.

Very nice room with view on a garden and the sound of the ocean. I felt very welcome by Isabel and enjoyed the location in the city. I highly recommend this Airbnb and will surely book it again for my next trip

Isabel e Carlos, muito obrigada pela Vossa simpatia, disponibilidade em ajudar e proporcionar-nos uma estadia em que nada ficou por considerar, inclusivê o extra do estacionamento para a mota, chaves extra e cuidado em que estivéssemos bem, confortáveis e apoiados a 100% por vós. Parabéns pelo espaço!

Ubicación perfecta, tanto para descansar como para desplazarse al centro.A 1 minuto del mar y un autobús te lleva al centro desde prácticamente la puerta de la casa.Facil de aparcar en la zona.Trato correcto.Para repetir.

Isabel & Carlos’s private room was perfect for my husband and I! Our stay in Porto was lovely! The city is simply amazing, and the private and independent bedroom+bath was exactly what we needed to explore the town. The location is Prime! Close to the beach and the river, trams and buses... but we actually just walked everywhere really! Very clean and comfortable, and very quiet at night. I really recommend the stay!
The room was clean, had everything I needed and very comfortable.  The hosts were reliable,  helpful and nice. The location was perfect! I would definitely stay again in this cosy and peaceful place

I found everything I needed at Carlos and Isabel’s place. The room is cosy and clean, with sweet mini bathroom (the bathroom was my favorite). The location of the apartment is ca 20-23 min from the city centre with a bus. It is a good location for people who want to live in a quieter and more relaxed distric than city centre. It is just 7 min walk from there to the first beach. I am 100 % satisfied with my stay and I am planning to go back to Porto and stay at the same place. Isabel and Carlos are fantastic people :)

The place was quiet and close to restaurants and transportation as well.

We went there by car and there was always a place to park near the appartment.

Carols's wife was very nice and helpfull.

The appartment was clean and had everything we needed.

Thank you Isabel and Carlos for your hospitality.

Great stay at Carlos’ place. There’s everything you need in the room, it’s close to the Douro estuary with a few restaurants and bars to go to, and really convenient to reach Porto city centre. Carlos and his wife were helpful with all the information to reach to room and giving tips to make your stay better.
I would recommend 100%!

Wat een geweldige plek om Porto vanuit hier te ontdekken! Een fijne kamer met voldoende facaliteiten (waterkoker, kopjes, bestek en borden voor 2 personen), een heerlijke douche en een prima bed. Rustige omgeving en vlakbij het drukkere grote centrum. Wij hebben 4 dagen alles op de fiets gedaan en bezocht: wat een feest! Ondanks het (Hollandse) weer hebben we genoten en zouden we zeer zeker weer boeken via Airbnb en deze kamer!!!! Carlos en Isabel bedankt voor jullie gastvrijheid, het regelen van 2 fietsen en jullie hulp! Groet, Miranda en MarieAnt

Carlos en Isabelle zijn erg lieve mensen, die mij heel goed ontvangen hebben. Alles was in orde en heel proper. Het verblijf is niet ver gelegen van de kust, ong 100m, vlakbij een bushalte. Dit verblijf is zeker een aanrader om Porto te bezoeken, een goede combinatie van kustwandelingen en een bezoek aan de stad.
Очень уютная комната с отдельным входом, отличное расположение, предусмотрительные и приятные в общении хозяева. Спасибо за советы по местам в городе!
Very much recommended!

I can absolutely recommend this place to everyone who wants to visit the city of Porto but also wish to be close to the ocean. It's actually five minute walk to the Mouth of the Douro River and it's amazing to be able to look at this view everyday. If you want to get to the City, the bus stop is less then 100m away from the house. As for the room, it's just like in the pictures - very cosy, comfy  and clean. You get everythng what's needed (towels, soap, shampoo, hair dryer, even a small electric kettle), there is enough space for two people and their things. It's got its own, separate exit to the garden, so you don't need to be worry that you might disturb someone. Isabel was very nice and sweet to us, she show us the place, gave us all directions we needed. What more can I say? We couldn't be happier that Isabel and Carlos decided to became a hosts in Airbnb and share their home with us.

Se trata de un pequeño escritorio que Carlos transforma en cuarto para dos. La cama está muy baja a sólo unos 25cms del piso y también la TV está en el piso. El baño es pequeño pero cómodo. Todo muy limpio. Se entra por una puerta ventana que da a un jardín y hay una silla para tomar el fresco. Pero no hay ventana. De modo que si cierras la puerta...... Esta bien ubicada cerca del bus 500 que va a la Rivera y al centro. Carlos muy amable nos permitió late Checkout. Buena relación precio calidad
Good value for money - 2in1-Porto sightseeing and beach rest

今までの中で最高のAIRBNB｡ｲｻﾍﾞﾙとｶﾙﾛｽは到着日そうそうの夜夕食に招待してくれました｡建物のﾙｰﾌﾄｯﾌﾟで大西洋へ沈む夕日を見ながらｶﾙﾛｽお手製の野菜ｽｰﾌﾟsopa de legumesと焼き魚peixe no forno(ﾎﾟﾙﾄｶﾞﾙの味)を頂くという思いもかけなかった体験が､私たちの旅のｽﾀｰﾄでした｡その後､白ﾜｲﾝを飲みながら興味深い会話が続き､最終的にﾊｰﾌﾞﾃｨで就寝｡彼らは常に私達に気を配ってくれました｡

2日間過ごした専用ﾊﾞｽﾙｰﾑ付きのお部屋は､建物のﾊﾟﾃｨｵから直接ｱｸｾｽが可能で(ｷｰ付き縦長窓)､まるでﾌﾟﾗｲﾍﾞｰﾄｱﾊﾟｰﾄﾒﾝﾄの様でした｡ｵｰﾅｰの住居を通らずに道へ出られる様考えてありました｡室内全てが新しく､お掃除は言うことなし｡お茶が飲める様にｹﾄﾙとﾃｨｰｶｯﾌﾟが置いてあります｡

ﾛｹｰｼｮﾝは私たちのﾌﾟﾗﾝ(ﾋﾞｰﾁ徒歩5分､Museu Serralves徒歩20分)にﾋﾟｯﾀﾘでした｡市内中心部からはﾊﾞｽ (Phone number hidden by Airbnb) 分｡ｿﾞｰﾝ2のAndante Card 24h (4,15€)を使えばなんの不自由もなく､逆に静かで素敵なﾖｰﾛｯﾊﾟ的ﾊﾞｶﾝｽを体験したい方には超ｵｽｽﾒです!
ｲｻﾍﾞﾙ､ｶﾙﾛｽ､ありがとう!

Una experiencia inmejorable con Isabel y Carlos. El primer día nos invitó a una cena casera en la azotea del edificio con una maravillosa vista. Una sopa de verdura y un plato de pescado asado que cocinó Carlos (el sabor portugués) hicieron que nuestro viaje fuera muy especial. Luego continuamos con una larga conversación muy interesante. Fueron muy detallistas con nosotros en todos los sentidos.

La habitación independiente con una entrada propia (la ventana vertical con llave) y un baño privado hacen que el cuarto se convienta en un apartamento privado. La entrada-ventana da a un pequeño patio del edificio que comunica directamente a la calle (sin necesidad de pasar por la residencia principal). La limpieza es impecable.

La ubicación fue perfecta para nuestro plan. Unos días de playas (5 min) y otro de visita a la Fundación Serralves (20 min). Una zona preciosa para pasear. Para ir al centro de la ciudad el autobús línea 500 recorre por la desenvocadura del río Duero en (Phone number hidden by Airbnb) min (entre São Bento y la puerta de la casa). También existe otra opción que es el tranvía línea 1 (30 min), una atracción turística.

Nosotors ya tenemos una casa en Oporto. 
¡Muchas gracais, Isabel, Carlos!
Everything as described, very nice hosts, I recommend both for those who want to relax on the beach and explore the city.

The accommodation of Carlos and Isabel is beautiful!! You live together with some small fishes in a little room which contains all what you need for some days in Porto! 
Furthermore the house is located in silence but lovely quarter of Porto! 

Unfortunately we only met Isabel and his son, but they were really nice and courteous to us!

Thank you for the nice days we could spend at your room !!! 

Absolutely recommendable!!

This is an amazing place if you want to explore the city and also spend some time by the ocean. The place is very cosy and clean -  perfect for one person or a couple. It's located in a quiet area, however is just 10 minutes away from the city centre by bus.
Isabel and Carlos are lovely and very responsive. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone coming to Porto!

Locatie was top, vlakbij zee. Ook de stad is goed te bereiken met verschillende buslijnen of een uber. Carlos en Isabel waren ontzettend gastvrij en de communicatie verliep goed. Ze reageren snel. De kamer is lekker koel. Echt een aanrader!

Wer ein ruhiges, saubere und preisgünstiges Appartment sucht und nicht gerade Trubel und Party braucht ist hier richtig gut aufgehoben. Carlos und Isabel sind sehr gastfreundlich und wenn es irgendwo ein Problem gibt, wie z. B. das Schloss, das am Anfang nicht richtig funktionierte, wird es sofort gelöst. 
Die Lage ist außerhalb von Lissabon aber mit dem Bus, der direkt vor der Haustür abfährt, ist man innerhalt von 15 Minuten in der City.
Der Ortsteil liegt direkt an der Mündung des Douro, so dass das Meer und der Strand nicht weit sind, es gibt eine Strandpromenade und das eine oder andere einladende Strandlokal. Leider war mein Aufenthalt  zu kurz.

Probably the best accommodation in Porto ! 

If you prefer not to live right in the centre of town, Carlos & Isabel (approx. 15/20 minutes by bus) is the perfect place to stay. 

The accommodation is located between the centre and the beach. 
The centre and the beach can be reached by bus 500, which leaves from the bus stop in front of the house. (Approx.100m walk). 

Isabel and Carlos rent out a nice clean room, where you feel directly comfortable! 
The accommodation/ The room is clean and tidy and also offers a comfortable bed, a small but very nice private bathroom, a closet with enough space and a separate entrance door. 

With Isabel and Carlos you meet 2 warm, open and helpful people. They welcome you warmly and help you where they can. 
They give tips on where to eat and have breakfast in the immediate vicinity. 
So we found great little cafes and restaurants. 

We had a super nice stay with you and would return at any time. Thanks for the lovely days.

 Meron & Julia

És un bon allotjament. El llit molt còmode i la dutxa espectacular (amb vàris xorros), encara que el bany una mica petit, però amb secador, gel i xampú. Tens accés directe a la habitació sense haver de passar per la casa. Té un aqüari que et demanen que els hi donguis de menjar als peixos. A la entrada vem tenir un detall de alguns tés i galetes.  Ens van recomenar lloc per esmorzar i el bus que et porta al centre (15 minuts). Si haguèssim de tornar a Porto segurament buscariem més aprop del city center tot i que és un bon lloc.
Relació qualitat/preu correcta.
Absolutely lovely Airbnb. Carlos and Isabella are wonderful hosts and their room is one of the cutest I’ve ever seen. Includes an aquarium of little fishies! 6/5, would stay again in a heartbeat.

Isabel and Carlos’ petite Air BnB offers a wonderful respite from the city in its quiet location in the exclusive Foz district. Situated at the confluence of the Duoro River and the Atlantic Ocean, it is an amazing setting with cafes and restaurants located some 15 minutes by bus from the city center or 50 minutes on foot, which is a nice walk along the river.  The space is quite small but well designed and quite comfortable for a single traveler.  I especially enjoyed the desk, the fish tank, and the tiny but wonderful shower. Isabel and Carlos are world travelers and very interested in people.  I very much enjoyed their hospitable company.   I hope to be back in the future.

Un endroit agréable, calme. Isabel et Carlos sont disponibles pour donner les informations souhaitées. Pas tout près du centre de Porto mais très accessible par le bus. En plus très respirant le bord de mer après une journée dans la ville!

I had a short, but very nice stay at Carlos & Isabel's place. I arrived quite late at night, but Isabel stayed up to welcome me. The place is very cosy, quiet and in a beautiful location close to the sea. It is a fair walk to the city center, however a beautiful one (or you catch the bus:) ). All in all I had a very nice stay and I would recommend anyone to stay with Carlos & Isabel.
Very hispitable family, comfortable room and good location! Highly recommend walkers near ocean.

Carlos et Isabelle sont des hôtes charmants.
Tout a été génial pendant ma semaine.
Vous pouvez allez chez eux en toute confiance.
local perto das prais e fácil acesso à onibus para a região central, lugar confortavel e atendimento excelente.

Großartig. Ich habe selten solch nette und hilfsbereite Gastgeber getroffen wie Isabel und Carlos. Extrem hilfsbereit, jederzeit ansprechbar und bemüht, es dem Gast angenehm zu gestalten. Das Zimmer war sehr sauber, ruhig und schön gelegen in der Nähe der Mündung des Douro in den Atlantik. Das Bad ist klein, aber ausreichend und sehr sauber. 3 Minuten entfernt ist die Endstation der historischen Linie 1, die direkt nach Porto führt. Reichlich kleine Cafe´s, Restaurants und Bars in der näheren Umgebung. Für einen entspannten Aufenthalt absolut perfekt.

Isabel und Carlos sind wahnsinnig gastfreundlich und hilfsbereit. Die Lage ist sehr schön, nah am Meer aber mit einem längeren Spaziergang am Fluss entlang oder mit dem Bus kommt man auch schnell ins Stadtzentrum. Viele Einkaufsmöglichkeiten, Cafés und Restaurants findet man in ein paar Minuten zu Fuß.

It was a very good room. Clean and hygienic toilets. Location is very close to the sea and it’s perfect for walks along the coast. Carlos is a very kind host and a helpful person.  Very good experiences.

Great place near the ocean. Cozy interior, super nice hosts and only 15 min into the city Centre by bus. 
Excellent location to explore the city and the costal areas. Good breakfast option 5min away. Supermarket 10min.
10/10 would stay there again.

Die Unterkunft ist in Bezug auf Lage und Preis unschlagbar. Für zwei Personen als Paar oder BF ist es absolut ausreichend. Es ist genau wie auf den Bildern zu sehen. Carlos und Isabel sind sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit. Am letzten Abend haben  wir noch gemeinsam einen Portwein getrunken und uns toll unterhalten. 

Seife, Föhn, Handtücher, Shampoo vorhanden. 

Immer wieder gerne!
A very cozy and proper place to stay, quite near to the wonderful  seaside. Carlos and his wife are very special SUPERhosts!!! FIVE STARS FOR EVERYTHING!

name: Lovely apartment with private parking
summary: Independent apartment, fully equiped in vintage house. It holds 1 bedroom, kitchen, living room, bathroom and a further terrace outdoors. It may accomodate up to 5 people and is located very close to Campanhã, Porto's main train station.
space: If you are looking for an apartment with a central location when stepping out of the door puts you right in the busy stream of the city centre, the touristic bars and restaurants and the hop on/hop off bus, then this is not the right place for you. If, on the contrary, you are looking for a quiet neighbourhood where the city still boasts something truly genuine, even if you have to walk 15/20 min to reach the center, then this is the place for you :) This is an apartment in a beautiful early 20th century house located in the eastern part of Porto, an area of growing interest for tourism and housing in the city. It is very close to Porto main train station (Campanhã) as well as metro and bus.  The apartment is on the 2nd floor and only accecible by stairs. It has 1 bedroom with double bed. The living room is equipped with a sofa-bed for 2 people. Still there is a small mezzanine where we keep a mattress for a single bed, just in case it's necessary. It is best designed to host 1 couple

neighborhood_overview: Eastern Porto has a unique cultural environment. It blends the tradicional, the pop and kitsch with the artsy and the most contemporary hipster styles. The neighbourhood is quiet but active and lots of tradicional commerce can still be found nearby. It is located at walking distance from the city centre, the Faculty of Fine Arts, the public Library, the river Douro, etc.
notes: When  arriving please ring on the 1st floor right (the bell states 1º Dto). That is where we live and will be waiting for guests to arrive.
transit: Campanhã train station 5 min away, Sao Bento train station 20 min away. Heroismo metro stop 200 mt up (direct line to the Airport, Matosinhos, Maia and Porto main city centers). Bus stops just about everywhere :)
access: Guests will have access to all in the apartment, including the possibility of laudry. Private parking is also available for no cost.
interaction: We will interact with the guests in accordance with their wishes. We live in another apartment of the same house, one storey down. All the tennants in the house are friends so interaction is quite common.
house_rules: Above all we expect our guests to enjoy their stay. As a basic rule, don't do anything you wouldn't like other people doing to yourselves!

host.host_about: Hi! My name is José and Elisabete is my partner. We love being with people so our house is normally full of friends which include all our neighbours.We love our house and always find ways to change things around. I am a visual artist and work in the neighbourhood. Elisabete is an ex teacher, now in a new project producing and developing the best cold pressed oils for skin and hair care! We love too many things to describe them all, so we might say we love life!

reviews.comments:
Excelente experiencia en el Lovely apartment in Vintage House, fue justo lo que buscábamos con mi novia, queríamos vivir unos días sintiéndonos parte del lugar y saborear la cultura de la increíble ciudad que es Porto y lo hemos logrado al estar en una edificio típico de Porto en una casa Vintange con muy buen gusto y el excelente y muy buen trato de Bety y José y los demás vecinos del edificio, que estuvieron todos muy atentos con nosotros!
