reviews.comments:
A casa da Ana e do Gonçalo foram o local escolhido para a passagem de ano com um grupo de amigos. Fomos super bem recebidos com uma grande simpatia e predisposição a ajudar com qualquer coisa que fosse necessário.
A casa era ainda melhor do que parecia nas fotos, totalmente equipada, com mantas, aquecedor e tudo o que pudessemos precisar.
A localização não podia ser melhor! Não há melhor do que acordar de manhã e ao virar da esquina estar a ribeira do Porto.

We are french's students, we traveled some days in Porto, this space was good and we can cooking easly. It was rainning so we eard every time the water fall to the ground in the street when we sleeping. But It was cool and or was well received by Ana et Gonçalo

We had a spledid time in the old centre of Porto.
The appartment is very well situated next to the old Ribeira square. It's perfect to have such an appartment to your disposal, you feel home, and have a place to relax between the exploration of this very nice city.
We thank Ana & Gonçalo, and we hope the appartment is free when we go back next year. Porto is charming original.

Ana and Goncalo were very helpful and accommodating. When they were not available they put us in touch with their nephew who was equally as helpful. The flat was as described, neat and tidy. The weather was quite cold, but thankfully A&G left us with extra blankets and electric heaters to use. Location was great. Outside the flat there was a slight smell of the river/ sewage, but in all honesty it did not come into the flat, and once you go down the road it doesn't carry on. This may also have been down to the very wet weather we had while there. All in all, very happy and would definitely recommend.

The hosts were very accommodating and agreed to meet with my parents as they were arriving before us. Communicated very well and always responded in a very timely manner. You couldn't have asked for a better location of this apartment and the place was identical to the pictures in the in the listing.

THE PLACE TO BE, l'appartement est situé au milieu de la Ribeira , tout peut se faire à pieds c'est l'ideal,l'appartement est très bien agencé et équipé.
Nous avons passé un séjour très agréable dans ce duplex avec beaucoup de charme .
Accueil très chaleureux de Ana et Gonçalo, ils ont pris du temps pour nous indiquer tout ce qu'il y avait à faire sur Porto et répondus  à toutes nos interrogations en terme de commodités.. Merci..

We had a great time in Porto. Ana’s & Goncalo’s apartment is located right in the heart of the Old Town and is great value for money. You really are at the centre of things and it’s the perfect place to get swept away in the hustle and bustle of Porto. Ana and Goncalo were great hosts.

Ana and Gonçalo were very welcoming and made a lot of information about Porto's sights available. It was very clean, very beautiful and the location was superb. It does have a lot of restaurants around it, so it could be a bit noisy for us at night but otherwise  great location. We would stay there again.

Super appartement très bien placé, au cœur de l'animation de la Ribeira !
Nous avons passé un super séjour à Porto !
Toutes les informations données par Ana et les documents laissés nous ont bien aidé à organiser notre séjour.  Nous avons (presque) tout fait à pied ! Le parking Ribeira est proche et bien utile pour garer le véhicule.
Merci !!!
Philippe

The appartment was great, it is really nice and cosy, and it is situated at a perfect location. Ana and Goncalo were very friendly, they were very helpfull during our stay. We had a great time during our stay in Porto!

Kävimme majoittajan kanssa viestinvaihtoa ennen lomaa ja he antoivat mukavan vaikutelman. He olivatkin hyvin mukavia ihmisiä. He tulivat lentokentälle vastaan kahdella autolla mikä oli hyvin ystävällistä. He kertoivat myös kaupungista ja sen nähtävyyksistä. Asunnon sijainti oli täydellinen. Se oli myös erittäin romanttinen ja kaunis. Kokemus oli hyvin onnistunut.

Hemos pasado unos días increíbles en Oporto. Llegamos más tarde de lo que habíamos pensado y Ana & Gonçalo nos esperaron pacientemente y nos facilitaron la llegada, además nos recibieron con un regalo de bienvenida!. Nos dieron todo tipo de indicaciones y consejos más que de sobra para disfrutar de los días que estuvimos allí. La ubicación de la casa es inmejorable!! la única pega fue que el soporte de la ducha estaba roto pero como eran pocos días no quisimos molestar a Ana & Gonçalo y no se lo comentamos.
Great location, comfortable place, responsive and friendly host! Highly recommended!

This house is in the heart of Porto, set back enough to be away from the hustle and bustle but only a few steps up from the river, bars and restaurants. A great place to stay.
The house was clean and functional. Ana and Goncalo are perfect hosts with lots of information on places to visit and   eat.

The location of the house is wonderful! You are in the heart of the old city and the Douro ist just a few meters away. Perfect for a first visit to Porto!
Very cosy and warm house with everything you need.
Gonçalo gives a lot of good tips that will help you to have a perfect stay. Communication is very easy with him.

We spend a really good time in Porto, the flat is so well situated. The bridge is just next door, the view on the river is amazing, and plenty of restaurants and pubs, transport are just around.
Gonzalo is very kind to wait for us, also lat, for the check in, thank you.

Thanks for a great stay! 6 of us were in Porto for a long weekend and we had a blast. The apartment was perfect; location and size to accomodate us. The hosts were great, then even picked us up at the airport (for a fee but it was a great service). Thanks again! Bridget.
Superb location and very nice, big and overall pleasant apartment!
The apartment provides basic facilities but is good value for money and very well positioned for easy access to restaurants and bars, the Ribeira district and the Port house in Gaia.

Ana und Gonçalo sind sehr hilfsbereite liebe Leute, die  alles tun, damit man sich wohl fühlt. Wenn es etwas zu beanstanden gab, wird das sofort problemlos erledigt. Das Apartment ist charmant, die Möbel schon etwas mitgenommen, aber das passt insgesamt ins Bild von Porto und macht den Reiz aus. Die Lage ist super, genau am Duoro. Es gibt Strassenmusik bis in den späten Abend und auch morgens geht's früh los mit fröhlichen Lärm von der Flusspromenade. Nichts also für Leute, die es ruhig brauchen! Die Lage ist wirklich exklusiv und tröstet über den recht teuren Mietpreis. Im Umfeld gibt es typische Touri-Fallen, wo alles doppelt kostet, aber gleichzeitig findet man auch sehr nette kleine Bars, in der man chillig und günstig frühstücken oder generell lecker essen kann. Die Stadt ist klein genug, um sich schnell zurechtzufinden und groß genug, um immer wieder neues zu entdecken. Wir waren zu dritt (50, 25, 20 Jahre) und haben die Zeit wirklich genossen.

Very well located appartement ideal for a family of 5 who want to make the most of the city center.
It may be a bit noisy at night but this is acceptable.
Globally we recommend this place.
Great location! The apartment is somewhat basic. We were family with 3 teenagers and had a good time. Also it’s a bit noisy until very late at night.

This apartment is in the perfect location for being in the middle of the action. There were tons of restaurants close to the apartment and it was a quick walk across the bridge to tour the Port wineries. Be forewarned; if you are looking for a very quiet location, this area may not be for you. However, if you are looking to step outside of your door and start enjoying what Porto has to offer, I recommend this location.

Acceuil très très chaleureux de Gonçalo  et Ana lors de notre arrivée très tardive due à un changement d"'horaire d'avion....appartement super bien situé dans Porto près du Douro, fidèle aux photos mises sur le site....Nous avons adoré ce quartier bien animé  .....Encore merci à Gonçalo et Ana. ....
Localização perfeita, muito aconchegante, Ana e Gonçalo são pessoas muito atenciosas e simpáticas!

Perfect position to see everything that Porto has to offer. Ana and Gonçalo were great hosts quick to respond and welcoming. Couldn't recommend a better place to stay in Porto to be able to see the sights and be within walking distance to so many restaurants.
Great location!

Probably Ana&Gonzalo´s place is great for summer but definitely not in winter. The house is NOT WARM and ready for a stay in cold and humit season. There is NO HEATING in any of the rooms and living room, only bed covers (not nordic duvet) and small heaters which you have to switch off during the night. Those were not enough during our stay in January even we had sunny days! Moreover we were 5 people in the house without NO HOT WATER enough for all of us. 
The pictures did not show the reality. Furniture was much older and WiFi signal is only available in the living room, not the rooms.
On the other hand, location is great if you want to stay close to the river. Although think about that all restaurants, bars and main tourist attractions are close to Train Station and Clerigos Tower which means 15-20 min uphill walking distance from the house.

Appartement très cosy! Nous y avons été pour un court séjour à 7 et avons adoré. L'appartement est idéalement situé dans le quartier magnifique de la Ribeira. L'accueil a ete très chaleureux: Nous étions trompé d'adresse car le GPS avaient confondus les rues mais Ana a su nous retrouver pour nous amener à l'appartement.  L'appartement était très  propre et nous avons eu largement tout ce qu'il fallait en linge.
Encore un Grand merci à eux!
ottima ospitalità, la posizione della casa è ottima, vicina ai mezzi di trasporto e alle principali attrazioni della città, torneremo sicuramente. Consigliato!!
Nice apartment in Porto, we enjoy staying in it for a few days. The apartment is comfortable and has a very nice location. Thanks to Ana and Gonsalo for hospitality.
Great location. Good value thanks for the stay

Me and my friends (7 ppl tot) have booked Gonçalo and Ana’s apartment for our holidays and i think we cannot do a better choice like that.
The apartment is situated near Oporto’s riverside, in Ribeira district, at 2 minutes walking to Sao Bento’s station, 10minutes to Lello’s library and clerics’s tower. In less than 10 minutes u’re in Vila Nova De Gaia where u can find the wineries of porto’s wine.
The apartment is really spacious and comfortable, perfect for 7 italian people that want to have fun in Oporto.
Suggested!!!

L'emplacement et vraiment au coeur de l'animation du vieux Porto. Au pied de l'appartement se trouvent de charmants café avec vue sur le Douro.
Ana&Gonçalo ont été très attentionnés et à l'écoute de nos demandes
Michel
Great location right next to the Dom Luiz bridge and Douro river and plenty of restaurants. Enough room for about 6 people. Ana was very responsive to any concerns we had. Would stay again.
The house was supernice and located in the middle of the center. We really enjoyed our stay here!
Great Location. Ana & Gonzalo are very nice, flexible, and fast-responsive. Apartment is ok but only one toilet for 3 rooms + sofa-bed.

Ana&Gonçalo's apartment was nice, comfy, clean and most of all really well located in the city center!!!
We could easily move everywhere in Porto from there and it was perfect for discovering the city!
Also, I'd like to mention that Gonçalo was nice and patient with us on the day of the arrival even if we were a bit late.
I strongly recommend this place!
Incredible location, beautiful house. Everything was very easy and we would highly recommend this accommodation. Excellent.
good lication good experience
We loved it
Great location right on the river. Lots of tourists in the area. Easy to get to public transportation. Besides the hot weather, we had a good time.
Merci à Ana & Gonçalo pour l’accueil !

Our stay in Ana and Gancalo’s apartment was lovely. The location was perfect and Gancalo graciously picked us up from the airport. It does get a little loud in the morning but that’s only because the apartment is perfectly located right on the river front. You do have to hold the shower wand when showering but the pressure is good. Overall I would definitely stay in the apartment again!
It was a wonderful experience, the location is fantastic and the accommodations were outstanding.

Ana’s place is very well located, at 2 min walking distance to the Douro, so that everything is close by! Ana communicated well regarding check in info, and was even flexible regarding check out timing. The description / pictures are relevant; only the bathroom  is not as recent. We appreciated the extra blanket as heaters have to be switched off once u leave the flat, but once they are switched on we had no problem afterwards regarding the temperature of the flat.
If you want to stay in the heart of Porto for reasonable price this is a good alternative. However, I’d selected again it for group of more than 6 people.

Very helpful hosts. Cooked traditional Portuguese Christmas dinner for 6. Location is perfect. Right off square that is on river right by famous bridge engineered by protege of Gustav Eifel. Looks like same type structure.

Ana & Goncalo were great on communication, responding instantly to questions.
5 of us stayed in their home for 3 nights and found the location to be great and central to all the amazing sights Porto has to offer. 
We found the home to be difficult to heat on our first night, the rooms have heaters but took time to get the room to a comfortable temperature level. But in warmer months Im sure this isn't an issue.
The beds are a little hard with one slightly out of shape,  and the shower is fairly basic (hand held) but does the job. Because of the central location some noise can be expected early in the mornings. 
Overall the apartment suited our needs for our short stay and the price is more than reasonable for what we got.

The house was extremely well located and Ana was able to give us some really great tips on locations to have lunch and eat out. The house was perfectly clean and the easily able to accommodate 6 people despite only having one bathroom. The beds and living room were comfortable. 

However, we always felt somewhat on edge in the house due to the number of signs posted around the kitchen, bedrooms and bathroom about being charged 15€ for all sorts of extras like not washing up or using extra towels and bed linen. Not that this would be particularly unreasonable but it made us feel like we were walking on egg shells in and around the house. 

The hosts were aware that we were a group of six yet one of the beds was not prepared and we ran out of toilet paper well before we were due to check out despite only being there 2 nights. It really wasn't the end of the world but the shower head does not have a wall fitting meaning you had to hold it yourself if you wanted to stand underneath it.

Este alojamento local, cuidadosamente decorado, foi criado para quem aprecia conforto e privacidade aliado a um ambiente acolhedor e familiar.

Cozinha fogão, forno, microondas, frigorífico, torradeira e utensílios de cozinha. Jardim com mesas para refeições e cadeiras para repouso Rede Wifi gratuita em toda a habitação

host.host_about: My name is Fernando Gomes. Recently I inaugurated the 22 Oporto Guest House to offer accommodation in this magnificent city called Porto, whose historical center is a world heritage site.

reviews.comments: Le logement de Fernando est parfaitement situé. Il est proche du centre (700m) mais Porto étant très vallonnée, il peut être difficile pour certaines personnes de s'y rendre à pied. Pas d'inquiétude la station de métro est à 50m. Elle dessert la seule ligne nord sud qui permet de se rendre directement dans le centre. Fernando propose un petit déjeuner juste parfait. Ça permet d'être caler une bonne partie de la journée.

host.host_about: Portuense de gema com Matosinhos no coração, amante de desporto (em especial surf), de cinema, pessoas e viagens.

reviews.comments: El anfitrión muy atento antes de llegar, y después de marcharos, en fin muy amable y muy servicial

La casa es una auténtica pasada. Una preciosidad.
Las habitaciones súper amplias. Todo muy limpio, nuevo y moderno.
Muy cerca de la playa y buen conectado en metro o bus con el centro de Oporto.
A Andre no lo conocí en persona, pero estuvo en todo momento en contacto conmigo recomendándome cosas.
Tiene una habitación en la tercera planta-ático llena de juguetes de niños....los míos se lo pasaron en grande!!
Yo ya estoy pensando que si volvemos otra vez nos quedaremos otra vez en la casa de Andre!!!
Great stay in the Matosinhos area of Porto. André is a very nice host and his house is frankly awsome !

We spent one week in April 2017 in André's house : 3 adults, 2 young childrens.
Everybody enjoyed the house. Everything was perfect : the kitchen, the bedrooms (one with bathroom = suite), the kids playroom on last floor, the garden ! The agencement of this house is a success !
Besides, the house is very close from the beach (5 min by walk) and from any commodations you need during your holidays. For example, a supermarket is located less than 200m from the house.
To be noticed : You can also rent this house without renting a car : metro and bus station are close too. You can reach Porto city center easily with metro.
It's  definitely a perfect house if you want to do in the same day : surfing, chill and shopping.
Then, André was very convenient before our coming, trying to do his best to help us. The welcoming was really warmful.
For sure, we recommend André's house.
Casa bastante bem localizada com decoração moderna e muito agradável. O André foi bastante prestável para todas as situações. Sem dúvida que recomendo esta casa.

Andre house is perfectly placed for exploring Matosinhos and Porto. In an historically interesting quarter which each day revealed a new delight. The flat is comfortable and well laid out and we loved staying there.

André's place is even more beautiful than the pictures. It has a modern, clean, yet cozy feeling to it. We had our 2 year old with us and he loved the playroom on the 3rd floor. In fact, he never wanted to leave. He also enjoyed the many toys that were in his bedroom. If you have a toddler-elementary age child, I can say with confidence that they would love to stay here. Keep in mind there are 3 floors so there are a good bit of stairs but that did not bother us and our kid learned not to climb them without us. The place also has a great little backyard. We got to enjoy it on the last day and it was nice to sit out there with coffee and pastries and enjoy the breeze. It is about a 7-8 minute walk to the beach and the closest beach area is the widest part in Praia de Matosinhos and has the most cafes. Downtown Porto is about a 15 minute uber ride which was very convenient. Overall, we really loved the place and if we were to come back we would most definitely choose André's house again.

La maison d'André est très agréable à vivre proche de toutes commodités... un vrai plaisir d'y séjourner.... nous étions 2 adultes 1 enfant Et 1 bebe de 6 mois et nous revenons enchanté de se séjour et nous vous recommandons vivement la maison d'André...
The house is a great place to stay. Andre is the perfect host, easy and quick  to communicate with. Everything was even better as expected.

Our stay at André's house was really good. It's an ideal place for families, the kids really enjoyed their stay. 
The area is not very touristic so makes it nicely quiet and interesting and has lots of amenities like its proximity to the beach. It's also well connected with the city centre and the airport. 
André has been always very helpful and easy to communicate with him. 
Highly recommended!

The house is just fantastic, a classic Matosinhos House with a full recent and quite modern update . Andre is an excellent guest , always available. We will repeat if we came back to Porto. La  casa es fantástica. Una casa tradicional de Matosinhos con una reforma reciente y muy actual. Andre nos trato fantásticamente , si volvemos a Oporto repetiremos! 

Everything was new and clean,

A estancia na casa de André foi estupenda. Ben ubicada (preto de supermercados, restaurantes, metro, praia etc) e moi estilosa; disfrutas do fogar que é. Ampla, perfecta para familias con nenos pequenos dispón de todo o preciso e en cantidade, incluso un amplo ático luminoso cheo de xoguetes. André foi moi atento respondendo a todas as nosas dúbidas e preocupouse porque estivesemos agusto; sen dúbida, conseguiuno. Obrigada André! Sempre serás benvido na Galiza,na nosa casa de Laxe.

O imóvel sito no centro de Matosinhos é excelente. A casa é muito bem localizada e muito confortável. O logradouro é muito giro e a decoração da casa é muito prática e bastante aprazível e, adicionalmente, dispõe de garagem. A cozinha estava equipada com tudo o que é necessário. O André é um excelente anfitrião, sempre simpático e muito disponível. Recomendo vivamente o imóvel, que proporcionou uma óptima estadia.
Je recommande cet hôte à 100%... lieux idéal et très propre.   Proche de tout et logement impeccable... très bien et spacieux même pour 4.

Great house well located in Matosinhos. The garden and « game » room is a paradise for kids.
I would definitely recommend !

We’ve spent very nice time at Andre’s place, our children loved it! The house is big, very clean, cosy, well equipped. The garden is also very well kept. Andre is a great host. It was a pleasure to visit that place.

reviews.comments:
Buena experiencia, un sitio tranquilo, cómodo y bastante grande. El único problema es que la piscina estaba al otro lado de la finca, no al lado de la casa. 
La aconsejo

Sikke en fantastisk velkomst vi fik. Vi fik introduktion til huset, haven og poolområdet af ejeren. Det er et hus med en historie, hvor huset tilhører en gammel vingård. Huset er autentisk trods nænsom restaurering - det klassiske udtryk er bevaret - alligevel med moderne faciliteter. Det var helt over vores forventninger.
Man går gennem en lille lund tilhørende ejendommen på vej til poolen - en oplevelse i sig selv.
Poolen er næsten en lige så stor oplevelse som huset. Med klar varm vand og med en størrelse, der gør det muligt at få en reel svømmetur.
Vi siger stor tak til Mathilde og familien for den store graciøsitet, hvor vi følte os meget velkomne og havde en rigtig dejlig ferie.

Nous avons passé 3 jours dans ce fantastique logement, nous en gardons un très bon souvenir.
Nous avons été accueilli chaleureusement, malgré notre retard de près d'une heure !... Le logement est très agréable et le site très calme. Nous avons notamment beaucoup apprécié la cour fermée, la piscine, le barbecue, le verger et ses prunes succulentes !
Acceuil  très agréable, descriptif du logement très réel ;  tout le confort dans cette maison très typique et très calme.

Une vieille maison très bien rénovée avec beaucoup de charme. Très belle piscine, très propre. Tiago a tout fait pour rendre notre séjour le plus agréable possible.
Nous recommandons vivement ce logement.

Uma semana fantástica passada num ambiente bucólico.
Ares frescos e uma paisagem idílica.
Um conjunto de qualidades que nos trarão óptimas memórias.
Obrigado à Matilde e família pelo acolhimento, disponibilidade e simpatia.

Accueil formidable, avec boisson fraîche et gâteaux.
Superbe maison et jardin avec une grande piscine très propre, c'est un endroit rêvé, excellent séjour en famille
Demeure magnifique  et l'environnement est très beau , Mathilde et Tiago sont très gentil , je recommande ++++++

The house is very well renovated and contains everything needed for a comfortable stay. It corresponds well to the description, but we were surprised that there was no separation between the two sleeping areas on the lower level. We did ask about sleeping facilities before booking, so something definitely got lost in translation. That said, this did not detract from us having a very pleasant stay. This location is excellent for those wishing to "do Portugal", since within 90 minutes (by car) one can be in Viana do Castelo, Braga, Guimaraes, Vila Real, Porto, Viseu and Coimbra, to name but a few places to visit. Finally, many thanks to Tiago who came to our rescue when we got lost in Vale de Cambra upon arrival.

We had an absolutely wonderful stay and rural experience at  Matilde and Thiagos house. They made us feel very welcome! Apartment in the basement with a private terrace. A bit cool in spring, but that will be nice in summer!

name: M&M Space MM2  Apartamento no centro da cidade
summary: O apartamento fica perto de arte e cultura e dos mais belos monumentos da cidade. Belos jardins e paisagens da cidade e do rio Douro ficam perto e podem ser apreciadas.  Existem restaurantes típicos e de comida internacional ao redor do apartamento.   O espaço fica numa rua típica da cidade, cheia da sua magia e magnetismo e é muito pratico e confortável. O espaço é excelente para quem pretende visitar e conhecer a zona histórica e turística do Porto. Transportes públicos ficam próximos.
space: Excelente apartamento, extremamente confortável e muito prático. Um espaço onde existem todas as comodidades necessárias para uma estadia deveras confortável. neighborhood_overview: Excelente apartamento que está localizado numa das ruas mais antigas da cidade do Porto, cheia de magia e magnetismo típico da cidade. Apesar de estar no centro da cidade, o local do apartamento é muito calmo e sossegado. Ao redor existem vários tipos de mercados, quer de pequeno comércio local, quer grandes supermercados, onde se pode comprar tudo o necessário a preços acessíveis. Restaurantes, cafés,bares e diversas lojas comerciais encontram-se  ao redor do apartamento.
notes: Para as primeiras necessidades encontrarão disponível água mineral, café, chá, açúcar, rolo de cozinha, sal, detergente de loiça e roupa, papel higiénico, gel e shampoo. Não é acessível para hospedes com cadeiras de rodas. É necessário subir 2 pequenos lanços de escadas.
transit: O apartamento está localizado a cerca de 1 Minuto de uma estação de Metro, com acesso directo ao aeroporto Francisco Sá Carneiro. O acesso a qualquer outro ponto distante da cidade, ou de outras cidades do país é  muito facilitado. As grandes estações de comboios, S. Bento e Campanhã, por onde podem ir visitar outras cidades do Portugal, ficam a cerca de 500 Metros. Tem também acesso a transportes públicos de autocarro, na Estação rodoviária 24 de Agosto, a cerca de 150 metros do apartamento. Podem estacionar a viatura nas ruas circundantes do apartamento, mas tem que pagar taxa.  Pode também estacionar em parque publico/privadas a custo reduzido. O proprietário tem contratos com garagem publico/privada, onde os hospedes podem estacionar o carro, ao preço de € 7,00 por 24 horas.
access: É um espaço único. Os hospedes podem usufruir da casa por inteiro, tendo só o especial cuidado de não utilizar alguns artigos de stock da casa que não serão necessários para a sua estadia.
interaction: Será prestada ajuda aos hospedes, 24 horas por dia, desde que solicitada.
house_rules: - Devem respeitar o restantes hospedes a morar no prédio evitando barulhos excessivos. - Animais de estimação: Questionar o proprietário. Podem ser permitidos a um custo extra a acordar. e em casos excepcionais. Fumar: Podem fumar na varanda desde que cumpram as regras de segurança necessárias. - Ter cuidado com o manuseamento dos equipamentos existentes na casa. Dão-se informações se solicitado. - Levar o lixo utilizado para os contentores no exterior. São fornecidos sacos extra para o feito. - Ter uma boa estadia.

Thierry, Patricia, Anaïs et Manon,

reviews.comments:
I was visiting Porto to attend a conference at Exponor, the exhibition center located in Matosinhos just north of Porto. I chose Miguel's apartment for its convenient location directly across from Exponor. I took the 601 bus from the airport which for a fare of just EUR 1,90 dropped me off at Exponor. Miguel kindly met me there to bring me the keys. 

That evening I walked to his apartment, circling the Exponor grounds and crossing a bridge over the highway. Each day that I was there I was able to walk to the conference center and back within 15 minutes. I once took a taxi into Porto city center and it was very quick, the fare was about 10 EUR.

Miguel's apartment is in a modern residential building. The 1-bedroom apartment is spacious, well equipped, comfortable, tastefully furnished and impeccably clean. I found a welcome note with clear instructions to connect to the wifi and to use the big-screen TV (lots of channels), as well as tips about local shops etc.

Because the building is located along a major highway there is traffic noise which may disturb some people, but I did not find it too bothersome as the sound is continuous like rain. The bedroom is on the opposite side facing a quiet residential neighborhood so I was able to sleep with the window open. 

I enjoyed my stay and would recommend Miguel's place to anyone attending Exponor or to people with a car given the convenient location near Porto and near the beaches of Matosinhos.

reviews.comments: L'appartement est propre et fonctionnel! Identique aux images! ;) Proche du centre-ville, nous avons pu marcher facilement où nous voulions sans prendre de transports en commun. Ricardo donne de très bons conseils, surtout pour la nourriture locale !  En face, petite boulangerie où nous avons manger tous les jours de manière excellente et à petit prix.

Apartamento acogedor, limpio, bonito, en zona céntrica y con todo lo necesario.
El vuelo llegó con retraso por la noche y en todo momento la propietaria estuvo en contacto con nosotros para recibirnos en cuanto llegáramos al piso. 
En general perfecto!
Great location, great host ! Near to the city center. The appartment is very clean and confortable.  It was a great choice ;)

Não tenho o hábito de fazer comentários após hospedagem. Mas, neste não posso deixar de falar. Apartamento novo e extremamente limpo. E, nunca recebi uma tanta atenção em uma hospedagem. Pedro me ajudou em tudo que precisei, parabéns. Recomendo. Nota 10. Retornando ao Porto, não tenho dúvidas de onde ficar novamente.

Very nice and cozy apartment. It's clean and modern. Quiet at night, but very close to a lot of cool bars and restaurants.

We had a great stay and didn't have any complaints. The host provided a lot of useful tips on our arrival and allowed us to do an early check-in (our flight arrived at 7am) which was really convenient.

We'd definitely repeat next time we go to Porto.

Hello

Apartamento mega confortável, tudo muito bonito e organizado,  bem localizado,  25 minutos andando até a ribeira, local tranquilo,  recomendo, tanto Guilherme como seus pais foram espetaculares!!

A moradia é excelente, boa localização, a poucos minutos do Porto. Tivemos uma ótima estadia e a comunicação com o Guilherme foi excelente. Muito obrigado por hospedar nos.

Trato agradable y casa muy bonita. Guillermo ha estado muy abierto a todo lo que necesitábamos y es muy flexible (algo genial).

Estupendo
Really nice and clean apartment in good location. Kind owner - I can only recommend this place :)
Pense numa família fantástica, vc n vai se arrepender, super recomendado!!!

Ha sido una estancia muy buena en este piso. Es grande, está muy limpio y bien decorado. Además tiene terraza y eso le suma puntos. La ubicación es buena, tiene tren y autobuses cerca que te llevan a cualquier zona turística. Guillerme ha sido muy atento!

o apartamento do Guilherme é espaçoso para uma família de 5 ou 6 pessoas situado numa zona muito calma quer de dia ou de noite. bem situado se pretende  visitar o Porto e se tiver carro (5minutos). free parking mesmo em frente do apartamento.
logement spacieux, fonctionnel et agréable.
Apartamento muito agradável e acolhedor, com ótimas áreas... O anfitrião foi muito receptivo!!!

Tive uma ótima experiência em Porto no apartamento de Guilherme.  Apartamento confortável e bem  localizado, com farmácia, supermercado, transporte público, restaurantes, próximos. Fui recebida pelo pai de Guilherme, Sr. Amadeu, que nos mostrou o apartamento, deu tds as dicas sobre o entorno e sobre a cidade, foi extremamente solicito e disponível. Recomendo!
Tres bon accueil et disponibilité  de notre hôte. L'appartement est joliment décoré, grand, fonctionnel, très propre et à 5min à pieds de la gare. Nous avons apprécié notre séjour !

Guilherme ha sido muy hospitalario. Se comunicó siempre muy rápido. El piso estaba muy limpio y muy cómodo. Accesible para carros o sillas. Buena unicación. Sin duda o recomiendo y si puedo repitiré. Ah! Y tiene una terraza con vistas y una hamaca colgada que es un lujo!

Reserva instantânea e sem sustos.... excelente localização e espaço. Tem 2 cafeterias ao lado para o café da manhã... e até máquina de lavar roupas caso precise!! 
Recomendo!
Guilherme’s hospitality was excellent and  he made our stay in Porto one to remember. The apartment was superb, newly refurbished and very clean. Thanks you very much! Will stay there again!
Buena ubicación, muy limpio, excelente comunicación con el anfitrión que se preocupó para que nuestra estancia fuera fenomenal!!!
Apartamento excelente. Remodelado e de muito bom gosto. Guilherme é bem atencioso e nós deu dicas da região. Recomendo.

Un piso bonito, bien decorado, limpio, amplio. Buena ubicación para acceder a Oporto. Los anfitriones son muy amables y dispuestos a ayudar en todo lo que sea necesario. Recomiendo el sitio para visitar Oporto, volvería sin pensarlo.
El alojamiento está genial. Piso bonito, bien situado. El único pero es el frío. Por lo demás genial. Para repetir sin dudas

reviews.comments:
Excelente estadia!
Ótima receção do senhor Luis, muito prestável e atencioso.
Todas as divisões têm uma decoração única e foi possível utiliza-las na totalidade: cozinhar, lavar roupa, usufruir da televisão... e a cama é super confortável.
Muito boas acessibilidades, próximo de supermercados, farmácias, take away, entre outros.
Próximo da praia e com uma vista fantástica para o mar.
5 estrelas!

Hola.
He sido inquilino de Luis por el tiempo de una semana y además de sentirme en mi propia casa, ya que las fotos del apartamento ( T2 ) son totalmente exactas, muy modernito y funcional, Luis y su pareja han sido unos anfitriones muy atentos, amables, serviciales y buenos consejeros para visitar sitios, mejores playas, donde comer etc..........
Por mi, parte solo tengo que darle las gracias por la atención y prestarse a todo.
Grazas

Correu tudo muito bem, o Luis foi um excelente anfitrião e esteve sempre disponível para nos ajudar a aproveitar o tempo em Vila do Conde o melhor possível. A casa é ótima e embora não fique exatamente no centro é bastante acessível, tem uma estação de metro muito perto e dá para andar a pé com bastante à vontade na direção do mar. E tem muitos cafés e restaurantes por perto. obrigado!

Cuando uno se siente como en su propia casa, que mas se puede decir. Cercano a supermercado y restaurantes que dan vistas al paseo maritimo y a la playa. Facil accso a la autovía A28 Porto-Braga.  Las fotos son tal cual es la casa.
Excelente recepção, casa acolhedora e bem localizado. Excelente acolhimento por para do Luís e da Ana. Recomendo.

La casa, los propietarios y el entorno son perfectos para estar una semana o diez días.
La casa es preciosa, muy amplia, cómoda y está impoluta. Tiene todo los enseres nuevos y de muy buena calidad.
A 7 minutos andando la playa y a 5 min supermercado Lidl, Pingo Doce, McDonald y pizzerías. 
Repetiré

Alojamiento magnífico; supera las expectativas y cuenta con todo lo necesario para hacer de la estancia un placer. Además el anfitrión ha sido estupendo y nos ha dado toda la información necesaria para disfrutar al máximo de la zona. ¡Sin duda repetiremos!

Nos hemos sentido muy a gusto en el piso, Está situado en un buen barrio y es moderno, equipado de todo y muy limpio. Vila de Conde es una cuidad bonita y esta a 25 minutos en coche de Porto y Guimaraes. Luis nos ha hecho sentir como en casa y nos ha ayudado en todo. Hasta ahora nuestro mejor experiencia por Airbnb.
Superbe appartement, digne d'un grand hôtel, rien à redire très propre, et il y a tout ce dont on peut avoir besoin!

The flat is a top floor, nice view to the sea in the background, bed very comfortable, very clean and well designed flat. 
We have been received with local little cake. A nice touch from the host.
The host took the time to explain where to go and eat. Thanks for the tips.
La casa genial., tal cual las fotos.  Esta muy bien equipada, relativamente cerca de playa y muy cerca de supermercado y farmacia
The appartment is fantastic and close to all.
Great host. Warm welcoming. Gives good details on Porto and suggestions.

host.host_about:
Somos mãe e filha, Margarida e Filipa. Uma é médica, a outra tem uma oficina de cerâmica, desenho e gravura aberta ao público no centro do Porto (Oficina Gato Bravo - são benvindos!). Adoramos esta terceira atividade, é um óptimo desafio e oportunidade para conhecer pessoas interessantes, e proporcionar-lhes tudo para uma estadia perfeita na nossa cidade.

We are mother and daughter, Margarida and Filipa. One is a doctor, the other has a ceramics, drawing and printing workshop in the city center (Oficina Gato Bravo - you're welcome to visit!). We also love to work as hosts, it's a great challenge and an opportunity to meet interesting people, and give them everything for a perfect stay in our city.

reviews.comments: The Quarry Apartment is simply stunning - being able to have breakfast outside in a private courtyard is definitely a wonderful bonus. To come home to a very comfortable bed and fantastic shower after a day of exploring is a true treat. Tastefully furnished, the love for design is apparent and to be found in every detail of the house. The pictures shown don't do justice to the reality of this place. At a two minute walk from Trindade Metrostation you’ll find that everything you need and look for in Porto is really within walking distance. Small cafés, design shops, markets with local products, you name it. Thank you Filipa for being such a warm-hearted host. We really appreciated the extra towels, Nespresso and cold wine & Coke in the fridge :-)
Adoramos a nossa estadia no apartamento Quarry! A disponibilidade da Filipa & Margarida, o conforto, a limpeza, decoração e localização!

The appartment was very good furnished and decorated but very dark and cold. We had the heating on day and night whith a outside temperatur about 22 degrees. I missed the daylight very much and the little patio looks nice but  it was also dark. Maybe at high summer it is a good and cool place to stay. The area was very quiet and nearby the old city.

Très bon accueil, le logement est bien situé, au calme, propre et agréable: très bien pour visiter Porto en toute tranquillité. 
Que du bon sur l'accueil et la communication tout au long du séjour également. 
Bref, je recommande.  
Le manque de lumière décrit précédemment ne m'a pas gêné, bien contrebalancé par la déco très sympa.

Filipa welcomed us at the apartment and gave us all the necessary information. We could easily reach her via phone during our stay.
Communication via email prior to our arrival was also uncomplicated.
We can highly recommend her as a host!

The apartment is a real gem: historic Porto building, fully renovated and still keeping it's old charm. All used materials are of high quality and very solid. The limited space is perfectly used with built-in cupboards, double-storey ensuite double-bed + bathroom area, even leaving space for a small private patio outside.

Location is tops: right in the heart of Porto, next to the Metro-interchange "Trinidade". A walk down to the river and the more touristy area Ribeira is no problem, when you are too tired for your way back up, the Metro or a taxi is easily arranged and not pricy.

Only slight downside in Porto in the center is the lack of free parking space, but again next to Filipas apartment there is parking available (expect up to 1 EUR/hour), Filipa can give you advise on the best option and how to get there.

Overall experience: great! We came as a family with 4 adults and a 3-year-old (3 generations) and everybody was happy with this choice!

Für einen Kurztrip nach Porto können wir die Unterkunft sehr empfehlen. Die Lage ist perfekt ! 100 Meter von der U-Bahn Station Trindade, von wo man in allen Richtungen fahren kann. In 10 Minuten im Zentrum. Direkt um die Ecke ein tolles Cafe wo man für wenig Geld phantastisch frühstücken kann !
Die Wohnung ist voll ausgestattet. Es fehlt im Prinzip nichts. Philippa war super zu erreichen und die Kommunikation einwandfrei.
Einziger Punkt der für uns nicht optimal war, dass es in der Wohnung recht dunkel und etwas klamm ist, da es sich um ein einen alten Steinbau handelt. Nichts desto trotz , Top renoviert und für einige Tage absolut geeignet ...
Würden gerne wiederkommen
Great place to stay in Porto, beautiful design and very well located. Comunication with host was perfect during our stay.

El apartamento es perfecto. Muy bien situado, cerca del centro de la ciudad. Es muy bonito por dentro, estaba súper limpio y con todos los detalles para estar cómodos. Filipa nos recibió a nuestra llegada y nos explicó todo perfectamente.
Si volvemos a Oporto, sin duda volveremos a su apartamento.

It was nice being so close to the metro station! The apartment is gorgeous and was everything we needed. It's true that it is very dark in there and there is not a lot of natural light, but since we spent most of our time outside it didn't bother us too much.
Dieses Haus ist ein Juwel, man kann nur gratulieren, wie wunderbar das alles gemacht wurde. Vielen lieben Dank!

La casa es igual que en las fotos. La anfitriona muy accesible y en contacto con nostras todo el tiempo a pesar de no estar en la ciudad. Esta situada muy cerca del centro, se puede ir a pie o en metro que esta en la puerta de la casa. La unica pega que le ponemos es la falta de iluminacion, sobre todo por la noche las lamparas tienen poca luz y no iluminan la casa lo suficiente. Recomendable
Ideal locaion. Great apartment
Super nice place! I can definitely recommend it! Had a really good time here!

The apartment is nicely decorated and very comfortable. Located in a quite place and within walking distance of all sights. Margarida & Filipa are great hosts, very easy to contact and they make sure that you feel welcome in their home.
Tudo óptimo, especialmente a nível de localização, interior da casa, limpeza, estava tudo bom.
This place is very nice and comfortable. The wifi was excellent and the kitchen was easy to cook in. Margarida was a sweet host and was easy to communicate with.

Un séjour très agréable dans un logement très joliment rénové, confortable, parfaitement situé à proximité immédiate des transports (métro, bus), calme pour une situation en ville. Proximité du Centre touristique et commerces.
Logement très bien aménagé, douillet avec une petite terrasse au calme sur une cour intérieure. Propreté impeccable.
Un accueil très agréable de nos hôtesses en amont du séjour et sur place.
Great place. Apartment looks amazing. Probably wouldn't stay there in winter, since it is quite chilly and a little humid, but good for hot summer nights. Perfect starting point to explore the city.

The appartment was located in the center of the city but on a street where there was not much trafic which was good. The design was very cool and the patio was perfect for breakfasts. Me and my girlfriend really enjoyed our stay in this nice appartment!

The apartment has a very good connection to the metro and is in the middle of the city. You can reach a lot of things by foot. It is very close to the nightspots, like bars.The connection was very friendly. I would recommend it anytime.

Nous avons eu un super séjour dans cet environnement unique et confortable. Prendre le café ou l'apéro dans la cour intérieur était tout simplement magique. L'appartement est vraiment magnifique, les enfants ont adoré les lumières sous la vitre du plancher où l'on voit les vestiges de la pierre. Filipa nous disait que la restauration de l'immeuble a été fait par un architecte et cela se voit dans tous les détails. Il y a même un rideau électrique qui descend pour plus d'intimité à la mezzanine si on vient entre amis. C'est un peu humide à cause des murs de pierres et un peu sombre mais il y a des lumières partout et l'ambiance est incroyable. Nous le recommandons vivement! L'emplacement est idéal. Merci à Filipa pour ce super séjour, nous n'avons manqué de rien.
Très bien placé
Muy cerca del centro, el apartamento muy xulo
Très bien placé et très bien aménagé, l'appartement est très agréable malgré le manque de luminosité , à recommander

Tout d'abord un très bon accueil de l'amie de filipa avec une arrivé tardive. Elle nous a montrer tout le fonctionnement de l'appartement qui est vraiment superbe. La cuisine est très bien équipé avec tout ce dont on a besoin. L'appartement présente également une jolie terrasse qui est très agréable pour manger dehors. La chambre présente un store qui est pratique pour ceux qui aime dormir dans le noir complet. Des prospectus et un guide de la ville sont également disponible pour permettre d'organiser ses journées. 
Je recommande cette appartement. Merci à silvia l'amie de filipa
Apartment was fantastic. Exactly as described in the profile and pics. Cute little nook in the back. Anytime I had a question Filipa was quick to respond.

Super appartement idéalement situé dans un quartier calme et proche de toute la vie portuense. Bien équipé, cosy et confortable avec une hôtesse à l'écoute ! Un joli puits de jour qui fait office de petite terrasse agréable. Un mini bémol, si vous êtes sensibles, (ce qui n'est pas notre cas) l'appartement construit dans la pierre est un peu humide avec des odeurs de salpêtre. Personnellement nous n'avons pas été gênés car nous sommes habitués aux maisons, disons, rurales. L'appartement est super fonctionnel on sent la patte d'un architecte d'intérieur dans le design du lieu !

Mieszkanie bardzo ladnie urządzone i super zlokalizowane!
Niestety przeszkadza trochę wilgoć, cienkie sciany i owady w toalecie

Le logement est très agréable, idéalement situé dans Porto, près d'une station de métro qui va directement à l'aéroport. Il est décoré avec goût et possède une jolie petite terrasse. Margarida & Filipa répondent très rapidement et sont très serviables.
Bon accueil, appartement tres sympathique conforme a la description sur internet tres bon séjour

Interessantes Apartment - vielleicht ein wenig dunkel. Günstig gelegen.
Für uns war alles okay.
Bel appartement et très bien situé. Facile d’accès. Il y a toutes les commodités pour un séjour pour deux personnes.
Great area and host, awesome city and it’s perfectly located!

We stayed for 4 nights in this lovely appartment. 

We did not have a problem with the missing daylight, we turned on the light and it is very cosy. 

We opened the windows during the day so there was a good ventilation and we did not smell the moisture. 

The appartment is very special designed. We had everything we needed and we felt very comfortable.

The location was perfect.

When we visit Porto again we will visit Margarida & Filipa for sure!
beautiful restoration of an old house, the place is really interesting and good situated!

Absolutely a wonderful place with everything you could need. Close to the Metro and a super market right around the corner. Plenty of place to choose for eating.... warning- stay away from Christina's(horrible service and food). There was a couple of issues with the tenants who have the apartment above. They will throw their water off their balcony on to you if on the patio.

I would stay here again and recommend this place to anyone and everyone.

A casa da Margarida e da Filipa é muito gira. Adoro o design. Tenho pena por não entrar tanta luz natural e por a casa ser um pouco escura. Mas de resto a localização é ótima. Fica perto de tudo o que necessitámos. A Filipa respondeu-nos sempre num espaço de 5 min o que é ótimo e esteve lá pronta para nos receber. Aconselho este espaço principalmente a casais. Muito giro, gostei muito. Obrigada por tudo.

Very cool apartment indeed, maybe even more spacious than you'd get from the pictures. Previous reviews are very right about the location, the limited daylight (also in the patio, but very cosy lamps inside to make up) and the (smell of) humidity/moisture in the apartment (during summer I'm sure it's fine as you can air by opening windows, during winter that might be a bit fresh). Kitchen is also spacious and well-equipped, just be sure to use the pot holder to move pans as their handles get very hot. All in all I'd recommend it.
Super address!

Although we were only for a few days in Porto, we could enjoy the stay. Specially due to the very good apartment. Centrally located, easy to reach from the metro. Very good quality, very clean and well maintained. Trust the pictures in airbnb, but reallity is better!
Above all, the good communication has prepared joy.
Absolutely recommendable!

En el baño de arriba habia hormigas que hacen la estancia un tanto incomoda...
El equipamiento de cuchillos y tenedores y ollas un poco antiguo/deteriorado, tampoco habia vasos. La temperatura de la planta de abajo es bastante fria. Y en general poca luz natural.
La ubicacion es muy buena y Filipa siempre ha estado muy disponible tanto para la llegada como para conversaciones anteriores.
A perfectly located flat with lots of character.
It was great. Love the space. Also great with a kid!  Did not mind it’s a bit darker, enough light and gives a nice ambience

Mooi en origineel appartement, tof terras, ideale ligging (verbinding metro met luchthaven kan niet beter en een op een kwartier van de leuke straatjes), alles wat je nodig hebt is aanwezig! Af en toe is de hoge vochtigheidsgraad niet zo aangenaam maar dat neem je er graag bij tijdens een verblijf in dit top appartement!

Je recommande ce logement, pour toutes les raisons imaginables : emplacement, accueil, aménagement et équipement de l’appartement, confort (bons matelas), enfin... l’appartement a tout pour rendre votre séjour PARFAIT!

Le logement a beaucoup de charme, il a été décoré avec beaucoup de goût et est parfaitement équipé. Il est taillé dans la pierre donc il est humide et on peut trouver quelques fourmis mais cela ne nous a pas dérangé. Filipa a été réactive à nos questions et à accepté de nous recevoir malgré l’heure d’arrivee tardive. Porto est une très belle ville qui se visite à pieds, le logement est à environ 20min (avec montées et descentes !) du quartier touristique de la Ribeira et se situe à la sortie du métro qui permet de rejoindre l'aéroport, ce qui est très pratique

Super appartement met alle voorzieningen. Misschien een beetje donker maar dan doe je toch gezellig de lampen aan. Als je last hebt van een beetje muffe lucht dan gedurende de dag ramen open en je ruikt niets.
Werkelijk een aanrader, super mooie douche en heel schoon.

Beautiful apartment. Very friendly hosts. All the features you would desire for your stay; full kitchen and washing machine. Bathrooms are a little small for a larger person. Location is a very short walk to all the sights in Porto, and conveniently near Trindade station and a few large grocery stores.
Super mooi en sfeervol appartement. Goed en compleet ingericht, ook prima badkamer en keuken. Oude centrum om de hoek!

Très bel endroit, rénové avec goût. La seule critique serait son manque de lumière. Mais il est idéalement situé, à 150m du métro qui va directement à l'aéroport. Bien situé aussi dans le centre, on peut sans problème visiter à pied.
Accueil adorable de Filipa qui parle français!!
it's in central, good

Margarida nous a très bien accueillis malgré notre retard (train en retard de 40 mn). L'appartement est conforme aux photos, avec effectivement une petite odeur d'humidité due aux murs en pierre. Mais il est très propre. Le coin nuit est très calme, on n'entend pas du tout la rue. Le lit est très confortable.
Nous n'avons pas pu profiter de la terrasse car il y avait des travaux à côté le premier jour, et les autres jours il pleuvait, mais c'est certainement un plus bien appréciable.
L'appartement est très bien situé, juste à côté du métro et près du centre et du Douro (15 mn à pied). Nous avons fait toutes nos visites à pied. Il y a un supermarché juste à côté.
Notre hôte nous a indiqué des lieux à voir et il y a un petit guide en français très pratique à disposition dans l'appartement.
Nous recommandons pour un petit séjour à Porto et une expérience dans un appartement de ce style.

We had a great time during our stay in porto. The apartment is really nice and absolutly great located. The Trindade Metro Station, a grocery and some good reastaurants as well are close by. Filipa was always reachable and replied quickly to my messages. We would definitley come back and i highly recommend this gorgeous little apartment!
Perfect location!

Le logement de Filipa est très bien situé, en plein coeur d'un quartier de Porto en plein expansion avec plusieurs cafés et restaurants nouveaux genres (avec très peu de touristes !) Nous avons particulièrement aimé l'architecture et le design unique du logement !  De plus, le logement offre une petite court intérieure des plus sympathiques qui permet de décompresser même en plein coeur de la ville !

Un très bon séjour, dans un quartier agréable (assez bobo). Près du quartier touristique, on a pu se déplacer presque uniquement qu'à pieds. L'appartement possède du charme, cependant il y a l'odeur un peu prononcée de l'humidité liée à la pierre néanmoins pas particulièrement dérangeante pour nous ! (A noter qu'un appareil pour atténuer cette humidité était mis à notre disposition)
A bit better than the pictures and a cosy apartment. Very good location!
Clean and stylish! We appreciate the washing machine since we had been traveling for a while.

L’appartamento è molto bello, arredato con gusto e in una posizione ottima. Filipa è stata disponibile e gentile. Purtroppo però la zona giorno della casa è sotto il livello della strada e l’appartamento risulta molto umido e con un forte odore di umidità. C’è un piccolo spazio all’aperto, anche questo molto umido e pieno di insetti e zanzare, che lo rendono poco fruibile. Se dovessi tornare a Porto non alloggerei nuovamente qui.
Obrigadas! Tudo é ótimo!
Buona posizione casa bella ma poco funzionale. Ottima accoglienza e disponibilità
El alojamiento es fantástico, mejor incluso que en las fotos... La anfitriona tuvo mucho gusto en su decoración y tuvo detalles con nosotros. Sin duda cuando volvamos a Porto repetiremos!!

The apartment is wonderful! It was clean and comfortable, and the location is great to explore Porto by foot.
Filipa was very kind and welcoming.
We would definitely stay there again!
Loft décoré avec goût, fonctionnel et bien situé. Une hôte disponible et accueillante. A recommander sans hésitation !
LOVED IT! Nice location and space. Filipa was great:)  Would definitely stay here again!!!

We absolutely loved are stay in Porto. Beautiful apartment with everything we needed. One tiny remark that we did have is that the Wi-Fi wasn’t great, but that didn’t bother us too much eather.
Would defenitely recommend!!
The loft is very stylish and well located, had an easy time walking back from bars or restaurants!

Das Appartement ist von der Lage bestens geeignet um die Stadt zu erkunden. Metro Station ist in unmittelbarer Nähe. Aber auch zu Fuß ist man in 10min in Riberia und dem Kneipenviertel von Porto. 
Das Appartement ist liebevoll saniert und hat seinen ganz eigenen Charme. Wir hatten eine schöne Zeit dort. Filipa war immer gut zu erreichen. Wenn ich wieder in Porto bin, dann bestimmt in diesem Appartement.

Really nice apartment close to the shopping areas and Trindade station, where you can catch all of the metro lines. Very quiet despite its location and 2 minutes from a supermarket.
Everything in the apartment works, and the shower is great. If you're unsteady on your feet then the spiral staircase means this is probably not for you.
Super bem localizado! Estilo muito giro! Decoração fantástica! limpeza impecável!  Recomendo!!
Excelente localização , muito aconchegante o espaço do apartamento ! Contribuiu para que nossa estadia em Porto fosse maravilhosa . O metro é muito perto !

Sehr schönes Apartment, zentrale Lage, alles gut zu Fuß zu erreichen, Bahnhof direkt um die Ecke. 
Leider um diese Jahreszeit etwas feucht und kalt in der Wohnung, aber sehr schön eingerichtet.

L'appartement est très bien situé, juste à quelques pas de la station de métro et à 5 min à pieds du centre ville. Il est parfait pour un couple qui souhaite passer quelques jours à Porto quand il fait chaud ! Je ne vous recommande pas de booker cet appartement quand il fait froid en revanche, car le chauffage n'est pas très performant et les problèmes d'humidité se font sentir. Mais il parait qu'il n'y a pas beaucoup d'appartements qui sont bien chauffés à Porto. Nous aurions souhaité profiter de la terrasse mais il faisait assez froid pour petit-déjeuner dehors. Il se pourrait qu'on reloge dans cet appartement quand on reviendra à Porto en été si les problèmes de tuyauterie de la douche sont réglés.

reviews.comments:
We enjoyed our stay very much, thanks to great recommendations about things to do. 
The only thing, third bed was a little bit unfomfortable. Besides that the apartment was clean, stylish and with some nice touches. 
Also the location is a huge advantage. Almost everything is within walking distance.

Très bon rapport qualité/prix avec un très bon emplacement. On peut accéder au centre de Porto rapidement. 
Mais ça reste un peu bruyant, ce ne doit pas être du double vitrage. 
Très contente en tout cas.

Experiencia buena. Ubicación excelente. El anfitrión muy atento, la información muy detallada sobre la ciudad. La cama muy cómoda, aunque el sofá - cama algo incómodo y algo ruidoso. Aconsejable llevar tapones. Sin duda repetiriamos sobre todo por la gran amabilidad y disponibilidad de Bruno.
Todo perfecto! relación precio calidad super, la ubicación super.

Appartement très bien situé, à 5 minutes à pied,des restaurants et des commerces,métro.
Notre hôte a été très facile à joindre. Immeuble calme.

Très satisfaits ! La qualité principale de cet appartement est sa situation (centre ville, gares) dont vous pourrez profiter au maximum grâce aux conseils avisés du propriétaire (indications des visites, bonnes adresses, carte détaillée ..). Le lit ainsi que les équipements sont de bonne qualité également. Les points négatifs seraient la douche qui n’est pas très pratique et un peu vétuste et enfin le bruit de la rue en cas de sommeil léger... Parfait pour un petit séjour à Porto et dans ses environs !
Merci pour ce séjour ! L'appartement nous a bien convenu !

Very central location, can be (of course) somewhat noisy during workday mornings.
I definitely recommend this place if you expect a simple  accommodation within few minutes of walk to anywhere you may need. Exactly what you need when staying few nights in Porto.

the cost is not worthwhile for the service that we received. I don't recommend
The house, is really small basically just a room.
The moquette was not clean and full of dust, I'm allergic... 
The bathroom really small as well it was not clean, particulary the shower and the towels.
Bruno asks for extra payment for the check in after 9pm, fro 15 to 30 euro, not written in the description, he says because he has to pay someone to come, that someone was him... When we ask for a receipt he didn't want to give us.
He charged us 50 euro plus for an almost invisible wine stain on the  bedcover, really easy to clean. 
I didn't have a good experience.
apartamento muito bem localizado, ótimas instalações! não é tão barulhento quanto eu esperava. foi bem agradável.

Appartamento centrale, a soli 5 minuti dalla metro ''24 de agosto''. Tutti i posti sono raggiungibili a piedi se amate passeggiare. Bruno è una grande persona..mi ha mostrato la casa e mi ha dato mille consigli sulla città. È stato sempre disponibile rispondendo 24h su 24h. Ci sono tutti i servizi come da descrizione! Bellissima esperienza. Bel posto.Lo Consiglio!
Per me il massimo dei voti all'host! 
Buon viaggio.
Ciao Raff

A great location and a very nice space for the value. A simple, functional and extremely well located studio apartment. The host is always available and very kind also. Its an excellent alternative in a very nice area of Porto.
Very nice place, large windows and lots of light, in a very central location.

name: Flats4Rent Ribeira Historic Apartment 31
summary: This apartment is located in  Porto Downtown, namely in the historic centre, classified World Heritage by UNESCO. You will be  amazed at the walking distances to get to Ribeira, Douro River, restaurants, shops, entertainment and nightlife. This charming apartment provides you comfort and surely an amazing stay in a rehabilitated historical building. Its natural light, high ceilings and peculiar details will surprise you as you enter this incredible open space..
space: Welcome to Flats4Rent Ribeira Historic Apartment 31 This great open space apartment has got different defined areas: a sleeping area with a double bed, a living room area with a sofa and a dining area to enjoy your meals or just a drink. It also has a fully equipped kitchenette where you can cook your own meals. A hob, a fridge, a microwave and all the essential kitchen utensils are available. The wooden floor is original and be amazed by its big and high windows that let the natural light invade the apartment. Open the high balcony, take a look outside and feel what is happening in downtown. You will be surprised by the natural light in the apartment and its unique details. namely by the different modern and functional toilet. With a modern design but very cosy, our flats are meant to make you feel at home. We truly believe that details can make the difference and that is why our apartments are full of them. This apartment is placed in a totally refurbished historical building located

Its natural light, high ceilings and peculiar details will surprise you as you enter this incredible open space.. Un week-end vraiment sympathique, un appartement très bien situé, facile pour se balader et visiter la ville de Porto. Diogo est un hôte super sympathique et arrangeant ! Je recommence fortement !

Appartement très agréable et très propre. Le quartier est calme et proche du métro. L'hôte est à l'écoute et acceuillant. Très bonne expérience, je recommande sans hésiter (Website hidden by Airbnb) The appartment is very pleasant and clean. The district is quite and near the metro station. The host very sympatic and welcoming. I totaly recommend

appartement très bien situé et calme et propre
métro pas loin 
 tous les commerces et restaurants à 5 minutes à pied parfait pour un séjour à 2.
Nice appartment, good situation in Porto!
Отличная квартира! Очень комфортная и чистая. Всё рядом; магазины, кафе, бары, центр. Нас встретили очень тепло и дружелюбно. Остались всем довольны.

The location is very good, the ocean side and the river side are half hour distance either and there are many options of the public transport! The apartment is good too, they should develop the cleanliness.
Buon alloggio in ottima posizione. Buona l'accoglienza dal membro della Concierge assegnato.
Diogo was not present and not very reactive but it was a good journey. Thank you.

We greatly enjoyed our stay at Diogo's apartment.
The communication was very good friendly.
Diogo gave us a warm welcome and a lot of touristic tips. Super!
The apartment is very clean and cozy and has a terras.
 It is very well equipped (wifi, TV, kitchen, Bathroom, ....)
The location is close to the center.
The bedroom is on the backside and is very quiet.
There is no car-parking nearby. 
Thanks it was great!
T&K

Diogo appartement is well located closed to downtown Porto easy connected by metro. This appartement have a simple and functional kitchen and a large sleeping room with a lot of furniture. We enjoy also small balcony. The only bad thing was the sleeping room walls are quite fine but we sleep good.

This is a hidden gem in Porto. I loved my stay. The apartment is full of light, clean, tastefully designed. Was super close to my office so I just walked.  Diogo was always available to help & shared with me useful tips to explore Porto. Very highly recommended.

localização incrível, excelentes opções de restaurantes shoppings, mercados.
apartamento super útil me senti em casa.

Diago was very nice and helpful.
Great apartment 
Good location 
Thank you
Apartamento de ótimo tamanho para duas pessoas. Localização excelente e muita atenção e cuidado na recepção.
