host.host_about:
We are passionate about traveling.

When we travel our goal is always to have a good time and bring back good memories, same applies to our guests, we always try to deliver the best experience possible.

At the moment we have various rooms available across two flats in the same building in the heart of Porto downtown, the location is excellent and we can guarantee a good time in Porto :)

reviews.comments:
L'appartement de Mario a été rénové récemment et est vraiment très propre et bien agencé, chaque chambre à sa propre salle de bain, la cuisine est bien équipée (avec un lave vaisselle). 
Il est un peu excentré mais accessible facilement avec le métro depuis l'aéroport. 
Mario était disponible et à même créé une petite application avec quelques places à visiter et bons restaurants et bars à tester.

Our stay was really great and Mario was an amazing guest! We arrived very late (around midnight) and he was waiting for us. He also told us about his app, with a suggestion of places to visit and a walking tour: really helpful and well done!
The apartment has been recently restructured and it has all the necessary comforts. It's really close to the metro station with a direct line from the airport, and you can reach the city center by walk in 10-20 min.
I think it's a great place to stay for visiting Porto!

Marios place is lovely, really spacious and open. We were really glad it was so convenient by transport from airport and to the bus station, huge bonus. The only challenge would be the noise on the busy street but we managed to sleep through it anyway. Nice place. We would come back for sure
Confortable, friendly and cozy
Great experience! Wonderful appartment and the Host Mario is really Nice! Place to be!

Mario's place is conveniently located next to a metro stop and is walking distance to the historic area of Porto.  I loved the neighborhood's mix of old buildings and small local bars and cafes, with a few gastronomic restaurants, Seattle style coffee shops and art studios scattered throughout.  It is obviously a neighborhood in transition.  The apartment is in an old building that was recently renovated in very nice taste. My room was spacious and beautiful, and the bed was very comfortable with hotel quality sheets.I thoughly enjoyed my stay.
Nice place, clean, good looking. Mario's app is useful and nice to use to discover Porto ! We'll definitely come back :)

The place looked amazing, had lot of room and light. It was about 10 minute walk to the old town and had a metro station right next to the house. Mario is really easy to talk to and responds quickly. 

 It is a perfect place to stay with a group of friends.

We loved our stay! 

Thank you Mario

Mario's place was nice, clean and decorated beautifully. it seems exactly like the pictures and our room was spacious enough. Something that bothered us a little was the noise from the outside (the house is at a central road ) and also kitchen is not full equipment.
Mario answered really quickly, he was helpful, kind and we would like to meet and as we only communicated via phone.
Muita obrigada.
Mario's place was so nice! It is in a quiet but perfect location. The house is awesome and perfectly clean and the access to the room was easy. 100% recommendable

Mario is nice host, he was very helpful with all his advices.
The apartment is top clean, central located, seems new renovated, and we liked there a lot.
I can Mario and his flat highly recommend!

Mario's apartment was easy to find, just across the road from the metro station. He was very welcoming and even showed us his own app- which was so helpful navigating the sights of Porto! The apartment was spacious and had everything you needed, our only complaint would be the beds and pillows could be more comfortable. Location wise being near the metro was handy, as despite the close-ish proximity to Porto's central sights, the hills can be exhausting!
Everything's gone fine. Very clean and large house. Pictures corrisponded perfectly to the reality. Mario was available and kind.

The apartment is layed out beautifully inside. The noise of the street was quite loud, even at night. We had to sleep with earplugs. Breakfast was at a coffee shop, easily accessible with metro but still 15min away. Mario responds quickly on the phone if questions. The apartment was clean and very close to a metro station or just a 15min walk to the centre of town.
The host canceled this reservation 2 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.

Mario's flat is really neat and comfortable. It is at walking distance from the center and there's a metro station just down the building. Mario wasn't there in person but was always available on the phone and quick to respond. One downside is the noise from the street, which is pretty busy even at night.

L'appartamento si trova in una posizione tranquilla e poco caotica,leggermente distante dai principali luoghi di attrazione di Porto. Metro vicinissima che collega l'aeroporto con la casa(noi abbiamo solo camminato per ammirare questo gioiellino di città) così come a due passi la stazione degli autobus. La cucina è ben fornita e una sala pranzo luminosissima e ampia con cui conversare con gli altri guest della casa.
Sfortunatamente non ho incontrato Mario ma assicuro sulla sua disponibilità e immediatezza nel rispondere ai messaggi. Super disponibile.
Excellent newly renovated place with perfect location to porto train station, just two metro stops away. Very convenient idea with check in using key box with a passcode. I enjoyed the stay very much

Mario's place is a great location, steps from the metro and walking distance to most sights.  The place is sunny, comfortable, spacious and clean: definitely a great value.  If you are sensitive to street noise, you should know, it is just above an intersection, which is quite noisy, so pack your ear-plugs!
The appartment was great, very clean and well located. The comunication with Mario was easy. We've been so comfortable in his appartment!
Corresponde con el anuncio.

Mario's place is a stylish apartment near the city's main tourist attractions, it is also well situated in terms of its vicinity to public transport. Mario encouraged us to download his app: a tourist guide along the city, which proved to be helpful.
Muito eficiente o sistema adotado e tudo correu perfeitamente.

Wir haben diese Unterkunft sehr genossen, wenn auch nur kurz.
Super Beschreibung und dadurch gut zu finden bzw in die Wohnung zu kommen...super praktisch eingerichtet - alles Da, was man braucht...super sauber - top !!! Danke ;-)

Appartement magnifique. Juste à côté du centre. Esthétique, aéré et lumineux. La décoration est simple, épurée. Après une journée de découverte dans Porto on s'y sent bien. Le matelas est super confortable, on dort bien. Si vous avez le sommeil léger c'est mieux de prendre des boules quies. Mario est très gentil et a répondu à toutes nos questions! Petit déjeuner dans le bar est top.
Merci beaucoup, on a passé un super séjour :-)

Comoda e ampia stanza (per due più che abbondante!) in grande e bell' appartamento restaurato con cura nei particolari appositamente allo scopo di affittare le stanze, il che lo rende ideale e piacevole. Grande e bella l'area comune, con una cucina abitabile e ben attrezzata. Bagno funzionale, privato ma separato dalla camera dal corridoio della casa; peccato per uno sgradevole odore di scarico proveniente (credo) dalla doccia. Biancheria lavata e pulita, ma con aloni e qualche piccola macchia: se non fosse bianca nemmeno si vedrebbero, ma dato che lo è... si vedono!
Mario ottimo host, sempre presente, disponibile e ben organizzato, niente da dire!  
Nel complesso, se si vuole girare la città, più che consigliato!! Sì è sul lato est del centro, ad un passo dalla fermata della metro, che spesso si può non usare se si è disposti a camminare 10 minuti in più.
Muy bien explicado cómo llegar a su cas y cómo recoger las llaves! La casa está limpia, tambien la habitación. Muy recomendable!
Very clean and professional place. beautiful flat.

La habitación es preciosa y amplia. Mario ha sido un anfitrión fantástico y aunque no lo conocimos en persona  estado siempre pendiente.  La zona es tranquila pero céntrica. Por poner un defecto, no hay armario en la habitación,  aunque sí un espejo con perchas y espacio para colgar ripa.

It's a lovely renovated house, close to the city centre, with a subway station nearby.  Mario was a great host, very thoughtfull! It's a great place to stay if you're looking to explore life in oPorto.

Al llegar nos faltaba ropa de cama,ya que otros huéspedes se habían tomado el atrevimiento de entrar en nuestra habitación. 
A la hora de abandonar el piso,nos obligaron a dejar el alojamiento mediante tres llamadas,en porto caía el diluvio y nos dieron la posibilidad de dejar allí las maletas.
Mario además de airbnb  tiene otro negocio para dejar las maletas por  2,50...
A informação de que não há  elevador, deveria estar explícita.

Nicely located, modern and brilliantly clean space - the room and en suite were like a hotel! Solid inside knowledge from a very helpful host on the best places to visit in this beautiful city. Thanks heaps!
Everything went well 5 stars

Emplacement idéal pour tous ceux qui doivent rejoindre l'aéroport ou la gare des bus. 
Appartement spacieux, propre, fonctionnel.
Système de remise des clefs très efficace.
Flexible and helpful. Very good honor

O apartamento é ótimo, limpo e confortável. A localização é ótima, perto de supermercados, a uma pequena caminhada das atrações, em frente ao metro que dá acesso direto ao aeroporto. Mario deixou um mapa muito legal com dicas de roteiros. Não conhecemos o Mario, mas tudo correu bem na hospedagem. Recomendo.

Quarto grande e muito agradável numa casa maravilhosa, espaçosa e cheia de luz. No entanto, as janelas não fechavam completamente, e apesar do aquecedor, estava um bocado frio. De resto, tudo bom. Bom valor pelo preço.

It’s ok to stay couple of days, but if you want privacy in apartment it might be a problem because there is a 4 rooms with diferent people, and you must share living room and bathroom with others. And its very cold inside.
Fue genial la habitación Mario es muy atento a la llegada y comparte información que da buenos tips para conocer Oporto. Recomiendo este lugar, algo más por decir es que la cama es muy cómoda.

Ótimo Airbnb para casais e grupos de amigos! O imóvel está muito próximo ao metro e a restaurantes locais, além de contar com uma ótima infra-estrutura. O Mario foi muito solicito e respondeu todas as mensagens prontamente.

Mario was really understanding about check in and check out times. He helped us about anything we asked. The flat is so comfortable and well decorated. We haven’t met Mario, but I really recommend his apartment!

Seconda volta per me con Airbnb, a differenza dell'altra non ho avuto il piacere di conoscere l'host ma rimane sempre disponibile via telefono. Appartamento e stanze molto moderni e con tutti i comfort necessari (attenzione: in Portogallo non hanno il riscaldamento, ma è fornita una stufetta per riscaldare la stanza). Molto comodo il metodo di check-in e check-out in quanto si deve solo depositare la chiave. Molto consigliato anche per la posizione!
Large and stylish apartment. Good location for exploring of Porto but very noisy (earplugs are required). Otherwise, everything was realy fine.
Esta céntrico, relación calidad precio muy bueno.
Great value for money. Check in was really easy and Mario was really flexible with our check-in process.
Nossa estadia foi ótima, bairro próximo ao centro, ótimas acomodações, local muito limpo. Adoramos!!!

We really enjoyed our stay in Mario’s apartment. The apartment is very clean, large and bright. Mario instantly replied any questions we had and offered his help. The apartment is further very good connected to public transport. The centre of porto is reachable within 5 to 10 minutes by foot.

Muy eficaz y práctica la entrega de las llaves, así se permite tener plena libertad de hora de llegada. Preciosa habitación muy amplia y luminosa. He tenido un poco de frío al llegar pero mejoró con la pequeña estufa eléctrica. El ruido de la calle me despertó muy temprano pero la verdad, qué más se puede pedir a este precio tan económico!! En conclusión una muy buena relación calidad precio! Gracias Mario! Volveremos!!

Todo perfecto, buena comunicación con Mario que nos ayudó a resolver todas las dudas que teníamos sobre Oporto, La señora de la limpieza muy amable y siempre dispuesta a ayudarnos, muy buena experiencia, nos gusta bastante caminar para conocer los rincones de las ciudades y esta ubicación nos ha venido muy bien para desplazarnos andando por la ciudad.
The room was a bit cold but it was in a great neighborhood and walkable to the tourist areas.

Very nice apartment with cute details especially in the living room! The offered breakfast was next to the sightseeing point ‚Capela das Almas’ and a good start for a day in Porto. Thanks for having us :)

We stayed with Mario for three nights. It was very easy to get to the station from the airport by metro, as the train station (Campo 24 de Agosto) is right next to the house. Checking in is very easy and uncomplicated. 
The room is bright and modern. The private bathroom is located on the opposite side of the corridor. The kitchen is fully equipped, e. g. with fridge, freezer, dishwasher, fridge, etc. We kept some drinks and fruit in the fridge. 
The city centre and the river are only a few minutes' walk away. We rented bicycles for four days, which was a little bit unnecessary because everything can be reached either on foot or by metro. Nevertheless, we enjoyed a day trip by bike to the beach along the river. One trip took about 45 minutes. 
We appreciated Mario's quick reactions and his helpfulness. We would stay at Mario's place again.
방이랑 화장실이 매우 깔끔한 숙소입니다.  체크인시간 전에는 청소하는 시간이기 때문에 시간은 지켜주는게 좋은데 체크인전에 짐만 놓을 수는 있습니다. 엘리베이터가 없지만 2층이라서 캐리어를 옮기는데 큰 어려움은 없었습니다. Marco는 매우 친절했습니다.  직접 만든 포르투여행어플도 있었습니다.:)
非常好~It’s a good place

I'm happy that I made this choise, it is beautiful and well localised appartment. It was easy to get there from the airport (by metro), close to the old city (by foot); next to the terminal for longdistance buses (so you can visit other cities in Portugal). I had separate room with bathroom in fornt of it, there is a shared space like living room and kitchen, wher you can meet other people and have an interesting conversation. I really like this place. In addition Mario is very kind and helpfull.

Mario is a really nice landlord and we communicate well! The room is really tidy! And it's really convenient because it's near the metro station. What surprises me most is that it's even close to the coach station !!
El apartamento es igual (o incluso mejor) que en las imágenes. Está muy bien ubicado, hay aparcamiento gratuito al lado y además el contacto con Mario fue muy fácil y rápido. Repetiríamos sin duda!
Really nice, clean and modern apartment. Great communication with the owner. The top was his application with Porto ´ s map and tips what to see.    Recommend this accomodation!

Bright, spacious and stylish room (and the whole place really). If all old houses were refurbished like this, I would love to live in one. Good location and the custom map with tips was a great touch. Everything lived up to our expectations, except for two small things. I definitely recommend this place, just keep in mind: the windows are not really sound-proof so in the morning, when the cars start roaming the streets, you will hear them. The private bathroom is not within the room, but across a corridor. Quite close but not as private as if it was inside. Great value!

Appartement très agréable. Fidèle aux photos. Accès facile. Station de métro à côté, au pied des commodités. 
Logement un peu bruyant mais on s´y fait. 

Mario est joignable et très réactif et ce soucis du confort de ses hôtes. 

Je conseil ce logement.

Our stayed in this room was amazing. We had a great time exploring Porto. Although we didn’t met Mario his local tips and map were very helpful. The check-in is very flexible since you get a code to get into the apartment. We would definitely recommend this place!

Loved the architecture of a curved building and walls, the spacious room, the easy to use kitchen, lots of communication when I needed it. There was a plumbing seal problem with the shower that meant water spraying around...easily fixed. Appreciated the few extra touches such as tea bags, espresso coffee capsules (that i didnt know how to use!). Only problem was the traffic noise as I didnt realise I was obove a rountabour of 5 main street intersections...luckily the Portugese are not early risers otherwise fun to people watch....beautiful accomodation.

Great apartment with a cool, funky layout. Mario makes sure you're set to enjoy the city with a cool map he designed showing some good spots to go. The place was clean, and check-in was super easy. Mario communicated well and in a timely manner, even with our last minute check-in. We could hear road noise from our room (mostly the relentless high pitch of the pedestrian crossings), but we drowned it out with white noise (rainfall soundtrack on Spotify). Took up Mario's offer on breakfast. It includes coffee, a cold drink and bread with butter and jam. Not much food, but it's cheap!

Parking: our only real complaint. It was super easy and right in front of the apartment on the street, BUT our car was broken into overnight :/ Not really anything you can do about it, but it was still a huge bummer considering the street looks safe.
Had a great overnight stay, thanks
Óptimo local
Excellent space, cozy and bright room. The check in was very practical and the location is great. Very close to metro and bus station. I recommend!
All good, interesting flat and being able to enter the flat with a code was very handy and no waiting around for someone to meet. Thanks Mario

Lo más importante y que yo no entendí al reservar, es que se trata de un apartamento compartido! Alquilas una habitación y te encuentras con desconocidos por el pasillo... El apartamento es amplio y luminoso (aunque carece de estores o cortinas y las persianas tenían que estar casi todas bajadas para protegernos del sol). No dispone de TV pero sí de equipo de música. La cocina es sencilla pero completa, suficiente para una estancia breve. Dispone de lavavajillas y microondas. La habitación 3 es muy amplia aunque falta de armario. El baño está en el pasillo, con lo cual no es un baño privado. Además tiene un grave problema de cañerías, el olor es nauseabundo y estaba lleno de insectos. También es importante recalcar que tiene dos tramos largos de escaleras, por lo que no es accesible a todo el mundo. Por lo demás el piso está bien y la atención fue buena. Una vez que sabes que es un piso compartido las expectativas cambian. Aunque es imperativo que solucionen el problema de las cañerías urgentemente.
Perfect

Mario responde rápido a los mensajes, nos facilitó el check in y el apartamento estaba limpio, muy amplio y muy luminoso. 
Además nos facilitó una aplicación para hacer turismo en oporto, el apartamento se encuentra en el centro
vi fik ikke et privat badeværelse, som vi havde betalt - ej heller søvn om natten pga støj fra gaden. Der var tillige uhensigtsmæssig kommunikation med udlejer.

nice appartment in a good location, everything you need nearby (1min walk to metro, 4 min walk to LIDL supermarket), helpful host. right beside a street and windows are not closing very well, so it can get quite loud at night. try the very good breakfast :)

L appartement est très beau idéalement situé à côté du métro qui nous a permis d arriver directement de l aéroport et d aller où on veut .
Juste un peu de bruit à cause de travaux et de la circulation.

Chambre très spatieuse accessible facilement en métro. Appartement très joli propre et agréable. Cuisine fonctionnelle au top. Un peu bruyant car rue très passante à côté mais cela ne nous a posé aucun problème ! Super séjour ! Je recommande vivement !
It was a pleasure to stay at Mario’s place. Really clean and great communication with the friendly Mario.

Die Wohnung ist zentral gelegen, insbesondere wenn man vom Flughafen an- bzw abreist liegt die Wohnung super, da eine U Bahn im der Nähe hält. Auch in die Stadtmitte sind es nur 10-15 Minuten zu Fuss. Allerdings geht die zentrale sehr gute Lage teilweise zu Lasten der Lautstärke, da die Wohnung entsprechend an einer befahrenen Strassenkreuzung liegt.
 
Ansonsten ist die Wohnung sehr schön eingerichtet, ich hatte nur ein Problem mit der Türklinke in meinem Zimmer, da diese nicht (mehr) durch Schrauben fixiert war und sie sich entsprechend nur schwer von innen abschließen ließ. Von aussen war es kein Problem. Dieses Problem sollte aber mittlerweile behoben sein. Mit dem Schlüssel per Schlüsseltresor und Code hat es problemlos geklappt.

Kann das Appartement empfehlen.
Good location, good communication...Clean and nice place with everything you need.

Para além de todo o incómodo no check-in e de não termos ficado no alojamento que efectivamente marcámos, houve ainda problemas de sonorização e climatização.
Os tubos de saneamento que passam no interior do alojamento, vindos de pisos superiores, produzem imenso barulho cada vez que há descargas.
A climatização é fraca e desadequada o que tornou o espaço frio e desconfortável. 
Um termoventilador deve ser usado numa instalação sanitária e não num quarto/sala. Por não poder estar ligado durante um longo período tivemos imenso frio durante a noite. 
Também a roupa de cama, nomeadamente o edredão, não era de todo adequada à estação do ano. 
Na instalação sanitária não havia nenhum tapete de chão/saída de duche nem qualquer gel de banho/shampo. Apenas sabão de mãos. 
Mínimo dos mínimos. 
Boa localização, no entanto difícil de estacionar e descarregar bagagem. 
Medíocre. Não voltaremos a marcar!

reviews.comments: The flat is very spacious with super high ceilings that even the loft bed feels airy. Quiet with excellent shutters for blocking out light and sound. Very modern and stylish and perfectly centered in Porto. Would stay again and highly recommend. Thanks!

Location is stupendous. Love the huge windows/doors overlooking the city. 
Excellent space.

We had a really great time in Porto and this flat is definitely the best place to stay there. It's very central, modern furnished and clean. Joana and Elói are great hosts - evereything went smoothly.

We will come back for sure.

Loft acogedor en pleno centro de Oporto, con un servicio atento e impecable, que se mantuvo en contacto con nosotros en todo momento.
Muy recomendable

One thing I love about Airbnb is finding unique places to stay, and this is one of them. Great use of space, perfect size for 2. I loved staying here and wish I could have stayed longer. Great location, easy check in and really comfortable apartment. Would definitely stay again.

Great design, very cosy flat. There is anything you may need equipment wise. Perfectly located, all the interests points are at walking distance. You're close to some nice restaurants as well (try Puro 4050!). Only drawback: it is quite noisy with the street outside and the neighbors. But other than that the flat is perfect!
Our stay was great ! Central location, close to the Douro, Joao gave us good adresses to visit Porto, everything was great !
Au coeur du quartier historique, un lieu très agréable où l'on se sent bien. Merci.

Joana’s and Elóis’s apartment was simply incredible! From a stunning view of the vibrant city to beautiful interior and a warm atmosphere, it offered a comfortable stay right in the centre of Porto. Joana provided wonderful recommendations upon arrival and it was truly one of the most memorable stays. Couldn’t be more grateful!
The apartment has great furnitures, perfect location and it was very clean. Better than an 4 star hotel.

Tolles Appartment in einer absoluten Traumlage. Ein wunderschönes altes Haus, typisch Porto. Bad und Küche sind in einem Würfel unter dem Hochbett integriert, was wir ganz lustig fanden. Dadurch fällt auch der Wohnbereich größer aus. Ideal für einen Ausflug zu zweit. Gerne Wieder.

Nulla da dire, appartamento incantevole, moderno, zona centralissima: a piedi in un raggio di 10 minuti raggiungi qualunque luogo da visitare. Joana è stata super carina e disponibile. Assolutamente consigliato!

By far the best experience I have had at any Airbnb rental. The host was exceptionally friendly and accommodating - I was set to arrive in the early afternoon but due to train delays I did not end up arriving until the evening, the host was able to move her schedule around and was at the door waiting for me when I finally arrived. The space is BEAUTIFUL and very functional. The bed was very comfy, the window shutters blocked all noise from the busy street, the kitchen is fully equipped with everything you could need and the bathroom was stocked with towels, soaps, shampoos, etc. I would HIGHLY recommend staying  here!

The apartment was beautiful, clean, and in an amazing location. We stayed for a week and wished we could have stayed for longer. Eloi was an amazing host, and incredibly friendly and accommodating. We’ll be back!

A very cosy and comfortable apartment with a load of daylight. Well equiped kitchen and spacious living room. In a very central point down town Porto. All the nice places like the riverbank with Porthouses, streets with bars and restaurants are in walking distance. However the appartment is located next to an important street, we didn’t experience noices. Joana was very helpful and gave is great tips to discover Porto. She responded quick on our messages and brought us extra towels, coffee and a missing win glass. Super host! A great place to discover the amazint city of Porto.

Lovely space, in the PERFECT location to explore a beautiful city. Really close to shops and restaurants, as well as the main station in Porto, São Bento. Very stylish apartment, which was super clean. Our host was really friendly and gave us lots of tips for the area.
Nico Location. Clean. Nice interrior

Stylish and  spacious apartment which was roomy for three. The location is a block from the train station and close by to many great restaurants, cafes,  shops, and so on. The host was nice enough to let us check-in early and sent a nice fellow who showed us around the apartment and gave a lot of good recommendations to sight-see and to go eat. Highly recommend!

The Apartment place is ideally located for all the sites to see in the old district of Porto. The apartment is modern, clean, and well laid out. We enjoyed our stay there very much and recommend it highly.

Pros: clean, tastefully designed studio right in the center of town.
Cons: it gets hots and stuffy (windows only on one side) and neighbours are noisy
Great apartment and a very clear process  - i'd definitely stay there again!

This is a great base from which to explore the lovely city of Porto.  It is easily within walking distance of most sights and very close to Sao Bento for connection from the airport or any explorations further afield.  There are plenty of nice restaurants and bars in the area and the charming rua das Flores is the next street over.

The apartment is just as it looks in the photos - spotlessly clean and very comfortable for a couple.  Eloi and Joana have been extremely responsive and easy to communicate with.  Check in with Joao was flawless.  They offered to keep our luggage for a few hours before our late afternoon train on the day of our departure but we just used the luggage storage service offered at the Magic Moda store across the street.

Overall, we had a great stay and would highly recommend this apartment.

Our stay exceeded expectations in every way. The flat was large, beautiful, airy light and quiet. Modern interior in a 100 year old building. Centrally located. Quiet. Our host was fantastic. He was incredibly knowledgeable , helpful and responsive. Would absolutely stay here again. Thanks for making our visit such a success!

Super efficient arrangement of apartment space. Uncluttered, comfortable, contemporary furnishings. Great location, easy walking access to a variety of small eating establishments and public transport. Street noise was not an issue. I’m super sensitive to cigarette smoke, so kept windows closed to keep smoke from wafting into the apt from the many sidewalk smokers. Our host graciously accommodated our late arrival because of  delayed trains.
Great location, awesome hosts who were very communicative and incredibly helpful. Would recommend this place to anyone!

Perfect stay, perfect place and location, with a design touch !
We recommend it for sure !
Very very good. Nothing else zu say… Porto is amazing
Perfect location and fantastic apartment, really recommend it!!

Beautiful modern apartment in a great location. In walking distance to everything, including the metro and all other public transport. Lots of restaurant options in walking range. 
The apartment has  working elevator making it easy to transport luggage up stairs.  Check in and out was very easy. The host spent a lot of time going over recommendations for the entire city - this was extremely useful. 
We had a great stay in this apartment. When we return to Porto we will definitely be back to this accommodation. Thank you!
the apartment is very well located, decorated with taste and well equipped. We were well received and advised, we will definitely return.
Amazing apartment in a great location! Would highly recommend.
The space was perfect... clean, natural sun light, fun and stylish. Would definitely recommend!
Lovely apartment, really quirky layout but still so spacious. Perfect location, right in the centre. Booking in was good and got lots of helpful tips. Would 100% recommend

Tolles & stylisches Appartment, zentral gelegen! Kommunikation, check-in und check-out haben wunderbar und reibungslos geklappt. Wir haben unseren Aufenthalt sehr genossen. In posizione strategica, a pochi passi da tutti i principali siti di interesse. Ottimo il collegamento con la metro e il treno. La casa è molto graziosa, pulita e provvista di tutto quello che può servire. Joana è stata molto disponibile nel consigliarci e nel venire incontro alle nostre necessità. Assolutamente consigliata!

Our stay in the apartment was very nice and comfortable. Host was waiting for us in the house for the check-in and gave us some helpful tips being an architect like us. The apartment is probably in the best position to visit the city centre. Wonderful and cozy details make the wooden box perfect!

What an intelligently and well designed appartment! We felt at home at once. We were wellcomed  friendly with all the information we needed, thank you. Everything we needed was there. Moreover the appartment is well situated so you can get to a lot of interesting places in no time. Though the traffic noise was very loud and we had to close all the windows while sleeping, we highly recommend the appartment, cause it‘s so nice and well situated.
Excellent location, close to everything.  Apartment has absolutely everything needed for a short stay!

Ótimo apartamento, silencioso pois há portas a prova de sons. O espaço foi bem pensado e atendeu às expectativas. Estive sozinha, então foi suficiente. Creio que três hóspedes ou mais poderia ser complicado.  Recomendo a casais ou viajante solitário.

Excelente espaço. Aconselho vivamente

Excelente apartamento, muito limpo e próximo ao metro, cozinha completa com diversos utensílios e equipamentos, camas confortáveis e banheiros espaçosos. Os anfitriões foram pontuais e prestativos. Super Recomendo.

Great hosts and awesome apartment. Communication is quick and easy. The apartment is sparkling clean and very practical. Location is amazing: a few blocks away from the beach; plenty of restaurants and cafes around; 1 block away from the tram station. We had a great experience.

This apartment is a pearl. Everything is very comfortable and fresh. Even better than on pictures. Good interior made with love and understanding what might need every traveler. Nothing to add, nothing to complain. Just come and enjoy. 
 Great location in calm area with many restaurants around. Supermarket and metro station as well very nearby. 
  Nice view from both sides of apartment. No need to be scared of metro line outside. It’s very very silent and even gives some charm listening whisper of trains.

Antonio is a very friendly and helpful host.
I would stay their anytime again. The communication was great, the place was great. Overall a great stay in Porto!

The room is well located, clean and comfortable for a short stay. Antonio is very friendly and patient, our flight was delayed and we got later than expected but there was no problem in getting into the apartment. Thanks a lot!
Antonio is very very polite and friendly! We checked in after midnight and he was completely fine with that! Thank you very much!
Bon séjour chez antonio, logement très bien placé en centre ville. Antonio est disponible et arrangeant
Estuvimos muy agusto, fue muy cómodo tener baño propio y la habitación está totalmente separada del resto por lo que fue casi como estar en un apartamento. Recomendable!
Accueil parfait linge de toilette à disposition, chambre propre, un peu bruyant.
Good room for a city trip to Porto. It was clean and good located.
petite chambre bien située, très proche du coeur de Porto. Cependant, nous n'étions pas chez l'habitant, si c'est ce que vous cherchez, vous serez déçus.
Nice place to stay, it was very clean.

The place is easy to find, it takes about 10 minutes walk to the city centre :) 
Antónia is  a nice host amd very flexible !

Good stay. Everything was clean and comfortable. There is no kitchen (but there is a fridge in the room) and the neighbirhood is little noisy in the night. But the place is nice for a good sleepover in Porto.

Het lag enorm dichtbij het centrum van Porto. Goed bed, alles was ook heel proper. Alleen hadden we wel wat lawaai s' nachts en de ramen houden precies niet veel geluid tegen. Voor de rest echt een aanrader!
Antonio has been very welcoming and accomodating during our stay =)
En el centro de Oporto. Un lugar tranquilo y agradable en el que descansar. Limpieza excepcional. Antonio es una persona muy agradable, dispuesto a ayudar en todo momento. Recomendable.

Antonio's place is in a great location, minutes away from the city centre, the main square and a central train station that takes you directly to the airport. There is a great supermarket just around the corner. Antonio is very polite and helpful. He was also very flexible with my check-in and check-out times. You have your own separate unit with the bedroom and the bathroom so you actually have your complete privacy. Very good for value too. Thank you Antonio!
Such a amazing place to stay in the city center of Porto. Solo room with private bathroom in the calm area by the downtown of Porto in the walking distance. 100% recommended!!
Cosy room close to the centre of Porto and to the Metro with connection to the Airport. Antonios room has everything needed and Antonio is flexible about the check-in time. Was a good time there...
Antonio was very helpful and flexible. He gave us good informations about the city. The room was clean and well located. It was a good stay there!

Très bon emplacement! Station d'autobus, de train et de metro accessible à pied. Chambre très bien avec frigidaire. Accueil agréable avec des bons conseils pour les restaurants et directions. Je conseil cette chambre sans aucun doute !

Chambre très bien située près du centre et de la station de métro. 
Bonne literie. 
Antonio a été arrangeant par rapport à l'heure d'arriver. 
Top !

António es muy amable y servicial. La habitación se encuentra en una zona cercana al centro. Bien situada. Tiene parada de Metro cerca, pero no la hemos necesitado. Si se lleva coche propio, recomiendo aparcarlo en alguno de los Parkings privados cercanos, pues en la calle sólo se puede aparcar 2 horas.
We had a nice experience! The location is great, so close to city center!! António is very helpful and makes sure that you feel welcomed.
Stanza privata dotata di quasi tutti i comfort. Posizione centrale, molto pulita.

Antonio's apartment was perfect! The room was lovely with a private entry and bathroom - it is its own mini-apartment. The location was perfect, walking distance to all of the main sites and popular neighborhoods of Porto. The bed was very comfortable and Antonio provided everything we might need for our quick stay in Porto. Antonio was very kind and communicative before we arrived and super available for any questions we had. We loved our weekend stay in Porto!

From the very beginning we were welcomed guests for Antonio and his family and felt this at every moment. He followed all our wishes and provided us with everything: maps, booklets, information, accommodation. Our apartment was not big, but very comfortable. We had all what we needed: wide bed, TV, nice bathroom with big towels, refrigerator and so on.
Location is excellent! Not far from the train station and downtown, 50 m from the bus station and 200 m from Santa Catharina - pedestrian street with shops. So, everything is reached on walking distance. Around the corner is supermarket and many cafes. 
Antonio helped us with boarding passes. My husband left his mobile and Antonio did something close to impossible. 
Antonio is sincere and generous person and great host! He made our stay unforgettable!. Definitely recommended. 
Evelina
La habitación tiene entrada aparte y está muy cerca de todo, cerca del meteo; exc ubicación! Antonio muy atento y generoso; nos facilitó un microwave cuando lo necesitamos! En general muy bien!!
António家的地理位置极佳,到主要景点都是步行距离｡房东也热情好客,还帮助我们寄存行李｡十分推荐!
천장이 높아 겨울엔 방이 습하고 추웠습니다. 옆방은 밤늦게까지 음악을 틀어놓고 시끄럽게 했고, 난방기가 있었지만 작아서 효과가 크게 없었습니다. 그치만 방은 깨끗한 편이었고, 호스트도 친절하신 분이셨습니다. 지하철 역까지는 걸어서 8분정도, 시내까지는 10-15분정도 소요됩니다.
It's an excellent place to still. Near by everything do you need, and near from subway too. Mr. Antonio is a very careful person, he showed to me a place to wash my clothes, good places to eat, etc.

Antonio's place is a 10-minute walk from Trindade Station of the metro. From there you can walk to the center of the city (well, everything is in walking distance in Porto). 

Antonio's place is cozy and modern. It is nice that you have the entire place by yourself. There is a bath tub which is an extra point. Antonio was gracious enough to provide me maps and tips on how to explore the city. 

Thanks, Antonio!
Sehr gute Lage und gut vom Flughafen erreichbar. Schönes Zimmer mit eigenem Bad. :-)

Antonio fue un anfitrión genial, nos explicó donde ir, nos aconsejó por donde cenar y fue muy amable. La habitación está muy céntrica, muy limpia y fue muy cómoda. Lo recomiendo 100%, para repetir. :)

Antonio was a really friendly host and even drove us to the airport at 3am.
The location was downtown and so we could reached everything in short time. :)

La chambre est bien située dans la ville.
Bonne literie. 
Seul hic, l'humidité dans la pièce. Heureusement qu'Antonio a prévu un radiateur! Il nous a permis d'être au chaud et de chasser un peu cette humidité ambiante (sûrement due au mauvais temps)

Antonio is a very nice person! He came to the metro station to pick us up and show us the apartment. The flat is in a noisy place and a bit humid but well cleaned and furnished. Thank you for your kindness Antonio!

Muy cómodo contar con el baño en la habitación, y es muy central la ubicación; pudimos llegar a los principales lugares caminando. Las recomendaciones de Antonio y su amabilidad también son un plus, aunque no contábamos con que una parte de la habitación tuviera bastante humedad y ello afectara bastante el olor.
Antonio a été un hôte très sympathique, n'hésitant pas à nous donner des conseils pour de bonnes adresses à Porto. Très bon séjour.
The place is great, with your own little appartement. It is very central, near the main attractions. Antonio is very nice,  he recommanded some place to eat and things to do.

Logement petit mais idéal pour 2-3 nuits. Un peu excentré mais bien si on veut faire de la marche. 
C’est le père d’Antonio qui nous a donné les clefs, très gentil mais qui ne parle pas vraiment anglais donc communication délicate. 
Chambre assez humide et on entend toute la rue si on dort la fenêtre ouverte (prévoir boules quies). 
Sinon RAS.
位置非常好,靠近咖啡馆,餐馆跟超市｡景点步行十几分钟就可到达｡地铁站只要5分钟步行路程｡非常好的房东｡

The apartment was in a good area with a short walk into town. The bed was comfy, there was a fridge but no kettle or cutlery so if you buy things it’s an assembly picnic or else grab some plastic cutlery

Great place, looks much better than in the pictures. His father is the one who gave us the keys at the beginning of our stay, he didn't speak any english but was very friendly and showed us how everything worked. The only downside was that the room was very humid, and our clothes were damp most of the time. As for location, it was very easy for us to walk to wherever we needed to go, didn't need to use transit. Overall a great value, would stay again.
Appartamento molto confortevole. Buon rapporto qualità/prezzo. Posizione molto centrale.
Flexible Checkin (after midnight), located central in the city easily to walk to nice places; padaria and brazilian shop just around the corner; it was very nice
Tipica stanza portoghese, comoda per visitare la città e raggiungere l'aeroporto o altri mezzi pubblici. Essenziale ma completa. Wi fi funzionante.

Es una habitación con una muy buena ubicación cerca del metro, de restaurantes y supermercados. Ademas tiene un acceso privado, lo cual la hace en un espacio muy independiente. La habitación tiene lo necesario para dormir y el baño, asi que sera una buena opcion para un par de noches por Porto.
Good place close to the city centre. Highly recommended

La habitación está muy bien, al estar separada de la casa tienes privacidad, con un baño privado, televisión y nevera. 
Antonio siempre estuvo atento a todo lo que necesitásemos. Lo recomendamos totalmente, además la ubicación estaba muy bien, fuimos andando a todas partes.
Chambre ressemble a tous points de vue au descriptif. Calme dans l'ensemble. Très central. Proche du métro Trinidade.
너무 습했어요. 욕실 물이 빠지질 않았어요.
Very good location, very close to the metro. The room is clean and the check in was possible earlier than we thought.
this is a great location.   everything you need for your stay in Porto

Me and my boyfriend were welcomed by the father of Antonio who was very kind to wait for our late arrival and to show us the place. Wide independent room with fridge and private bathroom, located 10 min on foot from the city centre. The inconvenience though was that the place was not clean, and mainly it was very humid and therefore it smelled very musty! For this reason I do not recommend the place.

Rapide d’aller dans le centre à pieds
Seul bémol la propreté qui laisse à désirer et une odeur désagréable

J'avais fait une réservation pour une autre semaine, je voulais payé une caution à l'hôte qui n'a pas accepter et il m'appelle une semaine avant pour me dire qu'il avait donné la chambre à un autre couple car ils exigeaient une machine à laver et c'était la seule chambre qui en avait une, donc j'ai du recherché autre chose.

The room and the bathroom were private and clean, very cozy. The apartment was well located, 3 minutes by walking to the metro station of Trindade. Antonio was a awesome host, he waited for us, unfortunately in late for an issue with the rented car. highly recommended!!! It was a pleasure to stay there!!!

Muy recomendada, es justo lo que uno busca. Con entrada independiente, la habitación y el baño no son compartidos, es como un miniapartamento, todo pintado en blanco y muy limpio.  Muy cerca de Plaza de la Libertad y estaciones de trenes. Volvería a hospedarme ahí.

António was there to meet us on arrival; he was extremely friendly and provided us with local tips on where to eat/visit. The apartment was lovely and clean. It was also larger than we had anticipated. It’s about a 15 minute walk to get into the heart of the city and the value for money is 5 star.

This place was good :) Even if in the bathroom there was mold and the room is actually almost right at the street so at night you need to lock the windows properly and the heat is not good for sleeping, it was torebly. :) But the room was nice as at the picture.

Pieza con cama matrimonial, baño con tina y agua caliente.
sin cocina, sin mesas ni sillas pero con refrigerador.
Limpieza impecable.
Cumple con lo prometido.

Antonio’s apartment is very close to city‘s main attractions (15-20m walking) and very comfortable for a single traveler / couple spending few days in Porto. In addition, it’s at 5m walking from Trininade station, thus connected perfectly with both airport and train station. Private bathroom.

Antonio is an extremly kind host. We arrived very early and he agreed to check in few hours before the planned time. He went to welcome us and gave us some tips to make our stay great. The room has a separate entrance so it is very private. The room is located about 6 minutes from Trinidade metro station. It was one of the best stays with airbnb.
Very close to the center! Antonio was very nice and flexible about the check-in. Thank you very much!
Great value/price, Antonio gave us some tips during check in as of what to see, location was near most tourist places.
Conforme à  l annonce
Good location close to city centre
El Sr. Antonio es muy amable y nos dio consejos de que visitar en el lugar. en general el cuarto es limpio y bastante grande para dos personas. muy recomendable la ubicación
Exactement ce que nous recherchions, endroit à proximité du centre-ville et de tout à 10 minutes à la marche, belle chambre très propre qui a correspondu à nos besoin. António est très sympathique
Antonio was incredibly nice. When my flight was delayed, we waited so that he could give me the keys in person, and also gave me some good local tips.
la ubicación es muy buena, cerca del metro y el centro. Antonio es un excelente host
Antonio was very nice and flexible! He even came to help us when we were in a hurry, which is an absolute 5-star service.

Stanza indipendente con bagno. 
Non vicinissimo al centro della città, ma vicino alla stazione della metro per chi arriva dall' aeroporto e lontano dal caos dei turisti. Quartiere di solo portoghesi con minimarket nelle vicinanze.  Unica pecca, la stanza è un po' fredda. Con una piccola stufa si risolverebbe tutto. 
L'host è stato gentilissimo e disponibilissimo.   
Rapporto qualità/prezzo ottimo per chi non ha grosse pretese.

name: Awesome flat in the center (HUTB-014195)
summary: There are 3 double rooms (in 2 of them have balcony) a bathroom, 2 toilets and a huge and lovely living/dining room, kitchen. On the 1st floor (2nd real, without elevator). Nice neighborhood, good tapas bars, restaurants, pubs nearby. You can rent it by rooms too from November to March.
space: We offer a lovely flat with 3 double rooms (2 of them with balcony), a big living and dining room, fully equipped kitchen, 2 bathrooms. It is in the center just 10 min walk from the "Rambla" and the port, and also from the Pl. Espanya with the Magic Fountain. The closest metro station is within 3 min by walk from us, with 2  metro lines and the funicular so you can reach every important thing in the city within 15-20 min, there are a lot of restaurant, bars, tapas bars, pharmacy, bank, grocery, bakery just next to the flat. Bedsheets and towels are included in price and there is also WIFI in the whole flat.

host.host_about: likes traveling, photography, cooking

reviews.comments: Very nice apartment and it's close to city centre.

The location is perfect: quite close to the metro station and it takes only ten minutes in metro to most of the travel spots! The condition of the apartment was very good and clean. The only defect is that the wash machine didn't work, it was somewhat inconvenient as we were staying there for five days.
A great apartment in a great location. Value for money and our host, Suzy, was really accommodating. I would recommend this apartment and would certainly return next time I'm in Barcelona.

The apartment looks great online but even better in person. Our stay was a pleasant and comfortable one. Suzy was very helpful. Our experience was great! The wifi was a little spotty but this didn't take away from our general impression. Amazing location!

Suzy met us outside and showed us around the apartment, which was actually a larger one to the one we originally booked but still in the same location.  The apartment was great and had all the facilities.  It was also very conveniently located in proximity to shops, bars and metro.  We really loved the location and enjoyed hanging out at the La Esquinita pinchos bar just around the corner.  Suzy was very helpful and even let us keep our bags at the place while we did some more exploring on our last day in Barcelona.  In summary, we could not have wished for anything better!  Would love to stay here again!

It was our second visit in the same barrio, even in the same block. Apartment is like in descrpition. El Poble Sec is wonderful area, it's easy to go every where in Barcelona. We were four adults and apartment was really good for us.
Very nice and helpful host. Good flat. Great location.
Nice place.. Well located and clean!!

Accueil efficace,dès notre arrivée.Discret ensuite. Dommage de ne pas avoir eu plus d echanges, l impression d une simple location,nous attendons autre chose de ce principe de location.

Par ailleurs ménage fait mais pas dans les coins,donc un peu limite.Micro onde et poignées poisseux…

De plus 2 chambres donnent sur une rue bruyante et simple vitrage, nous avons peu dormi la première nuit, vive les boules Quies!
Autre point négatif en hiver:pas de chauffage,juste des radiateurs soufflants a déplacer….on aurait aimé être prévenus..

Sinon tres bien situé dans un quartier animé avec des bars à tapas sympas,distance a pied des ramblas et facile en métro pour tout le centre.

Notre arrivée à Barcelone s'est très bien passé, nous avons vite trouvés nos marques dans cet appartement. L'appartement est très proche du métro qui nous permet d'être en quelques minutes dans les plus beaux endroits de la ville. Suzy s'est montrée très arrangeante pour notre heure d'arrivée et de départ. Ce logement nous à permis un bon séjour à Barcelone!
Suzy's place was great! Very spacious and clean. Ideal location in Barcelona. The place had all the amenities you could ask for. I wouldn't hesitate to go back.
MUY BUENA UBICACION Y EN BUENAS CONDICIONES.

Appartement agréable et très bien situé avec des commerces à proximité. Hôte accueillant mais peu présent. Toute les consignes à respecter sont affichées sur les murs. Des objets sont à vendre.(magnets). Le principe de la location entre particuliers airbnb n'est pas vraiment respecté dommage!  Deux chambres conformes à la description en revanche la troisième chambre est très petite et sombre avec un lit d'appoint. La machine à laver ainsi que le four ne fonctionnés pas.
Dommage.
Übergabe der Wohnung lief problemlos, gute Erreichbarkeit von Suzy, sehr gute Lage, umgeben von vielen leckeren Tapasbars.

Such a great location! There are so many bars and places to eat within a 2 minute walk. There's a lot of nightlife around here. The apartment itself is a little noisey, but I didn't mind it too much. There were 4 of us who stayed here and we had plenty of space. I would recommend this location!
Quartiere perfetto. Host molto disponibile, in tutto. La casa potrebbe essere più pulita.

Getting the keys and leaving the flat was uncomplicated and easy. The flat is a good option when travelling to Barcelona. It has enough space and everything what you need. The location is very comfortable as there are a lot of bars and restaurants nearby and it's in walking distance to La Rambla. The only things that were a little bit disturbing are, that the beds are not too comfortable and its quite loud during the night. :)

Nos recibieron muy bien. Adam, el compañero de Susy nos explicó cómo funcionaba todo y nos ayudó con todas nuestras dudas.
La ubicación es muy linda, es barrio es ruidoso pero no es problema. El departamento es muy cómodo. La cocina es chica pero se puede cocinar bien. La ducha es excelente. Nos pudimos bañar las cuatro personas seguidas sin quedarnos sin agua

El piso es exactamente igual que en las fotos. Nos recibieron a la hora convenida, muy amable y cordial.
Es muy cómodo, muy cerca de todo. De restaurantes, de bares, supermercados, multitiendas con amplio horario.
Caminando puedes llegar a todo el centro, Raval, Gotic, etc.
Recomendadísimo.
Nos dejaron salir incluso más tarde de la hora convenida.

The listing of this apartment was exactly how they presented it online. The apartment was very spacious, clean, and never ran out of hot water for showering. The hosts were very welcoming and caring. There was a problem with the keys and the lock before we had arrived, but Suzy was already on top of the situation and made sure there was nothing we had to worry about. Suzy was very easy to get a hold of and super nice about any questions we had. The area the apartment was in was a great location. All the main attractions were very easy to walk to and was right next to a lively street filled with many restaurants to choose from. The owners also own a bike shop downstairs from the apartment which me and some friends took advantage of and rented bikes from them. I felt very welcomed staying here and recommend this apartment to anyone.
Todo era perfecto . BUENA UBICACION Y CALIDAD / PRECIO BUENA . El Suzy y su esposo fueron muy buenos . Gracias

My friends and I (5 adults) stayed in the flat during our weeklong Barcelona outing.  The flat is in excellent location. It is right on the busy street full of restaurants and a 10 minute walk away from La Rambla and Gothic quarter. 

The flat was clean and spacious (by European standards) and I can see how up to 6 people (3 couples) can comfortably stay there. 

The hosts were nice and friendly. When our kettle broke down, they got us a new one in a short amount of time.

Given its location, it is truly awesome.

The only issue is that given its central location, it can get noisy at night especially during football/soccer games.
El piso es sencillo pero correcto y cumplió con nuestras expectativas. Cuando llegamos había un problema con la nevera que nos solucionaron rápidamente. La zona es muy animada y bien comunicada.

The location of Suzy's flat in Batcelona was fabrastic! Centrally located to public transportation and local restaurants and bars, but on a quiet side street with outdoor cafes. The flat is obviously used as a rental property year round, and did not feel as "homey" as other Airbnb stays.
Très bon séjour, bel appartement, propre.
Everything was perfect, the apartment was in the center no need to usee the car.....
Nice flat in center of Barcelona.
Lovely apartment in a great area. Really close to lots of shops/supermarkets. Everyone we dealt with was friendly, would definitely recommend!
Great central location. Good communication regarding key pick up. Apartment was very clean and tidy. We did have a problem with the hot water which was fixed immediately

Host was very flexible with our arrival and leaving. Full marks for this.
Attention to detail in respect to lights not working, shower curtain, bath mat which should have been replaced a long time ago, wallpaper loose.
Area is very noisy at night and lasts into early morning.
Nice neighbourhood, friendly people. Helped take bags up the stairs.
We had a great experience! The flat was clean and cozy and the location is fantastic !
Big apartment and good location (away from crowded Rambla, but still on Carree de Blai, where the vibrant night life is with full of Tapas and Pintxos bars).
Ottima posizione vicino al centro della città ed alla metro ma la casa non è tenuta benissimo specialmente i bagni. Wifi molto lenta
Un apt muy centrico, de facil acceso. Todo limpio. Lo volveria a escoger en un futuro viaje.

Nice appartment in a perfect location next to the city  center (10 min from ramblas) . . And very nice hosts too ! 
Just a thing : the rooms are a bit noisy  because  of the busy  street in front of the appartment... a good place to stay anyway !
Beautiful apartment in a wonderful neighborhood.

Apparemment conforme à la description. Il est bien situé et nous avons pu visiter la ville dans avoir à prendre le métro.
Suzy répond très rapidement et est disponible. 
Le seul hic est la faible insonorisation avec l'extérieur et les autres voisins...

Appartement bien situé pour visiter la ville, à proximité du centre ancien et mer à pied et transports publics (bus et métro) à proximité. La rue reste bruyante même en soirée.  L'appartement est spacieux et bien équipé.  On recommande cette adresse. Bon séjour!
Only stayed for one night with some friends. Place was good, at a great location. The hosts were quick to answer and accommodating
Hello, Thank you for Everything, it was a Lovely Stay. We were very satisfied. Best regards,
Logement spacieux, bien équipé et très bien situé. Seul problème : le bruit de la rue tard dans la nuit...

The appartment is well located and it ticks all the boxes, perfect for a family stay.
Barcelona is an amazing city and las Ramblas is a short walk from the flat.
Thank you for the hospitality.
Très très bien
Good (Email hidden by Airbnb) munication with the hosts was flawless and warming.

This house is nice and cosy. Good if you are with a group of people! What I liked was the location in the city. There are very lovely tapasbars around and if you hire bikes it's easy to go anywhere fast! Thanks for staying there Suzy!

Perfectamente ubicado, limpio y bien equipado, este piso era perfecto para nuestra estancia. No llegamos a conocer personalmente a Suzy, pero por la comunicación que mantuve con ella parece ser una persona muy simpática y correcta. Todo genial!

L'appartement est très bien rangé et spacieux et il est très bien situé pour les transports et restaurants 
Malheureusement il est très très bruyant : vie nocturne très importante / immeuble mal insonorisé 
Je ne le conseille pas Avec une Famille 
Mais pour venir passer un Weekend entre amis il est parfait

Lovely apartment.
Good for young travelers.
Near many restaurants and bars. 
2 subway stops very near.
15 minutes by  foot to the Raval.

Apartamento muy bien ubicado, en plena zona de bares de tapas y pinchos y de cafeterías. A pocos minutos de la Plaza de España y del metro. La zona es un poco animada, al menos cuando estuvimos (fin de semana) y hubo ruido en la calle por la noche. Suzy atendió todas nuestras dudas por chat y nos recibió Sil. Estuvimos muy cómodos los 4, aunque algunos aspectos de limpieza y puertas rotas son mejorables. También hemos echado de menos una TV.
Piso muy bonito.  Aconsejato para tres, cuatro personas.
The apartment was pretty cool and well suited, but it was too noisy at night (we could hear what people did outside)
Close to lots of good tapas places. Clean and host was very helpful.

Great apartment located a short walk to La Rambla. There were many bars and restaurants with outdoor cafes located on the pedestrian street within in a minute or two walk from the apartment, very nice!

Buena localización 
Buena comunicación
Très bon séjour passé à Barcelone, appartement idéal pour visiter du Barcelone tout en etant au calme

Such a lovely hostess. Suzy was able to help me and my family with every little hiccup we had from getting to the apartment from the airport while there was a taxi strike to making sure we were with everything we needed. Thank you for the lovely hospitality.
非常好的地理位置,房间也非常的大,居住起来非常的舒适,楼下还有很多酒吧,非常热闹,感谢Suzy
Logement conforme aux attentes.  C’est vrai que le quartier est populaire, mais ce n’est pas si dérangeant que marqué dans certains commentaires.

Tiene una buena ubicación, el apartamento es muy antiguo y cosas  dentro de él un poco mal mantenidas.
Solo para llegar muy cansados y dormir.
Wir verbrachten drei Nächte in Suzys Wohnung! Wir fühlten uns dort sehr wohl und würden wieder kommen! Danke Suzy!
Excelente apartamento. Todo limpio y en orden, amplio, agradable, identico a las fotografías. Hay lugares para comer a un paso! Un poco de ruido por la vida nocturna. Totalmente recomendado.

The location is perfect!
Be prepared for 3 levels of steep staircase.
Good value for a quick stay

Nice appartment, excatly how we expected and according to the pics and description. The location is really good, central, near several subway stations, a lot of cafes, small grocery shops and several supermarkets. The communication with Suzy was super easy and fast. We stayed for 3 days in Barcelona and were very satisfied with our choice. The only thing that you should consider is that the windows are facing the street, so it's not a calm or silent place, but for us it wasn't a problem.
@Suzy: Thanks a lot for your hospitality!
The place is in heart of the city every attraction is in 20min reach. I would definitely suggest to go for it.
The stay was awesome. Nice host and cool apartment close to most city centre. We had an amazing time.

name: SUPER CENTRAL + BALCONY IN RAMBLAS !!!
summary: the room for 2 guests in literally in la rambla, the most central street of barcelona, the beach is nearby too, 15 minutes walking, all the atractions like gothic and sagrada familia are close too
space: very nice and warm room with balcony in the most central posuble location, la rambla in 30 seconds, la boqueria too and gothic area too, the roons has a bunkbed, ideal for travelers and friends
