name: White House
summary: Single-family home in Barcelona with lots of charm. Living room, fully furnished kitchen, 2 triple bedrooms, 2 double bedrooms, and 2 bathrooms with showers. Accommodation for 10 people. Heating and air conditioning. Garden with barbecue grill and private pool.
description: Single-family home in Barcelona with lots of charm. Living room, fully furnished kitchen, 2 triple bedrooms, 2 double bedrooms, and 2 bathrooms with showers. Accommodation for 10 people. Heating and air conditioning. Garden with barbecue grill and private pool. One hundred meters from the house, there are buses that can get you to the city center in 15 min. (Phone number hidden by Airbnb)
notes: (Phone number hidden by Airbnb)
transit: One hundred meters from the house, there are buses that can get you to the city center in 15 min.
house_rules: - El horario de entrada en los apartamentos será a partir de las 14.00 h. del día de llegada debiendo quedar libres las habitaciones antes de las 10.00 del dia de salida.  - Tarifa por registro de entrada a deshoras (después de 20:00): 40€ - El cliente se obliga a cuidar el apartamento amueblado, siendo de su cargo los deterioros o pérdidas que se produzcan en la misma. - Menores de 21 años, serán solamente admitidos en compañía de un mayor - Las HORAS DE DESCANSO son de 22,00 a 10,00 entre semana y de 00.00 a 10,00 los festivos, - Los apartamentos están dotados de un sistema de control de ruido, en caso de superar el máximo durante el periodo nocturno, un agente se desplazará hasta el apartamento. Si se vuelve a ocasionar un problema de ruido tras la visita del agente, será bloqueado el depósito - En el momento de la salida del cliente debe entregar la casa en buenas condiciones de limpieza. No se puede dejar la basura en la casa, utensilios de cocina y vajilla debe estar limpia, toal

host.host_about: Me encanta la decoración, la moda y estar al día de las tendencias pero lo que más me gusta es conocer gente de diferentes culturas y paises y hacer que su estancia en barcelona sea lo más agradable posible

reviews.comments:
Villa fidèle aux photos, bien entretenue avec un jardin  agréable. Propriétaire disponible et a l'écoute. Seul bémol : le quartier industriel alentour qui peut parfois être mal fréquenté. 
En résumé nous avons passé un très bon séjour dans cette maison idéale pour partir en famille ou entre amis.
Très bon accueil et maison très agréable conforme aux photos

This was a great little house, fresh decor and a really fun outdoor area to lounge around in. We found everything we needed there and very accommodating service.  I would highly recommend this as a place to stay, especially for a group it is perfect. My only drawback is that it is quite removed in location from city centre and we got a taxi each time we left the house. Still I would return to this location regardless as we had such a great time. Thanks!, Sinead.

The White House is a fantastic place. The rooms are a good size and the air con is efficient & relatively quiet. The living area is large and well-equipped and the outside space is also a great size. The pool makes a real difference too as the walls & surrounding buildings mean there isn't much of a breeze. It is in quite an industrial area, but there's a large shop nearby and buses & the town centre a short walk away. 

Jose Luis and Isa were very helpful and provided a lot of info for us when we arrived - taxi numbers were very useful as there aren't many passing, but you do need to speak Spanish in order to call. They were very flexible with our arrival time and would have been so with our checkout too, if they didn't have another booking. The only downside was some communication issues, which meant we only found out about having to checkout early on the morning it happened - so we were left with 20 minutes for 10 people to pack up.

That aside, the house is great and the hosts very friendly & helpful - a nice and excellent value house for a group in central Barcelona.

We were met by a very friendly host as soon as we arrived at the Villa, which was clean and tidy. The villa is located in a more industrial part of Barcelona but this isn't an issue with a supermarket just around the corner.  Barcelona centre is just a 10 minute taxi journey (approx 12-15 euros) away or there are local buses very close to the villa that can take you into town.  This villa is perfect for large groups, particularly with it's outdoor space that many other Barcelona apartments do not offer.  We would definitely stay again if coming in a large group.
Posto bellissimo...comodo all'aeroporto..alla città...persone disponibili e accoglienti!!!!!!!perfetto.....
Very Nice place

La casa, es preciosa, muy bonitas nos encanto.
muy grande y para repetir.
Muy recomendable  para grupos grandes.
Isa la anfitriona muy bien.

We had a lovely stay at the White house. Isa and Jose was really helpful with both the booking and greeting us at the house. The house is perfect for a group or friends or a bigger family. It's quite far from the city center and it take some time to reach. Especially in rush hour. But there is a big super market close to the house. Perfect for shopping for dinners in the patio.

We had a great time at the apartment. The garden and pool are great and the apartment was really well presented. The location is quite far out from the center but there are lots of buses from about a 6 minutes away. Highly recommended.
The place was fantastic and we had an amazing time! Highly recommended
Hello, welcome was perfect Mr Jose cas There to welcome us And give us all thé information around the Area. Nice week-end with friends And the housse os perfect for group friends.

We had a very nice holiday and the hostes are very friendly. 
For us the best part of the house was the garden with the pool there we spent a lot of time together. The house is perfect for large groupes unfortunately there are not much plates and glases and to cook with 2 pans was sometimes a little difficult. Even there are a loot of moskitos. But everything worked and de house was nicely done up. To the center we had with the taxi 10 minutes and with the bus 15 minutes, both is cheap. There is also a big supermarked about 5 minutes away.
We  very enjoyed our holidays in the white house and we will come back if we stay again in Barcelona.
The host canceled this reservation 230 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.

The house was as described and the pictures provided were accurate. The host made us feel most welcome with some water in the fridge and a bottle of red wine upon arrival. This was received especially well as we didn't arrive until midnight! Our flight was delayed considerably, but the host still met us with a friendly face. 

We has everything we needed, including fast internet and a dishwasher. The pool could have been a little bigger, but we were more than happy with what we got for the price, and again, it was as described. 

The house itself was in the industrial part of town, but it's only a 5 minute walk to the bus stop and 10 minute bus to Espanya, which is a Metro hub that will basically get you to everywhere in Barcelona. Travelling around on public transport is also inexpensive (1€ per ride if you get a T-10). The house was also about a 5 minute walk for a large supermarket.

Overall, the house had a nice clean feel, and was nicely decorated. I certainly wouldn't hesitate to book this house again or any of the others the hosts have on offer. They also let us check out late on our last day as no-one else was due to check-in (this saved us carrying our luggage around on the last day)

On behalf of the Honey party, thanks!

La maison est très agréable. Nous étions 8 à l'occuper et c'était, selon notre vécu, le nombre idéal et maximum, pour en profiter au niveau de la vaisselle disponible et de l'espace repas de la cuisine. 
Notre hôte a été très à l'écoute de nos demandes et très réactif. Par exemple nous n'arrivions pas à faire fonctionner les climatisations, une personne a été envoyée très rapidement pour nous aider à les faire fonctionner. 
Enfin, en ce qui concerne le quartier, en effet, il est éloigné du centre ville et surtout désert. Il faut compter 10 minutes en voiture ou taxi pour rejoindre le centre ville, mais 40 minutes en bus. 
Nous avons passé un très agréable moment dans cette très jolie maison.

Buscabanos una casa cerca de la FIRA. La casa de Isabel esta bien equipada. 
Esta aislada de comercio al estar en la zona franca, pero eso es por desconocimiento nuestro

Super cute little house on a quiet side street near the Barcelona/Hospitalet city line. Easy cab ride into the city, 2 blocks from a supermarket. Loved the layout - it was perfect for the 3 of us staying there for the week. 

Just wish it was warmer outside so we could have taken advantage of the pool!
Great house ... excellent location ... would definetely stay there again ...
The host canceled this reservation 205 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.

Leiligheten var fin og vi ble tatt vel imot av Isas venn da vi kom sent på kvelden. Den var velutstyrt og praktisk men renholdet kunne vært bedre. Det er kort å gå til bussen men du må regne minst en halv time på lokalbusser for å komme inn til sentrum. Ligger i et industriområde så det er ikke mye som skjer i umiddelbar nærhet, spesielt ikke om kvelden.

Contact with the Host was good. We had some problem with internet but we managed to resolve it by ourselve. The house is located quite far from the centre but about 500meters from it is a bus stop with all the necessary buses.

Non fatevi ingannare dalle foto, la casa è piccolissima mal tenuta e senza l'arredo delle foto, la piscina in realtà è uno stagno per le rane, il prato in erba sintetica e la zona è forse la più brutta è pericolosa di Barcellona abitata per lo più da spacciatori e prostitute, tanto che certi taxi si rifiutano di portarti a destinazione per paura, niente metro, solo un autobus che impiega 40 minuti fino al centro. Una delusione

Nous avions les deux maisons et le fait qu'on puisse passer de l'une à l'autre est parfait quand on est un groupe nombreux. La maison est comme sur les photos, la décoration soignée, et apaisante. La cuisine très bien équipée, la maison est assez spacieuse, plus que sur les photos selon moi. 
Il y a un bar en face qui ouvre très tôt, idéal pour manger un excellent sandwich et prendre une bière. 
La zone est plutôt industrielle mais il y a une station de bus (qui circule toute la nuit à proximité). Sinon, en taxi, c'est environ 12€ pour aller en ville.
Le supermarché est à 5 min à pied, ce qui est très pratique.
Globalement, ce fut un séjour fantastique, je recommande vivement ce logement !

Lovely villa, great size for 8 of us. Perfect place to chill. Only downside is it not being near to a metro but buses are easy. Also bathrooms could do with ventilation, but otherwise it's a lovely place :)

I really couldn't fault this villa! Everything was as described; it was clean, a huge amount of space for 6 of us, all the amenities worked and beautifully decorated! The location was perfect for us - you have a supermarket within a 5 minute walk and it is the same distance to a bus stop that takes you right into the centre of Barcelona. Alternatively, getting a taxi was super easy (download the Hail O app!) and only cost about 10-12 euros. 
We would all love to return and can hopefully do so :)

Attention aux photos tapageuses ! Nous étions quatre amis à avoir réservés cette maisonnette pour notre séjour à Barcelone de trois jours. Nous ne sommes restés que une nuit, préferant perdre notre argent,  tellement nous avons été déçus par cette location. Plusieurs raisons à cela: 
- La localisation. Pleine zone industrielle, odeur nauséabonde à notre arrivée, 25 minutes de bus du centre-ville.
- La piscine. Point central de notre réservation, la photo qui la représente sur l'annonce est clairement un trompe-l'oeil. Nous appellerions ça plutôt un bassin, étant donné qu'il ne doit pas dépasser les 4m carré. De plus, elle etait dans un état de propreté lamentable ( nous en sommes ressortis les pieds tout noirs après 5 minutes à faire trempette).
_ L'ensemble du logement. Pour le prix affiché, nous nous attendions a trouver une literie de qualité. En guise de cela, de simples matelas à ressorts, et au réveil de multiples boutons de piqures. De plus, l'ensemble est bien moins attrayant en réalité qu'en photo (Finitions bas de gamme, simple vitrage).

En résumé, nous avons la désagréable sensation de s'être fait avoir en bonne et due forme, tellement le décalage entre l'annonce et la réalité est terrible. Nous ne pouvons que vous conseiller de passer votre chemin, vous trouverez bien mieux au même prix ailleurs à Barcelone, n'en doutez pas !

We had a great time at the White House and the kids loved the pool ! The house itself is spacious and all amenities were available as listed. The wifi connection is great. On the negative side, the house smelt a bit of paint when we arrived, presumably because paint works were recently done, and we had some trouble with non-functioning light bulbs, but nothing serious. The neighborhood is a bit isolated (with lots of car and metal workshops nearby) but very quiet, and the bus service to the center of town is excellent. There's one supermarket in the immediate vicinity where we could buy all groceries we needed. Overall, we would definitely consider coming back to the White House on our next trip to Barcelona !
The house is very nice for a group of friends, its outside the city, for traveling by car it's perfect. The cleaning can be better.

we all really enjoyed our stay at the white house. we were a group of friends who only see each other a few times a year and had a wonderful time. the house was clean and had such adorable decor which we all loved.
the hosts were lovely and had good communication and let us check in early and out late so we weren't left carrying our luggage around.
had difficulties with everyone showering in the morning as water would go cold after a few uses, so bare that in mind when staying.
couldn't seem to find the hairdryer that was said to be provided, but didn't contact host as it wasn't a huge issue.
had a lovely stay, would stay at the white house or other properties by the host again!
Perfect little house, clean tidy and private

It's a pretty small house in an industrial area. It took about 10-15 minutes by bus or taxi to the city central. The supermarket was like 10 minutes away. If you want to go spontaneously out in the neighborhood you won't find anything. The communication could have been better. We flew in to groups to Barcelona. My friends were the first who arrived and asked if they could stay on the last day little longer because their flight back was taking of at evening. They were told it's ok to stay till 5pm if there's no other guest booking. And as he looked he said there wasn't any. So on the last day we had to leave within half an hour because no one told us anything about the other booking.

Great place, the garden is great to hang out! 
To get into the city it's faster to order a taxi to your doorstep by using the mytaxi app, because pretty often when you call the given tel. Numbers they don't have one available.
Would recommend, since it's big, it's secluded and your in the city really fast! The hosts were great, easy to communicate and very efficient!

Myself & 7 female friends stayed at the White House over the Easter weekend. The house was perfect for us - the large open plan living room / kitchen / dining area was a great place to sit as a group and relax. The bedrooms were light & airy. There were 4 bedrooms: 2 with 3 beds & 2 with 2 beds. Each 2 bed room had one of the 3 bed rooms connected to it through a set of doors. The outdoor space and little plunge pool were great too and gave us another place to chill out and get some sun - we didn’t mind being a bit outside the city centre to be able to get this. The White House had everything we needed, even uk to eu adaptors and a hand blender! Alina, who met us at check in, was really friendly and gave us all the information we needed. Isa responded quickly to any questions I had and even allowed us to check out a little later on our departure day. It was a great experience and I’d recommend it to anyone.

Good size property to comfortably accommodate 6 of us that were travelling. Location is not central but very easy to commute, close to Olympic stadium and Magic Fountains. Big grocery shop nearby well equipped and reasonably priced also close to nice bakery/Coffee Shop. Area seemed safe and quiet. Had good stay. Recommend for larger groups or family with kids
Very good. No complaints. Much bigger than previously thought.

Spacious and comfortable with an awesome plunge pool. The garden is a sun trap from mornings to early afternoon! 

Good for groups. Located slightly away from the beaten track but with a supermarket nearby and taxis always available.

Host was easy to arrange and great communication!

Thanks! :)

Great little dive pool and backyard area with a few deck chairs and a table.

location is not the greatest as it takes a while to get the bus and it will only take you as far as Sants station, no further. we caught a lot of taxis which were about 12 euro to get where we wanted to go 

good for a group of people that are not couples
What a great house. Kids loved the pool. Nice quiet area but close enough to town.
The host canceled this reservation 16 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.
Es un lugar acogedor, mucho más aprovechable con el buen tiempo (por la piscina)
ES UN ALOJAMIENTO TOTALMENTE RECOMENDABLE

neighborhood_overview: The location of this apartment is excellent: a short walk from the famous Arc de Triomf and the Parc de la Ciutadella (a really nice park very popular among young people and families). Plaça de Catalunya (the main square in Barcelona) and its variety of bars, restaurants and shops is really close to the apartment too. Visit the Barri Gòtic (the gothic town) with its quaint narrow streets and street artists. Do not forget to visit the Born, one of the three districts of Ciutat Vella. Walk along its streets full of shops, small cafes and restaurants with delicious tapas. Visit the Picasso Museum and the Chocolate Museum, or take a walk along the Passeig Joan Borbó down to la Barceloneta. Really close to the Metro station Arc de Triomf (L1).

Nuestra misión principal es hacer que todos nuestros clientes se sientan como en casa dando siempre la privacidad que necesiten. Todos los apartamentos están ubicados en las mejores zonas del centro de Barcelona, con lo cual podremos ofrecerle excelentes consejos para hacer de su estancia una experiencia única.

summary: 15 min from the center of the city. full equiped flat.
description: 15 min from the center of the city. full equiped flat.

reviews.comments: Adrian was great host, he went above and beyond to make us feel at home. We stayed here during the primavera sound festival. It was the perfect location, his apartment is a block away from the L1 metro which takes you directly to the trams for the festival. I also liked staying in a area  that is far enough from the tourist traps and loud city center. However if you do want to visit the city center it's only a 30 minute metro ride away. His apartment was clean and tidy. Our living space was comfortable. His two adorable cats were also very sweet! Thank you again Adrian! I'll hit you up next year when I come to Barcelona :)

Had a great stay with Adrian! We arrived late at night the first night of our stay and he was very welcoming and offered anything in his fridge. His apartment was very conveniently located, 4 min walk to the Metro and near lots of shops and restaurants. There's a lovely balcony with a view and he has two friendly cats! Highly recommended!

Adrian was a amazing host and was very caring, welcoming and friendly host. I recommended Adrian's flat to everyone who want to get to know Barcelona, spend time with to lovely cats and stay with peaceful and lovely neighbourhood. 

Adri, you are amazing!

It was possible to stay very spontaneously at Adrian's flat. We've booked on the day we arrived. He was very friendly and relaxed. He always asked if we'd like something from off the fridge. One night he cooked a meal for us which was very delicious. In general an awesome host! :)

neighborhood_overview: The apartment is located In the city centre in the multicultural El Raval neighbourhood.  Its one block from Rambla del Raval.  Almost all attractions in the city centre are with in walking distance of the apartment. Although its close to almost anywhere it is not as busy as some other nieghbourhoods of the centre like the Gotic and El Born. Some of the highlights of the neighbourhood are the famous Boqueria market, MACBA Barcelona's museum for modern art and Gaudi's city palace Palau Guell. It is also the place for trendy shops and restaurants to spring up, which next to their traditional counterparts make a lively mix of old and new.
notes: We have a pet bunny called Duque who is free to roam around. We keep him from going into the guest rooms. He is very sociable and likes to be petted.

Please try to not be wastefull of resources like water and electricity.

host.host_about:
We are Erwin and Isabel. A Dutch Colombian couple. 

Erwin, is a Dutch national who has lived in Barcelona for the past 8 years. I've worked as a tourist guide in the city. I speak Dutch, English and Spanish. I occupy myself with photography, drawing, cycling and playing frisbee. 

Isabel is a Colombian national and also has lived in the city for 8 years. She speaks Spanish and English. She Works for a small community garden and gives workshops in ecological gardening  and as well yoga and salsa classes. Isabel is currently away visiting family.

host.host_about:

Llevamos 14 años trabajando con un claro objetivo: ofrecer a nuestros clientes la mejor selección de apartamentos a precios competitivos. reviews.comments: Great place, very large too.

Exactly as posted in airbnb. Huge rooms, dining  area and.living room. Host is readily available. Easy to contact for your needs. Oscar even gave us tips on where to go. Clean apartment and the towels and bed sheets smells good.
An excellent, spacious apartment. Suitable for a large group.

The city tax wasn‘t mentioned in the pricing, which was a bit unpleasant. Furthermore, the neighbors are very sensitive to noise, we has a dinner with 10 people, some background music and animated talk, and at 11pm Friendly Rentals called because some neighbor had complained. I understand neighbors are annoyed by holiday flats, but I guess it’s important to know before booking. Also, Friendly Rentals gave us only two sets of keys, which is complicated if you travel as a group of 10 persons who might have different plans in the city. Bur apart from that, the flat is super nice, clean, well equipped, rooms are well distributed. Also nice: we could check in earlier than announced.
Great place and great location. We forgot some valuable items at the apartment and they kept it apart for us. Definitely recommend this place.
Good location!
位置好,环境不错,空间大,房东热情｡
Lindo y espacioso. Buena ubicación.

The apartment is in a lovely location and spotlessly clean. We enjoyed our stay very much a recommend it to everyone.
Well located, clean and spacious. Would recommend to others.
A lovely apartment with plenty of room for 10 guests

Muy bonito departamento, muy buena ubicación cerca de la parada del autobús  V17 y 47 que te traen desde barrio gótico. La sagrada familia está a unos 15 minutos caminando. Para desayunar hay muchos lugares ricos alrededores.  Muy recomendable, seguro regresamos

reviews.comments: I stayed at Loft Miro with my 6-year old daughter.  We absolutely loved our stay.  My top requirement, which was that the place was clean, was fully met.  It is a very modern and new apartment.  The furniture is good quality so the beds and the couch were very comfortable.  I liked the fact that it has both a bath and a shower so I was able to give my daughter bubble baths upstairs and I took my showers downstairs.  The WiFi was fast and the heating worked well (the temperature dropped in the evenings so this was handy).  The place was decorated tastefully and was very tranquil, just as described.  The location is also perfect.  It is located just a 5 minute walk away from the Plaza Espana, where there is a modern shopping centre with good restaurants.  It is close to 2 different subway lines (one just a block away and the other at the Plaza Espana), so there are plenty of options for getting around.  The train station is also close by.  There is a big park 1 minute away, which is great if you have children.  And there is a supermarket, a good bakery/cafe, a 24-hour pharmacy and a little grocery shop open evenings and Sundays - all nearby.  One thing that you cannot tell from the pictures or the description is where the apartment is located.  It is on the ground floor, in a private area (almost like a courtyard) behind an apartment building.  To get to it, you enter the building and then take a private, secured corridor behind the lift.  There is only one other apartment in this private area and no apartments above, so it is extremely quiet, which is refreshing after a day of being in a big, noisy city.  The only thing I recommend is that guests ask to be shown how to lock and unlock the doors to the apartment and the private corridor, as they can be a bit tricky.  They are very secure but you just need to know the trick.  Overall, the apartment was just perfect.  I would definitely stay again.

The welcome person, Ivan, was super friendly. The apartment is beautiful even better than the photos. Is well located in a quiet neighborhood …. definitely we will come back.
thank you.
Nice place, matched our expectations in every respect. Ivan, welcomed us warmly and sorted out everything for us. We'll be back here...

My friends and I stayed in Loft Miro for two nights in May 2015. The host, Ivan, met with us at the loft with the warmest welcome. He showed us around the loft and explained how everything worked (keys, wifi, bins, etc.), and also gave us loads of recommendations for nearby restaurants, bars and places to see. The location of the loft was just excellent. It was literally a two-minute walk from the metro station Tarragona, and about ten-minute walk from the train station.  There were several cafes, grocery stores and 24-hour pharmacy nearby. The photos here on Airbnb have shown exactly what the loft looked like. It was an independent loft on the ground floor behind a big residential building, so it was super quiet both day and night during our stay. The loft and facilities inside were in great conditions, and the beddings and towels are nice and clean.

La verdad que el piso esta genial y se ajusto a nuestras necesidades. 
La etencion con la persona responsable tambien fue muy correcta.

Alain met us at the apartment; very friendly and knowledgeable, even helped us with a problem with the taxi driver we rode with from the airport. 
The apartment was clean, attractively decorated, with everything working. Had 2 nice sized bathrooms which was very helpful for us as we were traveling with our 2 boys (12 and 15). 
The one minor problem we had was taken care of promptly and efficiently while we were out sightseeing, 
The neighborhood was interesting - while not in the center of things, it was not in a tourist saturated neighborhood, and it was very near a central transportation hub and one of the city's best shopping malls. We had breakfast every morning at the same charming neighborhood cafe  and after the second or third day, we were treated like regulars.

All in all, we had a great time and would stay at Loft Miro again.

I believe we were met by one of the host's agents. His name escapes me but he was extremely friendly and welcoming. He answered all of our questions and offered to help us in any way possible i.e. calling a taxi for the airport and translating conversations with locals over the phone if need be. He could not have been better or nicer. The apartment was true to the pictures posted. It was very nice and clean. It has a fantastic location just about 5-10 minute walk away from the metro. Would definitely recommend anyone to stay here.

Nous avons séjourné au loft miro du 10 au 18 juillet 2015.Très bien accueillisi par yvan.
Le loft est exactement conforme aux photos, confortable, moderne, fonctionnel -les salles de bain et cuisine sont modernes et impeccables bonne literie,  climatisé,très propre et surtout très calme.Seul bémol, pas de vue, mais un luxe à barcelone, très calme     !
A proximité de 2 stations de métro: sants et tarragone, très pratique  et à 5 mn des "arènes":centre commercial sur plusieurs étages ,avec un grand choix de restaurants à la terrasse au dernier étage et une vue panoramique sur la ville et les jeux d'eaux des fontaines , superbe.
En résumé , un séjour très agréable que nous recommandons

The loft is as pictured. A chic place to set up your home base as you venture the city. It is in a very convenient location. Also close to the aerobus. Alain was awesome and gave me some great recommendations and even made sure I was able to unlock the door!

The neighbourhood was nice and safe. It is close to restaurants and a shoppingcentre. The metro is around the corner. However it's not really in the centre of Barcelona, you always have to take the metro.The apartment was great. Everything was clean and it was well equipped. The WIFI worked very well. The contactperson was very kind, he explained us how Barcelona works en and he gave tips where it was expensive and where not. The apartment is perfect for four people, but for five it's rather small. There were plenty of cupboards for your clothes. I would certainly recommend this apartment to other people.

The loft is exactly as pictured, it was bright and spacious enough for me and two of my friends. The place was clean and prepared for our arrival. We were met by one of the agents who made sure to give us all the information we needed, as well as great advice and help on cool things to do around the city. Any help we needed as well as any concerns were easily and quickly managed! The location was great too. Very close to Las Arenas mall and Montjuic, while transportation to the other main spots were quite easy.  It was a great home base for us and we're definitely looking forward to being back.
Apartment was very beautiful and was very accommodating for 6 people. Diego gave us some great tips and was very helpful upon our arrival to Barcelona. I would definitely recommend staying here.

We enjoyed staying at Alain and Sylie's. We were greeted by Diego and another agent. They arrived very quickly after our phone call and gave us a detailed tour of the apartment, including information on local attractions, maps, etc. They answered some tourist questions we had.
My husband is very tall (over 6ft) and struggled a bit with the ceiling height up in the loft. We ended up not using the upstairs shower, as the ceiling was quite low. This wasn't a problem, though, as the shower downstairs was just fine.
We did run out of hot water one day, but I think that was because my daughter was washing her hair! The tank is in a cupboard on the deck, so it is easy to check the thermometer to see when it is hot again. :)
I really appreciated the washer/dryer and the clothes drying rack. Keeping on top of the washing is a priority when taking an extended trip with children.
The building felt safe and secure. We didn't see another tenant, but we did chat with someone from the cafe next door and they were very friendly and helpful. We heard some music each night around dinner time. Perhaps it was the dance studio next door?? But the music was never played too late.
The loft is in a great location, near Sants station, the old bullfighting ring that has been turned into a mall, the Montjuic fountain. I recommend walking to the top of the stairs at Placa de les Cascades for the amazing view.

The apartment was exactly as shown in pictures
Good location. Very close to subway.
The only minus is that amount of hot water is limited. We were 6 people and had to shower quickly :)
Otherwise no complaints

Ottima accoglienza di referenti dei proprietari. Hanno fornito informazioni su luoghi principali e consigli utili per il soggiorno.
L'appartamento è esattamente come le foto, al piano terra nel retro di un palazzo. La posizione è comoda per poter accedere a tutta la città.  Piazza di Spagna è a due passi e Parc Mirò proprio alla, uscita dal palazzo. Quartiere tranquillo e Piazza di Spagna offre molti posti per cenare.
Appartamento ottimamente fornito per il soggiorno.
Great place in a nice, convenient part of Barcelona.  Appreciated the quick response of the owners.  Highly recommend!
Wonderful appartement very well located.

Very close to the train station,10 minutes walking to the the loft which is behind a apartment building, but really easy to find. Two young guys welcomed us and took their patients to teach us how to open the door. Once you learned the skill you will find it's not like the other tenants said that tricky. 

The interior is quite new , clean and in a modern style. We pretty much like the furniture and painting colour. The pillow and quilts are really comfortable. Only the upstairs bathroom is a little small for a man, and since it's a loft the sound-proof is a bit weak. 
 
If you just need a good location and reasonable price its definitely a good choice.
A really Nice place with good service! All was perfect :)

El loft es tal y como se muestra en  las imágenes. Está bien situado. Una boca de metro justo al lado.Es acogedor a la vez que moderno. Está muy bien decorado. Las camas son muy cómodas y los 2 baños muy bien. En general está limpio y ordenado. La cocina es pequeña, pero para hacer desayunos o algo rápido es suficiente. La wifi funciona bien.
El único problema que tuvimos es que había quedado con Alain en que el dia de ida nos marchábamos a las 3 de la tarde, y el mismo dia de ida a las 7 de la mañana recibimos un mensaje de que teníamos que dejar el apartamento a las 11.30 horas. Esto nos causó un gran perjuicio ya que nos trastocó todos los planes del último día. Deberían haber avisado antes.
En general recomendable para una visita  a la ciudad.
The host canceled this reservation 2 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.
Magnífico loft. Tal y como se ve en las fotos. Moderno y acogedor.Nada de ruidos. Cerca de transporte público. Repetiría

The apartment was really nice and modern, beds were pretty comfortable but the couch was a little stiff and not suitable seating for 4 people to watch the TV together if they wanted to. But overall it was great! Ivan was super friendly and helpful, would definitely recommend!

We like the apartment, Santiago was very helpful, gave us information, on how to get around in Barcelona. Train station is near the apartment walking distance  restaurants, supermarkets. But we had one inconvenience  the light brakers went down and most of the house didn't had no electricity for couple of hours, until Santiago, send someone to fix it.
The place was very comfortable and Ivan was very helpful when we had a brief power outage.

We had an amazing stay at Loft Miro. The host was extremely accommodating and helpful and answered any questions that we had. Close to  the metro which was really convenient and lots of places to explore in the area. Already recommended to our friends :)

Die Kommunikation mit den Gastgebern, sowie die Schlüsselübergabe hat problemlos geklappt. Die Unterkunft sieht so wie auf den Fotos aus und bietet jeglichen Konform. Einziges Manko: im Hauptraum (und somit auch im oberen Schlafzimmer) gibt es keine Heizung, kann bei kälteren Wetter etwas ungemühtlicher werden. Allerdings gibt es einen kleinen portablen Heizstrahler in der Wohnung den man im Notfall dafür verwenden kann.

We loved our stay at Loft Miro! Perfect accommodations, idyllic patio for wine, and a perfect home base for sightseeing. We felt totally immersed within the culture by living in Lana and Alain's beautiful neighborhood!
The flat is located very good. The host was organized and everything went well, when we got the keys. Thank's to Lana&Alain!

Sehr schöne und moderne  Wohnung. Alles war sehr sauber und gut organisiert. 
Mit den Vermieter hat alles reibungslos geklappt. 
Kann man nur weiter empfehlen.

We were welcomed at the door and the host was very friendly. He gave us many great suggestions as to what we should do while in Barcelona. The apartment was just as pictured and very clean. we thoroughly enjoyed our time here and would definitely stay again. The neighborhood seemed to be a great representation as to what local life is like in the city. Great cafes and restaurants near by.

This is a beautiful clean unit that is exactly as pictured.  It is a little bit of a walk from the city center / ramblas area, but we like to walk and walked everywhere.  The host was very helpful and communication with them was easy and great.  The host also arranged our early morning cab pickup to the airport which was very helpful.  The listing does say that the unit has a washer/dryer, and I did not see one.  Maybe there is one in the building...I did not check, but I did not see one in the unit itself.

Me and my friends stayed at this apartment for 3 nights and had a great time. It's a great apartment, nice neighbourhood and located close to a train station so easy to get around the city. Has everything you need and they were very helpful.
Lana & Alain are awesome hosts with awesome apartment to stay in Barcelona. We love the apartment and the location is convenient.

I booked last minute (2 days before) and was so happy a place of this standard was available. Tony very quickly got in contact to arrange meeting us at the flat, and even though he fell off his bike on the way to us he made sure he got to us as quickly as he could! The flat was exactly like it looked in the photos, a perfect modern place for a long weekend away!
Hermoso departamento, muy bien ubicado. Todas las personas dispuestas a ayudar. Recomendable
Excelente!!

Great apartment - the space is well utilised, so it worked well for a family of five. The place was clean and nicely decorated. The location is also a bonus - as it is a very short walk from the metro. Our host was helpful - both upon arrival and when we took off. Much prefer this to a hotel room - when travelling with children.

Très bel appartement, conforme aux photos du site.
Quartier calme et agréable proche du musée national d'art, du village espagnol, de la fondation Miro et du Montjuïc. (possibilité de faire tout cela à pieds).
Il y a également 2 stations de métro proche de l'appartement donc, pas de problème pour se déplacer. Nous avons tout fait à pieds et en métro!
Bon accueil et bonne réactivité dans les communications (mail, sms...) 
Je recommande cette appartement avec plaisir, nous avons passé 5 jours à 6 personnes. 
Il y a aussi un parking souterrain pour garer la voiture à proximité ( nous avons payé 50€ pour les 5 jours pendant le mois de juillet !)
Great place for 6 people, easy to get around, metro is close by. some things in the apartment didn't work well, but nothing that ruined our stay.

Ivan, il loro agente ci ha accolto molto bene, spiegandoci tutto dell'appartamento e dandoci indicazioni su come raggiungere il centro e altri punti di interesse. l appartamento è bello così come lo si vede in foto, siamo stati in 5 e avere due bagni è stato davvero molto comodo! Tutto pulito e pronto all'arrivo, con asciugamani già piegati sui letti, sembrava di essere in hotel! Lo consiglio molto!

Very nice stay at Miro' Loft. The place was nice and very clean. From there it's easy to reach the heart of the city. The agent came late to the check-in as he was busy with other customers, but didn't charge us for the late check-in. Much appreciated as we arrived ourself after 21h.
really cozy house ever!! very much kind host and all the appliances are perfect!!

Excelente, cumple a cabalidad con lo mostrado en las fotos y lo esperado.
El departamento está ubicado en un lugar tranquilo y muy cerca de Plaza España y Montjuic
Volvería sin dudarlo

Lana&Alain's apartment is very comfortable, Plaza Espanya and metro station are nearby by 8 min walking.
The rooms and decoration are nice, we had a joyful experience.
Yes welcome

Modern apartment in a quiet neighbourhood and yet close to key public transport nodes e.g. Barcelona Sants station, and Metro stations.  Also near to La Arenas - one of the larger modern shopping malls in Barcelona with a very well stocked supermarket.  Highly recommended for a family visit.

This is a lovely apartment centrally located with easy access to transport and historical sites. We enjoyed our stay here and the welcome accorded by the host helped us adapt to the apartment and the city of Barcelona.

Tudo foi bom. O único senão foi a água quente dos chuveiros. Super pontuais na chegada , ajudando inclusive com táxi . Local super limpo e espaçoso . Localização muito boa . Não é colado as principais atrações , mas é perto. Alem disto,  e muito importante , metrô pertissimo.  Silencioso e com boas opções para jantar perto.

La casa è molto accogliente, la zona in cui si trova è comoda vicino alla metro e a qualsiasi zona interessata. 
l'appartamento è fornito di qualsiasi comfort, ci siamo trovati benissimo, la consiglio assolutamente.

Everything of the apartment is same as the pictures, and the best thing is the location.  Its near Barcelona Sants, it is much easy for the traveller who came from other cities by train.  You can easy to find the apartment from the Sants station.  And it have supermarket & convenience store just downstair, you can easy to buy drinks & food. This aparment is really a good choice when you are in Barcelona.

This is a very good place to stay , I come to Barcelona with my family, 3 old ladies and 3 young teenaged. The location is really good, easy to get to great tourist place, and only 5 mins to metro station! 10/15 mins to train station, 15/20 to airport !! The house is very clean; with all the stuff we need for cooking, we cook four times !! Very nice place to stay . The only one thing to pick is the air circulation, but that might because of  we, as Asian, don't get used to warmer . They are very helpful and friendly !Overall , I really recommend this is the best place to stay in Barcelona !
非常好,设施很齐全,位置也很好,

Excelente apartamento, muy bien ubicado, cerca al metro, Lana & Alain siempre fueron muy amables. Sugiero que pregunten si hay una persona que haga aseo al apartamento si es que es de su interés, yo no lo hice.

Appartement bien situé et calme.
Accueil très bien organisé.

Nous avons passé un très agréable séjour a Barcelone grâce a l'accueil parfait de Lana&Alain.
Le loft est spacieux, bien équipé, très propre et tout a fait conforme a la description.
Situé dans un quartier calme mais proche du centre, l'emplacement est idéal !
Merci beaucoup, nous n'hésiterons pas à revenir!

Very nice stay, convenient to go anywhere, close to metro station. Nice decoration and very clean, my kid kept talking about the wonderful stay in Barcelona. Lana & Alain helped to arrange the taxi to airport and introduced many good restaurant and travel guide, so helpful. Thank you for the good memories in Barcelona.

Bing
An amazing loft, in a central location, great for a group of young people! Excellent hosts!

Excelente opção em Barcelona. Loft bem localizado, ao lado da estação Tarragona (metro linha 3). Próximo a um supermercado (condis) e a um centro comercial (arenas shopping). Apartamento silencioso, limpo e funcional. Ideal para quatro pessoas, inclusive com crianças. Cozinha bem equipada, máquina de lavar roupa e louça. Pátio ideal para jantar romântico e toda infraestrutura de TV a cabo e Wi-Fi. Sensacional!!!!
Very responsive owners/staff.  Of our four vacation rentals this trip, they were the best.  Note the loft has a sloped ceiling , making it more difficult for taller guests.
Excellent hosts

The apartment is same as the pictures, great location and easy to access transport. (very short walk from the metro). We enjoyed our stay here.
The only thing to pick is the neighbor's loud party and quiet a lot of tiny black ants on the floor. :(

Except for the neighbor's loud party, we really enjoyed our stay.  Great location and walked everywhere.  We did not use air conditioning, opened windows in evenings and it was nice.  Bedding was a bit heavy for this time of year, but we came from Alaska so our temperature settings may be different.  The bakery around the corner (left out door, left at corner, immediate left) was really amazing.  Looks like several self improvement jobs were done, but nothing that makes any difference unless you are a perfectionist.  We would definitely stay here again.  We arrived earlier than planned and they were able to accommodate us - Thank you!
loft结构的室内空间､非常干净､交通很方便｡

Lana & Alain's apartment is absolutely beautiful!! I was very happy with the cleanliness. We was provided with everything we neeeded. The location is perfect and close to everywhere you possibly would want to visit in Barca. The host was polite, friendly and very helpful. Gave us all the info we needed for a first visit. definitely would recommend this apartment!!!!


Mel x
房子很新,很整洁,只是loft结构会导致楼上那间房没有门,不是特别隔音,但附近吃,出行都很方便｡房东人非常有耐心,很友好,而且很帅

This place was absolutely lovely.  My family and truly felt at home. I would recommend this place to anyone that wants to be close to almost everything and far enough to get some peace and quiet at the end of the day.
The check in was easy and convenient, and the stay was pleasant. I would stay in this aprtment again if I revisited the neighborhood.
Very nice place to stay, very clean and chic. Close to metro station.
Great place and neighborhood. Really enjoyed our stay

Location, location, location!!!  Loft Miro is so well located - near the Metro and country train station, and a delightful café around the corner for a delicious coffee and croissant breakfast a la Barcelona!

I recommend the property . Location is good , apartment clean and well equipped.
Comfortable , but wood floor in entrance hall needs repairs .
Muy cómodo todo!
Beautiful modern apartment, great location. Everything was perfect! The only thing that bothered was the lack of intimacy for the people in the bedroom upstairs. There's no door for this room.

Nice, contemporary modern loft that we enjoyed staying in during our 4 day stay in Barcelona. There were 6 of us and it was cozy yet spacious enough for all of us. The location was very convenient since it was close to the metro and in a quiet neighborhood which we enjoyed at the end of every day. 

The kitchen was stocked with everything we needed to eat in some nights. A carton of milk in the fridge was a very thoughtful touch since we were traveling with kids. A supermarket was right around corner and quite a few restaurants within walking distance. 

Highly recommend and we would choose it again if we visit Barcelona again.

Жилье находится в хорошем месте напротив парка Миро, недалеко от старого города. В квартире два этажа, на первом гостиная, кухня и спальня с ванной и туалетом, на втором этаже спальня и ванна с туалетом. Есть небольшое патио на балконе. 
На кухне есть все, что необходимо, чтоб готовить каждый день. Шустрый вайфай. Дизайнерский интерьер. 
Рекомендую данную квартиру. Спасибо!

Dear Lana and Liana, thank you very much for a great stay in Barcelona. The apartment is great, in a great location, well equipped. The stores around the apartment are great. We stayed there for 5 nights with our kids and we all had a great time. The check in was great as well. We highly recommend this apartment!
nice apartment for 2 couples, just a short a walk to arenas , plaza espanya , very nice location , quite pleased to stay there!
Thanks Lana for hosting us. We had a wonderful and comfortable stay at your beautiful loft.

Really handy place to stay. Next to metro and Sants station. No need for expensive taxis to and from airport. Right next to Plaza España. Clean, comfortable. Stayed with three adults and three kids aged 8-15 and we loved it. Very accomodating with late check out.
Emplacement parfait que ce soit pour les parking magasins ou métro

Appartement très jolie et lumineux. 
Très satisfaite je recommande
Una estancia estupenda, volveremos seguro!

Não tenho nada a reclamar. Acomodação excelente, limpa, confortável e check-in muito tranquilo. Sandro, o rapaz responsável por nos dar as boas vindas foi extremamente educado, nos mostrou todo o loft com bastante cuidado e ficou a nossa inteira disposição. Tem estação de metrô próxima, mercado e até um shopping. Vale muito o custo benefício!
We spent 6 days in Barcelona with my friends. The appartment was great. Everythig was good and also the wi-fi was fantastic. That was important to us because it was our work trip
Muy buen apartamento lo único que faltan las persianas.
The house is so close to the city centre. In a good place. It was clean and beautiful and had everything u may needed. You should stay in this house if you ever visit Barcelona. Thank you
Прекрасная квартира в удобном месте, приветливые хозяева, уютно, чисто и комфортно.
The place was perfect for 5 days for a group of 4. The place is located in a central but quite place.

Localização boa, internet e TV funcionaram bem, o local é silencioso e tem muitos serviços perto, cama confortavel.
Muitas coisas nos decepcionaram:
Falta de privacidade, uma pessoa entrou na casa sem avisar nem tocar a campainha, do nada.
Cobrança indevida, no site havia um valor de taxa de turismo, nos cobraram outra e quando reclamamos mudaram o valor do site para nos enganar, tive que me queixar ao airbnb, que claro percebeu a tentativa de nos enganar, os  anfitriões nem  manifestaram interesse em resolver o problema. Não houve  nenhuma retratação apesar do airbnb devolver 20 euros para nós.
O quarto superior tem o teto baixo, assim como o banheiro, isso deveria ser informado. Ninguém maior que 1.55 metros consegue usar esses ambientes confortavelmente. A chave de energia caiu várias vezes e a água quente acabava após 2 pessoas tomarem banho, ninguém nos explicou nada sobre.
A calefação é em grande parte feira com ar condicionado split inverter que adicionalmente havia um sensor de presença para desligar, ou seja o importante aqui é economizar e não dar conforto ao usuário.  Nos deixaram duas chaves da casa mas somente uma funcionava.A calefação dos banheiros estava quebrada e não arrumaram mesmo após nossa queixa. Por fim, muito frio impessoal  e não satisfatório um grande business como muita coisa em BCN, ou seja ganhar dinherio esta bem mas  o servço em geral  foi serviço ruim e portanto caro.

Lana & Alain's place is a stylish and spacious home with a loft bedroom. Located just minutes from Sants train station, their place also has a supermarket and affordable restaurants right at the doorstep. One thing to note is that the washing machine is located at the balcony so it was really cold to step out to use the machine during winter. Overall, it was great location to stay at.
Great place to stay for a few days visit to Barcelona! Close to transport and sights. Supermarket, park and cafes in walking distance. Hosts very helpful and quick to respond to queries.
Très bel appartement , calme et très bien placé : tout près du métro et d'une supérette, le top

Es un apartamento excelente, muy agradable, cerca al metro y otros lugares de interés, Lana & Alain siempre son muy cordiales y  la comunicación con ellos es muy efectiva. Ha sido muy grata la experiencia en este lugar.

Le logement de Lana & Alain est très spacieux, haut de gamme et plus que parfait pour 3 personnes, 2 styles de salle de bain différents. Les équipements sont optimales ( clim, chauffage etc ), les chambres spacieuses, l’accès au logements idéal pour toutes personnes.
La ville de Barcelone nous a enchanté de part son ouverture sur les différentes cultures, la gentillesse des gens, ouvertures d’esprits et j’en passe; les balades en villes furent convivial; une première pour nous. 
Le parc guëll avec son centre monumental nous a marqué particulièrement, une vue magnifique. En revanche prévoyez un moyen de transport ou autre pour vous y rendre, la queue pour les taxis est interminable lors des grosses affluences. 
Le quartier gothique,
la sagrada familia, magnifique sont à visiter absolument, sans oublier la barceloneta.

Все было просто великолепно! Расположение супер! Рядом отличный парк для прогулок с детьми и без. В шаговой доступности ТРК Арена с обзорной площадкой. Рядом с Ареной ресторан все включено Wok. 
Квартира отличная. Были с 14 марта по 20 марта, семья с 3 детьми. Всем было удобно. 
Спасибо хозяевам и персонально Сантьяго.
Рекомендую к посещению.

J'avais reservé cet appartement pour ma famille qui venait en vacances me visiter, les premiers jours ont été un peu bruyants á cause du voisin dén face qui faisait la fête tard, puis ensuite beaucoup mieux, ma famille a été tres contente de sejourner dans cet appartement, tres spacieux, bien decoré et bien placé. Le seul hic l'odeur dans la salle du bain du bas et comme je l'ai dit le bruit du voisin les premiers jours. Merci encore à votre agence Alain et Lana.

la casa è molto accogliente e curata nei dettagli.
il check in è stata fatto in tempi rapidi e con grande professionalità
la casa è vicina (circa 2 minuti a piedi) a due fermate della metro.
Loft impeccable, très bien aménagé et au calme ce qui est très agréable particulièrement à BCN. Métro à deux pas qui vous emmène rapidement partout. Une adresse que nous recommanderons à des amis.

Nous avons passés un très bon séjour chez Lana & Alain, nous étions 4 et nous avons été très à l'aise (grand appartement) nous recommanderons ce logement à nos amis.
Metro juste à côté qui dépose directement sur les Ramblas.
Bel appartement, bien situé, très calme. Idéal pour 4 personnes.
excelente lofm, bien ubicado y todos los servicios en orden
Amazing place for 6, everything we needed
Cozy apartment in a great position, ideal for a few days visit of the city.
Really nice apartment near Placa de Espanya. We much enjoyed our stay.
Best loft, good localisation, good communication, thank you so much Lana & Alain

Location perfetta per un gruppo di amici.
Casa bella spaziosa e accogliente.
Consiglio vivamente
Nice house but a little far from the city. Super private. Didn’t feel like an apartment more like a house. Supermarket and train station walking distance. Said 3 bedrooms but was 2.
The apartment is well-equipped and is situated at a very convenient location.

Location is great and property is nice. Communication with the owner was straight forward and clear. Had some minor issues which I am sure will be resolved for future guests! Overall a very good stay. By the way...mattresses are very comfortable in the bedroom upstairs!
The location is great. Metro station is right there. Lots of restaurants in the area too.

lana and Alain’s place is sparkling clean, comfortable, stylish and the location is awesome near placa de spanyol just 7 minuets walk so transportation is very easy. I highly recommend this place to everyone. For sure I will back to their place next time
muy buen loft

I do recommend the flat. The location is great, 5 min walking away from Espania Square and the Magic Fontains. Guillem is very friendly and helpful. The flat is big enough even for 6 people. Very clean and quiet. We had a great stay!

Lana and Alain’s place was very comfortable, stylish, clean, and functional. Beds and pillows were comfortable and the linens and towels smelled good. Kitchen utensils and appliances were complete. Space was ample for four people. Location was convenient, few minutes walk from Placa Espanya, Arenas de Barcelona, and Montjuic. Communication with hosts was fast and helpful. We hope to return soon.

Had a great time in the apartment.  We were 3 adults and 3 kids and we had plenty of space.  The split level plus 2 bathrooms worked very well for us.  The place was clean and modern as pictured.  The check in manager was great even though we were quite a bit later than expected.  The apartment was easy to get to and the neighbor hood was fine.  It’s close to the sites, but still requires using public transport to get down to the centre of town. We felt like the quality/price was well balanced.   We would recommend and would stay here again.
квартира очень понравилась, хорошое расположение,рядом метро и автобусные остановки, много разных магазинов и кафе. квартира уютная и чистая, все есть необходимое для хорошего отдыха в Барселоне!

We had a wonderful stay at Loft Miro. It is a quiet relaxing flat, far enough out of the centre to offer relaxing pauses in your stay, but just two minutes walk from a metro stop that has you in any number of locations in 10mins. You also have the advantage of having the exquisite Museu Nacional d'Art de Catalunya only 10mins walk away (plus a few additional steps)! An immediate local supermarket and pharmacy are on hand to the flat alongside many shops and restaurants within a few minutes walk, including Arenas de Barcelona for larger roof-top restaurants with an excellent view and even a cinema if needed. 

Our check in and check out experience were very easy with a wonderful host who gave lots of tips and stayed in touch throughout our stay. Late check out was very easily arranged for a small additional fee. The flat was spotlessly clean and is very well equipped for cooking if needed, which helps when travelling with children and the washer /drier is a also a useful addition. One bathroom has a large walk in shower, the other bathroom has a small bath and much lower shower, suitable for children and smaller adults. Any taller guests will need to share the downstairs shower. We had one or two minor requests during our visit for light bulbs and plugs etc and these were answered quickly. We visited out of season and the flat was warm and cosy. Lovely crisp white bedding is provided along with memory foam pillows and excellent mattresses / duvets - we slept well!

The street entrance to the complex is easy to find and well lit and the complex and wider local area feel extremely safe and welcoming. Entrance to the flat is on the ground floor so no major staircases or lifts required.  Be aware if travelling with older or disabled guests that there is a small external step up to the apartment entrance and one step within the apartment down to the nearest bedroom and bathroom. The second bedroom in the flat is up a small flight of stairs as seen in the flat photos. This didn't stop my older parents enjoying the flat, but it is not fully accessible. There are some works being done on the complex that temporarily make the second entrance to the flat darker, this is no problem for safety but visibility outside the flat door is a little restricted at night.

Overall we had a brilliant stay in Barcelona at Loft Miro with warm hospitality and good amenities, we hope you do too!

Great location livable and stylish property minutes walk to plaza Espanya and a shopping mall away from the touristic district lots of shops and grocery stores  a great place to chill and live around the locals
Super appartement bien situé, agréable et bien décoré. Merci à Guilhem PARFAIT pour son accueil, précis, ponctuel et disponible, c'est très rassurant! Un bonheur! PERFECT APPARTMENT!!!

loft appartment was clean and spacious, location ideal for a group of 4 - nice residential area with good connections on metro. William met us upon arrival and gave us local knowledge of where to eat and best tourist attractions. We had a slight issue with the hot water and messaged home owner and got a response straight away and someone came out to visit same day to resolve issue. Apartment has 2 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, upstairs bath/shower is Abit awkward but works none the less. We asked for late check out for a few of €30 which we all thought was exceptionally reasonable. Overall excellent trip to Barcelona - thank you Lana & Alain !

The Loft is beautiful and comfortable. It is conviniently located near many places to roam or catch a metro. We appreciate the personal connection at check-in and explanation of how to get to sites we wanted to visited. The grocery store is steps away. 
Most importantly the Loft is clean, beautiful and comfortable. When we were tired or wanted some downtime, the Loft was relaxing.
Very good

The charming apartment block is well-located on a lively block, with supermarkets, bars, airport bus, metro stops and street markets all very close by. 

As the first guests in the newly-renovated apartment, there were a few small details to be ironed out, but Lina and Marina proved responsive, reactive and helpful (and this throughout the Christmas period) and did everything that could possibly be done to deal with our requests. 

These aside, it was a comfortable apartment, with very convenient location and very supportive hosts.

Very nice apartment . 
Looks like everything was prepared with the highest attention . 
Apartment looks exactly as the photos , but once you get there it is even better , cozy , secure , clean and bigger than expected . 
I highly recommend this  apartment in case you have to visit Barcelona.
Definitely I would book it again .

Beautiful apartment, nicely furnished and in a nice location. Although took around 15-20 minutes minimum to get to las ramblas. 45 minutes to walk to the beach. Very well furnished with lots of useful amenities including a hair drier, washing machine etc. Beds were comfortable although no proper double bed (two singles pushed together). Bit cramped for 6 people but would be perfect for 4, maybe 5.

Beautiful apartment close to Urgell metro station. Lina was a great host when we noted the toaster didn't work she bought us a new one within hours. Very responsive hosts with all the essentials provided. Great renovation of a classic apartment too. Would highly recommend.

Si tratta di un bell'appartamento e molto pulito, in una posizione molto conveniente: è infatti a pochi metri dalla fermata della metro Urgell sulla L1 e l'autobus per l'aeroporto El Prat ferma proprio di fronte alla porta dello stabile.
L'aria condizionata ha funzionato bene, il WiFi non sempre.

The apartment is a part of an apartment hotel chain. The location is good, especially coming from the airport there's a bus stop right around the corner. There was an extra fee for our late arrival after 10pm. The apartment itself was sizeable enough for 4, and furnished like a normal, neutral hotel room, with a nice balcony. Unfortunately there was a strong moldy smell around the bathroom, so I wouldn't have liked to stay for more than a night or two. Nice cafes and supermarkets just around the block.
The apartment is a good point to visit Barcelona. Anything you need is available and the team of Lina cares for everything. The furniture is simple but comfortable.

reviews.comments:
Le logement bénéficie d'un excellent emplacement. Il vous permet d'atteindre "Las Ramblas" en 5 minutes à pieds et il est situé dans un quartier résidentiel à 2 minutes des commerces et des restaurants.

Le logement est très beau à l'intérieur, bien décoré et très propre, avec une terrasse extérieure spacieuse. 

Le propriétaire de l'appartement est très serviable, il nous a bien guidé pour arriver à la maison depuis l'aéroport et nous a fourni tous les conseils pour atteindre les principaux sites de la ville.

Je vous conseille vivement ce logement.

Appartement magnifique, tres propre, décoré avec goût et très bien situé ! 
Alberto est un hôte très accueillant et à l'écoute des voyageurs ! 
À réserver les yeux fermés !

My host, Alberto, is one if the nicest people I know. Honestly. 
We were at Barcelona during the terrorist attack in La Rambla in Augost 2017. 
He was the first to call us, making sure that we are safe. Glad to know the guy. 
The appartment is very good value for what we paid, central and very clean and very nice. recommend with all my heart

Lägenheten är fin och modern med två sovrum, plats för fyra personer i två dubbelsängar. Dock finns det bara två stolar innomhus. Bordet på terrassen har fyra stolar men själva bordet är litet så det bästa är att ha maten inne och gå ut och sätta sig. Det skulle vara bra med ett bord att fälla upp innomhus de dagar det regnar. Köket är sparsamt utrustat, men fungerar fint för enklare matlagning. Stekpannan är väldigt liten.
Sitsen i den lilla toaletten är trasig och det finns ingen hållare till toapappret på någon av toaletterna. Vattnet i duschen rinner undan långsamt och det blir lätt en sjö på golvet. 
Lägenheten har ett mycket bra läge med nära till metro som tar dig över hela stan! Nära att promenera också! Finns mataffär och lekplats nära och varje lördag är det marknad utanför dörren!
Det sämsta med lägenheten är allt oljud från trafiken, det är svårt att sitta på terrassen och koppla av. Det är också mycket ljud från grannarna i sovrummet vid ytterdörren.
Det finns ett litet skjul på terrassen där tvättmaskinen finns, det skulle behöva städas och slänga gammalt skräp som står där. Tvättmaskinen luktar illa och ibland är det svårt att öppna luckan, men kläderna blir rena!
Alberto är mycket trevlig och lätt att prata med! Han hjälpte oss mycket! Rekommenderar lägenheten!

An amazing appartement and an exceptional host!

The appartment has the perfect location. You can get anywhere on foot while discovering this beautiful city. The metro stations are also a few minutes away from the house. Different tasty restaurants and Supermercats are located around the corner. The neighborhood is very safe. The appartment is very well equipped. You can find there anything you want. It's very clean and beautifully decorated. I felt instantly at home. The terrace is perfect for relaxation, romantic dinners or for sipping your morning coffee before starting a new adventure. 
Alberto is an amazing host. He is very flexible. He went above and beyond to make my stay comfortable and memorable. His tips are priceless. Always reachable to answer your questions and make your stay even more enjoyable. It was really hard to leave. I left a part of me in this neighborhood and definitely took with me so many precious memories. If you are looking for an appartment to call home in Barcelona, this is definitely the perfect place!

Alberto's place is in a really great spot. I had never been to Barcelona and was a little concerned about being close to everything but not in an overly touristy area. Fortunately, everything is incredibly walkable from this apartment. The maps of Barcelona are a little deceptive, and you can easily cover a lot of ground without trying. The public transit is also amazing if you need to go a little further. 

I spent a month here and would not hesitate to return.

We absolutely loved staying in El Poble Sec!  It’s on a quiet street between two bustling neighborhoods.  Easy access to the Paralel Metro. Short walk to the Ramblas.  And many convenient markets minutes away.  It’s very close to the police station, so we felt that we were in a very safe neighborhood.

Alberto could not have been more charming or helpful. He is an absolutely phenomenal host.

We give this apartment our highest recommendation...
Great location. Extremely friendly host. I would definitely come back again. Clean apartment with great style and comfortable beds.

Alberto's place was our perfect home base for 3 months and Alberto is the best host we have ever had!

The apartment is in a perfect location for many reasons - it's a very short walk from LaRambla, the Paral.lel L3 station is on the same block, grocery stores/fruit stands/restaurants everywhere within a block or two! The apartment is very comfortable and stylish with a huge terrace.

Alberto is the truly the best host we've ever had and an absolutely wonderful human being. He gave us countless tips about Barcelona and travel to Roses, Sitges, Porto, and Lisbon. We loved running into Alberto in the neighborhood walking his dog. He would always offer help and tips with whatever we were doing or wondering about.

We highly recommend this place and any place that Alberto hosts for a wonderful and unforgettable experience!

facing a local playground n skate area with sat bio market, PARALLEL metro station down the street. 5 mins walk to Montjuic, Marina, El Raval, 10 mins walk to La Rambla. One floor up to 2 bedrooms, one face the inside of the building, one face the terrace and street side, 1.5 baths. Alberto is very friendly. More deep cleaning and maintenance would make more pleasant experience.

To be completely honest, our stay wasn't a good one. Checking in was no issue, but the room was incredibly small and was blazing hot. We were offered 1 fan that was pretty useless. 

Secondly, after our 2nd night, we were threatened to be removed from the apartment due to "noise". Our first night consisted of soft music played low on our phones and our 2nd night's noise was a quiet phone conversation, which was interrupted by a loud bang at the door from I  Esther. We essentially had to not make a single noise on our 3rd night to ensure we would remain in the apartment. I get that everyone has annoying neighbors who will complain about most things, but if that's the case, either let us know well in advance, or don't post your place on airbnb. Don't wait until the neighbors to put pressure on you to the point where you tell your guests they can't come back into the apartment and have to make other plans.

Also, take it from someone who's lived in Barcelona, this is certainly not the "most cool area." Easy access to Placa Espanya is great, but for a more enjoyable time you would want to stay further into Eixample.

Nonetheless, they don't seem like bad people, just on edge because Barcelona doesn't like airbnb.

Come da accordo preso precedentemente avevamo prenotato una stanza nel B&B della signora Esther. Eravamo in 4 ragazze, due sarebbero dovute restare nel B&B di Esther e altre due in un altra stanza abdicata a 3 min a piedi in un altra stanza. Appena arrivate ci ha accolto Robert. Non parlava inglese ne spagnolo e ci ha dato il permesso di salire tutte e 4 perché gli abbiamo spiegato che avevamo una valigia comune che dovevamo aprire per dare le robe alle due ragazze che alloggiavano li. Arriva Esther, la padrona di casa. Senza neanche ascoltarci ha iniziato ad urlarci dietro come una matta che non dovevamo stare li tutte e 4. Abbiamo cercato di spiegare con tutta la calma possibile che solo DUE DI NOI DOVEVANO ALLOGGIARE nel suo B&B. Eravamo salite tutte e 4 solo perché avevamo una valigia comune con le piastre dentro e le scarpe. Dovevamo solo dare alle due ragazze che dormivano ospiti nel B&B le loro cose, dopo saremo andate. Ci ha accolto urlando che non potevamo stare lì tutte e quattro e ha zittito Robert che ci aveva permesso di salire per dividere la roba che si trovava nella valigia comune. Urlando e sbraitando, ci ha buttate fuori casa senza neanche ascoltare cosa avevamo da dirle!!! Così ci siamo trovate dalle 13 alle 17 di pomeriggio a cercare un appartamento in zona. Ci ha rovinato tutto il primo giorno di vacanza che lo abbiamo passato a cercare case invece di visitare. Mi dispiace per chi alloggerà di nuovo in questo B&B. Mai trovata così male.

the place is clean and quite near to the sightseeing spots.

Julian is very knowledgable and clean:) he has a very comfy guest rooms and it is very convenient to get around.  It is in a very nice neighbourhood :) I recommend the say :)

Julian is very nice person. he is attentive and helpful. the apartment is comfortabe, cozy, quiet and super clean, what is very important! location also is great. i would recommend the place to everybody!

Julian was very responsive prior to my trip to Barcelona. My friend and I had a great stay at his apartment. Julian is a very nice person. I liked staying at his house because it was  quiet and peaceful after a full day of sightseeing..Also it was so conveniently located. We had a pleasant experience at Julian's home. Thanks again, Julian

Julian was a very nice friendly and hospitable host who greeted us on arrival with a continental breakfast and sweet selection together with a large bottle of water. He made our stay in Barcelona thoroughly enjoyable, and kindly organised a taxi for our departure to the airport, and even got up early himself to bid us farewell. We would have no hesitation in staying with again him should we return to Barcelona.

Julian have a great clean place. The location is really good to see the sagrada familia., the metro is really close and the bus stop is right outside so getting to the beach for sangrias is really easy. Thanks Mate

Julian's apartment was quiet, spotless, and easy to stay in. Julian is a very friendly and a very good host. The appartment is perfect to stay in Barcelone. It is very clean, very well located, peacefully situated and Julian helps you in all matters. We would still come again. Thanks Julian for all. We had a great time.

I am a single woman in my twenties, and my mother and I stayed at Julian's lovely flat for one night.  Julian was an incredibly gracious host. If you buy tickets to tour the Sagrada Familia and need to pick up your tickets from a Caixa ATM, there is one just across the street from his apartment.  The location of the flat cannot be beat! 

My mom and I were in Barcelona only for 1 day, since we were leaving for a cruise the following morning. We were very impressed by how gracious Julian was and how much he did to accommodate us.

The apartment and the room itself are very clean.  Julian provided us with two towels apiece, snacks, and cold water upon our arrival.  The bathroom is also extremely clean.

I HIGHLY recommend staying at Julian's place.  Meeting Julian was genuinely one of the highlights of our trip!  If I ever return to Barcelona, I will definitely stay with Julian again.

As two guys just looking for a place to rest our head we found julians place filled with rules and time tables. I think he was upset because we showed up 30 minutes late......Had to say we did not feel very welcomed to his place. 

Overall the place was clean,quiet and secure at a great location. I wouldn't go back but for the price and the right person this place is not to bad.

Julian is very kind and amicable host.  Very helpful at giving you all kinds of information. The price for room was great and location is perfect. 
Room was small but clean and nice. I have enjoyed my stay there completely, definitely considering going back there, if given opportunity.
Julian was a great host. He is flexible with the check-in times of his room. The location description was accurate to the last word. This is the place to be when you are visiting Barcelona. Good Job.

The room was very clean comfortable and quiet, convenient transportation from the Sagrada Familia is very close, julian is very patient, preparing maps and candy in the (Website hidden by Airbnb) est très gentille ,C'est une très bonne voyage chez lui.Merci beaucoup.

Julian was a great host. His place was clean, quiet and in a good part of the city to make getting around easy.

Julian is a very nice guy - we had such a pleasant stay at his pretty appartement! The room and the 2 beds were superclean, cosy and comfortable - we slept very well there :-) Always again - thank you, Julian!

Julian fue muy amable con nosotras, hemos tenido charlas muy agradables y nos recomendo varios lugares donde recorrer, y como movernos dentro de Barcelona , el lugar tal cual las fotos, muy ordenado y limpio, la cama muy comoda, EL barrio es muy tranquilo y desde alli puedes recorrer todo Barcelona por medio de los metros

Thank you for the good times!

Julian was a fantastic host! He was understanding of our changed arrival time and very helpful with directions! The entire flat is kept very clean and organized. Julian is a very accommodating host!

Julian is a very nice host, He told us loads of information which were very useful. The apartment is quite and only 10 minutes to walk to Sagrada Familia. His home is very clean and comfortable. I have a very highly recommend to all of you. Thank you again Julian.

The apartment is just as the pictures show. We really enjoyed our time in Barcelona! Such a fun city! Being so close to Sagrada Familia is really nice. It was very easy to get to other areas of the city. 

Julian is a great host. He gave us a map when we first got to his apartment and pointed out all the hot spots to see. He was very easy to live with and made sure we had everything we needed!

It was really a horrible vacation at Julián's apartment. First of all he did not welcome me and my girlfriend friendly. The first thing that he told us were some house rules written down on a paper. He told us not to take too long showers maximum of 10 minutes before anything else. At this point we thought that he is a little bit fuddy-duddy but it became worse. In the first night we came home at 1 AM and 7 AM very quiet to change our clothes at our room for 10 minutes and left the apartment again. In this morning we had a message written on a piece of paper glued at the door: ''I need to talk to you 8 AM''. I felt like I would be Juliàns' little child who has to be there at 8 AM. Of course we did not meet him at 8 AM but at about 10 AM we went back to his apartment and he catched us infront of the room. He told us that this is maybe not the right apartment for us and that we should think about changing our apartment. I told him that I will change the apartment when he gives me back the money for the next nights, but he refused that option. Thus, we did not leave but just tried to come to his apartment for sleeping. He has not a respectful behavior and his flat is not very clean. The neighbourhood is friendly and nice and the location is central. I would not recommend this apartment and this host.

He is really a nice to get in touch with. This time I went to barcelona without any preparation, only with aid of information from Julian. thank you for you receptions.

The listing showed exactly what you got. The location couldn't be better and Julian was extremely helpful in helping us use the metros and trains. We felt safe and at home! We will definitely be back!!
