The location of Julian's apartment is really good,not far away from La sagrada Familia,walk down for few mins. The metro station is also quite close,easy to go to the beach and most visit points. We enjoyed Bacelona a lot!
Julian is a very helpful host,told us exact way to go to his place from airport or train station and organized everything we need...

1. Расположение. От метро идти минут 10, не меньше, и постоянно в горку. Если много вещей и чемоданы тяжелые, не очень комфортно. 
2. Квартира. В квартире сдаются 2 комнаты - эта и еще одна на одного гостя. Обстановка очень скромная, ремонта давно не было, но все очень чисто, хорошо прибрано. Нюанс - ночью слышно соседей, так как конструкция дома такова, что внутри дома - полое пространство, куда выходят вентиляционные окна из кухни. Через них слышно все. 
3. Комната. Очень маленькая. на фото выглядит как-то просторнее. Нюанс: в комнате есть окно, которое выходит на террасу. Находясь на террасе хозяин/другие постояльцы видят все, что происходит в комнате. Чтобы чувствовать себя в полной безопасности, окно необходимо закрывать. Если закрывать ночью - очень душно. 
4. Хозяин. Это самая большая проблема этой квартиры. Неприветливый, угрюмый ботаник и педант. Такое впечатление, что он просто ненавидит людей. Стращал нас правилами: мыться быстро и бесшумно, за собой все убирайте, чтобы все выглядело так, как будто вас здесь не было, не шумите, иначе с соседями будет проблема, в гости никого не водите, громко не разговаривайте, музыку не включайте. Не нравится - я могу аннулировать бронирование. И что вы улыбаетесь - я говорю что-то смешное?
Сам за все то время, что мы его видели, не улыбнулся ни разу. После многочисленных отличных отзывов о нем, было очень странно встретиться с таким человеком. В общем, мы подумали, что он вообще серийный маньяк-убийца. В другой комнате жила девочка из Канады, она была такого же мнения о хозяине - Хулиане.
Останавливались всего на 2 ночи, пережили. Но старались в квартире вообще не появляться, душ принимать по-минимуму, разговаривали шепотом и ходили на цыпочках. На мой взгляд, не лучший вариант в Барселоне, таком солнечном и позитивном городе.
The room was exactly as described. Julian is a very pleasant and quiet host. The apartment is clean and comfortable. The room is great for quiet and respectful guests.
very nice

Julian is a wonderful host, very caring, helpful and reliable, he likes to follow rules and respect for others he made my sister and I feel right at home. I it was our first time in Barcelona, we didn't know what to expect, somewhat intimidating,  but Julian went out of his way and   he took his time to give us instructions on how to get places either by walking or taking the metro or the bus and gave us tip on what to do and what not to do.  
  His place is equipped with everything we needed to have a comfortable visit, from having our coffee in the morning watching the news and checking the internet  to prepare for our next outing, to come home late at night  to make a snack to go to bed or to go out again.
 His place is located in a very centric area, we din't mind walking at all, so while we stayed at his place we walked to  all the tourist attractions that are nearby, La Sagrada Familia, Park Guell, etc. we even walked to Barceloneta, it was a nice "paseo".   Definitely I would go back to Julian's

La descrizione dell'annuncio è perfetta, a me la stanza è piaciuta, è piccolina ma molto accogliente. La casa è pulita tranquilla silenziosa, Julian è una persona chiara e gentile, vuole che la gente rispetti la casa. A lui piace Bcn, la conosce bene e te la spiega con piacere. Il posto è vicino la sagrada famiglia e al quartiere di Gracia (tenete in consideraizone che Bcn è grande, ci sono diversi quartieri, pensate a Roma...Gracia sarebbe il Pigneto o San Lorenzo)... Se volete un posto tranquillo venite da Julian, se volete discoteca casino sbronze yeah allora magari vi conviene andare vicino las ramblas.

When I arrived at Julian's home, he was waiting for me outside.  What is significant about this gesture is that Julian was incredibly conscientious about being a great host!  He provided with with a lot of information about Barcelona in general and the area where he lives specifically.  Since he knew I spoke English, he provided me with an English guide book.  The description of the room and area was very accurate.  The neighbourhood is great to discover.  Transportation was perfect - both to get around the city and then to the airport - there were many options.

My daughter (19) and i had a very nice time at Julian's place. The apartment and room are quiet and clean.  Its near La Sagragda Familia. Julian is very helpfull and friendly.  When in Barcelona, we hop te get back and stay at Julian's place. adio Marijke
방은 괜찮았다. 그리고 깨끗했다. 집도 전체적으로 깨끗해서 좋았다. julian은 매우 깔끔한 사람이었다. 방이 조금 좁았지만 잠만 자는 숙소로는 불편함이 없었다.
Bonjour, le séjour chez Julian s'est très bien passé, appartement très propre, très bien située, Julian es très gentil. Merci beaucoup pour ton acueil Julian, @ la prochaine.

Mi estancia con Julián fue fantástica. La casa es muy acogedora, está muy limpia y recogida, y la situación es formidable. Recomiendo a Julián a cualquiera que quiera sentirse como en casa... Además es muy atento con los huéspedes, y sabe un montón de cosas sobre la ciudad. Un placer haber estado con él.

I stayed at Julian's place for 6 nights.  I arrived from Bangkok feeling really sick and basically stayed in my room about 22 hours a day hoping to be feeling better the whole time.  I only left the my room to buy food, go to the bathroom, or grab food from the refrigerator.  So, I was not one of Julian's typical guests.  Julian was a very good host suggesting and offering foods that he thought might make me feel better.  Thanks, Julian for your concern.

The apartment  was super clean and well maintained.  Julian obviously spent a lot of time fixing it up.

The listing description of the apartment and room was accurate. But there was an irreconcilable problem: Julian is not a very good or kind host. He was anal about being quiet, and once he came to my room at 3 am because I accidentally dropped my water bottle. He didn't respect me, my brother, or my girlfriend, saying it was "weird" that one night one stayed with me and the next the other did instead. On a different occasion, after going out for dinner and drinks with my girlfriend on her last night in Barcelona (I live in Zaragoza though she lives in the US) we came back around 1 or 2 am, which angered Julian who later accused us of being obnoxious people who just want to party even though we came in quietly, respectfully, and didn't wake the other floor mate up (we got along very well with the other airbnb guest). He said he didn't want to host visitors who wanted to enjoy the nightlife, as if it was abnormal.

Essentially, his house rules sound reasonable, but the way he enforces them prove to be absurd. He at least refunded the remainder of our trip when we decided to go elsewhere where we could feel comfortable and relaxed. You, too, can find a better deal in Barcelona; In my time using airbnb, Julian stands out as an exceptionally poor host, which is confirmed by other critical reviews.

Julians home in Barcelóna is an excellent choice..Its neat and very cozy..and just 5 blocks Walk from Sagradafamilia..You have métro as well as bus connections that can take you everywhere..the neighborhood is v nice and Quiet..Park Guell is Also a 20 min Walk..Julian is a very Nice and kind person..he gave me lot of good recomendations. I extended my stay at his place as i really liked it a lot :)

My friend and I enjoyed our stay at Julian's place. Situated close to Sagrada Familia, the place is close to public transport and it was great to see the magnificent building every morning. The room was cosy and clean. It was kept pretty warm at night which I appreciated a lot. The kitchen and the bathroom were always kept clean, too. Our host Julian was friendly and helpful, giving us information about the city and its history and how to use the local transport. The local restaurant he recommended was really great, too. Thank you, Julian!
Julian had a very clean room and apartment located in a great neighborhood for exploring Barcelona. Perfect for those who are looking for a calm, lowkey stay
방이 깔끔했고, 물 한병과 과자도 방에 배치되어 있었습니다. 늦은 시간에 체크인을 했는데, 집 앞에서 마중도 나왔구요. 숙소 위치도 산츠역 근처라서 좋았습니다.
Julian was very hospitable and very helpful in letting us know where sights were and how to get to them easily. Very quiet neighborhood and conveniently located.
If it were a lenient of deadlines, it would be nice but overall nice experience. Host let us stay over the listed check out time.

빠른 메시지 답장으로 집을 찾아갈때에도 큰 어려움이 없었습니다.
집성가족성당과 매우 가까운 위치에 있어 바르셀로나를 구경하시기에 위치상 적절합니다. 

밤 늦은 시간에 체크인을 하였음에도 친절하게 맞이해주고 숙소에 대해 하나씩 설명해주는 등 매우 고마웠습니다.

집주인인 줄리안은 매우 깨끗하고 규칙적인 사람이라서 전체적으로 집이 깨끗하고 편안하였습니다 :)
Very quiet and safe neighborhood,The room was clean and tidy, very warm, and affordable; the owner of the house is very nice, patient and give us a lot help
아랫층으로 마중나와주긴 했으나 친절하진 않았다. 무덤덤하고 깐깐했다.

Très bon accueil. Julián nous fait un petit tour de l'appart, nous expliquant tout ce qu'il faut savoir dans la cuisine, la douche, la chambre et les règles de vie. Dans notre chambre quelques chocolats et de l'eau ainsi des cartes, un guide de la ville en français et une fiche récapitulative des règles de vie, des infos à savoir (adresse, tel, wifi...)et des choses à faire dans le quartier.

De plus l'appartement est agréable, et nous avons aussi fait connaissance d'une autre voyageur australienne.
Merci pour cet agréable séjour Julián
La descripción del anuncio corresponde totalmente: un ambiente muy tranquilo, una casa muy limpia y ordenada y un barrio muy agradable.

I stayed in both rooms. Made a mistake by breaking the house rules on night #1 by using the kitchen. The rooms are nice, clean,  warmand quiet. The beds are quite comfortable. There's a guidebook in the room and Julian will also explain if you have questions about transportation etc. Overall if you don't have a jetlag after 19 hours of flight and you can get up and leave the room immediately in the morning this is the room for you. If you need some extended rest after flights this might not be the room for you as the host is not comfortable with guest resting too long.

The switch from the first room to second room is also quick as when I switched rooms, the bigger room is available and cleaned.
Julian is very nice and quite guy. If you want to spend your time exploring BCN and just have a good place to sleep, I recommend this room.

Julian was a helpful and friendly host who gave us a lot of information and advice and even lent us a guide book while we were there. The room was good and clean and the beds were comfortable. We were provided with everything we needed including clean towels. The location was great too: close to two metro stops and Sagrada Familia. Nice little touches too - a large bottle of water and two chocolates left for us. Great host, location, room and price.

Siamo state 4 giorni ospiti da Julian io e mia figlia casa carina e pulita. Julian molto discreto, quasi invisibile ma sempre pronto a dare informazioni minuziose su cosa visitare come muoversi e dove mangiare ....una ottima guida di Barcellona !!!! Grazie ancora!!!!

Como pienso que de todo se aprende y con la intención de ayudar, tanto a otros viajeros como a Julian, teniendo en cuenta que   esta era la segunda vez que utilizaba airbnb, sólo lo había utilizado en una ocasión con muy buena experiencia. Para mí esta experiencia ha tenido con ver con ciertos aprendizajes lo cual agradezco, entre ellos: que es importante elegir bien,  un lugar que sea adecuado a uno mismo, y tener en cuenta todos los factores, también leer las opiniones, no sólo las recientes, yo en esta ocasión no invertí mucho tiempo en la elección y  me decanté casi exclusivamente por la zona (cercana a un curso que iba a realizar en este viaje) y el precio, si es para eso, el precio es adecuado y la zona está bien comunicada. Gracias
Great neighborhood right by metro-stop.  Julian was a great host who informed us about the city. Very respectful and nice
Our host was very good, he gave us directions and tips to travel through Barcelona.  It is in a very good location and is very to navigate around.
Barrio bien, la casa como en la foto.

The house is really tidy and neat. And the location is good for visiting Sagrada Familia! The neighborhood is safe and has a lot of street lights. If you are a night activity lover, you should think twice about it, because it's not appropriate for taking shower after 23:30. In the conclusion, I still think the apartment is good for travelling.

Julián was a very nice and friendly host. He gave very precise instructions to support the house rules, so it was easy to follow them. He was also helpfull when we had something to ask about Barcelona's transportation or sights. The room was great and very quiet, so it was a good place to rest during a city vacation.

Julián is a nice, and helpful host. We had got useful information.
The room was exactly as it is shown on the pictures. 
Great localization, niear Sagrada Familia.

The room is clean and tidy. It's easy to visit the Sagrada Família, Gràcia and Parc Güell. Julian is nice, and always there for helping us. But I feel like he's a little stern, and not talk to much. And there are many rules to obey...“Be fast and clean”x3.(^^;;

Julián is a nice, somewhat reserved and quiet guy. He's very punctual and tidy. Next to having a map and a Lonely Planet booklet of Barcelona, Julián has lots of tips on what to see and do. 

The communication went smoothly and the appartment is located at a superb spot, on walking distance from the Sagrada Familia and (if you like walking) from he city centre.
tres bon accueil hôte disponible quartier très agréable

Julian was a great host.  He was very helpful and gave us information about getting around the city.  His place was perfect for our stay in Barcelona.  It was very comfortable and is really close to the Sagrada Familia Metro stop which was very convenient.  I definitely recommend this place.

We had an amazing time in Barcelona thanks to Julian. He was  very kind and thoughtful host. Always replied to messages super fast, useful directions and tips. The place was very clean and tidy. Recommended!
Apartamento limpio, muy seguro  y centrico. Acceso facil a Sagrada Familia .

Julián ha sido muy etento y comunicativo, nos facilitó información para recorrer Barcelona, el departamento está en una excelente ubicación y es muy cómodo, la habitación es la que se muestra en la foto y nos sentimos muy a gusto allí.
The room was clean, easy to find, and the bathroom was great. Julian was a great host!

I was there last week for one night. Julian was very accomodating and helpful. I had to travel last minute with my toddler and he was kind enough to accomodate us although the room is really meant for only a single person or a couple. He had everything organized properly with clear directions to get to his place and his house was clean and orderly. He also gave directions for sightseing. I would highly recommend any  one visiting Barcelona to stay at his place. For the price he put, it is practically a steal. Thank you  Julian.

we hadden een heerlijke kamer bij Julian. bij aankomst stond er een fles met koud water voor ons klaar, en ook de kamer was heerlijk koel door de ventilator (buiten 30C!). Bedden en kussens zijn erg goed. Appartement is erg schoon, en heerlijk stil!
Julian is een aardige gastheer, en heel behulpzaam. We hopen nog eens te komen! Julian, bedankt voor je gastvrijheid.
I like to stay in this flat.

Julian is a very nice guy. He is careful ,considerate and patience. He told us the routes ,the decilious restaurants and gave us many helpful suggestions .Our flight is very early, he even help us to book the taxi. The location of his house is good and the room is neat,clean and comfortable.  I think he is amazing host. Love him so much.

The room is as described, the place is quiet and clean. Location is quite near by the "sagrada familia". This journey has been good, but i felt a bit disappointed by the welcome of Julian. You might have been disturbed by people behaviors by the past and you looked like a little stressed for everything and you gave us your stress. I would like to have known what was your Barcelona, if you had some suggestions, but everything was a question of be careful, do that, not that...You asked us to leave the flat at 10am on Sunday to have enough time to clean for the next, very kind of you...This could have been an opportunity to know each other better...

The Julian appartment is a nice place nearly the Sagrada familial. The twin room is very clean and confortable. I recommandate it because it is very cheap and nice. .. Julian seems to be sympathical and like the quiet in his appartment. Good address !!!
Julian was an amazing host! Laid everything out very simply and was very helpful and accommodating.

It was lovely to stay with Julian. We had everything we needed and more. Julian had cold water for us when we arrived and gave us loads of good info and loaned us a lonely planet! The house was very clean, quiet and in a great location. Julian's very thorough directions made it very easy to find. Thank you Julian! :)
We stopped in to this apartment for only one night. It was all we needed. Julian was very respectful and to the point with his rules. Located in a good area. Extremely quiet apartment.
The room was very clean and quiet. If you search for something easy and laid-back this is properly not your first choice.

Julian was a fantastic and very knowledgeable and helpful host. We had an awesome time at his apartment and it's location is perfect. We decided to walk everywhere and didn't even use all the rides on our 10 ride metro card. 

Highly recommended!

The accomodation was clean and quiet. Recommendable when you're looking for a centrally-located place to sleep at. 
Quiet a lot of flat-rules so the trip should be about the city.

Tuve una buena experiencia en el lugar de Julián, el ya tiene todo preparado para cualquier visitante. De aquí esta muy fácil tomar el metro a otras partes, y tan cercano a Sagrada familia. Hay supermercados cerca por si necesitas comprar cosas básicas.

we are a quiet couple therefore we chose Julian house. He help you if to wish any advice about barcelona and your house is clean ( this is mandatory because he charge cleaning fee ). I wasn't free at ease there because Julian imposes much rules in your house when we got there he spent almost 20 minutes explaining mostly obvious things . It seemed that I asked a favor to stay there but I had paid. I wouldn't back there.

every thing is totally the same as description. Julian is very patient and helpful. the room is very quite at night for a sound sleep. the location is near the sagrada familia and park guell. highly recommended for those who wants to sleep well at night. there is a dream catcher outside the room, jajaja...I like it a lot.
Easy accommodation… We really enjoyed our stay here. It was exactly as described. Great location, everything clean, informative host. We would definitely stay here again and recommend it to friends!

사그라다파밀리아와는우주만큼멀고오르막길을걸어야하는것으로간절히바라면날씨가덜덥겠지만바르셀로나의성수기는35도이상인것으로방에는공기가통하지않고선풍기하나만덜더덜러털덜돌아가며주인은매우예민하여다른방사람이통역을요청하는데본인을욕하는줄아는미운마흔두쨜.집밖으로나가지않는현직선생의학생들을별로좋아하지않고방에서쉬고있는데왜여기왔냐고시비를터는개복치만큼예민한사람이므로숨이턱턱막혀변비가생기고돈더주고더좋은데가는것이좋습니다

Juliàn est très accueillant, et il s'est montré très disponible, alors que je n'avais réservé qu'une nuit. La chambre est conforme au photo, et l'appartement est bien placé près de la Sagrada Família, les règles de la maison sont assez précises, mais au service du confort des voyageurs.

Nous avons été très bien accueilli, le quartier est calme, proche de la Sagrada Familia (ce qui nous a beaucoup aidé pour se repèrer !!=) )
l'appartement est agréable et bien pensé.
Pour un séjour entre amies, le rapport qualité/prix est très raisonnable. On le recommande!
성가족 성당에서 가까워서 좋았다. 주변에 가까이 마트도 있고 버스나 지하철을 타고 이동할 위치도 좋아서 다른 관광지를 보기에도 편했다. 집은 조용하고 엘리베이터도 있어서 짐들고 가기에도 편했다. 호스트는 설명을 상세하게 잘해준다. 이 집을 추천한다. Thank you!

La casa di Julian è molto pulita e ordinata. Quando siamo arrivate in un pomeriggio caldo ci ha accolte con una bottiglia di acqua fredda. Durante la prima notte nella casa, la mia amica ha avuto un forte mal di denti e dato che non sapevamo cosa fare, abbiamo svegliato Julian alle 4 del mattino. Ci ha chiamato un taxi e siamo andate in una farmacia aperta per prendere gli antidolorifici. Grazie Julian per il tuo aiuto in un momento difficile per noi!

Nous avons été très bien reçues par Julian. Les règles de vie sont carrées et claires et la chambre est exactement comme sur la photos et sur l'annonce. L'appartement est très propre et calme. C'était la première fois que nous partions avec Airbnb et nous n'avons pas été déçues.Julian ne parle pas beaucoup mais en fait nous avons compris que c'est par respect pour ses hôtes, pour ne pas déranger. Il est extrêmement discret.Lorsque nous avons commencé à discuter il s'est montré très ouvert et bavard.
Merci Julian pour ton accueil!
Julian was great at giving us information about the various attractions that we should see.  Room was comfortable and our stay was nice.  Thanks Julian!

Una muy buena opción para visitar Barcelona a un precio muy interesante. Habitación sencilla con un muy buen anfitrión y muy bien comunicada, a un tiro de piedra de las zonas más turísticas.
Un placer y hasta la próxima.

Un apartamento recomendado para aquellas personas que quieran estar en un sitio tranquilo de Barcelona a un precio razonable.. Las normas de convivencia y respeto Julian las explica muy bien para que no haya malos entendidos y la estancia sea de mutuo respeto, lo cual es de agradecer.. Se echa de menos un saloncito de estar... Pero todo esta limpio y aceptable...

먼저 저희는 비앤비 이용이 두번째임을 밝힙니다.
줄리안은 비앤비를 하기에 적합한 인물이 아니라고 생각합니다.
저희는 돈을 지불했지만 그만큼의 대우를 받지 못한다고 느꼈습니다.
줄리안은 굉장히 예민합니다.(처음 만났을 때 문을 소리가 나지 않도록 살살 닫으라고 몇번씩이나 반복해서 얘기하는 등)
저희는 소음에 예민하면서 본인 방문을 항상 열어놓는 것을 이해할 수 없었습니다.
또한 줄리안이 정해놓은 규칙은 여행객들이 지키기에 무리가 있습니다.(특히 23:30부터 7:30까지 샤워 불가능)
방도 정말 좁습니다.
저희같이 큰 캐리어를 가지고 다니는 사람들에게는 불편합니다.
캐리어 두개를 동시에 펼 수 없어서 번갈아 피면서 이용했습니다.
참고로 위치가 사그라다 파밀리아에서 4블록이지만 생각보다 가깝지는 않습니다.
또한 다른 나라 사람들은 모르겠지만 구글맵에 나와있는 주소를 입력하면 엉뚱한 곳이 나오니 주의하셔야 합니다.
욕실 바닥에 물이 튄 것에 대해서는 미안하게 생각하지만 그 외 규칙들은 지키기 위해 노력했다 생각합니다.
3박4일 동안 숙소가 전혀 편하지 않았습니다.
환불 규정이 까다로우니 신중하게 결정하시기를 바랍니다.

We had a great experience at Julián's apartment. We arrived in the city quite late, but he was around to let us in and get us situated. The room was as listed, with two comfortable double beds. Great location, with the Sagrada Familia a few blocks away and easy access to buses to take you elsewhere in the city (the walk is nice too).

Julian was a wonderful host, very respectful and helpful regarding directions and tips around the city. The apartment is greatly located, very clean and neat. The room is exactly as advertised, even though it did not have A/C, the room has great ventilation and its very fresh. 
The apartment itself is very small but perfect if you are planning to be out all day.
Julian is very strict regarding his rules so if you are not a considerate person, you should book somewhere else. He rents 2 rooms at the same time so the rules helps keep order around in a small space.
Overall we had a great stay in a wonderful neighborhood, the apt is very safe and peaceful! We would recommend this place!

그는 규정을 11시 30분에서 7시30분 아침 까지밀 사용해야 해서.시내 까탈루나에서 30분 거리는 거리에서 특히나 10시에 버스가 끊겨서 지하철로 이동하려면 시내에서 9시30분에 출발하여야 해서 블수쇼 야경등을 볼수가 없었습니다 ㆍ 음식도 간단 음 식이외에는 해먹을수 업습니다  거실도 밥 먹을때 이외에는 사용을 할수 없도록 햬요 그는 항상 문을 열고 있어서 소음에 예민하였고 감시받는 느낌이었습니다

The room looked even better than in the picture. Julian actually greeted us outside and helped me take my suitcase upstairs. He welcomed us with a cold bottle of water, gave us a thorough tour of his place and even gave us space in the refrigerator. Можно завтракать и ужинать, но быстро. По факту выяснилось, что можно выпить чаю с бутербродом, приготовленный овощной салат ели быстро стоя на кухне, практически не жуя (со мной была тетя 59-три лет, на минуточку)! Хозяин практически все время находится в квартире, сидит в проходной комнате и ты все время на виду. Так что, если вы утром встали и,несмотря на погоду,  сразу ушли, а вернувшись –  в кровать, то это ваш вариант. Хотя, за такие деньги есть и лучшие варианты.
Excelente ubicación, lugar muy confortable y ameno, Julián es muy claro con las reglas, muy dispuesto a guiar y colaborar. Volvería con gusto

All of the following things are factual truths. We were lectured for 20 min on how to turn on light switches, lock doors, and flush toilets. Julian is also a political science graduate I'll have you know. The Curfew is at 11pm (not kidding). Disobey this and he will be passive aggressive and condescending towards you. As he was towards us. We didn't party in the house, we just were out a bit late in one of the most night life lively cities in the world, this was a big mistake as his tone got worse and worse. 

Other than that the place was clean and a decent location. Viva la France.

Julian is a nice host. The place is really clean and peaceful. The place is near Sagrada família which is just a few minutes walk. No problem with transportation coz' just outside the house there is a bus that leads to the city and also it is near with the metro.
Excelente piso, exactamente como se describe, muy buena ubicación y Julián es muy amable y dispuesto a ayudar con todo.
Very clean apartment and the location is very central. However the house rules are very strict and you need to follow them.

Very nice apartment, very close to the sagrada familia and easy to travel by metro. 
And there are tons of great bars and restaurants around the area as well.
I like my stay and Julian was very nice and useful!
I really recommend this place as it is clean, well located, you get a confortable room .
la ubicacion del lugar es excelente, buen de partida para recorrer la ciudad y el lugar muy comodo y limpio.

I had a pleasant stay in Barcelona. Julián is a great host and helped me a lot by pointing out things to see and do etc. The appartment is located a few minutes from La Sagrada familia in a quiet neighborhood and the room were clean.
Todo correcto
Everything was as expected. Good, cheap option for crashing in Barcelona.
La habitación es muy limpia y muy cómoda
Everything at Julián's went smoothly, good communication, the appartment is very clean and well located just few steps from Sagrada Familia
La habitación es tal cual aparece en las fotos, tiene todo lo necesario para una estancia agradable. Fácil comunicación con Julián
Un lugar limpio, cercano al metro, buena ubicación y además te aconseja los mejores lugares donde ir a conocer.
Muy buen alojamiento; camas super cómodas, el aseo muy limpio, respeto y silencio en la casa... Estuvimos encantadas. Os lo recomiendo!

Take a stroll along the majestic tree-lined streets of this historic area and marvel at the curio shops, stunning houses and numerous local bars and restaurants. Around us are: recommended restaurants, the second fresh market in Barcelona-Market Ninot. We have all types of services in the area: pharmacy, hairdresser, supermarkets, internet cafes, tobaccos and Clinical-Hospital Center world-renowned University of Medicine and School of Industrial Engineering.   All these buildings are modernist. A 10 minute walk away you can find a very popular area of nightclubs and clubs.

A familiar and personal contact with our clients is fundamental for us. To make the communication easy, our team speaks 5 languages: Spanish, English, Russian, German and Hungarian. You are always welcome if you have any question or just need an advice where to go to shopping or eat the best tapas in the city. During the day we are personally present in the building and we are also available in 24 hour in case of urgency.

host.host_about: PROVENZA MBS, a  small company managing an apartment building at nice centric neighborhood one block away from central hospital, a polytechnic university and a Ninot Market. Centric but safe surroundings.

reviews.comments: It was great on every point

The accommodation was perfect for us! Dimitry was a very friendly, uncomplicated and reliable host and the apartment was very clean and well equipped. We were seven people and it offers enough space for us. It was situated in the 6th floor and when we open the windows a fresh breeze blows throw the rooms. The neighborhood was save, even at night and the next metro station is 5 minutes to walk. 

Thanks for the nice apartment. We had an amazing time in Barcelona!
Классная большая квартира почти в центре
Dimitry is a great host, very friendly. The place is great for bigger group of people. The apartament is clean, well prepared.

We did not see Dimitry during our stay but his assistant in the office was exceptionally helpful and friendly.  
There were many cafes, bars and restaurants nearby and there was a metro station and bus stops in close proximity.

One bedroom had a light glaring in all night from outside neighbouring apartment block and was unusable. A dryer should be provided. Bathrooms should be restocked and cleaned at least every second day.

reviews.comments: The place was exactly as described by Paulo. We had a great time staying there. It is literally 2 minutes walk from the beach. We had good sleep there compared to other places we stayed in the city center where noise was normal until very late at night and very early in the morning. Paulo and his wife did all what they could to help us during our stay at their place.
It is good for company of friends. Perfect location . It is close to Marbella beach and nude place .

We enjoyed our stay at Paulo's place for 2 nights. Before arriving we had agreed upon 1:00 PM as the check-in and check-out time. When we arrived at the apartment, we were greeted by Paulo's wife, who showed us around the apartment and our room. On the last morning of our stay, Paulo's wife knocked on our door at 10:30 AM and said she had forgotten to tell us we needed to be out of the room by 11:00 AM for it to be cleaned. We were expecting to have until 1 PM as previously mentioned, so that put us in an awkward position. We quickly got ready and packed up our stuff, and she let us store it in another room for the remaining 2 hours.

The pictures accurately represent the space-- the room is large with lots of storage space, hangers and drawers; the bathroom is also very large, with a working shower and bathtub and lots of counter space. The mattress felt comfy at first, but it is very soft and not supportive (probably an Ikea mattress).

The living room is shared between multiple other rooms listed on AirBnb as well, and it has ample seating for everyone with 3 tables and 3 couches.

The location was overall good for that neighborhood. Immediately downstairs there's nothing, but turn the corner and you're on Rambla del Poblenou with lots of stores and restaurants and people strolling or eating. It's also a convenient walk to the beach (just don't take your shoes off, the beaches in Barcelona were very dirty).

Chris et Paulo sont tres gentils et propose tous les conseils dont nous avons besoin. Nous avons logé dans une chambre très spacieuse avec une salle de bain tout aussi spacieuse .....tout étais très propre et bien rénové. Endroit très calme et proche à pied d'une plage très propre et de restaurants. Toutes les commodités sont dans les alentours et pour le centre ville ...un bus vous y emmène pour moins d'un €. Conseil acheter la carte de 10 voyages. Nous y retournerons avec certitude.

L'accoglienza è stata ottima e la casa rispettava a pieno la descrizione dell'annuncio .... appartamento molto pulito e tranquillo ... i proprietari sono delle persone molto disponibili e cordiali.. ottima permanenza

Chris and Paulo are very nice and offer all the help and information we needed. Place is quiet with nice ambiance, we enjoyed our stay @Paulo's for five days in Barcelona. The house very close to the beach. We are foodies, So Paulo suggested the best restaurants available close to the place and those are very good. We will be happy to stay again at this place in Barcelona.
Ok

We had such a great stay at the apartment. Paulo and his family are so friendly and kind to answer questions and help with any information. The apartment is literally 2 min walk from the lovely beach, and about 15 min bus-ride to the center where the Rambla is. It only cost 2,15 Euro to take to bus and it is so easy to find at the main street, buses leave every 15 min. 

In the center we found a little place called Sol Soler and we will highly recommend it for at night out of eating tapas and drinking sangaria! so fantastic and local. We decided to walk to Sagrada familia and it was easy to find. From three girls who had an amazing stay in Barcalona - we would gladly come back for another visit anytime and stay at Paulo's :)

Paolo and his wife have just been perfect hosts, felt like being with family. Helped with an extra-bed, which was really very comfortable, had a bottle of water ready. One big room at center of all rooms is equipped with a clothwasher, a kitchen with all you need and plenty of space for eating/gathering. Sleeping rooms all have an own airconditioning (worked perfectly well). In room 5 (habitacion 5) we even had an own kitchen and 2 fridges, apart from a coach-bed, a table with chair. The surrounding is a little bit old-fashioned, but really quiet (absolutely no noise) and without feeling bad around there. Was told that this zone is getting more and more back to fashion again - really close to all! also the olympic zone. Just very recommendable! Just don't expect a hotel, and you will feel at home.
Paolo would take care of any request or query about Barcelona's sightseeing.
Paolo picked us up at the airport for 38 EUR, which was already a perfect start.
The flat is really very close to the beach, like 5 Min walk on a straight street. Beach is VERY clean and nice! Taking a taxi to town / Montjui / city center / Plaza Colon costs about 8-10 EUR/way (depending on traffic), by bus 1 EUR/person for one way till 1,5hours (you can jump off and on again within time).
Again 1 square further you have Poble Nou's own Rambla, which in my opinion, is much quieter and nicer than Barcelona's city center one! Great food at 'Tertulia' and an even much better Sangria at 'La Roda'. There's also hairdressers, cosmeticians, food shops and fashion shops... really all you can wish for!
If looking for great flamenco, I personally recommend (am a flamenco dancer myself), go to 'Palau Dalmases' at Montcada 20 (in front of Picasso Museum) in Barcelona city center. You will have a wonderful 1-hour performance for 20 EUR/person.
Any entry to museums, e.g. 'Sagrada Familia' take tickets online (MUCH cheaper and you avoid waiting queues!)  - it's an absolutely must-see one.
If you have kids (also teenagers) and it's warm I recommend to plan a 6-hour stay at 'Illa Fantasia' a great aquaparc with lots of funny tubes. It's not the most modern one, but funny. Food will be limited to hamburgers and fries and ice creams, though (ask at a tourist info for an organised trip - cheaper).
Our favourite zone within Barcelona's city center: Born. It's the ancient gothic area, with lots of little shops and bars/restaurants.
All in all, I'm sure to go back to Paolo's and certainly Barcelona - had a real great time!!!
Have fun, too.
By the way, it was our first time in Barcelona and furthermore, on AirBnB. Feel very lucky having hit with Paolo's apartment and even more with his lovely family :-D

Paulo et sa femme son tres gentil et genereux, ils nous ont acceuilli parfaitement et chaleureusement. Les chambres sont impeccable et agreable.

Je recommande fortement ce logement.
good room and nice host

Nos hospedamos en familia con niños por una semana en Casa de Paulo, desde el primer día quedamos muy satisfechos por lo que encontramos. La casa es tal como está descrito en el anuncio, muy acogedora, limpia, espaciosa y tiene todo lo necesario en la cocina. Paulo y su esposa muy amigables, estuvieron a la orden para responder nuestras dudas o recomendarnos lugares a donde ir y como ir. La calle donde se ubica la casa no está muy bien cuidada pero esto no es responsabilidad de los dueños, y a la vuelta de la esquina queda la Rambla de Poblenou, una calle comercial muy transitada donde se encuentra de todo, y las estaciones de buses o Metro hacia el centro de Barcelona están a pocos minutos de la casa. La playa queda a 6-8 minutos de camino, cruzando un gran parque que hace el ambiente muy agradable. Recomiendo la Casa de Paulo!

The accommodation is nice and clean with shared livingroom with extra kitchen. The owner's room is om the same floor with his family so I would pay attention mitigate noise level. But the location is ideal for going out or wisiting the beach. Thera are many nice restaurants within 2 min walk
Everything was fine except the beds were a little uncomfortable.

Very kind and responsible host.
The room was very clean and net. Excellent. I highly recommend.

La situacion del apartemento esta muy tranquila cerca de la playa y muy comoda para ir al centro con el metro y el autobus. Paulo y su familia son muy simpaticos y nos encanto cantar y tocar el piano en el apartamento. Es un apartamento muy bueno y el espacio comun esta muy grande. Todo alli para cocinar, descansar, y disfrutar. El bano esta muy grande y Paulo nos ha dado tambien acceso a una pequena habitacion para mi hijo.

This is  a professionalised Airb'n'b. Paolo was very friendly and flexible. You share the common areas with other guests, not much the family. It is clean and situated in an up and coming part of Barcelona, only minutes away from wonderful coffee and the beach. It seemed a little pricy, but that might be due to the MOBILE fair at the time of our visit. Overall we enjoyed our stay.

Our stay with Paulo was great and exceeded our expectations. Paulo was quick to communicate and was able to be flexible in meeting our very late arrival time from Girona airport. Furthermore the large size of the room and bathroom was perfect, and the common areas were beautiful. The apartment was also in very close proximate to the beach and close to central Barcelona. Would definitely recommend!

We had a great time in Barcelona, and this airbnb was perfect for our needs. Linens, pillows and towels were all provided, the beds were comfortable, and there was air conditioning and a fridge. The bathroom was amazing and spacious, and everything was accurate to the pictures and description provided. The shared living area was beautiful and clean, with a kitchen, sitting areas and a piano, which my friend (a composer) appreciated. Paulo was very flexible about us arriving at odd hours throughout the night and was overall a very gracious host. The airbnb is located a fair distance away from the tourist area, but there were plenty of fantastic local stores right next door to get meals and do a little shopping, and we enjoyed being close to the beach. Overall a great deal and a great airbnb experience!
Lovely hosts and large pleasant communal area. Great location near the beach and some nice restaurants
todo bien

El lugar tiene muy buena ubicación, las camas son muy cómodas, el salón es un lujazo y el baño una pasada. Paulo y su esposa son muy atentos y serviciales. No podemos estar más contentos de habernos alojado aquí!
The neighborhood is fantastic and the place is very quiet. We didn't expect it to be a hostel but it was very clean and spacious and we weren't bothered at all by outside noises.
Everything was awesome,  very kind and friendly hosts, apartments are close to the sea. Next time in Barcelona will try to stay here again.

Luogo fantastico, i proprietari sono molto ospitali e le camere sono sempre in ordine e pulite. Per quanto riguarda la posizione è vicinissima alla spiaggia ma un po' fuori dal centro dove però vicino si trovano metro e fermate del bus. Grande esperienza vale la pena provare.

Bonjour à tous,
Bravo à Paulo et sa famille qui nous ont très bien accueilli durant 9 jours en août. Nous avions mes filles et moi la plus belle chambre avec un grand dressing et une très grande salle de bains ! Ce sont des gens très discrets et adorables. Tout était très propre autant à la cuisine que nous partageons avec d'autres que notre chambre.
Vraiment excellent rapport qualité/prix.
Nathalie, Enghien les bains

Nous avons extrêmement bien accueillis par Paulo et Chris .
Paulo nous attendait en bas de l'immeuble à notre arrivée et nous a tout de suite mis à l'aise . 
L'appartement est très joli , propre , spacieux , fonctionnel , 
bien entretenu et très bien placé près de la Rambla ( avenue  avec des restaurants , boutiques , bars etc ) et à 5 mn à pieds de la plage .

Paulo a pris le temps de me donner des conseils sur les lieux à visiter à barcelone et nous a également suggérés des restaurants locaux fréquentés  par les espagnols.

Paulo et Chris sont des hôtes très gentils , serviables et chakeureux  . On ne pouvait rêver mieux !!!!

Our stay with Paulo was brilliant. The room was fairly spacious and the private bathroom was well kept. Paulo and his family were extremely friendly, especially their dog Mimi. The location the stand out feature, only a few minutes walk to the beach. We tried a few of Barcelona's beaches and the one nearest was by far the best. Would thoroughly recommend Paulo's place, if I ever come back to Barcelona this will definetly be my first port of call.

This was one of the best airbnbs I have ever stayed at and I would definitely stay here again and again. Paulo and his family are kind and generous people who made my stay unforgettable. My favorite part was playing the piano they have in the common area with his amazing daughter! 
The bedroom was spacious and clean and had its own refrigerator, so great if you like to save some money on meals.  The private bathroom was also a plus. The common area was decorated with interesting artwork and paintings and had a very welcoming feel.  It is a great way to meet other friendly visitors in passing or can choose to keep to yourself. 
The location is great since you are a 5 minute walk from the beach and literally around the corner from the Rambla in poblenou where there are tons of restaurants and shops.  Also it's a prime location for public transit with bus stops very close by and subway within a 10 min walk.  Poblenou has a special feel to it.  It's still incredibly lively but a nicer place to stay than the main part of the city if you like coming back to a quieter neighborhood to sleep. 
I would recommend this place to anyone.  Paulo,  his wife,  and children make this place special.

Fue nuestra primera experiencia en airbnb. Super positiva. Era como estar en un hotel pero con la comodidad de una casa. Viajamos con nuestra hija de 11 meses y fue todo espectacular. Excelentes anfitriones. Poblenou nos encantó. Un barrio a escasos minutos del centro pero mucho más tranquilo...a una cuadra de su propia rambla y de la playa. Volveríamos sin dudarlo!!!

Estuvo muy bien nuestra habitación privada en la casa de Paulo. El barrio tiene una pequeña rambla donde encuentras muchos restaurantes y supermercados, la playa está muy cerca y te puedes mover fácil en bus a las principales atracciones turísticas de Barcelona, compra en el metro o en la parada del tranvía las tarjeta de pasajes  sale un poco más barato que pagar directamente en el bus. La casa de Paula tiene cocina que puedes usar con todo lo necesario para hacer el desayuno o la cena, es compartida pero en el tiempo que la usamos siempre estuvo libre.

Our stay was good at Paulo's place. All the amenities were available and the neighborhood was lively.  It is also very close to the beach and the connectivity  (public transport) to almost all the important places is pretty good. Only drawback was the size of the room. It is sufficient only for two people. Since we were four it was a bit congested.

Primera vez en Barcelona y ha sido una experiencia sobresaliente, el apartamento esta muy bien ubicado y a no mas de 3 cuadras de la playa (bogatell). Todo ha sido de maravillas, totalmente recomendable! 

Saludos chicos y espero que nos volvamos a ver a futuro.

Great location! Will stay here again if we come back to barcelona! Walkable distance to various bus lines. Rambla de Poblenou around the corner and beach/clubs walking distance! It's like a hostel, own living space and individual entrance to rooms.
This is a very nice and down to earth couple how will go out of their way to make sure you are happy. I had a nice large well kept bedroom and extremely large bath!
Great location near the beach. Paulo and family were very nice and welcoming. Room was as described and furnished nicely. Would recommend this to anyone traveling to Barcelona.

Paulo's rooms are really clean, spacious and comfortable.  The communal room is really large and really comfy. There is everything that you need for a comfortable stay. Kitchen facilities are excellent. Anything you need just ask, Paulo will do his best to get you anything that you need.

Eine wirklich sehr schön eingerichtetes Zimmer mit einem riesigen Bad. Alles war sauber.
Die Wohnung liegt wirklich sehr ruhig gelegen, aber dennoch mittendrin. Die Rambla Poblenou ist direkt nebenan.
Danke für den tollen Aufenthalt!

Excelente alojamiento! Tuvimos un problema en la reserva por un descuido de nuestra parte (pusimos 1 huésped cuando en realidad éramos 3), pero por suerte Paulo y su familia tenían lugar para alojarnos y nos atendieron muy amablemente. La habitación fue sumamente cómoda e íntima. Pudimos usar el lavarropas las veces que lo necesitamos e incluso nos prestaron sombrilla y toallas para ir a la playa que queda a pocas cuadras. Está lejos del centro pero el transporte público queda muy cerca del alojamiento! La zona es muy tranquila, la Rambla de Poblenou queda solo a 1 cuadra, mucho movimiento de gente, bares y supermercados. MUY RECOMENDABLE, volveríamos!!!
Очень хороший хозяин. Отделный санузел. Близко к пляжу.

Hi I'm Laia,

I'm from Barcelona; as were my  parents, grandparents and great-grandparents, as far back as I remember! I am a lover of my city, but of the original city of Barcelona, the whole gothic and Eixample area is spectacular!

I worked previously in communication and creativity, but for some time now I decided to use all my creativity in creating furniture and decoration. I hope you ll feel at home in my apartment and enjoy very much the city!

See you soon!!
Laia

access: In the apartment you will find:   • High Speed WIFI (Optical Fiber 300 Mb)   • Bed sheets   • Towels   • Hairdryer   • Nespresso coffee machine   • Bathroom amenities   • Everything you need for cocking   • Washing machine   • Dry machine   • Iron And if you need something special tell us and we will try to get it.
interaction: When you arrive to the apartment, we will be waiting for you to give you the keys and explain about the apartment the area and Barcelona. For the check-out, we will go to the apartment to take the keys, say Good bye! and help you in anything you need.
house_rules: No es cuestión de hacer una lista de normas y reglas que seguir en el apartamento. Nuestra idea es que te comportes en el apartamento como lo harías en tu propia casa respetando el resto de vecinos, y la convivencia y descanso del resto de personas del edificio. No está permitido fumar.

host.host_about:
Hi! We are Alex, Javi and Pilar and we love to travel and meet people. We would like to meet a lot of people from all around the world and achieve that you will have a wonderful days in Barcelona.

Hola! Somos Alex, Javi y Pilar y nos encanta viajar y conocer gente. Esperamos poder conocer mucha gente de todo el mundo y conseguir que tengas unos días de vacaciones maravillosas en Barcelona.

reviews.comments:
Superbe accueil de Pilar, appartement très bien équipé ( lave vaisselle, lave linge, seiche linge, climatisation dans toutes les pièces).
Les serviettes de bain et les produits de toilette sont fournis.
Il y'a également des boissons, gâteaux en cadeaux de bienvenue. :)
L'appartement est également bien situé, pas loin des Ramblas; tous les commerces sont à proximité.
L'appartement est très propre, et très fonctionnel.
A recommander absolument

We really enjoyed our stay in Barcelona: the flat is fully equipped, functional, clean and true to the photos. And having access to the parking is definitely a plus! It is well located, in the centre and in walking distance from the attractions. Alex, Javi and Pilar are lovely hosts, ready to help and easy to communicate with. We recommend!
Very nice apartment fully in line with the description. We enjoyed very much our stay and the contact with the host was very good. I strongly recommend it.

1ère expérience avec air bnb: succès intégral! Super appart, excellente situation et surtout le parking. Alex répond très très vite aux messages. Je recommande! 
First experience with airbnb: great for the appartement, the location and  the parking. Alex answers very quickly. Go without any doubt!

We flew in from Ryan air, and took the public bus to Barcalona, then a taxi (only 8euro) to the apartment where Alex was waiting for us. He was friendly, and spoke english well. They had water, beer and chips chilled and waiting for us. A very nice touch after traveling. The apartment was exactly as advertised; one of the better we've stayed at from airbnb. 

The apartment is about a 20 minute walk to the beach.

Logement agréable et coquet.
Très bien situé.
confortable, rue calme.
Proche de la vieille ville, Rambla et port.
Hôte charmant, disponible et arrangeant.
Séjour formidable en partie dû à nos hôtes .

Il quartiere non è pericoloso si può girare tranquillamente a piedi di notte xchè ben illuminato e abbastanza frequentato a tutte le ore. é centrale (dista 10 minuti a piedi dalla Rambla) e fornito di trasporto pubblico, supermarket e negozi di ogni genere.

Nulla da eccepire in tema di accoglienza,
Pilar ci ha atteso anche oltre l'orario che avevamo fissato, ci ha lasciato 2 mazzi di chiavi, è salita con noi e ci ha illustrato dettagliatamente l'appartamento e il funzionamento degli elettrodomestici (c'è di tutto) la cucina è ben fornita di stoviglie e posate per almeno 10 persone.
Gli interni e l'arredamento sono nuovi e ben tenuti.

Una delle 2 camere con letto matrimoniale è piccola ma se si usa solo per dormire non da noia. 
I bagni sono senza finestra ma c'è l'aspiratore.
L'unico problemino che abbiamo ravvisato è che di sera, con l'aria condizionata accesa oltre a diverse luci, ogni tanto salta la corrente che bisogna sistematicamente riattaccare dal quadro che è dietro la porta d'ingresso.

In generale la sistemazione è davvero una buona scelta: lo consiglierei.
Fabrizio

Nous avons passé 4 jours dans cet appartement, et le séjour a été très agréable. Nous n'avons pas rencontré les propriétaires directement, mais tout a été fait pour que nous soyons accueillis à l'heure d'arrivée par une amie à eux, des bières nous attendaient dans le frigo, une chaise pour bébé a été mise à notre disposition... L'appartement est grand, spacieux, conforme à la description du site et aux photos. 
La cuisine est très fonctionnelle, bien équipée. Il y a deux salles de bain, une avec douche et une avec baignoire. 
il est très bien situé, deux métros à proximité, la plage est à 20 min en bus, le réseau bus est très pratique aussi pour se rendre partout dans Barcelone. Les remblas sont à 20 min à pied; 

Enfin, la place de parking dans l'immeuble est un véritable plus, pour y aller sa voiture le temps du séjour!
Bref, nous recommandons cet appartement, dans lequel nous avons passé un très agréable séjour!
The Sunny penthouse was amazing. Great location, very clean and very comfortable. Pilar checked us in and was very nice to show us around. Very recommended for future travellers to Barcelona.

Alex met us at the apartment and let us into the free underground carpark. He kindly showed us around the apartment, including descriptions on how to use appliances, air-con and wi-fi. He also left us a map and advised on nearby supermarkets and metro stations. The apartment is less than 5 minutes walk from 2 different metro lines and was clean and quite expansive. Perfect for a couple or small family. Would stay there again!

La experiencia ha sido muy buena, era la primera vez que usaba airbnb y sin duda volveré a utilizarlo. 
La casa está muy bien situada cerca de varios metros y del centro en si, de hecho en nuestro caso pudimos llegar a todos los sitios andando. Como pone en el anuncio es un ático muy luminoso.
Pilar fue muy amable, y nos indicó como movernos por la zona, aparte de dejarnos en el frigorífico refrescos, cervezas y leche (un básico después de un viaje largo).
Recomendaría este apto. sin dudarlo y sobre todo por la ventaja que es tener aparcamiento en el edificio, gracias a eso nos pudimos olvidar del coche.
El trato perfecto por parte de los anfitriones, el apartamento esta muy bien situado. Yodo muy limpio y muy correcto.
The apartment was lovely and everything was perfect. Highly recommend!

Expérience très positive: Alex, Javi et Pilar sont très disponibles et réactifs, tout a été extrêmement simple: Pilar nous attendait en bas de l'immeuble, nous à indiqué la place de Parking (fermé): un atout considérable dans Barcelone!
Très bien situé.

Merci beaucoup à vous 3, nous recommandons vivement votre appartement pour un séjour en famille !

Pour une première expérience avec Airbnb, ce fut un véritable succès. 
Appartement conforme à la description, très bien situé, très propre et calme. Produits de premières nécessité mis à disposition (Petit plus très appréciés: boissons fraiches et café Nespresso généreusement offerts!!!!). Hôtes très accueillant et répondant à toutes nos attentes. Nombreux conseils fournis dés notre arrivée pour optimiser la découverte de cette merveille ville!
Merci beaucoup Pilar, Alex et Javi pour les bons moments que nous avons passés. A très bientôt.
Very nice family and perfect welcoming! The flat is well placed and very clean. Everything is in place for a pleasant stay!
Una muy buena estancia, todo listo, todo en su sitio. Anfitriones muy majos y atentos!

Une très bon contact avec Javi et Alex avant d'arriver puis un super accueil de Pilar, que demander de plus! Tout était prévu à notre arrivé pour nous sentir comme à la maison. On vous remercie pour les conseils, grâce à vous on à passé un très bon séjour à Barcelone.

L'appartement est très très bien équipé et surtout très bien placé! Le parking est un gros plus.

Encore une foi merci à vous 3 c'était un excellent séjour.

Los anfitriones estuvieron perfectos.
Detallistas 100%
Barrio tranquilo. La casa genial, con todo tipo de detalles.
Ideal para visitar tranquilamente Barcelona. Metro cercano.
Gracias a Alex y su familia.

El apartamento es muy bonito, está muy bien situado y se puede ir caminando al centro pero también dispone de plaza de garaje gratuita si vas con coche. Los anfitriones encantadores, nos dejaron café, bebidas y algo de comer para la llegada y el piso tenia todos los detalles, todas las cosas necesarias del baño, de la cocina. Un piso para repetir! Muchas gracias!

Our experience dealing with Alex, Javi and Pilar was fantastic. They were waiting for us at the apartment when we arrived. The apartment was exactly as advertised.  It was clean, roomy, fully stocked and in a great area. The fridge was filled with beer, soft drinks, champagne, water and milk.  They also left cookies and snacks.  The espresso machine made great coffee.  Alex, Javi and Pilar were very accommodating and checked up on us a few times to be sure everything was OK.  If you are looking for an apartment to rent in Barcelona I would definitely recommend this one.
Все было замечательно, очень гостеприимные и радушные хозяева, общение с которыми заряжает позитивом и улыбками :)

Nice and clean!
Lot of light,
quiet area.

Friendly welcome!

This was excellent experience. Very clean and well equipped apartment (dish washer, washer, drier). Alex and Javi were waiting for us upon arrival and were gracious to give a lift to the airport on their way to work. The building has an elevator(lift). It is located a walking distance to both Espanya and Drassanes Squares. Subway and grocery/produce shops are just around the corner.

Alex and Pilar, you were wonderful and kind hosts. Your home is welcoming, neat, and perfectly furnished. My father particularly enjoyed the orange juice and Cokes that you had provided in the fridge. You guided us well so we were able to enjoy the sights of Barcelona with ease. Thank you again...I will always remember your hospitality.

Un grand merci à nos hôtes pour leur accueil formidable! Nous avons découvert ce très tres chouette appartement, superbement équipé, tout confort, et tres joliment décoré!
Tres bien situé, avec toutes les commodités à proximité,il nous a permis de bien profiter de la ville...
Merci, merci ,merci!

We were welcomed to the building by Pilar who carefully guided us into the reserved parking spot and showed us the apartment. She also gave us a map and circled everywhere we need to see in Barcelona, which was very sweet. They were able to accommodate our schedule regarding checking in and out, and they were also always extremely helpful with any request or issue no matter how inconvenient. The place is exactly as advertised and is in a great location and everything was in walking distance. We had a lot of happy memories there and will try and stay here again whenever the opportunity presents itself. 
Thank you Alex, Javi & Pilar for a wonderful experience.

Thank you Alex, Javi and Pilar for providing such a well appointed property for us to enjoy for our 4 night stay with our family.  We were met outside the apartment and walked down to our carpark which was so handy (finding a carpark in Barcelona is terrible).  They had left us some supplies of drinks, milk etc which was very much appreciated and really made us feel welcome.  The apartment had everything you could require and more, very much enjoyed the Nepresso coffee too.  
We plan to come back and stay again when we do the adventure park with our children.
Very well located for a good look around Barcelona and the notes left for us were very helpful also.  Yes go to Tonka across the road, very yummy food.
Accueil très chaleureux et généreux de Pilar. Excellent séjour dans ce bel appartement très bien situé, accompagné des bons conseils de notre hôte !

Our family stayed 2 nights and the apartment was perfect for us.  Pilar met us and gave us lots of good information.  We had a car so this apartment was great to park the car in the underground garage and then we walk to everything.  The metro is very close to which we did use as well.  Very clean and great views.  There is nothing lacking at all and this is a perfect place to walk and explore Barcelona.  It is great that there were soft drinks and beer waiting for us and also coffee for the morning.

Absolutely great! 
The Apartment was exactely like it is presented here in words and at the pictures (very tidy, well equiped and modern).
The location und surrounding of the Apartment are both brillant! There is a very nice Restaurant for breakfast nearby ("Federal"). Supermarkets are situated within a 2-Minutes walking distance.

When we arrived Pilar was waiting for us and handed out Information-sheets of all we needed to know -> a warm welcome from our very nice and sympatic host!

***absolutely recommendable***

Le logement était vraiment très propre, spacieux et lumineux. Un très bon équipement avec pleins de petits détails. Nous nous sommes vite sentis très bien et détendu. A cela il faut ajouter une situation géographique très bonne avec un accès direct par métro à deux pas du logement pour la Sagrada par exemple et le secteur port/plage à environ 20 min à pied.
Autre point positif, un parking privé en sous terrain pour le prix de la location. Un véritable plus vue le prix du stationnement à Barcelone.
L'accueil était chaleureux et nous nous sommes vraiment senti attendu. En effet, Pilar nous attendez dans la rue en bas du logement pour rentrer notre véhicule. Elle nous a donné pleins de conseils et de bons plans pour nous mettre au courant de tous ce qu’il y avait à faire à Barcelone.
Franchement un grand merci à eux 3 pour leur disponibilité, sérieux et sympathie. Si nous avons la chance de revenir à Barcelone nous savons déjà où loger.

Pilar, Javi and Alex were excellent hosts. The house is exactly as it is on the photos. Well equipped with beautiful modern design. A major plus is the parking availability! Next time to visit Barcelona will surely pick this house!

Très bonne réactivité au moment de l'inscription, accueil agréable, Pilar s'est adaptée au mieux à nos heures d'arrivée et de départ  et  nous a donné de bons conseils pour nos visites.
L'appartement est en tout point conforme à l'annonce.
Bus et métro sont à deux pas.
Nous recommandons cette llocation.

Pilar, Javi and Alex were excellent hosts. Pilar waited for us even thought our flight was late and explained everything we needed to know and more. The apartment is very clean and well situated. The Wifi worked great. There are 3 grocery stores next door and a very nice Tapas Bar called Tonka on the other side of the street, which made is easy for us to choose where to eat when we were tired after sightseeing.  If we go back to Barcelona we will call Pilar, Javi and Alex again. Gracias por todo.

Ottima accoglienza, per niente invadente. Bell'appartamento pulito e con tutto quello che serve. Arioso e spazioso. Ubicato in una strada principale vicino alla metro e non molto distante dalla Rambla. Ottimo soggiorno, da ripetere.
Great place to stay and well connected to Ramblas and via metro. Apartment was neat and tidy and host was waiting for us even though we arrived at 9 PM. Recommended for stay.

Great place, kind hosts!
The apartment has a good location, quite close to many sights, and there is great bar called Tonka on the other side of the street.
The hosts are absolutely kind, explained a lot about BCN and the place. The fridge was filled with drinks for us. The flat is really nice, the kitchen is well equipped, and wifi works well.
We were there 5 together with a little baby and grandparents, and we found the apartment large and comfortable for a family.
It's also great that it has a garage, but be careful if you arrive by a large car, because it's quite narrow.
The apartement is on the 6th floor, and the elevator was unfortunately out of order for some days, but it was not the hosts' fault, and they helped us with everything, even they gave us refund because of that.
Absolutely recommended, we would stay here again!

The hosts were all there when we arrived. Relatively easy to find. 5 mins walk from the nearest Metro station. 

I would say that the place is spacious,clean and modern. Safe neighbourhood with quite a few eating and drinking place plus a few groceries stores. You cant complain anything about that place. 

I like to add that the house is stock with drinks, some snacks and also a fully operational kitchen. We cooked up a great dinner there as well. 

The hosts responded really quick and gave us good tips around Barca. I will be back.

Nous étions attendus à notre arrivée. L'appartement est conforme à la description, parfaitement équipé, très propre. Quelques boissons étaient à disposition dans le frigo, ainsi que des capsules Nespresso.
Des informations étaient indiqués sur comment se rendre sur les principaux  lieux touristiques. L'appartement est bien placé.

Parfait !

what an absolutely wonderful flat!  we couldn't be more pleased with the entire stay.  we had great communication, met at a specific time and got settled in quickly.  the flat is near two metro stations and not too far off the road.  we would come back again without hesitation. /Clayton

Alex war ein super Gastgeber. Obwohl unser Flug 2 Stunden Verspätung hatte, hat er noch auch uns gewartet und uns alles gezeigt und auch die Taxis organisiert.
Die Wohnung ist sehr gut gelegen und super Anschluss an die ­ÖV. Die Einrichtung ist schön und praktisch. Alles in allem kann ich diese Wohnung nur empfehlen.
This apartment is perfect for 4 peoples !  We really apreciate it! Is location was perfect for us ! I recommend this place and if I ever come back in Barcelona I would come back here !

Our Airbnb experience with Alex was truly wonderful.  He went out of his way to meet us on our schedule, provided us with all the info we didn't even know we'd need, stocked the apartment with basics at no charge, was available for us when we needed him.  the apartment was very clean, comfortable and the kitchen well appointed.  The neighborhood was quiet residential - non-touristy, and close to everything including buses and subways.  I'd use their listing again in a flash!  They totally made our trip to Barcelona work!

1ère expérience Airbnb réussie !! Nous avons été très bien accueilli par Alex. Des boissons étaient à notre disposition ainsi que toutes les infos nous permettant de démarrer notre visite de Barcelone. L'appartement est parfait : très bien placé et super bien équipé. La place de parking est un vrai plus (même s'il faut beaucoup manoeuvrer). 
Merci à nos hôtes pour cet accueil !!

We had a great experience in the apartment of Alex, Javi and Pilar. We enjoyed the very friendly welcome and hospitality. The location was very convenient. The apartment itself was very clean and had a very good wifi connection. An apartment we would recommend!

Appartement très bien entrenu, propre, agréable et très fonctionnel. Pilar est très avenante et produit de bon conseils touristiques.
Nous y avons séjourné 2 jours en août.
A l'arrivée une carte touristique  de Barcelone vous attends avec des boissons fraiches dans le frigo.
Merci Pilar

The flat is great, very convenient for a family, with spacious kitchen and living room. The private parking was also very convenient. The flat is located very near from tourist places. Pilar and Alex helped us throughout the whole stay. They were very flexible about our arrival and departure time and gave us good tips to visit Barcelona. We recommend them :)

Logement plein de bonnes surprises ! Parfaitement équipé (il ne manque vraiment rien !) au cœur de Barcelone en proximité de nombreux bus et du métros, climatisé, 2 salles d'eau... Les hôtes sont prévenants et attachants. Si vous voulez aller à la découverte de cette ville vous pouvez choisir cet appartement délicieux les yeux fermés.

Nice and neat appartment, exactly as on pictures. Host Alex was very responsive and caring. There was welcoming atmosthere with fully equipped kitchen, welcoming drinks and snacks and a lot of coffee.
Good location, walk distance from most of sighseeings. 
Definitely recommended to stay at this place!

We (4 adults and 2 children) had a wonderful experience at Alex, Javi and Pilar's apartment.  Although we ran late coming from the airport, someone was outside the apartment waiting for us to arrive. We were welcomed with the air conditioning on (it was a hot day), beer and snacks.  The apartment is in the perfect location - very close to the metro and so much much within walking distance.

Pilar waited in front of the apartment on time and welcomed us very friendly. She guided us into the parking building which is very narrow. It wasn’t that easy to get the car inside but it is possible – we recommend it for smaller cars. 
Pilar brought us upstairs into the apartment, she explained everything important about the rooms, the kitchen and the area. Free beer and Coke were waiting for us in the fridge :)
Also Pilar prepared a map for us and explained us the sights of Barcelona. The apartment is comfortable, has a lot of space, WIFI works perfectly. 
Supermarkets and metro stations are close by – a very central location to live. 
Thank you for a pleasant stay at this great apartment and the friendly contact!

Alex, Javi and Pilar are very kind and hospitable. The apartment is clean equiped and luminous. Coffe drinks and apetizer were very apreciated.
In the complex, the perfect apartment to enjoy the city!
Brilliant Host. Very good communication. Outstanding flat , near to town. Clean and comfortable.

Staying at this apartment/penthouse made our stay in Barcelona outstanding. It's a place to be when you don't want to be labelled a tourist. A place that you can soak up Barcelona authentically, in an authentic neighbourhood ... but still close to transport so you're in the main city quickly - if you need to do the 'tourist circuit'. Every part of the apartment was excellent, and the host's attention to detail impressed me. Quality fittings, lovely views, sunny aspect, clean and well appointed for cooking meals. We felt 'at home' and comfortable ... and Alex, Javi and Pilar were excellent at communicating with us, and very helpful. I would highly recommend this stay, and it was great because my teenage son had his own bedroom.

Hemos pasado tres días y dos noches en ese piso y, perfecto! El piso estaba más limpio que nuestra casa!!!Jijiji. igualito que en la foto. 
Pilar fue un amor y, nos facilitaron todo desde el momento que llegamos a Barcelona.
Hay de todo lo que se necesite. Sólo tienes que llevar el cepillo de dientes y la pasta.
Todo un detalle por parte de los anfitriones el dejarnos agua, leche , café y refrescos para nuestro uso.
Repetiremos sin duda!!

Easy to get to the apartment from the metro.  Warm welcome from Pilar.  She oriented us to the apartment.  The apartment was just as described - sunny, clean and welcoming.  The neighborhood was perfect - we were about a 10 minute walk to las ramblas, 20 minute walk to the beach, a couple of blocks from 3 metro stations.  Poble Sec is a really fun neighborhood with lots of restaurants, bars and shops.  There is a great street to "Tapear"  (go from bar to bar for tapas and drinks) called Carrer de Blai.  
We had an amazing time when we go back to Barcelona we would definitely stay here again!

Best AirBnb experience we've had. The place is big, super clean, modern, well lit, and has a top storey view. Hosts are wonderful and they have put effort into the little things - eg. Beers in the fridge after a long flight, coffee, milk, shampoo,  etc. The location is walking distance to most places and next to tube stations for those farther away. If this were a hotel,  it would cost 4 times as much. Highly recommend it.

We enjoyed our trip to barcelona and our stay in this apartment. It was a good location nearby Ramblas, Camp Nou and other things you definitely want to see. There are 3 supermarkets in the area, which is convenient. The apartment was clean and neat. The host was very friendly and helped us when that was needed.

I had a great experience in this apartment! Alex was there to greet us when we arrived, and had a selection of maps and neighbourhood information ready for us. The apartment is clean, bright, and has a lovely view. Big enough for myself, my sister and our parents to share comfortably. It's in a nice neighbourhood, just a short walk from Parallel, and about 10 minutes from La Rambla. They had left the kitchen stocked with some light snacks and beer, which made us feel right at home. I would absolutely stay here again.

Un accueil attentif et chaleureux, un appartement tout à fait confortable et conforme à la présentation. Le quartier animé et proche de la vieille ville permet de faire beaucoup de choses à pieds, en laissant la voiture au parking. Un séjour vraiment agréable !

Conforme à la description, confortable et très propre l'appartement est très agréable. L'accueil était parfait et sympathique. Idéal pour une famille avec enfants. 
Fortement recommandé.

Nice apartment in San Antoni. Well located and surrounded by several shops/ restaurants.  San Antoni itself is very nice with its own cozy atmosphere. Ramblas is pretty close (15 min walk through El Raval). Metro (Parallel and San Antoni) is located at approx. 500 mtrs. The apartment is spacious and clean with a fully equipped kitchen. Especially if you need a parking and want to stay close to the citycenter, this is the place to stay. Alex, Javi and Pilar are friendly and helpfull during your stay. Yes, I can recommend this apartment! It wasn't the first time I rented it and it probably won't be the last time.

Nous avons été très bien accueillis par Pilar qui était bien à l'heure. L'appartement est juste splendide et d'une propreté irréprochable ! Il est spacieux, bien équipé  (rien ne manquait )et très bien situé.  C'est sans aucune hésitation que nous réserverons cet appartement si nous avons la chance de retourner à Barcelone. Nous ne sommes pas certains d'avoir les mêmes prestations ailleurs. Nous recommandons vivement cet appartement. Merci encore à Pilar pour sa gentillesse.
Samuel et sa famille

We had a great stay, the apartment is very homy and fully equipped. Alex, Javi and Pilar were very kind and hospitable.
Great experience!

Très facile a trouver, cet appartement nous a donné entière satisfaction!
Fonctionnel, super bien équipé, parking compris dans l'immeuble,métro a 150m, pleins de resto,bar, de supermarchés, d' (Website hidden by Airbnb) pied de l'immeuble!!
bref tout pour passer un séjour parfait!!
Accueil impeccable d'Alex, un pack de bienvenu super après la route(bières et coca au frigo, café,...)
Voilaaaaa

He estado en el apartamento con mi familia y nos hemos sentido como en casa. El apartamento está muy bien, tiene de todo. Todo estaba muy limpio. Además te ofrecen cafés y cervezas para que cojas sin compromiso. Nos dieron todas las facilidades para la llegada y la salida. Tuvieron una disponibilidad total para cualquier cosa que pudiésemos necesitar. Conocimos a Pilar que es encantadora.
El apartamento está situado a menos de 5 minutos del metro y varios autobuses. Tiene linea directa con la estación de Sants. Además se puede ir andando a cualquier sitio.
La zona está muy bien, con muchos sitios en los que comer, cenar o tomar una copa.

La casa nos pareció muy cuca, al llegar nos estaba esperando Pilar que muy amablemente nos explicó todo lo referente a la casa. Nos sentimos muy a gusto, es una casa moderna y bien equipada. Está situada cerca de la Avenida del Paralell que une la Plaza de España con Colón, así que muy buen ubicada. Única peguilla la plaza de parking que es un poco pequeña y de difícil acceso. Recomendable 100%.
Tanto Pilar como Alex son muy buenos anfitriones y el apartamento está limpio, cómodo y perfectamente ubicado para moverte por la ciudad.

Un sitio en el que nos hemos sentido muy cómodos. Para empezar Alex tuvo el detalle de equiparnos la cocina a nuestra llegada, con leche, agua, refrescos, cervezas, surtido de infusiones, azúcar, cápsulas de café para la cafetera...El piso es muy acogedor y está muy bien equipado con todo lo que puedas necesitar en pequeños electrodomésticos, menaje, sartenes y ollas impecables…  incluso con detalles en los cuartos de baño como monodosis de champú, cajas de pañuelos de tocador …
Destacar que está muy bien comunicado con dos estaciones de metro cerca y paradas de bus, además el barrio tiene de todo, desde supermercados al salir de casa y el fantástico mercado de San Antoni  a pocos metros.
Como negativo, podría decir que la plaza de aparcamiento es estrecha y requiere de maniobras. Con respecto a una de las habitaciones dobles, señalar que aunque la cama es de 135cm, está pegada a la pared y resulta un poco claustrofóbica para el que duerme de ese lado, además de que una de las almohadas cae delante de la llave de la luz y durante la noche al moverte enciendes la luz sin querer. También comentar que cuando hay varios electrodomésticos funcionando a la vez (termo de agua, vitrocerámica, televisión y aire acondicionado) salta el diferencial de la luz, por lo que te obliga a apagar uno de ellos. En cualquier caso estos puntos negativos realmente no son un impedimento para recomendar este alojamiento.

Spent three nights at A, J & P's great located apartment. 
On arrival Pilar handed over the keys and Alex introduced 
all the apartments amenities, which are plentiful.
The apartment has a great view and located close to restaurants, supermarket and public transport + I can highly recommend to stay at the apartment.
Kind regards
Jannick

Great appartement. 3 rooms and 2 bathrooms. Appartement was nice and clean. 10 min walk to ramblas. 20 min walk from the Beach. Close access to Subway. Alex's mam gave us good tips abort the city and the appartement. 

Alex is a helpful and trustable man. The appartement is worth the price. 

Thanks!
Excellent location and flat, thanks

Alex, Javi & Pilar were a special Host,  very helpful also in giving us some information about the city and its services. the house is beautiful, very spacious and suitable for five people, with very large windows overlooking the city and its beauties. The apartment is located in a quiet area near the center and the Ramblas, in a very suggestive zone, we moved by foot. I'm sure I'll come back to Barcelona, and it Will be a pleasure to stay in this Amazing apartment again. Thank you so much Alex, Javi & Pilar

Alex made us feel welcome by providing food and drink in the frig, explaining the mechanics of the apartment, giving us hints as to safety and security, and indicating locations of stores like restaurants and markets.  He also answered our questions immediately when we emailed him.  The apartment was perfect for our family of four adults. It had everything we needed to cook and eat at home. It is new and beautiful with a wonderful view of the rooftops and the city.  Overall it was splendid.

Nous avons séjourner 3 jours et 2 nuits dans cet appartement à 5 personnes. L'appartement est très bien équipé, comme à la maison. Super clean. L'accueil est au top, avec de petites attentions (quelques confiseries, boissons...). Les hôtes sont d'une vraie gentillesse. Nous avons rendu l'appartement en fin de matinée et ils nous ont permis de laisser nos bagages l'après midi pour profiter de notre fin de séjour. L'appartement est idéalement placé, entre place d'Espagne, Montjuic, la vieille ville. À recommander+++++

Merci à Pilar pour cet accueil ! Personne très sympathique. 
Appartement très bien situé dans
Barcelone, bien équipé et propre. 
Nous avons passé un agréable séjour. 
Encore merci.

Meine Familie und ich haben uns auf dem Weg nach Spanien ganz spontan für Barcelona entschieden. Am selben Tag haben wir noch die "Sunny Penthaus mit Parkplatz" gebucht! Obwohl wir erst sehr spät am Abend ankamen, hat Alex auf uns  für die Schlüsselübergabe gewartet . Alex hatte sogar ein paar Getränke, Tee, Kaffee und Milch für uns besorgt. Es war ein sehr angenehmer Aufenthalt mit viel Sonne (helle Wohnung) und die Wohnung ist sehr zentral gelegen.  Vor der Türe hat man verschiedene öffentliche Verkehrsmitteln und sehr gute Restaurants. Wer selber kochen will, hat gleich um die Ecke Supermäkte, Mercados und Obstläden.
