host.host_about:
Hello to everyone :) As owners we love being able to offer our apartments during your experience in the wonderful city of Barcelona. We welcome all cultures, religions and tastes. For us there is no discrimination but respect. Perfection does not exist but we strive to offer good conditions for your stay to be very positive. The only thing we like to ask is for our guests to be happy and positive. See you soon!

_

Hola a todo el mundo :) Nos encanta poder ofrecer nuestros apartamentos durante su experiencia en la maravillosa ciudad de Barcelona. Damos la bienvenida a todas las culturas, religiones y gustos. Para nosotros no existe la discriminación pero sí el respeto. La perfección no existe pero nosotros nos esforzamos por ofrecer unas buenas condiciones para que su estancia sea muy positiva. Lo único que nos gusta pedir es que nuestros huéspedes sean alegres y positivos. Hasta pronto!

reviews.comments:
Great location although the taxi driver got confused with a different address nearby.
Check in and out was very efficiently organized.
The apartment is on the 4th floor and not on the 2nd.
Shame we could not use the roof terrace much due to the weather.

Would love to stay again.

Thanks.
Stefan

Nous avons passé 6 jours fin mai dans cet appartement. Côté emplacement il est à 50m du bas de la Rambla donc idéalement situé pour visiter ou aller vers la plage. L'appartement correspond au descriptif de l'annonce. Il faut toutefois annoter que la terrasse est accessible en sortant de l'appartement et en montant d'un étage. Côté équipement c'était bien. Nous avons  eu des odeurs désagréables presque en permanence malgré la fenêtre ouverte en permanence dans la salle de bain. Les voisins de l'étage inférieurs (touristes français) ayant fait la fête toutes les nuits ont un peu perturbé mon sommeil et les 3 bars de la rue génèrent un peu de nuisance sonore mais c'est Barcelone avec sa vie nocturne.
Côté accueil ce fut parfait avec un accueil chaleureux.

L'appartement est vraiment bien, propre et bien situé ! 
arrivé en bas de l'immeuble on peut craindre un peu pour la suite car la porte est tagué et la cage d'escalier laisse un peu a desirer mais pas de panique, rien a redire vis a vis de la terasse ou de l'appartement. 
un peu de bruit avt minuit mais c'est barcelone et dans l'ensemble c'etait calme ! 
bref je le recommande ! c'etait un super sejour pr nous ! 
Merci !

Gemütliches Apartment mitten im Trubel der Stadt, nur 50m entfernt von La Ramblas und der nächsten Metro. In der Wohnung ist alles vorhanden, was man für einen Kurztrip benötigt. Die Dachterrasse kann sehr schön zum Frühstück oder für längere Abende genutzt werden. Optimaler Standort für Städtereisende.

Ce fut un séjour plutôt agréable, nous n'avons pas rencontré Martha, mais les personnes de la sous traitance qui nous ont ouvert la porte était OK, L'appartement est bien situé, métro, tout près de la mer, parfait, et si vous ne voulez pas vous embêter avec le petit dêjeuner l'hotel ""basic and chic" juste en bas propose de copieux petits dêj pas chers du tout.

Appartement bien situé (entre Ramblas, marchés et Barceloneta), très fonctionnel (lave-linge) et une belle terrasse rien que pour nous. A recommander!!!

Merci Marta :)
Bel appartement, équipement complet, très bien situé et personnes arrangeantes et sympatiques.

Our stay here was absolutely amazing! The apartment is in a great location making it very easy to either walk to Las Ramblas, jump on the metro or a short taxi ride to anywhere else within the city. Our flight arrived to Barcelona around 7AM and Daniel was kind enough to meet us early! The apartment was the perfect size for the two of us with plenty of bathroom space as well. Although it was cooler weather, the terrace is absolutely amazing and only you get access to it. I can guarantee the next time I'm in Barça, I would stay here again!

We felt very welcome and was greeted at the door when we arrived. only 15 min away form the airport in taxi and perfect location for visiting both sides of the Rambla. A bit of noise from the street during nights, but would live here again due to location. very satisfied.

The apartment was perfect! It placed right in the heart of the city, perfect walking distance to all places we wanted to visit. Metro station in few steps from the apartment, so if we needed to go somewhere far from the city center we used the metro. The apartment was the right size for us, comfortable, clean and great having a terrace on the roof! Yes, there is no lift in the attic and the building but it's good for burning calories! ) This was our first time using airbnb and we had the really good experience, would definitely come back here again. Thanks for being great hosts!

The landlord is very nice and always with a smile to welcome us on the first day. The house is the same as it is shown in the pictures and the balcony is so well to have a relax in the sunshine. The house position is so fantastic as it is near the La Rambla within one minute's walk to the main road. It is so convenient for us to have a breakfast  or lunch when we woke up in the morning as there has many restaurants.  Overall, the trip is like a dream with this apartment.

Had a great 7-night stay at Marta's Apt. Great location! A cozy 30 second walk from La Rambla and a 15 min walk to barceloneta (beach).
2 minute walk to the nearest metro. Plenty of nice restaurants, bars, museums in walking distance.
At night you will hear some noise (not much) from the nearby bars but that was nothing that bothered us.

Best thing about the place is definitely the private roof top terrace. We spent all our mornings there enjoying breakfast and the april sun. Overall the apt is in good shape and we have no complaints.

Didn't meet Marta but the guys from inoutapartments were nice and helpful and we had no problems with check-in/contract signing/check-out.
Would recommend.
Charming apartment with a great location. About 5 flights of steps but the rooftop deck is worth it!

Es war einfach perfekt. Die Lage ist ideal, um vieles in der Stadt zu unternehmen oder einfach nur zum Hafen oder Strand spazieren zu gehen. Die Betreuung vor Ort war sehr nett und hilfsbereit, die Wohnung entsprach voll und ganz der Erwartung und war mit Dachterrasse einfach wirklich schön. Im nahen Umfeld findet man alles, was einem so in den Kopf kommt, vom Supermarkt bis zum netten Café um die Ecke. Jederzeit eine gute Empfehlung. Für uns bestimmt die Unterkunft für den nächsten Besuch.

We had a wonderful time at Marta's apartment. It was clean and in a great location! Right next to the metro station and within walking distance to the beach and harbour.

We really enjoyed the terrace for breakfasts in the morning! 

Would recommend and stay here again :)

We were made to feel so welcome by David when we arrived. The flat is lovely, in a great location 1 min walk from La Ramblas and the flat had everything we needed including iron and hairdryer and comfy bed and air con etc. The terrace was a real sun trap and got the sun all day, it was great that it was our private space we could relax in. The only thing that wasn't ideal was 6 small flights of stairs with luggage but after all our tapas and sangria it was quite nice to have the extra exercise! We had a great time and would definitely stay here again. Thanks!

Host met us at the appartment late in the evening and was very helpful in giving us directions to the appartment. Perfect location for everything that you would need to do in Barcelona and the met is a 2 minute walk away if you wish to go further afield. The terrace provides brilliant sunset views of tibidabo

As we arrived in Santa Monica Street, we warmly greeted by David. 
He welcomed and warned us of the the 4th flour climb of 71 steps. 
Kindly he offered to carry our bags up the stairs , Whew! 
Accommodation was comfortable and tastefully decorated and very secure and safe. 
From that day forth we vowed we would venture up and down only once per day. 
The location of Marta's apartment was fantastic; so close to La Rumbla and Port Vell and situated in a little laneway. 
 Early in the evening could e a little noisey but with window closed, fine. After all we were in a vibrant exciting part of the city.  Thank you David for your warm greeting and fond farewell.

The whole experience with the apartment was good, the check in was punctual and all was as advertised in the ad. Being an Airbnb host myself I lacked the personal touch of the place. It's run more like a business, the up-side obviously being that everyting was very well kept and no surprises. The hosts were very nice and always helpful. This is a central and tidy place right in the middle of things!

We loved staying at Marta's apartment. The whole check-in process was great, our hosts were very communicative. The apartment was very clean everything was just as it was advertised. The terrace was a nice place to rest after a log day of touring. The location was great - central and walking distance to everything. Would be happy to stay again!

Das Apartment liegt genau bei der Ramblaz und hat daher eine perfekte Lage und man kann alles gut erreichen. Es war in der Nacht ruhig, auch wenn es direkt an der Ramblaz war. Das Apartment war sehr sauber und gut ausgestattet. Für 3 Personen ist es ein wenig eng aber es ist machbar. Was ich schad fand, dass die Wohnung nicht einer Privatperson gehört und man sich eher wie in einem Hotel gefühlt hatte und nicht das richtige "Airbnb-Feeling" hatte. Das Apartment kann ich jedem weiterempfehlen und das beste war die Dachterrasse mit einem tollen Blick über Barcelona.
Danke!

This was my very first Airbnb experience and it couldn't have been better. Location was amazing, walking distance to many of our scheduled points to visit. The flat itself feels very homelike and cosy, and let's not forget the terrace that provided us with a perfect space for lazy evenings with cheese, jamon and sangria. Everything went well and smoothly and I would easily stay again
Great welcome. Fantastic appartment with everything you need. Great to have aircon in the Barcelona heat. Amazing roof top deck to use. Really central and close to everything. Would recommend.
Great location! Great hosts! Rooftop terrace was so nice to relax and have a snack! Comfortable bed and nice living space!
David met us and was super helpful - he even carried our very heavy bags up 5 flights of stairs! He gave us great restaurants to try... And, he ordered an early morning taxi for us.
great appartement in the middle of la ramblas. very easy to reach the nightlife, the beach or restaurants.

My daughter and her grandmother stayed here and had a lovely time, a very clean, nice and central apartment.  Only a minute to La Rambla and the metro, also, the host was very helpfull and precise. Would definitly come back sometime!

We had a wonderful time in Marta and Paul's apartment. Paul is super friendly and was always available. He even carried my huge luggage up all the stairs, which was so nice. The apartment is exactly as shown in the photos and the the rooftop terrace is beautiful and offers an amazing view. It is located absolutely central and close to metro, beach and in a really interesting, diverse neighborhood, right by the lively rambles but on a small, quiet street. Kitchen is fully equipped with everything one could possibly need and even has a washing machine which was great for us as we were traveling over a longer period of time. Can definitely recommend Marta and Paul's apartment, thanks so much!

The place was very central to La Rambla. Check in instructions were sent only 30-40 min before check in but they sent someone to meet us at the place to inform us of check in/stay/check out details which was very helpful. Be prepared to pay a 30 euro initial check in fee and tourist tax (~2-3 euros per day) for each day each person is there at check in (not included in cost of place)... the place was very well stocked and had everything we needed. There was mold in the shower, a couple leaky/loose faucets, and guests are expected to buy their own toilet paper once the partial first roll provided was gone. Other than those few complaints everything was good! I would recommend the place!

The flat is as pictured - small, but cosy. The TV did not work as far as we tried, but that's not what we were in Barcelona for anyway : ) LOTS of stairs, more than anticipated, but as others have said - helped to work off sangria and tapas! The roof terrace was nice to have, though we didn't personally end up using it much after all due to rain. Was a bit noisy at night with the echo of people outside even with the windows closed. Overall, an amazing location for the price and cozy quarters to make you truly feel like you live in Barcelona for a few days. Kitchen is fully equipped if interested to make a meal. If you're not looking for something fancy, and want a great location with outdoor access for a good price, would recommend.

Everything what we need for a superb vacation was available in the apartment. We really enjoyed the terrace for breakfast and dinner. It was cozy and clean. Perfect for two people. The flat is ideally located in the city center. In the same street are a supermarket and some bars. It is not far from the metro Drassanes (L2). We met Paul for the check-in and the communication with the host was easy.
Very nice place off Las Ramblas.  Perfect location, clean apartment and cute terrace on the roof.  Lots of stairs so maybe not for the less mobile!  Would stay here again. Thank you!

Place is in an amazing location .. you can walk literally everywhere - Rambla 2min, gothic part 5 min, beach 20 min... basically no walk is more then 45 min - doesn’t matter what you want to see..
Place is 1 min walk from Subway/ Metro.. green line- gets you anywhere...
Taxi from airport was 25€- not bad ... 
hosts are super friendly and everything was better then I expected .
Strongly recommend!

A charming apartment in one of the older buildings in Barcelona with original style and features. A nice roof terrace for a cool evening drink. Close to great cafes and bars and easy location 5 mkins fm the Metro or Ramblas or the seafront. Always love Barcelona!
small but nice place, good location - terrace was perfect!

Apartament is located In the heart of Barcelona next to Main street LaRambla. Full furnitured, air condition and with extra linen and towels. Very nice terrace on the top of the roof. I can really recommend this place.
Fantastic apartment in a great area. 2 minutes from the metro, lots of bars and restaurants in walking distance.  Beach about 20 minute walk away. We had a brilliant time.

The check-in process was easy and quick. We didn't get to meet Marta or Paul but their friend Josep greeted us on time as scheduled. He was great to talk to! Beautiful small apartment that has everything you need. Roof top patio is special and the apartment's location is perfect - right off La Rambla. This is a fabulous Airbnb. Super clean too. Perfect for a couple. We would stay here again if we happen to find oursleves back in Barcelona on future travel.
lovely clean apartment located in perfect location and thankful for helping us find the apartment when we were lost. very good communication. would stay again
位置非常好,房东非常热情｡非常好的一次入住
Great place, great location, quick communication.
Great place for a couple. Rooftop is a nice getaway. Easy access to a lot of places in Barcelona.

The apartment was lovely and met all expectations. Location is amazing and close to everything. It was also amazingly quiet at night time considering the proximity to bars and La Rambla. I've stayed at other places in the same area over the years and could hear people partying all night long, so was pleasantly surprised that I could sleep through the nights (even on the weekend) uninterrupted. The host was gracious, friendly, and offered assistance should we need it (we didn't). The only other feedback I would give is that I was not able to confirm check in details until the day before my trip although I had been messaging for several days. When I finally connected with the host, he advised that he preferred me to either call or text upon arrival, which was difficult as I was not planning on bringing a cell phone with an international plan with me on the trip, which I ended up changing at the last minute so that I'd be able to connect with the host.
We loved Marta and Paul's place. Perfect location and very clean. Would highly recommend.
房东小哥很热情,接待很周到,房子不大,但很干净,有大件行李的旅客不太适合,楼层较高,但是露台很完美,总体来说还是不错的体验!

This place was just perfect. My friend and I enjoyed it a lot. Location was great. The apartment was super clean. We really liked the rooftop. Marta and Paul were gone while we stayed at their place but they had a friend of theirs checking us in. He was super nice, communication was great, everything worked out perfectly. I can highly recommend this air bnb for a getaway in Barcelona.
Nice, clean apartment within short walking distance La Rambla and El Raval area. Josep helped us check in a little early and was nice enough to give some recommendations.
Nice apartment, helpful and comunicative hosts, perfect location, unsuitable for a stroller (too many stairs).

Excellent situation, close to metro, big supermarkets, the major sights and downtown. 
We would warn anyone who is not good with steps that there are 71 steep steps on 5 floors to reach the apartment but once in, it has everything for an enjoyable stay.

We stayed at Marta + Paul's place for 9 nights during our stay in Barcelona. Very cute little apartment with a rustic feel with wood beams across the ceiling and brick accent walls. Perfect little place to recharge between adventures in Barcelona. Most important to us was the location of the apartment. You are just steps away from the nearest metro stop for the L3 line at Drassanes. Either way gets you to Plaza Espanya or Plaza Catalunya in just a couple minutes. You are just a 10-15 minute walk away from Barcenoleta and the beach. In general very centrally located.

Make sure you are okay with stairs. Walking up and down 5 flights is a good workout. You are very centrally located thus get some street noise at night especially during weekends. Though it does test your fitness a little with the stairs but the listing is very honest about it and we were well prepared. 

Would love to stay here again :)

This apartment is very inespensive, and in a great location. However, it is 1) very small, I think even by European standards; and 2) it is 70 steps up a narrow and steep stairwell. If you have a lot of luggage or any difficulty climbing stairs, I would not recommend it. On the other hand, if you have one or two bags, and don’t mind the daily forced exercise, then you’ll enjoy the apartment! Also, it had a bit of a musty smell when I arrived, but this was quickly cleared with the several windows. If your priorities are location and budget, I recommend it.

neighborhood_overview: I live between 2 of the best districts in Istanbul: Beşiktaş and Nişantaşı.  While the first is more bohemian, very lively, famous for its night-life and  next to the Bosporus, the later is much more affluent, elegant and full of specialized restaurants and internationally renown designer shops. Both are pretty, safe, very central and share an exiting lifestyle.  Everything is steps away or very nearby; gorgeous parks, mosques, Taksim and the TOP TOURIST ATTRACTIONS.  I'm surrounded by a huge array of cafes, restaurants, shops, bars and live music venues; all this contributes to making Beşiktaş one of the most sort after districts in Istanbul. Yet I live at a quiet and safe street. Witin 1 to 2 min walk: a hospital and pharmacy (at the corner) 3 supermarkets, including the cheapest chain in all of Turkey. The Saturday bazaar/farmer's market with very fresh and some organic products, only 150 meters away.  My street is quiet and with a line of trees. The Bosporus is a short walk away, f
notes: For avid walkers; the walk to TAKSIM trough Maçka park it's wonderful and it only takes about 25 min to reach Tksm. Or if you take the CABLE-CAPSULE ("teleferik") you can cross the park and have a gorgeous view from above and save a few min walk. You could even walk further to GALATA tower within 50 min (20 from Taksim square) and keep going down to Karaköy, only 5 min from Galata and another 10 min to Eminönū to the wonderful Spice bazaar and the Yeni mosque. All together you can walk from home to Eminönū in a bit more than 1 hr.
transit: **There are 3 bus routes that pass by the corner of the flat (130m) They go to TAKSIM, another to EMINÖNŪ (Spice bazaar) Karaköy & Yeni Kapı (very near the Blue mosque). 5 min walk there's the dolmuş (collective taxi) that goes to Taksim  in about 5 min. **Osmanbey metro is 15 min walk. This metro can lead you to Atatūrk airport within one hour with a short-easy change at Yeni Kapı. **Kabataş tram that leaves you at the door of the Blue mosque, Aiğa Sofia,  the spice and Grand Bazaars is 25 min walk or 1 bus ride away from this corner. Optional; taxi to Kabataş in 6 min and costs about €2.5 ** The ferries to Ūskūdar only take 5 minutes to reach ASIA! Or 20 min by luxurious ferry to Kadiköy (only 70 euro cents) From Beşiktaş centre there's another dolmuş to Taksim (5-7 min ride) and a huge selection of buses to go all around and mainly the most beautiful palaces in the city and near the Black Sea at Sarıyer!

This review is for our second reservation at the same hotel on our trip, after we returned to Istanbul after visiting other sites in Turkey. I have reproduced the same review from our first stay at the hotel:

Our stay at Sultan's Inn was a wonderful experience. I and my friends chose this place because of all the positive reviews it had received, and our experience corroborates everyone else's reviews! Sultan's Inn is an affordable and well-organised hotel. Our rooms were cleaned and tidied up everyday while we were out, dirty dishes were replaced and clean towels were provided. We never needed to request anything because it was all taken care of seamlessly.

The staff at Sultan Inn is very courteous, friendly and professional. They are well-informed about local sights and the ways to reach them. Sometimes their recommendations for guided tours and transport options are more expensive than the alternatives we found by ourselves, but their recommendations were still useful nevertheless. In particular, the hotel's airport pickup service is more expensive than local taxis. But this service was useful for first-time visitors to Turkey like us, since we'd have otherwise found it difficult to navigate our way to the hotel from the airport.

Also, the breakfast buffet is one of the best we've ever had, with a really sumptuous selection of foods for every taste! I'm not typically a morning person, but I woke up extra early just to make sure I got a crack at those amazing sausages, boiled eggs, baked potatoes, black olives, creamy yogurt with three different flavours of jams, chocolate brownies, and much more!

Finally, Sultan's Inn is very conveniently located at the heart of the Sultanahmet district in Istanbul. The area is fairly touristy, and Istanbul's local residents don't frequent it much. But for those of us visiting the city to take in all the famous sights like the Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, Topkapi Palace, most hotels in Sultanahmet are a mere 7 to 10 minutes walking distance from all these places. In partcular, Sultan Inn is situated at an intersection with a taxi stand, so for residents in need of private transport, it is very easy to find one right outside the hotel.

My only point of dissatisfaction was that the rooms were smaller than we expected. The photographs posted on Airbnb appear slightly 'stretched', giving the appearance that the rooms are longer than they really are. This could be just a function of the camera that was used to take the photographs, but it is worth bearing in mind for visitors who plan to spend a lot of time in their hotel rooms. Sultanahmet is so beautiful that we were barely in the hotel except at night, so it didn't really affect us.

All in all it was a good experience, and I would recommend this hotel to anybody visiting Istanbul!

Stayed in one of two rooms (I think) available at this gritty-but-stylish retro apartment. Small kitchen, lived-in, authentic, Ulas was very generous sharing coffee and such; living area is spacious and lovely: Decorated with music posters and relics from Ulas's event-organizing days, as well as tons of books. It has an artist's pad vibe (which I loved, but might not be everyone's style). Ulas (and roommate, too) were very friendly and communication was excellent. The air circulation in the room was a little less than ideal (I stayed in the second room, with the wrought-iron bed frame) and it got quite hot and humid, but hey, it's Istanbul in the summer and overall it was fine. The cats are friendly but got a little lonely when Ulas was gone, but if you like to play with cats, you'll have a family of three to entertain. The bathroom and other aspects of the "facilities" are worn and gritty, but well-maintained and perfectly functional. If you're looking to live as a student or artist in Besiktas, this is a great place to stay. The best part is that it's right off the main drag, which is extremely crowded and busy, but the apartment is actually amazingly quiet for Istanbul and set back enough from the busy-ness that it feels residential and cozy without any sacrifice in convenience.

neighborhood_overview: My place is in the middle of Besiktas-Nisantasi and Taksim. Besiktas is the leading culture, art and education capital and district of Istanbul as well as one of the most valuable regions of Istanbul with its Ortakoy, Arnavutkoy, Kurucesme and Bebek neighborhoods located by the Bosphorus. Nisantasi, Istanbul’s equivalent to London’s Chelsea or New York’s Upper East Side, used to be dominated by strawberry orchards in the 18th century. It was here that the sultan’s soldiers used to train their target, hence its name – Nisantasi means “target stone “ .Taksim Square is the center of Istanbul today, and Beyoglu has a very nice pedestrian street.  Besiktas is the best place to observe the lively Istanbul city life. It is also the popular meeting point as well as the most important junction for sea transportation. Besiktas also hosts the historical heritage of the Ottomans, culture and art with its Dolmabahce, Ciragan and Yildiz Palace. Besiktas is also one of the best places to see in Istan
notes: There are 3 supermarkets and 1 bakery on the road.
transit: Besiktas, Taksim And Nisantasi neighbourhood within walking distance of the house. Nearest metro station takes 7 minutes by walking: Osmanbey Metro.

reviews.comments: Although the house is new and nicely located, the listing is inaccurate, and the hosts did not have the place prepared for guests. We were clearly their first guests. After a delayed check-in, we were greeted by broken window shutters and air conditioning units that didn’t function. The apartment lacked the WIFI, laptop friendly work space, and washer/dryer units which are included in the listing. The hosts behaved more like landlords and did not apologize or go out of their way to help us when problems came up. They only reluctantly put a bed frame in the second bedroom (I had to insist, repeatedly). They refused to compensate us for the WIFI we were forced to purchase, although WIFI was on the apartment listing. We later found out that the TV was not set up either, so we couldn't use it. The house lacked other essentials: a table to eat on, trashcans and trash bags, pots or pans, hangers for clothes or towels, napkins/washcloths, etc. Anyone looking to book the place should verify that these problems are solved before reserving, because the apartment could eventually become a nice spot to stay in. At the moment, though, it was a rather bumpy stay.

The complex is extremely quiet.  The location was perfect for walking to Ulua Beach, the shops at Wailea, Wailea Center and Monkey Pod. Tamara and Steve are lightning fast to respond.  Loved staying here.

Deluxe Full Plush Memory Foam Bed, iHome with 4S or earlier connectivity, brand new fixtures. Spectacular location!

host.host_location: New York, New York, United States
host.host_about: Young professional couple who love New York City and want to share our home with people looking for an affordable vacation in the Big Apple. We are both from the mid west and bring strong values and genuine hospitality. Friendly, outgoing, and resourceful so our guests feel welcomed and appreciated.

reviews.comments: Great guy and neat , always there to assist me with anything i want

Good and simply solution. Have everything, near everything. Safe zone.
Very nice Host.
Hello Lee, thank you for your welcoming. Your room was a good value for the price . It's a good point that your apartment is near from the Subway.

Hi Lee & Daniel,

Thank you so much for accommodating us over the weekend. We loved the room! You guys were great hosts and we highly recommend you and your apartment to other Airbnb guests. The room is very clean and the bed is very comfortable with the memory foam mattress. When we arrived there were clean towels, shampoo and conditioner, and cold water nicely prepared for us. Lee & Daniel are really easy to deal with and more than helpful in recommending places to go and providing concise instructions in using the transit system. The apartment is located 7 minutes walk from 2 train stations and frequent bus services just around the corner so getting to and from Manhattan was quite easy. 

Thank you again Lee & Daniel for your great hospitality. Hope to cross paths with the both of you in the future.

Regards
Zoey & Jay

Lee and Daniel were absolutely the most gracious hosts. They were extremely communicative, polite, and respectful. The apartment is immaculate, the memory foam bed feels like you're sleeping on a cloud, and it was generally the perfect Airbnb experience. This is how it should be folks. Go stay with these dudes, you won't regret it.

Lee and Daniel were perfect hosts! Although we didn’t interact with them too much due to being busy sightseeing, they were very kind and gracious in our short interactions and via text, gave us our privacy, very accessible and provided everything we could possibly need. We arrived the first day to a wonderfully made up bed and a five-star hotel-like arrangement of fresh towels, tissue, shampoo and conditioner, and free bottled water sitting right on top of it. The bed was very comfortable. The AC worked perfect. The room was a good space. And the bathroom was clean, modern looking, and perfect size as well. Few days in, we noted how the only things missing in the room would be a towel rack and mirror and miraculously (almost scary, mind-reading type scary), Lee and Daniel had a new towel rack and mirror waiting for us the very next day. Seriously, FIVE STAR service. My girlfriend even remarked that they should open up their own hotel! The place was also very short walk away from both AC and J trains (which both take you to Manhattan in no time). Convenient stores close all over. We highly recommend staying with Lee and Daniel. They were very responsive to all our concerns and didn’t even mind our late-night arrivals, even though we felt bad because we didn’t want to wake them up with the door noise and such. Hope you choose their place and have as great a time with them as we did!

The host made my partner in I feel very welcomed would have wanted the bathroom and bedroom to be a bit cleaner as there was hair on the floor in the bedroom that was not ours and the bathroom was a bit moldy.
We had a really great stay! Great hosts, very organized and a great place!

Both Lee and Daniel are very friendly host. We stayed 13 nights here. The house is neat and clean. Everything is very organised. It's in a safe community and there's 2 subway station within 10 mins walk and 1 min to the nearest bus stop. We enjoyed our stay very much and would recommend this listing to anyone visiting New York.

Meme si avec notre programme chargé nous étions très peu a l'appartement nous avons été très bien accueilli et  bien conseillé également.
L'appartement est très propre et situé à 10/15 min à pied de 2 lignes de métro et la chambre a un lit super confortable!
6 nuits qui sont passées très rapidement!

It has been an absolute pleasure to have met Lee and Daniel: my girlfriend and I both wished we could have stayed more than just one night. The guys were very welcoming, and we had a great conversation comparing notes on New York and the US versus or home Europe - a moment for the likes of which we swear by AirBnB despite being rather private people. 

The apartment and room are very clean and light. It's conveniently close to the metro which gets you to Manhattan, a bus to Williamsburg, and an affordable Uber ride to JFK. Great place, good location, fantastic value.

We would absolutely recommend staying with Lee and Daniel!

This was our first time and Brooklyn and didn't know what to expect, after staying here we would definitely want to go back. This colorful neighborhood is fun, save and unique. Lee and Daniel was helpful, friendly and went out of their way to improve our stay. 
I love NY and this was a true living like a local experience. Easy parking outside the apartment and short walk to the train station to get into Manhattan. The area is full coffee shops and eateries to keep you busy.  Lee and Daniel did a fabulous job in creating a space that is comfortable and inviting. As seasoned travelers who've stayed in a couple of places, this one ticks all the boxes, we would highly recommend you stay here.

Lee and Daniel son increíbles!!!! Son divertidísimos, buena gente y serviciales, nos dieron consejos utilísimos. La comunicación con ellos es perfecta, contestan al momento que les escribes, siendo siempre super resolutivos. El apartamento es inmejorable. La habitación es comodísima, tiene una ventana que da al exterior y la cama es estupenda también, enorme!! En nuestra estancia coincidió que los días eran un poco fríos y contamos con un radiador que nos calentó al instante. El baño es muy cómodo y los chicos son muy limpios, todo está limpísimo. Para movernos utilizamos el metro, del que tienes dos paradas a escasos 10 minutos. Por todo, no dudéis en ir a casa de Lee y Daniel, es una opción estupenda para pasar unos días en Nueva York. Thank you guys!! Enjoy and take care!!
Lee and Daniel were really nice and friendly hosts! The room was really clean and tidy as well! Will definitely book this apartment again if I am back in NY!

Awesome stay at Lee and Daniel home! Very clean appartment, real Brooklyn experience, close to train and buses...
Lee and Daniel have always been available to answer questions, and gave fantastic food recommendations.
We would definitely recommend this place and come back next time we visit NYC.
Thank you guys!

All I can say is, amazing! Check in was convenient, the apt was clean and comfortable; very accurately depicted, maybe even better. The neighborhood is really nice, close to trains/bus, and has easy access to grocery stores, cafes, etc. 

As for our hosts, Lee and Daniel were super nice, asking if we needed anything and making sure we were taken care of, but not overly involved. It was really simple staying here and we could come and go as we pleased. Recommend!

Really nice place, that have everything you need near by! Lee and Daniel were really nice and were very good at making sure we felt at home and that we did'nt needed anything!! It was a really good experience, and we would definitely stay there again :-)

Although I couldn't spend much time with them I can say that they are incredible hosts. The room was so good and the bed is extremely comfortable. They are so kind and are always ready to answer any question. Thanks for everything guys !!!!
Everything is fantastic here. I really recommend this place.

We had a fantastic time here! The location is super close to the Brown Line trains (5-10 mins walk) in Brooklyn with easy street parking. Our hosts were awesome and room was very comfortable. There's also an amazing Indian restaurant close by. Thanks so much for an awesome stay!

Totally enjoyed our stay at Lee and Daniel's place! 
Apartment is very clean and tidy. We stayed in the master bedroom and were provided clean towels and all kinds of toiletries. 
Lee and Daniel are wonderful hosts! They made us feel like home and recommended us a nice breakfast spot called Trade Union. Everybody should go check out! It's 9 blocks away next to Utica Ave metro. 
Location is great. Within walking distance to two metro stations. Very safe and quiet neighborhood with easy access to restaurants and grocery shops. Neighbors are pretty friendly as well :)
I'd totally recommend Lee and Daniel's place to anybody wanting to stay in Brooklyn :)

Lee and Daniel were amazing! They were very communicable and accommodating! The first night Lee gave us several suggestions on where to dine and go out to bars. They were present when we needed them but gave us our privacy when we wanted it. Thank you!
Great stay in Brooklyn! Lee and Daniel were super flexible and kind. Wonderful comfortable bed. Although it's an up-and-coming area the neighborhood itself is certainly not high-end.

We had a wonderful stay at Lee's place. The room was as advertised spacious enough for 2 persons and very tidy and clean. Lee and Daniel did everything they could to make sure that we had a pleasant stay, e.g. providing us with tipps and tricks regarding public transportation or even recommendations where to have great meals!
We definitely would come again and can recommend this Airbnb room - very good value for the price, considering that it is in New York! :-)

Lee and Daniel were very welcoming hosts. They double checked if we had everything we needed and made our arrival, as well as the whole stay, very convenient and comfortable. The location of their apartment is great, close to the subway and several restaurants/bars.
Thanks again for having us!

It's a really great apartment, got enough space for two and we really enjoyed the time there. We had privacy when we needed and was treated very well by Lee and Daniel. They also gave us good suggestions and guidance, and contributed to a great start for us for our first time in NYC.

Lee and Daniel were great hosts. We saw Lee for only 5 seconds, but met Daniel a few times and he was so sweet and welcomming. We loved our stay. It is a bit far up in Brooklyn, but there are a few great restaurants around and many subway lines taking you directly to the city. The check in was easy and they were super flexible on the checkout.  We'd recommend staying here. Thanks guys!

Lee & Daniels have been great hosts! Leaving us privacy but helping whenever was needed. Their place is nice and cozy! And the neighbour is quite and people really friendly! We definitely recommended!

Lee and Daniel were great host! 
They helped us with every question we had and were very courteous.  
The room has a good size and the bed was very very comfortable!! The whole Apartement was very clean. 
I can recomment everyone to stay in Lee and Daniels apartement.
Lee and Daniel were great hosts. I felt welcome and they had everything I needed.  The place was clean and comfy.  It was a great stay!

We had a very good stay at Lee and Daniel's place. They've been kind and attentive and have done everything to make things easy . The apartment is very comfortable and the neighbourhood is wonderful. We surely recommand Lee and Daniel's place!

Lee y Daniel fueron excelentes anfitriones, nos sentimos muy cómodos en su casa! El barrio está bien, hay varios lugares para comer por ahí y el subte queda a algunas cuadras de caminata. 
Los recomendamos!
Lee and Daniel's place has a great location and is very clean. My sister enjoyed the comfy bed and it worked out perfectly for our NYC get-a-way. The hosts are very welcoming and communicative.
Lee and Daniel are awesome! Though we didn't have a chance to meet in person, communications went on well. Had great time at their place. Happy New Year!

We stayed at Lee and Daniel's place over new year. We didnt get a chance to meet them in person but they were very prompt in answering any questions we had. Their place was a little bit far from Manhattan, but easy access to transport. Room was cozy & clean. Would recommend Lee and Daniel to others.

My husband and I, had a very nice trip in NYC thanks to Lee and Daniel's welcoming. The apartment was close to the trains (about 5-10 minutes by feet). It was really clean and the bed is very confortable. Lee and Daniel are really kind and they are full of good advices. We didn't see them a lot because we were visiting a lot, so we came back to the apartment a bit later but it was really sympathic to meet them and we had a warm welcome so that's was awesome. 
Thanks guys !

Nous avons passé deux excellentes nuits chez Lee et Daniel.
L'appartement, surtout la chambre et la salle de bain que nous avons utilisés, étaient très propres et bien aménagés et correspondaient amplement à nos besoins.
L'appartement est situé à proximité de la station de métro Gates Avenue, à Brooklyn.
Le chemin vers Manhattan se fait donc très bien... à condition que le métro soit fonctionnel, ce qui n'a malheureusement pas toujours été le cas lors de notre séjour.
Nous n'avons pas eu la chance de rencontrer Lee et Daniel car nous ne les avons pas croisés, mais ils ont fait en sorte que nous ayons tout ce dont nous avions besoin.
Points positif: le stationnement gratuit en face de leur immeuble!

Lee's place was def a excellent stay for my girlfriend and I. Nice location and easy parking. Really nice neighborhood with great brunch spots in the morning. Room was comfy and just what we needed. Would recommend this stay for anybody!

Lee was kind and super flexible with check-in check out. He provided some great suggestions of things to do and placed to eat around the city. The apartment is comfortable and near some great bars and some tasty restaurants.  We would definitely stay again.

Great place to stay in NY. Bed-Stuy is a cool neighborhood with cafes and restaurants nearby. Easy access to Manhattan via A/C or J/Z trains. Lee and Daniel are very friendly and welcoming hosts. The place is super clean and comfy. Would definitely stay again!

We had a great experience and cozy stay at Lee and Daniel's place!The apartment is located in Brooklyn, 35-40 minutes ride by subway to the city center, easy to find and walk around in the neighborhood. The room is comfy and clean, bathroom and kitchen are shared with the hosts. Guys are very friendly and hospitable! We've received great tips (on getting to La Guardia airport, shops nearby, could borrow so much needed umbrellas, etc.) and generally, we had nice random chats. It was a real pleasure to stay and feel like at home! Thank you guys!

Lee and Daniel's room is at a 10-minute walk from 2 metro stations and it's about a 40-minute ride to Midtown Manhattan from either of the stations. The room was clean with an air conditioner, which was very helpful when we stayed there during a heatwave in New York. Nice and pleasant hosts and they make you comfortable very quickly.
Awesome spot -- very comfortable, organized, clean. Appreciated the little touches that made the stay feel like home! Super friendly and flexible hosts. Thank you!

Lee's place was clean, presentable and comfortable. 

His place is 10-15 minute walk about from 3 major lines into Manhattan so you can get just about anywhere within an hour. Very useful! 

Parking was a bit awkward as you had to move your car for street cleaning but otherwise fine. We also had to let the host into our room so he could get his clothes out every evening. This probably wouldn't be an issue if you didn't come back to the room after 8pm. 

Overall great value.

Great stay. Very clean, cozy place. Checking in was very easy. Parking right on the street and easy access to the city. Host checked on us a couple times but otherwise left us to enjoy the trip. Would book again easily.

Lee and Daniel were great! Although we only saw each other a few times, they always took the time to make sure we were as comfortable as we needed to be. Their place was very close to the subway. The room itself was extremely clean and the bed was so comfortable it had us struggling to get out of it each morning. We were sad to leave but can't wait to come visit again soon!
Good clean place in a good spot with great international food nearby.

Great place, and very accomodating host(s)!
The pictures and the desciptions are accurate.
Lee and Daniel were wonderful host, very polite with great recommendations. The apartment was clean and nice, the bed VERY comfortable. Close to public transportation and great restaurants.

Many thanks to Lee and Daniel for hospitality, they were very nice and attentive hosts. The room like a hole place was clean and cosy. Everything was like in the description and on the pictures. Would definitely recommend it to everyone.
Awesome location. The room was clean and cozy as described and photographed. With no doubt, it was a great stay!
For our first visit to NYC, Lee and Daniel's apartment was very good. They were flexible with check in and check out, and very accommodating during our stay. Thank you guys for being great hosts!
Fantastic hosts, clean and comfortable place in a very nice quaint neighbourhood

Lee and Daniel has a lovely home in Brooklyn. It was a great and safe neighborhood with great access to public transportation and free parking. Also with some easy shops and restaurants around a few blocks. I enjoyed my stay with them. They were very friendly and helpful and also gave me my privacy when i needed it. Thanks guys again!

I had a great time. These two hosts are sweet, super easy going, clean, friendly and helpful. Once you know your way around it is easy. 
You are well connected with the subway, and the train would.
The room is nice, and the bed is comfortable.
 Everything was clean.  I felt I stayed in a very authentic neighbourhood.
 I  would stay here again. I had nice chats with my hosts, and tehy gave me good information. Wonderful people. 
 See you in the future  lots of love Jutta

Comfortable bed and nice room. Easy check-in and check-out. Lee always answered my questions promptly. I saw Lee and Daniel only a couple of times.
It's fairly far from Manhattan (about 45 min by train) and even from downtown Brooklyn, but it's certainly a good place to stay if want to get a "real experience" from NY, not as the touristic place, but rather how is living there.

Lee’s place is a jewel for couples and solo traveler who want to explore the city. It’s in a calm neighborhood, very good connected to two main metro lines - that can bring you straight to Manhattan or JFK.

Room is comfortable and cozy. Big size bed. Bathroom is clean and well maintained. 

Lee and Daniel considerate and kind hosts.

We enjoyed our stay and we highly recommend staying here

Impeccably clean room with a very comfy bed and all facilities available. We had the whole apartment to ourselves since our hosts were out of town. Lee was very easy to communicate with and all instructions were clear. 

The neighborhood is very laid-back and full of shops and restaurants that have a non-touristy feel to them.
Transport is fairly easy with a couple of buses around the corner and several subway trains on about 10-15 minutes walking distance. The trip to and from JFK is really straightforward.

During the week the neighborhood is quiet, on Friday the streets are busier. 
All in all I would totally recommend this room, we have no complaints whatsoever.

The room and bed were very comfortable after a long day! Close walk to the train and delis. Inside, the apartment was clean and Lee was friendly & casual - very easy to have a quick convo with before heading out. They were extremely quick with communication and helpful with check-in. I would definitely recommend this to a visitor. Thank you for the stay!
Awesome hosts, awesome place.
Lee and Daniel are great hosts - we felt so welcomed in their home and had a lovely time. I would recommend this place to anyone without hesitation.

We stayed at Lee and Daniel’s for almost a week. It was a great place to come back to after a long day out on the town. Everything from check-in to check-out was smooth and they made themselves easy to contact in case we needed anything. 

A subway station was only a few minutes away and there was a nice bar just down the street. 

Would definitely come back!

Lee e Daniel sono stati fantastici: simpatici e puliti, ci hanno aiutato a prenotare il pullman per boston ed altre cose.
La stanza si trova a 10 min a piedi dalla metro a e c che in 30 min porta a Manhattan! 
Consigliatissimo!!!! 
Grazie Lee e Daniel!!!
Nice and comfy room within reach of public transportation. Would stay here again!
The place is nice and clean.  Comfy bed.   Very quiet and private. Definitely will recommend it to anyone and would love to stay again with them.

I needed a place to stay for a couple of nights in Brooklyn and this was a great spot hosted by Lee & Daniel. They were very easy to communicate with from booking through checkout. I only met Lee and Daniel for a brief bit but they were  friendly and easy to talk with. The apartment was very clean including the bathroom and bedroom with fresh linens and towels. The bedroom was very quiet and included a comfortable mattress which made for a good nights sleep. It had been very hot and humid outside during my stay in June and the air conditioner in the bedroom cooled me down!

Staying with Lee and Daniel was an absolute pleasure and I warmly recommend them to anyone planning a visit to NYC. They are fantastic and considerate hosts and their place is comfortable and spacious. Neighborhood is great as well, but also convenient for transportation elsewhere.

Daniel was super nice, felt like meeting a friend! Didn't get the opportunity to meet Lee. Place is a bit deeper into Brooklyn, but the street parking wasn't difficult and the subway was under a mile  away on foot. Neighbors could be rowdy, but couldn't hear them much through the walls. Nice place with comfy bed!
Lee and Daniel are extraordinarily hospitable. Enjoyed our stay a lot. It's a ten minute walk to a subway station, and the apartment itself is close to a laundromat, restaurants and coffeshops.
Nuestra estancia fue genial. Lee y Daniel son dos chicos encantadores, que nos ayudaron en todo lo que pudieron. Totalmente recomendable.
Lee and daniel were super nice and the best hosts we could ask for. The place is very clean and close to a bus stop and a subway station.

name: Waipiʻo Hostel- Kai Room
space: Waipi'o Hostel is located in the quaint village of Kukuihaele, less than a mile from majestic Waipiʻo Valley.  In a place where horses and wild turkeys often wander by, this is the old Hawaiʻi.  A place where neighbors are welcoming and life is sweet as the smell of sugar cane grass.  You'll enjoy the wonderful ocean view and many fruit and macadamia nut trees on the property.  We enjoy the best weather on the island- not hot like Kona, not rainy like Hilo, not cold like Waimea… just perfect!!  It’s also a central location for exploring the Hilo and Kona sides of the island.  Just 10 minutes away is the lovely town of Honokaʻa, with farmers markets, antique shops, restaurants, and the coolest old movie theater in the world.   Our three guest rooms are called "hostel style" but are really private rooms below the main home.  The rooms are simple, yet nicely decorated, clean, with great beds.  Guests share a bathroom, outdoor patio and living room with high speed Wi-Fi, couches, cable TV,
