host.host_about:
Aloha,
I'm the Executive Director of Hawaii Outdoors Institute.  I also run the Waipi'o Hostel and host interesting travelers from all over the world.  I travel often for work, and sometimes need to stay in your AirBnB!

reviews.comments: I felt very welcomed by Gregg, the property was beautiful. the water was hot and there was fruit a plenty. Anyone who's looking for a clean friendly place would enjoy this place.

When I arrived, Greg was there to welcome me and show me around. He informed me of a few things around the area so I could go out and explore.
The place was exactly what the listing showed, except the bed was exceptionally more comfortable than expected!
Thanks so much for a great stay!

This room had a really good feel to it. Very clean and good vibes. Really nice bathroom and shower. I would love to stay again if I visit the area. Overall exceeded my expectations from the listing and consider it very affordable for what you get. 

I was looking for a place to stay at the last minute and the host got in touch right away and helped me get set up. Host made me feel welcome, made sure I had everything I needed and gave some great advice about a nearby beach to visit.

Overall positive experience and would recommend!

Great experience from the beginning to end. Very close to the Waipio lookout- we walked. The rooms are clean and the bed was very, very comfortable. Swriously, more comfortable than thr resort we stayed at the night prior. No bugs in the room and easy to keep them out of common area if you keep the door closed. Great hosts, very helpful and accommodating. I would definitely stay here again if I am ever in the area. You also get to meet fellow travellers, which is also nice.

We only stayed one night but anyway we had a great time. It is a perfect place to discover the Waipio Valley (Very close to the hostel, it's just a 15 minute walk) and to get to know other people. The room was very nice, the bed was comfy and the garden beautiful. All in all a very cozy place to stay. Mahalo Greg for your hospitality :)

The room was very nice and comfortable. Greg was very prompt to answer my questions. When I arrived there was no one at his place, so I texted him to see which room I was staying at.  It was an amazing experience to pick up oranges, guavas in the morning and have them for breakfast. The only problem was the line for the bathroom in the mornings. It would have been nice to see Greg  during my visit but I couldn't.

Greg & Harmony were very accommodating and gracious hosts. Their two children added a delightful element.
The accommodations were clean and met our needs perfectly! Met some very fun guests as well during our time.
Loved the fruits that were available as well.
Thanks for enabling a very special HI stay.

Waipio Hostel is a great spot for a stay near Waipio Valley. It's an easy walk to the Waipio Overlook. The rooms are simple, clean and affordable. Greg was super nice as were the other travelers. We enjoyed comparing notes and planing adventures with the other guests. The kitchen is well stocked, there are lots of guide books about the Big Island and the bed was very comfy. Mahalo Greg!

My fiance and I had a great stay here last night.

The common areas are very cozy and inviting, and had a lot of little extras that made it easy to feel at home. Things like tea, condiments and spices were plentiful.

And of course everything was quite clean.

Our room was very roomy and comfortable. The bed and the linens were super comfortable and high quality.

We had to arrive late but Greg was really helpful and easygoing about it making it no problem at all.

As an extra bonus there are a number of fruit trees on the yard which we were allowed to pick from. Oranges and tangerines were in season, but there were others as well that didn't have fruit this time of year. We even got help from the neighbors puppy!

Our stay at Greg's place was perfect! Greg and Harmony are kind-hearted and very friendly! The hostel is rustic and charming. You can hear frogs and birds all night long and you'll meet geckos and other creatures in the garden - very cool! Pick a fruit or cook a meal in their outdoor kitchen! We had a great time out there!

My husband, infant daughter and I stayed with Greg and his family for one night only. They run a very sweet hostel in a fantastic location. Plus: We got a tour of all the fruit trees on the property by one of his children, very nice!

Greg was a lovely host. He was very kind and very laid back regarding my arrival time. The space was quite nice for what  you expect when you hear the word hostel, and I was pleasantly surprised by the bed. Of course it is more expensive than a regular hostel, so one should expect a few extras, but it was still a very nice stay, and conversations with his two young children were an added bonus for me :)

What a nice stay! We were given a yard tour by the cutest host ever (Greg's daughter) and received great tips regarding the closest beaches and restaurants. Great view on the ocean, cozy room and comfortable bed. Merci beaucoup!

Greg was great! Very friendly and knowledgable about stuff to do in the area when our original plan fell through, but gave us space to enjoy the hostel by ourselves. Not a lot of frills, but that's the way we like it! Perfect for us young 20 somethings exploring the island.
Nice hosts. Lots of amenities. Beautiful location.

Staying at greg's hostel was really nice. The place is great and cosy. Greg showed me the hostel and my room when I arrived, he was really nice and he really made an effort. The location is perfect for trips to waipio valley, it's just a 15 minute walk from the house to waipio lookout . I'd definitely stay there again.

Spent two weeks at this extraordinary hostel, and enjoyed every aspect. It was clean, Greg was a great, accommodating host (although he suffered a serious accident while I was there and thus was quite limited in his activities. That will be temporary and did not impact the great experiences I enjoyed there.). He recommended the Waipio Cookhouse nearby for meals, and that was a terrific bonus. Good, locally sourced simple foods and wonderful staff. But you have ample cooking facilities at the hostel if you prefer, and coqui frogs to serenade you in the evening. If you want a natural, peaceful, inexpensive place to see local Hawaii, including Waipio and nearby valleys of true magnificence, this is an unbeatable choice.
Greg was awesome. His chickens laid delicious eggs, and the home was beautiful.

We found the Hostel easy with our GPS, also the hostel sign on the Mailbox was helpful ;)
The room was prepared and and everything was clean and fine, we enjoyed the fresh eggs =)
Greg came down to talk to us and was very helpful.
Thanks again,

Michael

When we arrived after hiking down into Waipio Valley, we were greeted by Greg and his family. It definitely made us feel at home. He then showed us to our room and the amenities that accompanied it. The outdoor kitchen was great for when we made dinner on our second night. The room was fantastic and would definitely stay here again if we return!

Greg met us at the front door and showed us around the apt/property. He was very welcoming/nice and made sure we had anything we needed and offered to tell us more about the area and to talk to him if we had an questions later. The apartment was clean/nice and the bed was incredibly comfortable! The apt is o lookout. We walked, but you could easily drive there.

Harmony was very welcoming and answered all our questions about nearby Waipio Valley. We enjoyed the indoor outdoor cooking and eating area with the cool breeze and lovely view. The sitting areas was comfortable and filled with useful books. The shower was great with enough water pressure to wash my thick hair (and there was lovely shampoo and conditioner provided). Most importantly for me, the bed was great! Super comfy   
This place was recommended to me by a friend and I will certainly do the same.

Thank you very much for the spontaneous commitment :) your room was really cute and the rest of the hostel was absolutely lovely - the outside kitchen, the big bathroom and the cosy living room. We definitely recommend your hostel though we just came around for the introduction and and stayed for the few hours of sleep because of all the things to do on the Big Island ;)

Greg was wonderful! He heard us pulling in, and welcomed us into his hostel with open arms. We had a king size bed (which is my fiance's dream come true), a shower, kitchen and anything else one would need. We loved everything about this stay!

great stay. close to waipio lookout/trail.
very tranquil, cosy bed and lovely common area. very friendly and welcoming hosts. couldn t have asked for more. thank you.
We really enjoyed our stay, Greg is a great person. The house is in a really quiet location and we really liked the area outside for BBQ.

Great value! The room, booked at the last minute, was simple but clean and the bed extremely comfortable, our hosts were very nice, and even lent us a jacket when we needed one! We met cool people during our stay and ended up hiking with them :) perfect to explore the valley
迷ってしまい､到着が遅くなったにも関わらず､とても優しく暖かく迎えてくれました｡静かで星空も美しく､素敵な場所でした｡こんどは長期滞在したいです｡

Wai'pio hostel is located just five minutes walk from the Wai'pio valley lookout. The place is really idyllic, and we loved having breakfast and dinner in the outdoor kitchen area with a fantastic view of the ocean. The rooms were clean and shared a common bathroom and kitchen area with other guest rooms. Greg was a really nice host and made us feel comfortable. But the best part of staying there was the special fruit tree tour we got from his adorable daughter (with directions to the secret grapefruit and avocado trees in the neighborhood)! We loved this place and highly recommend it!
Greg is very friendly and the house is very well located to visit Waipio Valley. I had a nice stay!
Very welcoming.  Beautiful surroundings.
We stayed here for 1 night. It was very Nice.fully in the nature! Nice rooms,comfortabel beds.nice livingroom. Greg old us Nice things to do. We had a warm welcome!

Great place, very close to Waipio Valley. Greg and his family are very friendly and able to offer advice about the local region. Would certainly recommend to others. The fruit and nuts in the Garden are an added bonus.

Greg & Family's hostel is the first AirBnB experience I've ever had. Before arriving to Greg & Family's hostel, I stayed in contact with him letting him know my estimated arrival to the hostel. He was kind enough to let me know that he wouldn't be on the property and that he wouldn't be able to greet me, which is totally fine! 

While arriving to his property was a bit tough without GPS (which people should set way before hitting Waipio valley), we were able to find it with the description he set on his itinerary. With that being said, expect no cellphone coverage out here! Greg has graciously offered wifi on his property for convenience.

The hostel was lovely, and I really loved how convenient and close it was to the lookout! Although at night, I hear frogs and crickets pretty clearly outside of the hostel, so I would bring some earplugs with you if you don't regularly carry them. :) Thanks, Greg & Family!
greg was super kind and friendly. his place had a beautiful backyard and everything we needed was in the room. I would definitely recommend this to others :)

Nice little hostel with three rooms, common room, spacious bathroom and a nice seating area outside with the kitchen. Bit far away from everything, would be perfect to explore Waipi'u valley which is close.
Thanks for the nice stay, Simone and Jan
We had a very good stay. Room was simple but clean and fine. Very nice outside fully equipped kitchen. Fresh fruit from some fruit trees. Friendly and helpful owner. I can recommend this place.

場所も家族もﾍﾞｯﾄもお庭も出会う人も全てよかった!
3回もﾘﾋﾟｰﾄしてしまいました!

The place was outstanding! We had a room with a king size bed. The common area was fantastic, great outdoor cooking facility. The water is so clean and tasty! The location is perfect - great to venture the north island. The hike to Waipio is great. The Waipio Cookhouse has AMAZING food. Beautiful place to kick back. Would stay there again in a heartbeat. Thanks Greg!

We stayed here for 1 night whilst on the Big Island as we wanted to check out Waipio Valley. The location was perfect for this. The room was clean and exactly as described. The bathroom was also clean and the shower had good water pressure. We arrived whilst Greg was out but there were instructions to let ourselves in - he came down to introduce himself later and was very friendly.
Everything was just as mentioned, clean and quaint.  The only thing that I would say is that starting around 6 am there was a little noise upstairs of little feet. :)  Other than that, it was good!

C'est un endroit charmant! Tout est fait pour vivre une aventure particulière. Les fruits et légumes dans le jardin. Les conseils avisés d'Harmony & Greg et bien sûr le lieu qui est magique par bien des aspects. Si vous voulez vivre une vraie expérience complétement détachée de tout alors ce lieu est pour vous.
we were there only for one night. Greg is absolutely nice, the rooms are not very new, but regarding the price absolutely okay.

This place was awesome! I wish I could've stayed longer, but the one night I did stay was VERY relaxing and cozy. It's close to the Waipio valley and the Waipio cookhouse is close too, which has great food. I would definitely recommend this spot to anyone wanting to explore the Waipio valley or just to have a relaxing time in Kukuihaele.

We enjoyed our stay a lot! There were fresh fruits and avocados in the garden which we could take and eat. Good information was provided and even guide books to read. Greg's family was super nice and helpful too! we felt very welcome and would stay there again. MAHALO! :)

In general we had a great stay. I guess the kids running around upstairs can be a bit noisy, but they will go to bed before you anyway and it provides a nice home-atmosphere. Greg and Harmony are very nice and welcoming. The big avocado tree and macadamia's and other fruit trees are also pretty cool!
Greg's hostel was beautiful. Super comfortable king size bed, breezy outdoor kitchen, massive avocados, farm fresh eggs. Thanks for having us!
This place was awesome and we enjoyed our stay!
The host canceled this reservation 105 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.

Awesome place to stay if you are trying to stay as close as you can to Waipio Valley.  There's a place right next to the hostel called The Smoke House and that's the best locally grown and organic food you'll ever eat!  Best place to stay if you are looking for the best bang for your buck.  You can't go wrong.

Had a great stay at Waipi'o hostel. It's a great location and charming old house and general set up for the hostel. Greg was super accommodating with our timing being a bit out of wack. Would highly recommend it!
Perfect!
Zimmer einfach aber fein, mit Tisch zum arbeiten und einem sehr bequemen Bett. Gemeinschaftsraum ist auch gemütlich. Hostel sehr nah am Waipi'o Valley

The host was generous and offered us any fruit on the property, which included macadamia nuts and avocados.  The room was clean and cozy. As a hostel there were three guest rooms sharing one bathroom- which worked just fine as everyone was on a different schedule. 
The host welcomed us but mostly left us alone, he let us know they lived upstairs if we were ever in need. They have 3 young kids and being upstairs you could hear foot steps.
The area is nice but in the town many things were not open, I think we were there in the low season. But there is a fridge and all you need to cook most things.
We really enjoyed staying at Greg's place. It's truly unique place and we'll highly recommend!

I had a wonderful time at Waipio Hostel, I didn't want to leave! Greg was an excellent host with clear directions and check in/out procedures. I settled in very easily in this quaint set up, appreciating every aspect of the property. I would most definitely stay here again!

If you are hiking the muliwai trail or just looking for a fun and local experience, this is a great stay! It was clean and comfortable and the shared spaces allowed us to get to know a couple from Chicago staying next door. The outdoor kitchen is fun and it is so handy to have a full kitchen with all the cooking utensils for making meals and keeping costs down. Having a coffee maker is so nice in the mornings although there are only two mugs despite the plethora of other dishes. I saw no bugs inside the house area but the tree frogs sounded lovely at night. We stayed in the "kai" room and could hear the family overhead in the mornings and early evenings but not to the point of it waking us up or keeping us up. The clementines were in season while we were there as we're avocados so we ate really well. The check-out process was quick and easy. Highly recommend this place!

Waipi'o Hostel was a great base camp to explore the Waipi'o Valley area! Greg was very helpful and welcoming. I would only recommend bringing some earplugs if you're not used to countryside noises at night.

The setting for Greg's home is so relaxing and beautiful. We were able to relax and also get out to enjoy the sites. Greg was very open and would have helped in anyway I feel if we asked. The space was what we had thought it would be. Had a feel of living in the Honokaa area, not just a visitor. We had the room with the king bed and it was very comfortable and clean. Rustic is the best way to describe the space. It was clean and had all that we needed and also the experience of living around others.
The hostel is a really nice place and Greg is very friendly. A perfect place to stay to explore Waipio valley.

This hostel is exactly what we needed. Greg was super easy to communicate with and directions to the place/to get in were very clear. The bed was very comfortable and there were lots of great books to read :) The fresh fruit and coffee were also nice. The location was fantastic and very scenic. I would definitely recommend this place. Very much worth it!
Such a beautiful place to stay amongst fruit trees, incredible scenery and a kind, open, living family.
It's a nice place. Really quiet and totally authentic Hawaii.

Greg's hostel was perfect for a rustic stay following exploration of the amazing Waipi'o valley.   The well equipped outdoor kitchen with view of ocean and fruit trees loaded with tangerines provided the makings for a  lovely morning breakfast with fellow travelers.  Bed very comfortable to cozy in  and hear the night bird songs in this memorable corner of the Big Island.
Greg's place is better than described. It is clean, charming, and secure. The closeness to the Waipi'o Valley was outstanding. If we were booking again, we'd love to stay longer. Thanks so much Greg.

The hostel was a great place to stay for a solo traveler. Greg's place has a nice balance of community style living (shared bathroom, living room, kitchen) but with the option of some privacy with your own room. It was cozy, and I felt perfectly safe traveling there alone. Would totally stay there again!

Greg and Harmony seem very sweet and the description of an older plantation home had me wondering about their rooms when I saw they were downstairs. Upon reviewing many, many reviews stating it was clean I booked a two night stay. There was so much dust in our room above and behind the blinds, in the closets, the lamps well everywhere and there was mold on the walls in the shower. These may not be issues to some but I coughed all night so that my niece finally went to sleep in the car. Greg issued us a $20 refund for the cleaning fee, I stated our objections and not wanting to bash them as people only the condition of our room which was hardly fair since we then had to find another room for the night and pay again. Anyway am writing as I said not to bash them as people but not wanting another to have the same experience either.

If, like me, you stayed in lots of hostels in the 1970s, you'll love this place. Very nostalgic, with the best that those places had to offer. And Greg's place has a lot of nice upgrades.  Highly recommended.

The place is as described and the rooms are actually quite nice for a hostel. The common areas have everything you need and it's very nice to get to know the other guests staying in the hostel. However all rooms are adjacent to the common area, which means you'll also hear the other guests if they stay up late. The garden is very nice with its fruit trees and sea views.  Neighborhood is rural, lovely and peaceful: the real Hawaii as the host described it! At a stone throw from the waipio valley entrance.

This is a hostel is an old  sugar plantation located nine miles off Hwy 19 so a car is necessary.  It may seem "way out there" but you are actually very near Waipi'o Valley.  The accommodations are simple but nice.  The bedroom I had and the bed were very comfortable. The bathroom is rustic and simple.  It's very quiet at night except for the roosters so light sleepers  need earplugs.
nice room beautiful view,they are nice
Just as good as last time. My daughter was along this time and said she wanted to stay here all week.
If you are planning on attending a program in Honokaa, this is 8 miles out of town. You will need a car.
This place was just what we needed. A beautiful setting near the edge of the world with a great restaurant around the corner and a quaint town down the road.  Loved our stay here.

If you don't need it fancy but very adequate at a decent rate this is your pick. Have met some very interesting folks on both visits which adds to the ambience of this casual setting. Certainly a great pick if you want to explore Waipio or Waimanu.

Edge of the world!  This was a fun hostel - type stay. Shared a kitchen with other guests but it's such a small and cozy arrangement that it was really fun. Very close to the hike into Wiapio Valley (less than a mile down the road) and there is a nice little restaurant just across the way. Rooms are under the main house and you may hear a little noise from above but it's not bothersome. Beautiful older plantation house. Nice stay

Greg's hostel was much needed to crash at after a long day traveling. Bed was big & soft, and we drifted off to sleep to the sounds of nature around us. The hostel was as described; had all the basics and their backyard was fantastic. You can't beat the proximity to the Waipio Valley lookout either. Thank you!
This place is amazing! I felt very comfortable there, very safety and everything was clean.
This was a great location to get up get a great breakfast at the Cookhouse and beat the crowds to the lookout!

Best living experience in Big Island. 

We arrived late night but instructions were so clear we didn't have any trouble of finding the place. 

It is the perfect location if you're visiting the north part of the island. 

Greg and his wife are great hosts. 
Gave us plenty of info and tips about places to visit.

Peaceful and quiet area, you'll rest as never before. 

Restaurants and cafes close around 8pm so if you're looking for a late dinner my suggestion is to plan earlier where to eat or buy grocer before and cook at the hostel. 

Mahalo, 
Davide & Ben

Nice stay close to waipio valley. Very comfortable bed and good amenities, including nice shared bathroom and outdoor kitchen. Just be aware that there's a young family living above, so don't plan to sleep in past 6am.

Nice, quiet place to stay in one of the most most beautiful places. Don't forget to say hi to Tony and Johnette at the shaved Ice stand or great food at Wiapio Cookhouse. Loved all the fresh fruit shared by Greg. Comfortable rooms.
A very comfy bed and the song of the coqui frogs to fall asleep to.

Great location if you want to explore the Waipio valley. The place has everything you need to cook (outside stove, fridge, toaster, microwave, grill, spices) and relax (indoor and outdoor). There were fresh eggs and fruit trees. Greg was flexible with our checkin time and very welcoming. Would definitely stay there again. Bring some mosquito repellent.

Great price, nice people, get to meet people -3 rooms with one communal living room and bathroom. If you are a light sleeper it's not for you. Directly underneath main house. You hear every foot step, you wake up at 6am when the blender goes or  when the baby wakes up. No sleeping in here! Very close to Waipio.

The stay was very satisfactory! It was very nice of Greg to answer my calls prior to the visit and had patiently answered all the questions I had about the Island. We checked in pretty late in the night, and they had still come down to check out on us and made us feel comfortable. We came to the Island for a backpacking trip to Waimanu Valley and Greg had let us park the car for a nominal fee in the premises. Otherwise we would have had to hunt for a space. Everything about this place is perfect, the setting, the location.

ﾎﾉｶｱには泊まる所が少ないので､助かりました｡
壮大なWaipio valleyが近くにあるので､とても楽しみました!
お父さんがとても良い人でもっとお話ししたかったです!またBig islandに来たら､泊まりたいです:-)
The hostel is a perfect location for hiking in the waipio valley and a good place to meet other travelers. I enjoyed my short stay.

Greg's place was just as advertised, and good value for the money.  Be prepared for one bathroom shared with the other guests -- if someone is showering when you need to go, you need to wait!  Cooking is outside, but under cover (we cooked in pouring rain).  There were plenty of left-behind helpful things like spices and oil, and toiletries in the bathroom.  The proximity to Waipi'o is great; there's not much else to do.  We enjoyed picking tangerines and cracking fresh macadamias for breakfast.
This hostel was an easy choice in this rather remote location. Greg is a very kind, accommodating host and the place had plenty of unexpected amenities

What can't I say but views that leave you speechless. Up the road from Waipio valley. get a jeep and drive down it will be a trip in itself. Fresh eggs from the backyard. And a really good vibe. Slept like a baby.
Convenient to Waipio valley.

A very nice room with a huge, soft bed. I really liked the big bathroom with the wooden floor and the outdoor kitchen area where you have a view of the ocean. Greg and his family were very welcoming and helpful. The hostel is really close to the Waipi'o valley. You'll need a car to get to the stores, but also you'll be staying at a very nice, calm and friendly place.

A really nice spot (very close to Waipio Valley) with welcoming & friendly hosts! The outside kitchen, the privacy and the room are great :) 
A charming house, we recommend this AirBnB!
Just one thing, if you are very sensitive to any noise like me (no problem for my girlfriend), this charming old house (1922) may be too noisy.


Bien situé (proche de le vallée de Waipio) avec des hôtes accueillants et gentils ! La cuisine extérieure, l'intimité et la chambre sont géniale :)
Une maison charmante, nous vous recommandons cet AirBnB!
Une petite chose, si , comme moi vous avez des problèmes de sommeil (pas de soucis pour ma compagne), cette charmante vieille maison (1922) peut être bruyante.
This was a great place to stay! Everything was very clearly communicated and organized. The rooms and common spaces were comfortable and very organized. Very close Waipio Valley. Highly recommend!

Great stay! Greg and his family welcomed us with warmth and showed us to the hostel around back. It's nothing fancy, feels like a basement (because it is); but it's got a good shower and shared space, and a great outdoor kitchen overlooking the ocean and yard. The bed was super fluffy, clean and comfortable. We made eggs in the morning that came from their hens. Located a stones throw from the gorgeous waipio valley. We were glad to hang our hats here for the night after a day of exploring the valley! Thanks Greg!

I stayed at the Waipio Hostel for two nights, it was a late booking but Greg accommodated and checked me when I arrived. Room was spacious and the bed was very comfortable, good shower also. 

As the Room is essentially basement level noise is carried over easily through floorboards, but I sleep with ear plugs anyhow so was not a real issue. Everything was as listed and Greg was friendly and polite upon arrival.

And the location is fantastic, Waipio valley short drive away, as is Honokaa for local shops etc. And the Restaurant the Smokehouse is just a short walk away, great food. Would definitely Recommend to others staying here.

Mahalo :)

Great value. Easy check-in. Close to Honokaa and walk to Waipio Valley. Amazing star gazing at night. Amazing backyard with a great view of the ocean. A good way to live like a true Hawaiian. Also walking distance to this terrific farm-to-table restaurant called Waipio Cookhouse, which we visited 3 days in a row.

The stay in Greg and Harmony's home was wonderful. We really enjoyed the possibility to cook our own food since the outdoor kitchen is amazingly great equipped. The room was nice. We enjoyed the neighbourhood right next to Waipio Valley. Communication was perfect!

Everything has been great. One thing is the poor noise isolation that make early mornings noisy when you have kids running upstairs.
The place is beautiful, and close to waipio Valley.
Great place.
Nice place for what it is.  Nothing fancy but gets the job done.

Greg's place was conveniently located in a beautiful setting. Check in was very easy, the accommodation was clean and well set-up for travellers, and Greg was a friendly host. We'd highly recommend this place for anyone looking for a relaxed and comfortable stay in the area. Would love to return some day!

I loved the outdoor kitchen with everything a hosteler could need and the living room area was warm and cozy with a great library. We were invited to pick the fresh fruit and macadamia nuts growing on the property and informed of a great place to eat nearby.

Greg's place was charming and very well set-up for travellers.  We loved the well-equipped outdoor (covered) kitchen, and opportunity to forage fruits from the yard. Bedroom and common areas had nice character and bed was very comfy. Accessible to both sides of the island. Host was prompt with communication. Great stay. Mahalo!
WE loved staying here! Outdoor kitchen was great with many fruit trees and a peaceful view. Greg was very kind and hospitable. Great access to Waipio valley- worth the trek!
It was a very comfortable stay and nothing beats this location. Just Amazing!!!

I would definitely recommend Gregs accommodation. It's a short hike to Waipio Valley and the view from the house, overlooking the ocean is amazing. The kitchen is very well equipped with both kitchen tools, oil and spices. Bathroom was spacious and shower was very good(equipped with shampoo, conditioner and body wash!!). The room was perfect with a big bed and a small open closet. In the garden they have mac nuts, tangerines and avocados and we were allowed to take as much as we wanted! This was the perfect stay and Greg and his family was very welcoming :-)

We are looking forward to our next stay. Quiet, fun, good company, very nice and a lovely change from over -priced,  soul-less commercial hotels.  Peaceful, family atmosphere, very enjoyable. Thanks Greg and family!

The location is perfect if you're heading down into the Waipi'o Valley.  And it's close to the Waipi'o Cookhouse which was an awesome place to eat!  We stayed in the Kai Room and our bed was so comfy and nice, especially after a long day hiking!  Greg was a wonderful host and shared some hiking tips with us for the valley that really came in handy.  Also, the macadamia nuts and tangerines in the yard are wonderful!!!  Remember that you're staying in someone's home and you can sometimes hear the kiddos.  But it wasn't a big deal for us.  The price is terrific, the location is great and the family is wonderful.

Gregs place is pretty much how other reviewers described it. The noise from upstairs is substantial. And it is a basement- there’s a pretty strong mildew smell and quite a few bugs. There is a usable kitchen though the fridge doesn’t seem to do much. On the other hand, the bedroom was reasonably clean and the bed was very comfortable. Greg is a very friendly, laidback, and accommodating host. And the location is great - very close to waipio valley.
Had some good conversations with other fellow travelers, ate some tangerines and macadamia nuts straight off the trees. Overall a very comfortable stay. Highly recommended.
We loved staying at this hostel! Charming location, cute, clean rooms, and awesome hospitality.

Greg's house is very close to Waipio Valley (3 mins drive). We got here at night and Greg welcomed us and lead us to the guest apartments which located at the back of the house. Amenities are good and they has a country vide which I liked! And we were provided delicious breakfast made of home-grown potato. Overall a good place to stop by.

Greg hat uns freundlich begrüßt. Die Outdoorküche ist gut bestückt und der gemeinsame benutzbare Raum ist gemütlich. Wir konnten uns an den Früchten 8m Garten bedienen. Man merkt aber, dass das Haus älter ist und es roch feucht. Außerdem war bereits am Morgen früh um 6 Uhr Betrieb in der Wohnung. Die Wände sind dünn und alles ist hörbar.

great outdoorsy get away!
walls are a bit thin; i could hear other guests in other rooms. 
other than that, great location and great host!

Great location and amazing tangerines and Mac nuts on the property. Had a great night stay after enjoying a local reggae concert nearby and got an early start on visiting the Waipio valley. Definitely recommend.

Totally recommend this place. A cozy and soothing place to stay, with it's outdoor kitchen and wind chimes. We were able to fix a dinner just with food left by other guests and there is free coffee and fruits from the garden. Yes, you do here that Greg and his family live just above, but it did not bother us at all. very close to Waipio Valley Lookout.
Greg has a charming place, so close to Waipio Valley!

Its a great place if you enjoy the outdoors (super close to Waipio Valley).
Greg was very friendly and the check in/out process was very smooth.

Greg's place is incredibly cozy and is a great location for exploring Waipi'o Valley and the surrounding areas. Check in was super easy and the bed was incredibly comfortable. Just a warning for those who need dead silence in which to sleep this may not be the location for you. His family does live upstairs and the ceiling doesn't insulate much of the noise, so you will hear the kids moving around upstairs fairly early in the morning. If you're generally up and about around 7am it shouldn't be much trouble for you at all. We enjoyed our stay here immensely even though it was only for a night. Thanks Greg!
It was a quiet relaxing location and it’s right next to the waipio valley hike so I had a good time.

This hostel was perfectly placed. The bed was so comfy and i sleeved so well here, falling asleep listening to the sounds of the island.  The outdoor kitchen was great, I especially liked having breakfast looking out over the backyard. 

Thank you for having me, I really enjoyed my time!
Lovely hosts, very comfortable bed, great location. A bit too rustic for my taste,  but perhaps in line with hostel expectations.

Waipio Hostel is a extremely cute and practical place to explore Pololu and Waipio from. We especially enjoyed our visit to the Hawaiian Vanilla company which is near by. Everything at this hostel is clean and the bed is very comfortable. Cooking in the outdoor kitchen might be the highlight of the trip for me. You will hear quite a bit of noise from above and the walls between the rooms are quite thin so we could hear the other guests. This hostel is reminiscent of camping for me since it is so open and airy. I would recommend this to others.

We were able to pick fresh avocados, breadfruits, tangerines, Macadamia nuts, etc. straight from the trees and eat them in the outdoor kitchen which was a great plus. Highlights:

Lowlights:

Greg was a kind host. He welcomed us and showed us around the place. He made sure we had everything we needed.

Great location and Greg was super nice and helpful.  

Check out Sea Dandelion in Honokaa.  The food was really, really, good!
Nice place, beautiful property, tasty tangerines. Enjoyed our short stay.

Greg's place was great. very close to Waipio valley and there is wifi! Ate fresh bananas and oranges in the morning. Couldn't of asked for a better place to stay. Thanks!

Greg has a stylish place. The outdoor kitchen is especially awesome

Just remember that you will not be able to travel with any produce to/from the mainland, so enjoy what you can while on the island.

She provided many tourist tips and there's a Kauai book in the condo that we used for hours each day while exploring the island.  Condo is very clean and has everything you need, including beach chairs, an umbrella, beach towels, and boogie boards.  This has been my all-time favorite vacation!  Can't wait to come back :)

Beautiful space. I’m going to miss watching the turtles from the lanai.

name: Funky, Quiet, Safe EV Walk-Up
summary: Our unit is a co-op in an older building, full of diverse, responsible, close-knit folks. The apartment itself is a small two-bedroom, suitable for a couple and child. Not a luxury apartment, but everything you need is here. Including toys.
space: Our apartment is a fourth floor walk-up in a co-op that was rehabbed by it's owners. It has not been made to feel suburban or generic - it's not a 'luxury apartment'. It's plenty of space, a quiet well-lived-in, well furnished place to relax after a day of pounding the pavement or a night on the town.  It's well lit, with one very large and one small bedroom (our six-year-old sleeps there), a bathroom (shower, no tub) and an open kitchen and living room, all with wood floors, some painted, some stained. The building has been a pillar of the neighborhood for many years, and most folks in the building are invested in keeping the area safe, affordable and diverse.  For three adults you can use our spare mattress instead of the kiddo bed.  Linens and towels are yours to use, and you do not need to wash them (though you are welcome to do your laundry in our washer.)

notes: If you rent from us this August, there is scaffolding on the exterior wall of the  building. Work usually starts up around 9 or 9:30 and is over by 4.

I'm a theater artist - 50, mature, non-smoking, easy to get along with. I travel a lot for work - sometimes to teach, sometimes to perform, sometimes to direct a play. I often use AirBnB to save money on housing costs when I go.

neighborhood_overview: Within a few blocks of the apartment, you'll discover the many reasons that Williamsburg has become the global definition of "cool".  At the famous Nitehawk Cinema, you can watch movies while being served brunch. At local coffee shops, like Devocion, Toby's Estate, and Blue Bottle, you can hang out with more hipsters than probably where else in the world. The nightlife is probably Williamsburg's strongest feature, with several excellent cocktail bars nearby (I especially like Hotel Delmano and Maison Premiere), many options for live music, as well as the two best nightclubs in NYC (Verboten and Output). In summer, there's the outdoor foodie market Smorgasburg. There's excellent shopping at unique boutiques: escape the chain stores and global luxury labels that now dominate Manhattan.
transit: The Bedford stop on the L train is a 10 minute walk away. From Bedford, it's 1 stop into Manhattan; you can be in Union Square in 5 minutes.  Most of the major tourist sites are easily accessible. From the Bedford L station, Times Square is about 15 minutes. However, I always recommend that visitors spend as little time as possible in the main tourist areas in midtown, and I'm happy to provide recommendations for the areas where locals hang out.  If you'd prefer not to take the subway, there is a constant supply of Uber cars in the neighborhood, as well as regular New York taxis.
access: In addition to your private area, the apartment also includes a large chef's kitchen with new appliances (perfect for cooking and making tea and coffee), a dining table, and a large sitting area with a high-end sound and entertainment system. There's a washer and dryer in the unit for you to do your laundry free of charge (a rarity in NYC).
interaction: I'll be staying in the apartment's second bedroom, which is on the other end of the floor. I have my own private bathroom.  I love meeting new people and giving my guests recommendations for things to do and see in the neighborhood.
house_rules: Max. 2 people; no babies, please. No smoking permitted. Please respect the neighbors by not making noise very late at night.

The neighborhood couldn´t be nicer and safe and is so close from Bedford Street which is surrounded by an amazing amount of interesting shops and cofees and restaurants, and at a very short walking distance you can get  lane L and in one stop you are in Manhattan!!!

I have mixed feelings on leaving this review, as I intend to stay here in the near future and if I gush too much, there may be no availability.  

I have to say that Andrew was the perfect host (even from Australia) and it was the perfect apartment.  It was sunny and warm during some very cold days and just pleasant to be in a place that was so well furnished and laid out.  The pantry was stocked, there was pour-over coffee and the bed was quite comfortable.  I can't wait to come back!

We really enjoyed staying at Andrews apartment. It was very clean, modern and in a great neighbourhood. We really liked Williamsburg and would recommend staying here when visiting New York! Andrew was really helpful and friendly and kindly let us help ourselves to breakfast! The flat had everything we needed and was nice and spacious.

Andrew ensured I was fully aware of how to enter his apartment and the building. Excellent communication by Andrew post booking, pre arrival and on arrival, in fact he made me feel totally at home. The location is great and close to all the restuarants, bars and public travel facilities. Every picture tells a story! So Andrew's posted photographs are accurate plus some. A great bedroom with ensuite and very very comfortable living room with all the mod cons in the kitchen. Overall a extremely comfortable and worthy experience. Similarly, Andrew is a likeable man who takes pride in his apartment. Five stars and highly recommended.
My second stay at Andrew's apartment in Williamsburg in the last month. Refer to previous positive comments. Nothing changed: still a great place to stay.

Las indicaciones y consejos que dejó sobre el uso del apartamento y  sobre los alrededores nos sirvieron mucho para estar "como en casa". El barrio es espectacular, al igual que el apartamento. Nos dejó una guía con algunos sitios para visitar y mereció la pena. Todo un acierto!!!
Lo recomendamos sin lugar a dudas!!!

Andrew's place is perfect for a short stay in Williamsburg; conveniently located to restaurants, shops, and the subway, it's is a great spot to be if you're looking to be centrally located. 
The apartment is bright, spacious and modern. The room is equipped with a private bathroom and views of a lush courtyard. Set up on the third floor, a good nights sleep is ensured. 
Andrew is around to answer any questions and ensure a comfortable stay. I have only positive reports from my stay at Andrew's apartment, and would certainly recommend to anyone in consideration.

Andrew (as a host) and the apartment are both brilliant. Seriously, just book this place if it is available! 

The room is spacious, clean and has a great ensuite shower room. Kick back in the living room with the fast wifi connection and tv or head to any one of the great Williamsburg cafes just walking distance from Andrew's flat.

The perfect flat for a perfect stay in Williamsburg. I hope to be back!

This place is amazing: Spacious, light, clean and very quiet but still in a great location close to bars, shops, restaurant and the subway. Andrew was a great host, I would definitely book this again :-)

Andrew es un excelente anfitrión, respetuoso de la intimidad de uno y a su vez, bien dispuesto para ayudar ante cualquier necesidad que uno tenga.
Fue nuestra primera experiencia compartiendo hospedaje y la verdad que no pudo haber sido mejor.
El departamento es tal cual se ve en las fotos. Gran tamaño y mucha luz. Muy confortable.
La zona es muy linda si uno busca estar bien cerca de Manhattan y a su vez tener la posibilidad de disfrutar un poco más de tranquilidad. En la esquina está el East River donde se pueden disfrutar los atardeceres y está lleno de lugares para comer, tomar algo,etc.
La distancia al subte es de 7 cuadras aproximadamente. Primer parada de Brooklyn del metro L.
Fue muy flexible con horario de ingreso y salida. Nos dejo dejar todas nuestras valijas en el departamento hasta el momento de irnos al aeropuerto.
Muchísimas gracias otra vez Andrew por todo!
Ciertamente si volvemos sería un alojamiento a repetir!

We had a wonderful stay at Andrew's beautiful home. It really made our trip to Manhattan and Brooklyn even better. Will definitely come back next year! Prime location only 50m away from the Hudson river with great views overlooking Manhattan and 20m away from all the great shops in Williamsburg.

Thank you Andrew:)

Andrew has been such a great host! He was willing to help in anything we needed. It was the first time we shared a place and it has been a super great experience as in NY your're almost never ar home during the day so it was easier! Also... the neighbourhood is super cool with plenty of stores and restaurants and bars. Lots of people specially during weekends. It is also 5 min walf from the metro and from there only a couple of stops to Manhattan. Last, but not least, Andrew is super tidy and he was even worried about a lamp that has been broken by the previous guest and managed to replace it during our stay. The apartment is as it looks in the pictures... super comfy and cool. Thanks Andrew for hosting us in your apartment! Saludos, Gus and Paz.-

The appartement is placed in a hip upcoming area with great views of Manhattan. Lots of cafes and restaurants around. Takes 15min scenic ferry trip to Manhattan. Nicely decorated, quiet apparement. Friendly host.
Great location within 5 mins of subway and ferry. Great coffee shops bars and restaurants. Apartment has all the conveniences you’d need and is very stylishly furnished.

This is the best Williamsburg stay for me. I definitely recommend to stay here instead of tiny, dirty, noisy hotel rooms. 

Andrew is the great host. He is accurate, kind and helpful. 
I have a problem with my lower back but the bed in the room is good enough to support my back. 

I recommend someone who loves cozy Williamsburg life.
Andrew was a wonderful host and his space is perfect. Clean, stylish, best location, and private and comfortable. I’d choose to be here again every time!

Andrew’s apartment is incredibly clean, stylish, and comfortable! It exceeded my expectations! Andrew had everything we needed, including super comfy pillows and cereal for breakfast! He also recommended lots of cool coffee shops, restaurants, and events in the neighborhood. It’s the little things, y’all. The only thing that would make it better would be if it were a little closer to the subway. But I’d stay again!

Clean, stylish, and quiet space in a lively neighborhood. Communication with Andrew was easy and everything was very organized. Perfect for someone who wants to experience Williamsburg or Manhattan with some peace and quiet.
You can expect a clean, stylish, comfortable experience when you stay here. Andrew is very responsive and his apartment exceeds expectations. It was a peaceful place in the middle of a busy city.

We highly recommend this centrally located apartment in the hip Williamsburg section of Brooklyn. Loads of great shops and dining within blocks and a Whole Foods nearby. A nice diversion from the usual Manhattan hotels that are at least twice the price. Andrew’s apartment was clean, stylish, and amazingly quiet at night in a busy city.  There’s a washing machine and dryer, being able to wash clothes was brilliant. We were able to come home with clean clothes. The apartment was stocked with the essentials like, laundry soap, shampoo, body wash, teas, condiments in the fridge. If you were a staying in a hotel, you would only have a mini fridge. We would book this again on our next visit to NYC.

Andrew's place is one of my favorite Airbnb rentals I've ever stayed at. The apartment is clean, stylish, and above all, comfortable. The room and bathroom had everything I needed, and the space is full of thoughtful touches that make you feel perfectly at home, like a Sonos speaker in the bedroom that you can use and extra fluffy pillows. The bed is also the most comfortable bed away from home I've ever slept in. 

Even though technically this rental was for a private room in a shared space, I felt like I had the place to myself and only ran into Andrew once during my four-night stay. Not that I would have minded if we'd seen each other more — he's polite and welcoming, and I felt at ease in his home. The location is excellent; it's about a 10-minute walk to the L-train to get into Manhattan, and the surrounding neighborhood is lined with cool restaurants, bars, and shops. This place is a great value, and I'm glad I stayed there instead of a hotel. Thanks for the hospitality, Andrew!

host.host_about:
Aloha!
Im Sandi, my husband & I are the owners of this condo!  I am retired after 33 yrs of working in Supply Chain Management !  I have been married 48 yrs.  We have three adult sons, two daughter-in-laws and four BEAUTIFUL grandchildren!  I love to travel in my RV, spend lots of time with my family and LOVE being a Grandma!
This condo is our home away from home and I LOVE spending time there and sharing it with others when I'm not!  I take great pride in keeping it nice, comfy and affordable!  (my posted rates INCLUDE Maui's 14.41% tax rate!)
When I come to Kihei I absolutely LOVE spending time outdoors snorkeling, hiking and just enjoying ALL the beauty of the island.  I chose KGE(Kihei Garden Estates) based on it's location and how easy it is to access all the sights of Maui!  We have a very relaxed and non-commercial complex for our guests enjoyment.  I am very proud of my "home away from home" and LOVE sharing it with my guests!!!  Life is a vapor of smoke!  Enjoy every moment with your loved ones while you can!!

reviews.comments: What a find! Cute, nicely-laid-out one-bedroom apartment with everything you need, including a dishwasher, and TVs in both the living room and the bedroom. Ultra clean. Nice big shower. Quiet street, but walking distance to a nice shopping area (housing the excellent Maui Pie Company) and a block from the beach. Highly recommend.

Highly recommend this place if you plan to stay on Maui. The area is very quiet, yet scenic and close to everything. The beach is literally a 20 second walk from the place. Other stores are located near by, very short distance. There are events going on around the area as well at times, so everything is a walking distance from the condo. The condo itself was very comforting and the host provided many things that you need.
There is a beach to watch the sunset right next to it
This condo was much better than the pictures made it look! Very close to the beach and the pool and hot tub were great!
Very clean and updated.  Great location, and just steps away from a beautiful beach.
The place is lovely and cozy, and very spacious. The descriptions are just as described and my family had a wonderful time here.
Wonderful place, close to the beach, quiet and relaxing vacation, hope to be back soon!

We loved staying at Sandi's condo. We appreciated the location, next door to a nice grocery store and a short residential black away from a shallow and sheltered beach. While the condo itself is older, the kitchen, floors, and bathroom have both been updated. The kitchen is fully equipped. The lanai area is semi-private, but the neighbors are very close. It's a non-smoking association, but they do provide a smoking area (it's in the parking lot or you can go off property). The nice thing about that is that you don't have smoke coming into your space. That's especially nice because we had the doors and windows open the whole time we were there. The grounds are groomed and immaculate. I wish that I could tell you about the pool and hot tub, but with the beach so close we never had an occasion to make use of them. Kihei itself has some fun shopping (great quilt shop, Coconut's, craft fair) and plenty of grocery stores to choose from. Sandi also provided beach chairs, a couple of boogie boards, and two beach towels. Since we were there for ten days it was nice to have a second set of bath towels. The washer and dryer were just outside the condo and reasonably priced. We would definitely stay at Sandi's condo again.
Great area, great value, great host. Highly recommended.

Sandi's place is right across the street from the beach, super close to lots of grocery stores and restaurants, and has plenty of parking. Conveniently located to plenty of sights in Maui. All the amenities make staying there very comfortable. Plenty of towels and extras like beach chairs and a cooler. The value is excellent. The bathroom and shower are super clean and our stay was all the better thanks to being at this Airbnb location. Thank you Sandi and Brenda!

Awesome host! Sandi made sure we had everything we needed. Great communication. The place was simple with no frills but very clean and functional. The proximity to the beach was priceless. The grocery store and restaurants were all walking distance.

My three friends and I stayed in Sandi’s place for 10 days and it was amazing! The condo had a bed and a pull out couch and easily accommodated the four of us. Less than a minute walk to the beach and to the grocery store! Very central location and even without a car we found it easy to navigate the island. Very clean and Sandi was quick to reply if we had any issues or questions. Would 100% recommend! Thanks Sandi!

As advertised, Sandi's place is in a great location to explore the island from.  Very clean and check-in was effortless.   The entire complex is well maintained and beautifully landscaped with a nice pool and hot tub area.  I was impressed with the community grill and eating area as well with everything provided to have a group meal grilled on the spot while you and your group enjoy the pool area.

Easy to walk to the beach less than a block away and also walking distance to all kinds of shopping and eating options as well.

We took full advantage of the beach chairs and umbrella that Sandi had available.  Well stocked with bath towels, beach towels and additional linens.

It was so nice to come home from a day of exploring to a clean, central location that was safe and well-stocked with anything we might need.

Thank you Sandi!

I'm a big believer in sharing reviews, so I hope that this will be helpful.  Sandi was very helpful before I booked, answering questions about how her place would be for my disabled son.  (It was great for him.) The place itself was AWESOME -- very high-end kitchen and bathroom finishes. The complex was well-kept, quiet, and we met some incredible people nightly at the pool. The reason I gave it a four instead of a five was because nothing is perfect.  In this case, there were 2 TVs and a DVD player, but only 12 basic channels and 2 old Meryl Street movies in a cabinet.  Bring your own DVDs, or a ROKU, and you'll be set!  Second, a yard or so from the back patio was a 6 foot high Bougainvillea that separated the unit from a somewhat noisy street.  Combined with the patio above and the overhang in front, the unit was a bit dark and didn't have any view at all.  At this price point I found you get either a small ocean view with a crappy interior, or a nice interior without a view, but not both.  So just decide what is most important to you personally.

Thank you Sandi for a wonderful stay in an apartment that was super clean, comfortable and relaxing.  The pool was great and gardens beautiful.  The location was close to everything we needed including shops, restaurants and the local supermarket with the beach a very short walk.   We didn't have a car but the city bus stop was 2 minutes walk away providing us easy access from Wailea to Maalaea Harbour and everything in between.  We really thank Brenda as well for quick responses to the couple of questions we had (we now know what a water sensor alarm is).  Thanks again.
This place was a great place to stay. It was super close to the beach and everything you can hope to do was well within driving distance! We loved it there!

Sandi's place is really great! It's nicely upgraded, super clean. Easy access and closely located to beautiful beach. Everything was as described, very functional and over the top on most everything. Access to shopping, restaurants, and rentals and beach are all in walking distance. I especially liked that her condo is on lower level, no stairs or excessive walking to get to it. I hope I can return to her place. Highly recommend
Loved this place! My husband loved how we could walk to the beach every night for the sunset, and then end our night at the jacuzzi. Excellent!

Would definitely recommend to anyone staying in Maui. Great location close to beach access and pool. Little extras like beach toys and boards for kids. Quiet private patio to relax on with hose to rinse off after a beach visit. Perfect for families or quiet couple get away.
Very nice, clean condo with all the amenities you could need. Great location in  Kihei close to beach, grocery store and many restaurants. I would definitely recommend it!
Awesome stop in Kihei. Fully equipped condo, perfectly clean and situated one minute from the beach, grocery store and a great coffee shop. Thanks Sandi!

Sandi’s place is amazing. It is close to the beach, literally less than a minute walk and a lovely beach is right there for you to enjoy. The place is very clean, has everything you need and we had a blast. We had a great time and would love to go back, just no Hurricane Lane this time. Wishing all the people in Maui a speedy recovery after Lane.
A nice, comfortable place. Enjoyed barbequed dinner at the community bbq's by the pool. Very close to beach and good location for watching sunsets.
Great place to stay!

A really great apartment, super close to the beach, perfect for watching the sun set. Whilst we were there tropical storm Olivia hit but Sandi kept in contact with what to do and to check in we were ok.
The apartment was lovely and clean and a great space to be in after a day of adventures.

Sandi’s condo is in a perfect location with many restaurants and stores near by. There is a beach within walking distance where you can watch the beautiful sunset. The condo is spacious, making it perfect for 4 people. The tenant was great, super easy to communicate with! I would certainly recommend this condo to anyone who is looking to stay on the island of Maui.
Very nice place, better then the pictures, well located. Beach gear appreciated.

Sandi’s place is perfect for a quiet getaway. Easy walk to the beach, a great park with open space and picnic pavilion just a mile down the road. Well appointed and great for a two week stay away from the crazy tourist resorts. We would love to come back and you will too

Sandi's condo is a great place to stay.  The complex is smaller and away from the more crowded Kam beaches.  Perfect beach within just a few steps from the condo - super easy access.  Condo is convenient to pool as well.  Grocery store and Azeka shopping center are just a 3 minute walk and post office is right around the corner.  Sandi provides beach chairs, shade umbrella and plenty of pool/showering towels.  Sandi was also VERY quick to respond to inquiries - all in all, a GREAT experience and highly recommended

This condo was the perfect place for a week in Hawaii for our young family. We were close to everything. The outdoor kitchen in the pool area was clean and beautiful and the pictures here just don’t do the space justice. Thank you Sandi and Brenda!

host.host_about:
ALOHA and WELCOME to Waikiki, Honolulu on Oahu!  Thank you for your interest in one of our vacation rentals.  We are a TEAM of professionals who manage individually owned condo apartments for the owners when they aren't using them within several different condo / hotel buildings in Waikiki.   We offer a range of accommodations types from small studio apartments (with or without kitchenettes) to 2 bedroom residences with full kitchens.  

We want your stay to be an enjoyable one and finding the right match for you is key.  As a general guideline, there are many different types of buildings and hotel-type of arrangements.  For those doing Hawaii on a budget, studios offer the best of both worlds providing a clean, private place to stay within walking distance to the BEACH at affordable prices (vary for upgrades, views, cooking abilities).   For those looking for nicer or larger accommodations, then you should target $150/night off season to $250/night peak season (vary for upgrades, views, cooking abilities, building amenities, parking included).  If you are looking for an Ocean-front experience, then target $350- $400/night and for a luxury experience, $500 to over $1000/night.  Hawaii offers something for everyone at every price point!  

Our vacation rental units are privately owned and managed.  We offer an alternative to the hotel experience allowing our guests to “live like a local” in paradise whether be for a few days, a few weeks or a few months.  Our units are well maintained, repaired when necessary and treated routinely with pest control services.  We try not to interrupt our guests during their stay, and if the unexpected happens, we do our best to resolve it quickly with the least inconvenience to our guests.   Upon arrival, we try to meet all our guests personally to register, check-in, and answer any questions.  And if you’re running late don’t worry, we can make arrangements no matter the hour and register you in the office the next day.  

Stop by our real estate office, ground floor of Kuhio Village.  We are there daily to assist and share this incredibly beautiful island, local eateries, activities and entertainment found in Waikiki and around the island.  We look forward to hosting you in one of our vacation rental units and helping to make your stay a fantastic one.  A hui hou (until we meet again)!

Aloha & Mahalo nui loa (Hello/Goodbye & Thank you very much),
Hawaii Dream Realty Team, Hi’ilani, Luise & Theresa
Hawaii Dream Realty LLC RB-19373, Theresa Harden PB (R) RB-19372

Everything was great. The host was available to meet me at last notice and was accommodating with providing a much needed iron (for evening wardrobe).  Also, once messaged Louise would reply right away which was helpful. We had a very clean and nice room plus an amazing pool available to us. Downtown was just going out of the building. The location is also really great, since it's super close to waikiki beach and all the good food.
Professionals.  Great communication and great apartment !

When we arrived Hawaiian Dream A A rep from Hawaii Dream  Realty was sure to greet us upon our arrival at the airbnb. The building is centrally located and is very close to the Sheraton, Dukes and Sky Waikiki; however, the room is a much older unit. We actually had some issues with the water upon arrival. After a lengthy flight from the East Coast we were looking forward to a shower, but to our unortunate surprise the water was brown. In addition, we noticed that the blinds above the AC unit had gaps. We were concerned about mosquitos getting in. We brought both of these concerns to our Hawaii Dream Realty rep and she went out of her way to try to find us somewhere else to stay. Luckily they own several units and they were able to place us in another room until the water issue was fixed (we would have to just deal with the blinds). However, the room they moved us to (temporarily) only had one bed. We had specifically chose the original room because it offered two double beds for the three adults that would be staying. Our 3rd friend was taking a later flight so Hawaii Dream Realty offered us the smaller room for the time being. The water was a major concern so we took the smaller room. They told us that it was technically an upgrade because it was a newer unit. It must be said again that they did make efforts to be as accommodating as they could be; however, we were paying for a room for three adults. After being moved back to the original unit (water issue resolved), we mentioned this to Hawaii Dream Realty; but they offered no additional compensation because they said that they had to cover cleaning costs for the alternate room that they provided. We accepted the situation, but it had not been our fault that the displacement occurred in the first place and this was slightly bothersome. The room that we returned to after two days continued to provide some unpleasant surprises. The last two days we were visited by 3 cockroaches which probably got in through the blinds since we saw one on the balcony one evening. We were careful not to leave food out and were pretty clean since we spent minimal time in the room besides bedtime and showers. Also, the building had only one functioning elevator during our stay so we always needed to leave extra early to account for the amount of time it took for the elevator to get to us. There’re 4 big pluses and 4 minor minuses that I’ve noted during my weeklong stay at this property-
 
Starting off with the big pluses:
1. Location: the location of this property can’t be beaten. It’s within minutes of walk to the Waikiki shopping plaza, International Marketplace, Waikiki beach, and popular eateries such as Marukame Udon, Marugo Brothers, Masubi Cafe, etc. There’s a Cajun shrimp restaurant right on the first floor of this apartment as well!
2. Free parking: since we rented a car for our vacation, having a designated parking spot in the apartment definitely saved us a lot of money and hassle.
3. Responsiveness: the property manager was extremely responsive to my messages and always responded to my inquiries quickly.
4. Good AC unit: the air conditioning in the room was good and reliable, which was essential for the tropical weathers of Honolulu.

Now onto the minor minuses:
1. Intermittent WiFi: we had trouble with the WiFi as soon as we checked in. When we called the property management office, we were given the phone number of the cable company and was asked to call them ourselves. I was a little put off by this. In my mind, this should be something that is resolved by the property owner, especially since we were not even the account holder and did not have the authority to call and inquire about WiFi services.
2. Clogged kitchen sink: we found the kitchen sink to be clogged during our check in. The property manager offered to have a handyman to come and fix it. But since we didn’t want to deal with the hassle, we declined the offer.
3. Shower temperature: the water temperature in the shower fluctuated a lot. The water got hot really quickly, but sometimes would turn lukewarm or cold for no reasons.
4. Check in process: in my check in instructions, I was asked to call 10 minutes before my arrival at the apartment so someone could come and hand me the keys. Well, I called 15 minutes ahead of my arrival, but still ended up waiting another half hour upon my arrival before someone showed up to give me the keys. A half hour wait was painstakingly long when you had two screaming 2yo toddlers in the car.

All in all, we had a great stay at this property despite the small inconveniences. If the property manager can get on top of the negatives that I’ve mentioned, this could easily become a 5-star experience for us.

This place is located on the 21st floor of the Marine Surf complex. It's in an amazing location... right in the heart of Waikiki. There are so many shops and restaurants within walking distance. You're also practically next door to the International Marketplace. Sure, Waikiki is super touristy, but we were tourists, and the sheer number of quality dining options were overwhelming. It also had an excellent view from the balcony (especially the sunrise!).

The room was well-stocked and the instructions, while strict, are to the point and easy to understand (check out procedures, wifi, laundry, garbage, etc). We never needed to contact the hosts because the instructions were so thorough. 

A couple things to note:
- You must remove your own trash before you leave. There is a refuse chute on each floor that you can dump your trash down.
- If you stay here, make sure you remember to remove your shoes before walking into the main living space. There is a basket by the door reminding you to do so.
- Despite being on the 21st floor, you can still hear the drunken hollering and "whoo girls" from the Seaside Bar & Grill across the street at night. It didn't bother us (sounds of the city), but just something to keep in mind.

Would definitely stay here again!

The location of this condo was amazing - right in the heart of all the action (great restaurants, shopping, Waikiki beach, etc.). We were so happy to return home here every night after long days of exploring the island. Could hear noise from the streets below until about 10pm but it quieted down significantly after that. We had a 2-door Jeep Wrangler and were able to fit it in the parking spot with no problems. The condo itself was good - very spacious, decent bed, nice decor. The air conditioning unit was extremely loud so we had to shut it off at night to sleep, although the evenings were so cool that we didn’t really need air conditioning anyways. Our biggest complaint was that the hosts did not provide enough toiletries to last us for our 8-night stay - we ran out of paper towels, Kleenex, shampoo and conditioner. Definitely would have been nice to be provided with more of these basic necessities. Overall a great choice if you’re looking for an exciting and conveniently-located place to stay.
Super great location. Right in the center of Waikiki.
Great location, very clean studio over all, enjoyed our stay here. Thank you!

位置非常棒,逛街相當方便
還有免費停車場
公寓本身較舊,走廊稍微陰暗,但房源內部裝潢新穎
小建議 燈再明亮一些會更棒!
Great location without a doubt! Clean, safe, and welcoming place stay. Would definitely use Lei Hawaii's place in the future.

My husband and I had a wonderful stay! Exactly as pictured. Beautiful and clean. Others complained about the AC unit. It was perfect, not different than any other AC units. Did not hear much noise either. It’s centrally located. Everything was amazing! We are coffee drinkers so the only negative I can think of is the coffee machine. That machine has got to go. We enjoyed breakfast on the lenai every morning. Just perfection!

Our stay in Hawaii was really enjoyable and the place was very much in line with what we expected from what was posted on the website. The free parking was an amazing benefit and the value we got was really tough to beat! We wanted a car so we could get out of Waikiki when we wanted to, not having to pay for parking, and knowing our car was secure was great. Location is very close to the water and a short walk from anything worth going to in Waikiki. You could definitely stay here and not need a car at all. We definitely recommend staying here, and will look out for this place when we return.

Thank you for our stay! The location was fabulous for dining shopping and the beach! The condo is decorated in modern minimalist style-which we found relaxing. Although we had a car, we loved walking to Waikiki beach to see the sunrise, surf, eat and repeat. Due to all of the food options around we didn't do much cooking but if you would like to cook there are adequate kitchen supplies. This is a modest accommodation in a great location-which is in the heart of the action so it is a little busier. We were visiting from a small town so we enjoyed the all the people and enery! P.S. You will love the bidet-trust me! I can no longer live without one!  I would definitely visit again!

This is our second time staying with Lei Hawaii and we loved it! The place was clean, just like in the pictures. Location was amazing. Would definitely recommend anyone visiting Hawaii to book with them. We had a fantastic time!
Great location, clean place in a nice building. The parking spot is a bit tight so don't try to park there with a big vehicle, but it's great that there is parking at all. Recommended.
Central location and clean apartment.

The Marine Surf Waikiki is conveniently located on the corner of Seaside & Kuhio Ave. All the restaurants & shopping are within walking distance. 

The unit itself was clean & cozy. It had fresh linens, bath towels, plenty of toilet paper, a/c unit, cable tv, WiFi, and dishes if you want to cook. 

The parking was a big deal for me as it becomes difficult & expensive in Waikiki. The unit has one spot in the parking garage and although the spot was in the corner and was somewhat tight, it wasn’t a big deal. 

All in all, the unit was comfortable for myself, my wife, and infant daughter. Having everything nearby was great.
Clean and cozy space right in the heart of waikiki! would definitely book again!

This condo was exactly what we were looking for. Walking distance to all the shops, restaurants and Waikiki beach. Condo had a great view, clean and the building was safe. Would definitely stay here again.
Great stay. Unlike other Airbnb, this place had extra towels for us and our baby.

great location with great views over Waikiki to wards beaches and towards the mountains from both end of building balcony and having the pleasure of watching the Hilton fireworks from the 21st floor balcony made our evening.
I loved stay here! super good location, nice neighbor and complementary parking place. We would definitely stay again when we back to Hawaii.
A very nice trendy spot in the heart of Waikiki and near everything!!! Super recommended place!

The place is clean and has a nice view. Everything was pretty easy. We loved our time there. If you don’t like noises this is not a quiet area, but the location is great. It is walkable distance to everywhere in Waikiki.
素敵なお部屋です!立地もよく､満足!!
The apartment is super clean and very close to the beach and many good restaurants. We enjoyed the trip very much!
