reviews.comments: Great host! Excellent view and value, I've stayed at many AirBNB locations in Waikiki, and this is one of my favorites!
I enjoyed the apt very much. it was exactly how it was described. Super clean and tidy. Very comfortable.

This was an amazing place to stay in. The view was beautiful, the location was perfect because it was close to the beach and other places we wanted to check out. Even tho we didn't get a chance to meet with Sean, he was very helpful whenever we had any questions. Definitely would love to come back!

Sean's place was amazing! It was clean, great location with good restaurants in the lobby and also amazing views of the ocean and Waikiki. Sean was also very easy to reach for verifications and other information. Our stay at this was great and I would highly recommend it. I would definitely stay here again :)
Great little studio in waikiki. Next to Waikiki Brewing Company which is great for beers and food. Walk to the beach is about 15 minutes but very easy. Nice place, clean and nice.

Loved this studio in Waikiki!  Sean's place has been renovated and is modern, clean and perfect for two people.  The building itself feels a bit run down but it was great to step into such an awesome apartment with great views.

Parking is available in the building for $25 per day (cash only).  Two beach towels are provided.

Sean was super responsive and can't thank him enough for making check-in and out very very easy.  We enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend to anyone!
The description is pretty accurate. It's very clean and overall a great place to stay! I'll definitely book again whenever I'm back in the area for vacation.
I loved staying here during my time in Hawaii. The room is very neat, and there was plenty of room for my stuff. Not to mention the great view :)
The studio was perfect for what I needed for the week. He had the place equipped with dishes, WIFI, bedding, towels, etc...Very clean and simple place perfect for 1-2 people.

My husband and I really enjoyed our stay here. It's perfect for 2 people. The room is really beautiful and the view is great.

As a different reviewer stated the hotel/condo complex itself is a bit run down, but once you enter the room, you forget about the rest. The room is so nicely decorated and the view is the best. I wouldn't even worry about the rest. 

There are plenty of places to eat nearby that you could walk to. There are also a few eateries on the lobby level. There is a place called "burger and sushi" that I suggest you go to if you're looking for a really quick bite. There is also a nice brunch spot downstairs.

Sean was easy to communicate with and did a great job hosting us. When we first came in our key card wasn't working, but we called Sean and he quickly dealt with it. 

All in all, it's a great place, not too far or too close to all the touristy things in Waikiki!

Awesome room, just enough for the two of us. Had a hard time leaving the view. The complex had great places to eat, and we were able to get good use out of the hot tub and pool. Perfect place to unwind or just stay in and enjoy. We're hoping we'll be back soon! Thanks again for everything, Sean!

The stay at Sean's place was great! Very convenient, close from bus station, walking distance from alamoana shopping center as well as Waikiki area. The room was clean and the view from the room was splendid.
He is super helpful responsive and accommodated us at the last minute when we needed a place to stay.

Sean was great! Very communicative all the way through. The apartment was super clean, comfortable, and a great way to spend our 8 nights in Honolulu. The building was close enough to everything and felt safe and secure. Would definitely stay here again! Thanks Sean!!
Amazing stay! Sean's place is perfect & very close to Waikiki beach / shops. Sean was very responsive and the place is equipped with everything you may need. Loved it, we will definitely be back !

Sean was great this was a last minute trip and my husband and I felt confident booking with Sean. The complex is a bit "transitional"  but Sean's place is clean and updated. 2 min walk to a local brewery and less than a mile from Waikiki beach. Thanks Sean!
Sean was very easy to communicate and willing to accommodate early check in. We enjoyed the stay. Highly recommended this place for visitors!

The studio was just as pictured. Very clean and simple. Great view, good AC, and comfortable bed. Sean was flexible with our schedule, which was extremely helpful. It was 10-15 minutes to walk to the beach, and there are markets nearby to grab some groceries. Overall a great rental and host.

Great location if you want to stay out of the hustle and bustle of Waikiki, we were able to walk about 15 mins and be in the centre of everything which was cool. 
The apartment is quite small and basic. It has been renovated and looks exactly as the pictures show.
The apartment was very nice- clean, convenient, with a really great view.  You have a great panorama of Waikiki with the ocean in the background.  It was good value and very pleasant.

Sean's place is lovely, it is clean and nicely decorated. It is also centrally located to great shops and restaurants. The view is wonderful. Sean was attentive and quick to respond to any questions or concerns I had. I would recommend staying here. Thank you Sean!

As first time visitors to Hawaii, this place is great!  My sister & I loved it!  It is clean, modern, safe & the location was perfect for us as most places we wanted to visit/see/check out, were all within walking distance.

Sean is an awesome host - great & efficient communication.  Also helped us check in earlier than normal due to arriving at 6.30am - we were very appreciative of this!

I recommend this place to anyone & would not hesitate to stay here again.

Mahalo Sean!
一般般吧,可以看出房东是用了心要做得比较有逼格,可是毕竟是民宿,和酒店没法比啦,图片看着不错,实际会打折扣,相对来说价格也是偏贵的~

The studio was perfectly located within walking distance of all major shopping, nightlife, and the beach. Sean's place was just as pictured, spacious yet a cozy home warmth to it. With a backdrop of Diamond head for sunrise, waikiki beach during the day, and a great view of city lights in the evening. We had everything we needed to cook a Thanksgiving meal, which made everything feel more like home. This space was perfect. Sean was a great host and was very accommodating to our needs. Highly recommended if you are visiting or just want a getaway in town for a few days as we did.

Sean was a great host. The studio isn't big but it is modern and minimalistic, has everything you need and enough space to be comfortable. I really liked that the shower was a stand up and not in a tub.

My younger sister and I recently travelled to Hawaii for the first time and had the pleasure of staying at Sean's place. Sean was very accommodating to us (even organising a slightly early check in for us given our 6am arrival!) The apartment is in a great spot - walking distance to both Waikiki Beach and Ala Moana. It's a little further back from the beach which ended up being fantastic for us because you're just outside of the chaos but close enough to stroll to the beach/bars/restaurants. Will definitely stay again on future visits!

The place is perfect for one person or couple staying in Honolulu. I stayed in this place for a couple of days in the city and really enjoyed this place. It was comfortable, very clean. The check in process was easy and painless.
Great position

Perfect little apartment! Has everything you need for a few days stay, and in easy walking distance from bars and restaurants. 
Thanks Sean!

The appartment was a great place to stay at, very clean and the whole building is very secure as only registered guests get access. The view you have Out of your window is amazing, you can see the sea, the City and diamonds Head.everything you Need is very close by, ie shops, restaurants , laundry (inside building) , shopping. We had a rental car With which all the beautiful spots can be reached within half an our.
Sean was a Great host enabling us to have the best Time in beautiful Hawaii. We highly recommend Sean and his appartment! 
Thanks for everything, Sean! 
Michel & Danny
Exactly as described

Place was very accommodating, location is great, Sean was also very good in communications. The unit included basically everything we needed which is amazing.  The downsides are that the washer and dryer is on a different floor and requires coins, the AC is also noisy when on energy saving mode, changing it to cool mode keeps it on so we recommend that for overnight. Overall a great unit and would recommend to anyone.

Sean's place is in a great location.  I was here for a conference and it is walking distance to the convention center, as well as walking distance to shops, restaurants, and the beach in Waikiki.  The condo was clean with all the necessary amenities, and has a great view (from the 29th floor)!  I would highly recommend anyone to stay Sean's place.

Sean was an amazing host. He was very attentive. Details provided for check-in was specific and easy to follow. The room met and exceeded my expectations. Very clean and humble home. View was great, I was able to see the ocean and mountains from the high-floor view. All the necessary amenities were provided. There was even water and coffee in the room. i would highly recommend Sean's place to family and friends. On my next visit to Hawaii, I will be booking again with Sean.

숙소를 들어갈 수 있는 방법은 딱 이틀전에만 알려줍니다. 몇박을 하던 타올은 한사람당 빅사이즈 타올 한개만 제공되어 말려서 사용해야합니다.
침구에서 대체적으로 깨끗하지만 
덮는 이불에 먼지가 굉장히 많이 붙어있습니다.  
거리는 와이키키에 걸어갈 만한 위치이며 야경이 좋습니다. 더버스 정류장은 생각보다 가깝지 않습니다.
Sean's place is nice and clean. About a 5-10 minute walk to the ocean. 15 mins from Waikiki Beach. Thanks for a great stay!
Great location and very clean. Perhaps if there were at least a pot or pan for guest to use that would make the kitchen + stove a lot more useable.

His house is really nice. The view is awesome. You can see the river and the beach. And Sean answered quickly.
창 밖에 강이랑 바다가 한 번에 보여서 좋습니다. 그리고 답변을 빨리 해줘서 좋았습니다.

Location, location, location. This is a great value for the location. By stay here, you are within walking distance to all the key areas within Waikiki. A plus - the view from Sean's unit was stunning.

The building offers parking at $25 a day (a bit steep, but understandable), and we never had an issue with finding a spot. It was also very easy to navigate to.

My only recommendation is to pack a pillow and toiletries. To be expected, there were no toiletries in the unit; I was happy to have packed my own. In addition the bed pillows were thin and felt like a low-cost Ikea brand. If you have any preferences on the way you like to sleep, I suggest packing your own pillow. 

Overall, I highly recommend this spot for the traveler looking for a great location to cost/value ratio.

Thanks for letting us get the most of the stay in Honolulu!

Absolutely loved Sean's place. The apartment was very close to the Honolulu conference center (the reason for my visit), but also close to the beach and downtown Waikiki. The view is amazing! The apartment was very clean/well-decorated, and Sean was very quick to answer any of my questions. Beach towels were also provided, which I thought was very considerate.

Beautiful pick! The location is great, the view from the 29th floor was wondeful. The apartment was exactly as described and clean. Everything is in walking distance (e.g. Waikiki Beach ~15min.) Sean was very communicative and friendly. Onsite parking is expensive but i never had an issue finding a spot along the Ala Wai Canal. I would definitely stay again on future visits and recommend Sean and this apartment to anyone. Mahalo!

The unit is close to everything. Eveything is clean and decorated with taste. Kitchen is equiped with the minimal cooking tools but has enough to cook with. Sean was kind enough to accomodate us with a let checkout. Communication with him was really easy!
This place was awesome, the view was better than the pictures. I would definitely book with Sean here again if I'm staying in honolulu again!
This place what definitely what we were hoping for for our stay! The views were amazing! Very centrally located to all of the activities in Honolulu/Waikiki.
Sean was a great host! Extremely communicative, response and accommodating.

This is a great comfortable and cozy place to stay for couples or individual travelers. The place is nicely remodeled, bright, clean and has a beautiful view of the canal and the ocean. It also has all the usual appliances, accessories and utensils for cooking, eating, showering, towels for the beach, etc. Wifi and cable is provided. Check in and check out is super easy. You can't go wrong staying here. Sean is a great host too. He's quick to respond! Thanks!
Great location, easy check in. Parking is a bit expensive $25 per day. Clean room, great air conditioning and comfy bed.
Perfect place to stay in Waikiki! Nice view, close to the beach and all main attractions. We would recommend it to anyone.

My wife and I had a wonderful stay at Sean's condo. The pictures are accurate, the place is very clean, and the view is incredible! The beach and ABC stores are all in walkable distance. We would certainly stay again!
A decent compact studio apartment within walking distance of the beach and all the shops/restaurants of Waikiki. On site parking and gym are both available and easy to arrange. Would recommend.
I had a wonderfull stay in this flat that is very lightfull and with a great view over waikiki's skyline ! Communication with sean was perfect.

The place is in a great location with lots of food and shopping options within walking distance. Everything was clean and having a kitchen definitely was a bonus. Would definitely recommend this place to any friends or family looking to go to Waikiki!

Sean's place was perfect for my trip to Oahu! As others have mentioned the building is a bit outdated but the unit itself is newly remodeled and feels clean and modern. Building was safe. The space is small and the bed is a full which is perfect for 1 person, maybe 2. Parking is $25. Check in was simple, and communication with Sean was quick and easy. Location is perfect if you want to explore Waikiki as well as the rest of Oahu. Room has beautiful views of Diamond Head and Waikiki beach. I would definitely recommend Sean's place for anyone traveling to Oahu on a budget. I know I will be back!

The place looked exactly like the pictures posted. It was very nice, clean, conveniently close to the places we wanted to get around in Waikiki &  Ala Moana Center, and the perfect amount of space for two! Also, very fast and easy communication with Sean. I would definitely recommend his place and would come back and stay at his Air Bnb again!
this is a good place!

We enjoyed our stay. The place is updated, clean and spacious. The kitchen is equipped with everything you might need. TV has Netflix and radio. The view is amazing, especially at night. The window being open the place is breezy and never hot, so we end up turning off the  conditioner. There are buzy streets below, so traffic buzz is unavoidable, still nothing extra, easy to get used to. Lots of good places to eat and close to the beach. The walk to the beach is short and nice as you can walk through Hilton Hawaiian Village with ponds and waterfalls. The host is great and responsive. We would most definitely stay again.
Great location!   We were easily able to walk to the beach and shops! Awesome studio apartment.  Sean was very easy to communicate with.
Sean's place was exactly as pictured, clean, tidy, and great location. Pool area was also great. Would definitely stay here again!
The place is clean and just as depicted. Fridge works. Kitchen works. Everything alright.
Perfect, well kept, comfortable space for one or two people! Convenient location and awesome communication with the host! Highly recommend amd would definitely use again! :)
Sean's place was nice and clean with a lovely view.  It was about a 10minute walk to central Waikii but there is some places to eat that are very close.

We had an amazing time during our anniversary trip to Hawaii.  It was a great apartment that had everything we needed for our week long vacation in Paradise. Our host was very responsive and helpful, we really appreciated it. It was a great location about a 10 minute walk from the beach and near great restaurants, would highly recommend!
Amazing view and 10 minute walk from the beach. Was a great place to stay!

My boyfriend and I stayed at Sean's place for a week and it was the perfect home away from home! The room was clean, bed was comfy, and spacious! Walking distance from the Waikiki strip and beach. Communication came easy with Sean and didn't need much help getting in/out of the room. Would definitely stay again!
Sean's place was great! Awesome location, very clean and easy instructions, we couldn't of hoped for better!

Great location. Apartment was clean and tidy and was perfect for what we were after. Short walk to the start of the main strip (5 minutes) and short walk to the beach (5-10 minutes). Would definitely stay here again. Sean was great, very responsive and easy to talk to, which made staying in Waikiki a lot easier.
We had a excellent stay at Sean's studio. Very convenient location and nice view of diamond head. The ac was wonderful and much needed in the hot climate. Communication with Sean was flawless.

The place felt a little smaller than advertised, but I guess they're all like that especially in Honolulu. Other than that we had a great stay. The view and nearby beach is amazing and Sean was very responsive. Would come back.

Sean's place was great! Such an incredible view both up the canal towards diamond head and over to the ocean at Waikiki. Only a 10 minute walk into the centre of Waikiki, also had air con, and great facilities (bathroom, TV, kitchen, oven/stove, microwave), Netflix was also a huge bonus. Such a cute little unit and a great view, would stay here again.
Все очень чисто, удобно, хорошее местоположение. У нас не было никаких проблем во время проживания. Всем советую арендовать жилье у Шона!
Great place with a surprise view of the ocean and Diamond Head! Really tidy, new and easy check-in and communication. Would definitely recommend and stay again.
Vraiment beau! Ca sent bon! Très centrale! Près de tout! Nous circulions beaucoup avec Biki et The Bus! Je recommande à 100%!!!!
좋았어요

Good location. Strange building, good unit. Simple unit. No top sheet (Sean dropped one off once requested) AC was loud and blasts at your head when sleeping if you have it on, which is needed due to the heat. Host was a good communicator initially, but not after I had to leave unexpectedly.
Wonderful stay, it’s really central to some of Hawaii best hidden gems and has the most fantastic view.
The place is clean, has a great view, and walking distance to everything in Waikiki. Sean was a great host and shared some helpful tips. Would definitely stay here again.
Great location with a great view.

The apartment was much better than the pics. The locations was perfect and nice views of the river and the sea. Cosy place and also the location, you can walk to Waikiki Beach in less than 10min and also Ala Moana Centre! Sean was a great host and responding quickly my messages. Would definitely stay here again. Something I didn't espected was the beach towels, I forgot completally to bring mine and I was thinking to buy one and he had two there already.

100% I recommend Sean's place.

Place was as advertised. Easy access and very central to everything, restaurants and shopping area. 

Only negatives - Staffers in the building are not pleasant and at times rude. The A/C unit is loud for those light sleepers, and water pressure in the shower was weak on the last two days of our stay. Wish we had more than two towels for bathing and beach . Albeit, building did have washer/dryer however do need to pay for it. 

During our stay, building at water system maintenance so they shut off the water. Apparently this is once a month. We were out and about so it didn't impact us. 

Other than issues noted, good location.

Sean's place was exactly as described. We didn't want to rent a car while staying in Waikiki and his place was in a perfect location! It is close to restaurants, the beach, and convenient stores. It was about a 15 minute walk to the beach. The view from the room is amazing too! This was our first Airbnb and it was an amazing experience!

10 minute walking distance to Waikiki beach, great view of the canal, clean stylish room. What else do you need?
Hope to stay here in the near future.

Sean's place was great for our week in Oahu. The apartment was clean and we really enjoyed the wifi, Netflix and air con. The only down fall of our stay was the other guests staying around us, as we had a bit of noise a few nights. All and all Sean was a great communicator and we had an awesome time!

Sean's place was exactly like the images - perfect space for one or two people! I loved the decor and the kitchen amenities. Location was within a walkable distance to Waikiki Beach and pretty central. The apartment was everything we needed!
This place was great! Very clean and cosy. Close to the beach (10 min walk) and tons of shopping and restaurants. Sean was very accessible and easy to communicate with.  Thanks Sean :)
Great view over Waikiki. Check-In was easy. Apartment was clean and had everything you need for your stay.

I really loved the location. You look out the window at night and your surrounded by lights. Waikiki beach is just walking distance away. Sean gave us very clear instructions for check in which made it a breeze to get to the room. We only stayed in our room when we were sleeping since we were always out and about but it was a very great place. Highly recommend it!
Thank you so so much.

Sean’s place was great! Convinient location with everyone we needed. Everything was within walking distance and Sean was easily accessible via phone. It was easy for parking since it was within the building - worth the $25 bucks since we didn’t have to uber anywhere unless we went out of Waikiki!

Beautiful view!  Definitely a great place to stay on a budget. Close to shops and the beach.  I’ll echo what others have said - the air conditioner is a bit loud, but wasn’t a problem for us. Water pressure in the the shower a bit low. Clean room and well styled.
Great space, great view.  We stayed with our 22 month old son. Perfect amount of space central location. Clean and updated suite that had everything we needed!
Nice apartment with a great view, walkable to all of Waikiki’s attractions (if you don’t mind ~10 minutes of walking). Parking was straightforward too.

You can use Netflix. And laundry is 5th floor. Shower water strength can not control. Its weak to us. And we got 2 body towet for  3 days. And 2 beach towel. Location is good to rent car. Air conditioner sound is little loud. But its good condition.

We enjoyed the central location of this property.  There is a good coffee and breakfast sandwich (crossiant, streaky bacon, eggs and cheese) bakery in the lobby.  The Seven Eleven is next door.  Loved the views from the property.  The Air con is loud but we were grateful for having it :).  Netflix was a great addition.  We did nightly strolls along the Waikiki strip.  It is about a 15 min walk.  Ala Moana Mall is closeby. The property is good value.

Notre séjour de 4 jours dans le studio de Sean était super.  Il est propre et très bien localisé dans le quartier de Waikiki.  Il se trouve à environ 15 minutes de marche de la plage de Waikiki et est entouré d'une multitude de restaurants et de boutiques pour tous les goûts.  On a même une très belle vue sur la ville et on peut même voir l'océan à partir de la chambre du 29e étage.  La communication avec Sean était facile.  Pour les 2 derniers jours, nous avons loué une voiture pour visiter un peu plus le reste de l'île.  Nous aurions pu prendre le stationnement à 25$/jour, parce que ça n'est vraiment pas facile de stationner dans Waikiki, mais nous avons choisi de stationner un peu plus loin et nous trouvions des stationnements, avec un peu de difficulté, dans un rayon de 1,5km.  La seule chose que nous pourrions reprocher, c'est que la description de l'appartement disait qu'il y avait une cuisine pour se faire à manger, ce qui est vrai, mais nous n'avions pas vu dans la description qu'il n'y avait pas de grille-pain et de machine à café, alors que, selon moi, une cuisine fonctionnelle devrait avoir ces éléments à la base.  Il y a tout de même une pâtisserie, qui sert aussi du café, dans l'immeuble... ça dépanne.  Malgré ce petit détail, je recommande le studio de Sean, parce que c'est un excellent rapport qualité-prix dans Waikiki.

The room was the perfect size for just my wife and I, perfect for any couple looking to explore. It didn’t have much in the room other than WiFi and a television which is all we needed for the minimum time we stayed in the room each day as we explored the trails and the entertainment around. The room was clean and had everything we needed, Sean thought about everything, would gladly stay there again

Great place with an amazing view of Waikiki. Very convenient location and the option of parking came in handy. Quick responses from Sean to our questions. Thanks for a great stay we loved exploring the island.

Loved this studio apartment. Perfect size for 2 people. The bed is full size and there is no couch. What you see is what you get. Sean kept in contact when necessary and was prompt to respond. Waikiki was a busy beautiful city and Sean’s place is close to all. Definitely recommended! We’ll be back soon! Mahalo :)
This place was perfect! Beautiful view of Waikiki, clean, fun and stylish!!

We did not enjoy our stay here and I would not recommend this place. 

Good: clean, bed was comfy, location is close to beach and other popular areas downtown, AC worked well, nice pool and hut tub

Bad: shower did not work and I had to fix it for it to run properly upon our arrival, shower curtain rod will fall down during your shower, they give you a broom but no dust pan? No oven mit! No baking pan! No toaster?! Are you kidding!? Smallest frying pan possible provided (big enough for 3 eggs), AC VERY loud beside bed, many police calls in the area, no beach gear provided, building was old and smelly (compared to other places in the area), only 2 pillows provided, not enough towels

We loved this place for the price! The location was great and in the middle of everything. The only issue we had was the parking for $25 a day and the loud AC right next to the bed but I believe that comes with almost any unit you’ll rent since it’s so hot in Hawaii. The hosts were fairly quick on their responses and very kind. Loved having a microwave and a refrigerator for the nights we cooked in or needed to keep something cool. Wayyyy better than a hotel!!!

Exactly as pictured in the photos. A couple minutes walk from the main strip so relatively quiet area. Very responsive and easy check in instructions. No issues in recommending to anyone to stay here.
The place was very clean and Jennifer/Sean were quick to respond! They even had sunscreen and beach towels all set for us! Overall, we had a lovely stay!
Sean and Jennifer we're great hosts. Great communication and easy check-in and check-out. Will definitely stay here again.
Thank you! Everything was fine. Great location and nice view.
Sean/Jennifer's place was awesome!! :) Loved the location, the studio itself, and everything went so smoothly. Staying here definitely added to my Honolulu experience – thanks guys!

Although Hawaiian Monarchs itself is not a best place to stay compare to the other hotels, this room is cute and clean with beautiful Ocean View and Mountain View. 
I enjoyed staying this room and it was easy to go to the Waikiki by walk and easy to go to Ala Moana by bus.
Thank you so much.

Sean’s place was very clean and looked exactly as the pictures portrayed the place to be. Although the AC was loud, it worked splendidly and the room was wonderful to come back to. There were even drinks in the fridge for us and the shampoo, conditioner, and the body wash was provided. There were 2 shower towels and 2 beach towels and the water pressure on the shower was fine. Thank you for a great stay!!

Sean's studio is a great place to stay when visiting Honolulu. The apartment is very comfortable and located in a great spot within walkable distance to shopping, restaurants, and the beach. Sean and Jennifer were also very proactive in providing all of the information I would need to get the most out of my stay in their studio apartment. I highly recommend booking with Sean and Jennifer!
Great place. Very clean and amazing views. Handy location. Thanks Sean and Jennifer.
All around great value for Waikiki on an affordable extended stay. Full kitchenette was awesome. Central location. I will hopefully be returning soon.
Great location, perfect for access to the beaches and the shops.
The views are incredible. The room was more than adequate for our 2 night stay and super clean. The area is good with amenities all around and the beach is only a short walk.
Awesome spot! It’s in a great location/walking distance to many things. The place itself has an awesome view and styled nicely. The hosts had great communication.
Clean, good location
Endroit bien situé , transport en commun accessible et près de la plage

that was
a spaious room with a great view.
you will definitely enjoy it!

This listing was outstanding and the location couldn't be anymore perfect. The waikiki strip and beach were just a 8 min walk and ala moana mall is just a a quick uber away also. Definitely recommend this listing. The hosts were also amazing and response to our messages quickly.

This condo was great value. The location was perfect for us, 10 min walk to both the beach at Fort DeRussy end, and Ala Moana for shopping. Buses to Pearl Harbour and elsewhere were really close too. Plenty of choices for dinner within a mile walk and a decent size pool on level 6. 
Overall, this was value for money and suited us. Good coffee down in the lobby too, which we found on the last day!

Sean's place was just as pictured. It was clean, stylish and had all the basic necessities. The view from the room was amazing and location was close to a lot of restaurants and stores. Communication was also great and very responsive. Would definitely stay again.

Location is great, and the room is clean.
The hot spa is great. But there are no pots and pans.

Seans place was just as in the pictures. Also clean and very stylish. I enjoyed the view out of the windows and the close proximity to food and stores. 

Be careful about parking, a lot of tow zones and not a lot of street parking. This building has paid 24hr parking for hotel guests. But it can add up in price. 

Will be back.

Excellent view of everything Waikiki has to offer. Great walking location to downtown and has an awesome restaurant and bakery downstairs. Parking is gated $25/24-hours or free parking on the street 6pm-6am (no parking any other time).
We enjoyed Sean's place very much and would recommend to anyone looking for a convenient location in waikiki

We enjoyed our stay at the accommodation in Honolulu, the location was great and we had an amazing view! It would be nice to have some more cooking utensils but besides that everything that one could need was there :-) 
Easy check in check out!
Great place with great location! This place also have amazing view which I enjoyed very much!

Room was OK but very minimal. What you see is what you get. The cleaning and the location were great!
The noise is an issue in this house as one apartment is basically divided in 2. The result was to hear everything the neighbors were doing.

Very clean and cute studio. We had everything we needed for our 2 days stay. Check in and check out went off very quick and easy with the lockbox in the lower lobby. We had a great stay there and the location was good to reach great restaurants in Waikiki and the beach.

I had a great stay in this apartment, place is simple but totally clean, everything you need is there, it looks exactly like the pictures, communication during booking was perfect and totally helpful.
I can recommend it!

Sean's place was in the perfect location! We really enjoyed waking up to the beautiful Waikiki skyline every morning and walking to downtown was really easy. The location of the apartment was also not far from the airport as well as North Shore and Kailua. The apartment itself was very clean, thoroughly stocked, and the perfect size for my boyfriend and I. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting Honolulu and looking to stay close to the action, but not too far from the countryside. Thank you again!

This was my partner and I's first stay at an Airbnb and we loved it. Communication between Jenn was fast and easy. The room is in such a great location, an easy walk to everything. It was modern, clean and bright! Thank you!
Thanks a lot! I loved the aparment, great location and incredible view of honolulu. Everything was really well. I totally recommend it!

Aloha,
This condo was perfect for what we needed for a short stay in Waikiki for a dental convention.  It was a 5-10 min walk over the canal to the convention center which was perfect and a bit longer walk to the beach or a cheap Uber there when we got tired of walking.  Very simple condo, but got the job done for 2 people that planned to be on the go more than hanging out in our room the whole trip.  There’s a refrigerator, microwave and stove if needed too.  Would recommend this condo!
Mahalo!
Great location. Nice to have a stove and fridge in the unit to prepare food. Bed was slightly small for two people to sleep in especially if one or both are taller or wider than normal.
Sean’s place had a great location and the condo was clean and nice. Would really recommend this place!

Amazing view. The room was really clean and nicely decorated. They respond quickly to any questions and the people inside the hotel are really nice and helpful. Security was amazing didn’t have to worry about anything.

The apartment is in a great central location, very convenient local amenities (breakfast/coffee, convenience stores, public transportation etc) & all of Waikiki is within walking distance.  Quick & clear communication with the hosts.   Apartment is is perfect base if your “out & about” for majority of the day.   Thanks!

The room looks very cute and was nicely decorated, also the view was perfect. The room included everything we needed and a lot of storage room. The kitchen includes basic supplies to cook small meals but the pots and pans are quite small, also there was no coffee maker, but downstairs is a cafe, where you can get coffee and pastry, and some other places to eat. The check-in procedure and parking is very well organised. The location is good, although ca 10-15 minutes walk from the main shopping center and beach. Nevertheless, we enjoyed the walk.
Loved staying here!

I would rate this 5/5 for its cleanliness, comfort, and safe environment. It is a cute, small studio perfect for two. If you want to explore Waikiki everything is walking distance and the food downstairs is delicious. The apt provided us with beautiful sunrises every morning and we had an absolute blast. If you’re looking for an affordable, safe, and close place to the main strip of Waikiki I would recommend here. We also parked a car downstairs for a reasonable amount a day and the communication between the owners was always quick & informational. Mahalo, we’ll be back!

Lovely clean, compact apartment which is close to amenities like the laundromat and bus stops. About 15-20 mins walk to waikiki and the Ala Moana centre. Excellent views and Taco Bell is only 6 minutes away!

Great location. I really enjoyed my stay, and the view is amazing. 

The only downsides I can think of are that building is a bit run down and the elevators sometimes take a looong time to arrive. But you're on vacation, right? So no rush. The pool area is nice, with a big pool and lots of space. The apartment itself is in good shape, and I need to reiterate that the view is truly fantastic!
Sean's place is pretty  damn awesome. I really love the view that the condo has and I like the way the place was arranged. Thank you again Sean for that awesome stay at your place.
A wonderful place to stay with a great location!
Clean and super cute.

I was in Oahu for a couple days for training and this was such a great accommodating  place for me. I was able to walk to a few places for food during my stay since it’s in Waikiki which there were a lot of options near by. The apartment looked just like the pictures and was very clean. You get a beautiful city, lake and ocean view from the apartment! Jenn was very helpful and quick with responses when I had any questions. I would definitely stay here again. Thank you Jenn & Sean!

Great location, amazing view, snorkel equipment + beach towels made a huge difference too. Only one drawback- it is impossible to sleep in if you need a dark room, the curtains do not block the light at all.
Really great location to be in and the apartment is really nice. The only downside is that the walls are very thin so you can always hear the neighbors.
Nice view and location.

It's very stylish and clean. Everything was in the room. But one of room card keys didn't work for elevator and door. I stayed here for 5 days, but towels were given for only a day so it was inconvenient I needed to wash towels

If you want the perfect and spacious 2 bed/2 bath condo that is tastefully decorated, complete privacy and serenity and a lanai surrounded with lush shrubbery, THIS IS IT! Bright and airy, this unit is located in a quiet, ground floor, private location on the cul de sac. Tile throughout the dining to living areas and carpeting in the bedroom. Check out the recent pictures of the slide show listed on this AirBnb. Hawaii Tax ID #: (Phone number hidden by Airbnb)

reviews.comments: Best AirBnb experience so far! No issues at all. Everything was fine.

We had a fabulous and comfortable stay at Grand Champions! The unit was accurately depicted (actually looked even better in person) with beautiful furnishings and equipped with all the essentials for added comfort and convenience! It is private and in an excellent location within the GC community. A beautiful gift basket was awaiting our arrival. Check-in is a breeze. The lanai faces an amazing garden with views of the mountain and a peek-a-boo view of the ocean. Kitchen is well stocked for cooking if you so choose. The master bath has an amazing walk-in shower. The pools are beautiful and the grilling areas are kept clean. Some very nice beaches nearby and a great central location to get around the entire island by car. Host Amanda represents the best of hospitality; friendly, responsive, and professional! Will definitely recommend and come back again.
Amanda was great! We loved the grand champions villas and was surprised by how close it was to everything.
Very nice condo with 2 full baths and walk in shower!  Gift basket on arrival was an unexpected nice touch.   The wall mirror makes the mail room look really big.   We will be back soon!
The hosts were very responsive.  Unit was very quiet.

Beautiful place very clean and more that we expect very convenient with beach chair umbrella and beach towels. 
We will comeback and stay in the unit #137 . Very close to everything and Amanda is a very nice host ! My friends really love it !
Overall a great place
G

Excellent location, close to shops and great beaches.  We had a minor cleaning issue when we arrived, but CBI was very responsive and addressed it promptly.  The unit was well equipped with furnishings that met our needs.  The pool access, parking, and check-in was seemless.  We enjoyed our stay.

Thank you to a wonderful host! The place was immaculate and beautiful decor nice island touches. The master shower is so spacious. Location was ideal close to shopping and beaches and easy to explore the island. Looking forward to our next vacation!! Mahalo!

This unit is at the ground floor and there is another unit above it. The area is very quiet. Very short drive to the shopping resort area and the beaches. Rental car is highly recommended.
The unit comes with a dishwasher, washer and dryer, and even a juice blender. There are two bedrooms and two shower rooms. The main walk-in shower room is very pleasant to use, especially with young kids. 
The management company is professional, always fast to respond and very supportive during our few weeks stay. 
We would definitely come back again!

This place was beautiful and so centrally located. We loved that everything was either a quick drive or in some cases walkable. If we ever get a chance to get back to Maui, we would want to stay here.

name: Tropical Stay near the Beach ★ 2 Bedroom
summary: Overlooking Anini Bay with lush landscapes that affirms Kauai's nickname "Garden Isle" the Ka 'Eo Kai resort offers a variety of water, golf and tennis pleasures. Enjoy beautiful views, exotic surroundings that pay tribute to Kaua‘i’s environment, picturesque pools, intimate nature trails, clubhouse activities and a golf lover’s dream spot between the number 3 fairway of the Makai Golf Course and Princeville’s historic tree lane.
space: Just look out your window or step out onto your lanai. You'll love what you see, whether you are gazing at the misty Hanalei Valley Mountains, breathtaking Bali Hai waters, or fragrant gardens and golf course vistas. Check out the resort's two gorgeous swimming pools. A secluded quiet pool...a charming spot for a quick dip. The second is far more elaborate: this large sculptured pool is a family treat with cascading waterfall, kiddie wading pool, and hot tub. Enjoy a quiet stroll down the historic tree lane to pristine Anini Beach. Fun activities await you at our elegant clubhouse: dancing, golf scrambles, bingo, luaus, and more.

neighborhood_overview: You’ll find botanical gardens dotting wondrous Kauai, yet those lovingly nurtured grounds are a mere hint of the island’s breadth. The landscape changes at every turn, meaning you’ll move from thick green foliage to otherworldly foggy landscapes to sunny beaches around every bend in the road.
notes: No air conditioning; units cooled by trade winds, ceiling fans in every room. All reservations are subject to Hawai'i's Transient Occupancy Tax upon check-in. Wireless Internet is free for up to 4 devices, ideal for emails and basic web browsing. For more streaming and surfing options on unlimited devices, Enhanced High-Speed Wireless Internet is available for $9.95 per day, $49.95 for 6-10 days, and $59.95 for 11-30 days.
transit: A rental car is highly recommended as there are limited public transportation options and most attractions and activities are not within walking distance.
access: Amenities     2 Outdoor Swimming Pools     Organized Activities Program     Outdoor Hot Tub     Outdoor Children's Pool     Tennis Court     Clubhouse
interaction: We strive to make your vacation planning and stay a great experience and give you great customer service. Feel free to email ResortShare with any questions.
house_rules: The reservation will be booked into the guest’s name as it appears on Airbnb. If this name does not match your photo ID or if a guest by a different name will be checking in, you must provide the first and last name at the time of booking.    Must be 21+ years of age at the time of check-in.  All reservations are subject to Hawai'i's Transient Occupancy Tax upon check-in and the 2 Bedroom is $11.47 per night. Unit sleeps 6 guests but the bed will vary in size.  King, Queen, Queen Sleeper or Queen, Queen, Queen Sleeper.  This is a Wyndham Timeshare resort all sale presentations are optional. The resort will be undergoing an exterior renovation project to repair wood and paint throughout the property June 1, 2018 - Feb. 28, 2019. During this time noise, dust, odors and workers on-site may be experienced. Additionally, some parking spaces may be blocked for staging purposes and unit views may be obstructed at times. Dates subject to change.

host.host_about:
Here at ResortShare we strive to create a seamless transaction for our guests, allowing them to enjoy a relaxing vacation at over 50 of the top destination resorts in the US.

We manage a premium selection of the best units at these resorts, most of our units include kitchens, laundry capability and separated living and sleeping quarters. You will have all the comforts of home, with the resort/hotel amenities you need while on vacation.

reviews.comments: We booked the Wyndham last minute after showing up to another Airbnb the day before and being unhappy with the cleanliness of it (and the cats we were supposed to leave the door open for).  Luckily the other listing had a flexible cancellation policy and this listing was available to be booked last minute - our host was able to work quickly with the resort as we had already cancelled our other Airbnb and were on our way.  We were extremely pleased with our stay and it was only marginally more expensive than our other Airbnb we booked.  It was ten times better and we had tons of space for the five of us and would definitely book again!
Nice, clean, and well equipped place.  Thank you for hosting us.

My husband, his family and I stayed at the condo at the Wyndham in Princveille, and it was absolutely perfect. It was plenty spacious for 6 adults. The location was super convenient to Hanalei Bay, the St. Regis, beaches and hikes. We would absolutely stay here again!

It was a beautiful condo , the staff was so helpful helping us plan activities as well as showing us places only natives go to overall the condo had every little thing we needed from a laundry room to every amenity needed to cook , the bathrooms also were amazing with a built in it was 4 of us but the condo can easily sleep 8
Very noisy condo with radios and TVs blaring. Neighbors are not very considerate or courteous. Not a relaxing place at all.
Place was spacious & clean with great amenities and very helpful/friendly staff.
This place is amazing, if you wanna hike pr go to the beach, this is the place to stay. Their rooms are so big and spacious.
Perfect large apartment

Loved that the pool was right next to our unit for the kids, we went right after the big flooding so many of the beaches and waters were closed due to contamination levels, loved that we always had a cool breeze with all the windows open, we never had to turn on the AC. Great stay and good location!
It was the last place at which we stayed in Hawaii and we loved it! It was a nice surprise receiving a Lei during check-in.
Great price for the location and amenities.
We had a great time. Lots of space and a well-equipped kitchen for cooking. Close to the groceries with a jacuzzi make this a great spot for a group of friends.
Lovely quiet area, beautiful scenery! Didn’t know it rained there so much though

Great place. The staff is fantastic, they explain you all the activities they have and solve all your questions. In the lobby you have complimentary  coffee all the time and Mai Thais in the afternoon. The resort is in a very good area, near the supermarket and the main road. I would definitely come back.
Nice, clean, fun pool and jacuzzi...
Expect a great layout with 2 bedrooms, living room and a fun kitchen-dining layout with a wrap-around porch and a pool with a view of the ocean!
Great value and quick turnaround. Good location on the north side. Very clean unit and kitchen. Amenities were great. Would recommend and visit again.
very very spacious and cozy and beautiful. so close to foodland and other shops. clean and easy to cook and relax...feels luxurious.

The resort itself is nice yet its important to know that the bottom units are very noisy and each unit is designed differently.  They are very spacious and well stocked with everything you would need.
Nice resort for adults not great for young kids. Don't let the resort put you in 8A/B or 9A/B unless you want to be In a high traffic busy intersection.

name: Maui Oceanfront Condo/Kaanapali/Kahana 2 Bedroom
summary: Maui is outdoor living at its finest! There is no escaping the view.  This condo does not border a noisy parking lot nor street - The view from this condo makes the ocean look like it's your swimming pool, its spectacular!  You can see the ocean while sitting on our tropical couch or cooking dinner in kitchen! - If you love the ocean, this is it! We have a first class fully remodeled condo with a top notch kitchen, full fridge, double ovens, microwave and granite counter tops.
space: Maui is outdoor living at its finest! Enjoy having breakfast lunch and dinner on your lanai staring at the ocean! Wake each morning to birds singing, swaying palm trees and the teal blue waters of the ocean.. there is no escaping the absolute OUTSTANDING view from this condo!  Condo's view is of the ocean, pool and the Island of Molokai, whether you're sitting on the lanai, on our tropical couch, or cooking dinner in our fully equipped gourmet kitchen, complete with double oven and full size fridge! ..Eat in, Dine out the choice is yours. Condo is minutes away from many of Maui’s famous activities, shopping areas, beaches, sights, restaurants and grocery stores. Enjoy Maui as you have always imagined...relax and set your own pace. We are conveniently located close to many restaurants, grocery stores, farmers’ markets, hiking trails, golfing and shopping areas. house_rules: Quiet hours exist from 10pm to 8am - All Maui Condo's, hotels and public areas are smoke free

host.host_about:
Aloha, we live on this beautiful island of Maui.  We have owned our condo for 10 years.  Our prior residence was in Anchorage Alaska for 35 years.  We love the outdoor living here on this beautiful island of Maui, like the weatherman 
says "Maui has the best weather on the Planet"

reviews.comments: Deb went out of her way to make my birthday visit amazing! She is very helpful and quick with her responses. The house is exactly as pictured/described and get clean and pleasant. It is fully stocked and you are not in need of anything. I would recommend this place to anyone and would love to have the opportunity to stay again.

This is a great place to stay with a few friends. The view is spectacular. I took my parents and best friend and this place accommodated our needs perfectly. The place was stocked with everything we needed to cook as well as a nice balcony area facing the ocean to eat at. The beach area felt private and was great for laying out. We snorkeled out front and we saw 7 giant sea turtles!

Deb's place is exactly as portrayed in the pictures and descriptions. It has a lovely, unobstructed view of the pool and the ocean. It is wonderful to relax on the lanai and hear the waves break on the rocks. The beach is small and not for everyone as the lava rocks need to be negotiated, a bit tricky if surf is high. However, we found a wonderful beach minutes away with a grassy park, large welcoming sandy beach and wonderful snorkeling. I spent a half hour swimming along with a turtle one day. There are also turtle to be found right in front of the condo. Deb alerted us to local events, steered us to other beaches, stores and local events. The layout of the condo is perfect for two friends, the kitchen has everything. After dinner, it was lovely to go out to the lanai and enjoy the stars and the moonlit sea. Mahalo, Deb, for 9 days of delight. I will be back. Soon, I hope.
The host canceled this reservation 136 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.

We absolutely loved staying at Deb's!
Well equipped kitchen. Walking distance to local coffee shop and groceries. Comfortable beds. Turtles, turtles, and did I mention turtles?!
Quiet after 10pm (We loved this)
Residents were friendly. Our hostess was quickly responsive and went above and beyond in making sure we had everything we needed and she even informed us of pods of whales that would be coming by the condo.
Part of me doesn't want more people to know how great this listing is because it will be harder for me to get in, but it would a shame if you missed this condo. It comes with so much aloha!

What a beautiful place to stay, with so many special touches.  The kitchen had everything we could dream of in the way of cooking told and appliances.  The condo was spotless and beautifully furnished, and Deb was a pleasure to work with!  I would highly recommend this condo, and will definitely stay here in the future!  Thanks Deb!

The listing was very accurate and met all of our expectations. Deb answered questions promptly and offered many suggestions to make our stay even better. It was a treat to overlook the ocean and island mountains beyond and see the sea turtles at high and low tide. 
Lots  of information was prepared and left for us in a notebook which made it easy to understand how the condo complex worked. Overall it was just a wonderful several days to spend in West Maui
Our stay was wonderful! The place was lovely and the location gave us access to everything we wanted to do.

From the moment we booked Deb was fantastic. She was in good communication up to and during our stay. I had an accident the day before we arrived and I broke my wrist. Deb was genuinely concerned and offered lots of things to do in the area with this in mind.
The host canceled this reservation 185 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.
Amazing ocean view.  All the amenities you would need for a family or a romantic getaway.  Deb was amazing and treated us so well.  I will be returning.
Deb's condo on Maui was awesome.  The view from the lanai rivals anything we saw during our stay.  It's a small complex right on the ocean so no big crowds.  Exactly what I was hoping for!

Great location. 8 mins to Kapula Bay and Kaanapali  (black rock). The condo is in a great condition and has everything you may need to have a comfortable stay. We loved having dinner on the patio and whale watching. The complex really observes quite time and gives that peaceful relaxing environment. Deb is an amazing host.

Deb was great! I had requested something special for our arrival to help us celebrate my sisters 21st birthday and she went over and above. We arrived to cake a balloon and some goodies and a fresh lei. Condo was fresh and clean and the views were breathtaking from the balcony. Thanks for a great stay x

Deb's place is great! The view is breathtaking and she is a SUPER welcoming host. Her response in communication is lightning fast.  The location was perfect too. We rented a car so it was easy to get around. The condo manager is great too! thanks Jeff.

Our stay was just as we imagined. Communication from Deb was great and made our holiday easy and fun. Driving is the best way to see Maui and the Condo is at a good location with beautiful views of the sea and sunset and we even saw turtles! on the private secluded beach. The facilities are clean and close to amenities - just a couple of minutes drive from a shopping area and restaurants. The condo is good sized and was awesome for my family of 4. Deb was a very welcoming host and I really appreciate her constant communication and tips. I would recommend staying here to anyone especially families...and rent a car- the best way to see Maui at your own pace. Thanks Deb :)
This home was the perfect location for my family. Beautiful views, clean and close to some of the most beautiful beaches and snorkeling. Deb is a great host.

Deb had been assisting our trip planning right after our confirmation of staying in her condo.  She has been a great landlord to actively provide information, suggestion, and help along the way.  Needless to mention that when she found out that we left our keys in the condo, she notified immediately that allows us to find solution to get it.  She helped to mail the keys to us all the way back to China.  We really appreciate Deb's great support to our trip in Hawaii.  We will definitely go back if we have a second visit to Maui next time!

Great condo and location. Perfect size for 4 adults. No beach access from the condo but amazing views from the lanai! Fully stocked to cook in every night, walking distance to the farmers market grocery store.

Deb and Tony are terrific hosts.  The provide great recommendations are incredibly responsive.  The unit is very much like the photos, except the view may even be better.  Our daughters loved the boogie boards, I liked sitting on the porch and watching the whales, and the turtles on the little beach in front of the unit were fun to see.

Deb’s condo was perfect for what we were looking for! The view can’t be beat. The condo had beach towels, beach chairs and the condo complex had beach toys you could use. The direct beach access is small and not ideal for swimming but it was great turtle watching. The condo complex is family friendly however observes quiet hours so if you have rowdy kids might not be the best fit. Deb customer service was impeccable. It was rather unusually humid during our stay and she offered to bring us an extra fan.

Perfect location, super comfy beds, beautiful decor, even a removable shower head perfect for rinsing off little ones after their pool time. Deb’s suggestions and communication were top notch. I’d come back here in a heartbeat!

The condo is clean and well appointed. You feel welcomed the moment you walk through the door. The beds are comfortable and you are supplied with all the towels you will need for your stay, including wonderful beach towels. Large walkin shower in the master bathroom along with a jacuzzi tub in the upstairs bathroom. When you stay at Deb and Tony's wonderful vacation condo, you become part of a lovely community. The permanent owners are so welcoming and the guests seem to be hand picked. The environment is friendly and very social. The grounds are impeccable and the views spectacular. Sunsets from the lanai while watching the tiki torches being lit were a special treat. You will not be disappointed.

Deb is a great host and we had an amazing stay at her condo. It’s very well located, has some stunning views and great amenities as well. Deb was very quick in responding to my queries and provided with very useful information and tips before and during  the stay. I would highly recommend the place!

Deb is the best of the best.
She was always available via text and kept in constant communication prior and during our stay at her beautiful condo.

This is the best alternative over any resort hotel in the Kaanapali area.  The location of her condo is perfect for excursions to the West side of Maui.  All of her suggestions for beaches to food were perfect for our little family.

The kitchen is stocked with all the amenities you would need to make your stay perfect.  She was even thoughtful to leave us a few welcoming gifts (loved the chocolates Deb!).  The only sad part about staying at her condo was that the trip was over way too soon.

The sunset/sunrise views are breathtaking, the ocean waves was a relaxing background to help us unwind and experience Maui like it should be.

We can't wait to come back to Maui and if Deb's condo is available we are staying here again.

Deb is a great host and gave us a lot of tips on what to explore in West Maui.
There is shopping and beaches nearby, no need to drive a lot, you can really relax
The condo is perfect size for a family of 4,  very well equipped, everthing that we need was there. 
The location and the view from the lanai is great, the kids enjoyed the pool very much and to make it perfect we could enjoy beautiful sunsets and rainbows and even saw turtles at the beach next to the unit.
We really enjoyed staying in Debs place and we hope to stay here again when returning to Maui.
Thanks a lot !
Deb is delightful and made our trip, from check in to local tips seamless. A special spot on the water in a wonderful community. Hope to make it back with the family to Deb’s place soon

space: Recently furnished apartment with easy access to many restaurants near Columbia University. A super clean space with a very large living room. Includes a cable TV, kitchen tools, dishwasher, washing machine, and dryer. Close to two subway stations (trains 1, 2, 3, B, and C). 15 minute to Times Square and Midtown by train.
