host.host_about: Hi! I speak English and Mandarin well, and am working on my Spanish and French. Background? I went to a Liberal Arts school in Massachusetts and studied Economics, Computer Science and Philosophy. I am interested in Startups, Finance, Real Estate, Hotels, Political Philosophy.

reviews.comments: I had a great time staying at Rui's. The room was very clean and neat, s well as the bathroom. Great place, I would definitely stay there again! He was also very helpful. I couldn't ask for something better!

Apartment is in very good condition, in renovated building with elevator. Subway is within 2 blocks distance, as well as central park, which makes it very convenient location for exploring the city. Apartment has 2 bathrooms and 3 rooms, so you are likely to have good company while your stay.

The host, Rui, is very anticipating, he provided us with some good advice on what to see and what to do in the city. He also puts nice stickers with guests names on the room doors, which makes communication easier.

We had a very good stay, and will definitely consider visiting Rui again when in NYC
Very clean apartment, he's cool no complaints.  This was our first time using air bnb and we will use it again.  neighborhood is fine we'd go back if we're in the area.
Host responded quickly to my initial inquiries.  He was present when I arrived.  The location is good for the upper West Side.  Very close to public transport and some decent restaurants.
Rui  answered very quickly by email. Saw Rui when we arrived and when we left. The room was a bit small but ok for a few nights. Close to Central Park and subway.
Overall is good, clean room, kitchen and bathroom. Rui also cooked for us once. Thanks for Rui that my and I had wonderful NYC trip!

Rui's place was very calm and quiet. Mind you, my partner and I weren't really "home" too often, exploring the city by day and only arriving to sleep. He provided everything from towels to shampoo. The two bathrooms really came in handy as well so my partner and I could expedite the time it took for us to get out the door. I recommend staying with Rui, if only for a quiet place to stay!
The host canceled this reservation the day before arrival. This is an automated posting.

When I arrived, the key was outside the door where he said it would be, the access worked, just as he said it would.  All great.  First floor was an added bonus.  Entering the apt. I removed shoes, as requested.  Floors are bright white.  There is a central room (pictured) and it connects to four bedrooms and two bathrooms.  

Everything looked very new!  So new that the TV still wasn't connected.  Not necessarily a bad thing.  Rui left notes around the apt. to point out bathrooms, bedrooms, shower operation, etc.

Location is terrific!  Walked to Central Park lake in AM.  Cab and subway connnections are easy.

This place has a unique vibe and look too it. We walked in and there are four bedrooms with two bathrooms. One bathroom being just for females and another for both female and male. The place is clean and has been renovated. The room was simple but had what is needed. A small desk with a chair and a full size bed with two pillows and comforter. The bathroom was clean and he provided towels for my room. The apartment is on the first floor so easy to access. I felt safe here but not much privacy because once you walk out of the bedroom your in the main area. I would consider staying here again because of the area it's in and I felt secure. His communication needs a bit of work but wasn't bad. I didn't get to personally meet him but wanted too. I don't think he lives here but just rents the place out to different people.

The apartment is really clean and quiet, good privacy, transportation is convenient  (<30min to anywhere in DT Manhattan), and Rui generously offered drinks and quality toiletries there. Wonderful experience.

Rui  (Ray) was very responsive to our needs.  The apartment has been totally redone from floor to ceiling; everything is new - there are  four sleeping rooms, two bathrooms, wi-fi, and a common room with kitchen and washer/dryer.  A TV too, but it didn't work, probably because he had just moved the rental rooms from a third floor apartment to a first floor apartment and the move was so recent that a few  details were  not finished.  The block is mostly residential and is very close to Amsterdam and Broadway for restaurants, groceries and subway/bus.  It is very convenient.

Location is very convenient and in a nice neighborhood.  It is a simple and clean place
just what we needed after a long days walking in the wonderful city. Will stay in the future
again.
The apartment is on a quiet street close to the Central Park, within walking distance to two subway stations. The rooms are cozy and clean. I'd choose to stay here next time I am in Manhattan.

Our stay at Rui's apartment was nice. Apartment was clean and location was good, there was everything that we needed for couple days stay. The pictures were from another apartment, eventhough the style was similar, I would say that it was apartment from the same building..

Fotoet er fra et lignende sted. Det er ikke fra det sted , vi boede. 
Omtalen passede nogenlunde, men der var ikke beskrevet, at der var 4 værelser og et mindre fællesrum. Vores vært dukkede op dagen efter, vi var ankommet for at spørge om alt var OK.
Der var sørget for vand og køkkenet fungerede, så vi selv kunne lave morgenmad.

Nos hemos sentido a gusto y seguros. Muy complacidos  con la habitación que nos asignó en general con todo el apartamento. Nuestro anfitrión   fue muy atento. El barrio muy seguro y agradable. Hay muchos servicios y comercios. Los medios públicos de movilidad al alcance de la mano. Rápidos y eficientes. Lo recomendamos.
Everything was great! The place was always very clean and the bedroom was really comfortable. We liked its location as it is only 10 minutes walking to the subway station.
The check-in procedure was really convenient. You can check in almost any time you want. The room was super clean. The location is easy to find as well.

It couldn't have been an easier transaction. Ray made it very convenient to access the apartment. The apartment is exactly as described and in great condition. The neighborhood is nice, quiet, and very close to Central Park. We had a great overall stay.
性价比很高的公寓｡位置在上城,离地铁近,出行方便,房间干净整洁｡推荐!

The room/apartment description is accurate. It was a clean, sparsely decorated place, with 4 small bedrooms, one common room/kitchen, and 2 tiny bathrooms. The location is convenient - close to 2 subway stops, various delis and restaurants, etc. I stayed with my 8 year old daughter and felt safe. The TV didn't seem to work, but not a big deal b/c we didn't spend much time at the place and we connected w/ the wifi. My only complaint is that the temperature was too warm - making the place seem very stuffy - but we ran the A/C unit while we slept and that made it more comfy. Rui was very responsive to all questions. A great deal for NYC!

Nice place to stay in New York, and the directions are very helpful.
Location is good on the upper west side. Very close to central park and just a few minutes away from the subway stop that takes you to central Manhattan.
It's a good experience
Comfortable room in great UWS location. Ideal for a short stay.

Die Wohnung war sauber und obwohl Rui abwesend war, hat alles hervorragend geklappt.
Die Gegend ist etwas laut und für zwei Frauen etwas unheimlich, da sich vor allem nachts wenige Touristen draussen aufhalten und der Weg von der U-Bahn zum Haus durch dunkle Gassen führt.
Die Wohnung ist im Erdgeschoss und man hat das Gefühl jedes Geräusch von draussen wahrzunehmen.
Das Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis stimmt sicher überein, würde mir aber das nächste Mal überlegen eher in Downtown zu buchen.
The room was very clean and very nice overall. It was a little cold the first night but then the heat seemed to kick on and everything was great! Would recommend
I would recommend him any day, good location, clean, everything ready and in place.

très bien location excellente à 10 minute en transport du centre de Manhattan, les chambres sont propres et toutes les informations nécessaires sont très bien communiquées merci je conseille vivement.
Great place. Clean area and comfy beds.

This was a great place to stay, a great location and a great price.  We needed a last minute place after being stranded in NYC after the snowstorm and Rui allowed us to check-in early and check out late the next day.  2 bathrooms made staying there an even better experience!

Thanks so much and you have a great place!

This was my very first Airbnb experience, and it went reasonably well!
The first thing we received was a long list of instructions on how to get into and use the apartment, which was really helpful. It was good to have these things (like door codes) on hand at any moment. 
The apartment itself was minimal, smallish, and clean. The building seemed nice, and the neighborhood had plenty of things in the area to see and shop at, especially with regards to food/coffee/groceries. 
Biggest pluses: the room was private and sparse, even if on the small side. We stayed in Room 01, which we learned was the smallest choice (it was a first come first served style, with three or four rooms available). The apartment was cleaned virtually every day. It was quiet indoors, and we were almost never bothered by anyone else. There were two shared bathrooms, which was nice when needed.
Biggest cons: The room is at ground level, and everyone walking by can be heard up and down the street. The room was SMALL but the other three rooms looked to be about twice the size (so choose them!). The living room space had a tiny couch and no chairs, so it wasn't really comfortable. The two bathrooms seemed less generous when there were six people in the apartment all at once. 
The toilets were specifically marked to not have ANY paper waste be deposited into them, which was annoying and gross. We were asked not to flush things like tampons and pads (a reasonable request) but also to throw out used toilet paper in the trash (which was not so great).

Overall, it was a nice place with a weird rule or two. Choose the bigger room, and you probably won't meet anyone else staying there.

My stay was absolutely amazing! It was my first time in New York and I wouldn't have had it any other way. The room was located perfectly with all my friends, access to the train, and local food spots. There was also instructions for everything and Rui was super responsive w/ any questions.  I will def. recommend to other guest!
It was great first time experience didn't know what to expect but when I walked thru the door I felt at home! Very quiet, clean and peaceful!

Ray was a very welcoming and attentive host! The reservation process and explanations for getting into the apartment was very clear and detailed. The place was very nice - super clean rooms and linens, uncluttered shared areas and conveniently located. It was almost like being in a private hotel room, but at a much better price!  We had a ton of privacy, only seeing other guests a couple of times in the evening. The type of guest that stays here is very responsible and friendly. 

It is conveniently located by the northern end of Central Park and very accessible to the subway systems - we traveled all of Manhattan from here easily. Plenty of great restaurants and shops in this area too. The keys and pass codes to the building, apt and rooms made us feel very safe.

Although we didn't meet Ray in person, he went was extremely responsive to our texts and very helpful in getting packages and mail sent to the apt - we had forgotten a few things at home and had them shipped. It was invaluable to be able to do this. 

My husband and I would highly recommend this place to any visitor to NYC. Thanks for all of your help, Ray!

The apartment is really nice, very close to Central Park and in a nice area. There are four bedrooms and two bathrooms which is usually enough. The kitchen could use a few more tools, there is really not much there for example no can opener and only four glasses.

Rui is exceptional at answering all of your questions quickly, and left detailed instructions so you can enter the apt on your own. The best thing about this listing is that it is flexible (for check-in and check-out), it is discreet, and it is in a convenient location close to the subway and to Columbia university.

The housekeeper came by daily so it was very clean. My room was spacious. However, I did originally reserve a room with a desk and my room did not come with one.

I arrived at check in time, no rooms were avaliable yet, but that was fine because I was planning on leaving and exploring. Ray helped clear that up which was awesome. When I came back, there was a room avaliable and there were clean sheets and towels. Bathrooms had extra soaps and stuff which was convenient since I forgot my shampoo. Great place to stay to stay! Wish he had more places in nyc!

Overall, had a great stay at Ray's place. The location is perfectly situated near public transportation. The place is small but comfortable and the fact that it has two bathrooms is a plus. The only downside is that it is located on the first floor and street noise can be loud at times. One other thing is the lock on the door of the apartment is very difficult to open. I realize the host probably doesn't have control over this and this is also something common with NYC apartments but it definitely made it a bit difficult to access the apartment. 

Regardless, I would definitely stay again at Ray's place. Check-in is the easiest I've ever encountered on airbnb.

The listing was very accurate ! The apartment was just as described and my boyfriend met the host and said he was great ! The location was amazing and it was amazingly clean . We will definitely stay here again if we travel back to NY!
Stayed at Ray's accommodation for three nights.  Extremely clean, great location and a very well organised host. Would highly recommend.
I never saw Ray, but he was very nice in finding me a steamer and the hose was clean and perfectly located!
Never met him in person but his guidelines and instructions were really helpful for us. The house was really clean and nice! Perfect location, absolutely recommended!

Thanks Ray for a good stay. Our room was quite small and unfortunately we were too late to move to the bigger room. Although we emailed a few times before and during our stay, you were not very responsive. The apartment is clean and well maintained. Excellent showers and luckily quiet co-guests. The location is walking distance from Columbia University which made it an ideal spot to attend the graduation of our son.

Wonderful experience! Very clear and easy check-in instructions and house rules (and explanations for things like how to operate the shower on cute post-its :), clean and pleasant apartment (especially the room and bathroom), and good location by multiple subway entrances and the park and a nice neighborhood. Couldn't have asked for better!
Great location, very nice apartment and room was nice and clean.  100% recommended!

The place was great! Perfect for 2 people - by cool people who stayed there as well. 

Couldn't complain. Thanks, Ray!

The location of this was great, very nice and very safe, however the apt was filthy and clearly hadnt been cleaned!! The apt was was much more like a hostel than an air bnb; the room was tiny (7 steps end to end to be exact) with no cups to drink out of and no plates or pots or pans to cook with, not to mention that the kitchen was little more than a fridge and a small line of cabinets. 

The Room
The pictures of the room were not of the room and the room was both filthy and tiny with the bed being little more than an old and very uncomfortable spring mattress on a flimsy fold out sofa type base. The pillows too were old and flat.

The Bathroom
The bathroom was modern but disgustingly filthy with hair all over the floor

All in all this was a hostel with the property owner not living in the property and instead renting out all the rooms!!
We spent a wonderful time in NY staying in Ray's apartment. It's very good located, close everywhere, especially to Central Park and subway. What's important for me the apartment was clean.
A room very handy, as described in the ad in a good location.

Ray's place was overall great. Upon booking a room, I was sent a document with all of the instructions I needed for check in and check out. It was very clear and detailed and everything worked or as it should have.

What I didn't realize was that the apartment was a four bedroom apartment; it felt a little like a hostel. However I only saw the other guests a couple of times very briefly. There were also two bathrooms so there was never a long wait for the bathroom (although I did have to wait a few times). 

Ray has a professional cleaning lady to clean the rooms before any guest stays and you will be provided with towels as well. I couple critiques I have is that the toilet paper in the bathroom could be better quality, and there should be hand towels and washcloths in addition to bath towels for guests. 

The apartment is on the upper west side so it takes about 30 minutes via MTA to get to Rockefeller center and closer to 45 to get to lower Manhattan. However transit is very close and we never had to walk far. 

Overall, I would recommend staying at Ray's place if you do not mind sharing the apartment with others.
Great space! The host was very communicative and made the process from start to finish smooth!

The location is great if you are looking for a residential non touristy neighbourhood. Central park is very close.
The appartment itself feels more like a hostel. We have met many different guests during our stay. There are very few kitchen tools (like 2 cups for a 4 bedroom appartment). Rooms are quite small with limited possibilities to open a window. There is AC, but it is quite noisy.
We appreciated that there are 2 bathrooms.

Unfortunately we never met or even spoke to Ray (even through text!-- we texted him which room we chose to stay in and received no response). The apartment was very clean and we were able to find free street parking right outside-- although I'm sure not everyone was so lucky. When we got to the apartment around 12:30, we were able to leave our things in the living room until the rooms had been cleaned, which was very convenient. We didn't get back until late at night, so we took the one available room. Somehow, we either couldn't figure out how to turn the electricity on in that room (the rest of the apartment was fine) or it just wasn't working. Which, of course, meant that it was very hot, as well as no lighting. There were also quite a few nitpicky things that Ray insists upon when people live there (no toilet paper in the toilets-- what???). But in spite of this, I had a good stay. The apartment is in a good location and easily accessible to the subway. Essentially, it was just a place to sleep, and that was all we really needed.

The room was as advertised. The location is fantastic, about 5-10 minutes away from the Subway lines. While I haven't met Ray personally, he left a very detailed and diligent note explaining all that was needed for the room. Overall, I would recommend this place for a short visit to NYC.

Check-in and check-out process was systematic and streamlined, I couldn't meet Roy in person during my stay, though. Safer location than I concerned before. I liked the neighbor, especially a shop that sells fresh carrot juice in the morning. Small room(I got room #1) and road construction from early in the morning were cons.
It was nice staying at Ray's place..the room was not that big but we managed it. The bathrooms were clean!
Excellent location in uptown west side. Great if you want to experience walking to and from Central Park. Just two blocks from Subway station and near many bars and restaurant.

The building is nice and requires code for entry. Something was up with the doorknob so we had difficulty getting in, luckily other renters were leaving so we were able to get in. The space is clean enough and I actually appreciate all the sticky note instructions because it makes things easier. Upon entry we smelled gas and realized someone had left the stove on so we turned it off. The bathroom was reasonably clean. The bedroom was very clean and he had a power strip so you can charge multiple things. You are meant to write your names and how long you'll be there on a sticky and put it on your door, but there were no working pens so we weren't able to do that. I'm thankful all we did was sleep here. Aside from being in a good location, there were many things misleading about this listing.
First off, there is NO free parking on the premises. He is referring to the street parking outside his apartment. You do not learn about that until after you book and it is too late.
Secondly, the instructions the host sent us after booking were very long, poorly articulated, and left us with the impression that he wasn't suppose to be renting his place out as an airBnB. Getting in was like trying to get into an escape room. Many combinations and locks AND the door to the apartment was very janky and taped together.
Additionally, the space is not as nice as it appears in the pictures. The common space is messy, very dark, and NOT air conditioned. Not comfortable to be in. The room we booked was astonishingly smaller than the pictures. The only thing that I will say is the bathrooms are very nice and the only redeeming quality.
Last of all, the space is shared by many people, not including the host (which we never even saw by the way). There were at least three other people in the apartment in addition to my boyfriend and I. This became problematic in the morning when trying to get ready on a time crunch, even with the two beautiful bathrooms. It was quite frustrating.
Overall, I wish I read the reviews before booking this listing because I would have absolutely looked elsewhere. Because of the "free parking" LIE we had to pay $90 for a parking garage space which threw off my budget for my entire trip. Know what you're getting into if you book this listing.

The neighborhood is the best part of this apartment, as it is 2 blocks away from some of the best dining (especially brunch, try beauty and Essex or Hotel Chantelle!) the city has to offer.

reviews.comments: Cozy room, very close to the 2 and 5 trains. Made for a productive stay!

She was very kind and welcoming throughout my whole stay, and the location of her place is beyond ideal, being only a block away from the 2 and 5 trains for Manhattan access. I would absolutely recommend her as a reliable host. For the location and comfort, her asking price is certainly a great deal. If you need a cozy place to stay while in Brooklyn, this is an excellent option. Very satisfied with my stay.

Rivka's home was in a very convenient location to a subway that was literally round the corner so that we could easily get to and from the city. Her home was exactly as described, and Rivka would always get back to any questions we had more or less right away. The only thing was carrying our heavy luggage up many flights of stairs.

Rivka is the most charming host and she has a great apartment. Highest recommendations. 

The apartment is in one of the last authentic neighbourhoods in Brooklyn. There's good coffee around the corner and great beer a few blocks north. 

It's a few flights up, but worth it. The apartment is warm and cozy. The bed is comfortable and the water pressure is surprisingly good for NY.  

On the social side, Rivka made Shakshouka the first night, and brought me along to an engagement party. I had a great time.

Rivka is very kind and careful host. Home was exactly as described, it was clean and room was cozy and nice. Neighborhood is good, near to small markets and supermarket and close to the 2 & 5 subway station.
The last day she cooked some cookies and unfortunately I could not take some of them with me.

A small room in a sunny, and somewhat shabby apt. The bed was comfy and you have lots of bedding to choose from. Rivka was nice. For some reason she posts a photo of her own (much nicer) bedroom in the ad, which seems a bit odd, as it has nothing to do with guest's space.

R. ist eine herzliche, freundliche, hilfsbereite, unkomplizierte Gastgeberin. Das Appartement ist nett und liegt in einem angenehmen Stadtviertel von Brooklyn. Manhattan ist mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln gut zu erreichen, etwa 20 min. Sehr empfehlenswert und immer wieder herzlich gerne!!!

Rivka's place is a perfect spot to stay in while working in NYC. Close to trains and buses. Near Prospect Park. Rivka is a wonderful host, friendly, attentive and a great baker that left delicious goodies to snack on.
We needed a place quickly and Rivka responded immediately and got our room ready on very short notice. She was very flexible and very accommodating!

A comfy little apartment in a very convenient part of Brooklyn, one block from several subway lines. Wish we'd had more time to explore prospect Park. 

Clean, tidy, and good value.  Rivka was extremely helpful and friendly.
Good wifi near to subway value for money

Rivka is such a nice and warm person! She is so kind to us and showed me lots of things if we need help. And she prepared for coffee when we left early morning!
The room was clean, tidy and cozy. But the heater in the living room was a bit noisy so that I couldn't sleep well but I could sleep well in the bedroom.(This often happens in New York though, and my friends could sleep well even in the living room:))
So if you don't care about it it's a really good house to stay at, especially for long stay! You can walk to subway station within 3 minutes:)

Rivka's was one of a couple places I stayed at after moving to the City while I was still looking for an apartment, and hers was certainly my favorite. Carrying my bags up the stairs was a bit of a chore, but from there the stay was nothing but pleasant. Rivka's very knowledgeable about the area and always had a helpful suggestion for places to check out. 
The apartment is blocks away from prime subway spots and the Brooklyn Museum and Brooklyn Public Library are only a couple stops away, if not walking distance if you don't mind a trek.
I loved staying with her and highly recommend it for anyone looking for a comfortable place to stop for either a trip to the city or moving transition.

There isn't much more to say without repeating myself.
Rivka's a wonderful host. I had to extend my stay an extra night and she was wonderfully flexible about the whole thing. Thanks ever so much for having me~

Serious, tidy and friendly; definitely a five stars host!  The host was very well organized and was around for all of our questions.  We had a terrific time at her place and we definitely are looking forward to coming back again.
Rivka was a great host! The bed was comfortable and perfect after a long day of walking. Easy access to the metro to get around.
Great host. Great neighborhood. Clean, quiet, and safe. Post marathon the host let us come back and shower before we head out, and she had freshly made cookies!! Highly recommend.

Rivka is a great host! She's very welcoming and friendly. The room's neat, clean and comfy. The apartment is located in a nice neighborhood and is close to the subway stations. Brooklyn Museum and Botanical Gardens are at a walkable distance, and so are restaurants and bars. Today, when I was leaving, I was pleasantly surprised, when Rivka offered freshly baked cookies! 

Overall, it was a delightful experience. Highly recommended.

Rivka was an excellent host. We unfortunately did not get to meet her however, she was extremely accomidating and had 2 beds made up when we arrived in addition to some cookies! We had one small issue getting in however, it was quickly resolved and Rivka was very responsive. The apartment was clean and had everything we needed including some extra blankets and towels. The area is pretty centrally located. We went to a show in Prospect Park and walked both ways ~20 minutes. Overall, we had a great stay and would recomend it to anyone! Thank you Rivka!

-Emma

I contacted Rivka looking for a same day booking as I'd been let down by a previous booking. She was so sweet about it and only asked that I give her a couple of hours to get it ready.
She was so welcoming and showed me on some local maps of the best way to get around and she was so enthusiastic about the local area which was so nice!
If you're looking to get into city, it's perfect t. Direct 2 or5 trains into Manhattan with 3 nearby as well.
The flat is lovely and the bed was super comfy; I slept so well every night. Rivka even provides tea and good coffee and even baked a yummy pastry which I could help myself too!
I would 100% stay again and am looking forward to exploring more of the area!

Very homey feel, very safe room to stay in. Awesome experience! Not to mention our host Rivka was the best! Very awesome easygoing person. She even sent us home with some delicious home baked cookies!!
This was a wonderful place to stay. Rivka was very accommodating and the location was less then a 5 min walk to public transit. I would definitely recommend it.
I loved space, it was just right. It looks just how it does in the pictures.
Rivka's warmth and hospitality really made the stay a lovely one. And the bedroom was super spacious and comfortable. Highly recommended!

She is  a suprehost. I travel a lot with airbnb and she was the best. Rivka help me a lot and give me a good tips where to go. She was so nice and i had so much to talk with her. The room is in good size and very clean. The bed is so comfort. I was feel like home. Thank you!

Rivka was so lovely, she was very flexible with check out and let me keep my stuff at her house till 6pm when I could check into my next place. She even made delicious cookies for guests! I would highly recommend her place to stay.
Çok konuksever birisi ve sorularıma çok detaylı cevaplar veriyordu. Benimle gerçekten iyi ilgileniyordu. Teşekkür ederim Rivka!
Rivka place is great, I really enjoyed my time there and I will love to go back. The area is unique and quiet and the apartment is clean and confi . I had a really good and pleasant time.

A very comfortable, simple cozy setting - totally clean -the best bed I've ever slept in and the host is sweet helpful warm patient and exactly what I was looking for. I did not realize it was on the fourth floor, and had a suitcase which Rivka carried up the stairs for me. She saved me and my back.

Location was very well . Subway was very close you can use subway 2 and 5 so you can go easily everywhere rivka was helpful she gave more information about the new york I recommend this home strongly:)
We had a great time staying with Rivka! She gave us fantastic advice about using the subway to get around town and overall provided a wonderful experience.

My wife, daughter and I stayed with Rivka during our trip to New York. We were not sure how we would feel staying in the same apartment as the host but Rivka is so friendly and accommodating that we felt like were staying with an old friend. The place was clean and in a great location.  Look forward to visiting again.
The location is great, its only 2mins walk to the subway station, which is very easy for us to get to Manhattan and many tourist attractions. Rivka is also a very nice host. I recommend her place.

There are two things i wanna to add. The apartment is on the forth floor and there is no elevator, so if you have many luuages you  need to consider it. And i suggest you to bring a earplug when you sleep for the reason that the sound of the heating raditor is loud when it is working in the midnight.
Everything else are fine and the owner is very kind and nice too. She cooked some delicious cookies for my friend and i.
Appartement agréable avec hôte très accueillante! Proche métro

Excellent place to rest in Brooklyn and enjoy NYC, Highly recommend, nice quiet, affordable, dont think about it twice, Rivka is cool and would help on everything, cook for you too ! We are coming back  Greetings from Albania

Staying at Rivka's place it was amazing for us. We even forgot that it was Airbnb. Besides the perfect location, cleanness, communication and pricing Rivka is such an awesome person. We're really happy about staying over there. Also, she knows how to cook. Really. Her place is really, really well located. Literally 2mins from subway, restaurants, groceries, coffee shops and such. She has a cozy place and we felt like home.
Host is super nice, and the apartment is super convenience.
rivka was super cool and let us check in last minute. very flexible and easy going. getting there and getting in was a breeze.  the apartment's in a dope spot close to prospect park.

Staying at Rivka’s was beyond what I expected! I moved to NYC and stayed with her for over a month and a half while I was figuring out permanent housing. She provided the most hospitable situation I have ever encountered anywhere. She treats you like you are staying at a close family members house and goes above and beyond to make you feel comfortable. Fun conversations, movie nights, and dinners were just some of the highlights of the stay. Staying here is good for introverts and extroverts because you have the space and quiet you need but also the social interactions. I’m honestly honored to have met such a great person and I now consider Rivka an actual friend even after I left her house!

name: Stylish, Bright & Airy 4 Room Loft in Williamsburg
summary: Our home is a very spacious and beautifully designed railroad apartment, with a huge kitchen and dining room, bedroom and living room. We have lovely hardwood floors throughout, and an adorable vintage bathroom. While very centrally located in Williamsburg, the apartment and street are fairly quiet. Amazing restaurants are all around us, and the subway is just 3 blocks away.

neighborhood_overview: Williamsburg is the epicenter of Brooklyn as a fashionable worldwide brand. The neighborhood may have rents higher than Gramercy and more crowds than Soho, but it’s popular for a reason: The quaint streets are lined with inventive New York restaurants, rooftop bars and eclectic shops, and throngs of people flock to the waterfront for flea markets and giant food bazaars during the summer. Once among the city’s most industrial neighborhoods, Williamsburg emerged as the gritty epicenter of New York’s counter-culture in the late 1980’s. The plentiful supply of dormant factories and warehouses served as a useful landscape for many of the city’s most significant and pioneering visual artists, musicians, poets, and experimental theater. By the late 90’s, Williamsburg became an international icon as a “hipster-haven” and a hotbed of youth culture. Today, Williamsburg remains one of New York’s most vibrant and trendy neighborhoods; and a destination for those seeking chic restaurants, independe

host.host_location: New York, New York, United States
host.host_about: Travel lovers from Jeddah/Paris/London and Portland, OR looking to share our home!

reviews.comments: I booked Mo's apartment last minute for my mother who was visiting, and it was perfect for her. The apt is actually a lot bigger than shown in the photos, which was a nice surprise. The building is quiet and the bed was extremely comfy. The apartment is really nicely decorated, and most of their personal items were put away, so it didn't seem like we were invading someone's home. It was also immaculately clean. I will definitely book here again!

Mo's place is amazing! Three blocks from the L train, in a really cute and upcoming part of Williamsburg, with lots of nice bars and restaurants on the block. The apartment is really spacious and super clean. We didn't really use the kitchen, but it was huge and fully stocked, and the dining room has this amazing, huge concrete dining table. They have a nice desk space to work at and a really comfy bed and sofa to lounge around on. The apartment is pretty quiet, even though it's a busy area, and we slept well. They also cleared out their bespoke looking copper clothing rack in the bedroom for us, which was really nice. The host was easy to contact and checked us in relatively last minute. I would recommend this place to anyone! Great value, huge space and super charming vibe!
Lovely loft near the cool places in Brooklyn!
Perfect Place,  Comfortable,  Open, Sunny.  Great location, easy subway access.  Nice neighborhood.   Can't wait to stay again!
This trip was Perfect, Ann is very helpful and receptive, we recommend Ann !
Stacy was such a sweetheart

Ann is a fabulous host! I had a bumpy start to my trip with another Airbnb and Ann graciously accommodated my LAST minute late night request. She went well above and beyond as a host, super friendly and well organized! Her home is fantastic! It’s spacious, clean, homey, comfortable, perfect location. Honestly was by far the best Airbnb I’ve stayed in! The apartment is 4th floor walk up, but I didn’t mind, her home is well worth it and we all could use an extra booty boost! It’s a large apartment in NYC standards, and well equipped with the essential home items one may need when traveling. I was so comfortable and at home I was sad to leave after my week stay! I would 100% recommend booking with Ann if you have the opportunity, you will not regret it! My opinion… THE best Airbnb in Brooklyn area… and that’s coming from someone who travels A LOT!  Thank you Ann!! You Da Best!

We spent 4 wonderful days in this beautiful, clean and spacious apartment. Ann has been very helpful and reactive to our requests.The area is very exciting and vibrant.
From the start to the end, we enjoyed every minute of our experience there.
Thank you Ann for your kindness !
The apartment was adorable with a lot of sunlight. Walkable to restaurants in the area, and our hosts were very communicative and helpful in making our stay great!

For anyone wanting to stay in Brooklyn this is the perfect spot. The apartment is located in the eastern part of Williamsburg, away from the buzz around Bedford but close enough to walk there as well as to Bushwick. And with the L train only three blocks away (and more options available just a little further away) it's very handy to go anywhere in the city. The neighborhood itself also has a lot to offer and the hosts helped us out with several terrific bar and restaurant recommendations. Don't miss the Taiwanese place on the corner!

The apartment itself is nice and spacious and had everything we needed on our four-day stay. Nothing to complain about whatsoever.

Finally, the hosts: Everything worked perfectly there as well. Quick and easy communication, helpful recommendations and super friendly.

Once again, if you're looking for a genuine Brookyn place perfectly located yet away from the most crazy parts of Williamsburg, this is for you.

Mo and Stacy were easy to communicate with, personable & responsive in email & text. (We did not have the opportunity to meet them in person.) The subway was an easy 3 block walk and we commuted to Manhattan every day (about 20 min). There are 4 flights of (Website hidden by Airbnb) keep this in mind when packing. As Mo/Stacy told us, the lock was tricky...don't give up! We basically only slept and showered at their place but found it to be clean and comfortable. I always travel with an extension cord, which was helpful for charging purposes near the bed. Thank you again, Stacy & Mo!
Great place!
Nice apartment at Good location. Lots of bars and restaurants in the neighborhood. Unfortunately the bikes were not available.

This is a really great & big apartment at a nice location in Brooklyn. Stacy was easy to communicate with and responded really quickly to our questions. The Subway (L-line) is an 4 min. walk & takes you directly to Manhatten.
We spent 2 wonderfull weeks at their apartment.
This is a cool space, located close to the L train and near many nice restaurants. Stacy is a wonderful host.
Great Location, easy parking, classic railroad style.

I am very happy to stay at Mo & Stacy’s place. I could not meet them in person but communication was easy enough. There are many cool cafe and restaurants nearby which I enjoyed a lot. This place is big enough to stay 3 people and it is very stylish. I highly recommend this place for all !
Mo & Stacy's place is cozy, clean, in a great location, and a great price. Can't reccomend it enough.

Mo & Stacy’s place was very cool and was exactly what I was looking for to spend a weekend in Brooklyn. They provided all amenities needed and more! I would definitely be prepared to struggle slightly with getting the doors open into the apartment, but Stacy provided very descriptive instructions which made it a lot easier. I would definitely recommend staying at Stacy and Mo’s apartment and would love to stay again.

This apartment is wonderful to stay in; felt like I was a Brooklynite again. Great decor, convenient location to the subway and great surroundings. Delicious restaurants within walking distance and thoughtful amenities provided. Stacy was very responsive and helpful. Would definitely love to stay here again!

L'appartement de Stacy est très bien situé, proche du métro et des commerces. Il est également très pratique et bien équipé. 

Stacy a été vraiment disponible et réactive à chacune de mes questions et nous a donné toutes les bonnes adresses du quartier ! 

A réserver sans hésitation ! :)
Beautiful and clean railroad-style apt. Large space. Quick communication. All around, a great deal. I highly recommend.
We really enjoyed our place with Stacy. The environment was described, most amenities were available , great location and excellent communication with her.  I would definitely recommend!

We found the address easily and located the keys as it was described by the host. The flat Is on the third floor of an old apartment and without a lift you have to have really light bags. 
The first impression is not the best with heavy odour in the building and old stairs. 
Flat is nice and bright with character. The bed is placed in a space between living room and kitchen with no window. So in summer trips you have to consider leaving both doors open to have fresh air but the trade off is the noise and lights from the street. It is a good size apartment  but the facilities and amenities both in kitchen and bathroom are not adequate if you are on business trip. We struggled to have shower as the bath tub kept blocking.

No dishwasher no washing machine no iron and iron board which you would need if you are staying more then few days or have limited outfit that you have to wash and iron 

There are cafe and restaurants nearby and a big market if you want to have your coffee brewed at home in the mornings as there was no tea or coffee supplied for guests otherwise.

Stacy was kind enough to let us check in early morning with a little extra cash payment to the cleaner
Our overall judgment for the place was that it needs a little improvement and review pricing.

Thanks to Stacy and Mohammed for helping make my stay in NYC so great! The apartment has everything you need and is within easy walking distance to restaurants, stores, bars and the subway. Stacy also provided me with a list of recommended local services, stores and places to eat, which was super helpful! Thanks again for your great hospitality!
Great location next to the metro. Easy street for Uber and Lyft to get to.

Stacy’s place was great. The metro was like 5 mins away, location was safe and her apartment had everything I needed. If you have heavy luggage like I did though, just make sure you can hike it up 3 flights of stairs I had a suitcase that was 50lbs and it was rough going up which is described in her listing. Other than that, you’ll really enjoy the place!
房東的家很有異國風情,傢俱和擺飾很用心,床很舒服,鄰居很安靜,附近的餐廳Win Son/ Champs/ Ozi都非常不錯;唯獨房子在四樓無電梯,若帶大行李要考慮喔｡
Stacy’s place is large for NYC, brightly lit, and full of greenery. A very nice place to crash at the end of a full day.

Stacy's apartment was super stylish and very spacious! She was super helpful and even let me use her private amenities that I had forgotten myself.

I had never been to Brooklyn myself, so my only comments would be that I wished I did a little more research on the area before I went! Know the subway routes, because there are a few sketchy stops along the way. No cabs in the area, so make sure you have Uber or Lyft!
Stacy's apartment was beautifully decorated. Great location in Brooklyn.
Stacy has a very spacious and delightfully decorated place. The quiet building and convenient location made for a great time in Brooklyn.
Great property and great location. I only stayed for one night but was able to find/do everything I needed. Easy check in and out. Thank you
Stacy's place was perfect for my Mom staying in the neighborhood for the holidays. The apartment was big, clean, and perfectly located. She loved it :)

Stacy and Mohammed’s place was comfortable, roomy, bright and perfectly located to discover the cafe and bar gems hidden in the neighbourhood and travel around NYC (the L train is a three minute walk). We loved making their spot our home base for our trip and highly recommend their place!
Stacy was a great host and I would stay at her place again.

I spent 4 weeks at Stacy’s place and it was my home away from home. The place was way bigger than I expected and super roomy. The decor is boho chic and she had all the amenities you would need for a stay. 

The neighbourhood is good - in Williamsburg and a quick walk to the Montrose L Train which will take you to Bedford (in my opinion the best area in Brooklyn for shops, dining, etc) or to Manhattan really easily!

Stacy was a responsive and helpful host! Would definitely recommend if you’re looking for a spacey one bedroom and a launching pad to explore Brooklyn.

reviews.comments: Jackie was a great host. She left us tonnes of information about NYC, and gave us all the tips we needed to ensure our stay was wonderful. Her apartment is lovely and comfortable. And the location is great too.

This is the best place to stay in NYC in every way:  location, comfort, a gorgeous apartment, and helpful host. We enjoyed a week here eating and going to the theatre. It is so easy to take subways, the bus, or walk, or a city bike from Jackie's place. We will return!

name: Sunseekers Walk To Kamaole Beach I
summary: One Bedroom Apartment With Large Lanai With Ground floor, super clean unit in one of maui's favorite south kihei complexes. Across the street from the great kamaole beach park. Six tennis courts, three pools and lots of barbecues.Rate includes 14.42% local taxes.
