reviews.comments: The wife and I spent five days at Mark's apartment in Kihei. It is a great place - very comfortable, clean, well furnished and well lit, a couple of minutes walk from Charley Young beach and located close to the major highways of Maui. Mark was super responsive to emails and our entire stay went very smoothly. Would definitely recommend this place to any of our friends.
Great location with well stocked apt.
Our host, Mark was very prompt and friendly in our communications. He shared information about his place as well as giving us some advice about nearby restaurants.
Nice and clean place to stay in Kihei.a lot of amenities...great location... Absolutely recommend

The description of the apartment was very accurate. Mark gave us all the resources necessary to enjoy our stay in Maui and really let us do our own thing. You get a real local feel of Maui and it served as the perfect home base for when we decided to check out other parts of the island. All in all, you get what you pay for, and I'd recommend this apartment to friends & family.
We enjoyed the stay and proximity to everything!
Mark answered my questions quickly and provided the items that I needed. He resolved the door code issue fairly quickly.

L'acces au logement se fait vraiment facilement et ce, via un code. Un beau panier de produits locaux nous attendait pour notre arrivée. Tous les produits ménagers (papier toilette, savon vaiselle, savon linge, etc.) étaient fournis. Tous les articles de plage ainsi qu'un lit de bébé étaient disponible. 
Belle piscine! A proximité de belles plages, restaurants et supermarché. 
Le complexe date des annees 70 et l'appartement ne semble pas avoir été renové depuis.
Host was very responsive and communication was clear. Place was just as  described but could have been a bit cleaner.
交通很便利,马路对面就是海滩｡房间设施很全,房东想得很周到｡房东很友善,我们误把房间的东西带走丢在租车公司,房东还主动去取回了,很感谢｡在基黑的几天很愉快!

Ladies and Gentlemen,

this condo is superb! It is so well located in Kihei, a pretty laidback town with lots of nice restaurants and spare time activity offers, right next to the beach.
The appartment is fully equipped with everything you need for an outstanding beach vacation. Chairs, towels and snorkeling equipment. First we were worried, because we flew only with carry-ons but Marks appartment had everything we needed and did not bring by ourselves. 

Also, it is very clean and has an AC. The tennis court is right next to the appartment door as well as the BBQ area. 

Mark did provide us with all required information upfront so that a smooth check-in was possible.

There is nothing left to say besides: Thank You for this amazing experience Mark.

Mark's Sunseekers apartment is a wonderful place to stay! Mark is a fantastic host and went beyond expectations to make us feel very welcomed (and special!). The apartment has everything you need to relax, make dinner, enjoy breakfasts on the lanai. Plus there is a pool and a BBQ area very close by - both of which are very nice and we made good use of them. The apartment is clean and well equipped. The location is great. We spent a day in our car exploring the beaches and snorkel spots north of Kihei, and the next day doing the same south of Kihei. Just wonderful. Highly recommend both this accommodation and this location. I hope we can come back sometime.

Great Location Your will not have to go looking for amenities Mark has thought of everything you will need. He also took extra step by leaving such a nice gift for your arrival. We will definitely come back here.

Mark's house is very good!
so, recommend

Perfect place to stay with my little family.  It had a nice pool to cool off, all the things you need for dining in.  Close to the beach and to resteraunts and stores.  When I had an issue with chevking out in time (totally my fault) Mark was there wen I called and was understanding snd helpful.  I would totally stay here again if the opportunity ever arose.

Great location! Super clean, comfortable and well furnished. Responsive host who provided unexpected condo amenities upon arrival. Look forward to staying again at Mark's place as soon as I am able to return to Kihei!

We loved our stay.  The place was great:  clean, nice furnishings, and well located.  We used the BBQs and the pool in the complex. Parking good: never had a problem finding a good spot near the unit.  Mark also provided beach toys (example boogie boards) which were a lot of fun for the kids.  The unit was spacious, with large closets.  The in-unit laundry was a huge bonus.  Great location - a short stroll away from a lovely beach to watch the sun set.  Highly recommended!  Would love to stay here again.

Bei Mark fühlt man sich vom ersten Augenblick an wohl! Alles ist sehr sauber und heimelig eingerichtet. Das Appartment hat Vollaustattung, es ist von der Waschmaschine bis zum Geschirrspüler alles da. 
Es wird auch alles für den Strand angeboten, inkl. der tollen Tommy Bahama-Stühle! 
Ein paar Willkommensgoodies machen das Ankommen sehr angenehm. Jederzeit wieder würden wir bei Mark einchecken!! Mahalo
OK place given the location.
The host canceled this reservation 248 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.
Great location, walkable to many beaches and restaurants. Well equipped with the things we needed.

Mark's location on the south portion of Maui was only walking distance from several beaches and restaurants. You will truly enjoy staying here. There are also several amenities which include a pool, BBQ, and tennis courts! This place was truly a nice "home away from home" to return to after a long day of exploring Maui. Mahalo and aloha for now!
Great place.  Great location.  EVERYTHING you need and more.

We were 3 girls and stayed a whole week in Marc's apparment. We had a blast. The condo had everything we needed. From beach towels and beach  umbrellas to kitchen supplies. Beach and pools we're super close. Marc responded immediately and was a great host. Definitely a good place to stay on Maui.

Great location in Kihei. The condo is nice and well kept. Close to amazing beaches and we loved the atmosphere in Kihei. Mark has everything you need. Snorkeling gear, body board, beach towels, chairs and umbrellas. We loved our stay!

Mark's place is really nice and practical! It has all the amenities you need for a relaxing beach holidays: beach towels, umbrella, and chairs. I even saw fins, which we did not use since we had ours.
It is quite big for 2 people, stays cool during the day so no need for AC, the terrace is directly on the grass so very nice to have breakfast, it has a washing machine in the apartment, it is quiet, and you do not need a key as it is a keypad with an access code so no risk to lose it. 
The kitchen is well equipped with everything you need and You can have a BBQ just 30 seconds away! 
The swimming pools are nice even if they are small. The best thing is going to the beach in 5 minutes, especially early in the morning. Plan on snorkeling and seeing turtles there!
There is plenty of parking spots. Don't forget to get your parking permit!
Being in Kihei allows to go easily everywhere on the island. One of the best spots to buy food is ABC (2 minutes drive).
Finally, Mark is easy to contact and replies in minutes to your questions and makes you arrival in Maui event nicer with a nice basket of gifts. He really practices the Aloha! 
If we ever come back, we will most probably contact him again.

Sehr schöne Wohnung, komplett ausgestattet, tolle Lage (auf der anderen Straßenseite schon der Strand; Restaurants/Kneipen + Einkaufsmöglichkeiten fußläufig erreichbar; Surf-Schulen fußläufig erreichbar).
Haben uns hier sehr wohl gefühlt. 
Vielen Dank für alles!

We had a great time at Mark's.  The location was great and we were within walking distance to a beautiful low key beach and to restaurants. Beach towels and chairs were provided as well as kitchen stuff. we had a wonderful time!

Everything was amazing as described.!!! :) I've enjoyed staying this place very much. Mark gave us 3 hrs early check in due to our early arrival from international flight. Super sweet!  One thing to remind to the party who might come as 4. (Only because it said this place could take 4 guests. )  Sofa bed in the living room .... is really not comfy. Me and my mom was trying to sleep in  the sofa bed. It felt like as though my body was floating on the top of bunch of squicky metal springs. It makes too much noise and sinks here and there.  So don't rely on the sofa bed. You might as well end up sleeping on dinner table chairs. Other than that I loved staying on this palce so much! ♥

Mark's place is at an amazing location since it's in between the west and east side of Maui. It's also a great place to catch the sunset at a clear day since the beach is right across it. It came with  a lot of amenities which my family and I did not expect and we are overall very impressed with his place.  I highly recommend this place to anyone looking to book an AirBnB
Great place in a great location. Mark has thought of everything and I would stay there again in a heartbeat

Mark's unit is fantastic, very clean, well kept up, and I enjoyed staying there. Large TV, Cable was fine and the WIFI worked great! Location/complex is a little old, but fairly close to a lot of shops and restaurants. Really quiet at night and overall positive experience.

This place was so well equipped for our week in Maui. 4 beach chairs, 2 body boards, large cooler bag for beach, 4 sets of fins/masks, beach towels, ketchup mustard and all the essentials in the fridge. Even sunscreen, makeup remover, mouse, bug spray and some toiletries! We also arrived to find a pineapple, bag of Maui coffee, Maui cookies and Maui chips! Can not say enough about how well stocked the place was. The parking was easy and always available, there were security guards patrolling constantly, the pool was the perfect temperature and the hose and bbq were super close to the room. The AC was super helpful for the hot trip. We didn’t need to reach out to our host during our stay bc we had everything we needed and he was super helpful when booking. I would stay here again. 
Kalie 
Mahalo
We had a great start at Mark’s location for our very first trip to Maui :) Highly recommended!
The apartment is fantastic! All necessary equipment is available and great beaches can be reached by foot. Many thanks for a great stay!

Grate place to stay, home away from home, very comfortable,  useful the chairs and the umbrellas for the beach, many towels available and grate the use of the washing and drying machine in the unit, nice the lanai on the ground floor with direct access to the outside and the table for having breakfast.
Wonderful experience!

Tv didn’t work, no signal.
Window air conditioner didn’t cool bedroom. Bedroom did not get below 79 degrees,  had to sleep on pullout couch

A really well sited apartment with everything you need for a great stay on the Kamaole Beach area of Kihei, you'll love staying here. With a cool and shady lanai looking out over a green lawn, comfortable living spaces, easy access to pool, tennis court and barbecue and plenty of parking, this is a top spot. We loved our stay here.
Loved the place and the location. Very quiet, close to the several beaches, walking distance to restaurants, supermarket, etc. Highly recommended!

This condo is everything you could need for your stay in Maui! The location is prime, the condo is clean and air conditioned. From beach towels to boogie boards, there is anything you’d need for a trip to the beach! Mark was very friendly and quick to respond to any questions or concerns about our stay! We felt extra welcome in the space with some local treats, and a delicious fresh pineapple! Mahalo, Mark!
A beautiful spot with the deck onto a great green space was lovely and close to the beach great tennis courts

Great unit and exactly as described and pictured.  Mark was a great host, accommodating to my check in time and quick to respond with any questions that I had.  Have been coming to Maui for many years and would definitely recommend Mark's condo.  Close to all amenities and literally across the road from the beach yet far enough away to avoid any road noise.  Even if you don't go to the beach, the complex has three on site pools and a few tennis courts.  The onsite BBQs were perfect for cooking and eating "at home".  There were plenty of nice extras in the unit from having a small amount of laundry soap to beach toys to a blender for making frozen drinks.  Would definitely stay again if available.

Such a great place! Perfect place for us four adults with one bedroom and the one pull out couch. Mark had everything we could possibly need, including beach chairs, umbrellas, shower and beach towels, and any type of kitchen supplies. He left a large note with all the best suggestions for the area as well as se
Hawaiian snacks and coffee! Having the laundry right there was great too. Right across the street from a great beach.

name: Nautical Nest
summary: Welcome to our bright sunny, clean and airy newly renovated 1 bedroom, one bath hale. Sip a cup of coffee and watch the sun rise right outside your front door :) Better yet take a 10 minute walk to the beach and watch it rise from the ocean! Restaurants, stores, and coffee shops are only a 5 minute walk away as well.
space: Our kitchenette has everything you need- fridge, microwave, sink, coffee maker, hot plate, rice cooker/crock pot & toaster oven. The living area has dining for 4, flat screen with all movie channels and Sunday Ticket, and a queen size futon (doubles as extra bed) for snuggling on a rainy day. There are plenty of windows to let the ocean breeze blow through.
description: Welcome to our bright sunny, clean and airy newly renovated 1 bedroom, one bath hale. Sip a cup of coffee and watch the sun rise right outside your front door :) Better yet take a 10 minute walk to the beach and watch it rise from the ocean! Restaurants, stores, and coffee shops are only a 5 minute walk away as well. Our kitchenette has everything you need- fridge, microwave, sink, coffee maker, hot plate, rice cooker/crock pot & toaster oven. The living area has dining for 4, flat screen with all movie channels and Sunday Ticket, and a queen size futon (doubles as extra bed) for snuggling on a rainy day. There are plenty of windows to let the ocean breeze blow through. The access to the one bedroom is along the walkway to the left of the main house. There is a patio area for grilling, and a seating area outside unit. A washer and dryer are available during your stay. Please contact host for access. We are available 24/7 via call or text, and live on the property. We have had guests in
neighborhood_overview: Awesome location! Just a 10 minute walk to Kailua beach and only a 10 minute drive to the world famous Lanikai Beach. 5 minute walk to Aikahi shopping center, home to many new restaurants including Nico's Pier 38 Kailua and Hawaii Hot Pot ShabuShabu and Sushi! We are conveniently located in a main street making it very easy to hop on H3 to head to Waikiki, Honolulu, airport and Pearl Harbor. It is just under 4 miles to hop on the scenic route to the North Shore. Kailua is such a cute little town, we waited almost 10 years to find the right home and this is exactly where I dreamed of raising my family.
notes: -Trade winds blow rain in, so please close all windows when you leave the unit. -Hot water takes awhile to get to the unit (old house) -Please call or text upon arrival. -Please call or text when you need to do laundry. -Please recycle with bins provided
transit: Bus stops in both directions located just a minute walk down the road. We also have bikes and kayaks for your land and water transportation :)
access: The access to the one bedroom is along the walkway to the left of the main house. There is a patio area for grilling, and a seating area outside unit. A washer and dryer are available during your stay. Please contact host for access.
interaction: We are available 24/7 via call or text, and live on the property. We have had guests in the past, who have stayed for a week without us seeing or hearing them. We have also had made many new friends who have joined us for a BBQ's and beach!
house_rules: - Quiet Hours 9 PM- 6 AM - Laundry Hours: Contact Host

host.host_about: I'm a preschool teacher turned play at home Mom. Living the dream raising 1 boy, one girl here in paradise with the coolest guy in the world (my husband Bret). We live a very healthy, super active lifestyle and love to be surrounded nature. We try to live life to the fullest and love traveling, eating good food, trying new things and meeting new people :)

reviews.comments:
Bret and Shawna's place was perfect for our little family. They were communicative and gracious hosts through and through. 

We loved our stay and would totally recommend it!

I had a great stay overall, the place was clean (never saw a insect inside which is unusual for Hawaii), well appointed (couldn't think of anything I wanted or needed that wasn't thought of), safe (well lit outside and gated).  

The only reason I am giving a score of four is the road noise.  The property which is attached to the side of a residence is on a main road.  The unit doesn't have air conditioning which most homes in Hawaii don't, as utilities in Hawaii are expensive and nighttime temperatures don't nesastate it.  So having all the windows open at night will make quality sleep a challenge especially if your a light sleeper.

The owners were friendly, helpful and communicated well both before and during my stay.

Aloha!
A great house in Hawaii, enjoy it!!!

It was fantastic stay for our family. very close to the beach, supermarket, some restaurant, bus stop... really nice place! Bret, Shawna and their kids are really friendly and we have appreciated to their kindness.

Walking distance to beautiful beaches, driving/biking distance to the famous Lanikai. We got to catch 3 sunrises over the nearby beach--highly recommended! Clean, comfortable, very functional space to stay! The hot plate was great for us to save a little money on a few dinners. We never had trouble with parking by the house. It was easy to feel at home here! We had an amazing time!

Shawna and Brett were hands down the best! The first place we were going to stay fell through and we needed a room last minute, within an hour of contacting them we were at their amazing beach cottage. 

They greeted us with the sweetest most genuine smiles and made us feel welcome from the beginning. 

They let us use their bikes and double kayak even going the extra literal mile to drop us off in a sweet spot where it would be most conviennent to put in at. 

The place is a short walk to the beach, clean, has a little kitchen, is private, and the best little place ever. It had everything we needed and then some. We weren't bothered that it didn't have air as we felt like we were sleeping on the beach with the air that circulates naturally from the ocean breeze. 

We will most definitely go back. Hopefully sooner than later and if you need a place to stay, go stay with Shawna and Brett!!!
Shawna's place is in a great location, is quiet, and comfortable. I'd stay there again!
I enjoyed my stay.

We absolutely LOVED our stay at this AirBNB spot. The location was so perfect. We were close to shopping, restaurants and the BEACH! They let us use their beach chairs and even a volleyball. It was much bigger than I expected. It had everything we needed, and it was SUPER clean! I am so glad we stayed there.
Cute little place and fit our budget and had everything we needed for our stay. The price was great for my budget and was a good value.
A lovely place to stay. Would come back and stay!!

Bret and Shawna are great hosts.  Completely available and unobtrusive at the same time!!! Very warm and delightful people!
The little place is well maintained, in a great location, and it is a treat to step out the door and immediately see lovely flowers! I have stayed in or near Kailua several times and Shawna's Nautical Nest is a very good value. While cozy, the living area with a futon and bedroom area separate allows for options a studio would not.

Shawna and Bret were very friendly and welcoming hosts. They provided a queen size air mattress in addition to the bed and futon for us to sleep on. Check in and check out was easy and their place was only a short walk to the beach. There was plenty of parking available on the street. I would highly recommend this place to anyone!
Everything is great
Great place to stay! Close to interstate and beach. Quiet place. Nice surf board decoration. Made us really feeling some of the islands spirit. Lovely hosts.
Shawna's homes were beautiful and cozy in a great location only a short walk to the beach.  Her and her family were amazing hosts.  We would absolutely stay again!

Shawna and Bret are great hosts! They make you feel at home and are super accommodating. The place is super clean and filled with all the little necessities you didn’t even know you needed. After leaving a dress at their place they even reached out in order to get it back to us. It would be a pleasure to stay with them again. 10/10

I spent 9 days with Shawna and Bret in their home-away-from-home Nautical Nest.  Our little suite was perfect for us.  It was clean, pleasant, and nicely decorated and stocked with everything you'd need.  The bed in the bedroom was very comfortable, and the futon in the living room worked just fine for my daughter.  The many ample windows allowed the gentle trade winds in.  There was no AC, but certainly there was no need, as we were never overly warm.  Best of all, Bret and Shawna were themselves warm, welcoming, and helpful.  They have a sweet, calm lab, Bella who greeted us friendlily from time to time, and two quiet little kiddos who toddled around the front yard from time to time but who were never noisy.  Also, and this is a big plus, they have 3 bicycles and a couple of kayaks to you to use for free.  Bret will even help you load the kayak onto your car.  The beach is an easy 10-15 minute walk or 5 minute bike ride away, and the shops and restaurants in Kailua town center are only a 10 minute drive or 20 minute easy bike ride away.  All-in-all, a great place to stay, out of the commotion of Waikiki, but yet only 20 minutes away from the airport, Downtown Honolulu, Hanauma Bay, or many cool hikes.
What a great place and location. The unit was clean and had everything needed for our stay. Also Bret and Shawna were wonderful, friendly hosts and communicated things well.
Shawna and Bret were so fantastic and welcoming. We highly recommend staying here, it’s so central to everything and the hosts are great and so welcoming.

Shawna and her family was a great host!
The house was better than I expected! It was very nice.
My family enjoyed so much!
I want to stay here again when I visit Hawaii next time!
Thank you!
Great place to stay! Very clean! My wife and I highly recommend this site!

Shawna was so wonderful and the place was super comfortable and cute. She let us borrowed bikes and we biked to the beach, which is about 10 min away. There is a Safeway close by also. Overall it was a really nice stay and the location is great. We really enjoyed the seclusion from the main busy areas.

We had a wonderful time at the "Nautical Nest".  Shawna and Bret are wonderful hosts, going well out of their way to make our stay a great one.  It's a nice location to explore Oahu. We would love to stay again if we make it back here!

Shawna and Bret were such great hosts. They answered all our questions and let us use their beach chairs which was awesome! The place was clean and close to everything we wanted. Would definitely recommend staying at Nautical Nest!
Amazing rental! We loved everything about our stay with Shawna and Bret! Can't wait to go back!

Shawna and Bret are wonderful hosts and made sure that we had everything we needed. They even made sure to provide a play pen, books and sand toys for our kids and let them play on their trampoline! We had a great time and enjoyed being close to so many beautiful beaches. We would definitely recommend the "Nautical Nest".

Great place to stay, easily accessible and Shawna and Bret were great hosts. They let us use their beach gear so we didn’t have to rent any and overall so hospitable and welcoming. Would definitely stay here again!
I recommen this place, nice and quite
they were great. it was a lovely space with everything we needed

Fantastic place, amazing value! We loved our stay at the Hale. It's a very cute guest house with amazing beach house touches and decor. The bathroom was recently renovated and the apartment is equipped with a comfortable bed and renovated finishes like the bathroom and kitchen. Good wifi, fast communication and help from Bret and Shawna. They were extremely hospitable and made this a top-5 Airbnb stay I've ever had. Just a super cool place. But do understand there is not A/C. No A/C is common in Hawaii so we knew what we were getting into.
Shawna and Bret were great hosts. Friendly, welcoming and helpful. Anything we needed they provided. We would definitely go back if we go back to the area.

My Family and I, we had a really nice stay at Shawnas house! There was a warm welcome just as we were family members so we immediately felt at home in our holiday appartment. Beaches are beautiful in Kailua and we could use the bikes to get there. We highly recommend a stay at Shawnas home and we hope to get the chance to come here again - loved it!!!!

Upon our arrival a little attention was waiting for us to welcome us.

Really a nice place well located, near the city and services and at the same time a few minutes from one of the most beautiful beaches of the islands. A small apartment really adorable with a terrace and a bbq or we passed to the opportunity our evenings in the tranquility.

Thanks to Brett, who was particularly effective with a problem at the refrigerator. I would not have done better.

Alain and Manon
Highly recommend! Great value. Great location. Awesome hosts!!

Shawna and Bret were wonderful hosts. Very welcoming and the communication was perfect.
The apartment was exactly as described. You can reach the beaches, restaurants and shopping easily per car or bike in minutes. We recommend staying at Shawnas place and will book again next time when we are back to this beautiful area.
Thank you very much Shawna and Bret for a wonderful time!
Aloha! Carsten and Britta

Shawna and her husband are very friendly!  Our family showed up at 1:30, tired from a long flight, and they made us feel welcome and allowed us to check in then instead of wait for the check-in time.  They have a bunch of chairs and beach equipment outside their front door, which she told us to use whenever we wanted.  The location is on a busy street, but the apartment is quiet and there is plenty of free street parking.  Public beach access is about a 10 minute brisk walk.  This isn't a luxury place, but it is fairly priced for the money. 
Kailua is a great place to stay!  Plenty of good restaurants and beaches, without the frantic tourism of Honolulu.

Shawna’s place was perfect for my mom, grandmother, and me during our stay in Kailua. The location is amazing, the suite has everything we needed, and Shawna is literally the sweetest and most accommodating host ever. Would absolutely recommend this place!
The best place in Kailua.

We stayed at Shawna’s place for three nights with our two little boys. The apartment is small for four but really nice and clean. Shawna was really helpful with all kind of tips, communication was quick and easy and the beautiful Lanikai-Beach is just a five minutes drive away. We can definitely recommend this place!
Great hospitality!

Amazing spot!!! Private with great hosts and amenities! We would book it again in a heartbeat. We rented a car and found this the perfect location to see the whole island with a reasonable drive! But the bus line is feet away and a beautiful beach a short walk.

Fantastic location - away from the hustle and bustle of the town but only 5 minutes away if you want some great food or to hang out at Lanikai Beach. Also central to some great hikes like Olomana and the Lanikai Pillboxes. Lastly, Shawna and her family are super accommodating and have great recommendations for the island no matter what you’re looking to do!
We had a lovely time at Shawna's small but cute and cozy space.  No complaints.  Totally great and kid-friendly.

This was the PERFECT place for our little family for our week long vacation. My wife and I stayed here with our two younger children (8 and 6) and loved it! Shawna is the world's best host and helped make our trip be everything that it could be. Kailua is a wonderful little city with everything you will need along with some of the most beautiful scenery/beaches Oahu has to offer. Unlike the Waikiki area traffic was minimal and getting places was easy! I would highly reccomend it for a local/tourist balanced experience.

Shawna is so sweet and accommodating! She provides boogie boards, bikes, beach chairs and other beach goodies (including beach towels which is very nice!) The welcome gifts were a nice touch and the coffee was delicious!! Thank you so much, I hope to be back one day!

This was our first Air b&b stay and we were a little nervous when we first booked. All of that nervousness melted away as soon as we walked onto the property. What a nice, clean and cozy little place. Shawna and Bret were great hosts, giving us suggestions on everything from restaurants, hikes, snorkeling...  everything! There was plenty of room for 3 of us. We chose it because of its proximity to the Marine Corps base but travelled all over the island easily. I can’t say enough nice things about this experience. It made our trip awesome! If we ever get to go back this is exactly where we will be staying.

It is a best place with kids. Host has every beach stuff for adult and kids. You can use everything even bicycle!. And safeway and some restaurants are located in 5 minutes on foot. Kailua is a nice place and Shawna and her family are also nice people.

Spotless place and in a good location within walking distance to Kailua beach, grocery stores etc. The hosts were very welcoming, easy to communicate with and provided lots of beach towels and also beach umbrellas, kids toys and boogie boards that guests can borrow for a nice day on the beach. Had a great stay and would highly recommend it!
Perfect location. All the amenities needed. Easy parking. Clean space. Cute outdoor space too. Everything perfect.
Good space for one person. Kitchenette, bedroom, and living space are clean and standard.
We enjoyed our stay and how close this cute place is to the beach! Very quiet for sleeping!

This place was so cute, clean and perfect for what we were looking for.  Although we didn’t interact with Shawna very much, she introduced herself at check in, was extremely friendly and ready to provide recommendations.

The Nautical Nest is a very comfortable and clean place to stay in beautiful Kailua.  Nice decor, easy access with electronic door lock,  items for cooking, lots of towels, comfy bed and close the beach.  Shawna checked in with us a couple times to make sure everything was okay. She recommended an off the beaten path place in Honolulu called La Mariana which is one of the last original tiki bars in Hawaii. It's a restaurant as well and has great history and has been the back drop at different times for the Hawaii 50 show.  So if you're interested in that kind of thing, it's worth the drive.   Shawna is a wonderful host and her upbeat energy is amazing.  We highly recommend the Nautical Nest!

name: Lovely Apartment
space: Travel to an amazing part of Brooklyn- Here you will find the Brooklyn Museum, Prospect Park, the Botanical Gardens and a slew of restaurants that will satisfy any palette. All less than a 5min walk from the apartment.  Subway lines are close by- within a 5 -10 minute walk to the 2, 3, Q, B, A, C.  The apartment is cozy and warm. It is great for couples or families. The unit is equip with Wi-Fi, Cable, TV and a full Kitchen.
description: Travel to an amazing part of Brooklyn- Here you will find the Brooklyn Museum, Prospect Park, the Botanical Gardens and a slew of restaurants that will satisfy any palette. All less than a 5min walk from the apartment.  Subway lines are close by- within a 5 -10 minute walk to the 2, 3, Q, B, A, C.  The apartment is cozy and warm. It is great for couples or families. The unit is equip with Wi-Fi, Cable, TV and a full Kitchen.

host.host_about: I am a costumer in theater, tv/film.

reviews.comments: We had a wonderful time at Rosalynn place. The apartment is awesome and well located. The neighbourhood is nice and just near the Prospect Park which was really cool to go running in the morning. Rosalynn was a great hostess, she really cared for our well-being, it shows in the little details that makes you feel at home.

The appartment of Rosalynn is wonderful, very cosy and nice. You feel at home. Rosalynn provided us with a lot of good tips and informations. Also the location of Brooklynn was marvalous and a verry good starting point for all who visits NYC for first time. At neihborhoods you can find shops and restaurants but also museum and botanic garden and the acadamy of music and you are very close to subway station. We hope to come back soon.

I booked Rosalynn place for my mum and sister coming to visit us in Brooklyn. She has been a perfect host and her place is beautiful, clean and cosy and located near major attraction such as the fantastic botanical  garden. Thank you very much Rosalynn

Rosalynn was such a great host! My parents got a bit lost on their way there and she sent a cab for them, and when one of the pipes leaked under the kitchen sink she had someone up to look at it within hours. The apartment was indeed lovely and beautifully decorated. It's literally a stone's throw from Prospect Park though getting to Park Slope is a bit of a hike - it's about a mile to 5th Ave. Thanks Rosalynn!

Rosalynn was so generous and helpful from beginning to end - starting with graciously making sure that our four-hour-delayed flight (landing at 1am) didn't affect us getting our key. 

The apartment is adorable and cozy and clean. Everything you could want. Rosalynn's place has all the amenities one needs - and the bed was super comfortable!

The apartment has a great location, it has two tubes with three direct lines to Manhattan, so you don´t have to be changing line and in just 15-20 minutes you are already in the heart of NYC.
The area is very quiet and safe, we were with our baby and it didn´t feel insecure at all. It has few things and places to see around; like a museum and a beautiful park. It is nice to go for a walk also. Just beside the apartment has very nice coffees and restaurants, and it is full of shops where you can find anything. It is also very alive, during the week we were in there, there were so many things to do! A carnival, a night opened at the museum, a couple of gigs... 
Rosalyn did few groceries for us, she is very friendly and responds fast when you contact her and very honest. She was also very flexible with the check out time as we had a late flight.

Rosalynn has been super nice and flexible. I modified my trip during my stay at her place cutting it by 2 weeks without problems. The apartament is located near prospect park and it took me about 25 minutes to get to Union Square from there. It was clean and fully equipped.
I can definitely recommend it.

This is a great neighborhood in Brooklyn.  It is convenient to so many local activities and Manhattan.  We felt safe at all times.  Rosalynn's apartment was very clean and quiet.  There are some lovely decorative touches.  The only negative thing I have to say is directed to my husband and myself...we are getting a little old for a 4 floor walk up!

Cozy, clean, beautiful and unique home. Cool cafe right across the street (but get up early - otherwise, there will be a wait). Super close to awesome Brooklyn sites and neighborhoods, and, of course, the park - but the street is very quiet. And, Rosalynn met us when we arrived in the middle of the night! Loved our stay. Rosalynn was so gracious! She recommended some great restaurants & activities and check in to her place was super easy.  She really made us feel at home in her space.
The location could not have been more convenient.  It is around the corner from the Brooklyn Museum, the most beautiful library, Prospect Park, great restaurants  & the metro station. Travel into Manhattan & the airport was really straightforward. We also were able to walk through many neighborhoods surrounding ours, which was great for exploring. We really felt like we were in the middle of it all, but it wasn't nearly as overwhelming as Manhattan, and felt really safe.  We plan to stay here again on our next visit!
The appartement is really nice, and I absolutely love this neighborhood of Brooklyn!
Great location great value and great host. I highly recommend.

Rosalynn foi muito gentil ao nos receber. Tentou explicar um pouco sobre a casa e nos deixou bem à vontade. Nos sentimos em casa e pudemos vivenciar dias maravilhosos. O apartamento é muito bem localizado e bastante confortável. O único porém foram as escadas, mas nada que atrapalhe a estadia.
This is a nice, quiet apartment in a great location in Brooklyn.
This is a great place! A perfect location; clean. It's a great space. I would definitely recommend this apartment -- you won't regret it!
The host canceled this reservation 7 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.

I chose this spot because of its location and it did not disappoint. Easy walk to the subway, good food, Brooklyn Museum, and Prospect Park. It was comfortable and convenient. I was totally fine with the 4th floor walk up, but make sure that you are really comfortable bringing your suitcase up and down all those stairs. Folks in the building were friendly. 

When I had a little Internet problem, Rosalynn responded quickly. There were a few things in the home I couldn't figure out (how to turn on the living room ceiling fan and how to keep the bedroom fan on without lights), but they weren't a big deal and I'm sure Rosalynn would have responded quickly if I had asked her about it. The A/C worked great, especially considering the August heat and humidity. 

One thing to note is that it appears that the host lives there, and just stays elsewhere when it gets rented. I like that because it means I'm helping someone with their rent rather than renting an airbnb-only space which takes away valuable housing in a gentrifying community. The only downside is that there isn't much space for your own things. Probably not a big deal for short stays, but possibly an inconvenience for longer visits. There wasn't space for me to unpack my suitcase and the fridge/freezer are half filled.  I also felt nervous touching/disturbing any of her things  (the host didn't give me any indication that she cared, it was my own hang up). I guess I'm just trying to say that it was a good reminder that I'm renting someone's apartment, not a hotel room.

I enjoyed it overall and would totally consider coming back next time I'm in town.

Rosalynn lakása tökéletes helyen van, 4-5 percre a Brooklyni múzeumtól, parktól, metrómegállótól, mégis nagyon csöndes és biztonságos helyen. Mivel Rosalynn a lakásban lakik ha nincs vendége, kicsit kevés a rakodóhely, de ez minket nem zavart.
Rosalynn köszönünk szépen mindent! Tökéletes kirándulás volt!

reviews.comments: This place is awesome. It is located on the garden level of a classic brownstone on a tree lined street just a few steps away from the "F" line subway. It's about 15 minutes ride into lower Manhattan. There are great restaurants nearby and Prospect Park which is totally amazing, having been designed by the same guy who designed Central Park. The hosts are great communicators and attended to all our needs. The back patio was a great respite after many miles of walking in the city. Highly recommend.

Christina and Gustavo were very nice and accommodating. The apartment was clean and is in a beautiful area and even though I set up the apartment alarm by mistake late at night once, which woke them up, they were very nice. They were also flexible in my departure time. I definitely recommend.

Great hosts & the apartment was everything that we needed for a six week temporary solution while we were waiting for our own place nearby to be ready. Conveniently located a few steps from the F train, close to many restaurants and bars with a delicious cake store on the corner, I gained 10 pounds!

I highly recommend Christiana and Gustavo's place! They are incredible hosts, always doing anything they can to make you feel at home. The studio is just as described, super clean, spacious and cozy and the location is great!
Great apartment and great location.
Great place! Right in the middle of everything, and a very comfortable bed!
Great location and clean space!

Christiana and Gustavo were kind and helpful hosts - it was easy to communicate, they made sure we had everything we needed and live upstairs from the apartment. The apartment is the basement flat of a classic brownstown, it is spacious but does not get that much light during the day. Then again, it has access to the pretty backyard. The area is brilliant, lots of exciting dining options and bars right nearby, and Prospect Park is 3 blocks away. It is also super close to the F and G train. A great place to stay in Park Slope!

Fantastic place! Big rooms and a great garden. We have had breakfast there nearly every morning. Between de birds and squirrels. Lovely,
,  Beautiful neighborhood with many supermarkets and coffe to ga places. Subway around the corner. For us uncomfortable beds for 4 persons. (To soft for us) for the rest; cannot imagine a better place to be. Near the parc, near the city near the beach.

The house is clean and comfortable and the neighborhood is perfect for families, quite, safe, close to the park and Metro.
Nice place, cleans, subway around the corner!
Christiana's home is a reliable place to stay. Its simple, clean, and close to the subway. Christiana was always quick to respond to our questions and needs.

Superb location, really convenient with subway within 1 min walk and many things around and yet a very residential and friendly neighborhood. Studio is very clean and had everything we needed, we had a great experience and would definitely stay there again. Thanks again Christiana and Gustavo!
Simple, comfortable, basic, and cozy apartment, great for 1-2 people. Easy logistics and communication, great value.

There are supermarkets a few blocks away and subway stations very near that can take you to the city fast and easy. Parks , restaurants and stores nearby. We even took the subway to the airport both times.

Best place we ever stayed in NYC! Clean, pretty near to F-train, nice neighborhood. Can’t wait to go back!

The Appartement is very clean and very well located. The garden is very pleasant. The subway is only 2 mn walking.
The Wifi works very well.
It's perfect for two persons, but not well adapted for two people because of the inconfortable sofa bed.

Christiana’s  place was great for our family of four.  Both beds are comfortable. We used the electric pump provided for the sofa bed and the kids were very happy. Great location, plenty of shops just a short walk away. Being So close to prospect park was an added bonus. And very easy to get to manhattan on the F Line.

We had a very comfortable stay at Christiana's place. The house is located in a very safe neighbourhood with a CVS pharmacy and many options to eat just around the corner. Its a walk away from the beautiful prospect park. The house has all the basic amenities and Christiana and Gustavo were there to answer our queries anytime we needed anything. Christiana was a super helpful and amazing host. the place is very well located and super safe and well connected neighborhood

name: Tara Cottage:a Haven for Relaxation
summary: An elegantly furnished cottage on park-like grounds with panoramic views of Kealakekua Bay. 'K Bay' with its unparalleled fine swimming, snorkeling & kayaking and the sacred Place of Refuge National Park are both a 10 min. drive from Tara.
space: Tara Cottage features a dramatic 300 sq. ft octagonal central room with a 15 ft apex and skylight. Furnishings include: a raised platform bed with an excellent queen mattress, Art Deco armoire, writing desk and a sitting area with an enclosed cabinet for cable TV/DVD.  There is a separate twin-beded room to accommodate a 3rd adult/older child. Tara Cottage is beautifully appointed with original artwork, fine furniture and Indonesian wood carvings and fabrics. You will also enjoy the excellent libraries of fine books, CDs and DVDs. The cottage provides high speed wifi, a full kitchen with outdoor propane BBQ and a Bosch washer and dryer. One showers outdoors in a dramatic lava rock grotto in a garden setting. The 'waterfall shower' is equipped with Grohe fixtures and side jets, for  a uniquely satisfying cleanse. Privacy is assured by bamboo fencing and the surrounding lush Thai bamboo.  On the ocean side of the cottage is a bi-level lanai with superb, unobstructed views of Kealakekua B

neighborhood_overview: Tara Cottage is located 4 miles south of the town of Captain Cook in the heart of Kona coffee country. This farming community is also known throughout the islands for its organic fruits and vegetables that are prized by fine restaurants throughout the state. The South Kona location of Tara is a relaxed 'kick-back' area populated by friendly people who frequent nearby coffee shops, as well as favorite spots to enter the water for excellent swimming, snorkeling and scuba diving.
transit: A rental car is a necessity to drive to Tara Cottage (a 35 minutes south of Kailua- Kona); to reach area beaches that are a 10-15 minute drive from the cottage; and to access favorite spots for entry into the water to swim, snorkel and scuba dive.
access: Tara Cottage is for the private use of its guests.  It provides free wifi; a landline with free calls to the other islands, the US mainland and Canada; HD wide screen TV, a full kitchen and its own Bosch washer and dryer.
interaction: I greet guests when possible within an hour of their arrival and no later than the next day.  Usually within an hour of their arrival (no later than the next day for late arrivals) I provide guests with a tour of the cottage, pointing out the Guest Bookwith useful information about the cottage, including the Cottage Rules; the Activities book full of things to see and do in the South Kona location of the cottage; and the Restaurant Guide with menus of many restaurants nearby and in Kailua-Kona. Further interaction with guests is at their discretion. However as I live in a 2nd cottage lateral to Tara Cottage (and out of its sightline),  I can easily be reached by phone to provide suggestions/recommendations and to promptly address any concerns or problems that might arise.
house_rules: Guests are provided with a page of Cottage Rules prior to their arrival, also to be found in the guestbook in the cottage. They are asked to respect my privacy  and the privacy of my cottage and its grounds, as I will  theirs. Pets are not allowed and smoking is permitted only on the grounds surrounding the cottage. The amenities of the cottage (washer/dryer, outdoor shower, wifi, etc.) are only for the use of registered guests. Also none of the fine books, CDs and DVDs within the cottage may leave the cottage.  Arrival is after 3 PM with departure no later than 11 AM unless other arrangements have been made well in advance.

host.host_about:
I have been living above Kealakekua Bay on the Kona Coast of Hawaii's Big Island since 1994. I live on Iand I developed and named Tara Farm, where I grow Kona coffee, ulu (breadfruit) and white pineapple among other fruits. 
This property is also the site of beautiful Tara Cottage. 
 I was born and raised in the Washington, D.C. area, moving to San Francisco  in 1978 to take the job of Audiologist for Alameda County; and later Director of Audiology for the Hearing Society in San Francisco. After 13 years in the SF Bay Area I moved to Kauai in 1991 and hosted a  B&B there for 3 years. The move to the Big Island followed in 1994 where I managed another beautiful B&B near Kealakekua Bay while developing my property and building Tara Cottage upslope at its  950 ft elevation. I moved onto the property full-time in 1998 and have been privileged to live here ever since.
My interests include swimming and snorkeling, playing the piano, cinema, reading and traveling.

reviews.comments: Michael's home was so lovely!! The pictures don't do it justice, it's even more magical. I thought the location was so perfect for all outdoor activities & Michael was incredibly helpful with providing advice! I'll 100% stay in this beautiful cottage again!!

We had a fantastic experience at Tara Cottage — it exceeded all of our expectations! What more could we have wanted? There were beautiful flowers, macadamia nuts, and local Kona coffee that was grown literally right outside our window. The cottage itself was absolutely beautiful. Michael gave us a nice tour of the property when we arrived, and he did everything possible to make us feel welcome. He was unobtrusive but always available to answer questions or just say hello. This was a fabulous place to stay, and I'm happy that we chose to stay here. Wouldn't change a single thing.

This place was amazing! The grounds were spectacular and so peaceful. The cottage is located on a small coffee farm with a STUNNING view of the Kona coastline. Michael greeted us after we arrived and showed us around the cottage. Otherwise, he left us to enjoy the peaceful privacy of the cottage. The cottage itself is beautifully decorated and cozy. The beds were SO comfortable (seriously, Michael, where did you get those mattresses?), and Michael truly thought of every detail to make our stay comfortable. There was extra sunscreen, mosquito spray, shampoo and conditioner, anything you would need in the kitchen, playing cards, beach chairs and umbrellas, and towels. A nice touch was the fruit basket, zucchini bread, and macadamia nuts waiting for us when we arrived. This place is truly wonderful and the perfect getaway for a relaxing vacation. We would definitely stay again! Also, if you are looking for a nice place for breakfast/brunch, check out the Coffee Shack a few miles down the road. The breakfast was great and the views were AMAZING!

I'm not sure where to even begin. Words can't describe the beauty and magic of Michael's Tara Cottage. It is obvious that he put a lot of thought and care into crafting this exquisite place! The books. The music. The linens. The decor. The dishes. The coffee. The wonderful arrival treats. THE SHOWER! That comfy bed! All glorious. The view is to die for. Pictures truly do not do it justice. The frogs. The birds. I did not want to leave! I will definitely, definitely, most definitely be back! We travel to Hawaii most years, staying on different islands.......and Tara was our favorite. Ever. Thank you, Michael for a magical stay!

Tara Cottage is a beautiful place to retreat into the the lushness of Honaunau, South Kona country side.  Michael our host has enhanced the already beautiful surroundings of  large mango trees, and papaya trees with Ti plants and bamboo. The view of Captain Cook Monument and the sunset every night make this a very special place.  The outdoor shower, privacy, and beautiful cottage interior made this a perfect get away.  We are looking forward to returning to this Hawaiian treasure.

Every time I entered the driveway to Tara Cottage I felt very happy to be back. It just starts with the well maintained property and you park your car with an impressive view. After spending a few minutes looking at the bay, you enter the beautiful furnished cottage, maybe looking already forward to another "waterfall" outdoor shower which you enjoyed 2-3 times per day...you might want to finish your day with having a BBQ on the Weber grill or just watching the impressive (Website hidden by Airbnb) soon as you relax on the bed you will fall easily asleep like you would not have (Website hidden by Airbnb) far about the cottage. Now the most important words about the host: Michael is a charming, kind and very professional host taking care of any detail you can imagine. I also enjoyed so much meeting his (now) two dogs. 
Finally: If you get the chance: reserve for a memory of your life (which I will have).

Well - it is not easy to describe all the things I enjoyed so much. Perhaps as an intro: I first booked for one week and was then very lucky that I could extend my stay for another week until the next guests would arrive. If you get the chance on airbnb that Michaels Tara cottage is free for your dates (or even for a shorter period): book it as fast as you can...
I travel (really) a lot for work and leisure around the world and this is one of the best places where I stayed so far. Thank you very much Michael for your hospitality and kindness! I hope I get the chance to come back one day!

Tara Cottage is a paradise-like place; a cozy, charming home on a gorgeous piece of land. If you are looking for a place to unwind and pamper your soul, I truly hope Tara Cottage is available on your requested dates. Michael is very kind and helpful, which made our stay even more enjoyable. We will definitely come back as soon as we can!

We stayed at Tara cottage on the last leg of our honeymoon and it was the perfect end to our trip.  The cottage and property were beautiful!  Michael was a great host and was easy to contact and talk to if we had questions.  The photos don't do it justice, we loved the outdoor shower!  We would absolutely stay again if we make it back to the island.

Tara Cottage is the ideal location if you're in the Captain Cook area. Maybe one of the most beautiful places on the whole island! It's very close to great local restaurants and stores, as well as  swimming areas like (one of my favorite snorkeling spots of the trip) Two-Step Beach. It's also just very comfortable and relaxing. You can literally stay at the house all day and be happy. Michael was always quick to respond to any questions I had, and his on-site assistant Chuck was funny, kind, and wonderfully generous with his time and knowledge of the island. My wife and I had an amazing stay here and we'd definitely come back a million more times if we could.

Tara Cottage is a gem!  Michael the host, is very friendly and welcoming.
We loved the stunning, peaceful location (about 30 minutes drive from Kona airport) with a view of the ocean and the beautiful, well kept gardens.  Everything is thought of, including some complimentary local produce, flower arrangement, books, cds, beach towels & chairs, cool box, snorkelling equipment etc.  The kitchen has a selection of condiments, cleaning and washing products and is very well equipped.  Two of the best snorkelling areas are very close by and each morning the dolphins come into the bay, which added to a very special experience.  It was wonderful to sit in the garden drinking fresh coffee which had been grown in the garden!  Great solar powered outdoor shower too! This place is so good, we didn't want to leave!   Thank you Michael

This is truly a bit of Hawaiian paradise. From the cottage you look across lawns above the coffe plantation  down the hill and out across the bay to the captain cook monument without seeing any signs of habitation -very quiet except for the occasional wild turkey or rooster. Set at about 1000 foot elevation the temperature is perfect and great to come home to when the beaches get too hot or humid. The grounds are immaculate as is the decoration of the cottage. We feel we were very lucky to find such a place for a quiet and peaceful vacation. Well done Michael!

Tara Cottage was everything Michael promised and more. He was very welcoming, always available to answer questions and knowledgable about local happenings and history. We stayed for two weeks and could not have been happier. Each day we left to explore the island hiking, swimming, snorkeling, coffee tasting, sightseeing, and returning to Tara was like coming home. Quiet and relaxing, surrounded by a beautiful garden filled with birds and a gorgeous ocean view from the lanai, we wanted for nothing! The cottage was well equipped from kitchen to laundry to water toys and a wonderful outdoor shower. Tara is close to the some of the islands best snorkeling, a great local beach and grocery store. An idyllic place to stay for couples. Michaels listing of Tara was completely accurate and the neighborhood was ideal. If we return to the Big Island we will stay here again!

This property is perfect for a couple looking to unwind. The serene setting and lovely amenities could not be better. Plan to spend time there rather than run around sight seeing. You will not want to leave.

My husband and I spent 5 nights at Tara Cottage in early June and we absolutely loved it. As so many have said, it's a beautifully-appointed cottage with many nice touches, located on a breathtakingly gorgeous property! It had everything we needed and was very comfortable and welcoming. The outdoor shower was a treat and made it feel like a spa. The fresh fruit and baked goodies we received upon arrival were most welcome and we adored the Tara Coffee. We only wish we had brought more home with us! The view of the ocean and bay in the distance was nice to gaze out on from the kitchen table and lanai. And we really appreciated how quiet Tara Cottage was! It felt private, which we really liked. The coqui frog-song at night was a real highlight for us as was the birdsong in the morning. All in all, it was the perfect location for exploring South Kona and for enjoying amazing snorkeling at Two Step (we went every day, sometimes twice) and getting to know the area. Five nights is simply not enough! We regret not taking the time to rent a kayak at Kealakelua Bay, so we need to come back for that! Michael was very gracious as was Gloria, the housekeeper. We lacked for nothing (except for ripe mangoes and white pineapples, because they weren't in season yet!). I don't think we could've found a more perfect place.

What an oasis! This property is truly a tropical retreat, surrounded by lush greenery and with an amazing ocean view. As an experienced B&B owner, Michael has stocked the house with supplies for everything you might want, from an elaborate meal to a day at the beach. He even provided us with fruit and coffee from the property to enjoy during our stay. We would definitely recommend to anyone looking for a quiet home-away-from-home.

The Tara Cottage was great! Pictures do a great job representing the place. Beautiful view and well taken care of. Outdoor shower is pretty awesome! It was very nice to have beach towels and snorkeling gear accessible at the cottage, eliminating hassle of rentals or purchasing. We had a great time and would come back! Fresh fruit from the farm was delicious!

Tara Cottage is an amazing Place with a stunning view to the Ocean. It is Nice and quiet and the perfect Place for relaxation. We were so in Love with The outdoor shower. We can highly recommend Michaels Place. He is very kind and has Great advice for you.

Such a wonderful place of the world. So beautiful and calming. The view was amazing especially at sunset. Outdoor shower was funny experience but I liked liberating feeling. I'll definitely come back.
Excellent vacation spot!

This is an exquisite cottage.  We loved our stay.  The design, setting, interior details, artifacts, artwork, views, ambience, wonderfully warm outdoor shower, privacy, and comfort.  We have stayed in many Captain Cook Airbnb's over the years, and this one is especially memorable in its elegance.

All I can say is WOW. Nestled in the hilltops among lush greenery with a sweeping, expansive view of the coastline, Michael's little home was everything we wanted it to be and more. There were so many thoughtful touches--from providing us with a gift basket filled with local goodies like banana bread, macadamia nuts, fresh fruit, and coffee grown right on the property to providing essential gear for snorkeling along with beach towels and an onsite laundry, this house has everything you need. The outdoor shower was a rustic luxury as well. Everything was stocked and so comfortable during our stay. I would absolutely come and stay again, I'm already homesick!

Where do I start? My husband and I just spent a week at Tara Cottage celebrating our 25th anniversary. It could not have been a more perfect environment for relaxing and taking in the beauty of Hawaii. Michael has put so much thought and love into every square inch of the cottage and surrounding acreage. This was our first time visiting the Big Island, but we spent just as much time lounging in the cottage, relaxing on the deck, taking in the spectacular views and going for walks in the surrounding neighborhood as we did sightseeing. It was definitely home away from home. Being upnin the mountains away from busy downtown Kona was perfect! Far enough away, yet a 15 minutes drive to downtown Kona. We will definitely be back! Thank you Michael! And thank you my friend Karen, for telling me about this little piece of Heaven!

Michael's cottage is a great space and an ideal island vacation home. Its very well stocked with anything you might need, including beach gear (chairs, towels, snorkeling equipment, etc). The views are fantastic and the location is great for exploring the Kona area. A big bonus for us was all of the birds and other wildlife (geckos!) just outside your door.

If you want to stay in a secluded place, surrounded by lush greens and incredible views- Tara Cottage is for you! This vacation getaway is dreamy! So private, beautiful, clean; with all the amenities you can think of from dishes, to blenders, to candles, to fans, to soap and shampoo, beach towels and chairs,  etc... the list goes on. We absolutely loved the outdoor shower - there is nothing like it that makes you feel more free and refreshed. The friendly geckos are the cutest and the chickens and birds that come and go are lovely to watch. The grounds of Tara are gorgeous!!! If you prefer to vacation away from everyone else and feel a sense of tranquillity and peace, stay here. Thanks again to Michael and Gloria!!

What an amazing stay we had at Tara Cottage.  Michael was an amazing host with lots of helpful tips on places to see and great dining options.  Great coffee grown right on the farm as well.  There was the fully stocked kitchen and bbq which we used to prepare our sunset dinners.  Lots of snorkeling equipment to check out Captain Cook and Two step a few minutes away.  And the amazing outdoor shower!  Book it!

Paradise found!  Tara Cottage is just as described and every bit as beautiful as shown.  If you are looking for peace and serenity close to some of the best snorkeling on the Big Island, look no further.   We fully enjoyed our stay and hope it was the first of many visits to Tara.

I just came home from spending two beautiful weeks at Michael's place and I already miss it! I decided to go to Hawaii to do a personal retreat. I arrived exhausted and burnt out and I feel very rejuvenated upon return. It's a lovely space full of thoughtful touches and located on a majestic piece of property. I loved everything about Michael, the property and the good energy surrounding the land. I had a magical time and I highly recommend it for all those seeking a quiet refuge.

Michael's place had an absolutely spectacular ocean view set on a private lushly landscaped property.  The Tara cottage was unique, charming and extremely comfortable.  This is an ideal place to relax, prepare food and enjoy the lovely Hawaiian climate.  Thank you Michael for sharing your slice of heaven with us.
The host canceled this reservation 92 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.

name: Quirky apt in great area
summary: Eclectic and bohemian two bedroom apartment in Brooklyn's trendy Bushwick neighborhood, just twenty five minutes from the city. We are a short 10 minute walk from the super convenient L and M subway lines giving you a straight shot to Williamsburg, the Lower East Side, East Village, SoHo, West Village, Midtown and more! A multitude of great cafes, bars and restaurants are right on your doorstep. We have two cats and a dog so animal lovers are a must!
space: Your home in Brooklyn is beautifully decorated with souvenirs from our travels - spacious, sun soaked and plant filled apartment on the 1st floor of a charming, pre-war house. Large sized private room with a comfy queen bed, armchair, clothing rack, ceiling fan,  TV with AppleTV (Netflix and HBO) plus cable, two large windows with tons of natural light, and plants. Sleeps 2 comfortably with bed linens provided. We also have a twin size airbed if needed. Full bathroom with tub and shower.
