neighborhood_overview: Bushwick is one of New York’s hottest neighborhoods.  A former working-class, industrial district in northeast Brooklyn (adjacent to Williamsburg), Bushwick has evolved into a bohemian enclave – home to experimental art, avant-garde performance, affordable craft cocktails and sustainable eats.  The neighborhood’s relaxed “go local” philosophy makes it easy to immerse yourself in Bushwick’s abundant culture Wander the streets and immerse yourself in the the neighborhood's world-renowned street art, take a tour of the Fine & Raw Chocolate Factory, go on a craft cocktail crawl, check out a few art galleries and sample some truly innovative cuisine to find out why Bushwick is fast becoming the new hipster epicenter of Brooklyn.
notes: We'll provide you with a unique neighborhood guide and can hook you up with tours and fun day-out ideas
transit: 10 minute walk from the Myrtle-Wyckoff L/M lines and an 8 minute walk from the Halsey St. L line.
access: Your private room and all the common spaces which consist of a bathroom, kitchen, outdoor patio, living room and entryway, you'll share with me. Please feel free to use the kitchen to cook and store food during your stay. Wifi throughout. There is typically some free street parking nearby if you are bringing a car but watch out for street-cleaning twice a week!
interaction: Interaction will vary. We live here and will be in and out with work, etc. My husband and I are happy to answer any questions before, during and after your stay.  We are friendly and outgoing and love to share our passion for eating and drinking in the city. Sometimes we might be down for a meal or a drink with guests but no pressure!
house_rules: PLEASE NOTE: We are flexible with check in times but you must arrange your check in time with us well in advance as we both work during the week and one of us will need to arrange to be home to meet you. Please text or message us with an ETA for any arrivals outside of the agreed upon check in time. For late arrivals (after 10pm) a late arrival charge of $45 will be imposed.

host.host_location: New York, New York, United States

reviews.comments: Sarah was an awesome host!

Apartment is really lovely, and is really close to the subway so it's easy to get around. Sarah and Jack were great hosts. They made me feel really welcome, were really flexible and friendly - couldn't ask for better hosts!
They are very helpful and friendly. The apartment is close to F train, so it's easy and convenient for us.

We had a great stay here, Sarah was a great host, the room is nice, the pets are adorable, there were cider and granola bars for us, the subway map and the recommendations for shops and restaurants were very helpful. And thank you so much for letting us stay longer than the checkout time because our flight only departed in the evening. We would stay here again and recommend this place to everyone. Very close to the subway, to Prospect Park and some nice food.

An excellent host and an excellent house. Sarah was extremely helpful with her suggestions and her communication, and she was really accommodating with our erratic schedule and odd arrival and departure. It was blessedly easy to get from Sarah's place to the rest of the city. Her pets were really, friendly, too. I wouldn't hesitate to stay with Sarah again on a future trip to the city.

I had a great time in NYC. The accommodation is as described. It is really close to the subway station, so I could get anywhere really quickly. Sarah and Jack were really helpful and their dog and cats were very friendly. I arrived in NY quite late, but that was not a problem for them.

Great stay, very well organized, and the room is very new yorkish, with lots of fancy little things. It's not a regular IKEA place, on the contrary many items are set to have something particular reminding of the good old days. The neighborhood was safe and the location is easy to reach with a subway or on buses. Highly recommending for the great value to anyone looking for a trip to NYC.

Sarah and Jack are awesome hosts. Their apartment is gorgeous and close to the subway which made it easy for us to get back after long days out in the city. The apartment is in a quieter neighborhood which we appreciated as it offered us a break from the bustling nature of New York City. The room is super comfortable and spacious, and the price is unbeatable for what you get. We didn't get the chance to interact much with our hosts as we were out and about but they were really friendly, as well as their pets. I definitely recommend Sarah's place!

Staying at Sarah's place was perfect for our trip to NYC, the apartment has a great atmosphere and vibe. It's located a stone throw to the subway with connections to Manhattan and further into Brooklyn. The subway took around 20-25 mins into Manhattan which was great.

Sarah and Jack are super nice friendly people who made us feel very welcome. They also provided us with lots of great tips for things to do, see and visit!

We loved their pets, they were super cute and friendly with great characters, they provided us with so many laughs and smiles during our stay. 

I would totally recommend staying at Sarah's, we are looking forward to when we can make a return trip!

We loved our stay at Sarah’s place and will definitely come back! The hosts are great, very welcoming and ready to help. The apartment is cool and stylish. The room is bright and clean with nice thoughtful touches (snacks, tips for travelers, maps, etc.). The place is very close to subway and has street parking available, if you arrive early enough. Highly recommend!
Very responsive and overall an amazing hostess. Very comfortable stay and t felt like a was visiting family or friends.
We were very impressed with how thoughtful they are with the guests stay. We had a table full of goodies and information about the city. We really enjoyed staying there.
Sarah is an excellent host. Her place is very clean, within a few minutes walk to the subway, and is very comfortable. I would definitely stay with Sarah again
The public transport is one street away from the appartment and it takes about 45 min to reach manhattan midtown
Es un lugar muy cómodo, limpio y cercano al metro, es bastante seguro. Sarah y Jack fueron muy amables, sus mascotas son adorables y muy cariñosas.
We couldn’t be more satisfied about it. Sarah and Jack are superb hosts and if we ever came back to NYC we would most likely stay with them again. Thanks for everything.

Fantastic hosts! They went out of their way to make sure we were comfortable and had everything we needed for our stay. The apartment is really close to the subway and surrounded by a bunch of great restaurants. Would definitely recommend!
Nice couple, lovely and friendly pets

Very close to the F train, which is one of the main lines running into Manhattan. Jack and Sarah are super nice, and they're very knowledgeable about the area. Lots of nice little extras, like an available umbrella if it rains, Netflix on the TV in the room, etc.
Sarah is a warm and gracious host. The place is beautiful and its in close proximity to the public transit. I'd highly recommend this place!
The host canceled this reservation 25 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.

We had a great experience here - Sarah and Jack were super accommodating and flexible. We had a late bus ride out of NYC and they let us leave our bags there past check-out time so we wouldn't have to carry them around all day. Also a great place if you're an animal person because their cats and dog are very friendly. The nearness of the subway station was also convenient; the ride into the city takes a little while, but it's definitely worth it if you're not in a big rush. I really recommend staying here!

I highly recommend staying at Sarah’s. She was absolutely fantastic. (And I’m sure her husband is too! But we were only at the apartment to sleep, so we didn’t see him very much) Sarah was so quick to respond to questions when we were trying to figure out the subway system. Thoughtful little touches. Very comfy bed. And the pets were adorable. 

The train right by the apartment is so safe and a straight shot into the city. The neighborhood was very safe as well. We rode the subway late and got home late and never once did we feel uncomfortable walking from the station to the apartment.

Sarah and her boyfriend live with their cats and a dog in a beautiful appartment in Brooklyn. The next subway and good restaurants were just a few steps away. They were both very helpful and friendly. I would be pleased to visit them again in the future.

Sarah and Jack are amazing. They have a wonderful place in a great location with an insanely comfortable bed and seriously cute animals. They made themselves readily available, too, and had great tips on places in the area to check out.

Sarah and Jack were outstanding hosts! We would definitely stay with them again. The room was so cozy and their animals were super cute! It was our first time using AirBnB and they were amazing. We would definitely recommend them!

Clean, neat,cozy place. good and safe location . Within 10minutes walk to subway and supermarket, laundry service and cafes just at the corner. Appreciate Sarah and her husband help me to get uber last minutes from her place to airport(New York Uber don't accept cash payment). I have great time with them and their dog and cats.
We had a nice stay at Sarah's apartment and would definitely stay there again.
Loved the room and the pets! Located very close to the subway and would definitely stay at again

Sarah is a fantastic hostess. The apartment is spotless and filled with life. In addition Sarah was extremely kind and she went out of her way to make sure my boyfriend and I were comfortable. If you’re looking for a homey place to stay, with an awesome hostess and a killer pizza place (Fazio) down the street. This is the place for you.

We had an amazing stay here. Thank you so much for an incredible time. Sarah & Jack were thoughtful, helpful & had some great suggestions. We can not recommend them enough. If we’re ever back in New York we would definitely stay here again.

Ik boekte deze B&B toen Sarah & Jack nog op hun vorige adres woonde. Achteraf ben ik blij dat ik “mee gegaan” ben naar hun nieuwe adres. Prettige ruime kamer in een prettige, veelal door Puertoricanen bewoonde buurt. Prettige communicatie met mijn hosts. Ze hebben een lieve rustige hond en 2 katten, van wie er 1 erg gehecht lijkt te zijn aan jouw kamer. Als je daar geen prijs op stelt, zijn je hosts je daarbij graag van hulp. Prima B&B!

Comunicazione veloce con Sarah e Jack, quando c’è stato qualche piccolo malinteso abbiamo subito risolto. I loro animali domestici sono adorabili (ma chiudete la porta se non volete averli in camera, il primo giorno soprattutto tendono ad essere entusiasti di conoscervi e potrebbero invadere un po’ gli spazi). La casa è carina, l’unico difetto è il bagno un po’ piccolo ma è funzionale, la posizione è buona ma non ottima se si deve andare a Manhattan tutti i giorni in quanto è un po’ distante, ma tutto sommato ce la siamo cavata con i mezzi pubblici. L’aspetto positivo è che abbiamo avuto un assaggio della vera NY e di Brooklyn, non quella sempre patinata di Manhattan, ed è stato interessante.
Lovely couple to stay with! Very accommodating and made me feel very comfortable from the get go
Fantastic spacious room wit garden in Brooklyn. ..great hosts...what more is required?

You won't find a better place to stay in Brooklyn. The room was very comfortable and clean with clear instructions for check-in and your stay. Jack was full of insightful tips about the neighbourhood, such as things to do and places to eat/check out. It is conveniently located for the subway system and is around really great bars and restaurants. Also, the dog and cats just add to the already great experience!
Great hosts and a charming, spacious room. Great proximity to bus and subway, cool neighborhood with a variety of eats. Easy to reach via MTA from JFK airport. In all, a really pleasant oasis in NYC.
Clean place, cool neighborhood, great hosts! Would stay with them again.

The house is located very central in Bushwick Brooklyn and that’s a great place to stay! Young, vibrant, living... Sarah is a lovely friendly host. The house is small but clean and has everything you need. ( good pub and pizza around the corner, good bed, clean shower ). Be carefull: this is not Manhattan, but hey... Brooklyn is fine!

Nice house close from the subway. 
Lovely cats and very quiet neighborhood. 
Room clean and spacious. 
Also a back yard.
We love our stay with Sarah and Jake! They were nice and respectful. It was easy to communicate with them via airbnb. Thanks guys!
Great.

Sarah and Jake are great hosts! They gave me many advices and made me feel like home. The flat is nice and well equipped, with a small cute terrace where having breakfast. Everything was perfectly clean. The location is convenient too, just 10 min walking distance from the closest subway station to Manhattan and in a very interesting and lively district which has been a great surprise for me! And don't forget the 2 lovely cats and the sweet dog that will welcome you every time you come back home! But don't worry, they are very quiet and respectful!
I highly recommend Sarah and Jake's place!
Really nice room in a great neighbourhood. Not too far from the subway (about 10 mins walk). Lovely pets in the apartment :)

Amazing host with 3 gorgeous pets!! Location is about 40mins on subway into Manhattan - closest station is about 10min walk away. Great value and Sarah is a fountain of knowledge about the area and things to do/eat! Would totally recommend staying here especially if you don’t mind the somewhat long ride into the centre of Manhattan.

First time in New York for myself and a friend, we were honestly a little apprehensive to stay in Brooklyn because we didn’t know the area much but Sarah’s place was super cute we couldn’t pass it up. Our plane got delayed about an hour so we got to the apartment later than expected. Sarah and her husband Jack were super nice and accommodating! Gave us awesome tips and the few times we were able to talk to them they were always friendly and ready to eat about our NYC adventures! Also she has the most amazing pets Ruby, Lola and Zeplin! Definitely a recommended stay, definitely will book again :)

Had a lovely stay at Sarah’s. She not only had the place all clean and ready but also added personal touches like a cold bottle of water with a glass, a bowl of chocolates. 
The apartment is 10mins walk to the subway with a convenient commute to Manhattan.

This is one of the best finds on Airbnb. It’s amazing value for money, as it’s just such a nice room and apartment in a very cool area. 
Sarah has made a guide for food, drinks and things to do in the area and New York more broadly, which is amazing. We tried several of the places on their list and they were very good. The pets are very cute and well-behaved. 

Overall, it was just very easy to be a tourist when you stay in Sarah and Jack’s apartment and I would highly recommend it.
Good place to stay. The house is about  10 minutes walk from the station. the bedroom is really quiet and we did not hear a single bark from your dog. bed and linens good. we recommend it!

Sarah and Jack were wonderful hosts. Their place was very charming and had some lovely personal touches. The room was very spacious and clean. The walk to the subway was just a few blocks and the area had some really cool spots around for coffee and food. I highly recommend Sarah and Jack’s place and I’d love to book again in the future.

El apartamento y el cuarto son enormes considerando que estás en New York. 

Sarah y Jack son muy amables, te ayudan en lo que puedan. 

Como mencioné, el cuarto es enorme y tienes todas lo necesario. El apartamento a 30 minutos de Manhattan pero muy cerca del metro que te lleva a todos lados, te da la oportunidad de realmente vivir la vida como todo un neoyorquino. Regreso sin problemas!

AMAZING DEAL! The accommodations were lovely & we enjoyed the apartment so much! It was clean, cozy, and stylish. Sarah’s communication was top notch. Definitely would recommend to anyone wanting to escape to the city for a quick vacation & definitely would stay here again!
Sarah and Jack were great hosts. Amazing location, very close to the subway, spacious room. We would definitely stay here again!

Sarah is lovely, even with my mom not speaking very good english, they managed to have conversations, she is very understanding and understandable !
Her pets are very nice and friendly, and her dog is amazingly well educated, never barks, wont jump on you.
the place it self is nice and clean, room very stylish.
however, it is an appartment, meaning theres people under AND above, which makes the place really noisy. the walls are also quite thin so we can easily hear what's going on around.
it also is about 40minutes away from Manhattan, which in our opinion was a bit too far.. 
also, make sure you can contact them at all times, because due to a 2hours delay at the airport, we almost had to find another place to sleep at (her husband was kind enough to stay up till 1am though)
Sarah was very sweet in keeping in excellent touch with me daily, as our schedule changed due to unexpected events on our end. We hope to stay with Sarah and Jack next time we are in Brooklyn!

Sarah and Jack are very nice and helpful. The subway station is a few minutes away and has a lot of stores to buy food or cofee. The bed is really confortable. They have 2 cats and a dog... they are all very sweet! We sure recommend this place to stay when you travel to NY!
Stay here! The hosts and pets are super sweet, the locale is totally convenient, and the overall stay is spectacular for the price. 10/10, would recommend.
Very stylish space, nice hosts, sweet pets, near of the subways.. So perfect!
We enjoyed our four nights in Brooklyn. Sarah's place is great, close to metro, good facilities and a chill atmosphere. The cats and the dog are cute and we highly recommend staying here.

Me and my girlfriend had a couple very nice days there. The apartment has a very good location! By walking less minutes you can get to subway stations and to some super cool supermarkets and food bazars. The pets they have are so cute and curious. That's why we enjoyed our stay there. Sarah and Jack are so friendly, and we had a good communication with them. It's typical for New Yorker apartments that they have trouble with cockroaches, so we saw some there too. But Jack and Sarah immediately did the best they could to deal with this problem and to get rid of the very little number of cockroaches we saw there. That was very helpful. We would definitely recommend this apartment to any one! And we hope to be there some day again (not just because we miss the pets :) ) And if you want to eat one of the best pizzas of your life - please taste the delicious pizza from "Tony's" nearby the apartment.

host.host_about: Hello there! Thanks for checking my listing. I would be happy to assist you during your stay.

reviews.comments: We had a great stay at Civan's, neat and practical apartment with quiet bedroom close to the subway. Good breakfast / coffee place one short block up and Empire State view, Civan will take good care of you.
Civan's place was very conveniently located, very chill, and there were good food options nearby.

L’appartement était conforme à la description faîte sur le site, toutefois l'hygiène et la propreté était limite...

Au point de vue de la situation de l’appartement, elle est très intéressante dans un quartier vivant et typique de Brooklyn, magasin ouvert 24/7 à 100m pour boisson, sandwich, petit déjeuner etc etc; sans oublier le Dunkin Donughts juste en face!!!! Le top pour commencer la journée avec une pâtisserie et un coffee!!! De jolies petit restaurant dans les environs, nous recommandons particulièrement SUD, vino e cucina situé sur Bedford Avenue à deux blocks de l'appart!!

Niveau transport en commun compter 35 minutes en métro avec un changement pour atteindre Manhattan ou environ 25 à 30 $ en taxi!!!

We spent 10 days in NY and this flat has been perfect. Great location, spacious, well organized, clean, comfortable bed.  Just at subway exit, it's near to enjoyable places in Brooklyn like Brooklyn Musuem, Prospect Park, Dumbo, Williamsburg for shopping and eating out. 
Civan is a good adviser for exhibitions and has excellent taste for art galeries. He's been helpful and trustful.

Apartment was exactly as pictured. An easy place to lounge about with a comfortable bed. Didn't spend too much time right around the apartment--though there is a deli with great Dominican food just around the corner (just says Deli above a black awning)-but the apartment is less than half a block to the subway to take you to the other areas of Brooklyn you may want to spend more time in. Civan was a great host, particularly with my last minute booking. Great communication and was flexible with timing of when to meet us to pick up and retrieve the keys. Would stay again.

Civan is a really great host; he is very friendly and helpful. His apartment is quiet and there is a very nice view, especially on the roof. The subway is at 1 minute on foot direct to Manhattan! There is one bedroom and a great sitting room. The kitchen is quite lightly equipped to cook .We spend a very nice week on this place.

Civan's place was great! Very comfy stay and it was very clean! The area was great and it was not a bad subway ride into the city! Subway stop is literally right beside the apartment!  Civan was a great host and was good at communicating with picking up and dropping off the keys when checking in and checking out and if I ever had any questions during my stay he responded immediately!  I would definitely stay at his place again when visiting!!!

Civans place was nice and simple, everything you would need. The apartment is very close to the subway and easy to find. Civan and his friends took good care of us two lost swedes when got to NY and gave us a good guide so we could find the place. It was kind of hot in the apartment due to the heat wave and one night some one across the street had a bit of a loud party but other than that we had a good stay!
Nice apartment, great location (10 seconds away from the subway). Easy to get anywhere in New York!

Our stay in Civan's place was really great! He's very nice and helpful. I stayed there with my boyfriend for a week, and the apartment was perfect for a couple. The neighborhood is quiet and safe and the subway is almost 10 steps from his door, very close and well connected to Manhattan. If I go back to New York, I would stay at his apartment again. 
Thanks for all Civan!

Civan was great at accommodating my very last minute booking and he's a super nice guy!
His apartment is pretty bare bones and basic, but it's clean, interestingly decorated, incredibly close to the subway, and was exactly what I needed during my stay.

The apartment was exactly what we saw on the pictures. Very clean, cozy and near the G line station. 
Civan was the perfect host: kind and respectful. He helped us when we needed.
We recommend this place!

Civan is really an nice host. Helpful and friendly. The apartment was exactly like you see on the pictures. A quiet place, just next to the G Line, really easy to find.
The neighborhood is also really nice, even for a girl who's traveling alone.

We really liked the area. It is very close to the subway and there are some really nice cafes around. We enjoyed our stay a lot. Civan is very caring, it is very easy to organise everything,s o that was great.

The place is nice and simple, as described and pictured. Civan was very helpful and gave us advice regarding directions, nearby shops etc. 
Although if you are planning to spend most of the time on Manhattan this is not the best location because you'll have to switch subway lines to get there and it turned out that it takes significant amount of time.
But it's really close to Williamsburg which is also a great area to explore.
The reservation was canceled the day before arrival. This is an automated posting.

Civan is a great host. He was very helpful in pointing out the various cafe, groceries and utilities around the place. The flat is beautiful and less than a minute from the subway station. Great stay overall!

Very beautiful apt, in a quiet contest. Great sight from the window. Civan was very nice with me, even if i was in late for the check in! The city is awesome, but also this apt is great, full of books and great works of phitography! I think i'll ask for it again the next time in NYC!
The reservation was canceled 3 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.
The reservation was canceled 15 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.

Civan's place was located right next to the G train which was perfect for all our adventures in Brooklyn. There was also ample street parking right in front! His place was clean and comfortable. But most importantly civan was so easy to communicate with and hospitable our entire stay! I would definitely stay at his place again.
Civans place is by the train and in a safe location. The apartment is as shown and Civan is accommodating for check in and out. Loved our stay

We enjoyed staying at Civan's apartment. It was as described and the neighborhood was really nice. We felt there was still a genuine mixity, not too gentrified however with good coffee places nearby ;) right next to a metro station but be ware, it might take a little while to get to Manhattan. Communication with Civan was easy. We recommend it!

The apartment is quite good located with a subway station so close (2 mins walking). The apartment is nice and cute. The bed is so comfortable. The only negative point was the noise, the fridge made noise (not much if you close the bedroom door) and the first night was a party close by and you can hear everything from the bedroom. Rest really nice.

Book Civan's place. My boyfriend and I went up to NY for a hockey game in Brooklyn and Civan's apartment was in the perfect location for enjoying both Brooklyn and the city. Civan was super flexible with check-out and check-in times and very helpful. The apartment was super chic and clean for being in an older building. The area was very safe and literally 3 minutes from the G train that can get you to or connect you to any other train needed. Overall, we had an amazingly fun and comfortable time and Civan's place was the foundation for that.
civan is a great host. everything was like in the description. he is very helpful and easy going. we could check-in and check-out whenever we wanted. we would recommand civan without any doubt.

The apartment is great! Super cozy and fits our needs pretty well! 
The most important it is very close to the subway (G line) and lots of grosseries stores around.

Civan war der perfekte Gastgeber. Er war so freundlich auf uns zu warten da wir aufgrund des Stadtverkehrs doch etwas später ankamen als angekündigt. Das Apartment war super sauber als wir ankamen. Wir haben uns gleich wohl gefühlt. Haben auch ein paar mal selbst gekocht da die Küche sehr gut ausgestattet ist. Die Lage war top! Einige Supermärkte, Cafés und 2 U-Bahnstationen in nächster Nähe. In der Nacht ist es ab und zu etwas lauter, aber das haben wir in Brooklyn schon erwartet und hat uns nicht gestört. Am Morgen haben uns dafür die Eichhörnchen und die Manhattan Skyline vor dem Fenster begrüßt. Wir können Civan und sein Apartment nur empfehlen!

Civan’s place was perfect for my week-long stay in the city. I never met him but we Facetimed before and made a plan for where i could access the keys when arriving. Nice hot shower, relaxing and comfy bed - I saw someone commented on a noisy fridge but i didn’t notice that at all. It’s pretty spacious especially for the money, and was nice to hang out in the apt and have morning coffee or a quiet evening. It’s right on the G train too, location perfect for me.

Civan is super quick at responding which made the transaction easy. 
Great location in a sense that it's easy to get to Manhattan. You'll also find cheap places to eat in the neighborhood and an awesome coffee shop just around the corner. 
Air conditioning was provided in the bedroom, a TRUE blessing!
Overall we had a nice stay and would book again -
Civan apartment is perfect ,nice size apartment ,very clean and transportation right on the corner .

Sweet place to stay, with free places on the street to park your car if you have one!
Civan was very kind, very easy to reach and he cared about us during our entire trip! It was really appreciated.
Civans place was great. We were in town over new year and needed somewhere close to a friend a few blocks away.

name: Beautiful Apt, Tropical Resort, Steps to the Beach
summary: Our nightly rate includes already the mandatory Hawaii State Tax of 14.42%. Spacious 2BR/2BA Vacation Rental Condo in a Beautiful Resort with well-manicured Japanese zen garden. directly across the street from the beach.
space: Beautiful and spacious describes this 2 bedroom, 2 bathroom condo at the Kihei Resort. This 1000+ square-foot, fully furnished condo has all of the amenities of home and overlooks the pool and spa areas. This Condo is just minutes away from restaurants, shopping and many other first class South Maui beaches. Kihei Resort is a small intimate complex of only 64 units that is lushly landscaped to give you a true tropical Hawaiian experience. The Resort offers a very nice Pool, Hot Tub & BBQ Area. Highlights of the Condo: - Fully equipped kitchen - Washer and dryer. - AC in the living room and upstairs bedroom - Ceiling Fans in all of the rooms - Queen size sofa-sleeper in the living room - Tub/shower in both bathrooms - 32" Flatscreen TV - DVD player - Free wifi - Free parking spot - Pool, hot tub and BBQ area on the common grounds Maximum occupancy of 4 people. We do not accept 3rd Party bookings.

Spacious 2BR/2BA Vacation Rental Condo in a Beautiful Resort with well-manicured Japanese zen garden. directly across the street from the beach. neighborhood_overview: Safe and quiet neighborhood! Shopping, restaurants and golfing just minutes away! Nearest Beach: Kihei Beach, across the street - approx. 0.16 miles
notes: Beach chairs, beach umbrella, a cooler and beach towels are provided for our guests use. This is a family owned condo. Please treat the condo how you would treat your own home. This is strictly a "non-smoking" rental unit. Maximum occupancy of 4. We do not accept Third Party bookings. Children are welcome but the unit is not childproofed and does not have a crib, high-chairs or Pack 'n Play.
transit: Car Rental recommended.  Local Bus service throughout Maui.  Shops, Restaurant just min. away per bus or car.
access: Resort Amenities: - 1 Pool and Jacuzzi, - Free parking - BBQ Area with outside dining area
interaction: After booking, we will send you all of your check-in instructions via email. We are available during your stay via email and cell phone.
house_rules: 1) CHECK-IN AND CHECK-OUT:   Check-in time is 4:00pm and later, check-out time is 11:00am or ealier on your departure date. You will receive an email with the check-in instruction of the unit once the reservation is complete. 2) CHECK-OUT PROCEDURES:    Upon check-out please  a) put all perishables and food items in the refrigerator.  b) turn off all lights, fans and air conditioners.  c) place all trash in the trash cans.  d) lock all the doors and leave the keys on the kitchen counter and put the key from the lockbox back into the lockbox. 3) DAMAGES:  Please notify us immediately of any damages to the property. Guests agree that any of her/his group members, including children, and or those who are legally allowed onto the property, shall pay a replacement value and or repair cost for any furniture, fixtures and or fittings being damaged during the term of their stay.  4) NOISE:   Please keep in mind that you are in a long and short term neighborhood. Noise carries easily and we ask

host.host_about:
Anke Kirchner, R(S) & Property Manager - Next Maui Vacation LLC/ A Division of SRH Inc.

Aloha, I'm Anke, Realtor, surfer, runner & kiteboarder living on Maui. I specialize in buying and selling homes and condos on Maui and I love what I do! 

Love, Live Aloha!

reviews.comments: The codo is very nice, beautiful and spacious. Two bedrooms, which both stayed a decent temperature at night. Also has 2 AC units. Pretty cool balcony. I enjoyed staying on the balcony on my laptop and watching the sunshine or the rain falling. Washer/dryer were nice to have. Anke was extremely responsive to my calls, and even brought over garbage bags when we ran out. I also enjoyed the pool. The condo is within walking distance of a beach, which is nice.

Anke, 
Your place was wonderful for our family. The kids used the pool every day, my parents participated at the ukulele jam session at Keolahou Church, and my wife and I loved running by the beach.  Thank you again for making our stay memorable. 
Aloha, 
jason

We absolutely loved the place! It has everything you might need during your stay. Close to the beach and a short driving distance (~10 minutes) to a number of good restaurants. Anke was super nice and helpful. I highly recommend this place for staying in Maui.
Everything was great!

This condo is amazing and perfect for a one week plus stay. It's very spacious and, with the two AC units plus the ceiling fans, can stay cool despite the hot weather. It's right across the street from the beach and kitty corner to 2 parks. It's also really close to a lot of good eats! It has a full kitchen and comes with cooking utensils which allowed us to cook and prep meals for extended days out (i.e.  Road to Hana). To our surprise, the condo came equipped with beach chairs and a boogie board which we took full advantage of.  It also comes with in-unit laundry and dryer as well as soap and dryer sheets! The resort is very quiet and the people who live there are respectful of quiet hours. You get to meet fellow travelers and residents in the pool / jacuzzi area which is also a plus. All in all, we enjoyed our stay. Just don't forget to bring your own soap and shampoo!
Everything was as described! A very beautiful and clean condo directly at the beach in Kihei. Anke was also very responsive and helpful, would love to come back any time!

Anke communicated very well with me prior to arriving.  She sent me documents that gave me clear directions to the condo.  Once I arrived I noticed that I did not need anything as everything I could possibly need was at my finger tips.  I will definitely stay at this condo again.   Thank you Anke.

Our stay at Kihei Resort was wonderful. The place was perfect for the 4 of us. The place was spacious, clean, comfortable, quiet and well located. The condo had many amenities such as the community pool and free guest parking and was situated 5-15 mins drive from many eateries and stores. The beach is walking distance away across the street and Wailea is only about a 10-15 drive away as well. Anke was a great host giving us all the necessary information we would need as well as checking up on us via message during our stay to make sure all was fine. Definitely recommend this place for travelers! In the heart of Kihei and close to the airport and other attractions.

This is a beautiful place by a beautiful beach with great amenities, like hot tub and swimming pool. You probably don't need them though. Just walking across the street, you can snorkel in waist deep blue water, where I saw five turtles and a lot of fish. It is very safe for kids or people don't swim. 

The place provides enough towels so you don't need to pack them. Washer and dryer is conveniently located in the unit - not those coin operating ones. 

Anke is very nice too. We got a box of chocolate as gift when we arrived :)

Everything was exactly as described and we were made to feel welcome immediately with a nice little care package and local tour guide notebook!

The Kihei resort is amazing and very private and low key and relaxing.  The spa and pool area is great at the end of a long day of adventures.

I would recommend Anke and her property to anyone!
Anke was very helpful and the apartment was everything you'd expect and more. We had a great time I would highly recommend this place to others.

This place has beautiful gardens and a nice pool and hot tub in a quiet community. We really enjoyed our stay and it was a very short drive to the south or north to get to great beaches. You can easily walk to the beach as well if you don't mind using the shoulder. We did a good amount of cooking and had everything we needed.

Pros :
Close to the beaches
Quiet
Beautiful garden
Having own Washer and dryer
Beach toys, umbrella, small surf board, beach towels, beach chairs provided

Cons :
Kids under 14 years are not allowed in the hot tub (The policy we received before we got to the condo didn't mention anything about kids not allowed to use the hottub)
The sink and bathtub drains don't work very well
Old and dated property 
Restaurants, grocery stores, coffee shops are in driving distance (you can only walk to the beaches and one Korean restaurant that I wouldn't recommend anyone to go. 
Poor quality kitchen equipment  (if you try to cut or cook anything, it will be challenging)
I broke $40 blender and I got charged for $80.73 for it so don't break anything :) 

This place is ok but not if you have young children. It's more suitable for people without children, retired people. 
Oh, they also don't recycle or compost so if you have any environmental consciousness, it is probably not suitable for you.

Beautiful condo in a gorgeous development full of well manicured gardens.  The view over the tropical garden and overlooking the pool is lovely.  The condo was super clean and quite huge.  Everything you could possible need and perfect for a group of 4!  Very smooth check in and communication process.  Thank you Anke for everything!
A great location and nice and spacious condo. We loved our stay here, and Anke was very quick to help us with anything we had questions about!

Anke's Condo was amazing! A beautiful two bedroom, walking distance to the water, and came with every amenity possible. Unfortunately, our flight was canceled so we did not arrive until the next day and our travel was extended. We were very nervous, because we thought we would have to arrange an extra night stay else where, but luckily Anke was very understanding and allowed another night. We could not thank her enough for her time and help. I would highly recommend Anke and her condo to anyone and everyone.

This property has it pros and cons.

Pros:
Anke was very responsive and nice.
The place is nice and clean.
The condo is right above the pool which was nice.
People there was very nice.

Cons:
It's a older property which was fine but the condo was old as well.
AC units are on the top floor and middle floor but not in the middle bedroom. Which got hot in the room but it was humid when we stayed at.
There was no sideway outside the resort which was not safe to walk outside.
There were some bikers staying there as well which was loud sometime because of the bike. 

If you to want walk around in Kihei then I would recommend another place near the kamaole beach 1-3.

Overall, it was a ok stay for us but my kids loved the place because they had the upstairs to themselves. Lol

The condo is beautiful and well-furnished.  All appliances worked.  The supplies were more than adequate and easily found.  The host was always available via telephone and answered all questions clearly and quickly.  Would book again tomorrow if I could!

Anke's place is awesome, just as advertised. Mellow, low key and quiet. More over its beautiful and close to everything you'd need. Inside the complex it's like a little tropical village with plenty of greenery and birds gently chirping in the trees. Pool, hot tub, BBQ area,etc, etc. If you never left the complex you'd still have a great vacation! Outside the resort everything you need is close: supermarket, coffee shops, gas station. Great location to access roads for any point you'd want to go. Two thumbs up & 5 stars !!! I want to stay here again.
Thanks Anke.
We enjoyed our stay.
This condo was as described. A little worn but quite comfortable and clean. Good location.
Great place to stay at a great value!
This is an awesome condo. It was definitely one of our best vacations. We loved it!

This place really is across the street from a great swimmable beach (complete with a 500-year-old stone wall to hold off big waves), and is a twenty-minute walk to groceries, restaurants and other shops. Two bedrooms plus a futon in the living room, two bathrooms, laundry in the unit, full kitchen, and a closet full of beach equipment; plus, the condo's pool is twenty feet from the front door. Anke was great to work with; per her instructions, we let ourselves in, but when we had an issue with the shower (nothing broken, we just couldn't figure out the knob) she was over within minutes to help us out and say hi. Very recommended!
As advertised.

The place is spacious and central to both north side and south side of the island. The bedroom does not get a lot of AC since it is on the opposite end from the AC wall unit. There is an additional AC unit for the loft so that helps. We really enjoy our stay here, check in was easy and everything we need are there.
The apartment was clean and spacious. It is only a short walk from the beach and has a beautiful balcony. We can highly recommend this AirBnB.

We stayed there as a couple for 3 nights. Nice apartment and a big comfy bed. Well equipped with everything one needs for a stay at a condo in Maui. Unfortunately the jacuzzi was closed the other night, so we only got to use it once. However, Anke’s place is not the cheapest in Maui, you get a lot for what you pay for. 

Thanks Anke for our stay at your place

My stay was great. The condo was in great shape, supper clean, and well appointed. The location and the gardens in the main area were fantastic. I had a wonderful time and will likely rent this unit again on my next trip…if it is available.
Wonderful quiet and cozy place to stay with family.

Great location, very quiet, clean and spacious.
Walking distance to the beach and close to town. I really enjoyed my time there and I would stay there again.

The pictures are an accurate representation of Anke's place. Spacious, clean, and homie. Location is a little outside of town so you'll have to drive almost everywhere but it is quiet and the neighbors are friendly. Good spot for a getaway, with friends, or for a family.
Nice place in a good location.
Great location and it felt very homey.  I would recommend this to anyone visiting Maui!

The condo had a great location in southern Maui, close to everything. It had everything we needed and more. Everything was organized and well laid out and the condo was perfect for what we needed and expected. I would definitely stay there again and highly recommend the unit.

Anke was a great host, the place is very clean has all of the amenities you will need. The location is perfect, there is a beach and a great "cove" to snorkel across the street. Lahaina, Road to Hana and plenty of great beaches are within driving distance to make the most out of your time while in Maui.
My family loved this condo so much! It is adorable and perfect. It has everything we needed. We would definitely recommend this place! Hopefully we will be back soon!
Great location on Maui, easily accessible to beeches and any driving you wish to do around the island. Great local amenities, wonderful condo, fabulous, would highly recommend

Your host Anke is one of the most professional and promptly responsive owners you can only hope to deal with on your travels. 
The property is welcomingly quiet. Except for the grounds maintenance crew and their trusty leaf blower. It is far enough away from the regular hub-bub about 5mins further up the road where you will find all the shops, businesses, restaurants and resort/hotels. 
The beaches within walking distance are just ok. Nothing to expect from any Maui postcard. Great for a nice walk from the property to watch the sunset. 
Kihei Road is always busy, so watch for traffic when walking on the side of the road. 
Anke’s place has everything you will need. It is a very spacious, two level property with sleeping arrangements for numerous guests.

Anke's place is a great place to stay! It is easy to find and the location offers great access to many nearby beaches, stores, snorkel rental, local foods, etc. The condo is very spacious, clean and comfortable with more upscale amenities and all the personal toiletry items you need. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay there and highly recommend Anke's condo if you want to stay in the Kihei area.
Anke is a great host driven to provide you with the best experience and service. Thank you Anke!

Our family absolutely loved the Kihei Resort. The folks that live there full-time were friendly and easy to talk to. My children really enjoyed their company.  The onsite manager and his wife were amazing people. We had an issue with the pool key and Anke and the manager were very responsive and prompt.  I would absolutely highly recommend staying at this wonderful place in Kihei. Mahalo

Das waren paradiesähnliche Zustände!! Die Unterkunft ist wunderschön! Keine 3min zu Fuß - Straße überqueren - und man ist am Strand. Das Haus gehört zu einer sehr gepflegten Reihenhausanlage. Mit Pool und Jakuzzi. Es wird sehr auf Ruhe und Ordnung geachtet. Was wir sehr zu schätzen wussten. Die Unterkunft ist mit allen Utensilien ausgestattet, die zu einer Küche gehören. Dazu gibt es eine Waschmaschine und einen Trockner. Anke hat uns super umsorgt, zur Begrüßung gabs u.a. Ananas, Mango, Pralinen und Kaffee(!!). Und auch sonst konnten wir sie ansimsen wann immer wir wollten und bekamen, spätestens nach 5min eine Antwort! Anke gehört zu den fleißigsten, gastfreundschaftlichsten und freundlichsten Menschen, die wir überhaupt im Leben kennengelernt haben, wenn wir auf Reisen gehen. Und wir reisen sehr viel! Danke Anke!!!! :))) Kiss&Huge!!! :)))

Es war eine wirklich tolle Zeit in der Unterkunft von Anke. In der Wohnung sieht es wirklich so aus wie auf den Bildern. Super viel Platz zum Sitzen, Schlafen und für die ganzen Koffer / Klamotten. Die Wohnung ist liebevoll eingerichtet und besitzt alle notwendigen Haushaltsutensilien, so dass das Kochen in der Wohnung kein Problem darstellt. Der Weg zum Strand und Meer dauert 1 Min, also eine gute Lage. Zur Anlage gehört auch die Benutzung des Pools und Jacuzzi, die gut gepflegt sind. Es gab keine Mängel oder defekte Sachen in der Wohnung.
Nice spot. Good location.
great condo just across the street from a beautiful sandbarred beach, where you can swim with turtles! it was clean, comfy, and perfect for our family vacation.

We had a great time staying at Anke's place. There was a kitchen, air conditioning and 2 bathrooms, which is appreciated. The home is a bit dated but is very clean and has the amenities we wanted. The home was also in walking distance to the water and had a pool as well. We were very comfortable here. Anke was great in fixing minor issues. The power to the loft was not working when we arrived and we could not find the cooler or hand soap. Anke had some dropped off and fixed the power while we were away after notifying us that she intended to do so. We appreciated her fast response. She left a little welcome basket as well which was nice after traveling. One disappointment I had was that the dryer was not working. I had to air dry and blow dry my clothes over night before flying out early the next day.
We enjoyed our stay in Kihei immensely, and Anke's place was great.  It's very close to the beach, and we appreciated having the selection of beach items that were available in the condo.

Overall a solid place to stay, missing a few details (toiletries, spotty WiFi, beach supplies). I would not recommend it for families or anyone noise averse, but it would be great for couples or friends traveling together. There was a pesky rooster nearby that was constantly crowing, and the regular construction/lawn maintenance noise was fairly substantial. The upstairs loft is very pleasant and well furnished, but completely open to the downstairs area with no way to block sound or light (we knew this going in but didn’t realize how taxing that would be). The patio was great and we enjoyed being central on the island and the lot always had parking. There was a washer/dryer in the unit, which was a pleasant surprise, but the dryer wasn’t terribly reliable. The kitchen was equipped well enough for simple meals and it’s not too far from a grocery store!
My friends and I had a great experience staying at Anke’s place. It’s clean, has everything we needed and is at a convenient location. I will definitely recommend it to my other friends!

This is a perfect property for a small family with essentially 2 bedrooms and 2 full baths located only a couple minutes walk to Kalepolepo beach park where you can swim with sea turtles in a calm , shallow water environment. The property  may have somewhat outdated decor but is well appointed and clean.

Beautiful quiet tropical property. Walked across the street to a great beach that wasn’t too busy (saw turtles multiple times - plus). Easy drive to nearby restaurants. The beach supplies were just okay. There was really only one “good” beach chair. The rest were more like camping style chairs - we ended up rotating who got the good chair - not ideal. We were also disappointed that there wasn’t better seating for a place that hosts up to 4 guests. There wasn’t anywhere for all 4 of us to sit together and eat or play a card game comfortably. We loved the pool and the hot tub - it was never too crowded and just steps from the unit (we were here during a peak time - New Years). We also ate at the beach front Indian restaurant across the street which was nice. The unit is a bit more dated than the images portray. The AC units (one in the loft one in the living room) worked great but the downstairs bedroom does get a bit warm.  Anke was very responsive whenever we needed anything!
Very nicely appointed, great location.
Anke is a lovely host.  She makes effort to correct any problem.  The unit is comfortable and in a great location.  Enjoy your stay.

We had a wonderful stay! The unit has great access to the beach and is close to grocery stores and restaurants. The space had everything we needed including sand toys for our kiddo and beach towels and beach chairs/umbrella. We had an issue with internet service mid way through our stay and Anke took care of it immediately. The grounds are very well cared for and we enjoyed the pool and hot tub. The complex does not have recycling but we found a recycling center nearby.

name: Affordable Guest Room
summary: This listing is for our Bedroom with Shared kitchen, bathrooms, lanai, and other common areas. The room offers one king-size bed. It is a bit more spacious than our other private rooms. Therefore, if you need a little extra space, this may suit you best! With beautiful peach walls; hints of blue; and windows that look out on our beautiful Hawaiian gardens, this nautical room delights everyone from all ages and backgrounds. We do have AC.
space: Kalani Hawaii is not your typical "place to stay." As a fusion of all accommodation styles, we are a unique, boutique Private Lodging offering our guests the finest accommodations on the North Shore. Our rooms are rented out individually or joined in privacy for families or groups of travelers. What you will experience at Kalani Hawaii is an escape from the everyday rush, a peek through the palm trees to see how life exists when you're on island time. We offer once in a lifetime memory, beautiful vistas, breathtaking sunsets, and short strolls to famous beaches, snorkeling, world class surfing, and much, much more. Your personal day begins when you want it to and only requires you to share the sand and warm Pacific with sleepy turtles, tropical fish, jumping porpoise - and surfers during our winter big wave season. Oh yes, and you'll find many others just like you, in awe of our sunsets that truly have no rival on either side of the equator, so enjoy every second of your stay!

We offer once in a lifetime memory, beautiful vistas, breathtaking sunsets, and short strolls to famou
neighborhood_overview: We love that we live in one of the most beautiful places on Earth. Known as the "7 Mile Miracle," the North Shore of Oahu is one of the most sought after places for vacationers. We're lucky enough not only to live steps away from world class beaches, surf breaks, and historic Haleiwa town, but we are a serene getaway amongst all of it.
notes: As we are a fusion of all accommodation styles we want to clear up any confusion with regards to what we offer as a private lodging. We offer private rooms and studios as well as shared dorm style rooms, and everyone has access to shared common areas. We serve breakfast upon request only at an additional charge. Parking is private and secure at no additional charge. Security cameras around property and hallways. Complimentary phone for all USA calls is available.
transit: The buses in Hawaii are some of the most efficient around and we have a bus stop just a short walk up the road. If you'd like to be more mobile we suggest renting a bike or car. Otherwise, we're only a few steps away from many of the world's most famous beaches.
access: Guests will have access to all shared common areas at our lodging which includes a large kitchen, lounge area, our expansive outdoor gardens, a shared patio seating area with BBQ & TV as well as bathrooms, laundry and surfboard/bike storage. Please see our website for photos of all the wonderful areas you can access.
interaction: We are available for any questions you may have but our goal is to allow you to relax in peace - when you need us, we're there, otherwise enjoy your escape on the North Shore of Oahu.

host.host_location: On the "7 miles miracle" known as the North Shore of Oah'u, Hawaii.
host.host_about: Aloha! I am the proprietor of a private lodging on the North Shore of Oah'u, a place where you will find an escape from the everyday, relaxation, and some of the most beautiful beaches in the world. Here we enjoy the beautiful weather, lush jungle surroundings, and the way the sunlight glistens off the Pacific. If you'd like to join us at Kalani Hawaii Private Lodging you can find more info about us on our website at (Website hidden by Airbnb)

reviews.comments: Very well received and very clean room.  Great help from the owners.  Good facilities.

name: Old School Hospitality
summary: This spacious ground-floor apartment can sleep four very comfortably.  It has two bedrooms, one bathroom, living room, dining area, an indoor waterfall, and stocked kitchen, There is a beautiful lanai that overlooks a large koi pond and spacious, manicured grounds. We call the property Old School Hospitality because it was built from recycled materials from the old Hakalau School. Much of the house's charm comes from the unique materials used in construction.
space: This charming apartment has an indoor waterfall that immerses you in a tropical setting. The unit has many custom features; the shower has lava and granite features and opens to the outdoors.

notes: The one acre is fully landscaped and has fruit trees and many palms.

reviews.comments: Old Schoolhouse Hospitality is a dream stay. Everything had attention to detail and was very comfortable. I especially loved the peaceful feel inside and outside. I encourage everyone to stay here.

This is an awesome place, new modified level with an incredible art design from every room. The  beautiful indoor pond with water fall and outdoor pond, tastefully decorated with every need thought of, well supplied  kitchen made cooking at home easy. The area is not in a common location but if you are looking for a quiet area to relax, enjoy the typical scenery out of the traffic. This house was a pleasure to stay in, the host Jim and Ted are very welcome to their gussets  and made every thing easy.

The hosts, house and grounds were truly amazing.  It  is what one images Hawaii to be beautiful and  relaxing.  It is about 16 miles into Hilo but I was looking for a  private getaway and found it at their home.  The hosts had built this home  and the attention  to details are to be appreciated.    The lava rock fireplace, kitchen area where you can enjoy a meal while looking out to  their private oasis and many other personal touches that will make your stay a true pleasure.

A beautiful and peaceful property. This home is a gem! Family friendly environment and "hip" enough for the singles. Jim was a very friendly host and provided us will all the amenities that we needed! We were able to cook dinner and breakfast due to the fully loaded kitchen. The back yard was defiantly one of the highlights of this Gem. The home has a great character to it and we will be back to stay for another weekend in the future!

Jim and Ted were amazing hosts! They go above and beyond in making a stay with them enjoyable. They provided valuable feedback and answered our questions before and during our stay. The accommodations are beautiful and comfortable. They undoubtedly made our trip to Hawaii the best possible experience possible for our family. They encapsulate what Airbnb is all about. We hope to host them on the mainland some time. ;)
Beautiful self built house and thoughtful host! Perfect for exploring this side of the island and the volcano! Thanks Jim!
Jim location is a must go if you are in the area such a wonderful and caring host and also his home is a great experience in its own. Loved and enjoyed every minute and the history is just amazing.

Jim's place is a tropical paradise. Beautiful koi pond in the backyard that my 2 kids (10 and 9 y.o) could not get enough of the tadpoles, micro frogs, toads, variety of fish. He also has a variety of great games that my kids enjoyed, did not miss having a TV. Place is clean and lovely, and fans provided nice breeze since no AC. Also no dryer but clothes line with the fans dried our clothes well. Location of the house is terrific for all locations near Hilo, and going to Akaka falls, botanical gardens, and volcano national park. Couldn't have asked for a better location and stay, Jim even provided fresh fruits and veggies and sent us off with freshly baked blueberry scones. Thanks again Jim!

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and certainly plan to return if Jim will have us back.  The Old School Hospitality is a paradise within the paradise of Hilo/Keaau and was so comfortable.  We absolutely loved the indoor waterfall and the fabulous spacious bathroom and outdoor shower!  Though there was no kitchen oven, only a gas stove top and microwave, we found it very easy to work around it.  As the setting is so serene, one of our favorite things were waking up each morning and enjoying our coffee and/or mimosa's on the patio while taking in the wildlife and beautiful fruit trees and soft breezes.  We seriously can't to book again! ❤️

We really enjoyed our stay. Beautiful home and landscaping. Jim was an excellent host and we enjoyed learning about the local history of the house. The space is large and has all kinds of extras - everything you might need.

Before reserving, Jim promptly answered all my questions. His property is lovely and the space is clean, comfortable, and quiet, just as described. The bathroom is wonderful. What made the experience special was the aloha hospitalty. Felt welcomed as a friend, was invited to share a few meals and he helped with questions about the local area. At the same time, there was plenty of privacy. If you want to be in this area, this is a terrific choice.
Loved every aspect of our experience with Jim.  The scenery was breathtaking and accommodations were over the top! There's no other place we want to stay except right here!!  Amazing time!!

This is a remarkable place. We were overwhelmed by Jim's hospitality and the charming house itself. Our three days were way too short to enjoy all the cozy corners of the apartment and its surroundings. It's a good place to stay clear but still close enough to Hilo. Volcano National Park is only a 40 minutes drive away. If you want to have a relaxed place to stay in the Hilo area outside of town - stay at Jim's!
Beautiful scenery, quite place, lovely cats, great host :)

Your villa is a fashion, beautiful, clean. The garden in front of the is very sweet to grow a lot of fruit. We have just arrived at the villa, the landlord sent all kinds of fruit, kinds; papaya; banana ; hu you;oranges and so on. Everything needs to be satisfied. All of them are first-class. We really enjoyed the time here. We`ll come if we have time. Thank you for bringing us good memories. Thank you for your own cake. It`s very delicious.

Merry Christmas!

This place is AMAZING! Jim and Ted are amazing hosts who went above and beyond with their generosity. The rooms were spacious and charming as seen in the pictures and the house was clean and welcoming. The pool table was really fun and we loved the view of the backyard (watching the koi and neighborhood chickens). This is the perfect place to relax and unwind. My only regret is that our time there passed so quickly. Out of our whole trip in Hawaii, this place was the family's favorite. Will book again :)

We had an amazing stay at Old School Hospitality. The house is beautiful and rich in history. The backyard is well kept and allowed for exploring. The kitchen had everything we needed including fresh fruit and flowers from the yard. The shower was a highlight, you could look up and see the trees and sky.  We felt secluded but were close to all things volcano and to the black sand beaches. Jim went above and beyond to make us feel welcomed. We would stay here again in a heartbeat!

This place is a gem in the jungle!  It's is spacious, stylish, clean, quiet and simply beautiful.  The hosts, Jim and Ted, are fantastic and very prompt in communication.  I would recommend this place to anyone travels to the Big Island.

Irene

A bit out of the way if staying to see the Volcanic National Park, 30-45 minutes, but the back yard is so lush and beautiful. They allowed us to stay one night and we made our reservations rather last minute. A most unique place with lovely colors, wood floors, pool table and the bathroom is to die for especially the shower.

Jim is a very kind host with true aloha spirit. His place is truly unique with the indoor waterfall and waterfall like shower.  It is in a semi rural setting and at night you will be serenaded by the tree frogs and birds.  Thank you again for your hospitality!
This is a great place to stay for a couple of nights or more. The grounds are beautiful. The inside is well constructed, beautiful, spacious & super clean. The shower was a pleasure.

Прекрасная база для тех, кто хочет исследовать восточную часть острова. Огромные апартаменты с прудом и двором, невероятно гостеприимные хозяева и дом с уникальной историей. Рекомендую.

I would recommend to stay in Jim&Todd’s place for everyone who wants to explore East side of Big Island. 

It was unforgettable to live in their unique house. There are plenty of space, huge backyard with a fish pond, lots of nice and sweet details like fresh fruits and flowers, coffee and tea in the kitchen, classy furniture and floors and a unique bathroom made of lava. And there are orchids blooming right on your backyard (Website hidden by Airbnb) 
Jim and Todd hospitality exceeds any expectations. Jim did all to make us feel very welcomed, he gave us lots of recommendations and even took us to the local event with Hawaiian music. Thank you so much guys, we hope to see you again! Masha, Kosta and Max.

Amazing surroundings, postcard location, gorgeous accommodation. We have stayed in the same estate previously and Jim’s place offers everything you could want. We travelled with our 3yo and he loved he place also. Thx Jim

We had a lovely stay at Old Hospitality.  The place is very big - two full bedrooms, living room, large dining table under the sun/rain room, kitchen, and the amazing bathroom.  It rained every day we were there and the fountain would trickle water whenever the pond above got full enough.  We ate breakfast looking out over the lawns at the large pond, eating fresh fruits grown on the property.  It was lovely.
Wonderful host and a beautiful home!

My wife, myself, and one of our friends stayed here for two nights and loved it. It was close to Kalapana and the Lava, easy to get to Hilo. The place is great, well decorated and clean, nice kitchen that was easy to cook in, and we enjoyed the pool table and stereo for some light music. Shower was beautiful, and the indoor waterfall/pond thing was very cool. Loved the outdoor koi pond. Beautiful place and we’d highly recommend it! The kind of place we took plenty of pictures of, to remember the great place we stayed during our trip! Jim was also very nice and responsive. Went above and beyond to help us enjoy our stay

What a fabulous experience at Jim’s Old School Hospitality Airbnb. The accommodations are unique & absolutely stunning. Everything you need and more at this place. It was so relaxing! We felt like we were in our own tropical paradise. Highly recommend!

This place is awesome! 
I highly recommend this place

Old hospitality is just as advertised. The space was absolutely beautiful. You feel cocooned away in your own little paradise. It was a central location to all the place we went and to our friends who lived on the island. Jim was a great host. He made sure we checked in and had everything we needed. The waterfall is an awesome feature, and the shower was so nice. He even gave us some lemons. We will definitely be back soon. Thank you Jim and Ted.

Jim’s old school hospitality lived up to is name! Wonderful hosts, a lovely apartment, lots of space to hangout In the back yard and enjoy the koi pond. 
Should the Puna area be what you are looking for this is the place to stay. Hilo is 20 minuets away, Pahoa is 15 minuets in the other direction. lots of good food in both areas. Loved the time we spent here!

We have nothing but great things to say about our brief stay at Jims place.  It's better than advertised.   So serene.  It's like a mystical jungle with great , very clean amenities.  The indoor waterfall is great and the open air shower is fun too.  Book for sure, you will not be disappointed.

Magical...  what an incredible place to stay and an absolutely fabulous host.  Thank you Jim!  :)  Words cannot express how amazing of an experience it was for all of us to stay here.  Our only regret is that we didn't get to stay longer.  If you want a true "aloha" experience - this is a place you will find it.    
Mahalo nui loa ~
What a beautiful home! Jim and his partner built an extraordinary home. Jim’s hospitality is second to none. You are surrounded by tropical life and sounds and beauty. Amazing experience!

Jim’s place is gorgeous, it really is a special place, very tropical and lush. The home is immaculate, the shower is awesome and if you forgot anything, it’s probably already there! One thing to note is that the WiFi is not the strongest - enough to spot check weather and email but probably wouldn’t work if you were doing business. Fortunately for us we left work at home. Oh and Jim made us delicious scones on our last day!

We were a group of 3 friend staying at this wonderful property for 4 nights and loved every moment of it! The host was very responsive from the very beginning of the booking and arranged for his kind neighbour to check us in on our first day. The property is incredibly spacious (even bigger than it looks in the pictures), spotlessly clean and full of lovely details, you will feel like home in no time. The location is ideal for exploring around Hilo and secluded for a peaceful rest after a day out hiking and enjoying the area. The garden with the pond was a great touch and we enjoyed all the night sounds from the surrounding nature. Jim was very welcoming and offered to help with anything we may need for our stay. We loved it and would surely return!
Highly recommended! Two large bedrooms, lovely living room and a very beautiful garden with a pond. Pretty clean. I wish I could spend a whole day there without going out.

This is a piece of paradise! You can hear birdsong and enjoy the great scenery from any room!  Bright and airy.  Kids loved the huge backyard where they could feed koi and tadpole in the morning.  Board games and the pool table were a hit at night!  Host was quick to respond to any questions and requests.  Close to the tidepools and the Maku'u market (love it!).  It's a bit far from restaurants and shops (30 min each way) but the kitchen has everything you need to make an easy meal.  It's a huge place for the 4 of us!  Just note that they don't have a dryer.  But they have a clothes line ropes and most of our items dried within a day.

Jim's place is such a serene tropical paradise. This place stimulates all senses like scents of the flowers around , sounds of birds,  animals, rain and thunder, sight of chickens and birds, lush green tropical, koi pond and the well lit backyard by lightning, touch the hard and porous lava rocks, feel the velvety backyard .  We couldn't spend much time as planned but we took lots of pictures , had some fun playing pool table and sitting in the sun/rain room. Loved the shower with all amenities. Thank You for sharing such a serene space with travelers like us !
Jim is a wonderful host with a very comfortable, beautiful AirBnB. Definitely worth staying at Old School Hospitality!
Perfect place to kick back and unwind. Jim is very helpful if you need anything or have any questions.
자연속에 멋진집이 최고였어요

This is a beautiful and unique place in a very rural community.  I LOVED falling asleep to the sound of the frogs (but the frogs are loud, so if you're sensitive to noise that may be a problem. They come out only at night). The indoor/outdoor shower was amazing. Jim let us feed the koi fish in the backyard and that was a treat. No TV and very little cell phone reception out there, but I didn't mind. House was clean and quiet. Jim was a great host.

The accommodations were beautiful. We enjoyed the pool table and the Koi pond. The grounds are meticulously well maintained. Jim is a very gracious host. The location is close to Hilo providing a good selection of excellent restaurants should you decide not to use the kitchen facilities. At night you can hear the coquis, frogs and toads that in habit the Koi pond.  Though having most of the modern conveniences it maintains a certain amount of rusticity.

We stayed at this rental for 10 nights.  Jim's place truly lives up to its name, Old School Hospitality. There are plenty of resources and amenities. The kitchen is well stocked with everything you need to cook a decent meal (gas cooking, too).  The bed linens are soft, beds comfortable; sparkling clean everywhere. We didn't have to buy shampoo and soap like in other rentals, because a generous amount was provided for the four of us. The fish pond with waterlilies in front of the patio is gorgeous, and one can hear the coqui and bull frogs at night with their enchanting concerto. 
 A good place for snorkeling nearby is Richardson Beach Park. The beach is rocky, but there is live coral reef close to shore with a decent amount of fish, including schools of yellow tangs.  We have also seen sea turtles galore at the same place. For places to shop and dine, you can either look online or use Jim's  info for guests (look for a blue binder) which includes very useful local tips. 
Overall, we were very pleased with this rental and would stay there again. Thank you Jim and Ted!
Not many tourists make it out here, which is awesome. Loved Pahoa and some great drives around the coast. The house is immaculate, comfortable, and the grounds gorgeous. Highly recommended!
The place was amazing, especially the tropical garden with the pond - we loved to hear the sound of the coquis at night. Had a great time there!

This airbnb is a beautiful surprise.  Jim and Ted have created a gorgeous and spacious apartment that provides a very comfortable and relaxing space.  It offers all the conveniences and more.  You will lve your stay in their home!
Jim's place has everything you need if you need to get away from the hustle and bustle, beautiful setting and love the indoor water feature and 'out-door' shower...
Jim’s place was wonderful. Clean, beautiful and peaceful .  I loved the waterfall and pond in the back yard.

amazing place! if you're looking for a unique Hawaii experience that is also very comfortable and clean this is the place! felt like living in the rain forest, lots of nature with a magical indoor space which includes a waterfall and pond.
Hermoso lugar rodeado de vegetación, baño muy amplio y espacios generosos en las alcobas! La casa está muy bien dotada. Su anfitrión siempre pendiente.
位在農村小鎮,雖然附近不是特別熱鬧,但是開車前往pahoa並不遠,Jim的家有一座很棒的撞球檯,讓我們渡過非常開心的兩個夜晚,除此之外,也非常感謝Jim告訴我們附近的旅遊資訊,讓我們不會白跑一趟火山,這裡一切都非常的棒,除了比較潮濕一點,其他真的很推薦,應有盡有的airbnb!

the only problem with staying here is it will spoil you for other places. this house was hand built by jim and ted, who are professional builders and there is so much attention to detail. it’s important to note that those pictures are for your private space, not common areas. it’s huge, has an internal water feature, great kitchen, pool table, and glassed in dining nook which is great for experiencing rain storms without getting wet. jim and ted were so generous with their time but left us to our own devices when needed. it’s like staying with family but without any emotional baggage . really hoping our paths cross again

Beautiful and peaceful space with easy access to Volcano National Park, Hilo and the Big Island's fantastic scenery. Jim was a great host who always made us feel welcome and gave great tips to explore the area. We would definitely stay here again when we come back to the Big Island.

Jim & Ted's house was wonderful and fantastic.And they were always kind to us. Their villa was cool and fantastic, too.
I was lucky to meet Jim and Ted in Big Island.
Place was amazing inside and out, and we had the place to ourselves most of the time.

We absolutely loved staying here. The house is so well done, cozy and relaxing and the location was great, in between all things we wanted to explore. I unfortunately had to work a few days but the wifi worked perfectly. Jim was also so kind and wonderful. It was such a pleasure to meet him. He even brought us a cake for my mom's bday. Hope we can come back and visit again.

Jim and Ted's guest suite is a delightful place to stay. We enjoyed it greatly. The creativity and fine craftsmanship everywhere were a joy to see. As hosts, Jim and Ted are definitely 5 star, very thoughtful and helpful. We would highly recommend a stay in their suite, for a chance to spend time in a truly unique setting. Beautiful gardens and surroundings, and wonderful touches in décor everywhere make the experience rate far above a hotel stay. Mahalo nui loa to both of you.

The stay at Jim's was wonderful. He and his family were generous and thoughtful in preparing a beautiful guest apartment. It was comfortable, clean, cheerful, and of course, exotic, with a beautiful back yard, with chickens and frogs to add to the soundtrack. Highly recommend a stay here. Mahalo!
Jim and Ted's guest suite was amazing!  It was incredibly spacious, and it seemed like they had thought through every detail.  It was a perfect first place to stay during our visit to Hawaii.
Tropical paradise! We had a great time. Jim is a super nice host!

name: Newly Renovated Flat, McKibbin Loft
summary: Largest of three rooms available for rent throughout the month of March. Located in the famous McKibbin lofts the block of flats and surrounding area is buzzing with energy and creative individuals, the perfect location for your New York experience
space: This newly renovated flat has played a huge part in my personal experience of New York. The entire block is full of friendly and creative individuals, and the flat itself is occupied by some very close friends. It consists of a large living area with a kitchen space, and three bedrooms. Being on the third floor and having very high ceilings makes the rooms and flat generally soundproof. I am yet to experience and evening or night where any noise from surrounding flat's have been an issue.  The bathroom has a large shower and bath, again newly renovated with the apartment, in impeccable condition.  My room is the largest of the three, consisting of a raised queen sized bed, desk space, office chair and storage space. Even with all of this present theres is still, so much room for activities. Once again the high ceilings really open the space out with a ceiling fan for that light breeze on ya face while you sleep, bliss.

host.host_location: Kingston upon Thames, England, United Kingdom
host.host_about: 21 year old Graphic Designer and Photographer studying in London, originally from Ireland. Looking to spend my summer in New York with some relaxed and easy going people. Hoping to get a part time job, along with some internships/ placements at studios to keep me occupied during the day.

name: King Bedroom with Private Bathroom and Rooftop !
summary: Old Glove factory turned into lovely 3Bd/2Bth loft apartment. Huge Rooftop deck with BBQ and view from NYC Skyline, large room and living room, open kitchen, Gym in the basement. Master Bedroom with private Bathroom available, HVAC/heater in room.  The apartment is located 3mn away from the L train subway - Graham Stop. - 15mn subway to union square (Manhattan) - 20-25mn from Soho - Citibike station 1mn away  - Grocerie shopping and Liquor store 2mn away

host.host_location: New York, New York, United States
host.host_about: Sophie, French,  NYC

reviews.comments: Sophie's apartment was lovely. Huge bed! Whole apartment was very clean, including the bedroom and en suite bathroom. The communication prior and during our stay was excellent, both quick and helpful. Location was good, very close to subway that went straight into Manhattan. Sophie provided good tips of where to eat and have drinks. Would definitely stay here again if I return to the city and would recommend to others.

Sophie‘s Room is very stylish and very comfortable with its own bathroom. The bed is one of the best we ever slept in and the Metro is not far.  Unfortunately, the  rooftop was under construction but  sitting up there is certainly nice. We had a great stay and can definitely recommend the place. The communication with Sophie was great, she always responded superfast.

name: Big 2BR loft in ❤️of Williamsburg-5min to Manhattan
summary: Live the full Brooklyn experience by staying in this spacious artist loft in the heart of Williamsburg. Surrounded by parks, shops and restaurants, and   being just one stop away from the city, this 2BR apartment is perfect for a family vacation.
space: Spacious 2 bedroom loft in prime Williamsburg location. Lots of light coming from the windows in the living room and one of the bedrooms.  Both bedrooms are fully equipped with queen sized beds, and guests will be received with clean sheets and towels. Open kitchen and dinner table, one nice and clean bathroom. There is a projection screen in the living room and a futon that can fit 2 extra guests. description: Live the full Brooklyn experience by staying in this spacious artist loft in the heart of Williamsburg.
